PLACE BETS alongside your mates and watch the race play out in real time. Up to 8 players.

579423182.title: Agony
579423182.short_description: Agony is a first-person, survival horror set in the depths of hell. You will begin your journey as a tormented soul within the depths of hell without any memories about your past. The special ability to control people on your path, and possess demons, gives you the measures to survive.

580901123.title: Tropico 6
580901123.short_description: In times of political turmoil and social unrest, the people are calling for visionary leaders, who will steer the fate of their country with foresight and ingenuity. Prove yourself once again as a feared dictator or peace-loving statesman on the island state of Tropico and shape the fate of your very own banana republic through four distinctive eras. Face new challenges on the international stage and always keep the needs of your people in mind.

581869850.title: Crazy Strike Bowling EX
581869850.short_description: Crazy Strike Bowling EX is a family friendly bowling game featuring anime style characters and wacky bowling alleys. Play as Aiden, Mr. Jenkins or other cute characters! Play in front of the pyramids of Egypt or the Amazon rainforest!

581925858.title: TARGET
581925858.short_description: VMC Beta, for internal use only.

582279671.title: Moto Racer 4 Demo
582279671.short_description: Choose from a variety of daring riders and get a taste of adrenaline riding freestyle or on the race course. Show your opponents what you can do with your best drifts and tricks! Show of your skills to win the championship and send your enemies of the road or into traffic for spectacular crashes. Impose your style!

582536220.title: 轩辕剑外传-穹之扉
582536220.short_description:
轩辕剑系列是一款拥有25年历史的东方史诗RPG游戏，当中十大神器贯穿每一代的故事，并透过不同年代的历史事件来阐述轩辕剑的特有元素──“立场不同，观点即不同”，表现如何实现“大义”、“王道”、“大爱”、“尽忠”……等宏大观点。
在最新作品《轩辕剑外传─穹之扉》中，将带领玩家来到神秘国度──华胥；传说中黄帝曾于梦中游历的神圣国度。.

582757602.title: Tennis in the Face
582757602.short_description: This is no Wimbledon, this is Tennis in the Face! Get ready for some hilarious ragdoll-smashing ball-bouncing action!

583069074.title: One Hundred Ways
583069074.short_description:
The puzzle-fun is now available on the Xbox One too!
The goal - to make the ball reach its goal - sounds simple - but it is not! To solve the levels, there are some tools available. Sometimes one needs to think outside the box to overcome obstacles.
The Xbox One-version contains 18 exclusive new levels and was optimized for controlling with the Xbox One gamepad. So overall, there are 133 levels to be solved! We have also optimized the graphics for the Xbox One.

583691146.title: Hyperdrive Massacre
583691146.short_description:
Couch multiplayer neon fragfest! Jump in a space cadillac and frag your way to victory against your friends, or practice against the AI to unlock the full crews roster.
Throw down the gauntlet in Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, buckle up and get your space tires screeching in DeathRace, be the toughest defender in LastManStanding, show off your tricks in Space Soccer, or put your retrogaming skills to good use in Space Pong. 
Become king of the couch with Hyperdrive Massacre!

583749034.title: SOULCALIBUR VI
583749034.short_description: Bring more than your fists to the fight! SOULCALIBUR VI represents the latest entry in the premier weapons-based, head-to-head fighting series. The heroic 3D battles transpire in a beautiful and fluid world, with eye-popping graphics and visual appeal. Featuring all-new battle mechanics and characters, SOULCALIBUR VI marks a new era of the historic franchise. Welcome back to the stage of history!

584036319.title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
584036319.short_description:
Japan, 1615. A new Shogun seizes power over Japan and enforces nationwide peace.

In his battle against conspiracy and rebellion, he recruits five specialists with extraordinary skills for assassination, sabotage and espionage. But how much are they really willing to sacrifice in the name of peace?

585159237.title: Now That’s What I Call Sing
585159237.short_description: Now That's What I call Sing features 30 chart hits including 17 number ones from some of the worlds biggest artists. Grab a mic and sing solo or play with up to 7 other friends and really get the party started!

585188640.title: Aces of the Luftwaffe - Squadron
585188640.short_description: The Aces of the Luftwaffe have returned! Dodge a hail of bullets and face their fearsome war machines in bombastic air battles and boss fights!

585382639.title: Trailblazers
585382639.short_description: Welcome to the Trailblaze Tournament! Get ready for high-speed thrills with an explosion of color in Trailblazers, the first-ever second-to-second co-operative arcade racer. Paint the track as you go to dynamically change the racing line, boost on your team's color and outwit the opposition in a sprint for the finish. The more you paint, the faster you can go!

585771792.title: WATCH_DOGS™
585771792.short_description: Play as Aiden Pearce, a brilliant hacker, whose criminal past led to a violent family tragedy. Now on the hunt for those who hurt your family, monitor and hack all who surround you by manipulating everything connected to the city’s network. Access omnipresent security cameras, download personal information to locate a target, control traffic lights and public transportation to stop the enemy. Use the city of Chicago as your ultimate weapon and exact your own style of revenge.

585971749.title: Super Mega Baseball 2
585971749.short_description:
The critically acclaimed Super Mega Baseball series is back with new visuals, deep team and league customization, and online multiplayer modes.

Accessible mechanics. Deep skill curve. Visceral pacing. Light-hearted vibe. Serious simulation.

Rookie or baseball purist, SMB2 packs a mode for you. Compete in ranked matchmaking (1v1), dominate friends in arranged matches (1v1, 2v1, 2v2) or take on the AI (solo, local/online co-op) - all kept fair by Ego, the genre's most flexible difficulty system.

586255311.title: WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate
586255311.short_description: The WARRIORS OROCHI series is a series of tactical action games in which heroes from the DYNASTY WARRIORS and SAMURAI WARRIORS franchises work together in an effort to defeat Orochi, the Serpent King. The latest title in the series, WARRIORS OROCHI 3, features over 120 playable characters, who can be played freely in three-character teams. Themes of loyalty, betrayal, friendship and love are explored in the human drama created as these heroes clash on the field of battle.

587027604.title: Goliath
587027604.short_description: Welcome to a mysterious world filled with strange creatures, giant monsters and warring factions. You won't last long here on your own. Fortunately, you know how to build giant robots! Find the plans, gather the resources, climb inside your giant robotic creation and start punching monsters in the face!

587488276.title: Outlast 2
587488276.short_description: Outlast 2 introduces you to Sullivan Knoth and his followers, who left our wicked world behind to give birth to Temple Gate, a town deep in the wilderness and hidden from civilization. Knoth and his flock are preparing for the tribulations of the end of times and you’re right in the thick of it.

588577476.title: ARCADE GAME SERIES: GALAGA
588577476.short_description:
First appearing in arcades in 1981, the masterpiece GALAGA finally comes to Xbox One!
Move the fighter left and right and destroy the waves of incoming aliens!

588779462.title: American Ninja Warrior: Challenge
588779462.short_description:
Are you the next America Ninja Warrior?

Compete and achieve Total Victory with the action-packed obstacle-course competition game!

• Take on classic obstacles such as the Salmon Ladder, Warped Wall, Log Grip and more!

• Build your own custom course and have your own personalized Ninja race through it

• In-game commentary voiced by the TV show hosts Matt Iseman and Akbar Gbajabiamila

• Offline multi-player & online leaderboards.

590396526.title: Demon's Crystals
590396526.short_description: Demon's Crystals is a frenetic twin stick shooter where you guide the Urican demons through countless hazards in order to restore peace to the world.

591141110.title: Narcos: Rise of the Cartels
591141110.short_description: Narcos: Rise of the Cartels is a brutal turn-based action strategy game based on the hit Netflix TV series. Explore the entire first season from two sides each with their own unique story. Join the narcos and expand the drug cartel empire, or take up arms with the DEA and bring it crumbling down.

591371027.title: Trove
591371027.short_description: Grab your friends, hone your blades, and set off for adventure in Trove, the ultimate action MMO! Battle the forces of Shadow in realms filled with incredible dungeons and items created by your fellow players. Whether hunting treasure in far-off lands or building realms of your own, it’s never been this good to be square!

591405932.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
591405932.short_description: After a robbery goes badly wrong in the western town of Blackwater, Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are forced to flee. With federal agents and the best bounty hunters in the nation massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal and fight their way across the rugged heartland of America in order to survive. As deepening internal divisions threaten to tear the gang apart, Arthur must make a choice between his own ideals and loyalty to the gang who raised him.

591630310.title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon
591630310.short_description:
Battle with swords and whips in this retro-style action game brought to you by game creator Koji Igarashi and Inti Creates! 

Play as Zangetsu, a demon slayer bearing a deep grudge, who must travel through perilous lands to defeat a powerful demon lurking in a dark castle. Zangetsu will meet fellow travelers along the way, who can join your journey as playable characters.

591995659.title: Monster Hunter World: Iceborne Beta
591995659.short_description:
This is the beta version of Monster Hunter World: Iceborne.

Unleash your hunting spirit!

592146950.title: Adventure Pop
592146950.short_description:
Embark on an epic adventure in this all-new, super-explosive bubble shooter! Ready your cannon, aim the bubbles, and fire away to burst through Adventure Pop!

A group of adventurers has come together to find new treasures, but not before running into trouble. Help Penelope find her friends but watch out for the pesky pirates!

592738720.title: Quatros Origins
592738720.short_description: Quatros Origins is a block puzzle game that tries to reconnect with the good old days where classic arcade games were easy to play, but hard to master!

593565047.title: MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE
593565047.short_description: Fight for your justice in MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE! The popular manga and anime series clashes head-to-head and Quirk-to-Quirk in this 3D arena fighter. Pave your path and choose between hero or villain and battle through iconic moments.

593615886.title: Paladin
593615886.short_description: You are earth's last hero - defend civilization from annihilation. Protect the cities, destroy the aliens and upgrade your fighter. Drive back the vile invading scum and save mankind in this frantic twin-stick shooter!

593651872.title: Bounce Rescue!
593651872.short_description:
Bounce Rescue! is a challenging 2D sidescrolling game of action, puzzles and platforming.

Single-player:
- 50 challenging levels
- 5 boss fights
- 5 different worlds
- 16 characters (if unlocked)
- Time Attack -mode

Multi-player:
- 2-4 local players
- 2-player co-op in story mode
- 16 characters (if unlocked)
- Deathmatch -mode
- Capture the Flag -mode
- Survive -mode
- Many multiplayer maps.

593828894.title: Absolver
593828894.short_description: Absolver is an online multiplayer combat experience where players are placed behind the mask of a Prospect by the ever-present Guides, the new rulers of the fallen Adal Empire that will determine your worth in joining their elite corps of enforcers. Prospects will wander forsaken lands, encountering others to learn new combat skills, acquire weapons and armor, and engage in solo duels and intense three-on-three battles.

594393663.title: Wondershot
594393663.short_description:
Wondershot is a local multiplayer battle arena!

You have only one ammo and one life to defeat your opponent. If you miss your shot, your ammo will be lost on the map and you need to pick it up without dying. You can play 1 to 4 players.
Each round, your weapon changes and the map does too.

No luck, just skill !

594585699.title: Nidhogg 2
594585699.short_description: The Wurm has returned and it must feed! Shed your garments and paint the walls with the flesh of your enemies, for only one can be worthy of sacrifice.

595091631.title: Snake Pass
595091631.short_description: As Noodle the snake, slither, wriggle, curl, coil and climb your way to the top of Haven Tor in this one of a kind physics based, puzzle platform adventure from award winning independent studio Sumo Digital!

597321826.title: Shining Resonance Refrain Demo
597321826.short_description: Play as Yuma Ilvern and stop the Empire from exploiting the power of the ancient dragons, including the soul of the Shining Dragon within you. With the help of your friends, realize your destiny, save Astoria, and unleash the strength you’ve always had locked away. Typically timid, will Yuma find the courage to realize the strength he has within him?

597672449.title: Funk of Titans
597672449.short_description: Funk of Titans is a thrilling and addictive game, simple and fun to play but hard to master. You will control Perseus, the son of Zeus and protector of the legendary holy music: the Funk. Run across the ancient greek mythology, collect funk vinyl, beat enemies, wear epic costumes, ride the legendary Pegasus and smash the rap, the pop and the rock of the evil Musical Titans in fierce dance battles. Only one music can survive and the Funk is the music of the gods.

597690024.title: SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET
597690024.short_description:
Your choices are heavier and faster than a bullet.
Full dive into an original story where you are the protagonist in the world of Gun Gale Online. Create your own avatar and explore devastated lands with your partner AI while experiencing exciting third person shooting in this action RPG. Encounter enemies and run into new and familiar faces from the Sword Art Online series. Choose your fate.

597771444.title: Gems of War
597771444.short_description: From the creators of Puzzle Quest, play the new Puzzle/RPG/Strategy mash-up, GEMS OF WAR! Battle against epic bosses or other players. Conquer all 25 Kingdoms to unlock the world!

598864782.title: Blue Angels Aerobatic Flight Simulator
598864782.short_description:
Become part of the BLUE ANGELS TEAM; try the aerobatic simulator licensed by the U.S. Navy!
Experience flight at 400 mph just 18 inches from your partner’s wing and face the challenge of official maneuvers aboard F/A-18 fighter jets and a C-130 transport aircraft. An assisted driving system allows everyone to learn even the most extreme stunts and thanks to the three play modes, anyone can experience the thrill of a real aerobatic pilot according to their abilities.

601877820.title: Yesterday Origins
601877820.short_description: John Yesterday becomes immortal following an occult ritual. However, not everything goes to plan. He and his girlfriend Pauline must embark on an investigation to try to reproduce the immortality ritual. But his former acquaintances have other plans for him...

602349928.title: World II:Hunting Boss
602349928.short_description: The World 2: Hunting BOSS is a 3D cross-platform hunting game. It's a tradition breaker for only keeping the giant Bosses with all small minions canceled. In game you can enjoy the stunning 3D effects like destructible scenes and dynamic weather system. The World 2 promises you the purest fun of RPG--fighting and only fighting.

603518600.title: Where Are My Friends?
603518600.short_description: Eye on the ball names Wheye had come to the planet where his friends studied local species. His friends went missing, the planet is about to blow and only Wheye can save everyone. He will have to face different trials on his own.

605012161.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95
605012161.short_description:
"THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
In addition to the character of popular work such as "FATAL FURY" and "ART OF FIGHTING" in the sequel title of the previous work "KOF '94", Yagamian will participate as the rival of the main character Kyo Kusanagi.
With the team edit function installed, it became possible to form a team with the player 's favorite character.

605317845.title: Stern Pinball Arcade
605317845.short_description: Stern Pinball Arcade is the most realistic and accurate pinball game ever created! Stern Pinball Inc® has created many of the all-time greatest pinball tables. They are the most experienced and largest producer of real pinball machines in business today! Modern classics in this collection include: Ghostbusters™ Premium, Star Trek™ Premium, AC/DC® Premium, Mustang® Premium, Harley-Davidson® / Third Edition, Last Action Hero™, Frankenstein™, Starship Troopers™, High Roller Casino™, and more!

605741753.title: The LEGO Movie 2 Videogame
605741753.short_description: Bricksburg is in ruins and Emmet’s friends have been taken! Team up with Emmet and a host of heroic characters to save their friends from the strange inhabitants of the Systar System. Journey into outer space, discover new worlds, and test your Master Building skills.

605857900.title: Quiplash
605857900.short_description: For 3-8 Players and an Audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The gut-busting, say-anything, no-rules party game!

605932637.title: Hello Neighbor
605932637.short_description: Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game about sneaking into your neighbor's house to figure out what horrible secrets he's hiding in the basement. You play against an advanced AI that learns from your every move. Really enjoying climbing through that backyard window? Expect a bear trap there. Sneaking through the front door? There'll be cameras there soon. Trying to escape? The Neighbor will find a shortcut and catch you.

606152324.title: GWENT: The Witcher Card Game
606152324.short_description:
GLOBAL LAUNCH — EXPERIENCE AN ALL NEW GWENT!

GWENT is a card game of choices and consequences, where skill, not luck, is your greatest weapon.

Pick a faction, build an army, and wage war against other players. The entire Witcher world is at your fingertips — its mighty heroes, nefarious villains, devastating magic and weaponry are yours to command.

606230808.title: Jack N' Jill DX
606230808.short_description: Will you help reunite Jack N’ Jill? 140 levels and a bunch of minigames!

606673599.title: Pumped BMX Pro
606673599.short_description: Pumped BMX Pro is the next installment in the high adrenaline, fast-paced arcade BMX trickathon. Master 60 levels and over 200 challenges while pulling off as many radical stunts as possible on one of 15 bikes. Want to make it your own? Design your own bike and hit the grind to reach the peaks of global leaderboards.

607002526.title: Castaway Paradise
607002526.short_description:
Instant vacation on your own tropical island! Decorate the island, play dress up, collect bugs, grow crops and help your new neighbors.
In Castaway Paradise you can do whatever you like!

607267025.title: N++ (NPLUSPLUS)
607267025.short_description:
This is the long-awaited sequel to the legendary N+, rewritten from scratch to be bigger, better, and more beautiful in every way.

N++ is a fast-paced, momentum-based platformer about darting around obstacles, narrowly evading enemies and collecting gold in a beautiful minimalist landscape.

607497985.title: Don Bradman Cricket 17
607497985.short_description:
Don Bradman Cricket 17 brings a new revolutionary control system delivering the best batting, bowling and fielding experience by providing you an even greater level of variety and precision of play. Motion captured first class cricketers, including Female Cricketers for the first time in all game modes.

Download and play with thousands of Community created Players, Teams, Stadia and logos.

607618494.title: Braid, Anniversary Edition
607618494.short_description: Control the flow of time to solve puzzles in this new version of the indie classic, featuring fully repainted artwork, a new world of puzzles, and seriously in-depth commentary.

607966981.title: FINAL FANTASY VII
607966981.short_description: FINAL FANTASY VII, the timeless classic loved by a legion of fans, comes to Xbox One with a number of helpful extra features! Experience the return of an epic adventure beyond imagination, culminating in the final battle to decide the fate of the planet.

608369389.title: FAR CRY PRIMAL
608369389.short_description:
The award-winning Far Cry franchise returns with its innovative open world gameplay, bringing together massive beasts, breathtaking environments, and unpredictable savage encounters.
Welcome to the Stone Age, a time of danger and adventure, when giant mammoths and sabretooth tigers ruled the Earth. As the last survivor of your hunting group, rise above extinction and unite your tribe.

608710317.title: ACA NEOGEO PULSTAR
608710317.short_description:
PULSTAR is a side-scrolling shooting game released by SNK in 1995.
Control the “Dino246”, and take down the aliens who are attacking the solar system. 
The game features a verity of offensive and defensive options, including 5 unique Voyager items and special IO items. Use everything at your disposal to protect your ship and defeat the alien threat!

609559474.title: Mekazoo
609559474.short_description: Mekazoo is a 2D platformer with vibrant, fully 3D worlds that can be explored and conquered with a kinetically diverse cast of animals either through a single player campaign or co-op multiplayer. Inspired by classic platformers, Mekazoo leverages those core elements to create a new, creative, unique and fun gameplay experience. Featuring a diverse cast of five playable characters each bestowing unique abilities.

609700427.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®
609700427.short_description: Experience a visceral Campaign or assemble your team in the ultimate online playground with multiple Special Ops challenges and a mix of Multiplayer maps and modes.

609835635.title: The MISSING: J.J. Macfield and the Island of Memories
609835635.short_description:
The sudden disappearance of a dear friend spurs J.J. Macfield to go look for her friend on the curious Island of Memories.
You can’t die on this nightmare island, even if you’re seriously injured. No matter
how many times J.J.’s brought back from the grips of death, she drags her
mangled body deeper into the woods.
She risks the suffering of having her arms and legs torn off, her neck broken, immolation…all in order to find her friend.
Complete the game and solve the mysteries of the island.

610006706.title: Dark Arcana: The Carnival
610006706.short_description: Find the missing woman lost in a mysterious Carnival of Horrors. Investigate two worlds: the one you know and an alternate plane existing behind the Hall of Mirrors. Discover the secret of an ancient being known as the Evil One. Reveal the story of star-crossed lovers and stop the Evil One from breaking its magical chains and invading our world.

610345881.title: The Jackbox Party Pack
610345881.short_description: For 1-100 players! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The team behind YOU DON’T KNOW JACK presents FIVE guffaw-inducing party games in one pack! You’re gonna need more than one party for this.

610645839.title: ACA NEOGEO TWINKLE STAR SPRITES
610645839.short_description: TWINKLE STAR SPRITES is a competitive shooting game released by SNK in 1996. Utilize Chain Explosions, Power Shots, and Bombs to defeat the incoming Enemy Golems, changing them into Attack Characters to assault your opponent! Experience a new style of shooting game with more than enough cute characters flying around to fill the sky!

610840457.title: Deer Hunter: Reloaded
610840457.short_description:
Deer Hunter is Back!

Deer Hunter: Reloaded is a 1st person hunting simulation game based off of the #1 hunting franchise in the World. Deer Hunter will provide an authentic hunting experience for players as they venture to some of the top-rated hunting regions in North America from the plains of West Texas to the rugged terrain of Alaska.

611353600.title: Dreamals: Dream Quest
611353600.short_description:
There is a world of dreams called Dreamland, where anyone can have their wishes granted.
Three wounded and homeless animals happened to enter Dreamland. Will they be able to find the treasures of Dreamland and save the world?
And will they be able to regain their health and go back home safely?

611794133.title: Just Dance 2019®
611794133.short_description:
Wherever life takes you, Just Dance 2019 will keep you dancing for hours with an insane amount of content for the whole family to enjoy!

Just Dance 2019 comes with over 40 new and fun songs, and access to more than 400 songs available with Just Dance Unlimited. Every copy of the game comes with 1-month’s access!

614295058.title: Age of Empires®: Castle Siege
614295058.short_description:
Age of Empires®: Castle Siege invites you to guide your empire through the Medieval Era on your Windows PC or touch screen device. Choose from one of several civilizations, including the Britons, Teutons, and Kievan Rus. Upgrade your keep, fortify your walls, and garrison defensive troops to protect yourself from marauders. Then, train an army to raid other cities, and command them in battle to dismantle your opponents’ defenses.

Over the ages, you’ll research technology, live through famous battles, and recruit a variety of heroes to your side, including Saladin, Richard the Lionheart, and Joan of Arc. Outsmart your attackers and outplay your victims to earn achievements and climb to the top of the leaderboards.

Take command, and make your mark on history!

* Age of Empires®: Castle Siege requires users to sign into Xbox with a Microsoft account to play.

616579628.title: Rocket Wars
616579628.short_description:
Fast-paced local multi-player game packed with action. 
Destroy your friends with all sorts of different weapons and power-ups across multiple game modes!

617101841.title: World of Warships: Legends
617101841.short_description: Experience epic, free-to-play naval combat when you helm one of over 200 historic vessels in an exciting balance of strategy and real-time combat in World of Warships. Outfit your fleet with flags, camouflage, modifications, talented commanders, and more!

617479290.title: Neon Chrome
617479290.short_description: Experience a ruthless top-down cyberpunk shooter and blast your way through enemies and walls. Upgrade, enhance and build up your strength. The path to stopping the Overseer is ever changing.

618537566.title: The Outer Worlds
618537566.short_description: The Outer Worlds is a new single-player sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. As you explore the furthest reaches of space and encounter a host of factions all vying for power, who you decide to become will determine the fate of everyone in Halcyon. In the corporate equation for the colony, you are the unplanned variable.

619521674.title: Four Sided Fantasy
619521674.short_description: Four Sided Fantasy is a puzzle-platformer where you constantly break the rules of the screen. In this world, you can wrap the screen at any time, so that you emerge from the left when exiting right, and falling down a pit turns into falling from the ceiling.

619718041.title: The Cave
619718041.short_description: Assemble your team of three from seven unlikely adventurers and descend into the mysterious depths. The Cave awaits.

620831719.title: GROW UP
620831719.short_description:
After Grow Home, BUD is back in this fantastic acrobatic journey to the moon, discovering an intriguing planetary playground!

While out exploring the galaxy, BUD’s parental spaceship MOM, goes to pieces. It’s up to BUD to collect all her parts and get them back to the moon.

Take on the challenge and join the walking, flying, rolling, bouncing and riding adventure around this unknown planet!

621760503.title: Big Crown: Showdown
621760503.short_description: Big Crown: Showdown sees friends become foes as they compete for the crown in 4-player local and online multiplayer combat, set over 3 wacky worlds full of medieval shenanigans. Avoid perilous hazards and engage in frantic fights as you attempt to knock your opponents off 15 crazy courses in the ultimate royal battle!

622432478.title: Blues and Bullets - Episode 1
622432478.short_description:
Eliot Ness, the former leader of the legendary Untouchables, wished only to spend the rest of his days working in his diner, not dwelling too much on the cesspit of corruption his city, Santa Esperanza, had degenerated into.

But things rarely go as planned.

Helped by various characters from some unexpected places, the player must guide Eliot through the increasingly morbid and decadent scenarios searching for clues to solve the cases in the five episodes of this season's Blues and Bullets.

622616436.title: Circuit Breakers
622616436.short_description:
Go back to the 1980s: Shoot, Explode and Explore in this frenzied top down arcade blaster with a modern twist for the Xbox One. Become a supreme warrior or co-op with up to five friends to rid the universe of a ruthless intergalactic robot army.
With exhilarating and frenetic arcade action can you save the day?

622753975.title: Headlander
622753975.short_description: You are the last known human in the universe, and all that's left of you is a disembodied head. Seeking clues to your fractured past, you must travel through a hostile world of machines using a special helmet that allows you to dock into and take control of any robotic host body. As you launch from one body to the next, you'll start to discover that things are not quite what they appear to be, and the fate of humanity has yet to be decided...

623325843.title: Cuphead
623325843.short_description: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

623413765.title: Numantia
623413765.short_description:
Units, heroes and battles inspired in real events.
Deep narrative linked to the historical evolution of the conflict.
Two different campaigns with their own heroes, troops, settlements and armies.
Play solo or with a friend in a local 1v1 mode.

624134529.title: Zombie Party
624134529.short_description: Zombie Party is a retro rampage of fun and over-the-top action, while still giving the players a deep and engaging Action-RPG rogue-like experience! Go on a time traveling adventure alone or with your friends, delve deep into procedural dungeons full of gold, loot, and secrets, or try to get the high score in arcade mode! Get the party started with 3 friends in this classic retro gaming experience with tons of content!

625611957.title: PLATINUM DEMO – FINAL FANTASY XV
625611957.short_description: PLATINUM DEMO — FINAL FANTASY XV whisks players away to a fragmented dreamscape, introducing an original story with a few unique twists.

625867999.title: ACA NEOGEO SHOCK TROOPERS
625867999.short_description:
SHOCK TROOPERS is an action game released by SNK in 1997.
Players take part in a rescue operation for Dr. George and his granddaughter who have been kidnapped by the evil organization Bloody Scorpion. The game features the ability for players to choose which route to progress, adding even more replayablity to the title.

625948041.title: Slime Rancher
625948041.short_description:
Slime Rancher is a chaotic adventure where you can explore a vast, alien frontier, build and customize a space ranch, and avoid the perilous avalanche of a thousand wiggling, jiggling slimes!

Visit http://slimerancher.com for more info about Slime Rancher!

627891457.title: Little Nightmares II Enhanced Edition
627891457.short_description:
Return to a world of charming horror in Little Nightmares II, a suspense adventure game in which you play as Mono, a young boy trapped in a world that has been distorted by the humming transmission of a distant tower.

Together with his new friend Six, Mono sets out to discover the disturbing secrets of The Signal Tower, if they can make it past a gallery of new threats and enemies.

629270283.title: Gang Beasts
629270283.short_description: Gang Beasts is a silly multiplayer party game with surly gelatinous characters, brutal slapstick fight sequences, and absurd hazardous environments, set in the mean streets of Beef City.

629798227.title: Deadpool
629798227.short_description: There are a few important things I need to say before you crack into my insanely sweet game. (Oof. Here we go again.) I'm a mercenary with an accelerated healing factor. I've been described as unstable, which is just plain coo-coo. (Wait, do sane people say coo-coo?) I'm gonna battle for the safety of humans and mutants. (And even mumans.) Be prepared for just about anything. (Holla!).

629912263.title: Mayan Death Robots: Arena
629912263.short_description: Mayan Death Robots reinvents the artillery genre in a Mayan setting invaded by alien killing machines. Pick a robot from the roster and enter the arena to destroy your opponent's power core. Aim your weapon before the timer runs out, but don't be distracted by the pretty scenery: when the rockets start flying, you already need to plan your next move! Will you choose to move your robot to a better vantage point, or will you build defenses to keep your opponent from landing a killing blow?

629977034.title: Shoppe Keep
629977034.short_description:
Swords, Wizards, Potions, Spells, fighting to the death and making money – it’s all in a day’s work.
CREATE your own fantasy shop selling everything from armor to potions and so much more
DEVELOP your business and dominate the market
EMPLOY “helper bots” – the latest in fantasy technology
BEWARE the evil Barbarians who threaten to attack at any time
BUILD your empire from the ground up in free play mode.

631368453.title: Necropolis
631368453.short_description: OBEY THE BRAZEN HEAD OR PERISH. Or don’t, you know, no big whoop. NECROPOLIS is a multiplayer, third-person, action roguelike set in a living, magical dungeon that endlessly reconstructs itself, offering only one way out: down. Craft, explore, equip, and hone your skills as you travel deeper and face greater threats. Find the exit, or die trying.

632819091.title: Kerbal Space Program
632819091.short_description: Who said rocket science wasn’t FOR EVERYBODY! Kerbal Space Program puts you in charge of the recently launched space program for a fun & clever alien race – the Kerbals. These little guys are counting on you to build spaceships, rockets & vehicles that can take off & hold on during COOL space travel missions, without hurting them in the process… EXPLORE SPACE, DISCOVER NEW PLANETS AND CONQUER THE UNIVERSE.

633432871.title: NHL® 20 Open Beta
633432871.short_description: Play the NHL 20 Open Beta* and be among the first to experience the newest ways to play. The fan-favorite ONES can now be played with friends on the couch, and the all-new Eliminator mode introduces winner-take-all competition where you and your friends compete to be the best in the barn.

634240708.title: MotoGP™19
634240708.short_description:
Race with official 2019 Championship riders!
Have fun with the new multiplayer experience and become Race Director.
Challenge the new AI, take a ride through the history of the MotoGP™ and unleash your creativity with the graphic editors.

634298669.title: Bad North: Jotunn Edition
634298669.short_description: Your home is under attack. The king is dead at the hands of Viking invaders. Hope is a distant glimmer in the fog, fading fast with every passing moment. As you rise to take your father’s place as ruler, it will fall to you to stage your defenses. But make no mistake – this is no fight for victory, but a desperate grasp for survival.

634582679.title: ACA NEOGEO KING OF THE MONSTERS 2
634582679.short_description:
KING OF THE MONSTERS 2 is an action game released by SNK in 1992.
Choose 1 of 3 monsters to thrash aliens around the world and become the undisputed King of the Monsters!
Work together in a 2 player co-op mode, or duke it out in versus mode!

635298240.title: The Walking Dead: Michonne - Ep. 1, In Too Deep
635298240.short_description: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries stars the iconic, blade-wielding character from Robert Kirkman's best-selling comic books. Haunted by her past, and coping with unimaginable loss and regret, the story explores Michonne's absence between issues #126 and #139 of the comic book.

636297311.title: Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon® Wildlands Ghost War Mode Open Beta
636297311.short_description:
Discover the new PvP mode of Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon® Wildlands in this free open beta! Push your spec ops skills to their limits in this tactical 4v4 experience.

Xbox Live Gold is required to play the Open Beta, sold separatly.

638965135.title: Descenders
638965135.short_description: Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

639411963.title: Metropolis: Lux Obscura
639411963.short_description: Metropolis Lux Obscura is a unique game with a film noir atmosphere, seductive wanton women, and dirty dangerous secrets. Gameplay is based on a motion comic with a non-linear plot mixed with MATCH3 puzzle fights.

639447070.title: Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing
639447070.short_description: Grand Prix Rock 'N Racing gives you the fastest, most exciting races. You can evolve your car, improving the engine, brakes, tires and more until you've achieved the perfect evolution to win the Championship!

640703885.title: LEGO® Marvel's Avengers
640703885.short_description: Avengers Assemble! The best-selling LEGO® Marvel videogame franchise returns with a new action-packed, Super Hero adventure.

641289386.title: TOM CLANCY'S THE DIVISION BETA
641289386.short_description: Tom Clancy’s The Division Beta is your chance to test and experience a pre-release version of the game.

641616197.title: ACA NEOGEO GHOST PILOTS
641616197.short_description: GHOST PILOTS is a shooting game released by SNK in 1991. The hero flies an old-fashioned seaplane in order to fight the two powerful nations invading their own country. Alongside giant military weapons, a mysterious combat unit arrives and makes for an intense battle.

642156375.title: Crash™ Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
642156375.short_description:
Go fur-throttle with Crash™ Team Racing Nitro-Fueled. It’s the authentic CTR experience plus a whole lot more, now fully-remastered and revved up to the max:

- All the original game modes, characters, tracks, power-ups, weapons and controls
- Additional karts, tracks and arenas from Crash™ Nitro Kart
- Race online with friends and Crash the competition with online leaderboards.

642305927.title: Death God University
642305927.short_description: DGU is a 3rd person 3D adventure/puzzle game where the player plays as a student of the Death God University studying to become a death god assistant.

642353763.title: Injustice™ 2 - Standard Edition
642353763.short_description: Build and power up the ultimate version of your favorite DC legends in INJUSTICE 2. This is your Legend. Your Journey. Your Injustice.

643690404.title: LASTFIGHT
643690404.short_description: LASTFIGHT is bringing 2v2 3D fighting back to your living room! Pick up any available object in one of the 8 stages and teach your opponents a lesson! Play in local multiplayer mode, for up to 4 players, or one-player story mode, with a cast of 10 characters inspired by the comic book LASTMAN.

643698720.title: Forza Horizon 2 Demo
643698720.short_description: A world of beauty and freedom awaits in Forza Horizon 2!

643894778.title: Shiness: The Lightning Kingdom
643894778.short_description: Shiness is an action-RPG that takes you on a journey across a universe on the verge of collapse. After crash-landing on a hostile island, you find yourself in a conflict spanning multiple kingdoms. Face off against dangerous enemies in hyper-dynamic fights, mixing magic with traditional fighting game mechanics. Gain experience to evolve your characters, learning exciting new skills and spells.

644053996.title: Gears of War: Ultimate Edition Beta
644053996.short_description: Thank you for registering for the Gears of War: Ultimate Edition Multiplayer Beta. To play the Beta you will need both this download and a separate unlock token, which is sent separately. The Multiplayer Beta will be active through Sunday June 21. Thank you for your help making the final release better!

644829211.title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
644829211.short_description: Having defeated the Campaigner, Turok throws the Chronocepter into a waiting volcano to destroy it. Unfortunately the blast awakens an even deadlier force - The Primagen. Once again a Turok is tasked with restoring peace to the land and stopping the Primagen from merging Earth with the nether world.

645046198.title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite Demo
645046198.short_description: Commence the fight against the encroaching threat of Ultron Sigma's evil forces. A blockbuster cast of Marvel superheroes and iconic Capcom characters unite in the visually stunning and immersive Cinematic Story Mode. Play this free story demo for a sample of the high-flying fighting to come.

645315969.title: Dead Exit
645315969.short_description: Dead Exit is an undead apocalypse, base management, card game. Each player controls a base and tries to outmanoeuvre their opponents and survive the evacuation of a city. Play your cards right. Make alliances. Break alliances. Betray sworn allies at the worst possible time and leave them to get eaten by the hordes. Or you can play on your own in a highly customisable solitaire mode. It's up to you how you play it, just make sure you get out of the city with enough resources to survive!

645502086.title: The Four Kings Casino and Slots
645502086.short_description: The Four Kings Casino & Slots is a rich social online multiplayer casino gaming experience. Play all of your favorite casino games like Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Slots and more! Meet friends, climb the leaderboards and win rewards to customize your avatar.

646333897.title: AereA
646333897.short_description: AereA is an Action RPG in which music is both your best friend and your worst enemy. As a disciple of the Great Maestro Guido you have to unravel the mysteries of Aezir. Find out what happened to the world and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and bring peace to the world.

646403599.title: Kholat
646403599.short_description: The most terrifying journey of your life set in the beautiful winter scenery of the Ural Mountains. Uncover the horrific mystery behind the Dyatlov Pass Incident. Narrated by the famous Sean Bean and powered by Unreal Engine 4.

647656873.title: Skylar & Plux: Adventure on Clover Island
647656873.short_description: Skylar & Plux: Adventure on Clover Island is an enthusiastic revival of the legendary 3D-platformer genre with classic gameplay, playful gadgets, and a lighthearted story set in a gorgeous, colorful world reminiscent of childhood adventures. Go on an action-packed adventure, collect gadgets to help you explore a beautiful paradise, and save it from destruction.

648298719.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane Xbox One
648298719.short_description:
In a world ravaged by war and dominated by magic, you are the last hope for the Empire of Man against the Chaos hordes.
Playing solo or with up to four players in local or online co-op, choose a hero from four character classes with unique and complementary skills, and prepare for epic battles wielding some of the most powerful artefacts of the Old World.

649279273.title: King's Quest™
649279273.short_description: Download King’s Quest – Chapter 1: A Knight to Remember. An aging King Graham reflects on a life of adventure with his granddaughter, Gwendolyn, taking players back to his teen years and his quest to become a knight of Daventry in King Edward’s royal guard. Discover a wondrous world full of whimsical characters, charming puzzles and perilous dangers in this fun and enchanting coming of age story.

649881449.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® Remastered
649881449.short_description: One of the most critically-acclaimed games in history, Call of Duty® 4: Modern Warfare® is back, remastered in true high-definition, featuring improved textures, physically based rendering, high-dynamic range lighting and much more for a new generation.

649884307.title: InkSplosion
649884307.short_description: Why should war be hell when it could be fun? Enter InkSplosion, a single screen twin-stick shooter, where the only real enemy is beating your previous high-score!

650235919.title: Planet of the Eyes
650235919.short_description: An atmospheric narrative-platformer about a service robot stranded on a mysterious planet, Planet of the Eyes features a stunning visual mix of puzzle and platforming challenges, an original musical score, and fully voiced audio logs left by another survivor. Explore the mystery of an unknown world.

650249872.title: Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes
650249872.short_description: World-renowned Kojima Productions showcases the latest masterpiece in the METAL GEAR SOLID franchise with METAL GEAR SOLID V: GROUND ZEROES. METAL GEAR SOLID V: GROUND ZEROES is the first segment of the ‘Metal Gear Solid V Experience’ and prologue to the larger second segment, METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN launching thereafter.

650424753.title: ACA NEOGEO THE LAST BLADE 2
650424753.short_description: THE LAST BLADE 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1998. The Four Gods aiming to seal Hell's Gate and the eternal dead who aim to stop them are in the middle of an intense battle. A variety of systems have been introduced. Characters have their own individual Sword Quality, the ability to Repel and turn back enemy attacks, Desperation Moves and Super Desperation Moves, as well as the ability to cancel enemy moves and sequence them into Desperation Moves known as Super Cancel.

650779126.title: NBA 2K18
650779126.short_description:
The highest rated* annual sports title of this console generation returns with NBA 2K18, featuring unparalleled authenticity and improvements on the court.
*According to 2008 - 2016 Metacritic.com.

650870805.title: Super Mutant Alien Assault
650870805.short_description: Dance with death through randomised rooms to clear your space freighter of irradiated aliens in a brutal arcade platformer shooter stuffed to the brim with unlockable weapons, explosives, special abilities and defense moves.

650880404.title: Titanfall ®2 Open Multiplayer Tech Test
650880404.short_description:
Welcome to the Titanfall® 2 Open Multiplayer Tech Test.

Featuring a deep multiplayer experience with more of the innovative, fast, fluid gameplay fans expect from the series.

650896382.title: iO
650896382.short_description: iO is an abstract physics platformer about size and speed. Grow bigger and smaller in order to solve some of the trickiest puzzles. Reach the exit as quickly as possible and grab a gold medal as your reward!

651668093.title: RESIDENT EVIL 7 biohazard
651668093.short_description: Fear and isolation seep through the walls of an abandoned southern farmhouse. "7" marks a new beginning for survival horror with the “Isolated View” of the visceral new first-person perspective. Powered by the RE Engine, horror reaches incredible heights of immersion as players enter a terrifyingly new world of fear as they fight to survive.

651709478.title: Emily Wants to Play Too
651709478.short_description: You are alone, scared and have been trapped inside an office building by four dolls, a mannequin, a jack-in-the-box and a zombie-looking girl named Emily. You just wanted to deliver your sandwich order and head back to the restaurant, but they want to play. Emily Wants to Play Too is a fun and scary survival horror game with action, puzzles, strategy and stealth elements.

652405162.title: STEEP OPEN BETA
652405162.short_description:
Be among the first to ride the fresh powder of Steep ! 
The OPEN BETA will allow you to create your ride and get a first burst of adrenaline in the Alps.
The mountain is yours to explore. So strap in, suit up and drop in.

652523540.title: Battlezone Gold Edition
652523540.short_description:
Strap into the cockpit of the Cobra – the most powerful tank ever built – and experience first-person tank combat across neon-scarred sci-fi landscapes in an explosive campaign for 1-4 players.
Load your tank with a wide range of devastating weapons and power-ups, and blast your way to a colossal final showdown.
The Battlezone Gold Edition includes all skin, bobblehead, and horn content packs!

652901378.title: APB Reloaded
652901378.short_description:
Anarchy or justice: which will you choose? Hit the streets as a licensed 
vigilante or hardened criminal in the gritty metropolis of San Paro.

653726544.title: Toy Odyssey
653726544.short_description: Toy Odyssey is a Metroidvania style action-platformer that takes you back to a world made from the nightmares of your childhood. Join Brand, an action figure come to life, in a fight against the darkness to save his owner, Felix. Unravel the house's mysterious past, and learn to overcome all odds.

654631320.title: Dustoff Heli Rescue 2
654631320.short_description:
Take off with your rescue helicopter, be the hero chopper pilot, and save the life of the wounded soldiers in the battlefield. Fight against tanks and trucks firing their weapons at you and transport the friendly army back to their base!

Save hostages being held in Prisoner of War camps.
Combat in military attacks in the desert, forests, mines, swamps and fjords.
Build radio towers and bridges.
Protect the friendly truck and VIP convoy before the enemies can reach and demolish them!
...

654883159.title: The LEGO® NINJAGO® Movie Video Game
654883159.short_description: Find your inner ninja with the all-new LEGO NINJAGO Movie Video Game! Play as your favorite ninjas to defend Ninjago from the evil Lord Garmadon. Master the art of Ninjagility by wall-running and high-jumping, and battle foes to rank up and upgrade the ninja's combat skills.

655312805.title: Desert Child
655312805.short_description: You are a hungry, young hoverbike racer who needs to get off Earth before it E-X-P-L-O-D-E-S. Hunt bounties, throw races, and do whatever you can to get to Mars and win the Grand Prix.

655366314.title: Fractured Minds
655366314.short_description: Fractured Minds is an immersive artistic short game, exploring anxiety and mental health issues. Embark on a journey through the human psyche to experience the everyday challenges associated with these conditions.

655591242.title: Far Cry® New Dawn
655591242.short_description:
Dive into a transformed, vibrant, post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a global nuclear catastrophe.
Lead the fight against the Highwaymen as they seek to take over in the latest installment of Far Cry.

Pre-order now to get the exclusive Unicorn Trike skin.

655708836.title: Rento Fortune
655708836.short_description:
Rento is online multiplayer business dice game. It is board game for 1 to 8 players.
Trade lands, build houses, win auctions, roll wheel of fortune, risk in Russian Roulette and most importantly - have fun. 
Obtain monopoly over the game board and bankrupt the other players in order to win.

656526439.title: MagNets: Fully Charged
656526439.short_description:
Polarity City is under threat: the Bloxbots have gone rogue! Only you can stand between them and chaos, and only you can discover who is behind this.
MagNets is an intense arena-based collect-em-up. Recycle Bloxbots and save the day in 20 levels and 4 zones, plus challenge levels, online leaderboards and local multiplayer.

656986554.title: NBA 2K19: The Prelude
656986554.short_description: From neighborhood legend to global phenomenon. The original career story mode returns with an all-new narrative, charting your journey from China to the G League and eventually the NBA. Download NBA 2K19: The Prelude for free and get a head start on your MyPLAYER before the full game release on September 7.

657819699.title: Friday Night Bullet Arena
657819699.short_description: Friday Night Bullet Arena is a top-down multiplayer shoot-a-thon with a twist: each player only gets one bullet! You can catch your own bullet to fire again, but catching other bullets is... not recommended.

659391373.title: WWE 2K16
659391373.short_description: Get in the ring and Raise Some Hell with WWE 2K16! Play as your favorite Superstars from the past, present and future and experience the most authentic, comprehensive, in-your-face WWE video game of all-time!

662536568.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES
662536568.short_description:
"WORLD HEROES" is a fighting game that was originally released by SNK in 1992.
Eight characters based on historical celebrities such as Hattori Hanzo and Rasputin will fight each other to become the world's strongest champion. In addition to the Normal mode, a Deathmatch Mode featuring various stages full of traps awaits you for merciless battles!

664898642.title: NASCAR Heat 3
664898642.short_description:
There are more ways to race than ever before in NASCAR Heat 3. Build your own race team and compete in the Xtreme Dirt Tour in the newly expanded Career Mode. Prove you’re the best driver in the world in new Online Tournaments. Just like real life, new at-track stories mean anything can happen on race day. Plus, all your favorite modes are back and better than ever - Split Screen, Challenge, Championship, 40-player online, and more!

*As of April 30, 2021, the Online Multiplayer servers will no longer be available. All Offline features will continue to be accessible, including Local Split Screen Multiplayer for head-to-head racing.

665983758.title: Forza Motorsport 5 Demo
665983758.short_description: COMING SOON! Forza Motorsport 5 features a brand new graphics engine, 16-player multiplayer, and hundreds of perfectly recreated cars, only possible on Xbox One.

666757656.title: Rayman Legends
666757656.short_description: The Glade of Dreams is in trouble once again! The nightmares multiplied and spread, creating new monsters even more terrifying than before!

667003203.title: Dogos
667003203.short_description: DOGOS incorporates current technology into classic shmup games: 3D graphics, dynamic camera, and the ability to move through scenarios as if it were an open world. DOGOS invites you to live a real action-packed experience that will challenge your skills and senses. Loads of shots and explosions, and an incredible, catchy soundtrack. If you like fast-paced, thrilling videogames, then DOGOS is just for you.

667126942.title: Uncanny Valley
667126942.short_description: Welcome to Uncanny Valley – an unsettling story-driven survival horror where nothing is as it seems. Explore an isolated facility and solve its many mysteries, but be warned: the choices you make have meaningful consequences that will determine your fate. Play through multiple times to reveal all of Uncanny Valley’s darkest secrets.

667331775.title: GunWorld: Xbox One Edition
667331775.short_description: Plant seeds, grow guns, fight aliens, and save the world!

667599199.title: ACA NEOGEO BASEBALL STARS PROFESSIONAL
667599199.short_description: BASEBALL STARS PROFESSIONAL is a sports game released in 1990 by SNK. One of the launch titles as the NEOGEO debuted, it came with both a VS Mode and Tournament Mode. The dynamic animation and powerful productions made for an exciting game.

668438210.title: LEGO® CITY Undercover
668438210.short_description: Join the Chase! In LEGO® CITY Undercover, play as Chase McCain, a police officer who's been tasked with going undercover to hunt down the notorious – and recently escaped – criminal Rex Fury and putting an end to his city-wide crime wave.

668950127.title: Joe Dever’s Lone Wolf Console Edition
668950127.short_description: The fantasy fiction/RPG gamebook classic by Joe Dever, Lone Wolf is re-imagined for a new generation with a brand-new story, a deep combat system, stunning graphics and much more! Make meaningful choices and carve your own path through this epic non-linear adventure. Test your strength in dynamic turn-based battles and accept the challenge of wits posed by the mysterious Shianti Cube!

669503806.title: Rock of Ages 2: Bigger & Boulder™
669503806.short_description: The greatest “giant rocks rolling through historical/artistic ages” tower defense game is back with Rock of Ages 2: Bigger & Boulder. Just like the title says, Bigger and Boulder cranks up the surrealism and gameplay to be, well… BIGGER AND BOULDER. With an emphasis on the chaotic new 2-vs-2 multiplayer, new time periods, and improved graphics, physics, and destructibility powered by Unreal Engine 4, players will need to be ready for some intense rocking and rolling.

669895014.title: DARK SOULS™: REMASTERED NETWORK TEST VER.
669895014.short_description:
Praise the Sun!

This is the DARK SOULS™: REMASTERED Network Test version for May 11-12.

*This client will only be available for download from 5/1 to 5/8.

Players will play the game as testers to play the game before release.
This Network Test is to ensure that the game will be able to manage its online capabilities on the day of release.

We hope that you will take the time to join in on this opportunity.

670498748.title: Pumped BMX +
670498748.short_description: Pumped BMX + uses the hit game 'Pumped BMX 2' as inspiration - taking everything which made the mobile version so successful and enhancing every aspect of it for console.

670545608.title: Armored Warfare
670545608.short_description: Armored Warfare, the future of modern tank shooters, is coming to Xbox! Take control of cutting-edge tanks and join your friends in completing co-op missions, compete with rival teams in PvP mode, or experience the real tank action in the Global Operations – an explosive mix of competitive and cooperative play empowered by large maps with respawn zones, surveillance drones, AI support, airstrikes, and much more.

671675837.title: GRIP
671675837.short_description:
GRIP is a high octane, hardcore combat racer, packing ferocious speed and armed to the teeth with heavy weapons.

Harnessing gravity defying physics alongside a bristling arsenal of outlandish weapons, GRIP delivers the fastest, most competitive racing experience ever. Scale walls, ceilings and anything else you can get your tyres on to... as you master tantalising tracks, tricks and perform mind-blowing stunts to race your way across the cosmos.

671807457.title: Portal Knights
671807457.short_description: Join this cooperative, 3D sandbox action RPG to level up your character, craft epic weapons, conquer enemies in real-time, and build almost anything! Craft your adventure. Forge your hero. Become the ultimate Portal Knight!

675104517.title: EA SPORTS™ NHL® 18 - Beta
675104517.short_description: Be The First to Play the EA SPORTS™ NHL® 18 - Beta.

676400860.title: FOX n FORESTS
676400860.short_description: FOX n FORESTS is a 16-bit style action platformer with RPG and puzzle elements! Switch seasons and wield your crossbow to unveil the mystery of the 5th season.

676432066.title: PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2
676432066.short_description:
The much-awaited sequel to Pac-Man Championship Edition!

Featuring eye-popping 3D graphics and funky visuals!
New modes include Score Attack and an Adventure mode!

676489959.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers
676489959.short_description: Remothered: Tormented Fathers is the pure and realistic survival horror videogame.

678033734.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2003
678033734.short_description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2003 is a fighting game released by SNK in 2003.
It features the same 3-on-3 battle system as the previous title in the series, but this time players are able to use the "Multi-Shift" format to freely tag in team members for speedier gameplay. A new character named ASH is also introduced, marking the beginning of a new chapter for the series!

678502136.title: Splasher
678502136.short_description:
Splasher is a fun, challenging 2D Platformer filled with humor and surprises. 

Armed with a paint cannon, you must face the dangers of the Inkorp mega-factory in order to save your companions – the Splashers – and put an end to the Machiavellian projects of the evil boss, Le Docteur!

678843074.title: Mr. Pumpkin Adventure
678843074.short_description: Mr. Pumpkin Adventure is a critically acclaimed, point-and-click puzzle solving game with a detailed, unique art style.

678849566.title: Valkyria Chronicles 4 Demo
678849566.short_description:
Default Short DescriptionA Continent Engulfed in the Bitter Flames of War!

Valkyria Chronicles 4 takes place in the same timeframe as the original Valkyria Chronicles, but focuses on Squad E of the Federation. Commander Claude Wallace and his childhood friends set out to fight for freedom in this desperate war, but bone-chilling blizzards, waves of imperial soldiers, and the godlike powers of the Valkyria stand between them and victory.

680174875.title: Tango Fiesta
680174875.short_description: Tango Fiesta is an action packed, top-down, cooperative, two-stick, shooter for 1 to 4 players.

680942588.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order™
680942588.short_description: Optimized for Xbox Series X|S. A galaxy-spanning adventure awaits in STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order. An abandoned Padawan must complete his training, develop new powerful Force abilities, and master the art of the lightsaber - all while staying one step ahead of the Empire.

681500618.title: The Walking Dead: The Final Season - Demo
681500618.short_description: After years on the road facing threats both living and dead, a secluded school might finally be Clementine and AJ’s chance for a home. But protecting it will mean sacrifice. In this gripping, emotional final season, your choices define your relationships, shape your world, and determine how Clementine’s story ends.

682100179.title: Armello
682100179.short_description: Armello is a grim fairy-tale board game come to life. Full of swashbuckling adventure combining deep, tactical card play, rich tabletop strategy and RPG elements. Wage epic single and multiplayer battles, cast spells, hire agents, and prepare poisons and ruses on your quest for the throne!

682404126.title: Paladins
682404126.short_description: Join 50+ million players in Paladins, the free-to-play fantasy team-based shooter sensation. Wield guns and magic as a legendary Champion of the Realm, customizing your core set of abilities to play exactly how you want to play.

682562723.title: Halo: Spartan Assault
682562723.short_description:
Halo: Spartan Assault is a fast paced top-down shooter set during the timeline between “Halo 3” and “Halo 4,” progress your Spartan career as you engage in over 30 exciting Campaign missions using many of favorite Halo weapons, vehicles and armor abilities.

Team-up on Xbox Live and fight with a friend against waves of the nightmarish Flood in the all-new online co-op multiplayer mode.

683015573.title: JumpJet Rex
683015573.short_description: Take control of a T-Rex with extraterrestrial jump boots, tasked with saving dino-kind from extinction in this highly challenging, 2-D platformer. Race against the clock as you jump, drop and dash your way through 40+ challenging levels to preserve life during the Mesozoic era!

684411144.title: Immortal: Unchained
684411144.short_description:
Unleashed and unforgiving. Can you rise to the challenge?

Being an ultimate weapon, you have been locked up for millennia by those who fear your potential. It will require many harsh lessons to unlock this potential in an unforgiving universe full of murderous foes. On your journey, expect no mercy and no assistance: Those that aren’t trying to kill you, will instead try to use you to further their own agenda. Trust no one.

684911782.title: Jettomero: Hero of the Universe
684911782.short_description:
Play as Jettomero, a giant, indestructible, and incredibly clumsy robot determined to save the human race. Explore a procedurally generated universe by flying through space and landing on planets while trying not to destroy everything in your path. Relax as you blast through the cosmos on a hero's uncertain quest. Will you ever save the humans?

Jettomero offers a unique and charming experience for players of all backgrounds.

686515917.title: Just Dance 2018® Demo
686515917.short_description:
Try Just Dance 2018 for free now! Turn up the volume and dance your heart out now on "24K Magic" by Bruno Mars.

Just Dance 2018 is coming back this fall on October 26th 2017 with over 40 tracks at launch, and more than 300 songs available with Just Dance Unlimited and the 3-month trial included!

686647649.title: Feral Fury
686647649.short_description:
Fast-paced twin stick shooter rogue-lite action.

"May the soil we conquer nurture the holy seeds of the great bamboo".

686748290.title: Atari Flashback Classics Vol. 1
686748290.short_description: Relive the golden age of video games on the Xbox One. From arcade legends to 2600 classics, Atari® Flashback Classics, Vol.1 delivers 50 iconic Atari games, including Combat®, Centipede®, Swordquest™, and many more. All new achievements, leaderboards and social features, combined with an amazing archive of classic artwork make Atari Flashback Classics the ultimate Atari collection!

686783342.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
686783342.short_description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

687339341.title: Brawlhalla
687339341.short_description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or locally. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android and Steam! Frequent updates. Over fifty Legends.

687576060.title: Skylanders SuperChargers Portal Owner's Pack
687576060.short_description:
XBOX ONE PORTAL OF POWER™ REQUIRED TO PLAY*

The Skylanders® SuperChargers Portal Owner’s Pack includes the full video game, works with any portal from the Skylanders series and includes Instant Spitfire and Instant Hot Streak. Expand your gameplay experience with over 40 Skylanders and vehicles to collect, and embark on epic adventures over land, under sea, and through the sky to save Skylands!

*Skylanders Spyro’s Adventure portal does not support PvP or Co-op play with SWAP Force Skylanders.

687953907.title: STARWHAL
687953907.short_description:
Flop it out with up to 4 players in a retro, epic narwhal battle in space! The heart-piercing action is furious and unrelenting. 

STARWHAL will change your life.

688015781.title: Flinthook
688015781.short_description: Live the life of space captain Flinthook! Armed with your mighty hookshot, your uncanny slow-motion powers and your trusty blasma pistol, plunder and fight your way through an infinite variety of randomly-assembled spaceships for treasure, loot and fame!

688529719.title: STAY
688529719.short_description: When Quinn wakes up alone in a locked room with nothing of note save for a computer hooked up to an internet chat room in which you're present, you become his single ray of hope. Your choices – and your timeliness – will single-handedly shape his escape efforts… or lead him down the path to an untimely end.

688816924.title: Moon Hunters
688816924.short_description: Play alone or with friends! A co-op personality test about exploring an ancient, occult world in 5 days. How will you be remembered?

689916261.title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr Ultimate Edition
689916261.short_description:
The Ultimate Edition includes Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor – Martyr and all additional content.

You are an Inquisitor, the Imperium's most powerful agent.
In this action-RPG, choose from amongst several character classes and take part in tactical and violent combat, in solo or co-op mode.

690285705.title: The Long Dark
690285705.short_description: The Long Dark is a thoughtful, exploration-survival experience that challenges solo players to think for themselves as they explore an expansive frozen wilderness in the aftermath of a geomagnetic disaster. There are no zombies -- only you, the cold, and all the threats Mother Nature can muster.

690811594.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES 2
690811594.short_description:
WORLD HEROES 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1993.
Players are able to take part in epic battles between 14 historic figures such as Hanzo Hattori and Jeanne. Players can enjoy numerous battle strategies via the simple but deep game system featuring mechanics such as "Throw Back" and "Projectile Bounce Back".

690974671.title: King's Heir: Rise to the Throne (Xbox One Version)
690974671.short_description: Two royal knights, Edmund and Randall Ulmer, are tricked into a conspiracy against the crown. Pursued by the royal guard and ruthless conspirators, the brothers embark on a dangerous journey that will uncover the kingdom's shameful secrets, restore the honor of the Ulmer family and change their fate forever.

691691903.title: Adam's Venture: Origins
691691903.short_description: Play as Adam and embark on a bold adventure with your companion Evelyn to unravel the secret of Eden. Set in the roaring 20’s, you explore ancient ruins and solve ingenious puzzles as you try to outsmart the evil Clairvaux company.

691951030.title: Deep Ones
691951030.short_description: «Deep Ones» is a retro arcade-platformer with multigenre parts, inspired by ZX Spectrum and works of H. P. Lovecraft.

693104257.title: The Station
693104257.short_description: The Station is a first-person sci-fi mystery set on a space station sent to study a sentient alien civilization. Assuming the role of a recon specialist, players must unravel a mystery which will decide the fate of two civilizations.

693381002.title: LEGO® The Incredibles
693381002.short_description: Experience the thrilling adventures of the Parr family as they conquer crime and family life through both Disney-Pixar films The Incredibles and Incredibles 2, in a LEGO® world full of fun and humor.

693693640.title: NASCAR Heat Evolution
693693640.short_description:
For the first time on Xbox One, race as your favorite NASCAR Sprint Cup Series drivers across all 23 licensed NASCAR tracks in stunning HD with incredibly detailed environments.

Get ready for the most fun you’ve had with a NASCAR game in years! Whether you’re a casual racer or die-hard sim fan, NASCAR Heat Evolution will adjust to your skill level with a brand new AI and Speed Rating system that applies the right amount of challenge for you.

694107204.title: Dance Central Spotlight
694107204.short_description: The newest game in the award-winning Dance Central series focuses on the core dance experience. With more routines per song than ever before and a massive library of additional songs for purchase, Dance Central Spotlight is all about you and the music.

694139546.title: Crawl
694139546.short_description: Crawl is the dungeon crawler where you control the monsters! As a malicious spirit, you haunt a hero as he explores the dungeons, possessing cruel traps and horrid beasts in an effort to slay him. Succeed and you re-gain your mortal form... now you are the hero, and now it's your turn to Crawl! Bring some friends to add local-multiplayer mayhem to the mix as you race to gain enough XP and loot to face them all, as they possess the limbs of the hulking final boss!

694552821.title: Commander Cherry for Kinect
694552821.short_description:
Welcome aboard, cadet! 
Help Commander Cherry on his puzzled journey and get creative with your body!

694833041.title: Battle High 2 A+
694833041.short_description:
The fast-paced fighting action of the Battle High series comes to Xbox One with improved graphics, balancing, and "enlightening" newcomers, Lucio Marmo and Beat, in Battle High 2 A+! 

Face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced as 14 students (and 1 insidious faculty member) and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

695383702.title: Outbreak
695383702.short_description: Race against the clock and battle the undead in this hardcore co-op survival horror nightmare.

695693557.title: Riptide GP: Renegade
695693557.short_description: Experience the future of illicit hydrojet racing, where armored riders kick out death-defying stunts over massive waterfalls, dodge cops through public waterways, and boost at breakneck speeds across surging waves.

696111680.title: BOKOSUKA WARS Ⅱ
696111680.short_description:
A sequel to the classic simulation RPG "Bokosuka Wars" with new features like dynamic stages, a 3rd nation, a new character and a 2 player co-op mode!

(C)2016 iTA-CHOCO RASHO
(C)2016 KADOKAWA CORPORATION
(C)2016 PYGMY STUDIO CO.,LTD.

696196977.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE
696196977.short_description: The latest Dragon Ball game lets players customize & develop their own warrior. Create the perfect avatar, train to learn new skills & help Trunks fight new enemies to restore the original story of the series. Join 200+ players around the world in the Toki Toki City hub & fight with or against them, and compete in online tournaments!

696603087.title: Demons with Shotguns
696603087.short_description: The ultimate couch fragger gibfest! Armed with a powerful boomstick and bullet deflecting shield, up to four players wage unholy war against each other as they compete for souls in nine different local multiplayer game modes (wave mode for 1-2 players also included) across four realms and 40 arenas. This is demonic local multiplayer action at its bloodiest!

696943051.title: Xenoraid
696943051.short_description: Xenoraid is an intense vertically scrolling shoot'em up with dynamic combat. Classic action gameplay with modern features like procedurally driven missions, fighter switching, and squadron management make Xenoraid a fresh and thrilling shooter!

696971555.title: Just Dance® 2019 Demo
696971555.short_description: Try the Just Dance 2019 Demo for free now and dance to "One Kiss" by Calvin Harris & Dua Lipa! Download the demo now and bust out your best moves! You can play the Just Dance 2019 Demo with just your smartphone! Simply download the free Just Dance Controller App to your smartphone to dance with up to 6 players!

697063683.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles
697063683.short_description: Return to the world of survival horror. Monstrous beasts and disfigured remnants roam freely with their numbers increasing rapidly. Scattered and separated from your fellow survivors, you've fled into a large manor estate to escape the relentless horde. Your only goal now is survival. Explore the manor, locate supplies and find a way to wake from this nightmare. But somehow... you know your fate is sealed.

698904373.title: The Park
698904373.short_description: Set in a creepy amusement park hiding a dark and sinister secret, The Park is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration and storytelling.

699525164.title: Mega Man 11 Demo Version
699525164.short_description: Block Man must be defeated! In this free demo, use the new Double Gear system to slow time or power up your shots to take on devious enemies and traps. Do you have what it takes to take down the deadly Robot Master boss and steal his powers?

699549304.title: Valhalla Hills - Definitive Edition
699549304.short_description: In Valhalla Hills you are Leko – youngest son of Odin, exiled to Midgard by your father for failing to meet his expectations. Far from home, you now find yourself with a disgruntled band of muscleheads. To get back to Asgard, you will have to lead your outcast Vikings through the mountain region of Valhalla Hills, where a magical portal awaits to take you to your rightful place in the realm of the gods. But the journey is a hazardous one, and the Vikings will need to do one thing first…survive!

699731308.title: BioShock Infinite: The Complete Edition
699731308.short_description: Indebted to the wrong people, private investigator Booker DeWitt must take on an impossible task: travel to a flying city above the clouds, and rescue a woman named Elizabeth.

701037441.title: Age of Wonders: Planetfall
701037441.short_description: The Star Union: once a vast empire connecting thousands of worlds, but its people have been left isolated and stranded following the Collapse. Hundreds of years later, separation has turned siblings into divergent alien species - independent factions who are setting out to rebuild the world as they see fit.

702634063.title: The Swapper
702634063.short_description:
What if someone knew your mind better than you did?

The Swapper is an award-winning, narrative driven puzzle game set in the furthest reaches of space.

702883504.title: The Long Reach
702883504.short_description: The Long Reach is an adventure game filled with colorful characters, puzzles, and a shock of discovery. Wait, weren't we supposed to say, “joy of discovery”? That can’t be right.

703233385.title: Tower of Guns
703233385.short_description: Tower of Guns is a fast-paced, bullet-hell, first person shooter with randomized levels and enemies, power ups, epic bosses and tons of unlockable items and weapons. You never know what to expect next!

703431595.title: Knee Deep
703431595.short_description: When a washed-up actor hangs himself on location, a spotlight is cast on the backwater Florida town of Cypress Knee. Knee Deep is a crime thriller where choices matter as you investigate this mysterious suicide. Use your skills of observation, deduction, and cleverness to pull back the curtain and reveal the true story behind a swampland conspiracy.

703886774.title: Monster Jam: Crush It!
703886774.short_description: Monster Jam® Crush It! brings you an all new action packed Monster Truck game of the most popular touring show in the world! Take control and experience Monster Jam® like you’ve never seen.

703997631.title: TowerFall Ascension
703997631.short_description: TowerFall Ascension is the definitive version of the hit archery combat game. Inspired by classics from the golden age of couch multiplayer, it's a 4-player local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches. The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but hard to master and combat is fierce.

704208617.title: XBOX
