1643624971.title: Spellagis
1643624971.short_description:
Use your powers of sorcery to fend off waves of fiendish enemies in top-down pixel art arenas!

Spellagis is a survival shooter where you take the role of a mage beset by swarms of blobs, snakes, ghosts, maggots and more. Wield your staff and fire magical projectiles to slay your foes, then collect coins they drop to buy items from the shop to keep stacking the deck in your favor, from spell enhancements and protective summons to food for quick health boosts. Destroy barrels in the arena for random potions and stacks of coins! Just always stay on your toes or enemy hordes will box you in.

Will you become the most powerful mage as you fight to survive, or will you succumb to the onslaught?

1643667072.title: Mechanita
1643667072.short_description:
Puzzle your way through a steampunk world of precision platforming and roving robots!

Get ready for a steampunk-themed adventure in Mechanita, a side-scrolling platformer packed with brainteasing pixel art stages! Take control of a goggled heroine as she carefully navigates 50 unique levels of gradually increasing complexity.

Run, jump and shoot with precision as you try to reach the airship at the far end of each stage. Avoid spike traps and roving enemies, hop on prop-driven lifts, use your blaster to stun robotic foes and jump on their heads to reach greater heights! Will you master this wonderfully mechanized world or fall victim to its clockwork creations?

1643697302.title: Ballotron Oceans (Windows 10)
1643697302.short_description:
Welcome to the next part of Ballotron!
You also shoot balls but everything happens underwater.
Make the Blue Ball hit the Green Ball to achieve the goal.
This time the level solutions will be even more fun!

1643768709.title: Gabriels Worlds The Adventure (Xbox Series)
1643768709.short_description: Help Gabriel find out what happened to his friends, explore levels with a high degree of difficulty, puzzles, collectibles and a beautiful story, in a precision platform game focused on exploration.

1643964549.title: Alchemist: Journey of The Soul
1643964549.short_description: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas! Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential. Are you willing to do what it takes to claim a soul of your own?

1644006979.title: ENDLESS Legend™ 2 (Game Preview)
1644006979.short_description: Lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet.

1644028139.title: Pillars of Eternity 2: Deadfire - Ultimate Edition (PC)
1644028139.short_description:
The award-winning RPG from the masters at Obsidian Entertainment finally arrives, featuring all major updates and expansions. 

The god Eothas awakens from his slumber, killing you and stealing a piece of your soul. Now resurrected, it is up to you and your companions to use magic, gunpowder, and steel to uncover the rogue god's machinations as he tramples across the Deadfire Archipelago.

1644135254.title: Dark Wukong Lagends
1644135254.short_description: Dark Wukong Legends is a fast-action platformer fighting game. Run, jump, battle enemies, unlock powers, and defeat epic bosses at the end of every level!

1644175486.title: Roll The Cat
1644175486.short_description: Peaceful puzzle game with multiple adorable kitties.

1644268993.title: Little Mage Adventure
1644268993.short_description: Platform adventure game where Mage Boy must cross the mystic valley where he meets many challenges. Collect all stars to achieve a high score in each level. Little Mage Adventure is a super fun and challenging 2D side-scroller game in the same style as blockbuster games. The game features 30 levels that will challenge you to beat it. Have fun!

1644270339.title: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship - Remastered
1644270339.short_description: Rediscover the breathtaking world of Windstorm. Delve into the fascinating story of Mika, a girl known as a horse whisperer, as she befriends the majestic black stallion called Windstorm – with fully updated graphics and a new photo mode!

1644305516.title: BlockWars
1644305516.short_description: A delightful platform shooter game for all ages, challenge your friends in this mind-boggling game that features mind-boggling, frantic gameplay, choose from 8 amazing characters, challenge up to 4 friends in this didinamic and adorable local multiplayer game, beat your friends in all 8 arenas available, try to be the last player alive, collect wins and be the first in the ranking.

1644314486.title: Ninja Master Toru (Windows)
1644314486.short_description: An evil curse that transforms the dead into living corpses was cast upon the land. The only way to stop the entire nation from crumbling to the undead is defeating the Kind of Undead, but entire armies of soldiers were annihilated and transformed into zombies. Only the master of steath, Ninja Master Toru, can infiltrate into the enemy territory and claim the leader's head!

1644377505.title: Allison's Diary: Rebirth
1644377505.short_description: Immerse yourself into this terrifying first person horror adventure, where you will have to explore and search for the truth about the night Allison killed her parents, while trying to survive against the darkness.

1644398698.title: Zombies, Aliens and Guns DEMO
1644398698.short_description: Earth’s last hope against an invasion is a bunch of soldiers.

1644512231.title: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia Back To Past
1644512231.short_description: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia is a spot-the-difference game with a twist! The Cheddar Mafia is breaking all the rules by going back in time! Travel across iconic eras, spot every difference, and foil their most absurd plan yet! Explore hand-drawn scenes, catch all 25 mafia rats, fix the past, and restore the timeline before it’s too late!

1644555235.title: STRIKERS 1945
1644555235.short_description:
The immensely popular and challenging arcade shooter masterpiece from Psikyo—
now with online rankings!

1644577583.title: Ion Fury
1644577583.short_description: Ion Fury is a true old-school first-person shooter from legendary 3D Realms, publisher Fulqrum Publishing and indie studio Voidpoint, set in a cyberpunk metropole. Blast your way through enemies like it’s 1990’s again.

1644613252.title: Winkeltje: The Little Shop
1644613252.short_description: Winkeltje: The Little Shop is all about building, decorating, and running your own old-world fantasy shop. Buy low, sell high - from nails and apples to swords and alchemic love potions. Impress your customers, craft items, and be the master of your very own shop.

1644860924.title: Gato Roboto
1644860924.short_description: Pounce inside of your cozy armored mech and set off on a dangerous trek through an alien underworld full of irritable creatures and treacherous obstacles in a valiant effort to save your stranded captain and his crashed spaceship. Tiptoe outside the friendly confines of your technological marvel and follow your feline instincts through tight tunnels and mysterious waterways to scavenge for new weapons and gear. Adventure awaits the most curious of cats in Gato Roboto!

1644975436.title: Rollerdrome
1644975436.short_description: Rollerdrome is a third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

1644979601.title: Chernobylite Complete Edition
1644979601.short_description: Chernobylite is a sci-fi survival horror RPG with challenging combat and a unique crafting mechanic. Set in the hyper-realistic, 3D-scanned wasteland of Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone, explore a non-linear storyline in your search to uncover the truth.

1644983795.title: Faeland Demo
1644983795.short_description: Begin your journey in Faeland, a handcrafted 2D action-adventure RPG inspired by the 8-bit classics.

1645030778.title: Smart Moves (for Windows 10)
1645030778.short_description:
"Smart Moves" is a puzzle with a strong roguelike feel. Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

"Smart moves" is a combination of puzzle and turn-based roguelike mechanics. Destroy monsters, open chests!

The hero can attack monsters when both are standing on neighboring squares. Avoid being the first at a distance of impact! The hero can't skip turns, but can use level objects - or other monsters - to “skip” the turn.

Every game level is a puzzle with its own logical solution. You have to discover and learn how objects interact with each other in the game world. You get a new playing experience where game mechanics are of maximum importance. Original art style included.

1645103025.title: Sin Slayers: Reign of The 8th
1645103025.short_description: Seven Deadly Sins. Have you heard about the 8th? Delve into madness in Sin Slayers, a challenging RPG Roguelite where you decide how much sin to bear as you transform the world. Assemble a party of wicked adventurers, kill, and pillage to drive off a gluttonous nightmare in turn-based battles.

1645103109.title: Shred! Remastered
1645103109.short_description: Bust out sick tricks and gnarly combos in over 30 courses inspired by Mountain Bike culture, hand crafted by a solo Dev who lives and breathes Mountain Biking!

1645263280.title: がっぽり！爆走人力車
1645263280.short_description: 人力車で街を突っ走る、和風爽快ドタバタゲーム！.

1645309277.title: Zero Squares (Xbox One)
1645309277.short_description: Zero Squares is a minimalist puzzle game that challenges your logic and strategy. Move the colored squares into their matching slots and clear the board.

1645311014.title: Tony and Clyde
1645311014.short_description: Back to the classics, Tony and Clyde is a story driven Arcade Shooter.

1645346930.title: The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge
1645346930.short_description:
Experience the feeling that surfers feel propelled by the power of the waves. With simple controls do cutbacks, stalls, schwacks, airs, and tube rides. A realistic 3D surfing simulation.
Compete against your friend with two player contests or test your surfing by completing the challenge levels.

1645357835.title: RAINBOW HIGH™: RUNWAY RUSH
1645357835.short_description: Play as the Rainbow High girls and use their unique talents to complete your first art assignment. #LetYourTrueColorsShine.

1645369996.title: Jumper (Demo)
1645369996.short_description: Platformer game that is very simple.

1645447317.title: Farm Manager 2022
1645447317.short_description:
Get ready for a logistic challenge in the next part of the best-selling series, which has been sold in over 120,000 copies! In Farm Manager 2022, as a farm manager, you have to ensure the right level of harvest, employee satisfaction, animal health, equipment efficiency and proper crop processing. You can buy new plots and use materials from abandoned buildings to expand your farm. Thanks to the new, more intuitive interface, employee management is even simpler.

In Farm Manager 2022 you will find even more plant species to grow. Now also organic ones! Grow celery, carrots, currants, gooseberries, onions and more. Observe plant growth. The new mechanics allow automatic field management using available employees and machines.

Enjoy a variety of machines that you can use when working in the field. Buy and sell them on the stock market. Look for bargains among used machines.

In Farm Manager 2022 you will find bees, sheep, goats, chickens, turkeys, ducks, geese and cows. For the first time, you will be able to set up a fish farm, ostrich, wild boar and quail farm.

Logistics center, mechanic’s garage, veterinary center and much more! The logistics center will allow you to transport larger quantities of resources and products easier and faster. In the mechanic’s garage, they will take care of your agricultural machinery. Employees from the veterinary center will ensure the health of your farm animals.

Prepare fields in spring, care for plants in summer, harvest crops in autumn and grow plants in greenhouses in winter. The weather can be dangerous for your farm. Heavy rain and hail may affect crop harvesting, and a thunderstorm can cause a fire that will damage your farm.

A satisfied employee is a good employee! Hire permanent and seasonal employees. Keep employees satisfied, control payroll and overtime. Increase their qualifications through trainings. Remember that everyone deserves a rest. Angry employees can leave at any time, so it’s really worth taking care of them.

1645452783.title: Betomis (Xbox)
1645452783.short_description:
Explore dark dungeons as a valiant knight and survive using your wits and limited resources!

Enter the tricky pixel art dungeons of Betomis, where you’ll need to carefully observe and explore your surroundings in order to escape! Betomis is a retro 2D action platformer where each chamber of the sprawling dungeon is a single screen of environmental puzzling. Light is limited. Weapons are scarce. But deadly hazards are aplenty, from spikes and spinning saw blades to creatures and carnivorous plants!

1645505906.title: Wreck Runners
1645505906.short_description: Physics-based co-op extraction game for crews of up to 4 players players. Venture into the twisted Bermuda Triangle aboard the ORCA, a hybrid utility craft that can fly, drive and dive. Gather loot, buy new equipment, and unlock cosmetics across chaotic runs.

1645524603.title: Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy - Demo
1645524603.short_description: Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets!

1645565942.title: Grim Trials Demo
1645565942.short_description: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

1645570658.title: The Empty Desk
1645570658.short_description: Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller with narrative adventure elements and unsettling details. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and uncover dark secrets in a world where reality bends and sanity wavers.

1645572933.title: Starlit Kart Racing
1645572933.short_description:
Come show your skills as a pilot and your intelligence to use the super powers of karts! With this perfect combination, you will be the great Starlit Kart champion!

Adrenaline fuels the mind-boggling races between heroes and villains from Starlit Adventures! Do you dare to join this team?

Highlights:
* Race on dozens of exciting tracks
* Experience mud, rain and even night races
* Win special challenges and battles against the Starlit bosses
* Use superpowers and special items to turn disputes around
* Collect beautiful customizable karts
* Choose a category according to your pace (from 150cc to 600cc)

Yes, you are able to feel all that adrenaline!

Starlit Kart Racing is part of the Starlit franchise, which features free-to-play action and puzzle games for all ages available on mobile platforms and consoles. The fun is guaranteed by intelligent controls designed for a better experience with the adorable characters from the Starlit universe.

1645577996.title: Must Dash Amigos
1645577996.short_description: Loco top-down Battle Racer with Piñata Stampedes, Avocados and mayhem for up to 4 Players!

1645584645.title: Spot Challenge Vol. 4
1645584645.short_description: Spot Challenge is a game series inspired by 'Find the Differences,' where you compare two images and spot over 245 differences across 35 levels. Play solo or with friends and family—test your attention to detail in this fun challenge!

1645584690.title: Mechapunk
1645584690.short_description:
Mechapunk is 2D Action Adventure Platformer Game,

Our main character embarks on an adventure,
but what room! Robots have taken over the world!
Embark on a grand adventure in this mechanized world!
But fear not, our character is a professional at this!

1645646111.title: Alvastia Chronicles
1645646111.short_description: RPG with over 100 companions?! Set out on an adventure in a retro-styled world!

1645652626.title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
1645652626.short_description:
Kena: Bridge of Spirits is a story-driven action adventure set in a charming world rich with exploration and fast-paced combat. Players find and grow a team of tiny spirit companions called the Rot, enhancing their abilities and creating new ways to manipulate the environment.

Kena, a young Spirit Guide, travels to an abandoned village in search of the sacred mountain shrine. She struggles to uncover the secrets of this forgotten community hidden in an overgrown forest where wandering spirits are trapped.

Find the Rot
Timid and illusive spirits scattered throughout the forest. They maintain balance by decomposing dead and rotting elements.

Key Features
• Build Your Team: Find and collect Rot to gain powerful abilities, make discoveries, and transform the environment.
• Explore: A forgotten village and a strange curse. Draw on the power of the Spirit Realm to restore this once-majestic world.
• Fast-Paced Combat: Spirits have become corrupt, trapped and unable to move on, challenging Kena at every turn.

1645656675.title: Infinos
1645656675.short_description:
Infinos is a pixel art side-scrolling shoot’em up that pays tribute to the golden age of arcade shooters while offering fast-paced, modern gameplay. Take control of the Fauria, a powerful one-of-a-kind fighter ship, and face an overwhelming alien invasion threatening to destroy your entire civilization.

In the distant future, the planet Infinos had become a beacon of technological advancement and interstellar exploration. As its people built a massive space city to house future generations, disaster struck. Contact was suddenly lost with the orbital facility. The truth quickly came to light: the attack was carried out by a mysterious and hostile alien force known as Argus.

All military resistance failed against Argus’ sheer firepower. In a desperate attempt to survive, the last scientists and engineers of Infinos poured everything they had into one final prototype: the Fauria. Equipped with unmatched firepower and cutting-edge technology, this lone ship became the last hope of an entire planet.

Pilot the Fauria through six action-packed stages, each with its own enemies, hazards, environments, and deadly bosses. From fortified enemy bases and mechanical cities to asteroid fields and the devastated core of your home planet, each level offers a new challenge and a unique atmosphere.

Infinos is designed for shoot’em up enthusiasts, retro arcade fans, and players looking for a thrilling, well-crafted challenge. Gear up for a visually striking space war where your skills—and your ship—are the last line of defense.

1645809691.title: Glaive: Brick Breaker
1645809691.short_description:
Rockets. Explosions. Neons. Blasters. 
Glaive: Brick Breaker is a classic and popular arkanoid-type game with beautiful 3D graphics. 
Many power-ups, tons of different stages and dynamic gameplay.

1645842971.title: As Far As The Eye
1645842971.short_description: Build a mobile village and travel with your tribe towards the center of the world in this roguelike turn-based resource-management game.

1645849823.title: I Wanna Be Car (Windows)
1645849823.short_description:
In his craziest dreams, Carl is a car! Accelerate and use ramps to jump through 10 dreamy levels in this inventive fusion between 3D platformer and kart racing game.

Simple to control and rewarding to master! You'll only need two action buttons: accelerate and break/reverse. By combining the two you can charge a boost! Releasing it will increase your top speed and send you flying from ramps and gaps.

In his car dreams, Carl imagines himself driving in cities, flying structures and space stations. Have fun and go wild in levels that are linear and sometimes not! Can you collect everything before reaching the finish line?

- Lite collectathon platformer designed to be fun for all ages and skill levels
- Bump into Cones, drink Sodas and collect timed Stars
- Unique control scheme where you control your character like a car
- Amazing visuals mixing low poly 3D graphics and modern shading
- Upbeat soundtrack for the right mood
- Try to collect everything in each level for the most fulfilling experience with the game.

1645862163.title: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Asia
1645862163.short_description: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia is a spot-the-difference game with a twist! Explore hand-drawn scenes, catch all 25 mafia rats, and bring peace to Asia. Hidden objects, surprises, and justice await. The continent is counting on you!

1645882991.title: Kitten Island 2
1645882991.short_description: The adventure continues! Return to Kitten Island and test your skills across 15 new platforming levels and guide your kitten on an all-new journey.

1645917629.title: Explosive Jake
1645917629.short_description:
Help the little skeleton to explode the way out from dark dungeon and not explode himself.

Explosive Jake - classic arcade game. Not only humans afraid of dark and deep dungeons. Our hero - a little skeleton with unhealthy crave of explosions, which trying to escape from dangerous castle dungeons. Help him to avoid enemies and explode the way out.

1645925675.title: REPLACED Demo
1645925675.short_description: Expose the sinister secrets of Phoenix Corporation as R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body. Set in an alternate 1980s America scarred by nuclear catastrophe, navigate a dark cyberpunk thriller in this narrative-driven 2.5D platformer blending cinematic exploration with fluid, free-flow action.

1645976157.title: Trifox
1645976157.short_description: Trifox is a colourful and cartoonish action-adventure featuring a phenomenal fox with a multitude of talents! Choose from a trio of classes – Warrior, Mage, Engineer – or mix-and-match abilities to create a tailor-made hero!

1646079824.title: Submarine Survivor
1646079824.short_description:
Master the seas, tame what lies beneath and live to explore another day!

Get ready to dive into the ocean's depths, face fearsome sea creatures and collect experience crystals in roguelite action game Submarine Survivor! As you face the blue unknown, you’ll have to upgrade your submarines with various combinations of weapons and chips to become the Lord of the Ocean. Submarine Survivor balances exploration with highly customizable combat across 2D maps packed with mission nodes.

Use your varied weaponry to efficiently fend off enemy mods while completing map objectives, all culminating in a blood-pumping boss fight! Adjust difficulty with modifiers that change how the game is played, earn passive upgrades with research, craft equipable items and strategize on-the-fly. As you progress, you’ll unlock new submarine models to build out your fleet.

1646082476.title: Galacticare
1646082476.short_description: Save the galaxy - one patient at a time! As the new director of Galacticare, you will build and manage a series of hospitals to keep your patients alive for as long as possible - for money! And also because it’s the right thing to do.

1646097714.title: Hell is Us - Demo
1646097714.short_description: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

1646102559.title: Unusual Findings
1646102559.short_description: Three friends uncover mysteries in the 1980s. Follow their amazing adventures in a game where your decisions really matter. Be prepared to spin like a record on your incredible journey back to the era of synthesizers, VHS Rental stores, 8-bit games and evil alien conspiracies.

1646140981.title: Double Kick Heroes
1646140981.short_description:
Double Kick Heroes mixes a shoot'em up with a rhythm game. 
You must survive on the highway to hell by killing monsters with your gundillac. 
Only the power of Metal can save your band!

1646155109.title: Mini Games For GTA the Trilogy the Definitive Edition
1646155109.short_description:
Mini Games For GTA the Trilogy the Definitive Edition Game now Windows Store!
It is an unofficial game. It is a game with many mini-games inspired by the game. It includes puzzles and memory matching games.

1646208827.title: Moo Lander
1646208827.short_description: Moo Lander is all about the milk! Embark on an epic quest to save your dying civilization – tame Mighty Cow bosses, uncover ancient secrets and fight hordes of enemies with a powerful milk arsenal. Enjoy a 4-player local multiplayer with 4 different gameplay modes.

1646285430.title: Space Hulk: Tactics (Windows)
1646285430.short_description: Space Hulk: Tactics is a faithful adaptation of the board game Space Hulk, set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, bringing a unique twist to the cult classic formula. Engage in bloody battles through an immense Space Hulk - a twisted mass of asteroids, wrecked star ships, and debris – as either a squad of Terminator Space Marines or the deadly alien Genestealers. Which side will you choose?

1646312420.title: House Builder
1646312420.short_description: Become one man construction crew and build houses like a simple African mud hut and as complex as a super modern energy saving architectural marvel.

1646334101.title: TramSim: Console Edition
1646334101.short_description: Urban Transport comes to life in TramSim: Console Edition! Experience photorealism in two European cities, Vienna & Munich, no matter where you are in the world, and drive realistic trams on a variety of lines. Run to the timetable and face unique challenges, there is gameplay for every taste!

1646363105.title: SPIRITUS ONE
1646363105.short_description: Return to classic survival horror in a unique new way. Albert and Rose investigate the mansion of 'Sanctuary', home to miscreants and broken souls, a vestige of horrors and dark secrets.

1646378646.title: Cat Quest III
1646378646.short_description: In Cat Quest III you play as a purrivateer in a freely explorable 2.5D open-world swarming with Pi-rats. You can sail the seas in your ship for treasures galore! But prepare for peril, as the Pirate King aims to hunt you down...

1646491435.title: Neko Rescue Tale
1646491435.short_description:
Scurry through the seasons in search of your lost feline friend!

A little kitty’s friend has gone missing, and it’s up to you to guide the frisky feline to rescue them! Presented in side-scrolling pixel art style, Neko Rescue Tale is a traditional action platformer where you guide a heroic cat through seasonally themed stages filled with enemies, traps, pitfalls and more. Run, jump and always land on your feet!

1646531438.title: To the Moon
1646531438.short_description: A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.

1646557419.title: Smoots Golf
1646557419.short_description: Hit the green with your friends at over 40 holes!

1646558960.title: Super Blood Hockey
1646558960.short_description: Arcade sports gaming gets a shot of adrenaline in Super Blood Hockey, a violent homage to classic 8- and 16-bit ice hockey games. Customize your line-up and take to the ice, using fast-paced skills and bone-crunching brutality to dominate.

1646559269.title: Extinction Rifts
1646559269.short_description: Fast-paced FPS where your power grows with every hit and rising combo!

1646597747.title: Dead Reset Demo
1646597747.short_description:
Trapped in a terrifying deathloop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.

1646699138.title: Trajectile Soccer
1646699138.short_description:
(1-4 Players)
Two teams of bottle rockets face off in a competitive match of Soccer. Spin your rocket, try and time your launch, and hope that the other team accidentally flings their rockets off the screen. Play against your friends locally(up to 4 players) or against the computer.

1646762292.title: Rider's Spirits
1646762292.short_description: Prepare to race in this legacy racing game!

1646765342.title: GluMe - Xbox Edition
1646765342.short_description:
Stick together to solve brainteasing stages in retro sliding puzzle style!

Get ready for GluMe, a sliding puzzle game where you control a slime, and any friends you pick up along the way. Move through top-down grid stages, collecting gems across 80 unique puzzles of growing size and complexity.

New challenges keep appearing: sleeping gray slimes wake when touched, turning blue and sticking to you. Use them to cross pitfalls, but don’t grow too big to fit into tight spots. Find the right order to collect gems and uncover secrets. Reset anytime if you get stuck. Enjoy chiptune tunes and retro vibes!

1646780412.title: Dentist Bling
1646780412.short_description: Ready for the ultimate dental experience? Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!

1646787217.title: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
1646787217.short_description: Explore an ANGRY city, meet the WORST people, and beat 'em up with STYLE! Pick your fighter, FREEZE TIME, build custom combos, and knock out your enemies, all to save the president.

1646810031.title: 3D Don't Die Mr. Robot
1646810031.short_description:
Survive a fruity dimension of destruction in fast-paced arcade-style collect’em up style!

Take the role of Mr. Robot who has been trapped in a highly dangerous and rather fruity dimension called the Neon Dunjun. The only way to survive is to collect fruits which explode on contact, destroying any enemies in their blast radius, helping Mr. Robot to cheat death for a few more moments. To assist him further, exploding fruits set off a chain reaction, causing other fruit to explode - filling the screen with destruction and more importantly, POINTS!

3D Don’t Die Mr. Robot is a reboot of the 2D cult hit with a whole new dimension of delights! There's remix mode with hand-made challenges, arcade mode with its high-scoring but mind-melting purity and lime attack mode with, well... limes! Top-down arena combat has never been more juicy!

1646833187.title: Knight's Quest (Windows)
1646833187.short_description: Fight as a knight seeking redemption in a world consumed by darkness. The adventure begins now.

1646893514.title: ミステリート～八十神かおるの挑戦！～
1646893514.short_description:
本作は数多くの名作アドベンチャーゲームを世に送り出した、ゲーム開発者である菅野ひろゆき氏の代表作の一つで、2004年パソコン向けとして発売された本格推理アドベンチャーゲームです。
プレイヤーである若き敏腕の名探偵『 八十神かおる 』 が所属する探偵事務所に事件の調査依頼が舞い込んできます。プレイヤーはコマンド形式で、様々な場所、人物から謎を解くための手掛かりを集め、事件を解決する事が目的となります。

個性豊かな登場人物やバリエーション豊富で飽きさせない多くの謎、驚きの展開の連続で引き込まれるストーリーを是非、体験して下さい。.

1646935799.title: Strike Mission XS
1646935799.short_description: Strike Mission is a top-down aerial action game where you play as pilot Jake Walker on a mission to stop a global terrorist threat. Engage in intense battles, daring rescues, and sabotage operations across seven action-packed missions.

1646978734.title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
1646978734.short_description: POLICE SIMULATOR: PATROL OFFICERS offers a Simulation Mode for veteran players looking for the most authentic experience, as well as a Casual Mode for players who want a more relaxing patrol around the streets of Brighton.

1646983647.title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket
1646983647.short_description: Shop Simulator: Supermarket is a chill retail management game where you can build and run your own supermarket without the real-world stress. Perfect for when you want to zone out and have some simple fun managing a shop.

1646985614.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy - The Game
1646985614.short_description: Back in December 2020, Xbox called all gamers, Space Jam fans and coding enthusiasts to submit their ideas for the new Space Jam: A New Legacy game available first with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate. After reviewing submissions from around the world, Xbox and the Digital Eclipse development team selected the ideas and game concepts from two lucky winners, whose ideas have come to life in one of the looniest arcade style challenges around.

1647023800.title: Legend Bowl
1647023800.short_description: Legend Bowl is a throwback to the classic 8-bit and 16-bit football games of the past. Take to the gridiron and fight your way to becoming a football legend! Enjoy sim-style gameplay, realistic weather, detailed stats, franchise mode, tournament mode, fully customizable rosters, and much much more!

1647070017.title: Yoko & Yuki: Dr. Rat's Revenge
1647070017.short_description:
Yoko & Yuki: Dr. Rat's Revenge is a family game suitable for kids of all ages. Yoko and Yuki are two adorable cats in love with each other. But the devious doctor Rat stole Yuki from Yoko. Now it’s time to do some cat business — to save the girlfriend, using helpful gadgets and finding the solution for any puzzle.

That is no ordinary cat — our hero is equipped with scissors to cut ropes, gravitron to flip the world and spray can to find hidden objects. And the game gets harder and harder with new puzzles and challenges. Daring players would be handsomely rewarded for using their wits and helping two cats to achieve their happiness!

1647091967.title: Horror Maze - Dungeon Edition
1647091967.short_description:
Arcade gameplay with modern design. This horror-themed maze game is an homage to one our favorite arcade games. Collect all the pills without getting caught by the 4 horrifying ghosts to beat the highscore.
Listen closely to dodge the ghosts and unlock 2 secret game modes!

1647209308.title: Cyber Tank Nano

1647221564.title: CocoRally Ultimate
1647221564.short_description: The NEXT Generation Of Racing Games!

1647297175.title: Super Waifu Ball
1647297175.short_description:
Roll, collect, and dive into the waifu-filled adventure of your dreams!

Super Waifu Ball is an arcade-style adventure where you roll through colorful, obstacle-filled worlds as a cast of adorable waifus. Complete levels, collect stars, and unlock collectible waifu figurines from the gacha machine!

Get ready for a gravity-defying, action-packed adventure in Super Waifu Ball, an arcade-style game where you roll through vibrant, obstacle-filled worlds as you control a cast of lovable waifus.
Master each level, collect stars, and navigate through increasingly tricky courses to unlock exciting rewards and surprises!

1647338299.title: Tower of time
1647338299.short_description: Lead the ultimate party of heroes into the Tower of Time, a vertical battleground filled with lore, mystery, and combat. Combining the nuances of classic RPGs with challenging tactical combat, Tower of Time transforms each battle into a puzzle of magic and mettle. Slow or pause time to plan your every move: strategically place your warriors, control the battleground with precise spells, counter incoming waves with devastating maneuvers.

1647357054.title: Blade Assault
1647357054.short_description:
Fight against the corrupt military of Esperanza as part of the resistance force of the Undercity. Bring the corrupt to justice by becoming stronger and fighting alongside your trusty comrades.

Blade Assault is a 2D action rogue-lite platformer with beautiful pixel art set in a desolate sci-fi world. The game features tight, responsive controls and a cast of charming characters. Playable characters have various transformable weapons that they use to battle against their enemies. Weapons can be further customized by different “Cores” and “Transform Upgrades” that appear randomly during gameplay.

Satisfying fast-paced combat. Utilizing diverse skills, dodging enemy attacks by dashing, launching projectiles, slashing away mobs of enemies. Your attacks change according to the “Cores” you select and the upgrades you decide to take on your runs.

Meet NPCs and find upgrades along your quest to unlock unique powers. Each playable character has their own weapons of choice kept in their own armory.

1647455747.title: Ellphaser (Xbox One)
1647455747.short_description: An elephant, precise jumps, and a world that changes with every leap!

1647467336.title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut
1647467336.short_description: Jump into adventure in this love letter to platformers! Play in single-player or couch co-op, and enjoy 8 colorful worlds, classic platforming challenges, and music by legendary composer David Wise.

1647479205.title: The Tale of Bistun
1647479205.short_description: The Tale of Bistun is a story-driven action-adventure game inspired by the famous Persian tragic romance “Khosrow and Shirin”. A stone carver with no memory of who he must traverse blighted lands to discover his identity and the source of a pleading, strangely familiar whisper.

1647550751.title: Prune & Milo
1647550751.short_description: Join Prune & Milo, a sister-brother duo, in this enchanting turn-based puzzle game.

1647566775.title: CD-RUN
1647566775.short_description: Leap over obstacles and opponents in this arcade-style race royale with one goal: Stay on the screen!

1647606257.title: Awesome Pea
1647606257.short_description: Welcome to the Awesome Islands World! Help the greedy Pea make his way through a string of levels filled with deadly traps and cute (but dangerous) enemies and collect all the coins he can reach!

1647622476.title: Teocida + Estigma
1647622476.short_description: Enter the surrealistic horror world of Teocida+Estigma!

1647672528.title: The Eternal Cylinder Demo
1647672528.short_description: In The Eternal Cylinder, players control a herd of adorable creatures called Trebhums and must explore a strange alien world filled with exotic lifeforms and surreal environments.

1647778757.title: What Lies in the Multiverse TGA21Demo
1647778757.short_description: Welcome to What Lies in the Multiverse – a dimension-shifting, comedic adventure about worlds turned inside out through the powers of one gifted young boy and the misguided lessons of an eccentric scientist.

1647836151.title: An Airport for Aliens Currently Run by Dogs
1647836151.short_description: An Airport for Aliens Currently Run by Dogs is an open-world comedy game set in a universe of simulated airports run by stock photo dogs. Solve their problems. Translate mysteries. Catch your flight.

1648049613.title: An Evil Existence
1648049613.short_description:
In the remote English town of Boatnug the Hartley household awaits anyone who dares to step foot onto their property. Occupied by a murderous family with a very dark past. 

When Unsolved mysteries social media page creators Lisa and her Boyfriend James decide to visit the Hartley household to capture footage for their social media page. They soon regret ever going there.

Within the first 5 minutes of game play you will be trapped into a interactive nightmare, a horrific exploration of pure and realistic survival horror.

The only way to survive and stay alive is to defend yourself from each member of the family who engage in combat through out the game. 

You are never safe.

Do you dare to visit the Hartley Household.

1648052713.title: Déjà Vu
1648052713.short_description: A minimalist puzzle game about life, death, and clones.

1648092060.title: Detective From The Crypt
1648092060.short_description:
Detective From The Crypt is a mystical Victorian detective story in which you play for a ghost girl helped by a ghost cat.

Jane wakes up in a crypt as a ghost. You are investigating the death of her family together. Seeking and researching evidences. Building an accusation based on them. You have a laboratory to research evidences. Play and get the feeling of being a true Victorian detective.

Reveal the secrets of the old estate while playing the game.

1648258499.title: Jaden & Jasmine: The Curse of Deception
1648258499.short_description: Follow a college student named Jaden Black who's on the run from the government.

1648305723.title: Sweet Candy: 2024 Crush
1648305723.short_description: The delightful and addictive vertical Windows game that will satisfy your sweet tooth and captivate your senses! Embark on a scrumptious adventure through a world filled with colorful candies, enchanting puzzles, and mouthwatering challenges.

1648318214.title: The Lord of the Rings: Gollum™
1648318214.short_description: Play as Gollum on his quest to retrieve his Precious. You will need to climb the mountains of Mordor, sneak around Mirkwood and make difficult choices. Who will gain the upper hand: the cunning Gollum or the innocent Smeagol?

1648318558.title: Quriocity Demo
1648318558.short_description: Quriocity is a sci-fi city builder game set on a bare alien planet very similar to Earth. Build and upgrade a wide variety of units to extract resources and provide services, such as maintenance, food production, education, entertainment and many more.

1648364111.title: Snack and Quack (Xbox Series)
1648364111.short_description: Guide hungry ducklings through 30 levels full of challenges.

1648491052.title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles
1648491052.short_description: Bulwark: Evolution mixes elements of a chill builder with grand strategy and exploration elements. It's a genre bending experimental game that can be both a peaceful building experience or a total conquest with airships, warbirds and fortresses. It's up to the player to decide.

1648504568.title: Pyramid Platformer - The Gem Heist (Xbox Series)
1648504568.short_description: Explore the pyramid world in Pyramid Platformer, a challenging 2D pixel art game. Face 40 levels filled with traps like spikes and spinning saws. Unlock skills like Double Jump and Dash, and collect gems to advance on this thrilling journey full of challenges!

1648532653.title: Little Droid
1648532653.short_description: Little Droid is an adventure platformer that takes you to a world of mysteries, tough enemies, and hidden dangers.

1648579041.title: Flowing Lights
1648579041.short_description: Flowing Lights is an Arcade Puzzle Shooter. Each fight is a puzzle. Attack and... Fail! ...Think back... try again! Got it? Improve with each try, there is always a smarter way to win!

1648619937.title: Edge of Eternity
1648619937.short_description: Wage epic turn-based battles as you follow Daryon and Selene on their quest to find a cure to the all-consuming Corrosion in this grand tale of hope and sacrifice, created by a small team of passionate JRPG lovers.

1648636134.title: Dreamless Girl
1648636134.short_description:
Welcome to this game that combines visual novel and side-scrolling bullet hell shooter elements.

During the day, you will experience the protagonist's school life from her perspective. At night, you will become a secret operative, piloting the Dreambreaker through various dreamscapes. To find her missing sister, the protagonist, Mu Deng, dives into different dreams every night, searching for the clues her sister left behind. Along the way, she encounters various companions and gradually uncovers the secrets behind her sister's disappearance.

1648660389.title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
1648660389.short_description: When stranded on a cursed island, survival takes strategy as well as strength. Conquer intense turn-based battles, recruit allies, adapt to ever-shifting events, and grow stronger with every run. Will you prevail and uncover the truth lying between life and death?

1648714593.title: Midnight Cat Heist (Windows)
1648714593.short_description: Play as a sneaky city cat with sticky paws and a heart of gold. Sneak, leap, and loot your way through cozy urban levels to bring the purrfect gifts home to your beloved human. Every shiny trinket is a treasure in this 2D pixel platformer of feline thievery and chaotic charm!

1648742604.title: Mable & The Wood
1648742604.short_description: Mable & The Wood is a Metroidvania where you can take the form of the bosses that you kill, changing how you're able to explore the interconnected world. It's also a Metroidvania where you don't have to kill anyone.

1648742833.title: Radish - The Veggie Monster Arena Shooter
1648742833.short_description: Radish is an intense, fast-paced and pretty hardcore shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn and addicting. Defeat the evil radishes, survive countless waves of enemies and break your high score. Will you be able to make it to the end?

1648756413.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY - OPEN BETA
1648756413.short_description:
Play the THRONE AND LIBERTY Open Beta

Gather your guild and prepare for battle. You’re invited to the THRONE AND LIBERTY Open Beta starting on July 18th, 2024, at 10 am PST. Sign up for the THRONE AND LIBERTY newsletter to be reminded to join the battle.

Join the battle and immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of THRONE AND LIBERTY, a free-to-play game that revolves around guild-focused combat. Engage in thrilling battles against dozens to thousands of other players and fantastic creatures in group battles and massive Castle Sieges. Quick thinking and active decision-making are critical because every choice you make in the ever-changing world of Solisium carries weight and directly shapes your gameplay experience.

1648806031.title: Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves (Windows)

1648813544.title: No One Lives Under the Lighthouse
1648813544.short_description:
You’re alone on this rock, just a lighthouse and the seagulls to keep you company. Nothing else... at least you’re pretty sure that’s it...

The cult slow burn horror hit No One Lives Under the Lighthouse from Marevo Collective is launching on Xbox with updated features!

The previous lighthouse keeper has gone missing without a trace and you are the newest keeper tasked with keeping the lighthouse lit every night. 

Keep your sanity from slipping on this desolate rock in the middle of the ocean, and don’t give in to hallucinations. Let it be a calming reminder that it's just you here, because No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

1648824152.title: Poop It 2: Pop it fidget game
1648824152.short_description: If you feel restless, you can take 30 seconds to relax. Touch or click on poop to crush them and touch to change/match colors. With funny sounds and cute graphics. Have fun!

1648906760.title: Everdream Valley
1648906760.short_description: A farming adventure with a breath of magic. By day, restore your homestead - raise crops, care for animals and rebuild your farm. At night become the various farmland creatures through your dreams.

1648951692.title: Ary and the Secret of Seasons
1648951692.short_description: Ary and the Secret of Seasons is an award-winning adventure game following a young girl as she journeys across the great world of Valdi. By becoming the Guardian of Winter, Ary gains the ability to manipulate the seasons around her. Ary will learn to control the seasons and use them to defeat enemies, overcome obstacles, and solve complex puzzles on her adventure across Valdi.

1649064189.title: World of Tanks: HEAT
1649064189.short_description: World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful hero abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks, unleash Agent skills, and take control in 10v10 online battles where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity.

1649097896.title: SnowRunner - Windows
1649097896.short_description:
Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience! 
SnowRunner puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive 40 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

1649102497.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream
1649102497.short_description: Introducing the 2nd installment for the 10th anniversary of SWORD ART ONLINE! A total of 21 characters from the series join the battle beyond memory—a challenge taken on solo or with friends. Go beyond memory... and Switch!

1649116493.title: Arcade Archives 2 MOUSER
1649116493.short_description:
"MOUSER" is an action game released by UPL in 1983.
Take control of the tomcat Nyanta and rescue his lover Mariya from her mouse captors!
The tricky mice will come at you with all sorts of surprises.
Nyanta will need all your luck and help to make it back with his fiancée!

1649213028.title: Nigger Tycoon
1649213028.short_description:
Gods Funny meme games if u wanna recommend some join my server
https://discord.gg/firmware - ShadowGarden <3.

1649213034.title: Pollito and Xiang Xiang: Adventure in the Forest Demo
1649213034.short_description:
Join Pollito and Xiang Xiang, the universe's most powerful and adorable robot brothers, on an unexpected “vacation.” 

Pollito and Xiang Xiang: Adventure in the Forest is an action adventure co-op game, where you control two cute characters that you can switch between to use their unique abilities,

Pollito is agile, excelling in combos and close combat, while Xiang Xiang can roll to attack and can throw slippers for long range attacks. Face dynamic boss battles, explore a world full of surprises, help the adorable inhabitants of the planet, find and gather resources to improve your home, switch between the Material and Cybernetic Worlds, and find food to get enough energy to regain their mighty robot forms.

In overall, get ready for a multitude of challenges while helping these adorable and super-powered brothers on a "vacation" that is far from relaxing.

1649219414.title: Golazo! 2
1649219414.short_description: Dynamic arcade football game with medium-sized fields and no fouls or offsides. Add street gameplay to this mix to have just pure fun & action!

1649362500.title: Xmas Survivors
1649362500.short_description: Holiday survival shooter where Santa slaughters endless waves of enemies.

1649386760.title: The Entropy Centre
1649386760.short_description: Think in reverse. Outsmart the impossible. A mind-bending first-person adventure where you solve ingenious and complex puzzles by rewinding objects through time.

1649441503.title: The Game of Life 2
1649441503.short_description:
Prepare to live a thousand lives in The Game of Life 2, the award-winning official sequel to the classic board game played by millions around the world. Gather your friends and family and dive into a bright, fun 3D world bursting with adventure!

The Game of Life 2 base game has everything you need to get started: 
The Classic World board
3 x outfits unlocked
3 x avatars unlocked
2 x vehicles unlocked 
3 x additional outfits to unlock
3 x additional avatars to unlock
2 x additional vehicles to unlock 

Plus, as an added bonus, you get two free worlds to play in – the Fairytale Kingdom World and the Haunted Hills World! Each contains a new board, three unlocked outfits, three unlocked avatars, two unlocked vehicles, and eight additional unlockables (three more outfits, three more avatars and two more vehicles). 

Spin the iconic spinner and set off on your life journey. You’ll be presented with decisions at every turn, altering your life path. Will you go to college immediately or drive straight into a career? Will you get married or stay single? Have kids or adopt a pet? Buy a house? Make a career change? It’s up to you! 

Earn points for choices that bring you Knowledge, Wealth and Happiness. Win rich, maximise your Knowledge or Happiness, or go for a healthy mix of all three and come out on top!

HOW TO PLAY THE GAME OF LIFE 2:
1. When it’s your turn, spin the spinner to travel along your life path.
2. Depending on the space you land on, you’ll experience different life events and choices, such as buying a house, collecting your salary, or drawing an Action card! 
3. At crossroads, you’ll have to make big life decisions, so choose wisely!
4. Your turn ends; it’s the next player’s chance to spin the spinner!

FEATURES
- CUSTOMISE YOUR CHARACTER – Choose between the pink, blue or the purple peg. Select an outfit and make your peg your own. Browse a selection of cars, bikes and scooters and find a ride to suit your style. 
- NEW WORLDS – Live life in enchanted worlds! Every new world features new outfits, vehicles, jobs, properties and more! Buy worlds separately in-game, or buy the Ultimate Life Collection to unlock them all!
- UNLOCK NEW ITEMS – Unlock new outfits and vehicles by playing the game and earning rewards! 
CROSS-PLATFORM – Join your friends and family, whether they’re on PC, another console, iOS or Android. 

Live every life you’ve ever dreamed of in The Game of Life 2 – play today!

1649498400.title: Highwater
1649498400.short_description: Earth has flooded and the planet is doomed, but there’s still time to enjoy the view. Guide Nikos and friends through the flooded world of Highwater and beyond in this story driven, adventure game where they’ll have to fight for their chance to escape.

1649519172.title: Retro Tank Arcade
1649519172.short_description:
Retro Tank Arcade brings back the thrill of classic arcade tank battles with a modern twist! Engage in fast-paced combat as you maneuver your tank across pixelated battlefields, dodging enemy fire and launching strategic attacks.

Your mission: destroy all enemy bases before they take out yours! But be careful—if your base falls or you run out of lives, it's game over. Use your gamepad or keyboard to navigate the battlefield, aim precisely, and unleash powerful shots.

Defeat enemy tanks to earn power-ups that enhance your firepower and defense. With retro-inspired visuals and action-packed gameplay, Retro Tank Arcade delivers a perfect blend of nostalgia and challenge. Do you have what it takes to claim victory?

- Classic arcade action with modern controls
- Strategic combat and power-up system
- Supports both gamepad and keyboard controls
- Destroy enemy bases and defend your own

Gear up, roll out, and dominate the battlefield—good luck, commander!

1649642799.title: Neonwall
1649642799.short_description: Travel through a world of neon, solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles. This experience requires focus, concentration, and timing to let the ball rolling as fast as you can. Remember... in a world made of neons... you will need balls to survive.

1649644431.title: Slime's Journey
1649644431.short_description: Embark on a slime’s heroic quest to save his parents.

1649660694.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre - PC Edition
1649660694.short_description:
Take on the role of one of the notorious Slaughter family, or their victims, in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, a third-person asymmetrical horror experience based on the groundbreaking and iconic 1974 horror film.

Experience the mad and macabre for yourself in The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

1649661267.title: Broken Pieces Demo (Summer 2022)
1649661267.short_description: Broken Pieces is a psychological thriller taking place in a French coastal village somehow outside the flow of time. Solve the mysteries by putting the pieces of the story back together by figuring out the enigma behind this mystical place.

1649675719.title: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood
1649675719.short_description:
Max: The Curse of Brotherhood is a classic action-adventure. At its core it is a platformer filled with puzzles. Max must start on a quest to save his brother who is kidnapped to a hostile world. His only chance to succeed is to stay courageous and use the powers of his marker to manipulate the environment. 
Unleash the many powers of the Marker and beat the evil kidnapper!

1649708833.title: Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember (Xbox One)

1649733312.title: Food Truck Tycoon
1649733312.short_description:
Test your skills and talent as owner of a busy food truck!

Your only job is to take orders, prepare food and serve to as many customers as possible.

Be careful not to burn the food!

Fulfill your dream of becoming the tycoon of the best food trucks in the city!

In Fodd Truck Tycoon you will find:

• 150 levels to explore, 50 dishes to serve.
• Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
• Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
• Over 35 Achievements to complete.
• Easy to play and hard to master.

Go ahead, try it out!

1649756512.title: In Harmony
1649756512.short_description: Discover the power to harmonize with the world.

1649832594.title: GRAVITY DOG
1649832594.short_description: Is a runner in which the player is able to control the force of gravity (change the gravity up and down). The goal of the player is to run as far as possible, and it is desirable to get a better result.

1649877246.title: Woot Woot Game
1649877246.short_description: Help Guinea pig (Cavia) to win couple challenges in this game.

1649883054.title: Jump Man
1649883054.short_description:
A highly addictive endless jumper you can play either solo or with friends for couch multiplayer fun! Chain combos, use power-ups, score as high as you can and climb your way up the leaderboards. Attack your opponents with special items while dodging their attacks and see who makes it in the end!

Features:
- Single player – compete for ranks in the leaderboards.
- Couch multiplayer (2-4 players) – attack your opponents while dodging their attacks and see who makes it in the end!
- A gallery of cute but mischievous characters to choose from.

1649891267.title: Doom & Destiny Worlds
1649891267.short_description: When Destiny calls for help, but no one answers, only four nerds can save the day. Armed with hand crafted weapons and bad jokes, can the four nerds survive, defeat three almighty tyrants and find their way home?

1649915618.title: Fragile Equilibrium
1649915618.short_description: Fragile Equilibrium is a game about the imperfection and impermanence of life. It is a reflection on transience, a balancing act to find beauty in decay and inevitable destruction. [FE] invites the player to explore a world of quick actions, forced decisions, and subtle shmup-style strategy.

1649996690.title: Alone in the Dark Prologue
1649996690.short_description:
This stand-alone prologue puts you in the tiny shoes of Grace Saunders – an 11-year-old girl delivering a letter, when things go horribly wrong…
Experience the unique 1920s horror atmosphere of Alone in the Dark and prepare for the terror that awaits in Derceto Manor.

1650081686.title: Wind Peaks
1650081686.short_description: In a place called Wind Peaks, mysteries happen, help the scouts find all the missing objects in this fun and relaxing adventure of treasure hunt.

1650124673.title: XIII A final Game of Tarot
1650124673.short_description:
How long can you play with Death?

Death comes for everyone, and now it’s your turn — but you didn’t expect it to want to read your future. Play your cards the right way and keep your Karma balanced — the closer to zero, the better. Try to achieve the highest score possible in this Roguelike!

Make effective use of the numerical relationships between the cards and their positions to keep the final sum as close to zero as possible. If you play well, you’ll earn money to buy magical coins that modify the cards on the board. Manage these resources wisely to get as far as you can — and beware of RNGesus.

XIII: A Final Game of Tarot With Death is a casual game to get hypnotized by for a few hours — especially great for high-score lovers. Compete with your friends and try to survive until you reach your absolute limit!

80 hours? Nah! This is a short and simple game, but still lots of fun. For those looking for a special challenge, it can offer much more — push past the limits of Tarot and conquer the 23rd round.

1650134876.title: Suika Wan! (Xbox One)
1650134876.short_description: Suika Wan! is a delightfully chaotic puzzle where tiny doggos drop, bounce, and fuse into bigger, fluffier friends, from pomeranians, to french bulldogs, to siberian huskies, each time adding a bigger breed to the screen!

1650138560.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Cats 2
1650138560.short_description:
Jigsaw Puzzle Cats 2 brings cute kittens and traditional jigsaw puzzles to your Xbox again.
Chose between 6 different puzzle sizes from 16 to 400 pieces and more than 45 new different adorable cat pictures and start completing your own jigsaw kitties right now.

1650152885.title: DAEMORGEN: Dawn of Demons (XBox One)
1650152885.short_description: Fast-paced pixel art FPS inspired by Doom, Heretic, and Quake. Battle demons, uncover secrets, and survive brutal combat in a corrupted world.

1650158255.title: Die After Sunset
1650158255.short_description: Action-packed roguelite shooter stacked with hundreds of items, unique quests, monstrous bosses and hordes of enemies. Choose from three unique characters, complete quests and level up after every run!

1650244744.title: Escape Dash Journey (XBOX1)
1650244744.short_description:
Dash, jump, and escape!
Face traps and thrilling challenges in Escape Dash Journey — a fast-paced platformer for all ages.

1650279595.title: World Cruise Story
1650279595.short_description: Captain a luxury cruise liner, sailing the entire world while entertaining VIPs!

1650388856.title: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place
1650388856.short_description: Creepy Tale is a mysterious adventure rich in riddles and eerie atmosphere. An autumn morning promised a quiet fishing trip, but events took Martin to "some other place." Find the way home, uncover loads of secrets, and save everyone that you can.

1650393061.title: Solitaire Dreamscapes
1650393061.short_description:
Drift away into a world of cards and dreams. 

It's time to escape reality with a magical game of Solitaire! 
Travel through surreal landscapes and explore more than 200 levels, 
restoring 5 breathtaking dreamlike locations! 

Choose from 4 different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed. 
Activate 120 brand new Supersize and Challenge levels for a unique gameplay experience. 
Unlock 18 Solitaire variants including classics like Klondike, and new favorites such as Siegecraft or Lady Maria. 
Dozens of gameplay variations enrich the classic Solitaire formula – including obstacles, power-ups, frozen cards, locks, ribbons, seals, bonus cards, and more! 

Search every last level for gems and coins to unlock upgrades for each dream scene, and aim for the elusive “Perfect” rating. 
Complete quests to release beautiful butterflies and birds that bring each world to life. 
Immerse yourself in Solitaire Dreamscapes – where fantasy and Solitaire meet.

Features:
- 200 Solitaire levels!
- 1.

1650442817.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided™
1650442817.short_description: The year is 2029, and mechanically augmented humans have now been deemed outcasts, living a life of complete and total segregation from the rest of society. Now an elite covert agent, Adam Jensen is forced to operate in a world that has grown to despise his kind. Armed with a new arsenal of state-of-the-art weapons and augmentations, he must choose the right approach, along with who to trust, in order to unravel a vast worldwide conspiracy.

1650484516.title: Sokobalien
1650484516.short_description: Build the biggest space farm in the galaxy!

1650506141.title: Beyond Doors (Xbox Series)
1650506141.short_description: Door-to-door, embark on a mystical journey.

1650518258.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die Demo
1650518258.short_description: Take on an ancient evil in Lost in Random: The Eternal Die, a fast-paced action roguelite set in the whimsical world of Random. Play as Queen Aleksandra and her die-companion Fortune as you battle twisted foes, wield powerful relics and abilities, and roll the dice to escape this nightmarish realm.

1650588295.title: OddBallers™
1650588295.short_description: OddBallers™ is a hilariously charming and totally bonkers multiplayer party game where each round is a new, absurd type of dodgeball.

1650593751.title: Calico
1650593751.short_description: Calico is a day-in-the-life community sim game where you are given an important and adorable task: rebuild the town’s cat café and fill it with cute and cuddly creatures! Build up your café by filling it with cute furniture, fun decorations, yummy pastries, and get it bustling with animals again!

1650638194.title: Ocean Oddities
1650638194.short_description: Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot-the-difference game set in underwater worlds, where players find subtle changes among coral, sea life, and treasures. With soothing visuals and timed or stress-free modes, it delivers satisfying “I found it!” moments.

1650669552.title: Block Dash Adventure
1650669552.short_description: Block Dash Adventure is platform jumping and flying game. You need to jump through geometry shapes and to avoid obstacles. The levels are hard, but you can try to pass level countless times. The game has a total of 50 levels and supports Xbox handle, mouse or keyboard to control. Have fun!

1650983927.title: Starward Rogue
1650983927.short_description: Blast your way through the Megalith, a labyrinth lodged in the side of a star.

1651098442.title: Wild West: Hidden Objects
1651098442.short_description: Step into the Cyber Wild West as a sharp-eyed detective! Search for hidden objects, follow clues, and uncover secrets in a town ruled by tech and outlaws. Twists, rivals, and mysterious characters await in this stylish story-driven adventure!

1651139522.title: Orbital Bullet
1651139522.short_description: Orbital Bullet is a fast paced 360° action-platformer with rogue-lite elements, where all actions take place in a circular pattern. Fight your way through a variety of procedural planets and use body modifications, crafting, upgrades and heavy weaponry.

1651162386.title: Rookie Knight (Xbox Series X|S)
1651162386.short_description: Rookie Knight is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer. Run, jump, wall slide, and fight your way through forests, mountains, and castles filled with traps and enemies.

1651196716.title: Steelrising - Beta
1651196716.short_description: Paris, 1789. The French Revolution has been suppressed with bloodshed by Louis XVI and his merciless mechanical army. Aegis, a mysterious automaton masterpiece, must confront the king's army alone to save history in this challenging action-RPG.

1651248133.title: Metal: Hellsinger (Xbox Series X|S & PC)
1651248133.short_description: Slay to the rhythm of metal and vengeance on an infernal journey through the eight Hells. Make them fear the beat. Metal: Hellsinger is a rhythm FPS bursting with demons, badass weapons, and heavy metal music.

1651275231.title: Gravity Escape From The Maze (Xbox Series)
1651275231.short_description: Gravity Escape From The Maze is a fast-paced action platformer where you control a small square with a curious ability.

1651300736.title: Gas Ratio
1651300736.short_description: Hit the gas and trust your luck! Gas Ratio is a high-speed, top-down arcade racer where "Power-Ups" aren't always helpful. Race against bots or challenge your friends in split-screen mode. Will you get a Speed Boost or lose your Gravity?

1651316148.title: Noodlebound (Xbox One)
1651316148.short_description: Slice, Dash, and Recover the Lost Flavor.

1651354273.title: Chomp!
1651354273.short_description: Be quick, because there's a red monster hunting you down. Traverse the maze, eat the dots, and stay away from the hunter. The more you eat, the more points you get. But, don't stay still for long, or you'll be the one getting chomped!

1651367915.title: Nico Saves The State
1651367915.short_description: SAVE and LOAD your state to get all the Crystals!

1651378107.title: Disaster Band
1651378107.short_description: Let's get the party started! Play solo or connect with your friends, pick a track, choose your instrument and start playing away. The fun never stops: Import your own tracks and prove that you and your buddies are not going down in history as the ultimate Disaster Band.

1651407582.title: Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master

1656989818.title: Kitsune Kaeru (Windows)
1656989818.short_description:
Embark on a spiritual journey through a world where ink, boxes, and precision come together.

In a land inspired by traditional Japanese sumi-e art, you play as a small Kyubi who loves cardboard boxes. Use your spiritual powers to create boxes and reshape the environment to your advantage: build platforms, reach impossible places, and find the path to the portals connecting each challenge.

But there’s a catch: the fewer boxes you use, the greater your mastery.

Blending precision platforming with clever puzzles, the game features over 30 levels, each offering multiple ways to solve them. Carefully plan your moves while facing deadly spikes, deep chasms, and powerful winds that can completely change your strategy.

With an art direction that combines pixel art and sumi-e brush strokes, every stage feels like a living painting in motion.

Features
Create magical boxes to solve puzzles and explore the world
Easy to learn, hard to master mechanics
Precision platforming focused on skill and creativity
Efficiency system: use fewer boxes to achieve the highest rank

Discover the balance between strategy, precision, and creativity in a charming and challenging adventure.

1657010226.title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley

1658660555.title: Amazecards (Xbox One)
1658660555.short_description:
Plan each move wisely in Amazecards, a tactical puzzle where your cards determine the fate of a treasure-seeking wizard!

In this challenging strategy game, each card represents a movement. Choosing the correct sequence is essential to cross the board, avoid dangers, and reach the chest at the end of each stage. One wrong step can cause the player to fall into holes or be struck by spike traps that alternate between active and inactive every turn.

🧙‍♂️ Think before you act

At the beginning of each level, carefully observe the map and analyze the available cards.
When a card is played, the wizard moves accordingly — and the card is discarded.

If you run out of cards before reaching the treasure, you must restart the stage. But don’t worry: there is always a possible path. It’s up to you to discover it!

30 levels in single-player campaign mode
Progressive difficulty

3 unique environments:

🌲 Forest
🏜️ Desert
🏰 Dungeon

Each environment introduces new elements, more complex maps, more cards, and more strategic possibilities.

1659234506.title: MFC - Midnight Fight Club
1659234506.short_description:
The gates are locked, the crowd is hushed, and your opponent is waiting. In this underground arena, there is no room for mistakes—only for those with the reflexes to survive and the strategy to win. 

The rules are simple, but the path is brutal. You’ll need to study your opponents, manage your energy, and keep your guard up if you want to climb the ladder. Whether you’re looking for a quick brawl or a long-term rise to glory, the arena offers a raw and honest challenge for anyone brave enough to lace up their gloves.

 Key features:
- Strategic Combat: Balance fast strikes with heavy attacks while managing your stamina. 
- Active Defense: Use manual blocks, ducks, and weaves to stay one step ahead. 
- Daze & Destroy: Chain your hits to stun your rival and land a massive finishing combo. 
- Unique Bosses: Conquer elite arena legends, each with their own specialized fighting patterns.
 - Fighter Growth: Upgrade your Strength, Speed, or Stamina to build your ultimate brawler. 

The bell has rung and the spotlight is on you. Step into the pit and show them who owns the arena.

1659361939.title: Space Shooter : Classic Arcade Game

Welcome to the Neon Apex 

Open only to the most elite racers, both human and other, prove that you can handle breakneck speeds and perilous racecourses to win it all.

1659515488.title: Suika 3D Fruits
1659515488.short_description: Suika 3D Fruits is an evolution of the classic fruit-stacking puzzle. Set in a lush, stylized forest, the familiar merging mechanic is enhanced by dynamic physics, where each fruit — from tiny cherries to heavy coconuts — falls and settles inside a wooden box in the middle of the forest. Players must strategically drop their fruits to trigger a chain reaction of evolutions. Watch your fruits roll and bounce in real time, merging from small grapes and strawberries into larger, more valuable types like oranges and watermelons. With vibrant low-poly visuals, a clear “life cycle” progression, and intuitive gameplay, Suika 3D Fruits turns a simple concept into a fun loop of strategy and cute fruits. Can you stack the fruits inside the wooden box and reach the final fruit before everything overflows?
