1687084892.title: REPLAY BOYS
1687084892.short_description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

1687306134.title: Loot Box Quest - Mystic Maidens
1687306134.short_description: Experience a thrilling adventure with Loot Box Quest - Mystic Maidens, where you can earn money by completing a variety of exhilarating and unpredictable tasks. Level up your skills to take on even more challenging quests and indulge in the excitement of opening captivating loot boxes.

1687392454.title: Control:Override
1687392454.short_description: Control: Override is a puzzle game where you must share control between the environment and yourself. Defy Physics. Solve puzzles . Terminate the rogue AI. And perhaps confront the truth about why it went rogue.

1687514084.title: WW2 Flight Simulator
1687514084.short_description: Experience thrilling WW2 aerial combat with smooth flight controls, challenging missions, and endless action. Defend cities, destroy enemy bases, and prove your skills in the skies ✈️🔥.

1687523022.title: The Alters: Demo
1687523022.short_description: Explore an emotional sci-fi game that features a unique blend of adventure, survival, and base-building elements. Play as Jan Dolski, a simple worker who creates alternative versions of himself in a desperate attempt to escape from a planet where even sun rays can prove deadly.

1687529145.title: Gvina's Space Adventure
1687529145.short_description: Gvina's spaceship crashed into an unknown planet. Now he needs to collect spaceship parts to fix his spaceship.

1687542728.title: Family Mysteries: Poisonous Promises (Xbox One Version)
1687542728.short_description: Entertaining plunge into the world of debauched elites, alluring women and corrupted cops, where power is the ultimate currency. This is a thrilling introduction to the brand new Hidden Object Game series in the tradition of best police dramas.

1687580905.title: Pillar by Michael Hicks and Gonçalo Antunes
1687580905.short_description:
Lost in an intimate snowy town, a palette of individuals are in search of a mysterious artifact said to bring great knowledge and understanding. Lead each character through their quest in this collection of minigames, each with unique personalities and challenges... maybe their paths aren't so different after all. 

Features:
- A collection of minigames, each representing different personality traits (introversion, extroversion etc.) through gameplay mechanics.

- Different people, different gameplay; each part of the game will challenge you in a unique way.

- Explore an intimate snowy town, beautifully hand-painted with attention to every detail.

- A distinct soundtrack, composed hand in hand with the game's design, by the game's designer, to ensure a cohesive experience.

1687585446.title: MENACE (Game Preview)
1687585446.short_description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.

1687693597.title: Assetto Corsa Competizione
1687693597.short_description: Assetto Corsa Competizione is the new official GT World Challenge videogame. Thanks to the extraordinary quality of simulation, the game will allow you to experience the real atmosphere of the GT3 homologated championship, competing against official drivers, teams, cars and circuits.

1687712929.title: Echoes of Aincrad
1687712929.short_description: Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. Create your hero, choose your gear, and master combat by building synergy with your partner, leveling up, and unlocking special abilities to expand your horizons.

1687835525.title: Helping Santa
1687835525.short_description: Help Santa keep his sled save.

1687888708.title: Cyberpunk Hacker
1687888708.short_description:
Are you ready to disrupt the cybernetic order and unveil the secrets at the heart of the neon-drenched horizon?
Dive into the neon-lit chaos of Cyberpunk Hacker, a fast-paced first-person shooter where every second counts.
In this frenetic FPS roguelite, your neural link is unstable, and every second counts. Blast through adaptive AI defenses, upgrade your digital arsenal and unravel a sinister corporate plot. With your life force constantly draining, you must think fast, shoot faster, and push your hacking skills to the limit. Can you liberate Neo-Tokyo before your connection flatlines?

You are a rogue hacker, armed with advanced cybernetic enhancements and a hacker's toolkit, tasked with infiltrating the fortresses of the world's most powerful corporations.
As your health steadily decreases, speed and strategy are your best allies. Engage in high-octane gunfights, utilize rapid movement mechanics like sliding and dashing,
and hack systems to manipulate your environment and gain tactical advantages.

Every room challenges you to outsmart security protocols and combat androids while managing your depleting health that doubles as a relentless timer.
Choose from an arsenal of futuristic weapons and stackable perks that enhance your abilities but also demand sacrifices, making each decision a balance between reward and risk.

Cyberpunk Hacker invites you to master its unique blend of intense shooting action and rapid strategic thinking. With multiple zones, diverse game modes, and over
80 different perks to customize your play style, and each run offers new challenges and combinations to explore.

Are you ready to disrupt the cybernetic order and unveil the secrets at the heart of the neon-drenched horizon?
Load up, dive in, and let the cyber chase begin in Cyberpunk Hacker!

1687995297.title: 3D.Checkers
1687995297.short_description: If you like games of strategy, you'll enjoy playing Checkers on your Xbox One. Have fun playing locally against a friend or family member, or you can play against the computer at one of 3 difficulty levels. Supports playing American Checkers, Kings Corner, and Fox and Hounds variants of Checkers. Please email support@ttssoftware.com if you have any issues.

1688119271.title: Hyperspaced
1688119271.short_description:
The Ultimate Co-Op Chaos in Space! 
The Multiverse is collapsing! Team up, jump into your spaceship, and face chaos—disasters, frantic repairs, and intense battles. Every mission in Hyperspaced is unique, and only teamwork will save the galaxy!

Pilot, Engineer, Gunner, or Janitor – Every Role Matters!
Steer the ship, man the turrets, extinguish burning consoles, patch up hull breaches, and mop up sticky space goo before everything spirals out of control. In this fast-paced co-op madness, no one gets to sit back and relax!
Mission: Retrieve the Galaxy Plugs!
Some lunatics have stolen the cosmic Galaxy Plugs, leaving the universe tangled in a mess of chaotic pipelines! Your crew must track down the thieves, recover the Plugs, and restore balance before entire galaxies vanish forever.
Friends, Foes, and… a Space Octopus?!
On your journey, you’ll encounter bizarre beings: a mysterious drone, a grumpy hermit, a talkative merchant octopus – and cats?! Help them (or don’t), but some might just join your reckless adventure!
Procedurally Generated Galaxies – Every Run is Unique!
No two adventures are the same! Explore ever-changing maps, discover new ships, and unlock crazy upgrades. Restore abandoned vessels to their former glory and experience different playstyles – from heavily armored freighters to nimble space raiders.
Don't Forget to Feed Scrappy!
Your junk-eating robot turns scrap into valuable resources mid-mission. Just make sure to pet him – he gets cranky otherwise!
So, buckle up – this is going to be a wild ride!

Key Features:
•	1–4 Player Local Co-Op – Maximum chaos guaranteed!
•	Multitasking Madness – Repair the ship inside while battling enemies outside in an innovative split-screen view
•	Infinite Replayability – Randomized maps, ships, and wacky weapons keep every run fresh
•	Build & Upgrade Your Ship – Customize your spaceship with new modules, weapons, and defenses
•	4 different ships with different layouts and gameplay mechanics to unlock
•	Boss Battles & Epic Challenges – Only the best crews will survive!

1688146955.title: Turtle Trial
1688146955.short_description: As a turtle explore, survive, conquer your environment and find away to escape your fate.

1688156571.title: Asteroids Blast 3D
1688156571.short_description: Asteroids Blast 3D is the arcade quality re-imagining of the classic Asteroids formula, bringing back old school fun with a 3D twist for your Xbox and Windows PC!

1688198598.title: ACA NEOGEO BLAZING STAR
1688198598.short_description:
"BLAZING STAR" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1998.
Your mission is to take on the sinister AI “Brawshella” that is the main culprit behind an army of deadly biological weapons. You have 6 different ships at your disposal for this task.
The game features classic high score gameplay with higher points awarded when players land successful charge shots to chain multiple enemies.

1688249349.title: Out of Sight
1688249349.short_description: You’re Sophie, a young blind girl who sees through her teddy bear’s eyes. Escape your captors and uncover the evil history of the dark mansion you desperately seek to escape in this unique, atmospheric horror puzzle/adventure game.

1688273727.title: Champion Shift Demo
1688273727.short_description: Unleash mythic heroes and their mighty vehicles in this thrilling co-op action roguelike. Seamlessly shift into car form, create builds with unique abilities, and battle endless enemies to stop the evil Dominion. Rev through high-octane missions, conquer epic bosses, and become an absolute legend!

1688287385.title: The Company Man
1688287385.short_description: Climb the corporate ladder and overthrow your boss!

1688481509.title: Space Kitten
1688481509.short_description: Time is your biggest enemy! Control an adorable space cat in a cute yet brutal platformer. You have exactly 10 seconds to solve puzzles, dodge deadly obstacles, and escape each room. With instant respawn, master the ideal route and escape, or face failure.

1688544029.title: Tales of Berseria Remastered
1688544029.short_description: Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced playability and quality-of-life enhancements! Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand.

1688571860.title: Spells & Secrets
1688571860.short_description:
In this rogue-like inspired action adventure, you free the wizard school Greifenstein from magical creatures by using your spells creatively. 
Play in local co-op, customize your own student wizard, solve mysteries and find powerful artifacts in this modern magical world.

1688620632.title: Casual Sport Series: Badminton
1688620632.short_description: Casual Sport Series: Badminton delivers energetic gameplay that captures the thrill of this lightning-quick sport.

1688749231.title: Loot Box Simulator - RPG Anime Girls
1688749231.short_description: Loot Box Simulator - RPG Anime Girls brings pretty anime girls and exciting loot boxes to your console. Choose between 4 action options and win great collectible pictures of the cutest anime girls.

1688832803.title: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 6
1688832803.short_description: Mud, sweat, adrenaline, and fun: all the best the motocross and dirt bike world has to offer awaits you in the new Monster Energy Supercross 6!

1688839217.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition (PC)
1688839217.short_description:
Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features like remastered art and effects, volumetric god rays, dynamic depth of field, screen-space reflections, and more. 

Skyrim Special Edition also brings the power of Bethesda Game Studios Creations to consoles. New quests, environments, characters, dialogue, armor, weapons and more – with Creations, there are no limits to what you can experience.

1688903402.title: Vasilis
1688903402.short_description: Vasilis is a hand-drawn adventure game. Vasilis, the main character, has lost her husband Peter in the rebellious city center. The city has plunged into chaos by constant riots, and almost every day something is burned or someone is killed.

1688979702.title: S.W.A.N.: Chernobyl Unexplored
1688979702.short_description:
S.W.A.N.: Chernobyl Unexplored is a science fiction FPS puzzle horror game, which takes place a few months after the Chernobyl Nuclear Plant disaster.
Experience a tale about an unexplored area within the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone - The S.W.A.N. Institute.

1688996321.title: Chameleon Dummy Hunt
1688996321.short_description: Find hidden dummies painted to blend into colorful levels. Search carefully, spot tiny visual clues, and blast every camouflaged target with your paint gun before time runs out.

1689096270.title: Active Matter Demo
1689096270.short_description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in the quantum unstable zones over control of the active matter – the substance that bends time and space.

1689149944.title: Horror Adventure : Zombie Edition
1689149944.short_description:
Horror Adventure : Zombie Edition is a zombie shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. There has been an outbreak of a mysterious virus killing people and transforming them into zombies. There are a few survivors left. As one of the few people left on this planet, experience what it’s like to live in the city of the undead. Fight the dead, save other people, hunt in the world and find ways to survive. Kill the virus infected people and protect your family..

Features:

⦁ Single Player Story: A full fledged narrative campaign to give you a taste of what it’s like in a post-apocalyptic world.

⦁ Ultimate Horror experience for players throughout the game.

⦁ Weapons system: Support for more than 10+ unlockable weapons throughout the story.


Get Ready for Extreme Horror Adventure ahead.

1689193187.title: The Count Lucanor
1689193187.short_description: Join Hans in a fantasy world and experience a unique adventure, full of surprises and challenges. Get hooked on an immersive tale, where every decision counts and every clue is a piece to solve the puzzle and get the treasure. Unravel the sordid secrets of the castle, meet colorful characters, and remember: horror always lurks beneath the surface.

1689241275.title: Black Jacket
1689241275.short_description: The Blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deck builder where you gamble your way out of hell. Stack broken cards, bend the rules, and unleash insane combos. Read your enemy, bribe the ferryman, and escape the afterlife.

1689264723.title: FIFA 15
1689264723.short_description: FIFA 15 brings football to life in stunning detail so fans can experience the emotion of the sport like never before. Next Generation Visuals put fans on Living Pitches with grass that wears as the match progresses. Player Control heightens the responsiveness of player movement, and makes Man-to-Man Battles more rewarding than ever before.

1689292278.title: 63 Days Demo
1689292278.short_description: Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?

1689317374.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator (Game Preview)
1689317374.short_description:
This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game.

Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

1689331071.title: Theseus: The Descent
1689331071.short_description: First-person survival horror with zombies and guns.

1689369156.title: Arcade Archives 2 MACH BREAKERS
1689369156.short_description:
"MACH BREAKERS" is a sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
The superhuman sports series continues with this sequel to “Numan Athletics”! 
Now featuring 7 athletes and 12 kinds of events, the action is even more intense.
Break the sound barrier and shatter expectations!

1689376479.title: Crypt of the Serpent King Remastered 4K Edition
1689376479.short_description:
Accept the challenge of the underworld in a nostalgic blend of first-person adventuring and roguelike gameplay!

Are you prepared to delve deep into a world of malice and deadly peril? Crypt of the Serpent King Remastered 4K Edition is a medieval first-person hack 'n' slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements that recalls the gameplay of dark fantasy classics while presenting its action in gorgeously gruesome 4K style. Explore randomly generated dungeons, fighting underworld creatures along the way, all while avoiding traps and collecting loot!

Goblins, giant spiders, skeletons, orcs and more await you in the tunnels and halls of the underworld. If you hope to survive, you’ll need to wield an array of melee and ranged weaponry, from swords and axes to crossbows and maces, each with strength and weaknesses depending on the foes you face. Select from 3 levels of difficulty to fine-tune your experience and level up your character’s abilities as you progress. Each playthrough is unique, offering countless hours of challenge and adventure!

1689409064.title: Shield King
1689409064.short_description: Survive in a world enveloped by mist!

1689470922.title: Pocket Stables
1689470922.short_description: Manage a ranch while training your racehorses to race for a Triple Crown.

1689543063.title: Moon Raider: Anniversary Edition
1689543063.short_description: A half-alien princess must save her dying mother, the former queen of the moon. Supports 2-player co-op!

1689582836.title: Dyna Bomb 2
1689582836.short_description: Enter level, shoot bombs, kill enemies, collect the key and run to the door.

1689677342.title: Re:Re:Ghosted
1689677342.short_description:
Endless job search. Hunt for the best resume. Die in someone else's dream. Frame HR for murders. And fail in the backrooms.

Re:re:ghosted is a first-person psychological horror game.

1689702773.title: Survive on Raft
1689702773.short_description: Build your raft. Fight with the shark. Craft a hook and tools. Construct your base. Explore islands. Trade with merchant npc. Team up in 5-player multiplayer. Customize your character. Survive the endless ocean after a plane crash!

1689725435.title: Drizzlepath: Deja Vu
1689725435.short_description:
Embark on an epic journey of self-discovery while pondering the nature of life itself!

A vast and mysterious world lies before you, one that hides the truth of your existence and echoes the memory of past lives. As the tenth game created by Tonguç Bodur, Drizzlepath: Deja Vu is a reimagining of his first creation, a standalone experience accessible by any kind of player.

In Drizzlepath: Deja Vu, you’ll take the role of a nameless man climbing towards a mountaintop in search of answers. Witness events as you explore, each gradually adding to the larger existential narrative. Ponder the enigmatic and cyclical nature of memory through abstract storytelling and beautifully detailed environments, punctuated by ominous imagery that’s more mysterious than it is frightening, a beacon to guide you forward.

1689725766.title: Serious Sam: Siberian Mayhem
1689725766.short_description: Serious Sam: Siberian Mayhem is a new stand-alone expansion to the world of the classic FPS series. Join the fight against Notorious Mental on a journey through the wild lands of Russia, and find your way through this lost chapter of Sam Stone's adventures.

1689732921.title: Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land
1689732921.short_description:
Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land is a 2D pixel art puzzle game inspired by sokoban with unique twists! Help the frog mage solve 40 challenging puzzle rooms using his three magical abilities to cross gaps, build bridges on lakes and navigate objects from one point to another! 

✓ TELEPORT: With the press of a button you can zoom across an entire room, crossing every gap on the way with the Teleport skill! 
✓ PUSH: No matter how far you are from a box, your Push skill will hit it and move it forward! 
✓ PULL: Want to bring a box closer to your position? You just gotta use your Pull skill to move it towards you! 

Players will have to use their full brain power to combine these three abilities and solve every puzzle. On top of that, you can't just use your magic willy-nilly, you have to plan and execute tightly so you don't run out of energy! The frog mage is just an apprentice, after all. If he uses too much magic, he gets tired and falls asleep!

- Puzzle game designed to be fun and challenging for all ages
- Simple to control so you can focus your attention on the puzzle
- Cute 2D top-down pixel art with calm and cute environments
- Soothing soundtrack for the right mood
- A particular puzzle is too difficult? You can skip it to keep the game going.

1689815489.title: Broken Universe - Tower Defense
1689815489.short_description: Roco is just an everyday racoon. He's just given his sweetheart a pretty necklace... which caused the ENTIRE universe to explode!

1689852285.title: R-Type Dimensions III
1689852285.short_description: The spectacular, fully-reimagined evolution of a legendary shoot ’em up!

1689936313.title: Little Big Workshop
1689936313.short_description: Manage your workers, stations, machines and create awesome stuff as your little big workshop grows into your dream factory!

1689950312.title: Freediving Hunter: Spearfishing the World
1689950312.short_description: Spearfish around the world against the world's best spearos!

1689956904.title: Little Helper Cafe (Xbox One)
1689956904.short_description: A hedgehog, sugar, and lots of logic on the table!

1690003636.title: Chants of Sennaar - Demo
1690003636.short_description: Legend says that one day, a traveler will reunite the Peoples of the Tower who are unable to communicate with each other. Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages in a fascinating universe inspired by the myth of Babel.

1690045506.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3 (Windows)
1690045506.short_description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters with new character, new features and new puzzles.

1690071668.title: Freddy Spaghetti
1690071668.short_description: Cook up some 3D action gameplay like you’ve never eaten before!

1690076332.title: Star Fire: Eternal Cycle
1690076332.short_description: Star Fire is a love letter to classic arcade side-scrollers, reimagined with roguelite progression, modern action polish, and that “just one more run” itch. It’s fast, punchy, and all about no-pressure fun with tight combat, slick movement, and endless ways to cause chaos.

1690094100.title: Run Sausage Run!
1690094100.short_description:
The most exciting sausage race in the world!
Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!

1690147077.title: Pirate Trails (Xbox One)
1690147077.short_description: Arrr, hoist the sails and chart the course, for the gold won’t bury itself!

1690172627.title: Frozen Rune
1690172627.short_description: Frozen Rune is a challenging 2D pixel art platformer. Conquer 30 deadly levels, collect the Ice Rune, and open the magic door to prove your skill.

1690203558.title: Sanic Racing Free version
1690203558.short_description: Note: This is a free version, there is also a remaster version if you are interested.

1690204019.title: Garten of Banban 3
1690204019.short_description: Delve even deeper into Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 3. Explore the bizarre, suspiciously abandoned underground facility and continue the search for your child. Can you find them before the facility's unexpected residents find you?

1690207976.title: Modern Tales: Age of Invention (Xbox One Version)
1690207976.short_description: Foil the plan for world domination!

1690272430.title: Regalia: Of Men and Monarchs - Royal Edition
1690272430.short_description: Regalia: Of Men and Monarchs is a tactical RPG about the restoration of a fallen kingdom to its former glory. Embark on an adventure that will remind you of your best jRPG experiences - assemble a party of valiant individuals, manage your realms, forge alliances, and vanquish your foes in challenging turn-based combat!

1690283335.title: Aery - Calm Horizon
1690283335.short_description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

1690343057.title: Kotenok
1690343057.short_description:
Pounce with precision as a pixel art kitty in retro platforming style!

Play as a lost kitten in a dangerous forest! Master tight platforming controls, sprint, pounce, and double-jump through 50 tricky stages filled with spikes, enemies, and clever puzzles.

Explore vibrant pixel-art worlds, bounce on mushrooms, outsmart foes, and hunt for hidden collectibles. Can you guide this frisky feline home? A charming love letter to classic platformers!

1690468494.title: DEATHLOOP
1690468494.short_description: DEATHLOOP is a next-gen FPS from Arkane Lyon, the award-winning studio behind Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, two rival assassins are trapped in a mysterious timeloop on the island of Blackreef, doomed to repeat the same day for eternity. As Colt, the only chance for escape is to end the cycle by assassinating eight key targets before the day resets. Learn from each cycle - try new paths, gather intel, and find new weapons and abilities. Do whatever it takes to break the loop.

1690514608.title: Skatemasta Tcheco
1690514608.short_description: Tcheco is back for another herculean journey on his shiny new skateboard. Survive bigger and crazier auto-scrolling stages as you smash and flip over everything that tries to stop Tcheco in his tracks! From beaches and cityscapes to a sports stadium and even the moon, traverse a vibrant selection of stages in any order as you roll your way to victory.

1690524168.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
1690524168.short_description:
From the depths of darkness, a dragon soars. 

A new dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG, presented by Team NINJA.

184 AD, Later Han Dynasty China. The land is overcome by chaos and destruction. The imperial dynasty that prospered for many years is now about to collapse. 

Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a dramatic, action-packed story of a nameless militia soldier fighting for survival in a dark fantasy version of the Later Han Dynasty where demons plague the Three Kingdoms. Players fight off deadly creatures and enemy soldiers using swordplay based on the Chinese martial arts, attempting to overcome the odds by awakening the true power from within. 

Wo Long refers to a crouching dragon, and also refers to a hero or person of greatness who is not yet known. This is the story of officers, who will later become heroes, during their ‘unknown’ period, and also the story of a protagonist’s rise from being a ‘nobody’.
 
Note: You must have an internet connection in order to use various content.
Note: This is the standard edition of the game. The Complete Edition is also available.

1690575171.title: Endoparasitic
1690575171.short_description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research!

1690610806.title: Romancing SaGa 2
1690610806.short_description: Romancing SaGa 2 is one of the many titles in the lauded SaGa roleplaying game series. In this popular entry, released in Japanese only in 1993 and boasting sales in excess of one million copies, the player's struggle spans multiple generations as he assumes the role of a series of rulers of the Varennes Empire in a valiant struggle against the Seven Heroes. A free scenario system—a hallmark of the SaGa series—enables the player to take command of a variety of protagonists along the line of imperial succession and experience the history of a nation as it grows and changes. This freedom of choice provides a compelling narrative that served as the cornerstone of the title's success on its initial release.

1690627127.title: Strayed Lights

1691013379.title: Secret Neighbor
1691013379.short_description:
Secret Neighbor is a suspenseful Multiplayer Horror Game where a group of kids try to rescue their friend from the Neighbor's creepy basement. Only problem is one of the kids is the Neighbor in disguise.
All new graphics, Hello Neighbor 2 characters and much more in this update.

1691035974.title: Ball Race 3: Jump
1691035974.short_description: Each level has its own specificity of construction, but each time on the same level we get a differently built track with obstacles, which is to make the game create a new challenge each time.

1691073510.title: Project Downfall
1691073510.short_description: Fight your way out in this dirty retro-styled tactical FPS.

1691092579.title: Baron: Fur Is Gonna Fly
1691092579.short_description: Choose an animal pilot, and let the thrilling aerial dogfights begin, in this bonkers local multiplayer action game! Up to 8 players duke it out in biplanes armed to the teeth with wacky weapons including flamethrowers, stinky fish, and more!

1691093219.title: Ancient Ants Adventure (Xbox One)
1691093219.short_description: Your task is to become the leader of this great colony, rebuild your army and learn to use magic to protect your comrades in order to turn the tide of battle with terrible enemies.

1691117579.title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
1691117579.short_description: Experience the thrill of T2 with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics!

1691152104.title: MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE 2 Demo
1691152104.short_description: Experience part of My Hero One's Justice 2 for free! In the demo you have a choice between playing a part of the Story Mode, Free Battle Mode where you can choose to play from 6 characters, and the Customize Mode.

1691178517.title: Pocket Harvest
1691178517.short_description: Reap the joys of country life and cultivate your farm and fame!

1691269064.title: Shadow Warrior 2
1691269064.short_description: Shadow Warrior 2 is the stunning evolution of Flying Wild Hog’s offbeat first-person shooter following the further misadventures of former corporate shogun Lo Wang.

1691293873.title: Kingdom Shell - White Temple Edition
1691293873.short_description: Explore the lands of the Kingdom, fight hordes of nightmarish creatures and powerful bosses, find secrets, help inhabitants in distress and stop the impending catastrophe.

1691312526.title: Tour de France 2023
1691312526.short_description: Ride shoulder to shoulder with the best cyclists and show your panache to triumph on the Champs-Elysées in the official video game of the Tour de France 2023! Compete in mountain or flat stages and experience all the action of the Grande Boucle.

1691343851.title: IN-VERT
1691343851.short_description: This is a challenging and captivating puzzle-platformer about a lonely robot searching for its missing master. To complete your journey, you'll need to navigate two dimensions simultaneously. Use the parallel world module to overcome every obstacle in your path!

1691373298.title: House Fighters: Total Mess
1691373298.short_description: Engage in fast-paced dogfights in this nostalgia-filled world, take on clever foes, and fight to save your fellow toy friends!

1691395527.title: Build a Bridge!
1691395527.short_description: Test your engineering and improvisation skills in a game where the stakes are as high as they get. It is you who will construct bridges for cars, trucks, buses..

1691448998.title: Farm Together 2
1691448998.short_description: Grow your own farm all by yourself, or cooperate with your friends in the long awaited sequel to the cozy, relaxing farming experience!

1691501118.title: Peglin
1691501118.short_description: The dragons have been popping peglins and stealing all of your gold for as long as you can remember. Enough is enough. It's time to venture through the woods, conquer the fortress, and delve into the heart of the dragon's lair to take back what's yours and teach those dragons a lesson.

1691514153.title: JoJo Siwa: Worldwide Party
1691514153.short_description: Run through JoJo's worlds to her biggest hits including D.R.E.AM, Bop and Nonstop! Can you match the rhythm and make the crowd go wild?

1691539579.title: Flappy Fly
1691539579.short_description:
Get Ready to fly. Use Tap to Fly.

Features
-Most Addictive Game you have ever Played.
-Tap to Fly and earn coins.
-Game excitement increases after every second.
-Use of HD Quality of Graphics in the Game.
-Suitable for all Age Group.
-Both Controller and Keyboard support provided

Get Ready to Fly.....

1691547506.title: Darkness and Flame 4: Enemy in Reflection
1691547506.short_description:
The evil spirit tricked you. Now you have to make everything right because others have tried and failed for centuries...

“Darkness and Flame. Enemy in Reflection” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

Power of the Flame is restored, Alice and her friends escaped from the Dark Army. In search of a place to rest, they stop at a strange glade and allow themselves to relax... 
However, in this new hostile world, one cannot lose its vigilance even for a minute. And the reckoning for carelessness will not take long... Alice finds herself dragged into a battle with the evil that is older than darkness itself.
She'll have to solve questions that many generations of brave men couldn't. This time, friends won't come to the rescue - they have fallen victim to a powerful curse.
Will Alice be able to make everything right? Will she find new friends that are ready to help? She was used to the dangers, but will her courage help in a world where no one hopes for salvation any longer?
Alongside Alice, you will explore the pristine beauty of Fertile Lands and find long-forgotten secrets. Solve puzzles and collect everything that can help her stop an ancient evil. Give people a new hope of salvation!

Find out how to stop the ancient force that lured you into a trap
Explore new lands in search of answers and solutions
Solve lots of incredible puzzles
Get help from new friends
Gather amazing collections and find dozens of morphing-objects.

1691570797.title: Sokocrab
1691570797.short_description: Solve puzzles as a crab, pushing barrels on a beach in 40 fun levels!

1691625847.title: Helicopter Master
1691625847.short_description:
Discover our amazing helicopter shooter game full of action! Fly in the sky with your favourite helicopter fighting for your survival against enemy air planes!

You are a pilot of the Army patrolling from the sky. Your commander reported unidentified air planes.

You just saw some air crafts approaching to your air plane but you need visual confirmation… Return immediately to your base and report it to your commander! Get out of here now! Do not start the battle alone, there are too may of them!

1691794314.title: Dark Deception Demo
1691794314.short_description: Death awaits you in Dark Deception, a story-driven first-person horror maze game. There's nowhere to hide & nowhere to catch your breath. Run or die - it's your choice. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with a mysterious woman, your only hope of survival is to find a way to escape.

1691837448.title: UNSIGHTED
1691837448.short_description: EXPLORE YOUR WAY. Awoken to a world ruined by war, Alma must traverse the vast city of Arcadia before the life force of her friends and herself withers away. Time is ticking, and every moment matters. Who will you save, and who will you leave to turn UNSIGHTED?

1691849278.title: FINAL FANTASY IV
1691849278.short_description: The original FINAL FANTASY IV comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

1691852956.title: Space Frontier (Windows)
1691852956.short_description: Classic space shooter with 13 levels, upgrade orbs, and epic bosses. Blast pirates and power up your ship!

1691874317.title: Boss Rush: Mythology (Xbox Series X|S)
1691874317.short_description: Take on the role of a mysterious knight who travels across different worlds in search of the most difficult opponents. Fight famous enemies from Greek, Scandinavian, Slavic and Egyptian mythologies and show everyone who is the strongest warrior! Only boss fights, only hardcore!

1691892209.title: Ruinarch
1691892209.short_description: Ruinarch is an evil overlord simulator with a focus on story generation.

1691924451.title: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
1691924451.short_description: Brian Fisher wakes up 30 years in the past as a small child, in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how he arrived there. He is trapped in a different dimension of time and space, and his mission is to find something hidden within this dimension of time and space and bring it back to the present.

1691955008.title: TOKI Juju Densetsu
1691955008.short_description:
The return of the wacky monkey!

Toki Juju Densetsu sets off on a new adventure! The cult action/platform game originally released on arcade machines in 1989 is back with a super-simian new version, featuring all-new hand-drawn graphics and re-orchestrated music!

1692022171.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0
1692022171.short_description:
Embark on an adventure of your own creation.
The latest in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series.

1692202568.title: Madness Beverage
1692202568.short_description:
Fight Manos’ demons
Become a space pirate and fight demons that were set free by the evil villan Manos. Travel through alien planets, forgotten caves, old castles and its dark corridors, and remember, be wary of what’s lurking in the dark! To defeat Manos you’ll have to survive demonic hordes and collect powerful drinks! How can you achieve that, you may ask? With the whole arsenal of deadly weapons and strong beverages that give you some real special powers! 
Visit Space Market 
Kaanatan is a popular space market set in the center of the galaxy. This is the place in which all of the mercenaries, thugs and even dignitaries live and trade, so it’s no wonder that you can find a lot of stuff here. No matter if you come here in the broad daylight or at nighttime, you’ll be in for a treat. Find Caleb’s friend, Xeos and have him prepare some magical beverages for you!

Find Madness Drop
Investigate the source of the radio signal in an old castle on Neo Valkyria, discover the secrets of a suspicious looking laboratory, explore Alien World with its intriguing wildlife and try not to die in flames while on a mission in Lava Cave. Legends say it was a home of dragons once upon a time. But it’s just some old legends, right? Why don’t you find out if there’s any truth to them? Grab Madness Drop and continue your adventure through space! 

Pick your poison
Purple, orange, red, blue, yellow or green… We have all sorts of beverages for you and every single one of them has its own unique power. Do you want some space? Inflict damage and push your enemies away from you with Purple Beverage. Protect yourself, slow your enemies, watch them through walls, move faster and become incredibly powerful, but be careful… Sometimes with great power, comes a price.

1692204625.title: Size Matters
1692204625.short_description: You play as a scientist who is shrinking every second in a race against time! Find all the ingredients and formulas scattered around the laboratory, which are necessary for producing the life-saving antidote.

1692217533.title: Stones of the Revenant
1692217533.short_description: Retro-Arcade style platformer with six unique playable characters. Team up with local co-op or try to defeat the Revenant and his minions solo in this challenging quest to save the realm of the living!

1692234207.title: ConnecTank
1692234207.short_description: ConnecTank is an action game for 1 to 4 players where you step inside a big honking tank. Link conveyor belts together, craft ammo, and put out fires as you battle rival tanks to help Finneas Fat Cat deliver packages. Build new tanks and take jobs in a changing world.

1692236270.title: Stolen Realm
1692236270.short_description: Stolen Realm is a simultaneous turn-based tactical dungeon crawling looter with action RPG elements where you control up to 6 heroes, solo or through online co-op, venturing forth in adventures set in a high-fantasy, low-poly world.

1692314393.title: The Echo
1692314393.short_description:
You are the neuro-salvager...You dive into deep, dangerous neural networks...And your rent is due...You need this job badly but you have a feeling this can be...different...in a bad way...This time, will you be able to silence the echo in your mind?

The Echo is a retro-cyber punk themed, first-person horror/mystery game...

1692326430.title: Cooking Fast Burger
1692326430.short_description: Serve these hungry customers the best burger! Prepare the dish they want, following the recipes, and collect points!Don’t upset too many customers or you will lose the game!

1692343738.title: A.I.L.A
1692343738.short_description: A.I.L.A is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur….

1692346754.title: Animus: Revenant
1692346754.short_description: You, keeper of a long abandoned refuge, must gather the dying memories of an an ill-fated world. Pick up your war hammer. Bring peace to the condemned, silence to the corrupt, and retribution against the deceitful. Fight, farm, craft, collect, end.

1692369103.title: BluePrint Racer
1692369103.short_description:
BluePrint Racer 
 
Race to Collect Coins and Perform Stunts in this Physics Playground.
 
GAMES.ARCHOR.COM.

1692370050.title: Push Or Move
1692370050.short_description: Looking for a fun competitive couch game, well look no further as you destroy your friends in this 4 player action platformer that is updated weekly.

1692395829.title: Croc's World 4
1692395829.short_description:
After millions played the first 3 parts of "Croc's World" it´s now time for "Croc's World 4"!
"Croc's World 4" is a classical platformer with a lot of new enemies and new twists!

It features:
+ 60 incredible levels on 4 islands!
+ 2 new characters to play: Kangaroo "Roodie" and "Baby Croc"
+ 2 new vehicles: submarine and helicopter
+ Nice graphics!
+ 6 different themes!
+ Many challenging enemies
+ 4 evil endbosses.

1692546142.title: Two Point Hospital™
1692546142.short_description:
The hit hospital building management sim comes to console for the first time!

BUILD, CURE and IMPROVE: Design stunning hospitals, decorate them as you like, cure very unusual illnesses and manage troublesome staff!

1692546379.title: GoNNER WIN10
1692546379.short_description: GoNNER is a tough as hell procedurally-generated 2D platformer with roguelike elements, following the largely misunderstood and altruistic Ikk on a journey to cheer up his only friend in this world—a giant landbound whale named Sally. Procerdurally-generated environments, arduous bosses, hidden secrets, multiple endings, and more await Ikk on his journey to make one person happy even if it kills him—which it certainly will.

1692548778.title: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe
1692548778.short_description:
This is the biggest trip in Europe, where you will visit 10 countries and 24 cities.

You will see ancient castles, natural objects, beautiful city streets, museums and various architectural objects.

- visit the streets of Piedmont
- see the Trevi Fountain and the Castel Nuovo castle in Italy
- visit the Meteora monasteries, the National Museum of Athens and the Acropolis in Greece
- visit the Algar Waterfalls and Alcantara Bridge in Spain
- take a ferry across the Mediterranean Sea 
- fly by plane across three seas
- fly in a hot air balloon to Germany, and take a comfortable train to France

You will find many scenes with a fascinating hunt for hidden objects and interesting minigames.

1692559022.title: Animus - Stand Alone
1692559022.short_description: Take on the role of an anonymous warrior — caught out of place and time — on a journey to bring an end to a broken world. Gather your weapons and choose with care: distance, timing, combinations, stamina, and attributes will determine the outcome of battle.

1692643519.title: Cowboys
1692643519.short_description: Saddle up for a supernatural wild west adventure! Choose to play as Roland or Robin and investigate a mysterious desert mansion. Master 8-directional shooting as you battle outlaws and beasts through treacherous levels. Discover powerful weapon upgrades, but be warned - death means losing them all! Unravel a dark secret through story-driven cutscenes and face off against challenging bosses in this thrilling 2D side-scrolling shooter.

1692656490.title: SNIPER Ghost Warrior 3
1692656490.short_description: Go behind enemy lines with the ultimate modern military shooter. Play as an American sniper dropped in Georgia, near Russian border. Choose your own path to accomplish your missions across an unforgiven open world.

1692675045.title: DayD: Tower Rush
1692675045.short_description:
Create the future!
You tripped into history, or to be precise – you fell straight into the past. It's all in your hands now in this uncompromising battle for survival of the species! Find out who's stronger – the technology of the future, or brute force.

Learn the power of science!
Meet the heroes of a new Tower Defense strategy game – the professor and his robotic assistant. They got a little lost in their time machine, but even entire hordes of dinosaurs won't stop them getting back to their time!

A unique world of 40 levels. Original opponents, fearsome bosses and rare fossils. Excellent game balance. You will leave your mark on history!

The technologies of the future against fossilized species!
Fight against thousands of enemies!
Fearsome weapons and unique opponents!
Excellent game balance!
Show your dominance!

1692686740.title: Baseball.free
1692686740.short_description:
Baseball.free is a Windows Store, Windows Phone and Xbox game where you play a baseball batter.
Get as many points as you can, win all the medals and beat your or your friend's records.
The game can be played from many players turn by turn.
You can also compete with other players from all over the world.

Keep playing.

1692734896.title: Suika Wan! (Windows)
1692734896.short_description: Suika Wan! is a delightfully chaotic puzzle where tiny doggos drop, bounce, and fuse into bigger, fluffier friends, from pomeranians, to french bulldogs, to siberian huskies, each time adding a bigger breed to the screen!

1692776682.title: Vlad Circus: Descend Into Madness
1692776682.short_description:
Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness puts your sanity to the test, challenging you to escape a labyrinth of nightmares and torment. 

Test your mind against a slow burn of puzzles, light survival mechanics, and methodical action.

1692782771.title: Bowie The Frog
1692782771.short_description:
Bowie The Frog is an endless runner in which you flip gravity to move around. Run through procedurally generated terrain, collect pasta, and dodge those pesky lava pits & beetles.

Bowie The Frog features randomly generated terrain filled with enemies to dodge and pasta to collect. Each second you go further in adds one point to your score. Try to stay alive for as long as you can while.

Bowie The Frog features gorgeous 8-bit graphics inspired by games such as Downwell, Solaris, Xenophobe , and more. Incredible chiptune music was inspired by the works of Anamanaguchi, Chipzel, and Toby Fox. It also features fun gameplay that is fully unique.

1692828729.title: Cats and Seek : Osaka
1692828729.short_description: Got some free time to spare? Come find 300+ cats in Osaka!

1692871917.title: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight
1692871917.short_description: Get ready to turn your living room into an epic puzzle matching battle in Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight, featuring 195 FREE levels and an ALL-NEW local multiplayer mode!

1692930613.title: Dracula's Legacy Remastered
1692930613.short_description: Haunted by frightening dreams about her forgotten past, Isabella - along with her fiancé - travels to an old ghost town, the only clue to her origins that she has been able to dredge from the depths of her lost memories...

1692950358.title: Exoprimal
1692950358.short_description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​.

1693003201.title: MotoGP™25 - Xbox One
1693003201.short_description: Rev up your engines for the 2025 season! Feel the authentic MotoGP™ thrills with refined sound design and exciting challenges. Train with new disciplines in Race Off mode and choose the Arcade or Pro Experience for ultimate fun or realism!

1693021972.title: Retro Racing
1693021972.short_description: Retro Racing is a infinite 3D Game and running game. Retro Racing is a great game that will help you have fun while away the time. Simple, but at the same time exciting game!

1693043906.title: Oakbound Quest (Xbox One)
1693043906.short_description: You take on the role of a brave warrior on a sacred mission: to recover the mystical oaks whose essence holds the power to restore life to your devastated village.

1693050229.title: Madden NFL 22 Xbox One
1693050229.short_description:
Madden NFL 22 is where gameday happens.

All-new features in Franchise include staff management, an enhanced scenario engine, and weekly strategy. Share avatar progress and player class between Face of The Franchise and The Yard with unified progression. And for the first time ever in Ultimate Team, adjust Superstar X-Factors at halftime.

1693098311.title: One Step After Fall (Español)
1693098311.short_description: Immerse yourself inside Steve Robinson's depressive thoughts, learn his story and face his destinies in this incredible narrative experience.

1693241943.title: After Wave: Downfall
1693241943.short_description: After Wave: Downfall is an arcade shooter where the player battles against monsters, completes various missions with a cool battleship.  Deathrix invaded the world and released a mysterious meteorite causing a great flood. Players can upgrade their ships for better performance to fight the most brutal enemies.  A Local Co-op mode allows the player to team up and adventure with others.

1693340366.title: Hogwarts Legacy
1693340366.short_description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

1693360685.title: Spot Challenge Vol. 3
1693360685.short_description: Spot Challenge is a game series inspired by 'Find the Differences,' where you compare two images and spot over 340 differences across 35 levels. Play solo or with friends and family—test your attention to detail in this fun challenge!

1693383438.title: Emoji Battlefield - Island Warfare
1693383438.short_description: Fight for survival on a cursed tropical island in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS! Battle swarms of ancient tiki emojis, collect power-ups, and upgrade your run as you uncover the island’s secrets. Explore jungles, ruins, and temples while dodging, shooting, and surviving the chaos.

1693391830.title: SpongeBob SquarePants™: The Patrick Star Game
1693391830.short_description: Step into Patrick’s shorts and create hilarious, physics-based mayhem, as you make the open world of Bikini Bottom your playground!

1693393910.title: Othercide
1693393910.short_description:
As Humanity’s last hope, lead your army to combat in an intricate dance of spectacular actions and counters, using an original Dynamic Timeline System, and face fearsome bosses in epic battles.
• Lead, evolve and sacrifice your army of Daughters
• Outsmart nightmarish creatures in a stunning Tactical RPG
• Endless combat possibilities with the Dynamic Timeline System 
• A deep, complex narrative.

1693397790.title: The StoryTale (for Windows 10)
1693397790.short_description: The StoryTale is a fairytale platformer with booms, explodes and shatters, where heroes fight with cursed weapons and tend to forget spells, but, don't worry, nobody gets hurt.

1693399606.title: Shapik: The Quest
1693399606.short_description:
This is a story of Shapik, traveling through magic forest in search of his missing sister. Explore a beautiful world, full of mystery, magic and danger and find your missing sister, solving puzzles on your way.

Graphics
Backgrounds and characters were drawn by hand. You will find very many seemingly inconspicuous details. Just stop and take a closer look.

FEWER letters
In this story you will not find a single text line. The whole story is told using animated “bubble thoughts”.

Exciting music
Our music maker composed atmospheric music to make you feel all the twists and turns and exciting moments of the plot. Listen up when you're tired of exploring locations.

1693450318.title: Hunt: Showdown
1693450318.short_description: Hunt: Showdown is a competitive first-person PvP bounty hunting game with heavy PvE elements, from the makers of Crysis. Set in the darkest corners of the world, it packs the thrill of survival games into a match-based format.

1693463344.title: Zen Wash (Windows)
1693463344.short_description:
Zen Wash is a relaxing pressure-washing simulator. No timers, no fail states, no stress — just the satisfying feeling of making dirty things clean again.

Pick a house, grab your pressure washer, and get to work. Every room is full of grimy furniture waiting to be blasted back to life. Watch the dirt disappear in real time, upgrade your gear, unlock new characters, and take on bigger houses for a greater challenge.

Every session is randomized, so there's always a fresh mess waiting for you. Perfect for unwinding, zoning out, or just enjoying something calm and satisfying.

No pressure. Just pressure washing.

1693474019.title: Arcade Archives 2 Mr.Do!
1693474019.short_description:
"Mr.Do!" is an action game released by UNIVERSAL in 1982.
Take control of a colorful clown as you clear stages by defeating monsters and collecting cherries.
In addition to the two widely played versions, this edition includes the rare "OLDEST version"—the very first iteration featuring a unique character design for the protagonist!

1693500094.title: Grass Cutter - Mutated Lawns
1693500094.short_description:
Grass Cutter is a game about cutting mutating lawns, that requires lightning-speed response and great logical thinking. Here every level is a challenging puzzle.

The goal is to cut the grass. Very simple, but only at first glance… Grass Cutter calls for focus and commitment. Just one blink of an eye – and you lost. It is very challenging! The game is made in a cubic retro-style, has high complexity at advanced levels and is ready to truly test your reaction!

1693521674.title: Rumbleverse
1693521674.short_description: Jump into the next Season of Rumbleverse, the exciting 40-person Brawler Royale!

1693607283.title: CASSETTE BOY
1693607283.short_description: In this world, what you do not see ceases to exist. Will you master the power of perception and call the moon back?

1693622886.title: Fridge Breach²
1693622886.short_description: An all new entry to the Fridge Breach franchise, experience the fidelity and fun from the original, Fridge Breach Mobile, but improved! Survive 5 days in numerous maps, encounter many hostile entities but don't let them catch you! For an idea of gameplay please watch the provided trailer or download Fridge Breach Mobile on all android devices off of the google play store.

1693635546.title: Weeping Willow
1693635546.short_description:
Weeping Willow is a kinetic visual novel in the genre of detective story, which takes place in the small medieval town of Weidendorf. This town was quarantined due to an outbreak of plague in poor neighborhoods.

The story begins with the mysterious disappearance of the husband of the main character, Baron Von Wolf. A few days later he was found in the local parish of the Scarlet Rose Order, but the baroness claims that she does not recognize her husband. Other people confirms the identity of the impostor and no one believes her. Because of the plague quarantine, the young Baroness is a captive of her own home and begins to seriously fear for her life. After this, a series of dramatic events unfold that will irrevocably change her life.

This short story will delight its players with a fascinating plot tied to intrigues, betrayals, and conspiracies.

1693651580.title: Bow to Blood: Last Captain Standing
1693651580.short_description: Become a Captain! Fly your ship and command your crew as you compete to become Champion in a winner-takes-all reality show. Build relationships and plot betrayals to avoid getting voted off the season and become the last captain standing.

1693654641.title: Narcissus
1693654641.short_description: Narcissus is an adrenaline-pumping, top down, action-horror game that puts you in the shoes of the last survivor on a doomed spaceship. The clock is ticking, and danger lurks around every corner.

1693676973.title: Clue
1693676973.short_description: Experience a fresh take on the classic murder mystery board game. Use your skills of deduction to find out who? With what weapon? Where? Join fellow detectives around the world. Gather evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the crime!

1693756497.title: No Heroes Here 2
1693756497.short_description: A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

1693779821.title: Mahjong - Xbox Series X|S
1693779821.short_description: Play a Zen game! Rediscover the famous traditional Chinese game. Find all the matching pairs of tiles, being careful not to become blocked in, to get to the end of each level. Concentration and perceptiveness are needed to finish the gorgeous boards that we have produced for you.

1693795486.title: Magic Twins
1693795486.short_description: Abra and Cadabra only wanted to make their wardrobe stylish but… what the hue? Hordes of elementals have appeared! The Colormageddon is here! Help the Magic Twins mend the damage done in this co-op Tower Defense game full of spooky but kawaii humor!

1693830737.title: Alan Wake 2
1693830737.short_description: Saga Anderson arrives to investigate ritualistic murders in a small town. Alan Wake pens a dark story to shape the reality around him. These two heroes are somehow connected. Can they become the heroes they need to be?

1693905146.title: Re:Turn - One Way Trip Demo
1693905146.short_description: Re:Turn - One Way Trip is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle-adventure horror game.

1693943612.title: Lost Snowmen

1693978901.title: Look Mum No Computer
1693978901.short_description: Music meets mayhem in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG! Craft synthesizer modules to gain new weapons and experiment with the original music of Look Mum No Computer. Meet quirky NPCs, complete quests and battle huge bosses.

1694019666.title: Doodle Puzzle
1694019666.short_description: Puzzle game where a little doodle comes to life. This unique puzzle game sees you changing perspective and looking at the world from a variety of different points of view, just to collect some gems!

1694054782.title: Forza Motorsport 6
1694054782.short_description: Forza Motorsport 6 is unrelenting action at simulation speed in the most beautiful and comprehensive racing game of this generation. Collect, customize, and race over 450 Forzavista™ cars, all with working cockpits and full damage. Compete in epic 24-player races across 26 world-famous locales. Master wet weather and night racing on your road to victory.

1694192867.title: Paint the Town Red SGDemo
1694192867.short_description: Paint the Town Red is a chaotic first person melee game set in different locations and time periods and featuring a massive Rogue-Lite adventure. The voxel-based enemies can be destroyed completely dynamically using almost anything that isn't nailed down.

1694200362.title: Rabio (Windows 10)
1694200362.short_description: Rabio is a 2D short retro-styled hardcore platformer with skill-based gameplay. Little Rabio discovers the depths of the rabbit hole, full of dangers and trials. Help him pass all the trials!

1694250070.title: Super Animal Royale
1694250070.short_description: Welcome to the coziest place to kill your friends. Super Animal Royale is a 64-player, top-down 2D battle royale where adorably murderous animals fight tooth, claw, and machine gun. Then, relax in Super Animal World with fishing, hamsterball races, and story quests before the next fight to the death.

1694252146.title: Cat Slide Tiles
1694252146.short_description: Unblock a path for the kitten in Cat Slide Tiles.

1694320597.title: Blind - The Unseen Truth
1694320597.short_description:
A girl with face blindness accidentally stumbles into a mysterious 'ritual' and begins to see things that ordinary people cannot. Thus begins a fantastical urban adventure.

- Rich storyline: A journey of urban legends and fantastical adventure.
Four years later, the protagonist returns home and reunites with her childhood friend, feeling both annoyed and comforted. During a heavy rainstorm, she encounters a mysterious boy, triggering a series of bizarre events. She joins an organization dedicated to solving strange incidents and embarks on an urban adventure.

- Multiple story endings.
Every choice in the story may influence the final outcome. How you navigate between the ordinary and the abnormal, and find a path in the narrow gap between reality and fantasy, is entirely up to your choices.

- 30 beautifully animated CGs and a complete narrative, comparable to a full-length novel.

1694362955.title: Bai Qu: Hundreds of Melodies
1694362955.short_description: A bittersweet slice of life set in modern Nanjing, China.

1694445171.title: Neural Requiem
1694445171.short_description:
The world has fallen to a ruthless artificial intelligence determined to erase mankind. Cities lie in ruins, the skies swarm with machines, and the future hangs by a thread.

You are John Veyron, a soldier reborn through brutal experiments, stripped of his past but armed with unbreakable resolve. With only steel and firepower at his side, John must march through hostile strongholds, confront merciless AI champions, and take the fight straight to the heart of the machine.

⚔️ What to Expect:

🌆 Epic Sci-Fi Environments – Battle through futuristic cityscapes, frozen wastelands, and secret underground facilities.

🤖 Cinematic Showdowns – Face powerful enemies in intense, story-driven encounters.

🔫 Arsenal of Weapons – Switch between rifles, shotguns, snipers, plasma weapons, and heavy launchers to survive overwhelming odds.

👾 Relentless Opposition – Drones, cyborgs, and monstrous machines will test your every step.

🎶 Adrenaline-Pumping Soundtrack – A fierce blend of electronic and orchestral music drives the action forward.

💀 One soldier. One mission. One final chance to save humanity.

1694466359.title: Socxel Pixel Soccer
1694466359.short_description:
Socxel - a game for one, two or four players.
Play football games alone against the computer or with friends on one console.
Call your friends and play the game where you need only one button!
It will be fun!

Features:
- Simple and addictive gameplay.
- Variety of balls for the game.
- A variety of modes, such as 1vs1, 2vs2, 1vsAI,2vsAI and many others!

1694487955.title: Life is Strange: True Colors
1694487955.short_description: Alex Chen hides her 'curse': the psychic power of Empathy, the ability to absorb and manipulate the strong emotions of others. When her brother dies in a so-called accident, Alex must embrace her power to find the truth — and reveal secrets long-buried.

1694490701.title: FuzzBall
1694490701.short_description: Roll, dash, bash and smash in this playful 4 player brawler!

1694557830.title: Bonds of the Skies
1694557830.short_description: A fantasy RPG with a story of friendship between humans and gods!

1694657478.title: Amnesia: Rebirth
1694657478.short_description: A first-person horror adventure. Uncover your past and survive the Algerian desert. Fear is your enemy; stay calm to not succumb to an illness threatening you and your loved one. Avoid darkness, hide from monsters and solve puzzles. Adventure Mode available for a less scary experience.

1694852268.title: Avatar The Last Airbender: Quest for Balance
1694852268.short_description: Team Avatar is back! Relive the epic adventure of the original Avatar: The Last Airbender series, as you play as Aang and his 8 friends to explore the most unique locations from the series, solve challenging puzzles and experience the most heart touching moments of Aang’s story.

1694926512.title: Akinofa
1694926512.short_description:
Akinofa is an arcade shoot 'em up with Roguelite elements.

Take control of Akinofa, a mysterious undead fish of green flames, in this difficult Roguelite shoot em' up! Beat as many enemies and get the highest score possible. Challenge your friends and the world Rankings!

Every action counts! Even if you don't finish a level, every coin you collect will be in your treasury to use for permanent upgrades.

1695010806.title: Dance of Death: Du Lac & Fey
1695010806.short_description: London, 1888: The people of Whitechapel live under the ghastly shadow of Jack the Ripper, Will you stop Jack before more blood is spilt on the streets?

1695078658.title: The Glass Staircase
1695078658.short_description: The Glass Staircase is an homage to survival horror and Italian zombie movies.

1695116593.title: Void Blasters (Windows)
1695116593.short_description: Void Blasters is an arcade space shooter where you battle waves of enemy ships, collect upgrades during combat, and increase your firepower to face the final bosses, The Hunter and The Crystal, in decisive encounters.

1695141626.title: Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Ghoul Patrol
1695141626.short_description: Enjoy 16-bit console gaming with the cult classic Zombies Ate My Neighbors and its sequel, Ghoul Patrol!

1695219996.title: Trigger Path (Xbox Series X|S)
1695219996.short_description: A charming sokoban puzzle game where you play as a clever knight dragging enemies into place. When all traps are filled, they activate, defeat the enemies, and clear the level. Solve handcrafted puzzles and explore colorful medieval dungeons at your own pace.

1695271858.title: PowerWash Simulator Demo
1695271858.short_description: Start washing away your worries with the soothing sounds of high-pressure water in the PowerWash Simulator demo. Fire up your power washer and blast away every speck of dirt and grime you can find on the Van, Detached House and Skatepark levels and get a taste of that simple satisfaction of power-washing to a sparkling finish.

1695317859.title: Tiny Tales: Heart of the Forest (Xbox Version)
1695317859.short_description: Welcome to the kingdom of Brie: the tiniest land in the world ruled by the mouse king Oliver. Hidden deep in the foliage of the forest, between the blades of grass and mushrooms, there's a place where tiny people coexist with animals. Our little hero Max suddenly interrupts the search for his father when he is called home to help his mother save his childhood home. His only hope is to win a prize in a tournament, but as it turns out this is just the beginning of an epic adventure. Can he become a champion of the kingdom and discover the reason for a deadly drought that endangers everyone? Help Max to unravel mysteries, find clues in hidden objects and defeat all puzzles that stand in his path. Follow the tiny man on an dangerous quest to discover a well-kept secret which, if revealed, could shake the very foundation of the kingdom of Brie. Become the hero and write your own chapter in Tiny Tales: Heart of the Forest.

1695323712.title: Darwin's Paradox! Tactical Octopus Action Demo
1695323712.short_description: Embark on a grand sea adventure in this special demo, featuring nods to a beloved stealth-based franchise. Utilize Darwin's sneaky octopus skills to solve intricate puzzles and escape from the aliens!

1695336703.title: The Town of The Lost Witch
1695336703.short_description:
A man named Benjamin Jones who suffers from schizophrenia wakes up in a coffin while he hears something from outside; 
someone approaches and manages to open the lid of the device, but vanishes in a few seconds.
 
Benjamin gets up and knows that his sister is in danger so he decides to cross the crypt where he is. He soon realizes 
that he is stuck in a strange town and that to get out of there and find his sister he must face a great truth.

1695392136.title: Tormented Souls
1695392136.short_description: Tormented Souls is a return to classic survival horror inspired by the original Resident Evil and Alone in the Dark series. With a fresh twist on the fixed perspective adventure, Tormented Souls modernises for a new generation - as Caroline Walker investigates the mysterious disappearance of twin girls in a terrifying mansion-turned-hospital.

1695499346.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
1695499346.short_description: Headbangers is a light-hearted, Rhythm Battle Royale Game where you and 29 other Pigeons compete against each other, all to complete your quest of claiming the title of Master Headbanger!

1695618656.title: Book of Demons
1695618656.short_description:
Book of Demons is a Hack & Slash Deck-building hybrid in which you decide the length of quests. Wield magic cards and slay the armies of darkness in the Old Cathedral dungeons. Save the terror-stricken Paperverse from the clutches of the Archdemon himself!

Book of Demons is a tale of good and evil about saving the world from the ultimate devilry. Inspired by the dark and gloomy atmosphere of the first Diablo game, Book of Demons is part tribute part parody of hack & slash classics.

1695638358.title: Vampire Survivors
1695638358.short_description: Vampire Survivors is a time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.

1695734611.title: Dust & Neon
1695734611.short_description: Dust & Neon is a best-in-class twin-stick roguelite shooter set in a post-apocalyptic Wild West.

1695767730.title: Mini Games For BeamNG.drive
1695767730.short_description:
Mini Games For BeamNG.drive Game now Windows Store!
 It is an unofficial game. It is a game with many mini-games inspired by the game. It includes puzzles and memory matching games.

1695781563.title: Blacksmith Forger
1695781563.short_description:
Blacksmith Forger,

We are a forge, We can craft Gold ingots and Iron ingots as well as Weapons and Shields.
Our customers order weapons and shields. You have to catch up with them!
If they wait too long, they get bored.
As soon as you deliver the Weapons and Shields to the Customer,
You have to be fast!
But if you need more speed, you can try Potions.
They will speed up your oven.
Beware, some customers may request powered weapons!

1695794575.title: Twisted Fate (Xbox One)
1695794575.short_description: Twisted Fate is a turn-based roguelike with a deep ability-modification system. Lead a party of three heroes, adapt their skills using modifiers, collect artifacts, and craft unique builds to destroy the source of corruption… or die trying.

1695844514.title: landscape incorporation xbox
1695844514.short_description: Jeu de voiture de course réalisé avec le moteur de jeu unity. Votre objectif sera d'aller jusqu'au bout du parcours sans avoir à recommencer le jeu. Au fur et à mesure que vous avancez vous cumulez des points. Au bout de 100 points ou plus vous remporter le défis.

1695928641.title: Neon Tail
1695928641.short_description: Roller Skating Open World with Super Powers and Alien invasions.

1695979902.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
1695979902.short_description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.

1696012554.title: Goat Simulator Windows 10
1696012554.short_description:
Goat Simulator is the latest in goat simulation technology, bringing next-gen goat simulation to YOU. You no longer have to fantasize about being a goat, your dreams have finally come true! 

Gameplay-wise, Goat Simulator is all about causing as much destruction as you possibly can as a goat. It has been compared to an old-school skating game, except instead of being a skater, you're a goat, and instead of doing tricks, you wreck stuff. Destroy things with style, such as doing a backflip while headbutting a bucket through a window, and you'll earn even more points! When it comes to goats, not even the sky is the limit, as you can probably just bug through it and crash the game.

Disclaimer
Goat Simulator is a completely stupid game and, to be honest, you should probably spend your money on something else, such as a hula hoop, a pile of bricks, or maybe pool your money together with your friends and buy a real goat.

Key Features
• You can be a goat 
• Get points for wrecking stuff - brag to your friends that you're the alpha goat 
• MILLIONS OF BUGS! We're only eliminating the crash-bugs, everything else is hilarious and we're keeping it 
• In-game physics that bug out all the time 
• Seriously look at that goat's neck 
• You can be a goat.

1696036019.title: The Innsmouth Case
1696036019.short_description: The Innsmouth Case is a text adventure game inspired by H.P. Lovecraft and the very first text-based adventure to combine horror and comedy in a fit and proper way.

1696049385.title: Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt
1696049385.short_description:
Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt is a first-person hunting simulator where you hunt the largest and most dangerous beasts to ever exist – DINOSAURS.

This game is a remaster of the classic dinosaur hunting video game, Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter, delivered with a new game engine, improved graphics, advanced dinosaur behaviors, and seamless player progression.

1696056657.title: King's Justice (Windows)
1696056657.short_description: Explore a mysterious saga in King's Justice (Windows), a thrilling platformer with 10 unique stages, diverse enemies, deadly traps, and gameplay that tests your precision and lightning-fast reflexes.

1696098157.title: Bee Flowers: Save the Garden (Xbox One)
1696098157.short_description: The bees are back for another mission.

1696147865.title: Zenless Zone Zero
1696147865.short_description: Venture into a post-apocalyptic world, explore perilous Hollows, and unveil the mysteries behind the last beacon of hope for human civilization.

1696148785.title: Supermarket Simulator - Horror Escape
1696148785.short_description:
Survive the night… if you can! 🕯️👀🛒
Play as a night-shift worker in a haunted supermarket 😱💀. Monitor the security cameras 🎥👁️, avoid the relentless killer 🔪😈, and escape before it’s too late 🏃‍♂️💨. With four thrilling episodes 📖⚡ and unique sound effects 🔊🩸, this horror simulator will keep your heart racing!

Download now ⚠️🔥 and face your fears! 😱🎮.

1696173302.title: RIDE 4
1696173302.short_description:
RIDE 4 leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X|S title when available.

Are you ready to live the best gaming experience that a motorcycle fan can get?

RIDE 4 will spark your competitive soul with hundreds of bikes, dozens of tracks and a whole new level of realism.

1696184173.title: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE DEMO
1696184173.short_description: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE DEMO.

1696266955.title: Ars Fabulae Demo
1696266955.short_description: Decades have passed and the Actress returns to the abandoned theatre to uncover an anthology of magical performaces, each with a unique gameplay, distinct setting and... a hidden message. Explore a variety of magical, hand-painted worlds as you piece together the story of your past.

1696456823.title: NBA 2K22 for Xbox Series X|S
1696456823.short_description:
A WORLD OF BASKETBALL
NBA 2K22 puts the entire basketball universe in your hands. PLAY NOW in real NBA and WNBA environments against authentic teams and players. Build your own dream team in MyTEAM with today’s stars and yesterday’s legends. Live out your own pro journey in MyCAREER and experience your personal rise to the NBA. Flex your management skills as a powerful Executive in MyGM and MyLEAGUE. Anyone, anywhere can hoop in NBA 2K22.

1696465874.title: The Adventures of Ally The Alligator
1696465874.short_description: In The Adventures of Ally The Alligator, embark on a thrilling journey with Ally, a swift and fearless alligator! Across 30 perilous levels, you’ll need to use your skills to jump, climb, and dodge deadly obstacles while searching for the keys to escape. Each stage presents new challenges, requiring quick reflexes and mastery of classic platforming mechanics. Get ready for an intense adventure, packed with action and exciting challenges!

1696466008.title: GRAVEN
1696466008.short_description: Action, mystery, and a chance for redemption await you in the gritty first-person action-adventure GRAVEN. Explore a dark fantasy world as a wrongly convicted man of faith. Battle the horrors of humanity, the wilds and beyond using armaments, magic, and the environment.

1696475651.title: Outlander
1696475651.short_description:
* Now you can buy Outlander once and play on both Xbox (One, One S, One X) and PC (Windows 10) *



Outlander is a blocky platformer game that is fun for all ages.

You start on a dark planet without any tools or items.
As you explore you gather materials and other objects and you build new or better things in the workshop.

You can build a simple house with lights. Even electric lights that you connect via wires to a battery.
Lights are very important in Outlander because the dark planet has lifeforms that can kill you instantly on contact! You only have one life, but don't worry, the Save button is only a click away. Remember to use it often. If you get killed it loads the last saved state.

Once you completely explore the world it gives you the ability to move to another world. And then to another and another!
Each world has something unique and interesting so you'll never get bored.

And if you unlock all worlds we'll give you a Creative mode to unleash your creativity. It is still in experimental stage but it already is serious fun :)

Outlander is a very active coding project and receives very frequent updates. It gets better every month. We are determined to make it one of the best games on Xbox and Windows.

Have fun!
