1696578695.title: Button City SG-Demo
1696578695.short_description: A narrative adventure about cute animals, friendship, and arcades.

1696603875.title: Gas Station Simulator (Xbox Series)
1696603875.short_description: Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

1696613855.title: Just a Phrase by POWGI
1696613855.short_description:
A hangman-style word game with a twist. One word in every phrase has been replaced by a homophone to make it tougher to deduce. 

Like NUCLEAR WAIST or STRIKE THE RIGHT CORD.

1696763703.title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
1696763703.short_description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights, brigands and a mysterious evil force run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. Lead your domain into battle in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

1696832928.title: NHRA Championship Drag Racing: Speed For All
1696832928.short_description: NHRA™ is back – bigger and better than ever! Immerse yourself into the teams, tracks, tuning, and strategies, then strap into the driver’s seat in your ultimate quest to become the Champion among the true Beasts of the Strip™.

1696839999.title: MXGP 24: The Official Game
1696839999.short_description: After a 3-year break, the official game of the MXGP is back. Experience the full 2024 MXGP championship with its 20 official tracks and over 50 MX1/MX2 riders. Immerse yourself in the MXGP with a full and deep career mode.

1696861740.title: Inspector Waffles
1696861740.short_description: Step into the boots of whip-smart Inspector Waffles and unravel a mystery...

1696868991.title: WRC Generations - The FIA WRC Official Game
1696868991.short_description: Rise to all the challenges of the most comprehensive, realistic and demanding rally simulation ever developed. Dive into the heart of the action and drive the cars from the 2022 WRC championship, including the new hybrid models.

1696896244.title: Whispers in the Dark
1696896244.short_description:
Puzzles. Mysteries. Unknown civilization. You are trapped in a strange cave guided by the whispers of a loved on you can no longer see. Bravely dive into the darkness and discover its secrets!

If you want to use voice commands in the game, make sure that all console users have given permissions to use microphone to Whispers in the Dark in Settings > Privacy & online safety > App privacy and the microphone is enabled. No data is collected. Review privacy policy at https://github.com/influnza/witd/blob/master/Privacy%20policy.txt

The game is available on Xbox One and PC.

Supported input devices:
Xbox controller
Mouse or touchscreen + keyboard
Voice commands.

1696900915.title: Aritana and the Twin Masks
1696900915.short_description: Prove your value and unmask all the mysteries inside YpY's Temple. Using an enchanted bow and arrow, take Aritana on this journey to save the Tree of Life while discovering some ghosts from his past.

1696916332.title: Ultimate Video Game Trivia
1696916332.short_description: Put your video game knowledge to the test with over 800 video game related questions.

1696945475.title: WrestleQuest
1696945475.short_description: TAG TEAM WITH DESTINY! Pro wrestling and RPG fantasy collide in the ultimate pixel powered adventure. “Macho Man” Randy Savage and tons of other icons offer guidance as you powerbomb your way to glory beyond the ring. This hero’s journey ain’t just an epic quest, it’s WRESTLEQUEST!

1696973273.title: Hunt: Showdown (Beta)
1696973273.short_description: Hunt: Showdown is a competitive first-person PvP bounty hunting game with heavy PvE elements, from the makers of Crysis. Set in the darkest corners of the world, it packs the thrill of survival games into a match-based format.

1697054811.title: Luxor Evolved
1697054811.short_description: A faster, more intense evolution of the arcade marble shooter, packed with unique levels, awesome power-ups and neon-styled arcade action!

1697083574.title: Sushi For Robots
1697083574.short_description: Sushi For Robots is whimsical puzzle game about quirky robots and their insatiable cravings for sushi - how do they actually process it is a mystery, but hey, if that makes them happy.

1697112419.title: Deliver Us Mars
1697112419.short_description: Deliver Us Mars is an atmospheric sci-fi adventure taking you on a suspense-fuelled, high-stakes mission to recover the ARK colony ships stolen by the mysterious Outward.

1697152864.title: EXAPUNKS
1697152864.short_description: The year is 1997. You used to be a hacker, but now you have the phage. You made a deal: one hack, one dose. There’s nothing left to lose… except your life.

1697171025.title: Edgar Poe: Hidden Object Detective Games
1697171025.short_description: Plunge into the mystical atmosphere of Edgar Allan Poe’s story!

1697184778.title: Harmony Chronicles: Chaos Realms Collector's Edition
1697184778.short_description:
Join Mona on her quest and experience the ultimate adventure! 

For eons, Harmony has maintained order and prosperity across all realms. 
However, a mysterious decline in her powers culminated in her disappearance, leaving the entire universe teetering on the brink of catastrophe! 
Initially convinced that this surreal experience can only be a dream, our hero, Mona, resolves to aid in the search for the missing goddess. 
Venturing through portals, Mona will encounter werewolves, mermaids, dragons, and other fantastical beings on her way to face off against an unseen malevolent menace! 
With stunning visuals, captivating storytelling, humorous dialogues, and challenging puzzles, The Harmony Chronicles promises endless hours of immersive gameplay.

1697218984.title: Retro Highway
1697218984.short_description: Hit the Retro Highway and return to the days of 16-bit blast processing and pure arcade fun! Retro Highway is a throwback game aiming to combine the accessibility of modern titles with the high-skill challenge and charming aesthetics of old.

1697249893.title: Rivenaar's Grove
1697249893.short_description:
Harvest ingredients for potions to prove your worth as the apprentice of a skilled magician!

Rivenaar's Grove is a top-down fantasy adventure spin on sliding puzzles. The quick little apprentice can only move in straight lines from one border of the field to another. It’s up to you to figure out how to use these nimble movements to gather crops as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Once each field is cleared, you’ll be able to move to the next, with 50 levels in all! As you progress, new traps, obstacles and portals will be introduced, making it even trickier to harvest. To further prove your worth, you can tackle challenge modes with limited moves and time limits. Can the student truly become the master?

1697279233.title: Bubsy 4D
1697279233.short_description: The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

1697327394.title: Disjunction
1697327394.short_description: Disjunction is a cyberpunk stealth-action RPG set in the dystopian underworld of a 2048 New York. Experience a reactive, intertwining story of three playable characters, working to uncover unfortunate truths that will change the fate of their city forever.

1697386135.title: Chicken Police - Paint it RED!
1697386135.short_description: A wild tale of love, death, chickens, and redemption! Chicken Police is a buddy-cop noir adventure, with a carefully crafted world, a gritty story, and lots of absurd humor. The game mixes elements of classic adventure games with visual novel-style storytelling.

1697419723.title: Mostroscopy
1697419723.short_description: Mostroscopy is a fighting video game that takes up the aesthetics of the horror and Luchador films of Mexican cinema from the 1950s, with an eclectic roster of monsters and masked Luchadores and a simple gameplay style with a retro presentation.

1697516444.title: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor
1697516444.short_description: Step into a brutal prehistoric world where only the fastest, smartest, and strongest survive. From your very first breath, you are part of a living battlefield — a wild ecosystem filled with constant danger, rival predators, and endless opportunities to rise or fall. Every step forward is a risk, every encounter a test, and every victory pushes you closer to dominance. Start small, think fast, and evolve relentlessly. As you grow, the world grows with you — harsher environments, deadlier enemies, and bigger rewards await those who adapt. This is not just survival… it’s a fight to become unstoppable. Features: • Progress through evolution-based chapters, each introducing a new dinosaur • Explore vast, ever-changing biomes, from lush jungles to harsh volcanic landscapes • Upgrade and customize your dinosaur with enhanced stats, abilities, and unique appearances • Take on intense missions focused on hunting, survival, and territorial dominance • Engage with other players through clans, trading, and shared challenges • Experience lifelike dinosaurs with detailed animations, sounds, and behaviors This is your chance to rise above extinction and claim your place at the top. Become the hunter. Become the threat. Become legend.

1697593036.title: Mad Experiments 2: Escape Room
1697593036.short_description: Mad Experiments 2: Escape Room is the sequel of the award-nominated cross-platform multiplayer escape game Mad Experiments. Alone or with up to 5 friends, follow the story of Hildegarde and Professor Cheshire, explore rich environments to find clues, and solve mind-bending puzzles to escape!

1697635406.title: Post Trauma
1697635406.short_description: Post Trauma is a modern-day survival horror, inspired by genre-defining classics. You awaken to find yourself in a twisted reality full of mind-bending puzzles, breathtaking tension, and unspeakable nightmares. Can you face your greatest fears and find your way home?

1697676059.title: A Space for the Unbound
1697676059.short_description: High school is ending and the world is ending with it.

1697703336.title: To Farm Lands: Sowing Fields (Xbox One)
1697703336.short_description: Plant, Fit and Relax on the Farm.

1697835764.title: SOVIET TIDE ARISING !
1697835764.short_description: Take to the skies over the western front in this fantasy alternate timeline WW1 casual run and gun style sim-shooter. Fly as a heroic pilot of the Allied Empires as you take on the nefarious rocket powered forces of the Greater Soviet Union!

1697870233.title: WordMaster
1697870233.short_description: Build words using tiles against up to three friends or AIs of varying difficulty.

1697932737.title: Golfish Demo
1697932737.short_description: Golfish is a cute single-player puzzle adventure where you roll, flop, and splash your way from ice hole to ice hole as a little fish on a big journey!

1697934385.title: RetroRev37 RetroPass
1697934385.short_description: This is a Launchbox-style UI for RetroArch.

1697967295.title: RainbowPhrase Prologue
1697967295.short_description:
It is a simple music game to catch the flying notes according to the music.
It is a game that hides the depth where the score gets higher when you catch the note by catching the core.

1698017195.title: Square Smash (Windows)
1698017195.short_description: SquareSmash is a modern twist on classic brick-breaking! Experience fast-paced arcade action with roguelike progression. Upgrade your paddle, unlock powerful abilities, and conquer challenging levels in this neon-infused, high-energy retro adventure.

1698029468.title: StarLightRiders: HyperJump
1698029468.short_description:
Blast swarms of enemies and charge your warp drives in retro shoot’em up style!

Defend Earth in this fast-paced arcade shooter! Take command of the HyperJump ships and blast through swarms of alien invaders. Charge your warp engines by collecting reactors—but beware, the enemy strikes back harder the stronger you become!

Switch shot types on the fly, unleash screen-clearing bombs, and chain combos for maximum destruction. Face off against epic bosses in intense vertical-scrolling action, all driven by light narrative transmissions. StarLightRiders: HyperJump delivers classic arcade thrills with a modern edge!

1698038870.title: Savage Halloween
1698038870.short_description:
In Savage Halloween, the world is taken over by monsters from the afterlife who were trapped in the Earth after a Halloween party.Every year the monsters are invited to the big 24hr Halloween rave, but this time no one came home, as an evil vampire used a spell to block the passage back to the afterlife because, according to him, the party could not stop.
Among the guests, James, a farmer who had his eternal rest interrupted, took his shotgun, and decided to end the riot.
Join the resistance and send everyone home. No one can handle so much noise, goo, and werewolf hair on clothes anymore.

1698046377.title: Highway Police Simulator
1698046377.short_description:
Introducing Highway Police Simulator: Dive into the action of American patrolling duty!



Put on your uniform and step into the shoes of an American police officer with Highway Police Simulator! This game brings the heart-pounding action of the American Highway Patrol right to your fingertips. Immerse yourself in the unique challenges and serious police duties that officers face on a daily basis and truly feel what it's like to patrol the highways while maintaining law and order.



A compelling police story awaits you, with the option to play as either a male or a female officer. With both a casual and a simulation gameplay modes, Highway Police Simulator combines the best of both worlds: the freedom to drive and walk in an immersive virtual environment, and a diverse variety of exciting cases to solve in story-driven gameplay. Explore a diverse open world and tackle any situation that comes your way with an array of vehicles including cars, helicopters, and more.



Welcome to Caminora, where new missions await you! Get ready to experience the thrill of the chase, the satisfaction of solving crimes, and the adrenaline rush of patrolling the highways. What kind of cop will you be? Will you uphold the law with integrity, or will you bend the rules to get the job done? Your decisions will have a real impact on the story and the environment. Highway Police Simulator is where YOUR story begins!





Key Features



Authentic American Setting: Freedom to patrol the highways and urban landscapes of the fictional US region of Caminora in a diverse open-world environment.

Story-driven Gameplay: Solve exciting criminal cases that require you to make critical decisions. Use training grounds to climb up the ranks and successfully complete assignments to advance in your career and ultimately become the best officer in town. Unlock new tools and vehicles to aid you in your quest for justice.

Unique Vehicles: Drive highly detailed special vehicles such as different police cars, helicopters and more. 

Various Missions: 

Investigate accident scenes, talk to the people involved, document the accident, collect evidence, and draw conclusions by interpreting all the information you have gathered so far. 

Inspect vehicles at traffic stops and ensure safe roads for citizens. 

Chase down criminals through traffic chaos in thrilling pursuits and test your skills as you navigate the streets in dynamic car chases.

Choose to approach missions in a strategically way and act calmly and cautiously or engage in shootouts where quick thinking and precision are the keys to success.

Morality System: Are you a good and righteous cop or do you like to bend the law from time to time? Either way, your choices will affect not only the outcome of the story, but also the environment in which you live. Do as you please and live with the consequences.

1698082433.title: SHARK! SHARK!
1698082433.short_description: Inspired by the legendary SHARK! SHARK!® game released in its original version for the Intellivision® home console in 1982, this reimagined version for up to four players offers you a modern and addictive gameplay, fantastic graphics, great sounds, lots of levels and many underwater characters.

1698099921.title: Just Bricks
1698099921.short_description: Just Brics is a game with a classic concept but with an innovative style have fun with 200 different levels that provided you with a lot of challenge and fun.

1698192470.title: Matchbox™ Driving Adventures
1698192470.short_description: Jump into your vehicle and use your imagination to tackle missions and win races. Navigate dynamic landscapes, earn medals, and Drive Your Adventure.

1698194763.title: Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders
1698194763.short_description: Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders is a point&click adventure with an extensive, immersive story. Take on the role of the detective in ancient China and solve the mystery of cruel serial murders.

1698247129.title: Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble (XBox Series)
1698247129.short_description:
Aly is an alligator with the ability to perform "Dashes" in the air, and loves to wander through the magical green forest.
But one day, he came across a flying saucer and ended up being abducted, taken to an inhospitable planet. Now he needs to find a way to return home.
Upon arriving on the alien planet, Aly finds a space laser gun and a helmet to protect himself from the hostile environment.
Now armed and protected, Aly is ready to face his adventure and the challenges that await him!
Help Aly the alligator overcome the traps and find his way out of the unknown planet before it’s too late.

1698277348.title: X-Force Genesis PC Edition
1698277348.short_description: Join the X-Force Squad and stop a hybrid race from taking over your planet.

1698415742.title: Monster Truck Ramp Adventure
1698415742.short_description: It's like a Monster Truck Rollercoaster ride! Get ready for a fun filled adventure spread over fifteen levels. Choose your truck or unlock new favorites. Next select your level and compete on the leaderboards for the best time on each.

1698419011.title: Stellaris: Console Edition (X|S)
1698419011.short_description: Stellaris: Console Edition puts the complexity of the galaxy at your thumbsticks. Whether you’re exploring the unknown, discovering the mysteries of the universe, or conquering it for the glory of your empire, players have more inter-galactic strategy awaiting them than ever before.

1698508835.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 First Look
1698508835.short_description: Take your first swing at greatness with the PGA TOUR 2K25 First Look. Build up to 3 MyPLAYERS in the most customizable experience yet. Immerse yourself in stunning visuals as you play through 9 Holes of a select course. Carry your progress to the full game!

1698518232.title: Zoo Orbs: Safari (Xbox Series)
1698518232.short_description: Stack, Merge and Reach the Giraffe.

1698538174.title: Splash Blast Panic
1698538174.short_description: SPLASH BLAST PANIC is a multiplayer competitive party game where you must shoot, ram, dodge and overall bully your opponents outside the screen with a variety of watergun-based weaponry. Inspired by old arcade titles as well as newer competitive party games, ruin all your friendships in a variety of stages.

1698597039.title: Hokko Life
1698597039.short_description:
Hokko Life is a cosy, creativity filled community sim game.

Step off the train into the town of Hokko and get settled into your new home!

This quiet village needs your help to turn it into the charming rural town everyone loves. With hammer and paints in hand it's up to you to design, build and decorate homes for all of your new friends!

1698720748.title: Dark Elven Legacy (Windows)
1698720748.short_description: You are Elynar, the strongest archer in the Kingdom, who must face terrible creatures in the Great Dark Forest. Shoot with your bow, use a special power, or obtain power-ups during the game to fight various types of enemies.

1698735528.title: Roofcats Band - Suika Style
1698735528.short_description: What do cats do on the roof? Music! In this Suika-like game, you must match the cats to make new musicians appear, all while avoiding overflow and dealing with a crazy dog that shows up to mess things up. Will you be able to hear a killer guitar solo on the last cat?

1698736128.title: Guts 'N Goals
1698736128.short_description:
This isn't your standard game of soccer. This is Guts 'N Goals, where soccer balls can be hockey pucks, and you use a bat instead of your feet to score goals.

Choose from over 30 unique heroes and get ready to play the world’s game like never before!

Different ways to play - Each stadium has a unique way to play a game of soccer. Score a goal with a beach ball on the beach, and hit a hockey puck at the skating rink.

Keeping you on your toes - During each game, random mutators will change the way you play. Mutators can change everything from the ball you’re hitting to the entire game design in a matter of seconds.

There are no penalty cards - Each of the over 30 heroes has a unique ability that can drastically change the tide of a match. You can use these abilities to temporarily KO your opponent, giving you an opportunity to score.

Play your way - Guts 'N Goals can be played singleplayer, co-op, multiplayer, and local couch co-op. Enjoy this hilarious take on Soccer however you like!

1698746853.title: MotoGP™23
1698746853.short_description: Open the throttle, pass your opponents and cross the finish line: live the dream of being the next champion with the new MotoGP™23, more amazing and challenging than ever!

1698802403.title: Warp Bot
1698802403.short_description: Explore a mysterious world among the stars with a small robot lost in space.

1698840007.title: Beholder 2
1698840007.short_description: You are a newly employed department officer within the Ministry of a totalitarian State. While you are poised to have an illustrious career and possibly become Prime Minister someday, the way up won't be easy. So, how high up the career ladder will you climb? The choice is still yours to make!

1698843377.title: DUAL PATHS
1698843377.short_description: A casual, simple platform game with 40 short levels and infinite lives.

1698914731.title: My Big Sister
1698914731.short_description:
Meet Luzia, a sarcastic twelve-year-old with a playful sense of humor. If you believe what she says, My Big Sister is an RPG-like adventure game that is not about her but about her sister Sombria.

My Big Sister is a game about Luzia and Sombria, two sisters who are trying to get back home after being kidnapped by strangers and Luzia takes it upon herself to ensure they both make it home.

Across the game’s multiple chapters and played from a top-down perspective, in My Big Sister, players can expect to clear puzzles and find specific items should they wish to advance through the game’s story, but be sure to take your time. With plenty of secrets and multiple endings, you’ll have your work cut out for you to make sure you get the ending Luzia and Sombria deserve.


Features: 
 * Unique story
 * Adventure style gameplay
 * Top-down pixel artwork
 * Original Soundtrack.

1698975334.title: Death, Soul & Robots
1698975334.short_description: In the game Death, Soul & Robots, you play as a kitty who is searching for the soul of Planet-42 to save the Earth. The game includes six large biomes to explore, seven types of weapons, and numerous quests. Players will have to fight unique enemies, solve captivating puzzles, and explore interesting levels to achieve their goal. The game also features six interesting bosses and over ten characters with their own amazing stories. At the end of the game, player will need to make a difficult moral choice that will affect the final ending.

1698989872.title: PICO PARK 2
1698989872.short_description: Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

1699033603.title: Game Type DX
1699033603.short_description: Game Type DX is a high-score shooter with wacky, looping levels and high speed action!

1699062321.title: GONNER2
1699062321.short_description: In this sequel to Gonner: Journey your way through deep dark chaotic places with unimaginable sparks of colour as you go on a mission to help Death rid a mysterious presence from her lair. Battle crazy bosses, lose your head (a lot), in this messy, cute, fast-paced procedurally-generated platformer.

1699141319.title: The Curse 404 Demo
1699141319.short_description:
The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets—but the clues you discover remain. As you explore dark rooms, solve increasingly complex puzzles, and avoid a relentless supernatural presence, you slowly uncover the hidden truth behind a tragic event that occurred within the house.

Blending stealth, exploration, and smart puzzle design, the game creates constant tension where every sound matters and every decision can lead to danger. The deeper you progress through the loops, the more intense and emotional the experience becomes—leading to a powerful and satisfying conclusion.

Features
-Explore the Haunted House (Access to main rooms, upstairs, and outdoor areas)

-Introduction to Time Loop Mechanics (Experience the reset system with persistent progress)

-First Stealth Encounters (Learn how to hide and avoid the threat)

 Core Puzzles Included (Environmental exploration puzzles, Jigsaw puzzle, Code lock puzzle, Proximity-based discovery puzzle)

-Mystery Setup (Introduces the main event and unanswered questions)

-Gameplay Preview (Flashlight, detector, stealth, and puzzle mechanics)

Get Ready for Ultimate Horror Experience 

Note : Buy Full Version to Unlock all the features of the game.

1699337652.title: Little Nightmares II DEMO
1699337652.short_description:
Return to a world of charming horror in Little Nightmares II, a suspense adventure game in which you play as Mono, a young boy trapped in a world that has been distorted by the humming transmission of a distant tower.

This demo will let you discover the Wilderness and its bloodthirsty Resident: the Hunter for a taste of the adventures awaiting you in the full game.

Will you dare to face this collection of new, little nightmares?

1699368577.title: Zero Zero Zero Zero
1699368577.short_description: Navigate past 100 challenging levels to find out if you are the master of 1-bit platforming!

1699406552.title: Space Accident
1699406552.short_description: The year is 2119. A turning point has begun in the history of space. The moment of the beginning of the colonial development of objects of the solar system. States rapidly began to develop and implement their projects, striving to establish power in yet unexplored space territories. One of such missions was the "CCM-1" (Callisto Colonization Mission) expedition, whose goal was the satellite of Jupiter - Callisto.

1699441638.title: Marshmallow Marvin: Templestone
1699441638.short_description: In Marshmallow Marvin: Templestone, players guide a living marshmallow through a trap-filled temple, solving puzzles and avoiding dangers in a thrilling platforming adventure.

1699459210.title: DRAGON BALL Sparking! ZERO
1699459210.short_description: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!

1699515516.title: Ah, Love! Season 2 (Xbox One)
1699515516.short_description: New season of a game about Love! Swap blocks to help hearts have a date, but avoid the black heart, spikes and other obstacles! Optional challenge: make the hearts meet specifically in a romantic zone - a special part of some of the levels.

1699548286.title: Hotshot Racing: Demo
1699548286.short_description: Hotshot Racing is a blisteringly fast arcade-style racing game fusing drift handling, razor-sharp retro visuals and an incredible sense of speed to create an exhilarating driving experience.

1699595315.title: Copycat Demo
1699595315.short_description: A poignant narrative-driven game about rejection, belonging and the meaning of home. It follows the story of a newly adopted shelter cat whose space in the home is taken by a copycat. Bring the tissues.

1699612058.title: Potionomics: Masterwork Edition
1699612058.short_description: The award-winning magical shop sim is coming to Xbox Series X/S loaded with new features. Experience the magic of capitalism in Potionomics: Masterwork Edition, the fortified version of the enchanting game that alchemizes potion-crafting, business, deck-building, and romance.

1699651320.title: Alex the Rabbit
1699651320.short_description: Alex the Rabbit is a classic 2D platform game where you control an adventurous rabbit. Collect carrots scattered across the map, face challenges, and win the Golden Carrot at the end of each level. There are 20 levels and 4 bosses in a fun retro-style adventure.

1699661138.title: SKELER BOY - Prologue
1699661138.short_description: Adventure gameplay with a dark and disturbing narrative.

1699683547.title: Surface Runner
1699683547.short_description:
🎮 Streamlined Gameplay: Just you & the track.
🎨 Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean, vibrant visuals.
🕹️ Intuitive Controls: Easy for all players.
📈 Adaptive Difficulty: Test your limits.
📦 Compact Size: No storage woes.
💪 No Pay-to-Win: Skill-based success.
Available on Microsoft Store! 🏃‍♂️.

1699783391.title: Seasons of the Samurai
1699783391.short_description:
Lead a samurai through a series of puzzles set in the eight provinces of Japan. Control the season and the time of day in order to change the configuration of each level, allowing the samurai a safe passage to the next level.

All puzzles require logic reasoning and good memory skills. New mechanisms appear as you make your way through each prefecture of Japan, increasing the challenge throughout your journey.

The combinations of seasons and times of day create realistic sunlight conditions. Leaves in the trees reflect all four seasons depicting the glowing reds of the maple trees in autumn and the beautiful purple and pink tints of the cherry trees in the spring.

Discover all the pieces of a Japanese painting and earn all the belts all the way to the black belt!

1699788094.title: MotoGP™20 - Windows Edition
1699788094.short_description: This year, experience all the thrills of the more-complete-than-ever Managerial Career mode and enjoy new technical improvements and graphics. Customize your bike and suit! Compete against the MotoGP™ legends or challenge your friends online!

1699829016.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
1699829016.short_description:
The third entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series is here!
Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate.

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series set in the Monster Hunter world, where you can become a Rider, raising and bonding with your favorite monsters.

1699838964.title: Two Hundred Ways
1699838964.short_description: Two Hundred Ways, the sequel of the successful brain teaser One Hundred Ways, gives puzzle fans twice as many mental challenges to overcome. The mission of each of its 200 levels sounds easy: guide one or more balls to the exit. But levels with up to three different layers and numerous ball traps don't make this task a walk in the park. Luckily, players can use dozens of tools to help them reach their goal - but using more tools means that their level score will go down...

1699928394.title: Crate Fang (Xbox Series X|S)
1699928394.short_description:
One crate at a time. One clever move at a time.
In Crate Fang, you play as a golden-armored wolf solving smart sokoban puzzles across ancient ruins. Push, undo, restart, and outthink each level at your own pace in this charming pixel-art adventure.

1699999089.title: Talisman: Digital 5th Edition
1699999089.short_description: The classic fantasy board game returns as Talisman: Digital 5th Edition. Edit the Talisman deck for the first time and customise epic adventures to play solo or with friends. Discover a world where every journey is a fresh experience in this latest digital adaptation of the beloved fantasy adventure board game. More than just a visual update, Talisman: Digital 5th Edition delivers a wealth of enhancements that elevate your adventure into the definitive, digital Talisman adaptation.

1700020315.title: MADiSON
1700020315.short_description: Suffer the brutal torment of a demon forcing you to continue a gory ritual.

1700051314.title: Deceit 2
1700051314.short_description:
Deceit 2 is an online social deduction horror game. Inspire fear as the Terror, play detective as the Innocent, or create mayhem as the Cursed. Trapped with friends and strangers: who can you trust to help you escape?

THE TEAMS

THE INNOCENT: SURVIVE AND ESCAPE
- Stay alive and outwit the Terrors or meet a grim fate.
- Complete tasks around the map to bring you closer to obtaining the escape key.
- Investigate suspicious activity and keep an eye on your fellow players’ actions.

THE INFECTED: DECEIVE AND KILL
- Transform and execute other players to whittle down the ranks of the Innocent.
- Secretly activate blood altars to unlock stronger powers.
- Manipulate and gaslight your enemies to turn on each other.

THE CURSED: DISRUPT AND CONFUSE
- Deceive Infected and Innocents alike and avoid suspicion. 
- Become a true agent of chaos, and exploit your curse to win the game your way.
- Every Curse brings a unique approach to the game.

MASTER THE RITUAL
- Climb the ranks of Ascension to become a master of Deceit.
- Unlock new items and Mutations that create unique play styles and strategies.
- Expand your wardrobe with epic character and item cosmetics.

1700125109.title: Hidden Through Time
1700125109.short_description:
Embark on a colourful hand drawn journey of discovery through the ages!
From missing dinosaur eggs in the stone age, to a king's crown in medieval times, can you find them all?
Discover, create and share worlds with your own hidden treasures in Hidden Through Time!

1700131175.title: Cat and Ghostly Road (Xbox Series X|S)
1700131175.short_description:
An atmospheric point-and-click quest in which you play as a wise white cat.

One day the artist saved a cat that was in trouble, and they began to live together. There were no signs of trouble until one day an evil spirit attacked the artist. After this, the artist became seriously ill and now the wise white cat must help his friend and save him from death.

To do this, you have to go on a dangerous journey into the world of ghosts and demons. Not all things here are what they seem: to see their true form, you need to have a special cat's vision.

It will be a difficult path, but not a single demon can stop you!

1700180810.title: Escape First
1700180810.short_description: Escape with your friends or take them up on a challenge to see who is going to Escape First!

1700273919.title: KinnikuNeko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT
1700273919.short_description: Join KinnikuNeko, a cat with a bodybuilder's body, in this fun 2D platformer and fight against the mysterious alien invasion. A story full of goofy humor, friendship, drama and action. Its aesthetics are a love letter to 90s anime along with an unforgettable soundtrack.

1700288245.title: Mad Streets Demo
1700288245.short_description: Coming mid August! Mad Streets is the kind of game that makes you crack a smile all while punching some one in the face, It's a physics-based party game meshed with a brawler that feels like an evolution to the genre with a deeper system that allows skilled players to direct their blows for face-crunching KO animations that wouldn't look out of place in MMA highlights. .

1700323460.title: Diorama Dungeoncrawl - Master of the Living Castle
1700323460.short_description:
Medieval fantasy meets retro style in this side-scrolling adventure through low-poly 3D environments!

Inspired by 16-bit action games, Diorama Dungeoncrawl brings old-school challenge and style to low-poly 3D set pieces! Battle monsters and avoid traps in your quest to claim the heart of the Living Castle. Explore shrouded forests, mysterious halls, towers and dungeons to face off against the powerful Necromancer who commands the forces of darkness!

As a side-scrolling hack and slash adventure at its heart, Diorama Dungeoncrawl brings a fresh artistic direction to familiar action mechanics! Face off against hordes of skeletons, bats and goblins! Deftly avoid devious traps and confront fearsome bosses. Run, jump and swing your mightier hammer, but beware of enemy projectiles that fly at you from all directions! Can you survive and restore peace to your kingdom?

1700344676.title: Ghostbusters: The Video Game Remastered
1700344676.short_description:
The beloved and critically acclaimed Ghostbusters video game is back!

Strap on your proton pack once again and join the Ghostbusters on the adventure with the voice and likeness of the original crew as you battle to save New York!

1700494417.title: Galactic Civilizations III
1700494417.short_description: Build a civilization that will stand the test of time in the largest space-based strategy game ever! Choose from dozens of unique races and make a name for yourself across the galaxy through diplomacy, espionage, technological advances, and more.

1700500187.title: Avenue Escape
1700500187.short_description:
Bring order to the urban chaos as you solve traffic jams in brainteasing puzzle action!

Are you clever enough to clear the streets? Avenue Escape is a puzzle game that challenges you to direct traffic jams and safely move cars through busy cityscapes! Each of Avenue Escape’s 50 levels features a bustling scene packed with cars, pedestrians and traffic lights. It’s up to you to figure out the perfect sequence to move every vehicle to its destination.

Think ahead, time your moves carefully and avoid accidents as you navigate tricky intersections and unpredictable crosswalks. Try to clear each stage in the fewest lives possible, but don’t worry too much, as levels can be tried as many times as it takes.

1700516900.title: NINJA GAIDEN 3: Razor's Edge
1700516900.short_description: High-speed ninja action that's as sharp as a razor's edge.

1700624625.title: Three Minutes To Eight
1700624625.short_description: "Three Minutes To Eight" is a mind-bending pixel art adventure game.

1700671760.title: Hoof and Seek
1700671760.short_description: Find all the hidden farm animals.

1700674805.title: Horror Forest
1700674805.short_description: Explore with your flashlight and find a way out this creepy place.

1700741047.title: Hex Gambit: Respawned
1700741047.short_description: Hex Gambit: Respawned is a quirky and competitive digital board game for 1-4 players that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down!

1700794367.title: Marine Survivors
1700794367.short_description: Dive into the depths as a mystical whale in this spellbinding twist on the survivors genre! Marine Survivors throws you into an underwater arena where ancient magic meets endless action. Cast powerful spells against waves of deep-sea foes as you grow stronger with each run. Choose your path wisely - each level-up presents new magical abilities that can make or break your survival strategy.

1700805989.title: Cyber Citizen Shockman Zero
1700805989.short_description: Help Shockman save the world one more time!

1700846766.title: Animal Lover
1700846766.short_description: Only YOU can save five hunky boys from a magic curse!

1700931091.title: Jaden & Jasmine II: Lost Memories
1700931091.short_description: It's been exactly one month since Jaden Black was shot and betrayed by Jasmine Miles.

1700993509.title: I Love Finding Pups Collector's Edition
1700993509.short_description:
Visit beautiful locations from across the globe while you find and collect adorable canine companions! 
I Love Finding Pups features classic hidden object gameplay across a wide variety of scenes with a great collection of mini-games sprinkled throughout!

Collector's Edition features:
- 6 extra locations – find even more cats!
- double zoom feature for Hidden Object scenes
- 12 additional minigames
- Additional adoptable pups
- Meet the developers’ adorable pups.

1701001802.title: Anvil Saga
1701001802.short_description: Anvil Saga is a management sim with RPG twists, where you run a blacksmith forge during the Hundred Years’ War – great timing, right? Face tricky choices and try not to get beheaded!

1701003819.title: IceLine (Windows 10)
1701003819.short_description:
IceLine is a top-down puzzle game about Ice Magician, who collects magic crystals and takes his skills to the next level.
This is a puzzle game with unique mechanics in which the player character leaves an ice trail behind him and thus changes the playing field for himself!

1701069444.title: Self-Delusion
1701069444.short_description:
These monsters have no mercy for you...

Self-Delusion is a first-person survival horror in the original setting of Slavic fairy tales. You will faces such unique monsters like: Kolobok, Leshy, Boggart, Lapot and other creepy creatures. Explore, hide or run. Just don't get devoured by them.

1701108859.title: HITMAN 3
1701108859.short_description: Death Awaits. Agent 47 returns in HITMAN 3, the dramatic conclusion to the World of Assassination trilogy.

1701116237.title: Magnetism X
1701116237.short_description: Enter a world where logic meets motion. In Magnetism, every room is a puzzle and every jump a test of precision. Use your magnetic powers to reshape your surroundings and discover your own path to the end.

1701200455.title: ACA NEOGEO 2020 SUPER BASEBALL for Windows
1701200455.short_description:
2020 SUPER BASEBALL is a baseball game released by SNK in 1991.
In the near future, there are two leagues with 6 teams each. Players pick their team, and compete for the championship. As the game progresses, landmines will be set up on the field, and armor can be purchased during games to reinforce players. These unique aspects make for a very different baseball experience!

1701212022.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 8
1701212022.short_description: Plan a game night with the looping lunacy of Drawful Animate, scrambled sentences in Job Job, surveys and teamwork in The Poll Mine, doodling and deduction in Weapons Drawn and chance and trivia in The Wheel of Enormous Proportions.

1701369421.title: Preserve
1701369421.short_description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

1701385216.title: Run Will Byers Run Demo
1701385216.short_description: Over a small town called Hawkins, there is a terrible threat. Terrible monsters from the parallel universe invaded the town. The boy whose name is Bill Byers should resist monsters. Help him to unite friends and protect his city. Collect the "3 Musketeers" candies and "Eggo" waffles to involve friends in the fight against evil.

1701416254.title: Eternal Threads
1701416254.short_description: Eternal Threads is a single-player, first-person story-driven puzzle game of time manipulation, choice and consequence.

1701558797.title: Boundland
1701558797.short_description: Boundland is a fun physics-based platform game where you navigate your multi-shaped character through lots of dark levels and scary boss fights.

1701578930.title: Retro Racers 2
1701578930.short_description: Retro Racers 2 delivers top-down arcade racing with 12 tracks to unlock, four classic power-ups, and hazards that punish mistakes. Time gate openings for an edge, dodge sudden oil slicks, and race in smooth 60FPS HD.

1701591001.title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club (Windows)
1701591001.short_description:
After an amazing summer vacation full of surfing and wasting the days away at the beach, 17-year old Kaito is about to start his last year of high school at a school that he is still adjusting to. Still recovering from being kicked out of many other schools before arriving to this one, Kaito is hoping to make some new friends this year and prove to his mom that he can finish school and graduate.

Going in with low expectations, Kaito couldn't believe when he hit it off with the new girl at school, Michiko. But just as the two were getting to know each other, Kaito discovered that his new crush has a twin sister, Yuuki, and he begins to question everything he's feeling.

When Kaito finally comes to his senses, he realized that it may be too late. Who does Kaito end up choosing?

1701624216.title: Hypnospace Outlaw Demo
1701624216.short_description: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village.

1701653588.title: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard Character Creator
1701653588.short_description: Craft a leader for others to believe in with Dragon Age™: The Veilguard Character Creator. Delve into robust customization options and create your own unique Rook. When you launch Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, on the same platform (sold separately), you’ll be able to carry over your character.

1701683366.title: Let's Sing 2020 mit deutschen Hits
1701683366.short_description:
All begins with the first tone! Sing as solo superstar or perform with your crew and friends to rock every party! With the latest version of the singing game Let's Sing you can follow the footsteps of cutting-edge artists.
- 35 German and international hits
- Sing solo or with up to four players
- 6 exciting Game modes including the new Let's Party mode
- Microphone-App: your phone as microphone 
- More song packs online.

1701705707.title: From Space
1701705707.short_description: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apolcayptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

1701706628.title: Harvest Moon: Mad Dash
1701706628.short_description:
Go solo or take along a few friends in this fast-paced farming frenzy!

Harvest, fish, milk, and more as you fulfill orders to complete each level, but watch out for molten lava, raging boars, and other obstacles!

1701791264.title: Twinshot Air Hockey: Instant 2-Player Action
1701791264.short_description: The purest couch-duel you’ll install this year—load, shoot, rematch.

1701821008.title: Trivia: Knowledge Trainer - the Quiz Game
1701821008.short_description: The quiz game for smart people. With high-quality and challenging questions.

1701830204.title: Zumba World - The Crazy Marble Dimension
1701830204.short_description: Enter Zumba World – The Crazy Marble Dimension! As a marble-munching hero, dash around a colorful hub world to pick levels across Soccer, Candy, Space, and Dino realms. Shoot, match, and explode marbles before they breach the goal-line, sugar gate, event horizon, or cliff edge!

1701866186.title: Dungeons and Ducklings
1701866186.short_description: Break walls, crush bosses, rescue ducklings and end the Lich - Quack ‘em up!

1701866254.title: Airplane Race War
1701866254.short_description: Airplane Race War is an airplane racing and war game.

1702020699.title: Tourist Bus Simulator
1702020699.short_description:
Create your own bus empire on Fuerteventura now!

Thanks to the economy system in the new Tourist Bus Simulator, you will be able to found your own bus company on the popular holiday island Fuerteventura.

Your offer comprises scheduled routes, hotel shuttles or sightseeing tours. Furthermore, you also have to manage your fleet, including vehicle care and maintenance, and employee planning. If you are successful, you can continuously expand your fleet.

In this PC game, the entire island has been faithfully recreated including a large number of roads and unpaved tracks, cities, villages and beaches. All areas are accessible. Thanks to the 1:5 scale, even long bus tours can be completed in an enjoyable driving time.

The MAN Lion's Coach is available in two sizes. You can choose between different bus designs to find the right one for each task.

FEATURES

 Map of Fuerteventura at an extremely high level of detail
 - 20 faithfully recreated cities and beaches
 - Many pass roads, serpentines, points of interest and three harbours
 - Find hidden stashes and other uncommon and interesting places
 Large selection of vehicles
 - MAN Lion’s Coach and Lion’s Coach C, originally as they are used on the Canary Islands
 - Large selection of bus designs, appropriate for each task
 - Off-road and service vehicle
 Various offers for your customers:
 - Scheduled routes: transporting passengers all over the island
 - Hotel shuttle: transporting tourists from the airport to hotels and back
 - Sightseeing offers for hotels with interesting custom tours for the tourists
 Economy system:
 - Extensive fleet management, incl. maintenance work
 - Personnel management and recruiting drivers, guides and mechanics
 - Maintaining vehicles, incl. refuelling, reparations, service in one’s own or an external workshop
 - Managing the bus company’s spare parts store, insurances, WIFI, catering, etc.
 - Supporting employees for their searches for flats, gyms, beaches, and bars
 - Extend your depot for additional vehicles
 - Buy your own apartment or estate and improve your personal accommodation
 Freely movable bus driver as well as passengers who board and leave
 Bus wash
 Various levels that can be unlocked by completing orders and gaining experience.

1702149410.title: Petit Island
1702149410.short_description: Petit Island is a charming open-world narrative exploration game.

1702153667.title: Buck Blastem
1702153667.short_description: Explore large levels. Find gold and artifacts. Buy guns. Earn upgrades. Bring an end to the chaos!

1702178095.title: Irem Collection Volume 3
1702178095.short_description: Three fantasy horizontal shoot ‘em ups from IREM’s arcade vault – Mr. Heli, Mystic Riders, and Dragon Breed, all in one explosive collection!

1702196563.title: Frostpunk 2
1702196563.short_description: Develop, expand, and advance your city in a society survival game set 30 years after an apocalyptic blizzard ravaged Earth. In Frostpunk 2, you face not only the perils of never-ending winter, but also the powerful factions that watch your every step inside the Council Hall.

1702225095.title: First Time In Paris Collector's Edition
1702225095.short_description:
Join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they go on their first big business trip to save a Parisian hotel!

A new Hidden Object adventure begins! Kate Robinson is an amateur travel blogger who's taking on her first big job—and it's in Paris! 
Join her and her daughter Nicole as they save the Hotel Hospitalité, all while making new friends and new memories in the City of Love!

Explore lavishly illustrated and animated locations and help Kate save the Hotel Hospitalité!

1702238506.title: Aliens Vs Plane
1702238506.short_description: Fight aliens and shoot asteroids in a plane surviving as long as you can!!

1702241488.title: Evil Wizard(Xbox)
1702241488.short_description: Evil Wizard is a humor-filled action RPG featuring metroidvania elements and carefully crafted pixel-art environments. As a defeated villain who barely survived a tough fight, you’ll have to face an army of so-called heroes to recover what’s rightfully yours. Rediscover your powers, infiltrate your own castle, unleash devastating spells, and purge your ancestral home of these miserable excuses for an enemy. Are you ready to get your hands dirty? It’s time to be the bad guy for a change!

1702244274.title: Autumn's Journey
1702244274.short_description: A visual novel about friendship, growth and understanding.

1702245509.title: Junkster
1702245509.short_description: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

1702263299.title: CULTIC
1702263299.short_description: Death is only the beginning in this haunting, retro-style FPS, where creativity and brutality go hand-in-hand. Crawl from your grave and fight your way through the ranks of a twisted cult. Includes the original campaign, Interlude, Chapter Two expansion, all Survival maps, and the Cultmas bonus map.

1702329210.title: Solid Void Art Nonograms
1702329210.short_description:
A great collection of nonograms!
Uncover art hidden within puzzles!
Have fun and exercise your brain!

1702363847.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator
1702363847.short_description:
"Welcome to Mars!
Rover Mechanic Simulator is a game in which you are a mechanic working on one of the first Martian colonies. Your main tasks include the repair and maintenance of Mars rovers, so that the remaining crew can collect detailed information about the structure of the planet.

Use various devices!
There are many devices at your disposal that will allow you to dismantle and maintain even the smallest parts of the rover. Use different tools such as a 3D printer, recycling machine, overhead crane, soldering iron and many more.

Fix Mighty Mars Rovers
There are many devices on Mars which served people in the past but broke down at some point. You can fix and restore them to service. Thanks to you they can continue to perform their tasks by sending specialized information about the composition of the planet. ""Spirit"", ""Opportunity"" and others have served people for years and they can still do it!

Fix damaged PCBs
Not all parts need to be replaced entirely. You can use special workbenches to repair damaged PCBs, clean and maintain parts that have worn out during rover's work. Thanks to this, you can save resources for much more difficult tasks.

Gain Experience
The game offers you several development paths that you can choose. Are you a tinkerer who enjoys disassembling devices into small parts? Become a technician! But if you prefer to precisely analyze the damaged parts and find malfunctions faster, then become an analyst. If you want to master the recovery of resources, follow the economist’s path.

Gain experience, earn higher and higher ranks and undertake more and more difficult tasks. Become the best engineer on Mars!".

1702440591.title: The Stairwell
1702440591.short_description:
It's your first day as a security officer in a mysterious building designed by an unknown architect. Within its vast stairwell, you are tasked with inspecting the floors for reported strange phenomena. Make your way through the building and carefully choose which way to go based on your findings.

How to Play:
If everything is normal, proceed upstairs.
If you notice an anomaly, go downstairs, quickly.
Do not miss too many anomalies.

The Stairwell is a psychological horror game inspired by anomaly loop games such as The Exit 8, with a new vertical dimension of massive scale. There are over 50 anomalies to uncover between all difficulties. You can see how many are left to find after you win a game. Anomalies that you haven't seen will usually appear first.

Customize the difficulty of your playthrough. In nightmare mode, beware: the lights are out. Can you find anomalies in total darkness with your candle?

1702474058.title: Fading Clouds (Xbox Series)
1702474058.short_description: One Step at a Time Among the Clouds.

1702524932.title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid
1702524932.short_description: Generations of Power Rangers collide across the multiverse’s 25 year history. Experience authentic, but re-imagined Power Rangers gameplay. This easy to learn, but hard to master fighting game is designed to welcome players of all skill levels.

1702560281.title: Hyper Team Recon
1702560281.short_description: Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth! Three energetic alien slimes, Ember, Penny and Lite, are tasked to travel to Earth in order to learn more about the lifeforms inhabiting the planet, using their species' unique morphing abilities to disguise themselves as girls in order to keep a low profile!

1702609951.title: Hidden Cats in Paris
1702609951.short_description: Meow meow, cat-spotter! Why not go on a trip around Paris?

1702625940.title: Ink Inside
1702625940.short_description:
From some of the minds behind Steven Universe: Unleash the Light, comes INK INSIDE - a hand drawn adventure with the heart of a Saturday Morning Cartoon!

Play as Stick, an unfinished doodle trapped in a box of notebooks beneath a slowly leaking ceiling. As the water seeps into the notebooks, it warps the land around them and turns once friendly doodles into mindless, soggy monsters. Uncover lost memories and save your friends by battling back the waves of wetness corrupting the world.

YOU can fight back against the invading “Sog” by hitting them in the face with dodgeball “CORES!” Hold and aim your attack before letting go at just the right time to trigger unique weapon “perks” - then get in close and knock the wet out of them with a melee combo. Use more unique cores and combo attacks in action-packed dodgeball-meets-beat-em-up style combat that will see you dodging patterns of projectiles, using specials, and mastering a unique form of action RPG combat!

Explore the worlds between the sketchbooks to unlock memories and meet a vibrant cast of characters who are fully voiced and animated. Featuring voices by Brian David Gilbert of YouTube & Dropout fame, and Deneen Melody from Evangelion and Netflix’s Romantic Killer.

Meet and recruit a colorful team of characters to help you on your journey. From the dependable Detective Fuzz to Traff, the Princess of Cursing who hits like a truck and talks like a truck driver.

Collect new gear, unlock stronger abilities and fill your COOL MOVES bar to BREAK THE RULES and deal extra damage by smashing through the invisible wall protecting your enemies.

Complete quests to uncover deep lore and visit shops to upgrade your gear, level up and mix and match new mechanics that will aid you on your epic quest to save the notebooks!

1702713376.title: Genesis Noir
1702713376.short_description: A noir adventure spanning time and space.

1702731390.title: Supermarket Simulator
1702731390.short_description: Run your supermarket! Stock shelves, set prices, take payments, hire staff, expand, handle shoplifters, design layout, deliver orders. Buy goods locally or online and bring them to customers yourself.

1702750733.title: Huntdown
1702750733.short_description: In the mayhem-filled streets of the future where criminal gangs rule and cops fear to tread, only the bounty hunters can free the city from the corrupt fist of felony. Lay waste to the criminal underworld and make a killing in this hard boiled action comedy arcade shooter.

1702764716.title: Beat Stickman: Beyond
1702764716.short_description: Beat a lot of Stickmans with a lot of stuff, and beyond!

1702869784.title: Project Motor Racing
1702869784.short_description: All the passion, beauty & intensity of pro motorsport merging the most iconic cars & circuits with a new benchmark in handling performance.

1702914632.title: Poker Club
1702914632.short_description: Live the life of a poker pro in the most immersive poker simulation ever seen, with Ultra HD 4K visuals and breath-taking ray tracing.

1703059239.title: God of Weapons
1703059239.short_description: Gear up for roguelike action with tons of unique weapons!

1703086168.title: Microsoft Sudoku
1703086168.short_description: Microsoft Sudoku has turned up the brilliance! With NEW levels of difficulty, FOUR (4) themes to choose from, DAILY Challenges, and ALL NEW Irregular and Ice Breaker modes, you may never go back to playing the classic way again. Keep your mind sharp across hundreds of brain training puzzles in bright, FUN colors. Play at your own pace or strive to become a GRANDMASTER today!

1703108542.title: Another Crusade
1703108542.short_description: Discover a 3d wooden puppet style world while exploring as a platformer, and taking battles in a turn-based combat as an old school RPG where timing and strategy is all!

1703114306.title: Zumania
1703114306.short_description: Funny and colorful family puzzle game! Embark on an incredible adventure across magical worlds with a magical ballista. Explore the mysteries of ancient worlds and get all the exotic bonuses that will help you solve the puzzles!

1703270586.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
1703270586.short_description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is a story-driven open-world RPG that immerses you in an epic adventure in the Holy Roman Empire. Avenge your parents' death as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Explore majestic castles, deep forests, thriving villages and countless other realistic settings in medieval Bohemia!

1703316023.title: Frank and Drake
1703316023.short_description: Two extraordinary strangers. One shocking conspiracy.

1703351539.title: Legends Aligned: Land of Order (Xbox Series)

1703360763.title: Despot's Game Demo
1703360763.short_description: Despot’s Game is rogue-like tactics with turbo-charged battles.

1703402830.title: Tilesweeper
1703402830.short_description: Tilesweeper is a well-known game Minesweeper, but with stunning graphics.

1703407158.title: The Red Exile - Survival Horror
1703407158.short_description:
The hunt is on as you attempt to perform an exile rite on a maniac pursuer before he finds and kills you!

First-person survival horror gets a roguelike twist in The Red Exile, where every playthrough is randomized across a procedurally generated map to keep you on your toes while elements of hand-crafted puzzles and level design are layered within. Your task is to perform an exile rite to rid this realm of your maniac pursuer before he can kill you first.

Outsmart, evade and fend off your pursuer as you locate items to unlock new rooms and complete the ritual. But be careful, the AI-powered pursuer learns from the actions you take and gradually grows stronger! Collect perks to unlock new abilities and stack the deck in your favor. Can you adapt and survive this deadly game of cat and mouse?

1703488144.title: Marioboy Strikers: Soccer League
1703488144.short_description:
Dive into the thrilling world of arcade-style soccer with Marioboy Strikers: Soccer League! Experience the excitement of 4v4 matches, where every player counts. With 10 unique and fun teams to choose from, you’ll dribble, pass, and shoot your way to victory while defending your goal with a skilled goalkeeper.

Designed for fast-paced fun, this game focuses on easy-to-learn controls and engaging gameplay. Whether you’re sprinting down the field, setting up the perfect assist, or unleashing a powerful shot on goal, every moment is packed with action and excitement.

Features:
⚽ 4v4 Matches - Compact teams for fast-paced fun.
⚽ 10 Unique Teams - Play with colorful and quirky squads, each with their own style.
⚽ Easy Controls - Accessible gameplay for players of all skill levels.
⚽ Run, Pass, Shoot - Simple mechanics with strategic depth.
⚽ Fun for All Ages - Perfect for casual gaming sessions or challenging your friends.

Grab your boots, hit the field, and become the soccer champion in t.

1703518315.title: Neoverse
1703518315.short_description:
NEOVERSE is a time warping multiverse game consisting of thrilling adventures that are packed with great and exciting challenges; combining roguelite, deck building, strategy gameplay all in one. It puts your skills to the test. Set off on an adventure with unique heroes to save the living realms regardless of time and space. 

“Be the savior of Neoverse”

-Create your own Strategy with 300 cards and over 100 skills
-Choose from 3 charismatic characters, each with their own unique abilities and specialities.
-Over 70 types of Monsters that need to be defeated in order to save the world, each with their different patterns
-Multiple skill Combinations for each Hero
-Master challenging levels for more Sophisticated Gamers

 “Start your journey across time and space to save Neoverse”
-Experience Different combinations by using new cards each time you play
-Your future destinations will depend on every decisions you make
-Plots and enemies dodging over the past, the future and beyond are legendary tales yet to be told.

“Endless gaming experience”
-Strategy Customization is key to saving the Neoverse 
-Auto-draw system for remaining cards

-Weave your talent tree and create your own skill combination
-Switch between various gear options to master your game

“Become who you want to be” 
-Unlock the DLC and have even more fun throughout the Neoverse
-Customize your character to merge into your unique role as a Hero

“Transcend Time and Space by becoming a time traveling Hero”
Immerse yourself on your journey through Neoverse, your problems, your joy - all these things become one, and you will find yourself transcended to the future.

1703750979.title: Island Trouble
1703750979.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious island, gather resources, craft tools, build upgrades, and complete missions to survive and escape. Explore beaches, forests, and rugged lands. Collaborate or compete with others in your fight for survival!

1703850048.title: Suika Nest (Xbox Series X/S)
1703850048.short_description: Fuse two birds of the same kind to summon a new type of bird! Keep repeating to unlock every type possible and build a nest full of life and variety. But watch out! If the nest ends up too crowded all the birds might fly away!

1703928788.title: Fool's Pub
1703928788.short_description: Play your best game to stay alive!

1703939860.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos
1703939860.short_description: Hunted by mercenaries of an enemy with untold power, the fighter Pseudo and the creature under his protection begin a perilous quest to the edges of strange lands.

1703986144.title: Kristala
1703986144.short_description: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

1704019228.title: REMEDIUM: Sentinels
1704019228.short_description: Become a Sentinel and face the plague in roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter set in the same world as REMEDIUM game. Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more powerful weapons and create unique builds to defend the plague survivors against the endless hordes of mutants!

1704101432.title: Empyreal
1704101432.short_description:
Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG.

In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation. These are no mere ruins: the Monolith is filled with danger, and the Expedition is ill-equipped to unearth the secrets within.

1704142080.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane Slayer Edition Xbox Series X|S
1704142080.short_description: Fight Chaos in this ultimate version of Warhammer: Chaosbane, which includes the Tomb Kings expansion, all existing content and the new Witch Hunter class.

1704200304.title: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection
1704200304.short_description: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection is a 3D remake of the original ARPG, featuring revamped graphics, dynamic combat, and a tactical summoning system. Dive into an adventure full of strategy and action, inspired by the classics of the 6th generation of consoles.

1704201327.title: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
1704201327.short_description: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is a genre defining experience that established innovative game-play mechanics that are a staple of the FPS and RPG genre today. Survive the wretched corridors of the Von Braun. Your training has prepared you for this.

1704224301.title: Devious Dungeon
1704224301.short_description: Set in the Dark Ages, Devious Dungeon is a medieval focused action platformer title.

1704351342.title: Hello Neighbor 2
1704351342.short_description: Find out what your neighbors are hiding in the open-world of Raven Brooks.

1704356008.title: Aery - Peace of Mind 4
1704356008.short_description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

1704427307.title: Deer & Boy
1704427307.short_description: A runaway boy meets a fawn in this poetic cinematic adventure. As their bond grows, so do their abilities. Experience evolving gameplay where silence speaks louder than words and your companion transforms from vulnerable baby to protector.

1704468348.title: MechaNika
1704468348.short_description: Plan for the destruction of all things that aren't awesome.

1704470568.title: Arcade Archives 2 KONAMI GT
1704470568.short_description:
"KONAMI GT" is a racing game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

1704490079.title: South of Midnight
1704490079.short_description: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Learn an ancient weaving power, explore the Deep South mythos and confront mysterious creatures in this folktale for modern times.

1704529510.title: Vzerthos: The Heir of Thunder
1704529510.short_description: Vzerthos is a 2D isometric old-school techno-fantasy styled Top-Down Shooter. Player's arsenal includes skills of the Thunder God's heir and three types of guns - use them to slice and dice, burn and blow up your enemies!

1704562600.title: Rugby 25
1704562600.short_description: Experience the Rugby 25 rush! From local club clashes to the grandest international championships, lifelike gameplay, strategic depth, and heart-stopping action ensure every match is a battle and every victory earned on the path to immortality.

1704577564.title: Axis Football 2020
1704577564.short_description: Axis Football 2020 features massive gameplay improvements, football gaming's most complete Franchise Mode, and a slick new UI!

1704625304.title: Top Run
1704625304.short_description: Top Run is endless runner with platformer elements. It has everything we love: neon, pixel art, a bit of outrun, tiny piece of synthwave, scanlines, VHS effects.

1704654963.title: Happy's Humble Burger Farm
1704654963.short_description: Happy’s Humble Burger Farm is a first person adventure horror cooking game. Discover the dark secrets of the Happy’s Humble franchise by exploring New Elysian City. But don't neglect work duties; keep Happy happy!

1704713857.title: Tangle Tower
1704713857.short_description: Unravel a thrilling mystery by exploring a strange and twisted mansion, discovering curious clues, interrogating peculiar suspects, and solving unique puzzles.

1704729571.title: The SpeedRun Game 2
1704729571.short_description: fast speed running action with lava is rising game mode and a co-op mode.

1704782946.title: How to Take Off Your Mask Remastered
1704782946.short_description: A cute otome game about a human girl who suddenly turns into a catgirl.

1704946873.title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
1704946873.short_description: Rule and expand the Varennes Empire across multiple generations, engage the Seven Heroes in a battle that spans millennia, and make choices that drastically alter the course of your journey in this non-linear RPG!

1704985822.title: Paper Flight - Speed Rush
1704985822.short_description: Paper Flight – Speed Rush is an interactive game experience that is designed to ease your mind and have fun popping innocent balloons.

1705027289.title: Block Puzzle Deluxe
1705027289.short_description:
Simply drag the blocks
Try to fit them all in a row or column
Blocks cannot be rotated

1705990324.title: Space Engineers
1705990324.short_description:
Space Engineers is an open world sandbox game defined by creativity and exploration.

It is a sandbox game about engineering, construction, exploration and survival in space and on planets. Players build space ships, wheeled vehicles, space stations, planetary outposts of various sizes and uses (civil and military), pilot ships and travel through space to explore planets and gather resources to survive. Featuring both creative and survival modes, there is no limit to what can be built, utilized and explored.

Space Engineers features a realistic, volumetric-based physics engine: everything in the game can be assembled, disassembled, damaged and destroyed. The game can be played either in single or multiplayer modes.

Volumetric objects are structures composed from block-like modules interlocked in a grid. Volumetric objects behave like real physical objects with mass, inertia and velocity. Individual modules have real volume and storage capacity.

Space Engineers is inspired by reality and by how things work. Think about modern-day NASA technology extrapolated 60 years into the future. Space Engineers strives to follow the laws of physics and doesn't use technologies that wouldn't be feasible in the near future.

Space Engineers concentrates on construction and exploration aspects, but can be played as a survival shooter as well. We expect players will avoid engaging in direct man-to-man combat and instead use their creativity and engineering skills to build war machines and fortifications to survive in space and on planets. Space Engineers shouldn’t be about troops; it should be about the machinery you build.

CORE FEATURES
Planets and moons – fully destructible & persistent, volumetric, atmosphere, gravity, climate zones
Game modes
- Creative – unlimited resources, instant building, no death
- Survival – realistic management of resources and inventory capacity; manual building; death/respawn

Single-player – you are the sole space engineer
Multiplayer
- Creative and survival mode with your friends
- Cooperative and competitive
- Privacy customization: offline, private, friends only, public
- A host on Xbox One and Xbox One S supports 2 player multiplayer (lobby), 1 host + 1 client
- A host on Xbox One X supports 4 player multiplayer (lobby), 1 host + 3 clients

New game options
- Scenarios - offer linear story with action-packed gameplay, while the majority of Space Engineers scenarios feature unique sandbox environments where players create their own challenges. 
- Workshop worlds - offer worlds created by other players. 
- Custom worlds - offer variety of customizable worlds where you can start your own scenario. 
Customizable character - skins, colors, community market, male and female character
Ships (small and large) – build and pilot them
Space stations
Planetary bases, outposts, cities
First-person & Third-person
Super-large worlds – the size of the world to 1,000,000,000 km in diameter (almost infinite)
Procedural asteroids - an infinite number of asteroids to the game world
Exploration - adds an infinite number of ships and stations to the game world; discover, explore, acquire and conquer!
Drilling / harvesting
Manual building in survival mode – use welder to assemble blocks from components; use grinder to disassemble and reuse components
Deformable and destructible objects – real proportions, mass, storage capacity, integrity

Building blocks - over 200 blocks (gravity generators, jump drive, turrets, doors, landing gears, assembler, refinery, rotors, wheels, thrusters, pistons, wind turbine and many more) 
Electricity – all blocks in a grid are wired in an electrical and computer network; electricity is generated by nuclear reactors or various power sources
Gravity – produced by planets and gravity generators. Spherical gravity generator also available.
Symmetry/Mirroring – useful in creative mode when building structures that require symmetry
Weapons – automatic rifle, small and large explosive warheads, small ship gatling gun, small ship missile launcher
mod.io Workshop – share your creations with the Community (upload and download worlds, blueprints)
Localized interface
- Official localization: English, Russian, Chinese, German, French, Spanish

Cargo ships - auto-piloted vessels (miners, freighters and military) that carry ore, ingots, constructions components and other materials from sector to sector. They can be looted but beware, they often contain booby traps!
Oxygen - take off character's helmet, generate oxygen out of ice by using the oxygen generator
Hydrogen - hydrogen thrusters, hydrogen tanks and hydrogen bottles
Factions - create and join factions, determine ownership of blocks and manage the relations between them (hostile/ally). 
Blueprints - save your ship or station on a blueprint and paste it into your game
GPS - create, send, receive and manage GPS coordinates in the game
Voxel hands - shape and form the asteroids and change their material (creative mode only)
Sounds – realistic and arcade mode

Space Engineers utilizes an in-house built VRAGE 2.0, realistic volumetric-based physics engine: all objects can be assembled, disassembled, damaged and destroyed. 
 
How to Play
Start by watching this video tutorial:http://www.SpaceEngineersGame.com/how-to-play.html
 
Performance Notes
The performance depends on the complexity of your world and the type of your Xbox. Simple worlds run smoothly even on old Xbox, but a more complex world with rich object interactions could overload even XBox One X.

Certain features of the game, including mods, may not be accessible by Xbox child accounts. At Xbox, a child means players under the age of 13, unless local laws specify differently.
