1735842687.short_description: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

1735843094.title: Trover Saves the Universe
1735843094.short_description: A game from Squanch Games! Your pups are missing. The cosmos is at stake. Only you and Trover can save everything in this bizarre comedy adventure!

1735845764.title: The Talos Principle
1735845764.short_description: The Talos Principle is a philosophical first-person puzzle game from Croteam, the creators of the Serious Sam series, and written by Tom Jubert (FTL, The Swapper) and Jonas Kyratzes (Infinite Ocean).

1735883866.title: Herd Dispatch (Windows)
1735883866.short_description: The Perfect Path for Every Little Sheep.

1735927363.title: DETECTIVE - Stella Porta case
1735927363.short_description: DETECTIVE: Stella Porta Case, puts you in the shoes of a detective who investigates three strange disappearances. In all cases there is a contract signed by the disappeared, that contract is from an organization called "Stella Porta".

1735946683.title: Royal Assault
1735946683.short_description: Royal Assault is a real-time tower defense game set in a medieval fantasy setting. Your people are under attack and you must fend off the invading armies by building towers. Choose the quick-firing Archer Towers to quickly dispatch flying enemies, the hard hitting Mage Towers to penetrate the armor of your toughest foes, the explosive Artillery Towers to do area damage to all ground-based enemies, or opt to build Barracks instead which train soldiers who can stop enemies in their tracks.

1736155189.title: Anodyne 2
1736155189.short_description: Travel to a surreal and dreamy multi-genre world.

1736174077.title: City Transport Simulator: Tram
1736174077.short_description: Become a tram driver, so hop into the cab for the ultimate tram driving experience! Take your pick from a selection of three real-world trams, the ULF B1, R2.2b, or ULF A1, and hit the city streets of Tramau!

1736201364.title: Button City
1736201364.short_description: A narrative adventure about cute animals, friendship, and arcades.

1736241026.title: GunSpinning VR
1736241026.short_description: GunSpinning VR is a rail shooter that takes place in a small city in the wild west. The city is invested by zombies and you have to clean it up to find the source of the infection.

1736252901.title: Lunar Lander Beyond
1736252901.short_description: Guide a roster of colorful pilots, eclectic advisors and state-of-the-art landers through a taxing series of missions. Deliver cargo, retrieve resources, and rescue stranded pilots as you navigate a mysterious universe of moons and planets.

1736276958.title: O.W.L Projekt
1736276958.short_description:
Guide a young being’s daring escape as you puzzle your way through isometric landscapes!

Get ready for an enigmatic and challenging adventure with O.W.L Projekt, a 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your mind and logic skills. Controlling Elysion, a young being created in a mysterious experiment, you will face the enigmatic Watchers in a journey to escape and uncover secrets.

Armed with the powerful Sanctum Staff, Elysion can move objects and overcome obstacles, offering a unique and immersive gaming experience. Challenge yourself through 50 meticulously designed levels as you manipulate blocks, drag platforms, discover secret passages and climb ladders in rotating dioramas, with new mechanics introduced as difficulty gradually ramps up!

1736333412.title: The Last DeadEnd
1736333412.short_description: The Last Dead End is an adventure game with the elements of FPS and horror.

1736384528.title: Ben 10: Power Trip
1736384528.short_description: Evil Hex has cursed Europe – and only Ben 10 can stop him! Explore a 3D world filled with combat, puzzles and secrets as you save the day!

1736391553.title: 30 Sport Games in 1
1736391553.short_description:
Ready to win?!
"30 Sport Games in 1" is the ultimate game that brings together 30 different sports in one game! Challenge your family or friends and may the best player win!

1736409202.title: DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game
1736409202.short_description: Become an average, everyday deer and stretch your neck out a bit.

1736454335.title: Alien: Isolation
1736454335.short_description:
Discover the true meaning of fear in Alien: Isolation, a survival horror set in an atmosphere of constant dread and mortal danger.
Underpowered and underprepared, you must scavenge resources, improvise solutions and use your wits, not just to succeed in your mission, but to simply stay alive.

1736608300.title: Mine Hero 2
1736608300.short_description: Jonny needs help to recover the 10 diamonds lost inside the mine. Unravel the labyrinths and see yourself become the Hero of the mine.

1736645141.title: Hextreme Void
1736645141.short_description:
Strategically power up to clear the field as efficiently as possible in a brick breaker about quick thinking!

Are you ready for a brick breaker with a twist? In Hextreme Void, you can’t lose! Instead of lives or game overs, the challenge comes from progression and optimization in order to complete all levels within a certain time limit. Each playthrough takes you through one of five distinct Voids, with 50 levels per Void. Stages are presented in high-def 2D style with hexagonal bricks arranged in increasingly complex patterns. Your ball moves automatically, but it’s up to you to decide how released powerups are used.

As you advance, you’ll earn experience and choose between various buffs that can enhance ball stats, increase your time limit, multiply coin output and more! Every run feels unique thanks to random upgrade paths and temporary powerups that appear. During runs, collect coins to unlock permanent upgrades, letting you grow stronger and tackle harder Voids with new strategies the more you play!

1736678881.title: Bleeding Edge
1736678881.short_description: Team Up. Cause Chaos. Grab your team and tear it up in Bleeding Edge, an electrifying online brawler where every fighter comes mechanically enhanced for mayhem!

1736697479.title: Smart Moves
1736697479.short_description:
"Smart Moves" is a puzzle with a strong roguelike feel. Different worlds with levels of increasing difficulty, sneaky monsters, unexpected obstacles and great treasures await you. Smart moves are the key to survival!

"Smart moves" is a combination of puzzle and turn-based roguelike mechanics. Destroy monsters, open chests!

The hero can attack monsters when both are standing on neighboring squares. Avoid being the first at a distance of impact! The hero can't skip turns, but can use level objects - or other monsters - to “skip” the turn.

Every game level is a puzzle with its own logical solution. You have to discover and learn how objects interact with each other in the game world. You get a new playing experience where game mechanics are of maximum importance. Original art style included.

1736717494.title: Princess.Loot.Pixel.Again
1736717494.short_description: Dare to enter the Dark Tower and defeat the Evil Mage to bring back the kidnapped King and prove your worth to him. Win the Princess’s heart in a new dynamic pixelart action platformer with the elements of a rogue-lite. Prove your worth to the King and find love!

1736766216.title: Lost Lands X
1736766216.short_description:
“Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests. 

The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures.

Susan Shepard has long decided that she is done with traveling to the Lost Lands and found herself in writing. However, the recent events in the Lost Lands have decided otherwise. Susan's best friend Folnur has gone crazy and killed old Maaron! What has changed in Folnur? Who or what forced these changes? This time, Susan will have to solve a problem not of universal importance, but important for herself. Susan will again go back in time to understand the reasons for what happened. On the way, she will meet old friends who will unite into a team. However, an old enemy will appear, whom Susan will never suspect to return. All the puzzles from the past and the present will come together in this story!

- Return to the Lost Lands as Susan the Warmaiden once again!
- Unravel the mystery of the old friend's madness and help to defeat his demons!
- Visit the Halfling Fair! Perhaps you will find help in this unexpected place to solve your problems.
- Solve fun and logical, easy and difficult, fast and long puzzles to move forward in the story!
- Go back to the past again! There lies the source of the current catastrophe.

1736783596.title: Re:Touring
1736783596.short_description:
Solve interesting puzzles and uncover the history of Luoni Energy

Re:Touring is a first-person puzzle game in which you'll explore the abandoned Luoni Energy Competence Center and uncover the facility's history, navigating through a total of 26 varied levels. Using a retro-style computer, you'll create color patterns to control elements such as doors, platforms and lasers. Each mechanism is carefully introduced to make the game accessible to everyone.

1736935121.title: Cralon
1736935121.short_description: Cralon is an authentic 3d dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

1736946918.title: Cuboy Adventure
1736946918.short_description: Cuboy Adventure is an exciting and incredibly cute platformer with parkour, puzzles, action events, and bosses waiting for you! Collect stars, unlock new abilities, find secrets, and defeat all enemies!

1737110143.title: Wenjia(DEMO)
1737110143.short_description: WENJIA is a 2D platform game with puzzle-solving elements. Players can freely travel between two realms, each of them with different challenges and obstacles. Players must utilize both realms’ mechanisms to reach their final goal.

1737117169.title: Winx Club: The Magic is Back
1737117169.short_description: Winx Club: The Magic is Back captures the essence of the Winx universe, delivering an enchanting experience with a mix of magical combat and puzzle-solving. Play as all six members of the Winx Club, each with their own magical abilities.

1737192562.title: Horace
1737192562.short_description: Horace is a classic platformer that tells an emotional and surprisingly rich tale of self-discovery peppered with nostalgic popular culture references that will bring a smile to any gamer who enjoys the 8 and 16 bit era!

1737229683.title: To Bee Jazz (Windows)
1737229683.short_description: Drop the Beat, Merge the Bees, and Build the Perfect Band.

1737283260.title: Lost Twins 2 demo
1737283260.short_description:
Experience a glimpse of our exciting puzzle adventure with this demo! This preview showcases a portion of the full game, offering a taste of the challenging puzzles and immersive gameplay that awaits you. Dive in and test your skills, but remember, this is just the beginning—there's much more to discover in the complete game!

Join Ben and Abi in a charming puzzle-platformer where the world itself bends to your will. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op as you explore a whimsical landscape, solve intricate puzzles, and overcome delightful challenges on your journey to reunite and find your way back home.

1737329553.title: Total War: Warhammer III (Old Version)
1737329553.short_description: The cataclysmic conclusion to the Total War: WARHAMMER trilogy is coming. Rally your forces and step into the Realm of Chaos, a dimension of mind-bending horror where the very fate of the world will be decided. Will you conquer your Daemons… or command them?

1737338210.title: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing
1737338210.short_description: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing pits you against the world’s best surfer’s at the most exotic locations on the planet. More speed = more moves! Pump control uses the wave’s power so you can surf faster and unlock more tricks. BL Pro Surfing features 12 world famous locations from point-breaks, to beach-breaks or deep water reefs. An in-depth leader-board sports game played out over an expansive world tour, or if you prefer just cruise the open world locations. Cutting edge graphics meets hardcore physics & at times, beautifully brutal waves. Pump, smash that lip, get sooo barreled and launch airs from waves that barrel, peak, break left, right, or just foam crumble. Customize your own character to within an inch of your life, or, play as some of today’s top pros including: Yago Dora, Clay Marzo, Nathan Florence, Soli Bailey, Mahina Maeda, Vahine Fierro, Felicity Palmateer, and of course the legendary world champion, and Pro Surfing commentator Barton Lynch.

1737346272.title: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition
1737346272.short_description:
The award-winning Dungeons & Dragons RPG returns, with classic adventures for modern heroes! Dive into a rich fantasy world with 100+ hours of play, including the original campaign, expansions, and more! 

CUSTOMIZE YOUR HERO
Slink through the shadows as a deadly half-elven rogue, wield fearsome magics as a powerful gnomish sorcerer, vanquish your foes as an armor-clad dwarven paladin... whatever hero you create, incredible adventures await.

SOLO AND CO-OP GAME MODES
Play solo or team up with friends for a grand adventure in the Forgotten Realms!

CONTENT
Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition comes with an EPIC amount of free content. In addition to the original campaign and expansions, enjoy free downloads of premium adventures, plus a portrait pack to customize your heroes.

BASE GAME & EXPANSIONS
• Original Neverwinter Nights Campaign: You find yourself at the center of intrigue, betrayal, and dark magic in Neverwinter Nights. Journey through dangerous cities, monster-filled dungeons, and deep into uncharted wilderness in search of the cure for a cursed plague ravaging the city of Neverwinter.
• Shadows of Undrentide Expansion: Another adventure begins in Shadows of Undrentide! Charged by your master to recover four ancient artifacts, travel from the Silver Marches to unravel mysteries of a long-dead magical civilization.
• Hordes of the Underdark Expansion: Continue the adventure started in Shadows of Undrentide and journey into the ever-more bizarre and hostile depths of Undermountain to challenge a gathering evil.

FREE DOWNLOADABLE CONTENT
• Darkness Over Daggerford: Darkness Over Daggerford is Ossian Studios’ enhanced update to the award-winning original premium adventure. The Duke of Daggerford has been mysteriously killed, a new power has taken over the town, bandits rove the Trade Way unhindered, and mysterious things stir in a fabled ancient citadel, yet all is not as it seems.
• Pirates of the Sword Coast Premium Adventure: A swashbuckling Dungeons & Dragons journey on the high seas— experience multiple endings, cunning henchmen, and a rollicking tale of woe!
• Wyvern Crown of Cormyr Premium Adventure: You have returned to Cormyr, the land of your birth, in the hopes of rebuilding your family’s fortune. Explore the kingdom on horseback, compete in jousting tournaments, and become a knight of Cormyr!
• Kingmaker Premium Adventure: Navigate guild politics and take on a mysterious masked mage to become Lord of the Keep in the premium adventure, Kingmaker!
• ShadowGuard Premium Adventure: You are recruited into the ShadowGuard— a secret organization tasked with protecting the Empire!
• Witch’s Wake Premium Adventure: You awaken on the battlefield with no memories, but soon you are drawn into a mysterious adventure that will take you to realms where the living world collides with that of the dead.
• The Dark Ranger's Treasure: Start a mysterious adventure at the Inn of Lance.
• The Winds of Eremor: Strange winds blow your ship to a mysterious island full of adventure!
• To Heir is Human: Save a kidnapped child from the clutches of the Drow!
• Contest of Champions: Go head to head in a competitive co-op battle against other teams of heroes.
• Adventurers of Neverwinter (Portrait Pack): A whole new cast of faces to create your next hero! Customize your Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition experience with this collection of ten new character portraits.

1737411489.title: Bouncing Boxes
1737411489.short_description:
"Bouncing Boxes" is a simple party game (I think) where you take control of a robot-box created by someone using an hoverboard, a bucket and some wheels...
Your aim is to push the other boxes (why should someone build robot-boxes..?) down from the falling platforms (yeah, platforms will fall randomly, because... Why not?).

1737462111.title: Spot The Pup
1737462111.short_description: Spot The Pup is a charming hidden object adventure where you search for mischievous pups in vibrant, cozy scenes, a delightful mix of discovery, relaxation, and pure puppy joy. Perfect for dog lovers and puzzle fans alike!

1737514117.title: Reed Remastered
1737514117.short_description: It’s up to Reed to collect and recalibrate special cubes in order to reboot the world!

1737524193.title: Loop Dash (Xbox Series)
1737524193.short_description: Run automatically, master jumping and dashing, collect 3 crystals in each level, and face 30 precision stages with spikes, saws, fake platforms, and increasingly demanding challenges.

1737560181.title: Without a Dawn
1737560181.short_description: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel.

1737564745.title: Matsuro Palette
1737564745.short_description: Survive seven days with a cursed painting! Will you be able to finish her?

1737614331.title: BATSUGUN Saturn Tribute Boosted
1737614331.short_description: A PIONEER OF THE BULLET HELL GENRE BY TOAPLAN IS BACK!

1737671428.title: Reposition Defense (Windows)
1737671428.short_description:
Reposition Defense is a top-down tactical tower defense where you don't just place your troops, you actively manage their position!
Use strategy, adapt to new threats, buy resources and upgrade your army to become the kingdom's last hope!

1737711768.title: Collie Call: Farm of Tomorrow (Xbox One)
1737711768.short_description: The future of farming just got fluffier.

1737803796.title: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone Demo
1737803796.short_description: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena.

1737854273.title: Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge
1737854273.short_description: Just go Up, Down, Left or Right. Easy, is it NOT? The ultimate brain-busting challenge is back with a fully revamped version!

1737875841.title: GRIME
1737875841.short_description: Destroy... Absorb... Grow... GRIME is a methodical and unforgiving 2.5D soulslike metroidvania in which you crush your foes with living weapons that mutate form and function. Parry attacks to absorb prey, acquire their skills and empower your vessel in a world of anatomical horror and intrigue.

1737902382.title: Sacrifice For Sale
1737902382.short_description: A unique choice heavy visual novel that you won't find anywhere else! Escape your grim fate, by arguing your case... Learn about the cultists who hold you captive, dismantle the cult, manipulate them- all to not end up as their next sacrifice!

1737916926.title: Bay Breaker
1737916926.short_description:
Get ready for an addictive and visually stunning experience with Bay Breaker!
Inspired by classic gameplay, it takes you on a journey across serene seascapes.

1737926681.title: Discounty
1737926681.short_description:
Manage your own supermarket, explore the tight-knit community of Blomkest, build friendships or make enemies as you uncover the town's secrets in this cozy management sim RPG! 

Step into the quirky harbour town of Blomkest, where your aunt has entrusted you with managing its only supermarket. Design and organise your shop, manage stock levels, work the checkout, and strike trade deals. Build relationships with the charming locals, and grow your business empire while navigating community dynamics. Use every tool at your disposal to expand your business, but be mindful: rapid growth might ruffle a few feathers in this tight-knit community. Will you pursue endless profits, or find a way to benefit everyone in Blomkest?

1737947185.title: Magic Sheep (Windows)
1737947185.short_description: A Cozy Puzzle of Barrels and Marble Charms.

1737957137.title: Apocryphoid
1737957137.short_description:
In the afterlife you realize you are trapped in a cyber space as a digital spirit. Now you have to fight the digital Angel Virus to free your new dimension.

The game is a Boss Rush Bullet Hell shooter with upgrades. Fight 10 different bosses and try to defeat a secret boss for better ending!

1737975190.title: HUMANKIND™
1737975190.short_description: Discover HUMANKIND™, a Historical Strategy game where YOU will create your own civilization and re-write the entire narrative of human history. HOW FAR WILL YOU PUSH HUMANKIND?

1738097527.title: City Destruction
1738097527.short_description: Serez-vous capable de défier vos ennemis?

1738218423.title: Magnus Trilogy
1738218423.short_description: Explore the depths of the human psyche.

1738342037.title: Funny Circus HD
1738342037.short_description:
Funny Circus HD is amazing Circus Game in which you have to jump to earn coins and save yourself from fire rings and other obstacles. This Game is very addictive in nature.

Features
-HD quality of graphics used in the game.
-Jump to earn coins and save yourself from fire rings and other obstacles.
-Game Complexity increases after every second.
-Game is very addictive in nature.
-Earn More coins to have good score.

Get Ready to save yourself from fire.

1738390204.title: Rivals of Aether
1738390204.short_description: Rivals of Aether is an indie fighting game set in a world where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Play with up to four players locally or up to two players online.

1738408835.title: Splitgate (Demo)
1738408835.short_description: Splitgate is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer shooter that features player-controlled portals. This sci-fi shooter takes the FPS genre to a new dimension with its portal mechanics, delivering high-flying, multi-dimensional combat. IGN describes Splitgate as “Halo meets Portal.

1738465345.title: FoxWolf Saga (Xbox One)
1738465345.short_description: Alternate control between two contrasting heroes: a nimble Fox and a powerful Wolf. The Wolf can perform a devastating dash that destroys enemies and obstacles while granting brief invincibility, while the Fox uses agility and a double jump to reach areas the Wolf cannot.

1738477013.title: Deep Space Rush
1738477013.short_description: Join the DeTeam to help stop the virus contaminationfrom infecting everyone in the space stations!

1738493440.title: Subdivision Infinity DX
1738493440.short_description: Subdivision Infinity is an immersive and pulse pounding sci-fi space shooter featuring stunning graphics and tight spaceship game play. Hunt down and destroy enemy spacecraft, crush capital ships, mine asteroids for rare minerals, and find blueprints to craft amazing new vessels!

1738616875.title: Primal Survivors
1738616875.short_description: Get ready for the wildest and most thrilling adventure!

1738627078.title: Bananitro
1738627078.short_description:
Reach top speed by eating Bananas?!

Bananitro is a 2D runner that combines speed, action, and a unique gravity mechanic, bringing an amazing mix of monkeys and bicycles.

1738666347.title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
1738666347.short_description: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord is a full 3D remake of the first game in the legendary Wizardry series of RPGs.

1738748704.title: Pipe Dream Xbox Edition
1738748704.short_description: This 2D platform game where we manage our little character will make you feel different from the platform games you know! In this game where we progress chapter by chapter, we are trying to reach the places requested from us by using the pipes extending from the ledges or trying to catch the keys placed in certain places. As you progress, not only the distance the pipes have to travel increases, but also the pipes are in different colors and need to be placed according to the correct color design, making your game more difficult but more enjoyable! Taste the different and varied level designs and try to progress with the right strategies!

1738914043.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
1738914043.short_description:
Enter the world of feudal Japan! Unleash your inner Assassin as Naoe, a stealthy and cunning shinobi, and strike from the shadows. Or take command as Yasuke, a towering samurai, and dominate the battlefield.
Explore a stunningly realized feudal Japan, where shifting seasons and dynamic weather change your surroundings, and master the deepest stealth mechanics in Assassin’s Creed history.

1738916410.title: Railbound
1738916410.short_description: Railbound is a comfy, track-bending puzzle game about a pair of dogs on a train journey around the world.

1738930252.title: ComputerHead: Springloaded
1738930252.short_description: In ComputerHead: Springloaded, you play as Chippy, a quirky computer character bouncing through a deadly, ever-changing arena. Jumping from trampoline to trampoline, you’ll dodge spikes, fire traps, and bear traps while collecting coins to purchase upgrades and surviving as long as possible.

1739126120.title: Zorro The Chronicles Xbox Series X|S
1739126120.short_description: Play as Zorro or his sister, Ines, in this action and stealth game inspired by the animated series Zorro The Chronicles. Free the people, restore justice and mock Sergeant Garcia by signing your name with the tip of your sword!

1739308504.title: Next Space Rebels
1739308504.short_description: SPACE IS FOR EVERYONE. In Next Space Rebels, you will develop from a naive rocket hobbyist into an experienced space activist by designing, building, and launching rockets of increasing complexity.

1739313000.title: Enclave HD
1739313000.short_description: One Game. Two sides. This is Enclave HD. Fight in a dual campaign during the great war of Celenheim in this enhanced and upgraded version of the beloved medieval action combat game.

1739375565.title: Minecraft Dungeons
1739375565.short_description: Fight your way through an all-new action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe! Up to four friends can play together, or you can brave the dungeons alone. Battle new-and-nasty mobs across action-packed, treasure-stuffed, wildly varied levels, all in an epic quest to defeat the evil Arch-Illager!

1739392581.title: Dungeons of Sundaria
1739392581.short_description:
Adventure through epic dungeons facing fearsome creatures either solo or with a group of friends. Master your class, loot everything, and destroy the foul creatures of the deep! 
Will you survive long enough to become a hero of legend?

1739437181.title: Street Racer Collection (QUByte Classics)
1739437181.short_description: Street Racer is one of the most insane and fun kart racers of the 90s. Run, fight, and win! Speed and brawls on crazy tracks! A classic that mixes racing and fighting, bringing back chaotic battles and irreverent humor for up to 4 players!

1739440108.title: Bravion (XBox Series)
1739440108.short_description: Bravion is a colorful 3D platform adventure where a young hero sets out to save his kingdom from a monster invasion. Explore floating islands, defeat enemies with sword or skillful jumps, collect stars, and overcome challenging platforming obstacles on a journey to defeat the Monster King.

1739485516.title: Cyber Tank 2

1739510140.title: Bug Academy
1739510140.short_description: Bug Academy is a crazy action game in which you control a swarm of insects. Break through walls while delivering fridges, send rockets into space using chili sauce or catch ghosts with a vacuum cleaner. Finish all the lessons and pass the final exam to become Bug Academy graduate!

1739513454.title: What's Different?
1739513454.short_description: Challenge your eyes and sharpen your focus in What’s Different?, a simple, addictive visual puzzle game where you spot subtle differences between two images in either fast-paced Challenge Mode or relaxed Casual Mode.

1739606934.title: Castlevania Advance Collection
1739606934.short_description:
Count Dracula is once more back from the dead...

Join the fight against Evil in the Castlevania Advance Collection, a compilation of timeless action-exploration masterpieces!

1739622609.title: Blood West
1739622609.short_description: BLOOD WEST, sürükleyici bir gizlilik odaklı FPS oyununda tuhaf Vahşi Batı (Weird West) efsanelerini gizemli dehşetlerle (eldritch horror) bir araya getiriyor. Topraklar üzerindeki laneti kaldırıp ruhunu özgür bırakana kadar bu çorak arazilerde dolaşmaya mahkûm edilmiş bir Hortlak Silahşor (Undead Gunslinger) ol. Birbirinden farklı 3 senaryo, yetenek (perk) tabanlı karakter geliştirme sistemi ve 20 saatten fazla oynanış süresi seni bekliyor!

1739676808.title: Police Chase (Xbox One Edition)
1739676808.short_description: In Police Chase thrilling missions, powerful cars and fighting crime will be your routine! Whether it’s issuing offenders with parking and speeding tickets or thwarting terrorist plots and other crimes — only one thing counts in your job: Guarantee safety in your beat!

1739700743.title: Untitled Lobster Game
1739700743.short_description:
We had a name for this game, but we seem to have forgotten it :C 


This game was submitted for LUDUM DARE 50

You can find the submission on Ludum Dare's website! https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/50/untitled-lobster-game

Please do not use this release to rate the submission on Ludum Dare, refer to Windows first release!
Everything here should be considered post jam updates!
To play the original xbox release, please download UWP release (whenever that's uploaded) and install it over xbox Dev Mode.

1739810420.title: Beautiful Sakura: Volleyball Club 2 (Windows)
1739810420.short_description:
After walking away from volleyball, Kaito returns to the court with a burning desire to chase his dream once more.
This time, he is serious about becoming a professional player.

In Beautiful Sakura: Volleyball 2, Kaito reunites with three strong and unforgettable girls.
Michiko, his passionate longtime rival who shares his love for intense competition.
Yuuki, disciplined and sharp, who pushes him to grow stronger every morning.
And Hikari, bold and unpredictable, who turns every match into something personal.

As summer training heats up, so do emotions.
Rivalries deepen.
Feelings clash.

It is not real gambling it is only enjoyable game.

1739902381.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2026

1740004757.short_description: Dive into the fascinating world of logic puzzles, where you have to control various weapons.

Help hearts to have a date!

1740159483.title: One Word by POWGI
1740159483.short_description: The word search puzzle with a difference - there's only one word to find! Complete each series of puzzles to reveal the words that complete a quote.

1740172423.title: Totally Reliable Delivery Service
1740172423.short_description: Buckle up your back brace and fire up the delivery truck, it's time to deliver! Join up to three of your friends and haphazardly get the job done in an interactive sandbox world. Delivery attempted, that's a Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee!

1740207095.title: Cat in the Box (Xbox One)
1740207095.short_description: Cat in the Box is a charming platformer and puzzle adventure where creativity, timing, and strategy are the keys to success. Play as an adorable cat and overcome challenging levels by pushing boxes, solving puzzles, avoiding hazards, and finding the key required to unlock the exit of each stage.

1740207992.title: Andromeda Survivors
1740207992.short_description: Master the Universe and Defeat the Invasion!

1740222435.short_description: A minimalist puzzler - color the grid with squares and rectangles.

1740306988.title: Takorita Meets Fries

1740314317.title: ScooterFlow
1740314317.short_description: The world’s most realistic freestyle scooter game is finally here. Ride the skatepark, hit the streets, boost the mega ramp, fully customize your scooter & throw down all of the real life trick combinations you could dream of within this physics based scooter game.

1740333199.title: Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe
1740333199.short_description: Destroy, bounce, explode! Roll downhill with Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe, a 3D platformer all about maintaining momentum, pulling down every object, avoiding deadly obstacles, and collecting some nice shiny gems too.

1740350205.title: Strike Mission
1740350205.short_description: Strike Mission is a top-down aerial action game where you play as pilot Jake Walker on a mission to stop a global terrorist threat. Engage in intense battles, daring rescues, and sabotage operations across seven action-packed missions.

1740491486.title: Shovel Knight Dig
1740491486.short_description: Jump, slash, and dig your way down an ever-changing chasm of mystery in Shovel Knight Dig, an all-new Shovel Knight adventure!

1740517029.title: West of Dead
1740517029.short_description: Descend into the grim and gritty world of Purgatory in this fast-paced cover shooter which combines the fluidity of twin-stick controls and tactical cover usage. Dodge behind cover as you try to outgun your enemies in the unknown procedurally generated hunting grounds.

1740555255.title: Rise of the Third Power
1740555255.short_description: Rise of the Third Power is a retro-themed, console-style roleplaying game, loosely based on the political climate of Europe in the late 1930's. The story takes place in the land of Rin during the height of the Age of Sail, following the events that would lead to the greatest war in human history.

1740574784.title: Ghost Ward Surgical Strike
1740574784.short_description: Enter the darkest battlefield of World War II in Ghost Ward Surgical Strike.

1740589725.title: Saving Princess of Mars
1740589725.short_description:
Saving Princess of Mars is an stylish action platformer featuring puzzles to solve and ton of enemies to eliminate.

Our main protagonist is lumberjack Jack from Earth who surprisingly spawns on Mars where he's trying to save its princess.

Hand-Crafted levels: Each level is uniquely designed for countless methods of completion. Defeat strange Martian enemies using spontaneous approaches and eliminate them on your way to freedom.

Exceptional combat: Adapt to chaos with style: stomp enemies like you're squashing grapes at a festival, deliver kicks that would make a martial arts movie jealous, and turn every encounter into a slapstick ballet of traps and tumbles. No bullets, no mercy—just airborne justice and foot-powered fury.

Multiple controllable characters: You will be able to switch between different characters during the gameplay. All controllable characters have different abilities, but of course – our main hero is the strongest!

Unconventional Storytelling: A mysterious tale u.

1740615656.title: Carlos the Taco
1740615656.short_description:
¡Buenos días, amigo! I’m Taco Carlos, and I need your help! A gang of skeletons kidnapped my bride right from our wedding. Only you can help me save her!

Carlos is a brave taco who never gives up, even when left to die. His goal is revenge, and those skeletons will regret letting him survive!

""Taco Carlos"" is a 2D platformer set in sunny Mexico. Fight enemies, use power-ups like flavor enhancements, and uncover the mystery of the kidnapping. Carlos is armed with ketchup and mustard tubes, as well as a stylish sombrero.

Are you ready to help Carlos save his love and bring some spicy Mexican justice to those skeletons? Let’s go, amigo!

1740664406.title: Sneaky Rat
1740664406.short_description: Push mirrors, open gates, avoid the cat, and get the cheese.

1740860919.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts
1740860919.short_description: Become the ultimate assassin in the most realistic modern warfare sniping game available. Engage in an immersive single-player campaign across large, open-ended maps. Tactical thinking, stealth approach and precision in execution of long shots required.

1740970769.title: Project Starship X
1740970769.short_description: Project Starship is back with a wacky take on cosmic horror. In this rogue-lite shooter, you’ll take the role of the tentacled-yet-hip Swagthulhu as you CRASH-KILL comical abominations in flashy 16-bit style! With multi-purpose dodge mechanics and tons of crazy pick-ups, you’ll be able to crash your ship straight through the enemy and emerge unscathed. Project Starship X celebrates genre conventions by turning them upside-down!

1741064411.title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure Demo
1741064411.short_description: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure is a blend of Automation and Real Time Strategy for both the die-hard fans of the Automation genre and the Automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

1741114585.title: Hive Jump
1741114585.short_description: In the 24th century, humanity is at war with a hostile alien race. Outnumbered a million to one, mankind's only hope of survival is the J.U.M.P. Corps.

1741135504.title: American Mafia
1741135504.short_description:
THE RENT IS DUE. PAY IT IN BLOOD.
They say you can't buy time. They're wrong. You just have to pay for it in blood.
Step into the rain-soaked wingtips of Leo Vancetti — a starving Sicilian street orphan who claws his way from a stolen loaf of bread in 1920 Corleone to the throne of New York's Five Families, only to watch his empire burn from the inside out.
American Mafia: Empire of Ashes is a brutal, cinematic crime saga spanning 35 years and two continents. A ruthless tale of brotherhood, betrayal, and the slow cost of wearing the crown.

KEY FEATURES

A Three-Decade Cinematic Saga — From the sun-bleached stone alleys of 1920 Sicily, to the fog-choked canals of 1928 Venice, to the neon-soaked concrete of 1955 Manhattan. Eight handcrafted chapters. Three distinct eras. One legend.
A Story of Brothers and Bullets — Forge a bond with Vincenzo "The Shadow" Falcone in the dust of Sicily. Build an empire with him in the shadows of Prohibition New York. Watch him slide a knife between your ribs on the marble steps of your own palace. Then come back from the dead and take it all back.
Master Multiple Disciplines — Pickpocket and parkour as a 12-year-old in Corleone. Ghost across Venetian canals under sweeping searchlights. Hold a Prohibition warehouse against waves of Irish hitmen with a Tommy Gun. Break out of Sing Sing in the pouring rain. Storm a corrupt precinct to save the brother who betrayed you.
Command Your Crew — You don't fight this war alone. Call in devastating sniper strikes from Elena "The Widow" to pin down rival enforcers. Breach doors with Frankie Moretti, your fiercely loyal Tommy-gun-wielding bodyguard.
The Price of Power — Watch luxury dining halls, crystal chandeliers, and pristine marble foyers disintegrate under heavy machine-gun fire as rival families try to bury you for good. The crown is gold. The palace is glass. Everything breaks.

"Vincenzo thought the crown was made of gold. It's not. It's made of the choices we can't take back and the brothers we leave in the dirt."
The National Syndicate out of Chicago is coming to collect.
New York is a house of ghosts.
Will you defend your legacy — or build a tomb?

1741176162.title: RED DEAD RECKONING: ICE AGE
1741176162.short_description: Survive the frozen Wild West in RECKONING: Ice Age — an AAA-style open-world action survival game featuring horse riding, shooting, climbing, gliding, bow combat, flying mounts, and cinematic battles across deadly snow-covered environments.

1741183625.title: Juiced Fruit Racing Demo
1741183625.short_description: Splash and smash your friends in this juicy party kart racing game! Make and take speedy shortcuts as you compete against the sweetest competition. A wholesome and hectic racer packed with power-ups and heavy laughter. (This is a DEMO with 4 tracks available to play.).

1741206400.title: Little Nightmares III
1741206400.short_description: Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares. In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere. Face your childhood fears together with a friend in online co-op, or in solo with an AI companion.

1741237286.title: EDENGATE: The Edge of Life
1741237286.short_description: Mia Lorenson, wakes up in an abandoned hospital full of questions. What happened to her? What happened to the world? Edengate: The Edge of Life is an interactive experience reflecting on feelings of uncertainty, isolation and hope in the face of devastation.

1741300205.title: Earthion
1741300205.short_description:
Return to the genesis of 16-bit gaming with Ancient's brand new shoot 'em up, Earthion! 
With Earth's resources depleted and its environment in ruin, most of humanity has fled to Mars. But when hostile invaders launch an attack on Earth, mankind has no choice but to fight back. As environmental researcher Azusa Takanashi, you'll pilot the state-of-the-art space fighter YK-IIA and mount the most important counterattack in human history. Losing is not an option!

Featuring eight action-packed stages full of stunning visuals, frenetic gameplay, and amazing special effects—not to mention an incredible soundtrack composed by the legendary Yuzo Koshiro—Earthion will have you on the edge of your seat as you fight to save humanity's future.

1741341311.title: Shadowblade Odyssey
1741341311.short_description:
Step into the shadows and embark on a legendary adventure in Shadowblade Odyssey, a mesmerizing 2D platformer inspired by classic retro Shadow aesthetics.

Navigate a hauntingly beautiful world filled with treacherous traps and formidable foes. Dodge deadly obstacles and unleash your mastery of blades and darts to cut through enemies with precision.

But brute force isn’t the only way—master powerful shapeshifting abilities to meld into shadows, evade enemies, and uncover hidden treasures.

Use your hard-earned loot to unlock deadly new abilities, enhance your skills, and forge your own shadowy legend. Whether it's sharpening your blades, extending your shapeshifting powers, or acquiring rare and unique techniques, the choice is yours.

Shadowblade Odyssey combines intense action gameplay with stunning retro-style pixel art and an immersive soundtrack, delivering an unforgettable adventure.

Do you have what it takes to master the shadows and carve your own odyssey?

1741399345.title: Space Chef
1741399345.short_description: Hunt, cook, and deliver cosmic cuisine to become the greatest chef in the Horseshoe Nebula!

1741459509.title: Ape Out
1741459509.short_description: Ape Out is a wildly intense and colorfully stylized smash ‘em up about primal escape, rhythmic violence, and frenetic jazz. Build up nearly unstoppable momentum and use your captors as both weapons and shields to crush everyone on your procedurally generated path to freedom.

1741490588.title: Fruit Adventure (Windows 10)
1741490588.short_description: Help Super Strawberry become the bravest Fruit in the Healthy Forest!

1741578998.title: Total War: THREE KINGDOMS
1741578998.short_description:
Product Summary

Total War: THREE KINGDOMS is the first in the multi award-winning strategy series to recreate epic conflict across ancient China. Combining a gripping turn-based campaign game of empire-building, statecraft and conquest with stunning real-time battles, Total War: THREE KINGDOMS redefines the series in an age of heroes and legends.

China in 190CE
Welcome to a new era of legendary conquest.
This beautiful but fractured land calls out for a new emperor and a new way of life. Unite China under your rule, forge the next great dynasty, and build a legacy that will last through the ages.
Choose from a cast of 12 legendary Warlords and conquer the realm. Recruit heroic characters to aide your cause and dominate your enemies on military, technological, political, and economic fronts.
Will you build powerful friendships, form brotherly alliances, and earn the respect of your many foes? Or would you rather commit acts of treachery, inflict heart-wrenching betrayals, and become a master of grand political intrigue?
Your legend is yet to be written, but one thing is certain: glorious conquest awaits.

ANCIENT CHINA RECREATED
Discover Three Kingdoms China, a land of breath-taking natural beauty. Battle across lush subtropics, arid deserts and snow-capped mountains. Marvel at legendary landmarks like the Great Wall of China and the Yangtze River. Explore the length and breadth of ancient China as you restore harmony to its embattled landscape.

CHINA’S GREATEST LEGENDS
Forge a new empire as one of 12 legendary Warlords drawn from China’s celebrated historical epic, the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Peerless commanders, powerful warriors and eminent statesmen, these characters each have a unique playstyle and objectives. Recruit an epic supporting cast of heroes to command your armies, govern your provinces and strengthen your growing empire. Characters are the beating heart of the game, and China’s very future will be shaped by its champions.

GUANXI SYSTEM
Modelled on Guanxi, the Chinese concept of dynamic inter-relationships, Total War: THREE KINGDOMS takes a paradigm-shifting approach to character agency, with iconic, larger-than-life heroes and their relationships defining the future of ancient China. Each of these characters is brought to life with their own unique personality, motivations, and likes/dislikes. They also form their own deep relationships with each other, both positive and negative, that shape how your story plays out.

ARTISTIC PURITY
With stunning visuals and flamboyant Wushu combat, THREE KINGDOMS is the art of war. With beautiful UI, vibrant vistas and authentic Chinese-inspired artwork, this reimagining of ancient China is a visual feast.

REAL-TIME & TURN-BASED HARMONY
The turn-based campaign and real-time battles of Total War: THREE KINGDOMS are more interconnected than ever before. Actions in battle now have much greater consequences, affecting your Heroes’ relationship towards you, as well as the friendships and rivalries they develop with other characters. In a world where powerful allies are one of the keys to success, this adds a brand-new element to how victory is achieved.

Microsoft no longer supports Windows 10 or older versions.

1741623548.title: Under Leaves
1741623548.short_description: Relax, looking for hidden objects in a gorgeous, hand-painted scenery. Under Leaves will take you on a journey around the world where you’ll discover charming animals and beautiful landscapes.

1741728886.title: Arcade Paradise
1741728886.short_description: With keys to the family laundromat but plans for something bigger, Ashley must stay one step ahead and manage profits in order to build an Arcade Paradise!

1741878550.title: The Pathless
1741878550.short_description: From the creators of ABZÛ, The Pathless is the mythic adventure of an archer and an eagle in a vast forest. Become the Hunter, a master of archery who travels to a mystical island to dispel a curse of darkness that grips the world.

1741967313.title: Edna & Harvey: Harvey's New Eyes
1741967313.short_description: When her best friend Edna disappears under mysterious circumstances, Lilli has to rise above her own and face a tough journey to not only get her friend back but also confront her subconscious fears.

1742041321.title: Sable's Grimoire
1742041321.short_description: Survive school and romance monster girls.

1742213041.title: Go All Out
1742213041.short_description: Greatest cast of heroes and antagonists from different worlds, games, movies and even comic books have been summoned for a face-off!

1742283736.short_description:

A century after the events of Asdivine Dios, peace has finally settled in. That is, until a visitor from another world suddenly shows up proclaiming the entire universe is about to be destroyed. Hearing this, Izayoi sets off in an attempt to reverse this seemingly pronounced fate with a trio of very idiosyncratic spirits as they criss-cross four worlds in search of an answer.

1742301300.title: Ready, Steady, Ship!
1742301300.short_description: Grab a buddy for this chaotic couch co-op delight. Use various tools and equipment to assemble the most efficient conveyor belts to keep the goods flowing! Best played in 2-player couch coop.

1742334128.title: One Hand Clapping
1742334128.short_description: One Hand Clapping is a 2D platformer that invites you to sing into your microphone to solve musical puzzles and discover the power of your voice as it changes the world.

1742456195.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hitori
1742456195.short_description: "Hitori" is a puzzle in which you fill in any unnecessary numbers, making sure that the same number doesn't appear twice in the same line. Once you get the hang of it, you can feel the joy of figuring out the many various gimmicks thought up by the creator. This is a puzzle for real connoisseurs.

1742707305.title: Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator
1742707305.short_description: Dedicate your life to saving others. As soon as you receive the emergency call, speed off to the site of the accident in your ambulance, sirens wailing. Apply first aid and transport the seriously injured to hospital. Every second counts!

1742726984.title: Roar of Revenge
1742726984.short_description: An epic Barbarian quest full of fighting and fantasy!

1742870442.title: Commandos: Origins - Demo
1742870442.short_description: Cadets, “Operation Prelude“ has begun! In this demo you can explore a unique test mission, specifically tailored to let you experience the real-time tactics gameplay of the upcoming Commandos: Origins before its launch. Guide the Green Beret and the Marine on a mission to the Channel Islands and make use of some of their unique skills to sabotage a cutting-edge German radar system, responsible for a shocking surge in RAF casualties.

1742965176.title: Ruff Ghanor
1742965176.short_description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, plan your strategies, and create powerful synergies as you advance to face your destiny.

1742971944.title: Cybarian: The Time Traveling Warrior
1742971944.short_description: Drawing inspiration from old school platformers, Cybarian: The Time Travelling Warrior is an arcade title with some beat ‘em up gameplay qualities.

1742982949.title: MotoGP™24
1742982949.short_description: Rev up your engines, MotoGP™24 is back! Dive into the heart-pounding action of the 2024 season and immerse yourself in the thrills of unexplored landscapes, all thanks to the revolutionary Riders market!

1742985601.title: Into the Restless Ruins
1742985601.short_description:
Into the Restless Ruins is a roguelike deckbuilder. Use your deck of cards, representing rooms and corridors, to grow the labyrinth of the ruins. Then auto-battle your way through them, harvesting as much Glimour as you can from the cursed residents before darkness overcomes your torch. 

Earn favours from the Harvest Maiden, find Relics to trade with the Hen Wife, Wulver and other characters from Scottish folk lore to upgrade and curate your deck, and hope you are strong enough to face The Warden when you can finally reach it.

1743049130.title: Quake II
1743049130.short_description: You are humanity’s last hope to stop the Strogg, a hostile alien race waging war against Earth. Play this military sci-fi FPS, now enhanced for modern platforms and feature-complete with all-new campaign content, Quake II 64, online multiplayer and co-op support, and more.

1743082490.title: Cybo War
1743082490.short_description: Middle East was invaded by cyborgs you as a different specie of cyborg need to stop and clean Middle East by this cyborg attack. You have 24 levels to play and 4 guns to eliminate the cyborgs attacking species.

1743151630.title: Deiland: Pocket Planet
1743151630.short_description:
Deiland: Pocket Planet Edition is a relaxing farming adventure where you will have to take care of your tiny planet. Farm, craft and fight monsters to make your home a special place and help others with their quest. 

Discover the story of Arco in this single-player experience, a tale about growing up, helping others and revealing the secrets that lie on the heart of your planet. We’ve crafted a relaxing game, with a strong narrative and a cast of diverse characters for you to meet.

1743190534.title: Speed Limit
1743190534.short_description:
Fight - Die - Repeat
A thrilling genre-switching rollercoaster that will test the limits of your reflexes.

1743219650.title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
1743219650.short_description: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

1743309413.title: Super Meat Boy 3D
1743309413.short_description: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D!

1743311963.title: Sam & Max Save the World
1743311963.short_description: Sam is a six-foot canine detective with a love of justice. Max is a hyperkinetic rabbity-thing with a taste for mayhem. Together, they're the Freelance Police. And they're about to save the world.

1743325195.title: Wings of Bluestar
1743325195.short_description:
Protect space against the final wave of an enemy that was once mankind’s ally!

Blast off for a story-driven shoot’em up experience unlike any other! As mankind faces the remnants of a mysterious artificial intelligence, it’s up to trainee pilot Aya and veteran ace Zarak to investigate the resurgent threat against free space. Along the way, these defenders of peace will need to confront their past and learn more about themselves before they can uncover the truth of their enemies.

Combining elements of traditional side-scrolling arcade shoot’em ups with HD presentation, Wings of Bluestar is both familiar and modernized, accessible yet challenging. In addition to multiple ships, weapon upgrades and intense bullet hell gameplay, a deep narrative experience awaits with dialogue choices and multiple endings for both playable characters. To extend the experience even further, Wings of Bluestar features boss rush mode, training and a shop to unlock in-game rewards.

1743369061.title: Dungeon Village
1743369061.short_description: Build a heroic hamlet that warriors and merchants can call home!

1743438450.title: Goblin Gold Hunt (Xbox One)
1743438450.short_description: Play as a greedy little goblin with an oversized sack and an even bigger hunger for loot! Dash, jump, and snatch every coin, chest, and shiny treasure in sight as you chase your dream of becoming the richest goblin in the world. Fortune favors the bold—and the gold-hungry! But watch out! Taking damage or dying will make you lose coins! Try your best to reach the end with the maximum amount of coins and show to the world the your greediness know no bounds!

1743457512.title: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2
1743457512.short_description: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS™ 2 is a block-building RPG set in a fantasy land threatened by an evil cult. Explore, battle, create and harvest in the charming single-player campaign or build big projects in the online sandbox mode for up to 4-players.

1743460039.title: Wizordum
1743460039.short_description: Wizordum is a retro FPS that puts you in the role of a Mage on a quest to track down the source of Chaos. With a wide arsenal of spells and magic items, battle your way through the world of Terrabruma in this unique blend of classic 90s shooters and modern gaming elements.

1743471702.short_description:

1743565876.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
1743565876.short_description:
Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness.
