1767095703.short_description: Selma and the Wisp is an astonishing platform game with a particularly eerie feel to it. Densely packed with logical puzzles and unexpected obstacles, innovative gameplay.

1767097660.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
1767097660.short_description: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this Lovecraftian thriller.

1767224779.title: WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT - Battle War Squad
1767224779.short_description:
Rule the skies in WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT and dive into explosive aerial combat where speed, precision, and courage decide every battle! Climb into the cockpit of legendary warplanes and fight through intense solo missions across a massive island warzone filled with enemy fighters, anti-air defenses, and high-risk objectives.

Feel the thrill of high-speed dogfights as bullets tear through the clouds and engines roar across the battlefield. Perform daring aerial stunts, chase down enemy squadrons, protect allied bombers, and launch devastating attacks on hostile bases. Every mission pushes your piloting skills to the limit as the war in the skies grows more dangerous with every victory.

Features:
-Thrilling single-player air combat campaign packed with nonstop action.
-12 powerful WWII-inspired aircraft with unique flight styles and upgradeable weapons, armor, and engines.
-Action-filled mission variety including dogfights, bomber escorts, interception missions, and ground strikes.
-Dynamic weather system that changes the atmosphere and challenges every flight.
-Progressive ranking and reward system with medals, upgrades, and new combat opportunities.
-Immersive aerial battles with fast-paced gameplay and cinematic warzone environments.

Start your engines, enter the battlefield, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate ace pilot. The skies are at war — and only true legends will dominate the fight.

1767506058.title: The Dark Eye: Memoria - Demo
1767506058.short_description: In Memoria, players travel through different time periods, following two distinct protagonists: Sadja, a southern princess who wants to be a war hero, and Geron, a bird catcher who wants to lift a curse from his girlfriend.

1767641407.title: 8-Bit Selection: Arcade Replay (Xbox One)
1767641407.short_description:
This is a collection of 5 different 8-bit style arcade games.

• Guest Rush — You play as a hotel housekeeper, trying to clean rooms after customers as fast as possible.
• Mythos Dash — You play as the Hero of the Mythos, slaying deadly minotaurs and saving ladies.
• Cauldron Forager — You play as the Witch of the Forest, collecting ingredients for her potion cauldron and defending against the forest dwellers.
• Tube Repairs — You play as a plumber who goes around the tube maze and fixes potential leaks.
• Pumpkin Bloodshed — You play as the Slasher that has to defend agains the army of evil pumpkins.

1767674924.title: Persephone
1767674924.short_description: Persephone is a puzzle game that explores the following possibility: what if death isn't the end, but the key to solve puzzles? Where, when and how will you choose to die in order to progress?

1767691054.title: Fueled Up
1767691054.short_description: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!

1767764646.title: Retreat To Enen
1767764646.short_description: Base building simulator 1500 years in the future. Journey to the Island of Enen to forage, craft, build, hunt, meditate, and explore across three vast biomes. Discover secrets and create the retreat of your dreams. With over 160 unique items to gather, craft, and build, every home will be unique.

1767784807.title: THE ORIGIN: Blind Maid
1767784807.short_description:
Get ready to feel the real terror in first person! Decades after the events that generated THE ORIGIN, a corrupt politician on the run from justice takes refuge in an inhospitable region plagued by terrible legends. His assistant disappears with the car keys he needs to get out of that place. During the search for him, he will be confronted with space and time, being forced to return to the past and find the Origin of the Blind Maiden as he seeks redemption from him.

FEATURES

• 1st Person Shooter: Use your weapons only when it is essential, ammunition is very scarce. Fight only when you have no choice and flee when you can, only then can you resist until the end.
• Skill upgrade: There are special infusions that you can get from a thousand-year-old ticket vendor, giving you access to different upgrades, such as running longer without getting tired, shooting without aiming, running and shooting, or carrying more items.
• Crafting: Mix herbs and items following the instructions of an old alchemist to create temporary abilities and black magic to combat enemies.
• Enemies: The chaos produced by The Origin has created cursed beings. Some with an arboreal appearance, others accidentally created by the Alchemist and others the product of evil, called Chimeras in ancient texts.
• Varied and distorted environments: Sometimes you will have to deal with the sudden changes in environment that The Origin is capable of creating to distort your mind. Be careful when turning each corner.
• Multiple Endings and New Game +: You will have the opportunity to redeem or condemn your character with which you can unlock the different endings. Continue playing in search of the different endings recovering the acquired skills.
• EVP: Use the main character's headset (almost deaf in one ear) to listen to voices and sounds from beyond and use them to your advantage.
• Puzzles: Solving puzzles will be an important part of the action and a real challenge, some of them will be really complex, although intuitive.

1767858132.title: RemiLore: Lost Girl in the Lands of Lore
1767858132.short_description: RemiLore is a “rogue-lite” anime-style adventure set in a colorful fantasy world where players hack-and-slash their way through an army of mechanical monsters using a huge variety of unique melee weapons and devastating magic attacks!

1767909920.title: Glyphs of Gitzan
1767909920.short_description:
Explore mysterious ruins and uncover their secrets by mastering the glowing glyphs!

Glyphs of Gitzan is a block-sliding puzzle adventure spanning 50 unique stages of increasing complexity. Take the role of a young explorer and navigate levels in top-down pixel art style, pushing stone pillars across tiled floors to align them with rows of glyphs. Glowing symbols on each pillar hint at the direction its light will emanate. If you can light up all the glyphs with the pillars in each hall, you’ll be able to proceed to the next tricky chamber. Can you unlock all the secrets of Gitzan?

1767971525.title: Graveyard Girls
1767971525.short_description: When two girls meet in a graveyard on Halloween...

1767974553.title: Cozy Grove
1767974553.short_description: Welcome to Cozy Grove, a game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding new hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to Cozy Grove!

1767985039.title: NubiaPhobia (Xbox Series X|S)
1767985039.short_description: Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor. Break the witch's curse on your home as you explore five distinct regions, each hiding a sacred key to unlock the village chest.

1767988502.title: Lost Wing
1767988502.short_description: Pilot a super fast ship through brutal environments, and try to top the leaderboards! Featuring numerous challenges, ships, enemies and traps, Lost Wing is a shot of pure unadulterated adrenaline.

1767994732.title: Dragonkin: The Banished
1767994732.short_description: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your dragonets, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

1768031432.title: Car Dealer Simulator
1768031432.short_description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

1768081511.title: Crusader Kings III
1768081511.short_description: Lead a medieval dynasty through the generations, as history swirls around you. Rule a small realm or a major empire, encountering a dazzling number of characters with unique personalities and priorities in this award-winning strategy game from Paradox Interactive.

1768090935.title: Cars Jigsaw Puzzles - Real Car Puzzles
1768090935.short_description:
Jigsaw Puzzle Cars brings cool cars and traditional jigsaw puzzles to your console.
Chose between 6 different puzzle sizes and more than 50 different stylish car pictures and start completing your own jigsaw cars.

1768097848.title: Carto
1768097848.short_description: Carto is a charming adventure game wrapped around a unique, world-altering puzzle mechanic. Use this power to explore mysterious lands, help a quirky cast of characters, and guide Carto on her journey back to her family.

1768116334.title: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)
1768116334.short_description: A collection of seven retro beat 'em ups with enhanced features like rewind, cheats, screen filters, and more!

1768155647.title: Mr. T-Shirt (Windows)
1768155647.short_description: Help Mr. T-Shirt in a world of paper and doodles. Collect the key and move on to the next level, facing unique challenges in every stage!

1768176594.title: Mega Survivors
1768176594.short_description:
Mega Survivors

Survive against thousands of enemies in an endless storm of chaos!
Mega Survivors is a fast-paced 2D survival action game where you battle relentless waves of monsters across diverse biomes — from forests and deserts to icy mountains, castles, and mines. Level up, unlock new weapons, and master your skills to last as long as possible in the arena.

Key Features:

5 Weapon Types: Axe, Fireball, Iceball, Lightning, and Spike!

5 Unique Environments: Forest, Desert, Mountain, Castle & Mines.

Thousands of Enemies On Screen: Powered by optimized physics and smart object pooling for smooth performance.

Roguelike Progression: Each run offers new upgrades, abilities, and insane synergies.

Playable Heroes: Choose your survivor and dominate the battlefield with unique powers.

Only the strongest will survive.

1768207044.title: Ocean Oddities (Xbox One)
1768207044.short_description: Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot-the-difference game set in underwater worlds, where players find subtle changes among coral, sea life, and treasures. With soothing visuals and timed or stress-free modes, it delivers satisfying “I found it!” moments.

1768256893.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
1768256893.short_description: In the bustling city of Midgar, lead Cloud and his allies in their fight against the Shinra Electric Power Company in a legendary tale filled with unforgettable characters and intense battles that fuse fast-paced action with strategic commands.

1768344349.title: Mina & Michi
1768344349.short_description:
Defeat enemies through the seasons in retro 2D style!

Join Mina and her best friend Michi as they travel through the seasons of a wonderfully colorful world, solving puzzles and challenging baddies along the way. Together, they’ll uncover secrets, collect magical items and learn special abilities that allow them to reach exciting new places. Take control of Mina and Michi simultaneously, or play cooperatively with a friend!

1768345780.title: Smart Chess 3D
1768345780.short_description:
Smart Chess 3D

Smart Chess 3D brings the timeless strategy game of chess to life with immersive 3D visuals and intelligent gameplay.

Challenge a smart AI opponent, improve your strategic thinking, and enjoy a smooth, realistic chess experience designed for both beginners and advanced players. Whether you want to practice your skills or play a relaxing match, Smart Chess 3D offers a clean and enjoyable environment to sharpen your mind.

Features:

Realistic 3D chess board and pieces

Smart AI with adjustable difficulty levels

Smooth controls and intuitive gameplay

Suitable for beginners and experienced players

Classic chess experience with a modern 3D look

Think smarter. Play better.
Welcome to Smart Chess 3D.

1768466312.title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2
1768466312.short_description: Your one-way ticket out of the factory awaits….

1768499765.title: 112th Seed
1768499765.short_description: In a future where Earth has become uninhabitable and food is so scarce that most of humanity has perished, take the role of a seed that could restore hope! Make your way through the last labs constructed to cultivate a plant species capable of surviving any environment. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, grow plants and find an exit in this casual yet challenging pixel art platformer.

1768536074.title: Symphonia 𝄞
1768536074.short_description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

1768552103.title: Ninja Village
1768552103.short_description: Lead a ninja clan in the war to unify feudal Japan!

1768560755.title: Truck'n Solitaire
1768560755.short_description:
Truck'n Solitaire is a unique and addictive solitaire game that combines the classic card game with the thrill of long-haul trucking. As a truck driver, you'll hit the open road and travel through different regions, completing challenging levels along the way.

Your objective is to clear the playing field by moving all three trucks 1,000 Units. You'll also need to strategize carefully, as you'll only have a limited number of cards to complete each level.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter different challenges and obstacles, such as Speed Traps, Tiredness, Flat Tires, and Running out of fuel that affect your truck's performance. You'll need to use your special cards, such as coffee, to navigate through these challenges and reach your destination on time.

Truck'n Solitaire features stunning graphics that immerse you in the world of long-haul trucking. This game offers hours of fun and entertainment for solitaire and trucking fans alike.

So, hop in the driver's seat and get ready to hit the road in Truck'n Solitaire – the ultimate combination of strategy, skill, and trucking!

Please note:
If you do not give the app appropriate permissions you will NOT be able to access Xbox LIVE. 
Creators Collection games, such as this one, cannot contain Xbox LIVE achievements and as such can not increase your GamerScore.

1768599367.title: SpiderBoy 2
1768599367.short_description:
It is a 2D platform game. Our hero spider human mix can throw web and fly to fight alive.
Played with arrow keys or WASD and space button.
If gamepad does not work please use keyboard.

1768685788.title: Total War: Warhammer
1768685788.short_description: The critically-acclaimed Total War: WARHAMMER combines a turn-based campaign of epic empire-building with colossal and explosive real-time battles, set within the incredible world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles.

1768724703.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault Demo
1768724703.short_description: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

1768725797.title: Girls of the Tower
1768725797.short_description:
Girl squad assembled! Conquer the tower in this auto chess adventure!
In this adventure, you can recruit over 70 unique companions across 17 races and classes, including orcs, archers, assassins, dwarves, elves, mages, and more. Build your ultimate team by combining their abilities and synergy.
 
Adapt your squad’s gear, formation, and composition to counter different enemy types. Every battle requires smart strategy and careful planning.
 
Between battles, visit the town to purchase, craft, and upgrade equipment. You can also trade for profit, take on side quests, and earn valuable rewards.
 
Multiple heroines, each with their own storylines and unique branching plots, await you. Discover different narrative paths and enjoy the daily lives and interactions between the girls along the way.

1768760597.title: Touchdown Pinball
1768760597.short_description: Score some touchdowns and win the game in the most entertaining Pinball!

1768814499.title: R3z: Arcade
1768814499.short_description:
R3z: Arcade! Finally with Audio SFX! 
My first game! In this game there's 4 different Modes! Maze, Zombies, Builder and Custom Levels! 
There's new things coming to these modes almost every Update with the chance for a new mode!

The Maze currently has 2 levels and will hold more Collectable Items later on...

Zombies has, well, Zombies! 
You have a weapon that can help to defend yourself against them.
They can see and hear you now... Are you sneaky?

The Builder allows you to build your own Levels but you currently can't share them with the world!

Custom Levels! Once you build your own level you can play in it! But, you can't play other people's levels yet... Hopefully that'll change soon!

All Feedback is Appreciated!

Please report any issues, bugs, etc. you find to R3z Shark!

What's Next in future updates?
A sledgehammer?
Maze and Builder objects like Traps and Destructible walls!
An Automatic Rifle to help clear Zombies!
Limited Ammunition.
Ammo Pickups.
Pixelated Shader collectable? (Retro style?)
A Special Sword! (Working on it...)
Sounds! The Game needs SOUNDS!
A color picker for Builder Objects, the Player and Player Items.

1768842875.title: Paper Pixel (Xbox Series)
1768842875.short_description: Paper Pixel is a pixel art platformer that blends classic action with modern mechanics.

1768951778.title: Super Dirt Racers
1768951778.short_description: Drive through water and over bumps and dips. Pick up nitro boosts along the way but use them carefully to beat your rivals. Unlock new cars and tracks by competing in leagues.

1768975758.title: Book It! (Xbox One)
1768975758.short_description:
Shiiiii… it’s time to organize the library! 📚

Step into the role of a stylish librarian in a puzzle game inspired by classic box-pushing games. Your mission is simple: push and organize books into the correct places on the tables while solving carefully crafted challenges in every level.

Explore 30 unique levels, spread across 2 distinct library environments, each bringing new layouts and challenges to test your logic and planning skills.

But remember: in a library, the most important thing is to keep quiet…

“Shiiii…” 🤫

Features
📚 Puzzle gameplay inspired by classics
🧠 30 levels
🏛️ 2 different library themes
🌙 Relaxing experience focused on logic and organization.

1768994193.title: Summer Seaside Search
1768994193.short_description: Relax on sunny shores while testing your eye for detail in Summer Seaside Search, a charming spot the difference adventure filled with vibrant beach scenes, hidden surprises, timed challenges, and cozy stress free gameplay perfect for quick breaks or laid back sessions.

1769121996.title: River City Girls 2
1769121996.short_description: The River City Girls are back! Misako, Kyoko, Kunio, and Riki - joined by newcomers Marian and Provie - hit the streets for an all-new beat-'em-up adventure! Team up for local or online co-op and explore a massive world packed with new abilities, enemies, locations, and more!

1769141283.title: Action SuperCross
1769141283.short_description:
The grandfather of all physics-based motorbike simulation games. With Xbox-exclusive content!
This retro gem is the predecessor of Elasto Mania, a truly unique and challenging experience.
Try this piece of gaming history yourself!

1769198913.title: Devoured by Darkness
1769198913.short_description: A nerve-wracking walk into the wilds of the unknown.

1769201615.title: Bioprototype
1769201615.short_description:
Bioprototype, a Roguelike & Skill Customizing Rhapsody!
This is an auto-bomber with programming elements. Customize your character skills with visual programming, utilize enemy organs to finish the mutation, and construct the ultimate prototype, one can survive in the endless wave of flesh. 
• Set your own skill trigger logics
• More builds: Bullet Master, Flesh Army, Virus Master, and more
• 24 unique characters with different skills
• 80+ organs with different functions
— Unlock unlimited combos universe
• Wild bullet storms
• Battlegrounds crawling with spores and offspring
• Venom is spreading everywhere
It’s not just a combat – create art with your organs!

1769300522.title: Last Stop
1769300522.short_description: Last Stop is a single-player third-person adventure set in present day London, where you play as three separate characters whose worlds collide in the midst of a supernatural crisis. An anthology drama, Last Stop is three stories in one.

1769444102.title: Awakening the Charge (Xbox One)
1769444102.short_description: Awakening the Charge is a colorful puzzle platformer with action elements. In this game you play as a small robot that, with the help of a charge, uses different mechanisms and destroys enemies. Improve your abilities with microcircuits, defeat big bosses, solve interesting puzzles. Immerse yourself in the world of robots and try to figure out what caused the massive failure in it.

1769451351.title: Gabriels Worlds The Adventure
1769451351.short_description: Help Gabriel find out what happened to his friends, explore levels with a high degree of difficulty, puzzles, collectibles and a beautiful story, in a precision platform game focused on exploration.

1769452181.title: Punchman
1769452181.short_description: Punchman is a simple 1 versus 1 fighting platforming game featuring a set of different characters, power ups, and levels.

1769463086.title: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol
1769463086.short_description: Step into the high-pressure world of international airport security, where every passenger and suitcase could hide a dangerous secret. In this immersive first-person simulator, you play as a border control officer responsible for stopping illegal trafficking, forged documents, and hidden contraband. Inspect passports, search luggage, scan cargo, and interrogate suspicious travelers as you uncover complex smuggling operations. Criminals will use hidden compartments, fake identities, and disguised illegal goods to avoid detection — it’s your job to spot the clues and protect the airport. Features: - Missions and Investigations: Search passengers, inspect luggage, interrogate suspects, and uncover hidden contraband across the airport. - Advanced Equipment: Use scanners, metal detectors, night vision cameras, and police dogs to detect illegal goods. - Character Progression: Level up your officer, unlock new skills, and gain access to better equipment and tougher missions. - Hidden Contraband: Discover drugs, weapons, counterfeit documents, smuggled animals, and more hidden in clever locations. - Dynamic Gameplay: Face increasing difficulty, make quick decisions, and complete high-pressure airport security operations. Stay alert. Trust no one. Protect the border.

1769494556.title: Metal Mind Demo
1769494556.short_description: We fuse transforming Mecha and Roguelite gameplay elements and combine game mechanics, such as weight, armor pieces, heat, and power for you to forge a unique weapon of war to fuel your killing spree!

1769592885.title: GUNDAM EVOLUTION
1769592885.short_description: An online first-person shooter based on characters from the popular Gundam anime series.

1769629692.title: Farm Builder
1769629692.short_description: Construct farms, roads and surround windmills and water-towers in order to score points.

1769691534.title: Tardy
1769691534.short_description: Tardy is a story driven space adventure about war, emotions, love and passion for old computer devices….

1769729445.title: Dice A Million
1769729445.short_description:
You like big numbers? Sure, got you covered.
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.
Will you be able to push luck to your side?

The game is called "Dice A Million" but dice alone won't get you anywhere far. Gear up your hand with more than 80 unique rings with that will act as your passive items. They're always active and trigger wacky effects in your dice. Get a bunch of them and you'll be hitting those dopamine receptors sooner than later!

And most importantly...
Break the game (It is one of those).

1769772134.title: Wargroove 2
1769772134.short_description: Trouble stirs on the shores of Aurania. An ambitious new faction has unearthed forbidden relics capable of catastrophic consequences. But how far will they go to achieve glory? Take to the battlefield, sea, and sky with a cast of new Commanders, using your wits to wage turn-based war!

1769809772.title: Royal Tower Defense
1769809772.short_description:
Lands of orcs have expanded in the last few decades and defined new borders. New borders which are dangerously close to us...

They depleted resources on theirs lands and it's only a matter of time before they try to put their hands on our Kingdom. Diplomats were already send to peacefully ask orcs to back off, but they’ve never returned. The sign was clear - there is no place for negotiations….

1769840508.title: The House of Da Vinci 3
1769840508.short_description:
The grand finale to The House of Da Vinci trilogy is here! Solve numerous new puzzles and mind benders and explore new mystifying locations of ravishing beauty. Use your wits and observational skills to escape rooms and solve the mysterious story behind one of the world’s most prolific inventors in history.

With sharp wits and an open mind, you will prevail.

1769849495.title: Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin
1769849495.short_description:
Prove your worth as a village hero by rebuilding a tavern, taking on quests and discovering romance along the way!

Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin is a yaoi-themed fantasy adventure visual novel where you can manage your daily routine, travel the land, accept side quests, pursue 3 possible romance options, discover 6 unique endings and unlock special CG scenes as you progress. The experience can be further customized by choosing from difficulty settings focused on story or gameplay challenge!

1769927360.title: Aery - Calm Mind 4
1769927360.short_description:
Aery - Calm Mind 4 is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. 
 You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

1769952074.title: RoboHero (Xbox One)
1769952074.short_description: Classic sokoban with a twist and a sci-fi theme! A scientific organization sends a robot-expeditor developed on artificial intelligence to the newly discovered exoplanet Xeran, on which, most likely, there are very valuable resources for humanity.

1769971395.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
1769971395.short_description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress - so she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

1769984530.title: Let Them Come: Onslaught Demo
1769984530.short_description: Battle alien swarms and build your loadout in this fast-paced roguelite shooter. Try the free demo of Let Them Come: Onslaught and experience explosive weapon upgrades, intense bullet heaven combat, and retro sci-fi action. Survive, upgrade, and unleash hell!

1770044397.title: Stylist Girl
1770044397.short_description: Dress up famous models and VIP celebrities to bring out their best looks with fabulous makeovers!

1770046472.title: Horatio Goes Snowboarding
1770046472.short_description:
Hire a board, get to the chopper and hit the slopes for endlessly replayable snowboarding action!

Paying homage to classic skiing and winter sports action of the past, Horation Goes Snowboarding is an arcade-inspired experience that’s straightforward and addictive, purely focused on thrilling gameplay without a story or complex mechanics to weigh it down! Start every run with a bunch of money and the urge to snowboard, then hire a board and head to the waiting chopper while avoiding traffic along the way. Once you’re airlifted the top of a mountain, it’s time to start your chaotic descent!

Courses are randomly generated to keep things interesting every time you play, and obstacles get increasingly tricky as you progress! Move your board left and right as you plunge downhill, racking up points by going through slalom gates and adding to your score multiplier as long as you don’t miss any. But watch out for the yeti! If you wipe out on the slopes, you’ll have to pay hospital fees, and running out of money means game over. It’s an endless cycle of snowy score attack fun, topped off with leaderboards to prove you’re the raddest boarder on the mountains!

1770092694.title: Going Under
1770092694.short_description: Going Under is a satirical dungeon crawler about exploring the cursed ruins of failed tech startups. As an unpaid intern in the dystopian city of Neo-Cascadia, you’ll wield office junk as weaponry as you make your way through the offbeat procedural dungeons beneath your company campus.

1770110484.title: EMPULSE (Game Preview)
1770110484.short_description: This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. EMPULSE is an upcoming fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter.

1770151400.title: Antiquia Lost
1770151400.short_description: An authentic RPG of a journey with a girl made of slime! Enjoy fluid 2D turn-based battles!

1770175851.title: Block Zombies!
1770175851.short_description:
In a world gone wrong, one girl stands alone. Alone, but not unarmed!

Strange crystalline structures have turned people into mindless, zombie-like creatures. Fight the Zombies! Stop the Infection! Save the Day!

Explore a variety of environments while blowing zombies into blocky bits. Find new weapons and upgrade them, from pistol and shotgun to flamethrower and RPG. Make use of flares, grenades and mines to destroy the horde.

1770237856.title: MEOW AND THE DIAMOND JUMP (XBOX SERIES)
1770237856.short_description: A casual, simple platformer with 40 short levels and infinite lives.

1770238303.title: Smart Moves 2 (for Windows 10)
1770238303.short_description:
"Smart Moves 2" is a pixel-art puzzle game with turn-based combat mechanics.

Each game level is a puzzle with its own logical solution. To move to a new level, you need to open all the chests. The hero is chased by monsters, they either wait in hide, or immediately attack him with his first step. There are some new worlds added in SM2 with new enemies: gnolls, bandits, predatory flowers, bloodthirsty slimes.

The hero defeats a monster when strike the enemy on the next square. Avoid being the first one within striking distance of the enemy! To stop hero moving and "skip" turn, the hero can smash some objects or destroy monsters. You can also use the portal.

From the very first levels you learn step by step how objects interact with each other in the game world. Success will be guaranteed!

1770279838.title: BOUNCY BREAD (XBOX SERIES)

1770956743.short_description: Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. This Demo version allows you to play the Beta Test chapter. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the full version.

1770956810.title: Aery - The King's Messenger
1770956810.short_description: In the story-driven flight exploration game Aery – The King’s Messeger you play as a little bird who flies through a medieval fantasy world on its quest to find to help the humans and scout the land for an potential attack of the evil kingdom. 1771398589.title: 911 The Police
1771398589.short_description: you take control of a police car. Patrol the city streets, experience the thrill of being behind the wheel of a law enforcement vehicle. Navigate through challenges and keep the peace in this exciting police adventure!

1771426972.title: Duck Run (Windows)
1771426972.short_description: Can you overcome the traps and lead the duck to its goal?

1771471711.title: Ashes of the Singularity: Escalation
1771471711.short_description: A massive-scale real-time strategy game where you command entire armies on a dynamic battlefield. Conquer multiple worlds across several single-player campaigns; or play with your friends in multiplayer combat.

1771555773.title: Santa's Winter Wonders
1771555773.short_description: Step into Santa’s Winter Wonders, a cozy spot-the-difference game with warm watercolor art. Each level hides 10 clever differences in festive scenes. Perfect for holiday puzzle lovers.

1771581366.title: Croc Legend of the Gobbos
1771581366.short_description:
Croc’s back and he’s still got the moves!

Croc Legend of the Gobbos is the heartwarming journey of an endearing, humble little crocodile equipped with only his iconic backpack and a wiggly butt as he platforms his way across a series of unique worlds by running, jumping, climbing, swimming and tail spinning on his quest to rescue his adopted family of Gobbos from the grasp of the evil sorcerer Baron Dante and his impish Dantini hordes.

With its broad appeal and groundbreaking creativity, the original game quickly became a multi-million selling platforming classic, and while the Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster delivers an authentic gameplay experience that transports players back to the golden age of gaming, it also introduces a roster of modern updates including enhanced HD graphics, modern control mechanics with an updated camera, and retro video modes to recreate the gaming experience that charmed us in the 1990s.

Dive into a beautifully recreated world filled with vibrant colors, captivating landscapes, and playful challenges which will ignite your imagination. The Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster offers an authentic blend of nostalgia and modern gameplay, ensuring a gaming experience that pays homage to the original while inviting a new generation to discover its timeless magic.

The game features 45 levels packed with enemies and bosses, spread across 5 different worlds including volcanoes, ice glaciers, underwater caves and even more…

The Crocipedia

With the cooperation of many of the original team members, Argonaut Games spent over a year tracking down a treasure trove of long-lost development materials in order to create a painstakingly curated digital museum featuring concept character and level designs, animation tests, game design documents, rare promotional merchandise, pre-release mixes of the iconic Croc soundtrack, and also created a series of documentary interviews with many of the contributors to Croc’s development. The Crocipedia is the perfect way for superfans and game historians alike to take a deep dive into the creative process behind the game and uncover the stories that helped shape Croc's journey to become a gaming Legend.

1771607527.title: Dogurai
1771607527.short_description: Play as Bones, a samurai dog with plenty of moves familiar to platforming fans! Perform double jumps, slice bullets in half and finish off enemies with special combos!

1771626735.title: Terminal 81
1771626735.short_description:
Mystery and psychological horror game with retro visual aesthetics

Terminal 81 is an indie job simulation, mystery, and psychological horror game with retro visual aesthetics. The game takes place in 2008, in a fictitious neighborhood in the city of São Paulo, in Brazil.

As a result of the global financial crisis of 2008, Lorena made the decision to emigrate to the large and wealthy city of São Paulo in order to find work to help her family. Lorena easily managed to get a job in a supermarket, what she did not know is that the neighborhood where she would work was Terminal 81, an old industrial neighborhood plagued by poverty, crime, and filth.

1771664199.title: ACA NEOGEO PLEASURE GOAL： 5 ON 5 MINI SOCCER for Windows
1771664199.short_description:
PLEASURE GOAL: 5 ON 5 MINI SOCCER is a soccer game released by SNK in 1996. 
Face off with various teams from around the world, make it through the prelims, get to the finals, and go for the gold in the SAURUS CUP! A fast paced experience unique to Futsal! Use the trick play button to perform jaw-dropping plays and defeat your opponents!

1771752301.title: Celestial Fall
1771752301.short_description: Experience a unique combination of a third-person platformer and a light-hearted exploration game with an almost philosophical story-telling. It is highly stylized and surprises with breathtaking environments, a surreal world full of beauty and grace, and a lot more….

1771770355.title: The Forgotten City
1771770355.short_description: Travel 2,000 years into the past and relive the final days of a cursed Roman city, where if one person sins, everyone dies. Unravel the mystery at the city’s heart by exploiting its deadly time loop, questioning locals, exploring, and solving puzzles.

1771831512.title: Manic Mechanics
1771831512.short_description: In Manic Mechanics, up to four players pull on their overalls and head to the auto-obsessed Octane Isle, looking to make a name for themselves as travelling mechanics. 1771895153.title: Faircroft's Antiques: The Forbidden Crypt Collector's Edition
1771895153.short_description:
When an old friend requests Mia’s help restoring an old cathedral, she packs her bags for the seaside town of Porto Nacosti, Italy!

1772059556.title: Ballotron
1772059556.short_description:

1772159983.title: Catie in MeowmeowLand

1772239384.title: Caligo (Xbox Series X|S)
1772239384.short_description:
Caligo is a small atmospheric walking simulator. It's an interactive story where you mainly have to look and listen.

Caligo is the darkness everyone descends into one way or another, and to each of us it's something different. For some it's a short but exciting adventure, some will see it as a place to relax. Yet others will be reminded of their worst nightmare, while for a few, it might come as a revelation. One thing is certain however: everyone will have to answer one big question.

1772304991.title: Super Star Blast
1772304991.short_description: Super Star Blast is a space shooter with challenging levels of increasing difficulty.

1772335526.title: Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey (Xbox One)

1772361619.title: Carrot Crusade - Mimika's Reckoning (Windows)

Armed with her trusty Carrot Blade and enchanted Carrot Arrows, Mimika must leap, slash, and shoot her way through treacherous lands teeming with corrupted beasts, ancient traps, and dark guardians. 1773001173.title: My Horse: Bonded Spirits
1773001173.short_description:
Your story:
Begin your adventure as the reluctant future heir of a stud farm. Prove that you are more than just a spoiled brat. Start from scratch and learn how to keep and manage a stud farm; it will be a challenge that will prove incredibly rewarding – return the stud farm to its former glory! Along your journey, discover that nothing is as lasting as the bond with your horses!

Manage your stud farm and return it to its former glory!
Your stud farm is not in a good shape – your job is to rebuild it, which will require quite a bit of skill and knowledge about keeping a stud farm. Develop your skills and gain knowledge to bring the farm up to scratch and learn how to maintain it. Manage your employees and other horses. Watch the stud farm transform from a ruin into a home for you and your horses.

Your horse isn’t the only friend you can make!
Saddle up and explore the idyllic open world of Chestnut Glen and its surrounding landscape. Help rebuild the run-down stud farm by trotting around and meeting the village’s residents – hang out with them and complete tasks for them to improve your and the stud farm’s reputation. 1773184662.title: Supermarket CEO Simulator
1773184662.short_description: Supermarket CEO Simulator – Build your retail empire and become the market leader! Take charge of your own business and turn a small store into a thriving supermarket chain! In Supermarket CEO Simulator, you have full control over every aspect of supermarket management – from stocking shelves and hiring staff to marketing, logistics, and expanding your business. The competition is fierce, and customers have high expectations – do you have what it takes to become a retail mogul? Key Features: Strategy & pricing – Adjust prices based on demand, analyze trends, run promotions, and maximize profits while staying ahead of the competition. Team management – Hire and manage staff across all departments, set salaries, improve efficiency, and maintain top-tier customer service. Do you have the courage to build a supermarket empire and become the most powerful CEO in the industry? In Supermarket CEO Simulator, success is in your hands!

1773258938.title: The Last Shot Arcades (Xbox Series X|S)
1773258938.short_description: Arcade machines in the universe of The Last Shot! 1773295066.title: PO'ed: Definitive Edition

1773338848.title: Survivor Legion
1773338848.short_description:
Unlock more classes, recruit more allies, and build your survivor legion!

• Multi-Character Team Battles
 Each character has unique skills and attributes, allowing flexible combinations based on combat needs. Whether you prefer powerful melee warriors or spell-casting mages, you’ll always find a role that suits your playstyle.

• Flexible Formation Switching
 Choose to gather your team into a circular formation to boost attack power, or spread them out in a line to increase speed. With simple switching controls, you can react quickly to the ever-changing battlefield and unleash your team’s full potential.

• Diverse Build Paths
 Different playstyles complement each other, enabling a wide variety of combat strategies. Explore countless possibilities, discover hidden combos and optimal builds, and let your heroes unleash their unique power and style in battle.

• Fast-Paced Combat
 A quick and rhythmic combat system makes every strike feel impactful. Combined with smooth animations and dazzling skill effects, it delivers an addictive fast-paced fighting experience.

1773422432.title: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol.1
1773422432.short_description: Eight legendary shmups, one explosive bundle. The Toaplan Shooting Collection Vol. 1 truly puts the blast in "blast from the past"!

1773431897.title: Yakuza 6: The Song of Life
1773431897.short_description:
How far would you go for family? Step into Japan's criminal underworld with fists swinging in this explosive action brawler starring legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu, who is hellbent on uncovering the truth behind a tragic accident that left his daughter comatose.

Master bone-breaking combos, customize your combat abilities, and indulge in all the vices that Tokyo's red light district of Kamurocho has to offer in the emotional conclusion of Kazuma Kiryu's saga.

1773544303.title: Beautiful Sakura: Running Club (Windows)
1773544303.short_description:
Beautiful Sakure: Running Club is a continuation of Kaito's journey, where he embarks on a new hobby. 

This visual novel delves into themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery.

Kaito's new passion for running leads him to join a local running club, where he reunites with familiar faces from his past and meets intriguing new characters. 



As he navigates the challenges of training and competition, Kaito finds himself caught up in another adventure, balancing the complexities of old friendships with the excitement of new connections.

Players will once again step into Kaito's shoes, guiding him through the ups and downs of his new life, where every run brings him closer to understanding himself and those around him.

1773577153.title: Smittys Patrol (Game Preview)
1773577153.short_description:
This game is still under development. It is subject to change before its release as a finished product. Please purchase only if you are comfortable with the game in its current state.

The life of Dave the taxi driver series brings you Smittys Patrol. Officer Smitty is back and ready to clean the streets and to protect the city and citizens of Bloomsburgh.

As Officer Smitty you will have weapons, items, and more at your disposal to help him achieve his goal of being the number one top flight super cop of the world!

1773632861.title: Canine
1773632861.short_description:

If you enjoy pure horror games, tension without weapons, and a retro atmosphere filled with stealth and suspense, CANINE delivers a claustrophobic, emotional, and highly replayable journey thanks to its multiple endings and hardcore mode. Try to save Tomy — without losing yourself along the way!

1773704351.title: Marble It Up! Ultra - Demo
1773704351.short_description: Roll, bounce, boost, and blast your way to victory in Marble It Up! Ultra - the ultimate marble platformer. Chase the records of your friends and the world's best players through a vast campaign - or face them head-on in thrilling multiplayer mayhem. Get ready to roll!

1773723817.title: Maiden Cops
1773723817.short_description:
Save the city from gangs of monster girls in classic side-scrolling beat ’em up style!

When Maiden City faces the fury of a secret criminal organization called "The Liberators" seeking to control the city and its inhabitants through violence, fear, and chaos, it’s up to the Maiden Cops to bring the crackdown! Join Priscilla, Nina, and Meiga as they fight to eradicate crime and restore peace and justice!

Pick a policewoman and take to the streets against buxom gangs, unlock special skins to customize your fighter, pick up gimmick weapons, chase high scores with combo chain bonuses and lay down the law using each character’s unique skills.

1774362586.title: The Backrooms 1998
1774362586.short_description: The Backrooms 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game telling the story of a young teen who fell into the depths of the Backrooms. Roam freely, mark, explore and try to unravel the story - however, don't scream.

1774402119.title: The Green Light

One late night, a mysterious voice on the radio tells him that a distant green light promises the peace and freedom he has been searching for. With nothing left to lose, Fred sets out on a journey into the darkness, where he must confront the depths of his own mind. Discover a story of self-discovery and decide whether freedom is worth the ultimate sacrifice.

1774418059.title: Suika Monsters (Xbox Series)
1774418059.short_description: Embark on this addictive adventure inspired by the Suika Game style, where you combine different Monsters to unlock new and surprising evolutions!

1774500212.title: Shantae: Risky's Revenge - Director's Cut
1774500212.short_description: Shantae: Risky’s Revenge – Director’s Cut is a powder keg of high octane, hair-whipping, hip shaking action! Guide Half-Genie Shantae through burning deserts, enchanted forests, dripping caverns and deadly labyrinths. Discover magical attacks, brew zombie coffee, save golden babies, and master the art of belly-dancing to transform Shantae into more powerful creatures. Use your powers to foil the lady pirate Risky Boots and save Sequin Land from certain doom! With its infectious characters, flirtatious humor, and deliciously outlandish action, Shantae: Risky’s Revenge offers up all the hair-whipping, belly-dancing action you can handle! 1775896577.title: Kitsune Kaeru (Xbox One)
1775896577.short_description:
Embark on a spiritual journey through a world where ink, boxes, and precision come together.

In a land inspired by traditional Japanese sumi-e art, you play as a small Kyubi who loves cardboard boxes. Use your spiritual powers to create boxes and reshape the environment to your advantage: build platforms, reach impossible places, and find the path to the portals connecting each challenge.

But there’s a catch: the fewer boxes you use, the greater your mastery.

Blending precision platforming with clever puzzles, the game features over 30 levels, each offering multiple ways to solve them. Carefully plan your moves while facing deadly spikes, deep chasms, and powerful winds that can completely change your strategy.

With an art direction that combines pixel art and sumi-e brush strokes, every stage feels like a living painting in motion.

Features
Create magical boxes to solve puzzles and explore the world
Easy to learn, hard to master mechanics
Precision platforming focused on skill and creativity
Efficiency system: use fewer boxes to achieve the highest rank

Discover the balance between strategy, precision, and creativity in a charming and challenging adventure.

1775967989.title: Surviving Mars
1775967989.short_description:

Build domes and infrastructure, research new possibilities and utilize drones to maintain your colonies functions. Cultivate your own food, mine minerals or just relax by the bar after a day’s work. Most important of all, keep your colonists alive.

Are you ready? Mars is waiting for you.

1776085745.title: Fruitbus
1776085745.short_description: A journey of flavors and friendships awaits you in your cozy, customisable food truck! Forage for fresh ingredients to create your own menu, then feed tummies and souls with home-cooked meals. Change the world, one apple at a time.

1776284292.title: Beyond Words
1776284292.short_description: From the creators of GoldenEye & TimeSplitters comes Beyond Words the genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting. Build powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and master a challenge where victory is spelled one letter at a time.

1776411413.title: Aero Darts
1776411413.short_description: Master precision and timing in AERO DARTS! Challenge the AI in a realistic 3D 301 dart experience with skill-based power control and multi-input support.

1776434181.title: Marine Survivors (Xbox Series)
1776434181.short_description: Dive into the depths as a mystical whale in this spellbinding twist on the survivors genre! Marine Survivors throws you into an underwater arena where ancient magic meets endless action. Cast powerful spells against waves of deep-sea foes as you grow stronger with each run. Choose your path wisely - each level-up presents new magical abilities that can make or break your survival strategy.

1776470461.title: GIGASWORD Demo
1776470461.short_description: Balance the weight of the GIGASWORD, battling between brain and brawn. Solve intricate puzzles, discover covert chambers, and slash through foes as Ezra fights to reach the top of the Nestrium and recover the God Crystal within. 1776510235.title: Pretty Princess Coloring Book
1776510235.short_description:
Let your young artist color in these enchanting princesses and heroines from here favorite stories and she will enter a world of beauty and magic.

Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

1776537169.title: NINJA GAIDEN Σ2

1776549840.title: Pizza Possum

1776631909.title: Chinatown Detective Agency

1777058720.title: Yakuza 5 Remastered
1777058720.short_description:
Experience the fifth chapter of the Kazuma Kiryu saga in 1080p and 60fps.

1777122764.title: Cavity Busters
