1777228920.title: Super Woden GP II
1777228920.short_description:
Experience a love letter to the world of motorsports as you climb the ranks and collect your dream cars!

Get ready to climb your way to the top of the motor sports world! Super Woden GP II is a love letter to the sport and arcade racing games of the ’90s. Compete in a wide variety of event types, from rally to endurance racing, in classic isometric style, using an intuitive central map interface to buy and tune vehicles, explore circuits across the world, visit your garage and more.

Obtain more than 180 vehicles from 9 car manufacturers using the credits you earn in racing events and unlock secret cars through skillful play. Race solo, challenge other players’ records or enjoy split-screen local multiplayer for up to 4 drivers!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.

1777243206.title: Lost Judgment
1777243206.short_description:
SEIZE THE TRUTH

When a convicted police officer reveals the location of a murder victim, Private Detective Yagami is called to revisit an impossible case of two crimes committed at once. But as more victims pile up and Yagami unravels the truth, will the scales of justice tip in favor of defending the law or enacting vengeance? 

From the studio that brought you the Yakuza series, Lost Judgment weaves elements of investigative sleuthing, noir narrative and action combat into one mystery thriller. Take your detective expertise to the streets of Japan and defend those that the law fails to protect. 
 
INVESTIGATIVE ACTION 
Tap into Yagami’s arsenal of private eye tricks to gather clues. From hi-tech gadgets including drones and social media listening devices to hardboiled gumshoe methods like scaling buildings and tracking suspects in the city. No stronger evidence than catching a suspect in the act. 

FREEFORM COMBAT 
Master Yagami’s three unique, combo-heavy martial arts styles to overcome any situation from group ambushes to single-target takedowns. Further weaponize street fights with traffic cones, street signs, bicycles and beyond, plus customize each style with skill trees. 

DEEP UNDERCOVER
Go undercover at a local high school as a club advisor to get to the root of a mysterious rise in delinquency as it relates to the case. Join the Dance Club, where you’ll be grooving to the rhythm; the Robotics Club, tasking your ingenuity to build the ultimate Yagami-bot; a boxing gym, to stick and move against fierce opponents; and a bike gang, where underground racing is the only way to earn respect. 

HIT THE STREETS 
As you comb the open cities of Kamurocho and Ijincho in pursuit of the case, take a break and get to know the unique culture of each through bars and other nightlife hotspots. It may be worth taking on a Side Case to lend your detective skills to residents in need – you never know who holds what cards.

1777264343.title: Dark Dungeon Mind Mess (Xbox Series)
1777264343.short_description:
As soon as the Knight takes his first step, darkness swallows his surroundings. Be brave, o Knight, and traverse the Dark Dungeon! Make your way into the light!

Dark Dungeon Mind Mess is a unique 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your memory and intuition. Grasp the layout of the level at the start, because as soon as you make your first move, almost the whole path ahead will turn pitch black!

Play through 50 mind-boggling dungeon rooms where you'll have to reach the end while navigating in the dark. The shadows hold even more danger: spike traps, falling blocks and pits that the Knight can jump over! Make sure to grab keys along the way to open locked doors and progress forward.

- Puzzle game designed to be fun for all ages
- Simple controls so you can focus on the puzzle: only directional inputs and a jump button
- Cozy low poly 3D graphics with gloomy aesthetics
- Atmospheric soundtrack for the right mood
- A particular puzzle is too difficult? You can skip it to keep the game going.

1777299042.title: Endless Fables: Shadow Within
1777299042.short_description: Famous anthropologist Pamela Cavendish goes back to her hometown to face a tragedy from her childhood. When her friend - Hans - was kidnapped by a nightmarish figure no one believed her. Years later, brave and steadfast, Pamela has a chance to make things right.

1777341064.title: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition
1777341064.short_description: The Outer Worlds: Spacer’s Choice Edition is the ultimate way to play the award-winning RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. Including the base game and all DLC, this remastered masterpiece is the absolute best version of The Outer Worlds.

1777345011.title: Neon Inferno
1777345011.short_description: NYC 2055: a city beyond salvation. Blast your way through this dense cyberpunk jungle in NEON INFERNO--an explosive fusion of 2D run-and-gun and gallery-shooter--and help the Family dominate the streets!

1777388058.title: Dorfs: Hammers For Hire
1777388058.short_description: Forge, run, and fight as a team! In this frantic co-op game, you’ll have to work alongside your friends to craft legendary weapons and prepare the heroes for an epic battle. Coordinate, manage resources, and keep things under control as chaos unfolds!

1777438490.title: Devil May Cry 5 Special Edition
1777438490.short_description: The legendary stylish action game is better than ever in the ultimate version of this multi-award winning hit. New features include the addition of Dante's brother and arch-rival, Vergil, as a playable character, Legendary Dark Knight mode, next-gen graphics upgrades and more.

1777486086.title: Beautiful Sakura: Running Club
1777486086.short_description:
Beautiful Sakure: Running Club is a continuation of Kaito's journey, where he embarks on a new hobby. 

This visual novel delves into themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery.

Kaito's new passion for running leads him to join a local running club, where he reunites with familiar faces from his past and meets intriguing new characters. 



As he navigates the challenges of training and competition, Kaito finds himself caught up in another adventure, balancing the complexities of old friendships with the excitement of new connections.

Players will once again step into Kaito's shoes, guiding him through the ups and downs of his new life, where every run brings him closer to understanding himself and those around him.

1777561506.title: Barrel River
1777561506.short_description:
Flow down the brutal water of the mighty barrel river with nothing but your wits and a rickety old barrel to guide you! Barrel river is a fun filled action game where you must flow down the river avoiding rocks and deadly jumping fish. As an added bonus, King Midas has touched the river with his magical golden touch, and his gold coins can be found on the river as well. Collect coins and try to stay alive on this deadly river. Your score is determined by how far you make it and how many coins you have collected. Compete with friends for the top score!

**Special Credit** The music for Barrel River came from Kevin MacLeod at incompetech. Search for him online, he's got some awesome tracks!

1777567504.title: Backrooms: Escape Together
1777567504.short_description: A visually lifelike co-op horror for 1-6 people. Journey through 11 procedurally generated levels, using what's available to survive and progress deeper into the Backrooms.

1777571402.title: Age of Wonders: Planetfall
1777571402.short_description: Emerge from the cosmic dark age of a fallen galactic empire to build a new future for your people. Age of Wonders: Planetfall is the new strategy game from Triumph Studios, creators of the critically acclaimed Age of Wonders series, bringing all the exciting tactical turn-based combat and in-depth empire building of its predecessors to space in an all-new, sci-fi setting.

1777584503.title: Treasures of the Aegean
1777584503.short_description: A time loop adventure packed with treasure, parkour and puzzles. Discover what happened to the Minoan civilization.

1777639349.title: Sunbeam Feast (Windows)
1777639349.short_description: Embark on a charming journey in a colorful and fiery world.

1777656573.title: Vanquish
1777656573.short_description: The hit sci-fi shooter returns. An overpopulated Earth suffocating under limited resources looks to Providence, the solar-powered space colony for support. When Providence is suddenly taken over by a mutinous group and its technology used to devastate cities, it’s up to a specially trained unit of space marines to reclaim the colony.

1777668222.title: GRID Legends
1777668222.short_description: GRID Legends delivers thrilling wheel-to-wheel motorsport action across the globe. Create dream race events, hop into live multiplayer races, experience a dramatic virtual production story, and embrace the sensation of spectacular racing.

1777690290.title: Metal: Hellsinger Demo
1777690290.short_description: Tear through two realms of Hell as you shoot to the beat in the Metal: Hellsinger Demo. Feel the mighty vocals of two metal icons as you carve your path towards vengeance and the Red Judge herself.

1777692734.title: Super Arcade Football
1777692734.short_description: Super Arcade Football is a fast-paced, modern take on classic football games that's easy to learn and hard to master, with match modifiers, online and local multiplayer, and custom tournaments, every match is sure to be a nail-biter!

1777741495.title: CAPTURED
1777741495.short_description: Experience isolation and the eerie feeling of being trapped in a never-ending loop.

1777774126.title: Visions of Mana
1777774126.short_description: Explore a world of elemental spirits and adventure in the latest Mana action-RPG.

1777786002.title: Commandos: Origins
1777786002.short_description: ALARM! You have been selected for a mission which will shape the fate of the entire world. Witness the very beginning of the legendary elite WWII force in Commandos: Origins. The long-awaited sequel to the Commandos series brings you right back to the foundation of the real-time tactics genre.

1777860928.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)
1777860928.short_description: Microsoft Flight Simulator is the next generation of one of the most beloved simulation franchises. From light planes to wide-body jets, fly highly detailed and stunning aircraft in an incredibly realistic world. Create your flight plan and fly anywhere on the planet. Enjoy flying day or night and face realistic, challenging weather conditions.

1777869653.title: Alpacapaca Dash 2 - Windows
1777869653.short_description: After saving the Alpaca Goddess and vanquishing the eternal darkness, you now have to save the Alpaca World again! Fragments of darkness started appearing and it's your job to destroy them and ensure peace will remain into the colorful Alpaca World.

1777903168.title: The Clocker
1777903168.short_description: The world has been swallowed into the grey void of time and space. The only key to the winding puzzle - a time-controling pocket-watch - lies in the hands of a clockmaker Father. Powerful and otherwordly, the watch creates a mysterious barrier between the Father and his estranged Daughter. Will they ultimately find each other, or both dissolve into the grey?

1777970139.title: GoonBoy
1777970139.short_description:
It's time to open up your brand new GoonBoy!
The GoonBoy comes with a RetroBoy and 3 assorted classic games! Flappy Birds and pac man and snakebird.

1777974087.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
1777974087.short_description: High-orktane combat racing in the Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive buggies, tanks and helicopters, mastering advanced movement and explosive weaponry online or against bots. Unlock gear, customize your rides and use the Creation Workshop to create, share, and play custom maps from the community!

1778148060.title: Little Witch in the Woods (Game Preview)
1778148060.short_description: This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game.

1778191394.title: Grab 50 Coins (Windows)
1778191394.short_description: Your goal is to Grab 50 Coins and reach the exit before the spikes crush you! The door will not reveal itself until you Grab 50 Coins!

1778217111.title: Doomed To Hell
1778217111.short_description: End the super population on hell to earn back your life on earth!

1778298055.title: Void Bastards
1778298055.short_description: Inspired by BioShock and System Shock 2, Void Bastards is a revolutionary new strategy-shooter that will test your wits as well as exercise your aim. Can you lead the misfit prisoners of the Void Ark through the derelict spaceships and myriad dangers of the Sargasso Nebula? Will you make the right choices about what to do, where to go and when to fight? Master combat, manage ship controls, scavenge supplies, craft improvised tools and much more!

1778336971.title: To the Basement: Before (Xbox One)
1778336971.short_description:
To the Basement: Before is a side-scrolling arcade game where flight, maneuvering, devastating humidity, traps, and boss fights intertwine in a single, grim journey through a contaminated area.
Test your resilience and willpower in these challenges!

1778348973.title: Grand Theft Auto Online (Xbox Series X|S)
1778348973.short_description: Experience GTA Online, a dynamic and ever-evolving online universe for up to 30 players, where you can rise from street-level hustler to become a kingpin of your own criminal empire.

1778435097.title: Re:Touring (Xbox Series X|S)
1778435097.short_description:
Solve interesting puzzles and uncover the history of Luoni Energy

Re:Touring is a first-person puzzle game in which you'll explore the abandoned Luoni Energy Competence Center and uncover the facility's history, navigating through a total of 26 varied levels. Using a retro-style computer, you'll create color patterns to control elements such as doors, platforms and lasers. Each mechanism is carefully introduced to make the game accessible to everyone.

1778466338.title: Murder Inc
1778466338.short_description: Murder Inc is a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time moves only when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.

1778566943.title: The Fissure
1778566943.short_description:
Investigate the mystery of an old family home in atmospheric visual novel style!

Take the role of a young man named Nahuel as he travels to his mother’s hometown of San Adraín, a quiet and remote village that he’s never visited before… or so he believes. What Nahuel finds in San Adraín feels oddly familiar, perhaps too familiar to simply be because of the stories his mom told him. The family home almost seems haunted, the townspeople are cautious and distant, everything smells of firewood and neighbors he’s never met act as if they recognize him.

The Fissure is a mature and atmospheric visual novel adventure, a narrative mystery about memory and buried secrets. Guide Nahuel as he explores San Adraín, making key decisions for him along the way. Your choices will determine how the tale unfolds, leading to multiple possible endings and adding new scenes to your gallery. Consider the clues you gather to use in subsequent playthroughs in hopes of uncovering the truth of San Adraín and how Nahuel is connected to its many mysteries!

1778585635.title: Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees
1778585635.short_description: A classic western dungeon crawler inspired by great 90s era RPGs. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous adventure.

1778611337.title: Tour de France 2021 Xbox Series X|S
1778611337.short_description: Win the yellow jersey with the official game of the Tour de France 2021. All 21 stages and the biggest Classics are included. Experience a new objective system, a redesigned My Tour mode and other new features!

1778635686.title: The Star Named EOS
1778635686.short_description: The Star Named EOS is a story-rich puzzle adventure built around photography. By recreating the compositions of photos from the past, uncover the truth of a family mystery. Experience a harmonious mixture of beautiful hand-drawn art and engaging puzzles as you embark on a journey of reminiscence.

1778647320.title: JDM Racing 2
1778647320.short_description: Get ready to experience the thrill of JDM Racing - 2! Dive into the world of iconic JDM cars and intense arcade racing action. Feel the adrenaline rush as you tear up the tracks with exhilarating drifts and high-speed races. With its classic console racing style, this game will transport you back to the golden age of gaming. Buckle up and unleash your inner racer today!

1778655763.title: Golden Knight
1778655763.short_description: Defeat the forces of darkness and bring peace back to the kingdom of Valerond in this action-packed mini metroidvania.

1778851260.title: Oddworld: Stranger's Wrath HD
1778851260.short_description: Stranger is a tough-as-nails bounty hunter with a difference!

1778926822.title: Backgammon Chef
1778926822.short_description: Are you a true backgammon master. Play against AI or a friend and prove how good you are.

1778964678.title: Balloball - Ribbit & Rescue (Xbox One)
1778964678.short_description:
Balloball - Ribbit & Rescue is a bright cartoon arcade game.
You have to save all the frogs that the evil fairies have trapped in soap bubbles. 
Use your hero's agility and speed to avoid all the traps and 
the power of physics to calculate the flight paths.

1779001328.title: Ninja Nightfall
1779001328.short_description: Step into the shadows of a dystopian metropolis overrun by ruthless machines. In Ninja Nightfall, you are the last silent guardian—an elite warrior trained in the ancient arts, now facing a city teeming with hostile AI.

1779096288.title: Deliver At All Costs
1779096288.short_description: Deliver At All Costs is a thrilling action game where destruction, absurdity and intrigue collide! Join Winston Green, as he delivers highly unconventional cargo, leaving a trail of havoc and chaos behind him!

1779135141.title: Riders Republic™
1779135141.short_description: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.

1779148468.title: Hand in Hand
1779148468.short_description: Hand In Hand is a 2D split screen puzzle platformer, where the player can control two characters at once, or two players can play in co-op mode on one device.

1779181957.title: Tavern Manager Simulator
1779181957.short_description: Restore your fantasy tavern to its full glory!

1779217161.title: No Son Of Mine
1779217161.short_description: He's intelligent, unpredictable, deadly, and cruel. Explore, fight, hide, and find the truth before HE finds you. Pay attention to your surroundings and don't panic. You will be hunted. You will be terrorised. No Son Of Mine does not hold your hand, can you survive?

1779302848.title: Iron Danger
1779302848.short_description: Iron Danger is a tactical combat game with a unique time manipulation mechanic. A never before seen combination that blends the tactical depth of turn-based games with the exciting action of real-time games.

1779319409.title: Bowling.Olympics
1779319409.short_description:
Bowling.Olympics is a Windows Store and a Windows Phone game where you're playing the popular bowling game. 
Can be played by more than one player.
Keep Playing.

1779326597.title: Heidelberg 1693
1779326597.short_description: Heidelberg 1693 is a challenging 2D Action platformer set in a zombie-infested version of 17th century Germany!

1779338695.title: Farting Simon Says
1779338695.short_description:
At long last, the two greatest apps in the history of man have been merged - the fart sound app and the simon says memory game app! Train your brain while also generating funny fart noises and going for the top score! Losing stinks when you are playing Farting Simon. Has there ever been a better idea in the history of gaming? There is only one way to find out - download Farting Simon today!

Farting Simon is just like the classic four color memory game from your childhood, but it not affiliated with any game manufacturer in any way.

1779343248.title: Sclash
1779343248.short_description: Sclash is a plug’n play 2D samurai fighting game full of tension where one hit is enough to kill. Play as a hand-drawn samurai in beautiful painted settings and fight your opponent in epic solemn duels where each move matters. Manage well your stamina, breath and take your time to land a deadly hit.

1779354193.title: Infernax
1779354193.short_description: Infernax is the adventures of a great knight who returns to his homeland only to find it plagued with unholy magic. Uncover the mysteries of the curse and face the consequences of your actions.

1779379181.title: FoxyRush
1779379181.short_description: Help Foxy get back the cherry stocks!

1779524202.title: Zumba - The Marble Shooter Tikki Adventure
1779524202.short_description: Prepare to blast your way through 200 vibrant and challenging levels in Zumba: The Marble Shooter Tikki Adventure. With every shot, immerse yourself in a thrilling journey full of colorful marbles and exciting challenges. Get ready for an adventure that will test your skills and keep you coming back for more!

1779648042.title: Alwa's Awakening
1779648042.short_description: Use your magic staff and progress through a large interconnected world where you'll solve puzzles, fight enemies and defeat bosses in order to help free the land of Alwa. Explore and uncover the secrets by using your platforming skills in this challenging and charming 8-bit adventure game.

1779771438.title: Like No Other: The Legend Of The Twin Books
1779771438.short_description:
The adventure begins!

Dan is a bumbling first-time adventurer who risks everything to solve the legend of the twin books by exploring the abandoned town of Red Pines.

Legend has it that a talented artist replicated the Spirits' Book, and the replica was so perfect that the museum staff mistakenly left the original behind during the evacuation of Red Pines. After learning of the legend, Dan decides to check if it's true, and recover the book if it is.

Join Dan on this light, family-friendly quest and help his love for adventure thrive.

1779773031.title: Boss Rush: Mythology (Windows)
1779773031.short_description: Take on the role of a mysterious knight who travels across different worlds in search of the most difficult opponents. Fight famous enemies from Greek, Scandinavian, Slavic and Egyptian mythologies and show everyone who is the strongest warrior! Only boss fights, only hardcore!

1779785203.title: Oil Wars
1779785203.short_description: Strategy vehicle combat game where you fight for the control of the resource locations.

1779788068.title: 9 Kings (Game Preview)
1779788068.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

1780001013.title: Ballotron Galaxy (Xbox One)
1780001013.short_description:
Discover the newest challenge in your favorite arcade!
Blast off into space and put your skills to the test once again.
Shoot small balls to strike larger balls and blocks.
Uncover creative solutions to connect the blue and green ball.
Experiment with unique strategies to overcome challenging, logic-based puzzles.

1780019677.title: Deflector
1780019677.short_description: Annihilate or get annihilated. Face the virus and don’t let it take control over the world.

1780044941.title: American Arcadia
1780044941.short_description: Welcome to Arcadia! A 70’s retro-futuristic metropolis where the citizens don't know they're contestants on the most watched reality show on the planet! Switch between 2.5D platformer & first-person puzzle gameplay to uncover the truth and escape with your life in American Arcadia!

1780050552.title: RUFFY AND THE RIVERSIDE
1780050552.short_description:
Story

Join Ruffy on an exciting quest to stop the mischievous villain Groll from destroying the World Core and throwing Riverside into chaos. Along the way, you'll travel to fantastic places with helpful friends like Pip the sassy bee, Sir Eddler the adventurous mole, and Silja the wise turtle. Meet a lively cast of characters, each with their own unique stories and dialogues, as the exciting adventure unfolds with unexpected surprises for Ruffy around every corner.

Unique Gameplay

As Ruffy, the Chosen One, you'll harness the magical power of SWAP, and use it to transform the game world. With SWAP you'll change the sun into the moon or ice into lava while overcoming countless puzzles and effortlessly manipulating objects to your will. You can turn a stone into wood to create a boat or swap a wall into rubble to clear your path, and much more as you fight, jump, and ride hay bales throughout the adventure. The unique SWAP ability opens up endless possibilities, making every moment feel magical and full of surprises.


2D levels and puzzles

Ruffy just won't stop! When the 3D world ends, he leaps into new 2D levels to collect even more treasures, but watch out - many obstacles must be swapped before you can safely pass through walls. Use your cleverness and the magical SWAP mechanic to transform objects and unlock new paths in your delightful adventure!


Explore a magical open world 

Explore the marvelous open world of Riverside, where Ruffy embarks on playful side quests, masters challenges, and collects magic treasures across seven distant regions. Ride hay bales, perform tricks on secret rails, and discover unknown areas as you meet the mysterious Etoi and team up with the Fish Gang to defeat bully sharks. Unleash your creativity by designing your own textures with Pix, transforming the game world into your personal adventure filled with surprises around every corner.

1780161453.title: Bullet Runner
1780161453.short_description: Top-down bullet hell shooter where you stop the clone army from taking over the world by one way: kill. them. all.

1780184182.title: Clea 2
1780184182.short_description: Clea 2 is a jump scare free, skill-based survival horror sequel to the 2019 adventure.

1780268897.title: Harvest Moon: Light of Hope SE Complete
1780268897.short_description: Looking for a fresh start and some new surroundings, you set off on a voyage to begin your new life!

1780450479.title: Wildcat Gun Machine
1780450479.short_description: Wildcat Gun Machine is a bullet hell dungeon crawler where you take on hordes of disgusting flesh beasts with a wide variety of guns, giant mech robots, and cute kittens.

1780460930.title: Wild Bastards
1780460930.short_description: The spiritual successor to the epic strategy-shooter Void Bastards, Wild Bastards is a hybrid FPS/strategy game with heart-pounding tactical combat, detailed management systems, and a roguelike campaign. Saddle up and lead the most notorious outlaws in the galaxy.

1780525037.title: Sunset Motel
1780525037.short_description:
Renovate neglected rooms, design entertainment areas, and manage your motel with style!
Deliver unforgettable experiences and ensure the satisfaction of every guest at Sunset Motel.

1780556395.title: LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition
1780556395.short_description: The miserable journey of a broken man...

1780561322.title: Grab 50 Coins (Xbox One)
1780561322.short_description: Your goal is to Grab 50 Coins and reach the exit before the spikes crush you! The door will not reveal itself until you Grab 50 Coins!

1780568718.title: Turn to Mine (Xbox Series X|S)
1780568718.short_description:
You are a space mining apprentice with a bright future ahead. However, your superior Commander Neek would rather watch a movie than teach you anything. Can you collect crystals and survive on your own?

Take control of your seeker and become the space miner you always wanted to be.
Turn grid squares to destroy enemy drones before they destroy you.
Solve space-themed puzzles and try to survive!

1780657415.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Numberlink (Windows)
1780657415.short_description: Numberlink is a puzzle where you connect the same numbers without crossing lines. Trust your instinct and get connecting! Keep in mind that the longer the distance, the harder it gets.

1780744592.title: Maggie the Magnet
1780744592.short_description:
Use the powers of gravity and magnetic attraction to fling yourself across the laboratory and solve puzzles!

There's nothing Maggie loves more than scientific experiments! She's an animated magnet, capable of turning her magnetic powers on and off whenever she wants. Sensing the potential for scientific discoveries, she opened her own laboratory and now there's only one key component separating her from having fun and exploring her capabilities. She needs someone to oversee the experiments! Are you up for the task?

Maggie the Magnet is a physics-based puzzle game, in which all the gameplay is centered around a single button. Holding it down enables Maggie's magnetic powers, thus making her fly in the direction of the magnet point, a metal plate with 4 magnets attached to it. Releasing it allows Maggie to perform all sorts of aerial stunts as she flies over gaps using gravity and built-up momentum. Fling Maggie around the laboratory and experiment with the unique layout of more than 150 challenging levels!

1780792148.title: Tennis Manager 2021
1780792148.short_description: Do you have what it takes to become the greatest tennis manager? Enter your academy, manage your team, schedule your tournaments, change your game plans and find out the new young guns. Take the reins, make the right decisions, become the best one!

1780797788.title: Toybox Escape (Windows)
1780797788.short_description: Toybox Escape is a colorful 2D pixel-art platformer set inside a massive toy factory gone haywire. After a system malfunction, only the maintenance robot T-01 remains active. Trapped in chaos, T-01 must cross assembly lines, storage rooms, and dangerous machinery, collecting ⚡ energy fragments to unlock doors and survive hostile patrol bots. Blending action, puzzles, and exploration, the game delivers a charming yet tense escape adventure.

1780870933.title: My First Date RPG (Xbox One Version)
1780870933.short_description: Oriana, a high school senior, is a little disappointed that she's about to end high school without ever going out on a date with a guy. At the tail end of her high school life, will a guy ask her out before the year is over? **This game is a work in progress! New stories to play are added to the game via free updates, so have fun seeing the game grow with each new update! Thank you for playing, watching, and reading!**

1781008619.title: MY LITTLE PONY: A Maretime Bay Adventure
1781008619.short_description: Explore Equestria, meet new MY LITTLE PONY friends, and bring back the magic of Maretime Bay Day festival!

1781023780.title: The Medium
1781023780.short_description: A third‑person psychological horror game where you explore both the real world and the spirit realm. As a medium drawn to a deserted resort, you’ll uncover dark secrets, confront echoes of trauma, and face the consequences of seeing more than one truth.

1781025496.title: Dreamless
1781025496.short_description: In a remote provincial town, teenagers mysteriously disappear every 25 years. You're a high school student about to turn 18... But what if you become the next victim?

1781025707.title: RESIDENT EVIL 2 R.P.D. Demo
1781025707.short_description:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

1781027452.title: Luppy (Windows)
1781027452.short_description: Luppy is a 2D platformer packed with personality, where you'll take on 32 handcrafted, obstacle-filled levels. In each stage, your goal is to collect coins and unlock the hidden trophy to move forward.

1781047490.title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
1781047490.short_description: Embark on this definitive version of the critically acclaimed Shin Megami Tensei V, massively expanded with a brand-new storyline featuring new locations, demons, and choices to make that will dictate the fate of all existence.

1781089938.title: The VideoKid
1781089938.short_description:
It's the 1980's. The Kid needed to earn some cash to take his girlfriend out. So by delivering pirate video tapes to his customers and staying one step in front of the cops, he quickly became... The Videokid. 
Running the gauntlet of his bogusly dangerous delivery route, The VideoKid must survive against all the odds to reach his beloved Jessica. Is today the day he'll finally reach her in time? 

The VideoKid pays homage to the 1980s, and the classic videogames of that era. Harking back to a simpler time of pure gameplay, take control of The VideoKid as he hurls videos through the mailboxes, or windows, of his customers to earn cash. Dodge civilians, jump and grind cars and avoid the neighbourhood cops to stay alive. But this is no ordinary street... you may also encounter strangely-familiar characters from your past. How many will you spot?

1781140717.title: Violetti Goottii
1781140717.short_description:
While exploring a mysterious cave in the forest a completely unpredictable accident leaves you trapped underground where you must escape by using you inhuman strength to hurl giant blocks at your enemies and activate abilities conferred by special blocks.

Keyboard controls for pc version: Space = a button, k = y button, j = x button.

1781154919.title: AlienCruise
1781154919.short_description: AlienCruise is an independent side scroller shooting game,these well-trained space warriors need to drive spacecrafts to explore and find a planet suitable for human life. In the unknown space, unprecedented great challenges awaits them.

1781205003.title: Terror of Hemasaurus SGDemo22
1781205003.short_description: Play as a giant monster and wreak havoc on humanity in this retro city smash ‘em up! Punch buildings, slap helicopters, eat humans, kick cars – enjoy multiple ways to cause carnage! Satisfying arcade action and mindless destruction for up to 4-players!

1781222390.title: Game Package1
1781222390.short_description:
There are currently 5 games in this package. It may increase over time. Please match the keys on your gamepads with A,X,B,Y on the keyboard to be able to play the games on xbox.

Escape key returns home page

Please match the Gamepad arrow keys with the Keyboard arrow keys.

1781300625.title: SLEEP AWAKE
1781300625.short_description: In the last known city on Earth, people are disappearing in their sleep. Those who remain exist in a crisis of reckless experiments to keep awake. You must navigate depraved death cults, otherworldly forces, and the ever-present horror of The HUSH, to save yourself and those who rely upon you.

1781344339.title: Control Ultimate Edition - Xbox Series X|S
1781344339.short_description:
A corruptive presence has invaded the Federal Bureau of Control…
Only you have the power to stop it. The world is now your weapon
in an epic fight to annihilate an ominous enemy through deep and
unpredictable environments. Containment has failed, humanity is
at stake. Will you regain control?

1781365913.title: Monster Train
1781365913.short_description:
Hell has frozen over. Only you can protect the final burning pyre from the forces of heaven and restore the inferno. Monster Train brings a new strategic layer to roguelike deckbuilding, with three vertical playing fields to defend.
Includes the released updates Wild Mutations and Friends & Foes! 
Visit powerful locations
To take back hell, you’ll need to power up. Choose your route carefully, different locations yield different benefits; upgrade your champion, recruit powerful units, upgrade cards, gain passive bonuses or duplicate any card in your deck.
Strategize to fit your playstyle
With five clans to choose from, each has its own unique and surprising gameplay. Pick your primary and supporting clan to gain access to all cards from both. During your run you will be able to improve cards by mixing and matching upgrades to open up new roads to victory. 
Challenge your friends, build your own crazy run to defeat or join in the frantic multiplayer mode Hellrush.

1781425798.title: Cozy Designer
1781425798.short_description: Position furniture and objects however you prefer and decorate 60 incredibly cozy environments. Without right or wrong, the only limit is your imagination. Photograph the finished spaces and create your own design gallery!

1781463671.title: Spirit Arena
1781463671.short_description: Fight incoming waves of monsters with a friend! Control powerful wizards as you free 4 different worlds from the grasp of those evil beings. Unlock new content and take on the greatest challenges of Spirit Arena!

1781508418.title: Recovery Elf 2017
1781508418.short_description:
In this single level game you have one job. 
Your mission is to recover the lost presents as fast as you can. 
Recover presents by running through them with your rocket sled.
Watch your magic and fuel levels because if you run out the mission is over. 
You increase your magic levels with each present recovered. You get more fuel by running through the fuel pump icons.
On a keyboard use the arrows to move the sled around. On XBOX ONE Controller use the Left Stick. 
The mission area is divided into three sections. The two sides of the valley and the valley. 
There is a teleport pad at each location. Use the y button on the keyboard or XBOX ONE controller to
 teleport to the valley. Use the x or the b button to get to either side. Be mindful that teleporting uses magic. 
The terrain is very rough in some parts. If you find you get stuck be sure to use your teleport ability.

1781545897.title: Vzerthos: The Heir of Thunder (For Windows10)
1781545897.short_description: Vzerthos is a 2D isometric old-school techno-fantasy styled Top-Down Shooter. Player's arsenal includes skills of the Thunder God's heir and three types of guns - use them to slice and dice, burn and blow up your enemies!

1781562419.title: Capybara Goes to Space (Windows)
1781562419.short_description:
Capybara Goes to Space is a lighthearted 2D platformer where you guide Capy, a laid-back astronaut capybara, through a strange alien planet in search of scattered spaceship parts. The world is full of bizarre creatures, radioactive traps, and mysterious landscapes that challenge your reflexes and curiosity. As you explore, you’ll uncover secret paths, dodge dripping toxic goo, and outsmart hilarious alien enemies.

Only the chillest (and bravest) capybara can repair the ship and find the way back home.

Are you ready for the weirdest space mission ever?

1781754560.title: Worshippers of Cthulhu
1781754560.short_description: LEAD the CULT OF CTHULHU. Decide the fate of your followers, perform eldritch rituals, and master the art of city-building in a world where the line between sanity and madness blurs. Can you endure the horrors you unleash?

1781754632.title: Micro Tanks
1781754632.short_description: Micro Tanks is that fan favorite artillery tank game from your childhood. Destroy the enemy in classic mode, or free for all mode for anything-goes shootouts. Time To Get Shell-shocked. Destroy Your Enemy, Before They Destroy You!

1781810940.title: Cats vs Dogs
1781810940.short_description: Run, jump, and claw your way to victory in the ultimate battle of cats vs dogs.

1781875316.title: Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu Collector's Edition
1781875316.short_description:
When a mysterious letter lands on the desk of private detective Casey Monroe, a strange case begins to unfold. 

A desperate plea from Lady Margaret tells of the sudden disappearance of her beloved dog, Lulu. 
At first, it seems like a simple matter of a missing pet. 
But as Casey arrives at the imposing mansion, it becomes clear this is no ordinary investigation. 
Lulu’s past is shrouded in shadows, and Lady Margaret may not be telling the whole truth.

Search for clues in lavish yet haunting locations — from candlelit halls and dusty libraries to forgotten gardens and crypts cloaked in mystery. 
Featuring beautiful artwork, atmospheric music, and a twisted storyline, 
Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu delivers the timeless charm of classic hidden object gameplay alongside a variety of challenging puzzles that will test both logic and attentiveness.

Will you be able to save Lulu — and the other dogs — before it’s too late? 
Or will the secrets of Dark Town remain forever buried?

The Coll.

1781910183.title: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
1781910183.short_description:
In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, fulfill visitor requests, manage facilities, and keep your staff and defenses in top shape. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work!

Visitor Satisfaction is Key 
After processing the bodies, visitors will return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves intact while providing fresh flowers and maintaining a welcoming environment. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help your business thrive.

Visitors can also stop by the Chapel to rest, attend sermons, and browse the Souvenir Shop for small keepsakes like candles and incenses. A clean, decorated, and well managed graveyard encourages greater generosity while donating!

Build your Defenses
Each night, waves of zombies will come with their numbers growing and special zombie types emerging, hungry for freshly buried bodies and for you. Some nights may be even more dangerous with special events like the Blood Moon. From basic defenses like barbed wires and fences to advanced machines like flamethrower turrets, keep your defenses upgraded, repaired, and fully stocked with ammo to withstand the night. Your loyal pet companion can also assist you during nighttime defenses.

Trust your Arsenal
With a wide arsenal of 13+ weapons, including pistols, rifles, shotguns, and your trusty shovel, you are the ultimate force against the Zombies. As you level up, unlock and purchase new weapons to become even stronger. Just make sure to stock up on enough ammo!

Even a Graveyard Can Be Cozy Sometimes!
Use your Farming Area to grow different flowers for profit and vegetables to simply eat and restore your energy and health. With Upgrades, you can even unlock a Grinder to turn zombie parts into Fertilizer. Decorate your Graveyard with benches, lights, paths, custom urns, and other ornaments to make it truly your own.

Expand and Upgrade Your Facilities
Your graveyard isn’t just a resting place, it's a business, and every upgrade matters. Expand your burial areas, manage custom urns at the urn station, upgrade your crematorium, and operate new facilities like the Stone Quarry & Workshop to craft your own gravestones. Improve your water supply, manage resource production, and unlock advanced stations like the Zombie Research Lab to process captured zombies into valuable products.

Hire a team of employees to help with day-to-day tasks: the Florist keeps flowers running, the Gravekeeper maintains burials and cremations, the Gardener keeps your farm in check, the Technician ensures all machines run smoothly, and Chapel staff like the Priest, Pianist, and Custodian help run sermons and services.

Every improvement helps you stay one step ahead of both business demands and the undead threat. Venture beyond the graveyard by unlocking Expedition Mode through the Expedition Station, where radio signals lead you to dangerous missions outside your walls.

1781945767.title: Wizard of Legend 2
1781945767.short_description: In an age of myth and magic, ambitious wizards from around the world have assembled to undertake the perilous Trials of Legend in the Floating Lands. Many will try. Most will fail. Only those who have truly mastered the chaotic, shifting elemental forces of Arcana will become a Wizard of Legend!

1781996402.title: Batu Ta Batu
1781996402.short_description: Batu Ta Batu is a colorful tile puzzle game from one up to four players. Slide, combine and match the tiles of the same color through hundreds of levels and several game modes!

1782127760.title: Chef's Tail
1782127760.short_description: Play as the "Cat Chef" in the spooky but cute underworld. Earn your coin by tending the trees, fishing and creating incredible dishes, or just sleep for 16 hours a day on a comfy pillow. The choice is yours.

1782146850.title: The Wild Eight
1782146850.short_description:
The mysterious plane crash was only the beginning. Eight survivors are stranded in the middle of an unforgiving frozen wilderness of Alaska. Don’t let it consume you. Find out the truth. Survive and live to tell the tale of The Wild Eight.

In The Wild Eight, always be on the move — it is your only way to survive and find out what happened with this mysterious place.

Explore and Survive
Embark on an adventure into the ruthless arctic wilderness and uncover the truth behind a mysterious plane crash that left its surviving passengers to die.

Hunt or Be Hunted
Gather resources, craft and improve your equipment at the camping site, escape blizzards and fight deadly beasts that lurk in the woods.

Loot
Find supernatural anomalies, strange laboratories and abandoned facilities, full of useful loot and things that don’t belong to this world.

1782148011.title: Moves
1782148011.short_description: Mental Stimulation Through Math – Test your math and problem-solving skills in a fun and educational game.

1782257009.title: Yakuza 6: The Song of Life for Windows 10
1782257009.short_description:
How far would you go for family? Step into Japan's criminal underworld with fists swinging in this explosive action brawler starring legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu, who is hellbent on uncovering the truth behind a tragic accident that left his daughter comatose.

Master bone-breaking combos, customize your combat abilities, and indulge in all the vices that Tokyo's red light district of Kamurocho has to offer in the emotional conclusion of Kazuma Kiryu's saga.

1782426167.title: Flat Heroes
1782426167.short_description: Flat Heroes encourages you to stylishly navigate and survive over 300 handcrafted levels, destroy the most epic bosses around and truly be the two-dimensional hero (or heroes!) you’ve always dreamed you could be.

1782579390.title: DPS Idle
1782579390.short_description: Collect cards, upgrade cards, defeat monsters, join guilds and hire heroes. Raise your DPS!

1782582535.title: Legends Aligned: Land of Order (Xbox One)

1782595902.title: The Eightfold Path
1782595902.short_description: The path of a Buddhist monk is a path of enlightenment. Find your way through the mystical forest, encounter beautiful creatures, magical places, evil spirits and puzzling challenges that will test if you have what it takes to become a buddha.

1782607681.title: Looking for Aliens
1782607681.short_description: Aliens are among us! Find them!

1782608966.title: The Excrawlers
1782608966.short_description: Excrawlers is an action-RPG rougelike game in which you and other heroes will embark into dark atmospheric dungeons and realms full of monsters and madness. Embark into parallel realms, defeat ancient monsters and find your way out!

1782658315.title: Commander Keen in Keen Dreams Definitive Edition
1782658315.short_description: Commander Keen is back. In the modernised Definitive Edition of the lost episode "Keen Dream", Keen has to fend off a nasty nightmare about evil vegetables. The Definitive Edition features full widescreen support, twelve all-new levels - doubling the length over the 1990 original - and a full music score. The game structure has been reworked to make the game a more modern experience without sacrificing any of the original charm!

1782668923.title: Crisis Wing
1782668923.short_description:
Push your shoot’em up skills to the limit in nostalgic pixel art style as you launch into Crisis Wing, lovingly crafted to recall the frantic action of arcade classics! Featuring 7 vertical scrolling stages, upgradeable weapons and cooperative multiplayer, Crisis Wing combines modern gameplay advancements with nostalgic presentation, enriched by a ricking FM soundtrack and CRT filters for a genuine old-school vibe.

From enemy swarms to screen-filling boss battles, Crisis Wing offers a daunting challenge while remaining accessible to newcomers. Practice mode lets you replay stages with infinite lives. Score Attack and Boss Rush bonus games further extend the experience with unique levels and bosses. Are you ready for takeoff?

1782717140.title: Light Fairytale Episode 2
1782717140.short_description: A turn-based JRPG series featuring a modern presentation with a classic core. Episode 2 resumes the adventure with Haru right after last episode's cliffhanger!

1782830545.title: BOUNCY BREAD
1782830545.short_description: Bouncy Bread is a simple and fun game with 40 challenging and balanced levels, offering a relaxing and accessible experience for players of all ages, with easy-to-learn mechanics and smooth progression.

1782973962.title: Poly Puzzle - Anime Battle Girls
1782973962.short_description:
Train your brain and creativity and find the right perspective. 

Rotate the pieces until the perspective is correct and everything fits magically together.

Relax and enjoy the masterpieces you will create.

1782977697.title: Pool 3D
1782977697.short_description:
Play Pool 3D against a real person or against an Ai (artificial intelligent) player and rediscover the fun and and excitement of this classic game on the BIG screen

With stunning high definition 3D graphics and realistic physics, you will feel like you are playing on a real table.

1782993166.title: Gravebound Dash (Xbox One)
1782993166.short_description: Gravebound Dash is a 2D platformer where the kid must use their newly found ghost powers to become intangible and avoid danger to collect all the sweets and candies they can find.

1783054290.title: Garfield Lasagna Party
1783054290.short_description: 32 mini-games and 3 game modes: all you need for a delicious party!

1783181941.title: Evan Daniel and Friends, Volume 1
1783181941.short_description:
Educational Game for preschoolers, this video game is intended to reinforce learning based on Standards of Education for Kindergarten in the State of California

Content Includes Letters, numbers, simple math and spelling.

1783252152.title: Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves (Xbox One)

1783404014.title: The Tower of Beatrice
1783404014.short_description:
The life of a thief isn’t easy: always hiding in shadows, clients cheat, traps bite…



Working on a contract for a mysterious client, you'll need to infiltrate the tower of the powerful sorcerer Beatrice, steal her Book of Recipes, and get out alive.



Along the way you will enter a demon's dreams to discover his most intimate desires, accept a gift from a Granny-spider, start the Clock Tower, feed a snail, make a tea for a demon, piece together a skeleton, and finally fix your own fatal failing.

1783440636.title: City Bus Manager
1783440636.short_description: Build your own bus depot from scratch and create your personal bus routes in City Bus Manager. Play in your own hometown or any famous city in the world with real map data. Buy buses, maintain them, take care of your staff and lead your bus company to become the #1 in town!

1783467767.title: Mark of the Deep Demo
1783467767.short_description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of elements from acclaimed Metroidvania and Souls-Like games. Embark on this journey as the pirate Rookie, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!

1783471882.title: Block Craft Survival
1783471882.short_description: Block Craft Survival is an online game that you can play for free. Block Craft Survival is an interesting arcade puzzle for all Block Craft fans. The first thing you need to consider is how to make the our lovley miner land quickly. In the game, you touch or click blocks to destroy them! Are you a smart person? Come and have a try! Have a great time!

1783499523.title: Boundland (Xbox One)
1783499523.short_description: Boundland is a fun physics-based platform game where you navigate your multi-shaped character through lots of dark levels and scary boss fights.

1783517095.title: Beatdown City Survivors
1783517095.short_description: Eradicate hordes of monsters in this survivors style roguelite set in a rotting, destructible city that hates you. Start fires, blow stuff up, electrify water, you name it. Upgrade & craft an arsenal of oddball weapons including pigeons riding boots. Unlock & upgrade offbeat characters & SURVIVE!

1783528863.title: Stasis: Bone Totem
1783528863.short_description: Experience a thrilling underwater adventure with classic point-and-click gameplay. Explore with 3 characters simultaneously. Ready for a journey to hidden places deep below the waves...?

1783702427.title: AEW: Fight Forever
1783702427.short_description: Developed by YUKE’S, AEW: Fight Forever combines nostalgic arcade-wrestling with All Elite Wrestling finishers and moves. Fight Forever features a big roster of AEW talent, multiple match types including 4-way, tag-team, unsanctioned lights-out, and tons of customization options. Career mode, more than 40 weapons, and so much more for fighting and grappling fans alike!

1783708757.title: Kaichu: The Kaiju Dating Sim
1783708757.short_description: Kaichu is a dating sim about kaiju! You play the role of Gigachu, a gigantic romantic looking for love. Meet six other eligible kaiju and visit twenty-four famous landmarks where Gigachu will answer challenging compatibility questions to decide the fate of your relationship.

1783710489.title: Coffee, Plis
1783710489.short_description: Serving coffee and complete chaos "Coffee, Plis" brings a crazy day of service in all the coffee shops in the city, being able to play alone or with friends.

1783766156.title: Hyper Shapes
1783766156.short_description: Hyper Shapes is a frenetic minimalist Boss Rush where understanding the enemies attack patterns and weaknesses is key.

1783811207.title: Jack Move
1783811207.short_description: Jack Move is a JRPG that features a unique blend of gritty cyberpunk story telling, turn based battles and beautiful modern pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.

1783815373.title: The Addams Family: Mansion Mayhem
1783815373.short_description: Family game night is about to get terrifyingly exciting! Save the Addams Family Mansion from destruction in this hilarious 3D platform adventure for up to four players. Play minigames that will have you bumping and jumping over each other to win.

1783825549.title: Road 96: Mile 0
1783825549.short_description: A prequel to Road 96, a story about two friends with different backgrounds. Meet Zoe and Kaito. This is where it all started. Challenge your beliefs!

1783894998.title: Bob The Brick Breaker
1783894998.short_description:
A game inspired by old arcade games, where waves of bricks make the climb to the top increasingly difficult. Adding to the challenge are minions and bosses, who will put us to the test.

Ask your friends for help, playing as a duo, or go head-to-head to see who's the best. If you think you're the best of the bunch, then get ready to prove to the rest of the world that you've got what it takes via the online leaderboards.

Prove you can outlast everyone else and be worthy of the title of brick king.

Let the challenge begin!

1784095373.title: Ping PONG Classic͏
1784095373.short_description: Pong is a table tennis–themed arcade sports video game, featuring simple two-dimensional graphics. It was one of the earliest arcade video games.

1784134484.title: Dog Duty
1784134484.short_description: As some evil bigwig Octopus Commander and his army are threatening world-peace, it’s up to you and your squad of misfits to eliminate that octo-scum. Liberate outposts, defeat bosses and wreck these wicked squids up, but beware, they’re well-armed.

1784154462.title: Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale - Demo Version
1784154462.short_description: Solve relaxing puzzles, enjoy a beautiful world and unravel a tale told in rhyme about a brave princess striving for freedom from the status quo.

1784162984.title: Mini Trains
1784162984.short_description: Welcome to the fantastic world of model railroads and steam locomotives where you can become both a constructor and a conductor. Choo Choo!

1784389929.title: Raining Blobs
1784389929.short_description: Raining Blobs is a challenging, fast-paced arcade puzzle game based around matching falling blocks, featuring adorable anime-style pixelart! Prove that you have what it takes to survive the endless blob rain with up to 16 players!

1784496768.title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Demo
1784496768.short_description: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree is an epic dark fantasy action RPG. Play the Demo to experience challenging Soulslike combat, battle a bestiary of monsters, and begin to explore and unravel the secrets of a vast, interconnected world.

1784534288.title: Independence Day Festive Finds (Xbox One)
1784534288.short_description: Independence Day Festive Finds is a patriotic spot-the-difference adventure packed with fireworks, barbecues, parades, and holiday fun. Find hidden differences, test your observation skills, and enjoy relaxing or timed gameplay filled with rewarding “I found it!” moments.

1784625849.title: Queen's Quest 5: Symphony of Death (Xbox Version)
1784625849.short_description: When the kingdom is shaken as children are being kidnapped, the court alchemist and best detective decides to take matters into her own hands. Using elixirs and shapeshifting magic, you have to stop the dreadful sound of the deadly symphony.

1784661676.title: Station Manager
1784661676.short_description: Build your own spectacular, multi-story station for your favorite trains!

1784709136.title: Ozymandias
1784709136.short_description: Build an empire in a single sitting. All the strategy of a classic 4X in a faster format.

1784809524.title: MIDNIGHT Remastered
1784809524.short_description: A remastered version of the 2017 web game 'MIDNIGHT', collect the seven letters of the deadly sins and repent your past offences in this horror game.

1784847115.title: Hypnospace Outlaw
1784847115.short_description: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village.

1784891077.title: Supernatural Super Squad Fight!
1784891077.short_description: Come join the chosen and fuel our flame against evil! Play as one of eight mighty fighters and battle across epic landscapes. Challenge the forces of darkness or oppose the forces of good. Which side will you choose?

1784931030.title: Aerial_Knight's Never Yield
1784931030.short_description: Survive A futuristic Tokyo style Detroit in this 3D runner that tells the story of Wally who has uncovered the evidence that can change his city forever. Explore a game world with a dope-tastic soundtrack featuring the authentic sounds of Detroit Artist.

1784940987.title: Secrets of SOCOM
1784940987.short_description: Battle with 1 to 4 players locally as a US Special Operations (SOCOM) soldier in over 20 missions. Relive the battles and capture or kill some of the notorious targets of all times including Osama Bin Laden, Saddam Hussein, and Pablo Escobar.

1784987658.title: Assault Suit Leynos 2 Saturn Tribute
1784987658.short_description: Modify your robot and head to the battlefield!

1785006490.title: Lost Words: Beyond the Page
1785006490.short_description: Interact with the words inscribed in the pages of a young girl’s diary to solve puzzles, tackle unique platforming segments and discover an emotional tale set across the vibrant world of Estoria in Lost Words: Beyond the Page.

1785015948.title: Unheard - Voices of Crime Edition
1785015948.short_description: Investigate crime scenes with a new aural device that allows you to hear voices from the past. Identify potential suspects and solve the mysteries. What is it that’s connecting seemingly unrelated cases?

1785019177.title: Nowhere Girl
1785019177.short_description: After getting sad-drunk with a biker-wizard, you, the protagonist of our story, have woken up with a ghost in your bed! Her ghostly tail is chained to your leg and she's just as scared as you are! You can shake and rattle and yell and kick and scream all you like, but there's only one way to set the poor thing free. You've got to fall in love with her. The feeling doesn't have to be mutual.

1785098854.title: Super Mombo Quest
1785098854.short_description: Bounce and stomp through a magical world! Do INSANE stunts and get huge combos!

1785122378.title: Omega Strikers
1785122378.short_description: Join the footbrawl! Smash opponents off the arena and score goals in this lightning-fast 3v3 free-to-play game. Squad up with friends and choose from a growing cast of colorful Strikers to sling slimes, toss tofu, and rocket boost to victory.

1785159792.title: Ghost Sync
1785159792.short_description: A fateful RPG involving a magical lady and a spirit of a man possessing a dog!

1785167647.title: Outbreak: Contagious Memories
1785167647.short_description: You’re trapped in a city ravaged by the undead - can you make it out alive? Join Lydia in her desperate struggle to escape, either alone or with a friend in co-op, in this chilling love letter to classic 90s survival horror.

1785174857.title: Spelunky 2
1785174857.short_description: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new.

1785218274.title: BEAR ESCAPE MISSION
1785218274.short_description: A simple, casual platformer with 40 short levels and infinite lives.

1785266369.title: AntVentor
1785266369.short_description: AntVentor is a point & click adventure game. You find yourself in a photorealistic macroworld where you immediately manage to ruin the life of the main character, ant, and foil all his plans for making his dream come true. Can you help get everything back in order?

1785274424.title: Raiden IV x MIKADO remix
1785274424.short_description:
A blast from the past soars into the present!

In Raiden IV x MIKADO remix, you'll continue the fight against the extraterrestrial race known as the Crystals in their attempt to take over the world. The arcade classic steps up for its explosive arrival on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. With this debut comes a suite of electrifying content featuring new levels, frenetic bullet-patterns, and intense gameplay modes such as Arcade, OverKill, Score Attack, and more! The addition of vertical screen play gives players a nostalgic blast from the past, while Double Play mode (the ability to pilot two ships at once) provides an exciting and challenging experience that’s out of this world! Soar sky-high with a stellar soundtrack that features live performances and new arrangements, with the ability to switch between classic and remixed songs.

With all this and more, Raiden IV x MIKADO remix stays true to its arcade origins while launching the franchise into the present!

- Play Your Way: Modes such as Dual Play and Double Play take your adventure to the next level!
- Modern Music: Remixed BGM from the original classic, including live performances and new arrangements!
- Old-school Vibes: Vertical screen play allows players to recreate the original arcade experience!
- A Suite of New Content: New levels, bullet-patterns, and modes, including Arcade, OverKill, Additional, Score Attack, and Boss Rush!

1785313161.title: I'm on Observation Duty 8
1785313161.short_description: Can you survive the night shift, or will you succumb to paranoia...? Use your keen memory and sharp eyes to spot the differences, before the differences spot you.

1785385145.title: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
1785385145.short_description: Make your own levels. Break everyone else’s.

1785387006.title: THE WEST FREE
1785387006.short_description:
THIS GAME IS IN WORK IN PROGERSS 
BEST PLAYED ON XBOX ONE X AND SEIRES S AND X
 THE WEST NEXT GEN is coming !! and it will be free and there will be a version that will be paid too that will have more to it like a bigger map. and a story missions more game modes besides free rome 

The West FREE is a open world game in the west you can be a outlaw. and be a cowboy killer.

New updates will be added new maps updates. weapons. new gameplay improvements.

1785402778.title: FINAL FANTASY XV POCKET EDITION
1785402778.short_description:
Download Chapter 1 and play for free!
Subsequent chapters are available for purchase.

"Explore the world of FINAL FANTASY XV 
with a cast of cute and cool characters! "

Now you can enjoy the FINAL FANTASY XV story across 10 exciting chapters


【Story】
The Tale of the Chosen King, Savior to the Star.

After years of fighting, the nations of Lucis and Niflheim at last agree to an armistice.

As a symbol of this promised peace, Noctis, crown prince of Lucis, is to wed the Lady Lunafreya of Tenebrae.

The prince sets forth for his wedding on the eve of the signing ceremony, sent off by his father, King Regis.
Unbeknownst to Noctis, however, the journey ahead is fraught with perils...

1785417254.title: The Oregon Trail
1785417254.short_description: A modern twist on the road to Oregon, this official game will immerse players in historical journeys. Pick your traveling party, stock the wagon with supplies, and embark on an adventure filled with tough choices, new dangers, and unexpected situations.

1785497127.title: Mini Games For PowerWash Simulator

Take the role of a hunter in a flame-retardant hazard suit and equipped with a jet pack as you traverse a wide variety of biomes, from forests and icy mountains to deserts and volcanic caverns. 

But be careful! Each stage is filled with roving enemies. Some monsters attack with brute force, while others carry melee weapons or emit magic projectiles. To even the odds and eliminate them before they take you down, you’ll need to utilize an arsenal of unique firearms, launchers and flamethrowers. 1788008761.title: Crown of the Empire 2: Around the World
1788008761.short_description:
Elena never dreamed of marrying a prince, dancing at balls and being bathed in luxury. While her sisters daydreamed of crowns, gems and new dresses, Elena delved into the darkest caves, explored catacombs in search of eerie secrets and mysteries. And even status of chief maid of honor didn’t dampen her ardor.

Incidentally, the queen never objected to her subject’s daring, bravery and desperate curiosity. Her Majesty had given Elena complex, and sometimes dangerous tasks more than once. Soon Elena and her friends and allies – Percy and Jorik – created a team that could solve any puzzle and handle the most difficult of tasks.

All members of the royal family respected Elena. The maid of honor was particularly friendly with the Prince, the young nephew of His Majesty. He had long dreamed to take part in the adventures of Elena and her team, and he finally got the chance. The queen’s favorite corgi Buttercup went missing. The Prince knew Buttercup better than anyone from the team, which meant he could help Elena and her friends search for the queen’s beloved pet.

As dusk began to fall, the team set off to scour the palace grounds, but Buttercup was nowhere to be found.

“She probably ran off into the woods,” the Prince suggested. “We need to search there.”

Trusting the Prince’s intuition, Elena, Jorik and Percy walked into the woods and followed the young man into its very depths. They walked in complete silence, when suddenly they heard voices and a dog barking nearby. As they crept up to the source of the sound, the friends saw two strangers in masks trying to shove a protesting and snarling corgi into a bag.

“Let’s surround them and capture them,” Percy suggested. The friends nodded in response and split up, cutting off the villains’ retreat. Then a branch treacherously broke beneath the Prince’s feet. They had no time to waste – the friends jumped out of cover and rushed toward the kidnappers, but they dropped the corgi and the bag on the ground and ran into the gloom of the woods.

“Wait, where’s the prince?” Jorik asked, looking from side to side.

It was like the young man had disappeared into thin air.

Join Elena on an incredible adventure through an alternate world of the Victorian era. You'll see incredible Scottish valleys, the rocky cliffs of Malta, a hot desert and much more!

Can good prevail? Will Elena find the missing prince?
In this game, you'll see:
- An incredible alternate world full of amazing mechanisms and mysterious creations!
- An intriguing storyline full of mystical events and cloak-and-dagger secrets.
- Colorful graphics and fun animations. - Enjoy 50 exciting levels in 4 zones.
- 3 game difficulty modes. - Useful bonuses: speed up work, speed up production, run fast.
- Simple controls and a helpful tutorial.
- Over 20 hours of exciting gameplay for any age.
- Fun themed music. Crown of the Empire
- Help the heroes find the missing prince!
