1788255303.title: Street Fighter New York
1788255303.short_description:
Dive into fast-paced, action-packed battles across New York’s toughest streets! Fight powerful enemies, master dynamic combat moves, and push your skills to the limit as each level gets harder and more intense. ⚔️💥
Are you strong enough to conquer the concrete jungle?

1788292351.title: RUSHING BEAT X: Return Of Brawl Brothers
1788292351.short_description: A classic franchise is reborn for modern consoles! Whether you're a newcomer or a veteran, playing solo or with a friend, this game will make you feel the rush!

1788295676.title: Yakuza 4 Remastered
1788295676.short_description:
Experience the fourth chapter of the Kazuma Kiryu saga in 1080p and 60fps.

2010, Tokyo. A shooting incident one night in a red-light district sets the city swirling with human desires and clamor. It was supposed to be a "common incident" for this town... until the appearance of one woman burdened with sorrow. As if drawn to a flame, men of the city's dark underground are gathered, one after another, at the door of the "legendary yakuza" Kazuma Kiryu.

As the fates of these four men overlap, the story of a miracle created by the passionate and violent way of life begins to takes shape.

Take control of multiple protagonists, a first for the series, allowing for unprecedented story depth and battle action. Three new protagonists, each with a rich personality, will leave their impact before the story concludes.

Complete The Dragon of Dojima’s journey.

1788342021.title: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY 2 for Windows
1788342021.short_description:
"FATAL FURY 2" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1992.
Terry, Andy, Joe return from the previous installment along withfive new fighters in order to decide whi is the strongest one.
In addition to Desperation Moves which can change the outcome of the battle, the two-lane plane mechanic is back stronger than ever, allowing players to fight each other in stage backgrounds.

1788451652.title: Project 13: Nightwatch
1788451652.short_description: An intense and immersive game experience where you take on the role of an Observer tasked with guarding the Motherbase of the Project 13 Organization. Your mission is clear: prevent any "Observator Prisoner", each potentially containing a dangerous anomaly, from infiltrating the Project 13 Headquarters. Equipped with a high-tech binocular, your keen observation skills are the key to success.

1788513791.title: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT Demo Version
1788513791.short_description: Experience parts of DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT for free!

1788541017.title: SAMURAI SHODOWN DEMO Ver.
1788541017.short_description:
This is the 2nd demo for SAMURAI SHODOWN.



SAMURAI REBOOT!



Experience the thrilling swordplay by playing SAMURAI SHODOWN.

1788626737.title: Golazo!
1788626737.short_description: Golazo is a dynamic arcade football game with a medium sized fields, no fouls and offsides whistled. Just pure fun! Mastering the game is incredibly easy during the fun and furious 7vs7 matches. With its local multiplayer modes and crazy vintage approach, Golazo is the ideal choice for Couch & Party gamers!

1788639475.title: Deep, In the Forest
1788639475.short_description: Strategic card-based RPG, where you are tasked with liberating the forest kingdom from the tyranny of the Mad King.

1788708666.title: Carto
1788708666.short_description: Carto is a charming adventure game wrapped around a unique, world-altering puzzle mechanic. Use this power to explore mysterious lands, help a quirky cast of characters, and guide Carto on her journey back to her family.

1788751821.title: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
1788751821.short_description: A fast-paced top-down arcade racer where tiny cars tear through giant household tracks. Race solo or with friends in chaotic local multiplayer, dodge hazards, master tight controls, and turn every room in the house into a high-speed battleground.

1788806598.title: Doug's Nightmare
1788806598.short_description:
Brawl with inner demons as a self-doubting banana in a wacky mix of twin-stick bullet hell and beat ’em up action!

What is a banana to do when he’s haunted by anxiety and inner demons? Doug’s Nightmare is a cartoony, hand-drawn bullet hell where your job is to help Doug the banana overcome his worst fears by pounding them into oblivion! Part top-down twin-stick shooter and part beat ’em up, Doug’s Nightmare pits you against swarms of bugs, mushrooms, floating brains and more!

Doug can punch when disarmed or pick up a wide variety of weaponry to fend off foes, from slimy squirt guns to spiky clubs. He can don shoes, gloves, cloaks, sunglasses and a wacky wardrobe to improve stats and look stylish as he gains the confidence he’ll need to take on the biggest baddies! Can you guide him to victory?

1788815366.title: Airi's World
1788815366.short_description:
Visit Airi’s World and Join the Adventure.

Keep Airi happy searching items and doing fun activities in several environments.

Visit the House, the Town, the Mountain, the Beach and have a Fun Adventure.

Changing Clothing, Swimming in the Ocean, Riding a Horse, Eating Food, and many other fun Airi’s activities you can enjoy within this game.

Features:

- More than 6 different outfits
- Four Game Enviroments
- More than 10 different activities
- Several quests to solve in each enviroment

*The Cat and the Walking People seen in the trailer are not included in this version.

1788911016.title: Murder Diaries 3 - Santa's Trail of Blood
1788911016.short_description:
In this game you abstractly follow the narration of a young man who slowly but surely becomes insane. 
This leads you straight into the middle of an exciting murder case and a murder mystery unfolds while you listen to the testimonies of witness, friends and relatives.

1788936172.title: We Were Here Too
1788936172.short_description: As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance, towering above the relentless storm. Discover the truth behind this dark castle in a communication-based, cooperative puzzle adventure.

1788955756.title: Yars Rising
1788955756.short_description: From the renowned development studio WayForward Technologies, Inc. (Shantae, River City Girls, Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp) comes Yars Rising, a 2D action adventure exploration of one of Atari’s richest, and best known classic titles.

1789081434.title: Hazel Sky
1789081434.short_description: Hazel Sky is a heartfelt adventure about a young engineer facing his destiny and his desires. Fix ramshackle flying machines and jump, climb, swing, and slide through a beautiful, mysterious world.

1789091683.title: Rain World
1789091683.short_description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

1789135808.title: Prison Alone
1789135808.short_description: Feel the tension and suspense in this psychological horror game!

1789157539.title: Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2
1789157539.short_description:
Puzzle Legends Reunite for the Ultimate Crossover

Japan’s beloved puzzle game series Puyo Puyo and world-renowned Tetris® team up again to deliver even more fun. Play traditional Puyo Puyo and Tetris…or mix them together to level up your game.

1789274689.title: John Wick : Save The Dog
1789274689.short_description:
John Wick : Save The Dog Game By Asw Studio !
Are you a John Wick fan?

This game is for you!

You know what to do to save your dog!

Destroy other assassins sent on you by Parabellum!

Enjoy this game with great controls by sharing it with your friends!

1789318977.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
1789318977.short_description: Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs. Want to save Bikini Bottom from lots of rampant robots? Of course you do! Want to underpants bungee jump? Why wouldn't you! Want to join forces in a brand new multiplayer mode? The battle is on!

1789366577.title: Junkyard Builder
1789366577.short_description: Satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle!

1789385168.title: ACA NEOGEO BLUE'S JOURNEY
1789385168.short_description:
BLUE'S JOURNEY is a side-scrolling action game released by SNK in 1991. 
In order to save the planet Raguy from the invasion of the Daruma tribe, the hero Blue must fight using leaves, boomerangs, and a variety of other weapons along with his special ability to change his body size. 
The branching stages allow you to enjoy the game again and again.

1789418618.title: Creepy Shift: House For Sale
1789418618.short_description:
Handyman needed - ASAP! The investor is coming in the morning and the house is still not ready. Take on an extra shift where horror meets simulation. Tackle the chaos, uncover dark secrets, and finish the job before dawn.

Your gig is simple, well-paid and pretty chill. Pack up the Kowalskis’ belongings, clean the house and do a few repairs. The property has to be ready for sale so make sure there are no skeletons in the closet… literally.

Just press PLAY and enter the world of dusty VHS horror.

Key Features:
- First-person gameplay
- Handyman / home-repair simulation
- Survival mechanics
- Repair & clean-up tasks under pressure
- Grim puzzle-solving
- Earning money under time pressure

*Game inspired by creepypastas and the “rules to follow” trope.

1789470804.title: IXION
1789470804.short_description: IXION is an unrelenting, city-building odyssey across the stars.

1789607751.title: Tiles: The Game
1789607751.short_description: Tiles is a fast-paced action puzzle game that will both convolute your mind and burn your finger tips!

1789609180.title: Road Stones
1789609180.short_description:
Discover the true power of magical crystals in Road Stones! By any means necessary stop the hordes of undead monsters with their sole aim to destroy any living souls. Try to be the brave and bold hero that is desperately needed in this monster-infested kingdom.

Become the savior in this action-packed strategy combining arcade and strategy gameplay inspired by the “tower defense” genre. Stop the evil-doers and then return to your magical tower and chill a bit until any next time the world will need your services once again!

1789787818.title: Vampire Crawlers Demo
1789787818.short_description: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turn‑based deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the TURBOTURNTTM with your own hands of cards.

1789832958.title: A Little Lily Princess
1789832958.short_description: A classic literary tale of a princess who becomes a pauper.

1789844462.title: Alex the Rabbit (Xbox Series)
1789844462.short_description: Alex the Rabbit is a classic 2D platform game where you control an adventurous rabbit. Collect carrots scattered across the map, face challenges, and win the Golden Carrot at the end of each level. There are 20 levels and 4 bosses in a fun retro-style adventure.

1789922063.title: Hidden Cats in Rome
1789922063.short_description: Meow-ma mia! The great city of Rome is full of cats!

1789928182.title: Finding the Soul Orb
1789928182.short_description:
Wield your crossbow both as a weapon of defense and a tool to solve the puzzles of a dark fantasy realm!

The high wizards created the Soul Orb, and for ages it has served the kingdom well. Now it calls to Alexander in his dreams, and he is determined to uncover its location. Finding the Soul Orb is a medieval fantasy game where you must use a crossbow both as a weapon against creatures of the night as well as a tool to solve environmental puzzles across 12 immersive chapters.

Presented in first-person perspective, this is a story-driven adventure that blurs the line between haunting realism and surreal dreamscapes, a journey that tests the mind and will of the player in one instance and invites exploration and discovery the next, ever balanced between light and dark. Will you survive to see it through?

1789981590.title: ACA NEOGEO TWINKLE STAR SPRITES for Windows
1789981590.short_description: TWINKLE STAR SPRITES is a competitive shooting game released by SNK in 1996. Utilize Chain Explosions, Power Shots, and Bombs to defeat the incoming Enemy Golems, changing them into Attack Characters to assault your opponent! Experience a new style of shooting game with more than enough cute characters flying around to fill the sky!

1790024475.title: Zumba - Treasure of the Marble Sea
1790024475.short_description: Set sail on a marble-blasting adventure! In Zumba – Treasure of the Marble Sea, shoot, match, and explode marbles before they reach the end. Unlock powerful upgrades, earn stars, and journey through pirate-themed worlds!

1790138032.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES
1790138032.short_description:
"WORLD HEROES" is a fighting game that was originally released by SNK in 1992.
Eight characters based on historical celebrities such as Hattori Hanzo and Rasputin will fight each other to become the world's strongest champion. In addition to the Normal mode, a Deathmatch Mode featuring various stages full of traps awaits you for merciless battles!

1790154846.title: Heart Box
1790154846.short_description: Professor Rat created Robby but gave him a weak battery, which is why our hero has to constantly recharge and participate in crazy experiments.

1790216132.title: Hades
1790216132.short_description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion.

1790217657.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
1790217657.short_description:
This time, the terror has followed you home.

In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows. Playing as a child whose role is yet unknown, you must safeguard yourself until 6am by watching the doors, as well as warding off unwanted creatures that may venture into your closet or onto the bed behind you.

You have only a flashlight to protect yourself. It will scare away things that may be creeping at the far end of the hallways, but be careful, and listen. If something has crept too close, then shining lights in its eyes will be your end.

1790332447.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
1790332447.short_description:
Made for Alien fans. Built for action-horror. Re-envisioned for Xbox.

Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks in the terrifying first chapter of a two-part saga set between the Alien and Aliens films. Sent to investigate a distress call on the remote planet Purdan, Zula uncovers a secret Weyland-Yutani blacksite overrun by deadly Xenomorphs.

Stalking, hunting, and attacking at every turn, these Xenomorphs' ferocity is matched only by their unpredictability. Aided by your synth companion, Davis 01, fight and survive using your weapons, skills, and sheer determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping original story.

Rebuilt for Xbox with stunning visuals, 60 fps, 3D audio, haptic feedback, and adaptive triggers, Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition delivers a cinematic action experience that makes you truly feel like you’re inside the world of Alien.

1790410374.title: Pushy and Pully in Blockland Demo
1790410374.short_description: Pushy and Pully in Blockland is an endearing co-op arcade game that will take you and a friend through ever-challenging levels. Kill monsters, match blocks, defeats bosses. Recover your spaceship and escape Blockland.

1790425501.title: PopSlinger
1790425501.short_description:
A vibrant musical shooter inspired by 90s anime!

Immerse yourself in the lively world of PopSlinger, a musical narrative shooter full of pop culture 
references, where you'll blast sinister invaders with soda-powered weapons to an award-winning Future 
Funk soundtrack!

1790450960.title: Green Giant in Miami
1790450960.short_description:
Green Giant in Miami Game ! 

Guide our Green Giant Hero to do his quests on the streets of Miami!

Complete all levels successfully!

It's a time pass game made for Hulk fans!

1790459892.title: Suika Wan! (Xbox Series X/S)
1790459892.short_description: Suika Wan! is a delightfully chaotic puzzle where tiny doggos drop, bounce, and fuse into bigger, fluffier friends, from pomeranians, to french bulldogs, to siberian huskies, each time adding a bigger breed to the screen!

1790537707.title: Core Keeper
1790537707.short_description: Can you uncover the secrets of the core and return to the world above?

1790545959.title: Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield
1790545959.short_description: Discover pulse-pounding stylized parkour action as you run, jump, smash, and slide through an afro-futurist-inspired kingdom. Enjoy a single-player or two-player local cooperative mode and experience the story of two brothers and their unexpected return to their lost kingdom.

1790555170.title: Safari Pinball
1790555170.short_description: Make a Safari through Africa in the most entertaining Pinball!

1790559387.title: Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx
1790559387.short_description: Paris needs a hero! Once again, the city of lights is in trouble as it faces a new menace—the most threatening sentimonster ever created is about to take control! As you take on the personas of the globally renowned superheroez Ladybug and Cat Noir, you’ll need to unveil the diabolical plan hatched by archvillain Hawk Moth—and squash it!

1790588251.title: Amoeba Battle - Microscopic RTS Action
1790588251.short_description:
Amoeba Battle is a new breed of real-time strategy game where you control versatile amoebas in the battle for the microscopic world. Unlike other RTS games, there are no bases to build - new amoebas are created through the miracle of binary fission! 

First though, your amoebas must forage for food in the beautiful yet alien environments that make up their world. Once well fed, these amoebas can replicate into two identical amoebas of the same type, doubling your army with a press of a button!

But multiplying amoebas won't always be enough. You will need to introduce mutations to evolve your weaker amoebas into stronger species. Experiment with different amoeba combinations to field a diverse force that can face any threat!

TAKE BACK THE MICROSCOPIC WORLD - Stop the infection and destroy its source in the varied and intense twelve mission campaign with four difficulty levels.

18 PLAYER FREE FOR ALL - Compete against other players in our 18-player free-for-all Versus mode or take on the AI in Skirmish, either solo or with up to two friends.

DELIGHTFUL ART STYLE - Journey through four exotic landscapes and battle with nine species of amoeba, all delicately rendered using a remarkable fusion of watercolors and pixel art. 

Experience an innovative real-time strategy game on a never-before-seen scale and battle for primordial soup-remacy in Amoeba Battle!

1790601437.title: Another World the Artifact
1790601437.short_description: this is a short game made for a game jam, with the purpose of demonstrating old graphics.

1790602115.title: Aery - Calm Mind 3
1790602115.short_description:
Aery - Calm Mind 3 is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. 
 You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

1790640537.title: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
1790640537.short_description: Step into the greaves of King Arthur in this fantasy action roguelite and wield the Broken Excalibur in a quest to rescue the scattered citizens of Camelot, vanquish the calamitous Void Giant, and escape from the Astral Dimension once and for all.

1790739309.title: Ad Infinitum
1790739309.short_description:
When reality is a nightmare, nightmares become real.
In this psychological horror game, you fight the terrifying creatures invading your mind. Can you save your sanity?

1790750119.title: Aeroplane Simulator 3D
1790750119.short_description: Airplane Simulator 3D is a thrilling multiplayer flying game where players can pilot a variety of realistic aircraft in an immersive 3D environment. Choose from different planes, engage in multiplayer dogfights, and experience the adrenaline rush of flying in this high-flying adventure.

1790764870.title: Geometric Sniper - Blood in Paris
1790764870.short_description: Katy, a French sniper, needs to protect her magnificent city!

1790829985.title: Speedollama
1790829985.short_description: Speedollama is a fast platformer shooter that sets a new benchmark for speed in the genre. Bursting with quirky humor and vibrant pixelated carnage, this game is not for the faint of heart. Are you ready to embrace the chaos and prove your skills?

1790921256.title: The Evil Within® 2 (PC)
1790921256.short_description: Detective Sebastian Castellanos has lost everything, including his daughter, Lily. To save her, he must descend into the nightmarish world of STEM. Horrifying threats emerge from every corner, and he must rely on his wits to survive. For his one chance at redemption, the only way out is in.

1790958152.title: Spinner Mania
1790958152.short_description: Do you like fidget spinners? This is the right game for you just try it.

1791008237.title: Unknow place
1791008237.short_description: Please note: This game was created for the '5min Dungeon Crawler' Game Jam, and due to the tight development schedule, many features may not be fully optimized or work perfectly. Brave the dark and challenging corridors of this dungeon exploration game in just five minutes as you face monsters and hunt for treasures. While there may be some imperfections, the fun and excitement of a quick and thrilling adventure are guaranteed.

1791015991.title: Nuclear Blaze
1791015991.short_description: Nuclear Blaze is a dynamic 2D Action game in which the player plays as a firefighter air-dropped in the middle of a mysterious burning facility.

1791030843.title: The Heroic Knight (XBOX ONE)
1791030843.short_description: A fast-paced fantasy platformer about traps, enemies, and a heroic knight’s quest.

1791067482.title: Flowers by POWGI
1791067482.short_description: This unique anagram puzzle is a bunch of fun! Plant letters on the petals to grow words through the middle of the flower!

1791084588.title: Primal Survivors (Windows)
1791084588.short_description: Get ready for the wildest and most thrilling adventure!

1791245577.title: ㅤㅤㅤㅤ
1791245577.short_description:
Nothing to see lol
ShadowGarden <3
https://discord.gg/modder.

1791288383.title: Mickey Storm and the Cursed Mask
1791288383.short_description: Spy up and save your parents in this action-packed platformer! Welcome to the world’s greatest waterpark! In this resort full of wild adventures and thrilling waterslides only you, and your sister, can stop the evil Dr. Fisher! Using the powers of a mysterious mask this vicious villain has enchanted the entire park to finally trap your parents.

1791290525.title: Mini Madness
1791290525.short_description:
Mini Madness is an arcade racing game inspired by such titles as Re-Volt or Micro Machines. 
Players are racing on crazy, expanded vertically tracks placed in a single-family house and in its large garden, by taking control over miniature remote cars.

1791296322.title: All of Us Are Dead...
1791296322.short_description: All of us are not dead. Our school has been infested with zombies, and we are still alive. Every day, our hopes of escaping this school become less and less likely. Follow us as we try to survive and escape our zombie-filled school. A visual novel based on the popular webcomic.

1791400679.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon
1791400679.short_description:
Become Ichiban Kasuga, a low-ranking yakuza grunt left on the brink of death by the man he trusted most. Take up your legendary bat and get ready to crack some underworld skulls in dynamic RPG combat set against the backdrop of modern-day Japan in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.

Russian and Brazilian Portuguese subtitles available in early 2021 via patch update.

Game leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X|S title when available.

1791488085.title: Rogue Pursuit
1791488085.short_description: Blast your way to a high score by using 9 powerful weapons against 5 deadly enemies. Dodge missiles, c4, spikes, and bullets as you avoid being eliminated. Compete against your friends to see who can get the best high score!

1791497779.title: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
1791497779.short_description: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into a journey filled with intrigue, deception, and unexpected revelations.

1791537867.title: Seeds of Resilience
1791537867.short_description: Ready to start anew? Build a village from scratch. Learn to choose the right items, understand nature's patterns, use real life-based constructions, and craft techniques in this turn-based tycoon game.

1791598817.title: Cats and the Other Lives
1791598817.short_description: Explore the reunion of a broken family from the perspective of the house cat.

1791601996.title: X-Force Genesis X|S Edition
1791601996.short_description: In this thrilling vertical scrolling game, you will revisit the great classics from the golden age of 8 and 16-bit gaming.

1791604637.title: Sonic.Time.Twisted
1791604637.short_description: Sonic Time Twisted is an unofficial classic-style Sonic the Hedgehog fangame that has been in development for 12 years with time travel, accurate physics, custom pixel art, a fully original CD-quality soundtrack, and sprawling zones with loops, gizmos, alternate routes, and hidden secrets! Stop Metal Sonic from capturing the Time Stones and resurrecting his former master.

1791707434.title: A Castle Full of Cats
1791707434.short_description: An atmospheric hidden object game with cat drama, cat betrayal… and cat love.

1791838609.title: Shatter Remastered Deluxe
1791838609.short_description: Relive the award-winning classic that redefined the brick-breaking genre.

1791848805.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream OPEN NETWORK TEST
1791848805.short_description: Select your character and choose between two modes to try in the SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream OPEN NETWORK TEST: Boss Raid or Co-op Quest!

1791949165.title: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders
1791949165.short_description: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders is an action-adventure RPG with base-building elements, where you take on the role of a classic hero who stands up to the tyranny and injustice that haunts Sherwood. Fight, craft, steal, and of course help the local people grow and prosper.

1791966220.title: Flaskoman for Windows 10
1791966220.short_description: Flaskoman is a puzzle platformer in a steampunk laboratory. Use mysterious liquids to activate lab mechanism and your abilities. Pass the test chambers and achieve freedom!

1792011119.title: Anime Girls Mini Puzzles
1792011119.short_description:
Mini Puzzle Anime Girls brings cute girl and minimalistic puzzles to your console.
Chose between 6 different puzzle sizes and 20 different adorable anime girl pictures and start completing your own puzzle girls.

1792046205.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Last Recollection DEMO
1792046205.short_description:
This is a demo for SWORD ART ONLINE Last Recollection. Players are able to experience the opening chapter of the game on this demo. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the retail version.

The culmination of the SWORD ART ONLINE game series, Last Recollection features the largest roster of SAO playable characters and sub scenarios!

1792055040.title: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure One More Time (Xbox One)
1792055040.short_description: Max is back in this adventure. He's depending on you to get the legendary diamond and overcome various challenges!

1792108303.title: Zomborg
1792108303.short_description: A gritty top-down shooter in a zombie apocalypse wasteland.

1792128139.title: Legend of Ixtona
1792128139.short_description: Fight turn-based strategy battles and save the kingdom of Ixtona!

1792153167.title: Sokobear Autumn
1792153167.short_description:
Autumn has arrived — and with it, a not-so-light mission for our friendly Bear!

The leaves won’t stop falling, and the forest village yards are completely covered. Now it’s up to the Bear to roll up his sleeves (or paws!) and put everything back in order. Embark on a relaxing yet clever journey by solving sokoban-style puzzles: push piles of leaves, navigate around rocks and logs, and find the perfect path to the garden holes.

There are 40 carefully crafted yards, each bringing a new challenge to test your logic and planning. Roll the leaves into big piles, clear your way by breaking obstacles when needed, and think a few steps ahead so you don’t get stuck!

Are the leaves still falling? Yes. But that’s a problem for Future Bear.

Right now, the task is simple: clean everything.

With cozy visuals, a charming autumn atmosphere, and satisfying puzzles to solve, this is the perfect game for players seeking a relaxing, challenging, and delightful experience.

Clean yards mean happy neighbors.
And well-solved puzzles mean happy players.

1792195884.title: Trust No One
1792195884.short_description: You'll need to think outside more than just the box. In "Trust No One,” a point-and-click detective adventure, you play as a journalist who tries to unravel a web of secrets about a mysterious AI-company. Explore the nooks and alleyways of Kyiv to discover the identity of your informant.

1792227428.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
1792227428.short_description: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in a first-person, single-player adventure set between the events of Raiders of the Lost Ark™ and The Last Crusade™. The year is 1937, sinister forces are scouring the globe for the secret to an ancient power connected to the Great Circle, and only one person can stop them - Indiana Jones™.

1792235703.title: The Chase of Ellen_TGA21Demo
1792235703.short_description: Your spaceship just crash landed on an alien planet and you are fighting for your life just to survive. 1793492538.title: SimAirport
1793492538.short_description:
You control everything, from the cruise-altitude decisions to the smallest ground-level details.

Challenge yourself to create an efficient & profitable international hub in Career Mode, or create an artistic masterpiece without credit rating worries in Sandbox Mode.

Construct your terminal, hire staff, sign airline contracts, tweak the daily flight schedule, configure standby gate availability, plan & design your infrastructure -- bag handling systems, roads & taxiways, fuel systems, runways, gates, hangars, service vehicles, and everything in between. Deeply simulated gameplay where each detail makes an impact -- down to the trash cans.

Simple & familiar controls for a smooth takeoff
The starter airport helps get aircraft landing & cash flowing almost immediately. Aim for profitability by scaling up, but remember: more passengers, more problems! Getting 2,000 pax out is easy. Avoiding bottlenecks for 10k+ pax will likely require different tactics!

Large & complex airports require extremely smart designs.
Moving walkways, multi-story structures, additional terminals, one-way taxiways, staggered schedules, and careful standby gate allocation -- these are but a sampling of the concepts you'll leverage on your way to truly mastering the art of large-scale airport operations.

One size does NOT fit all.
It seems simple, placing restrooms or retail areas for instance -- but it's more than meets the eye! Pax may become distracted when seating or interesting services require a long walk or are far from their gate! Carefully consider the details to truly maximize your efficiency and reap the profits.

Happy Pax, Happy Airline.
Getting flights out on-time is only part of the battle. Ensuring passengers catch their flight is another. When operations run smoothly & pax are all happily catching their flights you can be pretty sure that the airlines are probably satisfied, too! If you keep the airlines happy you can probably raise prices without creating too much fuss -- and that leads to bigger profits!

Core Gameplay
Career Mode & Sandbox Mode (unlimited funds)
16+ Aircraft, turboprop to turbine. 15 Airlines with realistic high-quality textures.
15+ research items to obtain improved transit, reporting, expansion, and other capabilities

Comprehensive Fuel System Simulation
Fuel can be a profitable saving grace or you may even decide to sell at-or-below cost as a loss-leader tactic in your effort to gain favor with airlines. Leverage the Fuel Marketplace as much as you can, too -- with enough capacity you may be able to cash in on any arbitrage opportunities that present themselves which can provide a welcome capital infusion.

Deeply Simulated Baggage Handling Systems
Conveyor to carousel, every single bag is tracked -- watch as each piece of luggage makes its journey. Losing bags is a sure way to upset an individual pax, but it also starts causing issues with the airline when occurring often. Bag handling systems can be quite complicated and you definitely don't want to become a case study like KDEN has! Take it slow and plan ahead -- building a highly efficient baggage handling operation is no easy task and requires careful planning!

Pax Info Systems
Info displays, kiosks, and public address speaker systems complete with Electronics zones to house the required amplifiers. Keep pax informed and they'll have a greater sense of urgency as their departure time nears and they're be far less likely to needlessly wander from their gate.

Robust Queues
Extremely powerful queue system provides you with full control. Supports numerous configurations include 'one-to-many' desks, to assign a single queue to multiple service stations. Optionally allows restrictions to be set per queue to allow/restrict certain types of people from using the queue (First Class, Coach, and Flight Crew) which you can leverage to create expedited queues for operational efficiency purposes.

1795554480.short_description: There’s plenty to unlock and discover in Canterbury Trails Park. Ride along as Barbie™, and Barbie with your horse, Lucky on this wild adventure.

1796401317.title: Factory Escape (Windows)
1796401317.short_description: Has work ever tried to kill you? Max is trapped in a deadly factory. Use your rolling skill, dodge traps, and find the key to escape!

1796412419.title: Blind Fate: Edo no Yami
1796412419.short_description: Dive into a world that mixes Sci-Fi and ancient tradition. 1796424069.title: Malu the Princess
1796424069.short_description: Help Malu reclaim her stolen crown in an amazing platform adventure!

1796519224.title: Intruders: Hide and Seek
1796519224.short_description:

In this new tense experience you become Ben, the eldest of the Richter family children. While on vacation at a country house, you’re the witness to three dangerous intruders slipping into the house and taking your parents hostage.

With your parents restrained and your sister hiding, you’re stuck in the house with the intruders. You’ll have to find a way to save your family while you figure out who the three assailants are and what they want.

Now they’ve devised evil plans to extract that happiness to power their deadly weapons.

El Gancho is set in the same universe as Task Force Kampas, but this time there's no help around. Play as a coco that finds an experimental laser-hook and swing your way through cosmic platforming stages in retro pixel art style! Search for your friends and destroy those imperial super weapons! The faster you move, the longer your trail becomes, and your trail can be used to wipe out enemies! Every run is randomly generated and unique, giving you a world of reasons to keep coming back and pushing your skills further.

1797327516.title: Palworld

1797618837.short_description:

1797622038.title: Wild West Tycoon
1797622038.short_description:
Welcome to the untamed frontier! In "Wild West Tycoon" you are tasked with transforming the rugged Wild West into a thriving economic powerhouse. This low-poly style simulation game invites you to master the art of frontier entrepreneurship where every decision counts and every enterprise takes you one step closer to building a legendary empire.

Features:
Frontier Agriculture: Cultivate a variety of Wild West crops such as Prairie Corn, Frontier Beans, and Pioneer Pumpkins. Each plant has unique requirements and benefits, challenging you to adapt and innovate farming techniques suitable for the Wild West.

Town Building: Design and develop your own Wild West town from the ground up. Construct essential structures like saloons, general stores, and stables to ensure your town's growth and prosperity.

Resource Management: Carefully manage limited resources such as water, timber, and gold. Make critical decisions to balance resource consumption with town expansion and efficiency.

Research and Development: Unlock advanced technologies through research to improve your farming and building capabilities. Experiment with innovative irrigation systems and durable building materials to thrive in the harsh conditions of the Wild West.

Survival Challenges: Face the realities of Wild West life, including droughts, dust storms, and bandit raids, which can threaten your crops and town's survival. Dynamic weather and event systems require quick thinking and robust contingency planning.

Stunning Low-Poly Graphics: Enjoy a visually striking low-poly art style that brings the beauty and roughness of the Wild West to life. The simplistic yet captivating graphics make building your empire a truly enchanting experience.

Embark on a unique entrepreneurial journey with "Wild West Tycoon Empire." Can you tame the wild frontier and build a new home for settlers?

1797639733.title: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village
1797639733.short_description: Seek the whiskers in the dark... Find the cats in the Spooky Village!

1797756676.title: 2D Car Parking Master
1797756676.short_description:
Put your driving skills to the ultimate test in Xbox Parking Master 2D! This isn't just about parking; it's a race against the clock where precision meets adrenaline.

Experience a top-down driving simulation built with a robust physics engine that rewards careful throttle control and sharp maneuvering. Feel the weight of the car as you drift around corners and squeeze into tight spots. But be warned: you are in Speed Run Mode. You have only 15 seconds to complete each level!

One scratch, one bump, and your damage meter rises. Too much damage, or run out of time, and it's game over. Do you have the nerves of steel to become the Parking Master?

Key Features

Intense Speed Run Mode: No time for hesitation. You have a strict 15-second timer for every level. Park fast, or fail.

Realistic 2D Physics: Experience authentic car handling with acceleration, braking, drag, and drift mechanics.

Dynamic Audio Engine: Immerse yourself with a reactive sound system featuring realistic engine revs, idle rumbles, and tire screeching sounds on hard turns.

20 Challenging Levels: From simple parking lots to complex obstacle courses with moving traffic and tight pillars.

Damage System: Watch your health bar! Collisions with walls, other cars, or obstacles will damage your vehicle.

Full Controller Support: Optimized for Xbox controllers with rumble feedback support for collisions and successful parking.

Keyboard & Mouse Support: Play your way with full keyboard compatibility.

Get ready. The countdown has started. 3... 2... 1... PARK!

1797796342.title: Eastern Exorcist

Art Direction
All hand-drawn Chinese ink painting style, with many atmospheric scenes.

Combat System

Storyline
Experience a complicated journey with joy and sorrow as an exorcist. 

Cutscenes

1798309304.title: Hayfever
1798309304.short_description: Help Thomas the Allergic Mailman gather all his lost letters in this challenging and unique 2D platformer! In Hayfever, the player takes control of Thomas – a young postman with a strong work ethic. There is just one tiny little issue… Thomas suffers from terrible (and we mean TERRIBLE) allergies.

1798390769.title: Ghoulboy
1798390769.short_description:
Find powerful weapons, items and spells to defeat your enemies and explore a magical realm of dungeons, towns, treasures and devious monsters.

Ghoulboy is a retro-inspired style action platformer. Exciting new platformer that combines the action-RPG genre with hack 'n' slash gameplay. 
2D action, heroic characters, gloomy environments, demonic bosses, these all seem to excite players a lot. Pixels will be combined with other cool retro elements and the result will certainly be something that will meet the needs. 

Once in-game, users will get to control a heroic character who will often be seen throwing a spear to create additional platforms. To boot, puzzle and combat elements will further enhance the experience. You wouldn’t want to miss out on it. With the gold that you collect, you can increase your health level, your arsenal of weapons to be thrown away.
Slay as many monsters as you can, collect loot, avoid dangerous traps and defeat menacing bosses.

Ghoulboy brings back the look and feel of the very best classic retro platformers from the 90's, introducing refreshed and engaging gameplay mechanics. If you miss platformers from the 16-bit era, and think games nowadays aren't that good anymore, think twice! Ghoulboy is for you.

1798400755.title: Pathologic 2
1798400755.short_description: Pathologic 2 is a narrative-driven dramatic thriller about fighting a deadly outbreak in a secluded rural town. You are a healer, and to save anyone, you'll have to survive in this bleak and strange world, where even food and medicine are scarce.

1798477678.title: AO Tennis 2
1798477678.short_description: AO Tennis 2 is the only tennis experience designed for and by its community. Create your own players, stadiums and legendary matches. Enter the competition to reach the top of world tennis in Career Mode.

1798547536.title: Paperman: Adventure Delivered
1798547536.short_description: Meet Paperman and the team in an adventure to find the lost mail and defeat the greedy dragon. Explore colorful worlds and collect all golden letters in this 3D collectathon platformer!

1798561540.title: Project Motor Racing (PC)
1798561540.short_description:
Project Motor Racing ignites all the passion, beauty, and intensity of professional motorsport.

The Best, Nothing Less
Race across eras in 70 meticulously recreated cars across 13 iconic classes & 28 global layouts.

* Cars: From today’s radical LMDh Hypercars to history’s most iconic legends, each vehicle is a licensed masterpiece
* Circuits: Scanned for ultimate precision and authenticity

Racing For All
From sim racers to first-time racers, Project Motor Racing delivers:
* Single Player Career
* Online Racing Modes 
* In-Game Events
* Packed 4-Class Race Experience

Simulation Refined
* First Principle Physics: New physics engine delivers unmatched handling realism and high-fidelity FFB 
* Benchmark-Setting Physics Engine built on mod-friendly GIANTS Engine 10
* Factory Driver Program: Every car’s handling painstakingly tested and approved by brand partners and hundreds of the world's top racing pros to assure authentic levels of handling precision
* Immersive Sound Design: Motorsport’s ferocity captured like never before

Feel Every Second
* “Living” cockpits with visible G-forces, heat-haze, etc.
* True2Track
 - Dynamic Weather Conditions
 - Adaptive Racing & Drying Line 
 - 24-hour day/night cycle.

1798643426.title: Dead Age II
1798643426.short_description:
Dead Age 2 is a unique combination of survival, management, Rogue-Like events, fast turn-based combat, classic role-playing game with tons of quests and a story in which your decisions directly affect plot progression!

10 years after the initial outbreak of the zombie apocalypse, the members of Jack's camp fled to Freedom City, where a cure for the zombie plague was developed. But the news brings more suffering than relief. New factions have sprung up in the region, in constant battle for dominance. The merciless Military, the shady Smugglers and the Independents made up primarily of civilians.

When an Independents' refugee camp was overrun by an undead horde, the few survivors struggle for food and valuable resources in an unforgiving world, always looking over their shoulder for gangs of looters and the flesh-eating dead.

Features
• More complex story with no knowledge of the previous storyline necessary: If you haven't played Dead Age you will still be able to follow the diverse story of Dead Age 2 without difficulty.
• Improved combat system: with fast-paced yet strategic battles and use of up to 24 skills
• Faction Reputation System: Increase your standing with the three major factions to reap rewards and improve trade
• 3D Base-Management: Assign tasks to survivors, craft items and expand you camp's capabilities for improved crafting options
• Compact Open World: Free exploration of the world map with 80 detailed locations to search for valuable resources
• Decisions with Consequences: Your decisions directly affect the story in a much more drastic way. Dead Age 2 has six unique possible endings
• Rogue-Like Elements: random 3D events with permadeath! If you die, you may purchase upgrades unlocked in previous runs for your next playthrough. Choose from 3 difficulty levels.

1798666879.title: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals
1798666879.short_description:
Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals is a multiplayer horror game where players take on the role of monsters and mortals from the Dark Deception universe (and others) and battle each other in nightmarish mazes. Some mazes will look familiar to Dark Deception fans, but many will be completely new! Monsters & Mortals has multiple gameplay modes to play with your friends:

1. Maze Escape: (4 v 2) Four mortals must collect the required number of shards to summon the portal & escape, while two monsters seek to stop or kill them before the time expires.

2. Shard Mayhem: Monsters only mode. 6 players compete against one another in a free for all to collect the most shards in the time limit provided. Shards spawn in waves and can be stolen from other players by attacking or killing them.

3. Soul Collection: 6 Mortals compete for shards in order to save their own soul. At the end of each shard wave, Malak will come for the player with the fewest shards and take their soul. They will become a monster and must hunt down the remaining mortal survivors. In the end, only one mortal will win the right to keep their soul.

Here are some of the key features of Monsters & Mortals:

- Unique mazes inspired by & taken from the hit game, Dark Deception.
- Powerful ultimate abilities unique to each character.
- Turn the tables with trap & boss activations. Monsters & Mortals adds new never-before-seen bosses!
- Collect item boxes to gain powers, health, trap items, status effects, and more!

1799175961.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 7
1799175961.short_description:
UP SHOT

You constantly run to the right, and your goal is to avoid squares falling on you from above. Hold the button to shoot upward and destroy the squares, but you'll remain stationary while shooting. Large squares require multiple shots.
The game ends when a square hits you.

SMILY ANGRY

You're constantly running and can turn with the press of a button. Two faces shoot at you above you. They can be happy or angry. Your goal is to collect shots from the happy face to score points and avoid shots from the angry face. The faces randomly change their emotions.
The game ends when you're shot by the angry face.

V BOMB

You control a plane that constantly flies from side to side. Press the button to turn. Enemies fly beneath you and slowly approach your position. Enemies drop time bombs that explode upward. Your goal is to avoid the explosions and try to lure enemies into the blast. When the bombs are very close to each other, they explode in a chain reaction.
The game ends when you are caught in the blast or an enemy touches you.

PIN CLIMB

You score points by climbing pins. Hold the button to increase your reach. Try to avoid the pins that are below you.
The game ends when you reach the bottom of the screen.

NUMBER LINE

There are two lines of moving numbers on the screen. Press the button to sum the numbers in both lines. You score points when the sum in the top line is greater than the sum in the bottom line. When the top sum is less than the bottom sum, your score decreases and the lines become closer together.
The game ends when the lines intersect.

1799391615.title: Endless Fables: Dark Moor (Xbox One Version)
1799391615.short_description: During her new adventure, Pamela Cavendish goes to a misty and mysterious Scotland where a seemingly innocent landscape of moor quickly reveals its dark nature. Spectre from the past and ghostly sounds will force her to follow the amazing legend of the Red Moon.

1799432498.title: Disc Room
1799432498.short_description:
Are you ready to get sliced in half? The year is 2089 and a giant disc has appeared in orbit of Jupiter. Step into the oversized space suit of a brave scientist and explore this sprawling intergalactic slaughterhouse.

1799437756.short_description:
In the year 2150, the planets of Kepler were discovered to be inhabitable and soon afterward were colonized by humans. People lived peacefully on the Kepler planets until Emperor Romeo took them over. Now you are being sent to take back the planets and save the humans.

However, what seems like a simple search soon unravels into a web of conspiracies, revealing the dark secrets hidden beneath the end of the world...

Unique HD Voxel Art Style
Highly stylized voxel environments where most objects are destructible, bringing an immersive and dynamic combat experience.

Challenging & Unique Boss Fights
Face off against horrifying bosses like the mutated head chef, an infected armored truck, and a deceitful faction leader. Each battle demands skill and strategy!

Immersive Story & Sound Design
From the echoes of gunfire to the eerie whispers of a dying world, every sound enhances the atmosphere. Paired with a gripping narrative, you'll find yourself fully absorbed in Annie's journey.

Love and betrayal, conspiracy and choice, humanity and survival... The truth of the apocalypse is waiting to be uncovered.

Join Annie on her journey for survival and discover the Last Hope!

1801844275.title: Milo: Paws & Buoys (Windows)

Set across sunny beaches and cozy poolside scenarios, each level presents a compact, handcrafted puzzle where players must carefully plan every move. With simple grid-based controls and intuitive mechanics, the game is easy to learn yet deeply satisfying to master.

Wrapped in colorful pixel art and a cheerful summer atmosphere, Milo’s rescue missions offer relaxing, brain-teasing challenges for puzzle lovers of all ages.

Key Features
30 puzzle levels
Play as Milo, the heroic lifeguard cat
Two charming environments:
Sunny Beach
Cozy House Pool
Unlimited undo system for a fair and stress-free experience
Simple grid-based movement 
Bright and colorful 2D pixel art visuals
Puzzles that reward planning, logic, and spatial reasoning.

1801882769.title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH
1801882769.short_description:
DON'T WATCH is a first-person psychological horror game from the intricate BrokenLore series.

Shinji is a young hikikomori, trapped inside his small Tokyo apartment. With unpaid rent, mounting bills, and a family that doesn’t understand him, he feels isolated from the world—and from himself.

His only escape is video games, but even that can’t ease the crushing weight of his anxiety.

You’ll explore Shinji’s mind as it unravels, but be cautious. Hyakume, a malevolent entity with a hundred eyes, is watching, waiting for the right moment to strike.

Your PC is the only link to the outside world. But even there, safety is an illusion….

1802262547.title: Red Panda is Hungry (Windows)

1802294767.title: Space Smash

1802402118.title: Meow and the Diamond Jump
1802402118.short_description: A casual, simple platformer with 40 short levels and infinite lives.

1802464934.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 5
1802464934.short_description:
All 5 games are fast-paced and controlled with a single button.

R WHEEL Try to survive inside a spinning wheel with spikes. Press a button to jump and hold a button to stay in the air longer. But your jumps release a wave that spawns the spikes. Collect bonus items to release a wave that clears the spikes and score points by clearing them. The game is over when you hit the spikes.

DIVARR Your goal is to knock the enemy bombs down and avoid hitting your allies. Press a button to fire and press it again to split your shot in two that will fly in two perpendicular directions each. You can split the shots up to 16 per screen. The game is over when you hit an ally or any of the bombs reaches the ground.

THROW M You are flying on a balloon which is constantly going up and down. There are enemies to the left of you firing darts at you and trying to pop your balloon. Hold a button to aim and release it to throw a projectile at them to knock them off and destroy their darts. The game is over when an enemy dart hits your balloon.

WIPER You are in charge of a wiper and your goal is to clean the windscreen from all the raindrops. The wiper is swinging from side to side and you can swing it from a highlighted side by pressing a button. The game is over when any raindrop reaches the bottom of the screen.

D MISSILE Your goal is to launch missiles and shoot down enemy projectiles falling from the top. Press a button to launch a missile, you can launch up to 3 missiles at a time. Hold a button to make the launched missiles rotate clockwise. The game is over when any of the enemy projectiles hits the ground.

1802484126.title: A Classical Kickabout

1802598063.title: Escape from Ever After: Onboarding
1802598063.short_description:
A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! Ever After Inc, a greedy megacorp from the real world, is taking over fairytales for their cheap labor and it’s up to you to fight back! Experience Escape from Ever After’s first chapter in this prologue version of the full game.

Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is a free, standalone version of Escape from Ever After, featuring the game’s first chapter. It’s fairytales vs. capitalism in this adventure RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games!

It turns out that storybooks are an untapped market ripe with valuable resources, cheap labor, and profit to be had—so naturally, real-world conglomerate Ever After Inc.™ found a way to intervene! With no choice but to get a job, a newly-hired fairytale hero named Flynt Buckler must team up with his former dragon nemesis in order to take down Ever After Inc. from the inside. Climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back against capitalism!

Dive into storybook worlds packed to the brim with colorful characters, captivating locales, and electrifying secrets! In Escape from Ever After: Onboarding, Flynt must enter a twisted version of The Three Little Pigs, in which the pigs have been contracted by Ever After Inc. to bulldoze the forest and build condos made from straw, sticks, and brick.

Face off against hordes of wacky enemies in snappy turn-based gameplay! Perfectly-timed action commands allow Flynt to finish off his foes with style, and an assortment of items, badges, and partners ensure there’s always a trick up his sleeve.

- Fight in a fun, fast-paced battle system that rewards experimentation and strategy
- Build and customize your party—every character has unique skills that can be equipped and upgraded throughout your journey
- Engage in office banter, help your storybook coworkers, and decorate your office as you climb the corporate ladder
- Explore vast storybook worlds brimming with sidequests, treasures, and secrets
- Stories within stories: experience a charming and lively narrative where the rules are constantly changing
- A jazzy, big-band soundtrack that keeps the energy pumping throughout.

1802675093.title: Halloween Pinball

1802716291.title: Oakbound Quest (Windows)
1802716291.short_description: You take on the role of a brave warrior on a sacred mission: to recover the mystical oaks whose essence holds the power to restore life to your devastated village.

1802732353.title: Jumbo Airport Story
1802732353.short_description: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!

1802771942.title: Time Trap: Hidden Objects Remastered
1802771942.short_description: Unravel the mystery of a missing journalist by investigating an apocalyptic zone full of anomalies and dangerous secrets.

1802779336.title: Uncharted Tides: Port Royal (Xbox One Version)
1802779336.short_description:
Dead men tell no tales!
And tales about an infamous ship - The Cursed Rose - probably cost renowned sailor Mason Owens his life. As his daughter you can do only one thing - find the damned ship and learn your father's fate.

1802905643.title: Ghost Files: The Face of Guilt (Xbox Version)
1802905643.short_description: Step into the shoes of Emily Meyer from Boston PD to face the mysterious case of 10 homicides. You are on the brink of solving the case when suddenly someone tries to derail it.

1802918297.title: Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy Complete Edition
1802918297.short_description: “Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy” is a point-and-click adventure about an eight-year-old boy who lives with his eccentric family in the shadow of Jorel, his handsome and popular brother. Based on the award-winning Brazilian animation “Jorel’s Brother”.

1802991132.title: Loopindex
1802991132.short_description: Test your wits on the unique “loop mechanic” with single player or co-op multiplayer.

1803025384.title: SYNTHETIK: Ultimate
1803025384.short_description:
SYNTHETIK is an unforgiving tactical shooter rogue-lite where freedom and experimentation is key. 
Fight in a world overrun by the Machine Legion and their Gods. 
Experience the next level in gun-play and dive into unparalleled build options and Android upgrades. 
Can you defeat the Heart of Armageddon?

1803025916.title: Esports Life Tycoon
1803025916.short_description: Manage your own esports squad, expand your gaming house and defeat legendary teams to become the best in the world!

1803097553.title: Once Again
1803097553.short_description:
Make up for lost time with Once Again,

If you could travel through time, who’s the first person you’d meet?

When teenage boy Sia opens his eyes after making a wish on a boring summertime birthday, he finds himself in an unfamiliar time, in front of a familiar someone who he never had the chance to meet.

Together, she and Sia will form a bond through photography, while recapturing their lost time into rolls upon rolls of film.

Who is she, and what journey awaits this star-crossed duo?

Is a goodbye an ending, or a promise for a reunion?
Let’s find the answers together, across time and space, in Once Again.

Feature List
• Every birthday, Sia gets to make up for a lifetime of missed moments with her.

• Transcending time and space, Sia’s bond with her is poised to be summer’s most heartwarming tale.

• Immersive interactive gameplay lets you directly control Sia’s actions with charmingly simple, yet satisfying gameplay mechanics such as scrubbing, writing, taking photos and more.

• Stunning illustrated art style that weaves the narrative and gameplay into a wistful, nostalgic journey.

• Photography-inspired gameplay mechanics such as focus, exposure and more serve as the perfect introduction to a timeless art form.


For Once Again, WeiFan has weaved together a gorgeous lineup of tracks that truly express all the feelings and thoughts that just can’t be put into words, and we can’t wait for you to experience them in our story!

1803141715.title: Football Manager 2024
1803141715.short_description: Shape a world-class team ready to dominate your managerial rivals in football’s most prestigious competitions. Progress never stops when you’re striving for footballing greatness.

1803165746.title: Yet Another Zombie Survivors Demo
1803165746.short_description: The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break the limits in this simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

1803471862.title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival Demo
1803471862.short_description:
Demo includes Taiko Mode/Improvement Support/
Great Drum Toy War/Run! Ninja Dojo, Playable Songs: Donderful Everyday, Symphony No.5, and Don-chan Band Playable Song: William Tell Overture.

1803567735.title: Spectrubes
1803567735.short_description: A new addictive puzzle game from the creators of Big Journey to Home, inspired both by the eighties and the modern games – we present Spectrubes!

1803575237.title: Rogue Loops
1803575237.short_description: Rogue Loops: Trapped family fights to escape an endless loop. Can you break free?

1803631176.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
1803631176.short_description:
BE YOUR OWN WEAPON OF WAR

Welcome to the year 3015! It’s a hell of a time to be alive. Humanity has colonized thousands of star systems, war is everywhere, and the battlefields of the future are dominated by hulking machines known as BattleMechs. It’s dangerous work for the elite pilots of these metal monstrosities, but that’s why a power hungry MechWarrior like you came here, right? If you’re looking to blast, wreck, stomp - and profit - step inside!

1803636646.title: What They Don't Sea
1803636646.short_description:
As a marine researcher with the Rachel Carson Research Organization, RCRO, you have been sent to collect samples of a special kelp for an alternative energy project.

What They Don't Sea was created by Team Atlantis, a group of middle school girls, at the 3-week Girls Make Games summer camp in Durham, NC. Team Atlantis went on to win Grand Prize at GMG's 2019 National Demo Day competition. To learn more, visit www.girlsmakegames.com.

1803784196.title: The SpeedRun Game Online
1803784196.short_description: The Long awaited Multiplayer game from The SpeedRun Game series.

1803856714.title: Hollowgrace (Windows)
1803856714.short_description: You are the Nameless Knight, bound by an ancient vow to protect the royal line until your final breath. Through cathedrals drowned in shadow and sanctums where angels weep black tears, you march toward the heart of decay itself.

1803898180.title: Outpost Delta
1803898180.short_description: Outpost Delta is a single player, 2-D side-scrolling sci-fi shooter. Take on the role of Delta, the outpost’s emergency defense, who along with her AI companion must defend the space station against alien intruders.

1803908059.title: Legendary Tales V. Price of Power
1803908059.short_description:
Forgotten lands and ancient magic give rise to a dangerous journey against the oppressive rule of witches.

“Legendary Tales V. Price of Power” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

In a world ruled by witches, survival is hard and hope is rare. Whispers of forgotten myths and powers suggest that change may still be possible. From hidden catacombs to long-abandoned cities, this journey unfolds across ruins of lost civilizations and through encounters with dangerous foes. Along the way, unlikely allies appear, old secrets resurface, and the fragile dream of freedom grows stronger. The journey is filled with uncertainty, but each discovery hints that the world’s fate may yet be rewritten. Thus, a story of magic, struggle, the search for safety, and the creation of a new future takes shape.

- Gather old friends to overcome hardships together
- Travel through incredible places no one ever believed existed
- Solve puzzles and play mini-games to put your wits to the test
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters.

1803918307.title: Musical Vibes
1803918307.short_description:
Discover a new dance game playable with the camera of your smartphone connected to your console or PC! Dance, hands free, to great music and learn new incredible moves! The system can do full-body tracking thanks to AI!

Try the demo on your Xbox and install the Musical Vibes Camera app on your smartphone to see if you can use the camera of your smartphone to play the game. See the requirements at the bottom.

Musical Vibes features 2-player local multiplayer. Dance with one of your friends by your side!

If you own a Philips Hue smart lighting system, connect it to the game and turn your living room into a concert hall! Bring the fun to another level!

In this first version, you can play one track for free in the demo. 2-player local multiplayer is only available in the paid version. When you buy the game, you can enjoy the 8 tracks included. We plan on adding at least 12 more so try the game each week to know if new tracks have been added.

For the times you don't want to dance or if you don't have a compatible smartphone, you can play the rhythm game mode instead. In this mode, you must press the correct direction on your controller at the right time, while following the music!

More features to be announced soon.

Requirements:

You need to install the Musical Vibes Camera app on your phone. The app is available on Google Play and the App Store. You need iPhone 6S or more recent iPhone, or an Android device with at least the performance of a Samsung Galaxy S9.

1804015757.title: Pocket Minigolf
1804015757.short_description: It’s time for some fun mini-golf! Sit back, relax, and score some holes. Fancy some multiplayer with friends? We've got you covered - up to 4 players on one console!

1804029190.title: Gettin Jiggy 2
1804029190.short_description: Gettin Jiggy 2 is a jigsaw puzzle. You must align the pieces according to a visual or numeric pattern. The pieces are swapped in order to move the pieces via the translucent value and the one you want to move. They will change positions on the board until you have placed the pieces into order e.g. ascending 0 to 8. You can save your game for later, adjust the sound, and pause the game.

1804098370.title: Swimsanity!
1804098370.short_description: Swimsanity! is a multiplayer underwater shooter with action-packed Co-Op and Versus game modes, all supported by online and local play. You play as our hero Mooba, who uses a variety of unique power ups and weapons to survive in this aquatic world.

1804163940.title: Marvel Rivals

Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe!

1804278141.title: Rugby 22 Xbox One
1804278141.short_description:

Play with best clubs and top nations, enjoy dynamic gameplay that stays faithful to the sport, and experience the intensity of big matches.

1804344876.title: Echo Generation 2 Demo

1804346464.title: Kusan: City of Wolves

put the numbers in the right place.

1804597350.short_description: Embark on an amazing adventure on the tropical island of Maupiroa! Take to the seas and discover the secrets that surround the island! Dive into the ocean's depths, teeming with life and color, with your dolphin friend Keanu. Learn about marine life and ecology while helping the local environmentalists save the island from impending disaster.

1804597999.title: sCATch 2: The Painter Cat
1804597999.short_description: sCATch 2 is a puzzle game where the goal is paint all colorful places of the maze and come to the exit. Combining colors and items with different mechanics on the way.

1804603673.title: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Wicked Witches

1804639035.title: Ultra Crystal Rush (Xbox Series X/S)
1804639035.short_description: Ultra Crystal Rush is a high-mobility, precision-focused 2D platformer centered on fast movement, route planning, and flawless execution.

1804795180.title: Mask of Mists (Xbox Series X|S)
1804795180.short_description: Mask of Mists is an action-adventure game in a first-person view in which you are immersed in exploring the world full of magic and secrets!

1804816803.title: Air Hockey 3D
1804816803.short_description:
Play Air Hockey 3D and re-discover the fun and excitement of this classic Arcade game on the Big Screen.

With stunning 3D graphics, you'll be transported to the arcades o.

Air Hockey 3D takes full advantage of HD giving you stunning crisp graphics.

Playing against the smart Ai (artificial intelligence) player won't be easy.

Windows Desktop version requires an XBOX controller.

1804852983.title: Train Station Renovation
1804852983.short_description:
Welcome to an old, ruined train station. A place that will give you a lot of fun!
In Train Station Renovation you play as a renovation company specialised in restoring railway stations. The game is set in abandoned and destroyed train stations, you will start with small rural ones to ease in and eventually be challenged with sprawling train stations in metropolitan areas. The game is divided into 10 maps (stations) which gradually teach you new mechanics and help you manage different working environments. Each station needs to be cleaned, fixed and decorated with items and equipment to bring it back to life.

Choose how hard you want to work.
The level of difficulty depends on the player's commitment. The game can be very demanding if you decide to complete each stage one hundred percent but it also can be perfect for beginners if you just want to relax while renovating and simply have a good time. In such a case, you only need to complete half the planned tasks to advance to the next stage.

Quick and easy access to equipment is the key to success.
There are many tools and options for repairing and decorating the station. Work with basic items such as paint rollers, spray cans, crowbars and repair wrenches or use your in-game tablet to order new materials and items. Some stations will even allow you to repair and renovate the old trains. This means you will be able to take care of the technical condition of those vehicles yourself.

Specializations development tree
An aesthetic development character tree t is available. You will speed up your work time at individual stages and elements of the game by upgrading your skills. You will also get new equipment or unlock new options while renovating. If you happen to enjoy some renovation activities more than others, you will be able to upgrade them during your playthrough.

Renovate and decorate train stations and trains.
Detailed and complex 3D models of railway stations allow you to renovate them - from cleaning, painting and to replacing decorations and mechanical elements.

The economy is very important
A complex economy aspect has been added to the game to increase realism. In addition to money needed to buy new items and repair materials, you can also benefit by segregating waste or completing additional tasks.

Build your own station.
Thanks to the station decoration system, you will be able to create the internal and external appearance of various facilities yourself. You can add benches, vending machines, kiosks, and other items as needed, and place them wherever you want. Thanks to this function, you will quickly turn a dump into a great looking ready for business train station.

1804884924.title: Pixel into the Galaxy (Xbox Series X|S)
1804884924.short_description: Help an explorer reach his destination: Earth.

1804899462.title: Tools Up - Ultimate Edition
1804899462.short_description: Tools Up! Ultimate Edition is a chaos-filled, local couch-coop extravaganza, all about renovating homes and the outdoors. It comes with all updates, content, and DLC in one package, supporting up to 4 players.

1804922747.title: Tux and Fanny
1804922747.short_description:
