1833460510.short_description: Infiltrate a terrorist occupied tower, airport, and shopping mall to get classified data and stop their plans. New features have been added to this revival of the home console version of Elevator Action Returns, a masterpiece 2D action game. Also features 2 player mode.

1833491079.title: Fireball 2
1833491079.short_description: Fireball 2 is an elegant and satisfying arcade survival game. Dodge and boost your way through a massive flood of enemies. Lure them into range and detonate a devastating bomb! Features infinite waves, two modes and difficulties, local co-op, dazzling visuals, and an epic soundscape.

1833503116.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
1833503116.short_description: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!

1833553446.title: A Sketchbook About Her Sun
1833553446.short_description:
Confused about her feelings for someone, Lucia, the main character, decides to flee from her city and wanders through a smaller town where she’s never been, searching for herself while still tormented by the thought of the person she’s attracted to.

The project is an interactive experience divided into 11 segments, each corresponding to a song from Red Ribbon’s new album “Planet X”.
Lose yourself into Lucia’s mindscape, divided between her thoughts, drawings, and music she’s listening to through her journey to re-discover her own self.

1833643769.title: Farmers Supermarket Simulator - Farmers Store
1833643769.short_description: Build your dream farm, produce delicious goods, serve customers, and grow your small farmers store into a thriving supermarket empire! 🌾🛒🍓.

1833650481.title: CASSETTE BOY Demo
1833650481.short_description: In this world, what you do not see ceases to exist. Will you master the power of perception and call the moon back?

1833651636.title: Portrait of a Torn
1833651636.short_description: As a young soldier returning to an eerily deserted home, you'll explore enigmatic rooms and uncover a haunting, tragic story. Experience an atmospheric journey filled with suspense, mysterious encounters, and a deep narrative.

1833729243.title: Knight Squad 2 - Demo
1833729243.short_description: Knight Squad 2 is a chaotic arcade multiplayer game for up to 8 players. Pick an eccentric knight and fight for glory with wacky weaponry. Triumph over your friends in a ridiculous amount of game modes.

1833761430.title: The Cursed Hotel
1833761430.short_description:
A short game inspired by 90s horror games. Explore the different floors of a strange hotel and repair the elevator allowing you to escape.

This game is currently a proof of concept and not a complete experience.

1833824515.title: Lacuna - A Sci-Fi Noir Adventure
1833824515.short_description: You are Neil Conrad, CDI agent. Awoken by the news of a murder, you rush into a case that will soon turn your life and the whole solar system upside down. Ask questions, collect evidence, and put the pieces together until the ugly truth reveals itself... or not.

1833883015.title: Rust Console Edition X|S - Public Test Branch
1833883015.short_description: The Staging branch is where the development team tests future content updates.

1833907881.title: Schlag den Star - Das 3. Spiel
1833907881.short_description: Fans of the popular TV show "Schlag den Star" can look forward to a new gaming experience: "Schlag den Star" is back in its third edition. The game promises even more fun, excitement and challenging games for all fans of the format.

1833930979.title: Zoo Orbs: Safari (Windows)
1833930979.short_description: Stack, Merge and Reach the Giraffe.

1833951964.title: Star Ores Inc. Demo
1833951964.short_description: Take over an abandoned space station and manage your own ore mine. Drill through the asteroid with your laser, sell ore, and build an automated network of robot helpers to maximize your profit.

1833960090.title: Kentucky Route Zero: TV Edition
1833960090.short_description:
At twilight in Kentucky, as bird songs give way to the choir of frogs and insects, familiar roads become strange, and it's easy to get lost. Those who are already lost may find their way to a secret highway winding through underground caves. The people who live and work along this highway are themselves a little strange at first, but soon seem familiar: the aging driver making the last delivery for a doomed antique shop; the young woman who fixes obsolete TVs surrounded by ghosts; the child and his giant eagle companion; the robot musicians; the invisible power company lurking everywhere, and the threadbare communities who struggle against its grip.

KENTUCKY ROUTE ZERO: TV EDITION is a magical realist adventure game in five acts, featuring a haunting electronic score, and a suite of hymns and bluegrass standards recorded by The Bedquilt Ramblers. Rendered in a striking visual style that draws as much from theater, film, and experimental electronic art as it does from the history of videogames, this is a story of unpayable debts, abandoned futures, and the human drive to find community.

1833961027.title: Boxville 2
1833961027.short_description: Boxville 2 continues the adventure of cans living in a box city. Two friends were setting up fireworks for the city celebration, but a mistake caused chaos and one friend went missing. Now our hero must explore Boxville and beyond to fix everything and find his friend.

1833987400.title: Flora's World (Windows)
1833987400.short_description: Help Flora save Flower Land! Jump, smash enemies with your hammer, and explore gardens filled with giant flowers, secrets, and challenges in a classic 2D platformer.

1833995435.title: ASTRO AQUA KITTY
1833995435.short_description: The Aqua Kitty cats have launched into space in an all new action RPG shoot-em-up adventure!

1833997940.title: Steamboat Incident
1833997940.short_description: Trapped at sea on a steamboat - fix it, hide, and escape.

1834026545.title: Melobot - A Last Song
1834026545.short_description: An adorable musical robot named Melobot, created to preserve harmony, awakens on a strange, silent planet consumed by a mysterious dark matter. Now, Melobot must embrace a role it was never programmed for: the role of a hero.

1834097862.title: ComputerHead: Springloaded (Windows)
1834097862.short_description: In ComputerHead: Springloaded, you play as Chippy, a quirky computer character bouncing through a deadly, ever-changing arena. Jumping from trampoline to trampoline, you’ll dodge spikes, fire traps, and bear traps while collecting coins to purchase upgrades and surviving as long as possible.

1834153031.title: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra
1834153031.short_description: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra is a hidden object game where you need to find musician kittens that are embarrassed to play their music. When you find them, they will play songs for you.

1834162170.title: Geometry Dash Finally
1834162170.short_description: Geometry Dash Finally is a game where you will have fun. There are 3 different levels in the game: "Cosmic", "Aurora", "Finally". Test how many attempts you'll pass through these sections. Have fun!

1834224141.title: The mosquitoes retro
1834224141.short_description:
The mosquitoes are attacking, and only you can stop this invasion! Protect humans from these annoying pests and don’t let a single mosquito pass. Use strategic poison to exterminate them before they can strike.

Test your reflexes and skills in a challenging and addictive game where every second counts. The more mosquitoes you eliminate, the higher your score!

1834233615.title: Tycoon Business Simulator
1834233615.short_description: Build your empire from the ground up! 🏢💸 Buy properties, upgrade them infinitely, and watch your wealth grow. Complete exciting missions 🎯, earn massive rewards, and expand your business empire 🌍. Are you ready to become the next financial legend? 💰 Download now and start building! 🚀.

1834258615.title: Ink. Demo
1834258615.short_description: Ink. is a colorful roguelike adventure where every game is a unique journey, different from the previous one.

1834315926.title: Beautiful Sakura: Fashion Club
1834315926.short_description:
Beautiful Sakure: Running Club is a continuation of Kaito's journey.

Kaito is at a crossroads, unsure of his future. He stumbles upon photography and becomes intrigued by the art. As he starts experimenting with his camera, Kaito reconnects with old friends, asking them to be his models. Together, they explore new places, and with each photo, Kaito becomes more confident in his newfound passion.



However, as time passes, deeper emotions start to surface. Friendships are tested, old feelings reignite, and unexpected tensions arise, turning simple photo shoots into moments of vulnerability and drama. Kaito must navigate these complex relationships while staying true to his artistic journey.

1834348602.title: GOLDEN TRAVERSE (XBOX SERIES)
1834348602.short_description: Arcade game inspired by classic gold mining games, where you use a claw to collect treasures in dangerous mines.

1834362316.title: WW2 Rebuilder
1834362316.short_description: Build the new future of Europe! Flip, renovate, repair and rebuild places destroyed during World War 2. Get to know the history and stories of civilians. Play an immersive building simulator with grappling storytelling.

1834382841.title: Out of Moves (Xbox One)
1834382841.short_description: Every step matters... Are you ready for the challenge?

1834401069.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - Playtest
1834401069.short_description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

1834558328.title: Chrome Wolf
1834558328.short_description: Enjoy tank fights in a tale of fleeting memories and the lives of freedom fighters!

1834838234.title: Mining farm Beta
1834838234.short_description: Early version of the game "Mining farm".

1834840157.title: Murder House
1834840157.short_description: A local news team breaks into an abandoned house to chase a salacious ghost story... until a MANIAC chases them! ...VHS era 80's slasher.

1834851623.title: Moons of Darsalon
1834851623.short_description: Action Space Lemmings! A perfect mix of hilarious action and retro vibes. Innovative mechanics with high replayability over 15 hours of gameplay. Fight aliens, pilot vehicles, fly jetpacks, build terrain, run, climb, swim, protect, and lead your companions to safety.

1834893426.title: Wildgate Summer Preview
1834893426.short_description: Wildgate is a PVP multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.

1834955289.title: March to a Million
1834955289.short_description: Run a music talent agency and make platinum-selling records!

1835039546.title: Everhood: Eternity Edition
1835039546.short_description: Welcome to an inexpressible world filled with a deep story, humor, amusing musical battles and strange delightful encounters. This is the best console version of the adventure RPG indie hit, including 16 exclusive new musical battles composed by some of the most renowned artists in the indie scene and designed by members of the community. Expect the unexpected!

1835041076.title: STRIKERS 1945 III
1835041076.short_description:
This hardcore 90s arcade shooter was
Psikyo's challenge to the world!
Now with online rankings!

1835142714.title: Escape First Alchemist
1835142714.short_description:
Escape first: Alchemist is a multiplayer first person escape room / adventure game, where you play as the apprentices of the reclusive sorceror-alchemist "Trismegistus". Your benevolent master managed to trap himself in a prison of his own making, and has bestowed upon you the challenge of releasing him. Of course, to make sure you don't just run away from his cunning riddles, he deigned fit to trap you as well...

Find ingredients and discover new potion recipes. Craft unique potions and gain the powers you need to escape.

Solve numerous interactive puzzles using logic, observation and communication.

1835165280.title: Access Denied: Escape
1835165280.short_description: Escape from the laboratory and unlock its mysterious secrets.

1835223085.title: Not For Broadcast
1835223085.short_description: Control the news in Not For Broadcast, a full-motion game like no other.

1835249581.title: ATOM RPG: Post-apocalyptic indie game
1835249581.short_description: ATOM is an old school role-playing game, inspired by classic RPGs and gamebooks.

1835342321.title: Akinakes (Xbox Series)
1835342321.short_description:
Akinakes is a fast-paced shoot 'em up game where you pilot a powerful ship through vibrant levels, collect upgrades to enhance your firepower, and take on epic boss battles.

Features:
- 5 Unique Levels. Each with its own theme and a challenging boss fight.
- Upgrade System. Strengthen your ship to dominate enemies more effectively.
- Stunning Visuals & Soundtrack. Immerse yourself in beautiful pixel art graphics and an energetic soundtrack.
- Combo-Based Scoring. Chain quick kills to build combos and rack up higher scores.

1835454890.title: Stay Out of the House
1835454890.short_description:
The smack of a hammer... your head lands hard on the dirty linoleum floor... a maniac drags you up the stairs and cages you like an animal! You have three days until the reckoning...

Welcome to the home of THE BUTCHER. Welcome to YOUR new home. Why are you here? Why has this mad man chosen you, and what are his plans for you? How will you escape? Can you even escape? All of these questions have answers, but can you seek them out? Do you want to? If only you’d heeded their warning to STAY OUT OF THE HOUSE.

You will be hunted by the intelligent and deadly Butcher - use your wits and whatever tools you can scavenge to make it out alive…
Stay Out of the House is stealth based, VHS style slasher horror. Part survival horror, part immersive stealth simulator: Hide in the vents, pick locks, set traps and avoid detection. You will be hunted by an intelligent and deadly AI, relying on your wits and whatever tools you find to make it out alive.

1835471088.title: Alchemist: Journey of The Soul Demo
1835471088.short_description: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people (Demo is singleplayer). Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?

1835497756.title: Agents of Mayhem
1835497756.short_description:
Agents of MAYHEM is the latest open-world, third-person action game from the creators of the Saints Row franchise!
In Agents of MAYHEM, you run a no-holds barred operation against a shadowy super-villain organization known only as LEGION and their mysterious leader, the Morningstar. Explore the city of Seoul as a variety of Super Agents to thwart LEGION's vile plans to take over the world!

https://www.kochmedia.com/en/privacy-policy/.

1835568548.title: Himno
1835568548.short_description: Rescue Wisps to bring light to the darkness through randomly generated maps!

1835698645.title: OUT OF THE BOX: Xbox Edition
1835698645.short_description: Dive into a wild story of gangsters and criminals in Out of the Box, a captivating thriller where you decide the fate of the peculiar customers of a luxurious nightclub in a never-ending race against the clock.

1835777563.title: "Buy The Game, I Have a Gun" -Sheesh-Man
1835777563.short_description: You might wonder who I am, well I'm Sheesh-Man, I literally come from another planet, I'm like an alien, a spooky sheeshing alien to say the truth. Don't challenge me or I will sheesh your whole family, including your dog, it's not a threat, it's a fact.

1835790896.title: Isekai Rondo
1835790896.short_description: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!

1835851520.title: My Aunt is a Witch
1835851520.short_description: 'My Aunt is a Witch' is a Visual Novel full of adventures and quests in the world of magic where you have an incredible chance to become an apprentice of one of the most peculiar and charismatic witches.

1835878377.title: The Gardens Between
1835878377.short_description: Fall into a series of vibrant, dreamlike island gardens with best friends Arina and Frendt. Manipulate time to solve puzzles in this mysterious realm where cause and effect are malleable.

1835926818.title: Hellblade II: Senua's Saga
1835926818.short_description: The sequel to the award winning Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, Senua returns in a brutal journey of survival through the myth and torment of Viking Iceland. Intent on saving those who have fallen victim to the horrors of tyranny, Senua faces a battle of overcoming the darkness within and without.

1835944487.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Into the Pit
1835944487.short_description: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden to survive. Be careful?it's not just your own life that?s on the line this time.

1835972815.title: KungFu Kickball Demo
1835972815.short_description: KungFu Kickball is a team based fighting-sports game where the best ball kicker wins! Punch, kick, and headbutt your way across the field to smash the ball into your opponents' bell and rack up points!

1835995970.title: Master Agent
1835995970.short_description: Master Agent is game which can be played either online or offline, where you send your agents to pass through various enemies, traps and obstacles to gain treasure and glory.

1836043414.title: Snow Squall
1836043414.short_description:
Your helicopter crashes in a remote, icy wilderness en route to delivering batteries to a mysterious research facility. 
Now, you must complete your delivery before you freeze to death or get eaten by a strange presence stalking you.

1836115301.title: Docked
1836115301.short_description: Operate massive cranes, terminal tractors and reach stackers in a realistic dock simulator. Play the story-driven Campaign to rebuild Port Wake or jump into Free Play Mode and take on cargo contracts with no mission constraints.

1836167982.title: Bem Feito
1836167982.short_description: Play once again Bem Feito, the great classic originally released for the handheld console JOGAROTO in 1999!

1836220700.title: 8-Bit Selection: Arcade Replay (Windows)
1836220700.short_description:
This is a collection of 5 different 8-bit style arcade games.

• Guest Rush — You play as a hotel housekeeper, trying to clean rooms after customers as fast as possible.
• Mythos Dash — You play as the Hero of the Mythos, slaying deadly minotaurs and saving ladies.
• Cauldron Forager — You play as the Witch of the Forest, collecting ingredients for her potion cauldron and defending against the forest dwellers.
• Tube Repairs — You play as a plumber who goes around the tube maze and fixes potential leaks.
• Pumpkin Bloodshed — You play as the Slasher that has to defend agains the army of evil pumpkins.

1836380058.title: Salvation: Echoes of War Demo
1836380058.short_description: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

1836437615.title: Punch Monk (Windows)
1836437615.short_description: Punch Monk (Windows) is a grid-based puzzle game with RPG attributes (Health, Attack and Defense). Players must battle enemies, who share similar attributes, survive and reach the destination alive.

1836455102.title: Arcade Hysteria
1836455102.short_description:
After sneaking into an arcade late at night, you find yourself trapped in an old game called Hysteria! Dodge enemies in Hysteria while collecting powerups to stay alive in this endless runner. How long can you last in the arcade?

Tap or press any button to jump and double jump. The goal of Arcade Hysteria is to keep your sanity as long as you can, as indicated by the top-right Sanity Meter. When the Sanity Meter is at 50%, the graphics will change and the game speed will be faster. When the meter hits zero, the game is over. 

Jump on enemies and collect hearts to regain sanity. The mask powerup allows you to take a single hit without losing any sanity, at the cost of losing your mask. You lose sanity constantly and by enemies running into you. To get a high score in Arcade Hysteria, make sure you never miss a heart Powerup and always jump on enemies!

Arcade Hysteria was originally developed in 72 hours during the 2015 Indies vs Gamers horror game jam and is now available on Xbox One for free! AJ Ryan is the game designer and programmer, James Ruschman is the game artist, and Ryan Froehling composed the music.

1836480198.title: Rumbleverse Network Test
1836480198.short_description: Your next chance to visit Grapital City is fast approaching! Pre-load and be ready to play.

1836570582.title: Faeria
1836570582.short_description:
With its unique living board, Faeria will challenge you with truly strategic card battles. Craft your deck, shape the battlefield, and fight for victory!

A strategy game like no other. Build exciting decks and shape the battlefield as you fight epic battles. Raise mountains, build forests, fill lakes, or harness the sands of the deserts. You choose your own path to victory.

1836594113.title: Bear With Me: The Lost Robots
1836594113.short_description:
The noir episodic point and click adventure series Bear With Me is back! Introducing Bear With Me: The Lost Robots – an all new prequel chapter featuring Amber’s brother Flint and the callous detective Ted E. Bear. 

Take to the gritty and bustling undergrounds of Paper City, discovering new characters and rich lore leading up to the events of the first three episodes of Bear With Me.

Dark interrogations, sarcastic banter, and challenging puzzles lie in store for our heroes as they collect clues to solve a bigger, more sinister mystery. Featuring an evocative soundtrack, expansive narrative and a uniquely drawn 2D animated art-style accented by an impressive film noir style, Bear With Me will take players through an emotional rollercoaster of a journey that will determine the fates of our protagonists.

1836648015.title: Bunny Pit Stop: Vegas Rush (Xbox One)

1836669355.title: Slime Ranger (Windows)
1836669355.short_description: You are on a quest to find and defeat the Slime King.

1836687833.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate
1836687833.short_description: The evil Dr. Eggman has built an interstellar amusement park – but he’s powering it with a captured alien race called “Wisps.” Use Sonic’s speed to free the Wisps and gain their amazing powers as you explore six colorful unique worlds.

1836689421.title: Rising Lords
1836689421.short_description: Rising Lords is a medieval turn-based strategy game with card and board game elements. Send your serfs to fight and die in your name... or let them prosper, and use them to your advantage!

1836720139.title: Higgs Boson: Puzzle Collection
1836720139.short_description: Think in angles. Solve in seconds.

1836752322.title: Breakneck City
1836752322.short_description:
Use your wits, reflexes and the mean streets around you to take down the city’s most ruthless gangs!

When a vicious gang tries to burn down their favorite video shop, Sidney Flintlock and Justine Jacobs take to the streets to bust some heads. Breakneck City is an old-school 3D beat ‘em up with a focus on environmental interactions. Featuring low-poly graphics, pixel art textures and the ability to team up for 2-player local co-op play, Breakneck City brings late-90s style brawler action to a new generation.

Punch, kick and dodge your way through 6 punishing levels including city streets, a dance club, skyscrapers and more! Take on gangs of varied enemy types and tough bosses. Pick up weapons to become even more effective in combat and use the environment to your advantage. Swing on lamp posts, kick your foes into garbage bins or out of windows and deal devastating dive-kicks from above. You'll have to use your surroundings to your advantage against these challenging foes!

1836761830.title: Creepy Road
1836761830.short_description: The world has gone mad and Flint Trucker must go down a long, creepy road to get back home and save his beloved Angelina. Blast your guns across different scenarios to fight hordes of ravenous beasts and bloodthirsty enemies. Will you survive?

1836785866.title: ParkourLand Elite: Playground
1836785866.short_description: Get ready to leap into a world of endless possibilities with ParkourLand Elite: Playground. Your next great adventure is just a jump away!

1836794259.title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
1836794259.short_description: "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate" is a side-scrolling beat'em up with the heart of a fighting game, supporting cross-platform pixel art anime action with up to 8P online multiplayer and all the characters from "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive"!

1836827624.title: Mortal Shell II Open Beta
1836827624.short_description: Step into the ravaged world of Mortal Shell II and begin the Harbinger’s journey. Play the opening three hours of the game in this limited Open Beta, with select progress carrying forward into the full release.

1836853409.title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2 (Xbox One)
1836853409.short_description:
After graduating high school, Kaito returns to his hometown for one final summer before stepping into adult life.
The ocean that once shaped his childhood memories now calls him back—and so do the two girls he once shared it with.

In Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2, Kaito reunites with his former surfing partners and close friends, Michiko and Yuuki. Once inseparable, the three drifted apart after the events of the first game. Now older, more confident, and carrying new dreams, they decide to revive the Surfing Club for one last unforgettable season.

1836863501.title: Through the Nightmares (Demo)
1836863501.short_description: Through the Nightmares is a hardcore platformer for anyone who’s ever been jolted awake from a fright. Run, jump, and change your size to survive in a world of nightmares!

1836865021.title: Connect Balls
1836865021.short_description: Rotate the obstacles until red and blue balls are connected.

1836942975.title: Grind Survivors
1836942975.short_description: Grind Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike where demon hunters face endless hellspawn. Dodge, loot, and blast through brutal bullet-hell combat with dynamic builds and ever-changing weapons in a scorched, demon-ridden world.

1836953509.title: DREAMERS Summer Demo 23
1836953509.short_description: DREAMERS Summer Demo showcases a special level set within the middle of the game. As you immerse yourself in this experience, you'll embark on an exciting collaborative single-player adventure, enhanced by a split-screen feature that allows you to control two characters simultaneously. Explore the enigmatic labyrinth of abandoned mines and discover what lies beyond their depths. Can you guide these two characters through the maze?

1837055702.title: Quartz Caverns (Xbox Series)
1837055702.short_description:
Quartz Caverns is an action-adventure puzzle game where you guide the main character through a series of ancient caves in search of mystical crystals. The caverns are filled with tricky puzzles, dangerous slimes, and other hazards that test your wits and reflexes. As you explore, you'll uncover hidden paths, discover powerful relics, and face numerous threats lurking in the shadows. Only the bravest can retrieve the legendary crystals and uncover the secrets of the Quartz Caverns.

Are you up for the challenge?

1837096770.title: Death's Gambit: Afterlife
1837096770.short_description: A contract binds you to Death who seeks to eradicate immortality. Will you do his bidding and restore the natural order, or succumb to its power in this hardcore 2D action RPG?

1837221982.title: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves OPEN β TEST
1837221982.short_description:
We will be holding an open beta test for FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves, with the aim of improving the quality of the online experience.
Interested players can participate even without an Xbox Game Pass Core or Ultimate subscription.

1837273328.title: REDEX - Console Edition
1837273328.short_description:
Survive a relentless battlefield in side-scrolling retro arcade style!

REDEX is a pixel-art survival shooter where you battle waves of enemies in fast-paced side-scrolling combat. Collect coins to buy ammo, grenades, armor, and more from vending machines, then trade rare gold for permanent upgrades and new characters.

Unlock new zones, from rooftops to labs, and use air-dropped crates to deploy turrets or mining terminals. Distract foes with dummies and adapt your tactics to survive. No rules, just fight to be the last one standing!

1837367469.title: SolSeraph
1837367469.short_description: Build your cities and set up defensive structures to protect them from the constant threat of monsters. Brought to you by ACE Team, SolSeraph combines action and strategy for a rich gameplay experience reminiscent of the 16-bit era.

1837368114.title: Dagon: Complete Edition
1837368114.short_description: Step into the stories of H.P. Lovecraft and discover the eldritch horrors lurking behind the veil of reality.

1837410971.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT
1837410971.short_description: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 20 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!

1837444005.title: Garenti Atomic Fps
1837444005.short_description: Are you ready for a perfect Action? Grab your weapon and fight the enemies to seize the well-protected place. It's a very difficult game. There are too many enemies. Improve yourself try to kill them all. Try to capture the big castle.

1837458997.title: 911: Cannibal
1837458997.short_description:
In this horror game you are a kidnapped teenager. Maniac - cannibal keeps you in his creepy house. Hide and search items that can help you find a way out of the scary place and survive the nightmare. Solve puzzles to get to inaccessible places. And do not forget about attentiveness - you need to carefully cover up your tracks so that the maniac does not suspect anything.

Can you hide and outsmart the cannibal and survive without missing a single detail? Or will he catch you in the very first minutes and in the evening you will find yourself in his plate? In this horror, survival depends only on your ingenuity, attentiveness and memory.

Game features:

- Fascinating story and investigation
- Interesting puzzles
- Horror elements, hide and seek, and survival
- Quality sound and detailed environment.

1837473990.title: Naruto Puzzle +
1837473990.short_description:
Love Naruto play this puzzle game
Naruto is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto. It tells the story of Naruto Uzumaki, an adolescent ninja who constantly searches for recognition and dreams to become true...

1837564150.title: Ragdoll Fighter
1837564150.short_description: Flail, punch, and kick your way to victory!

1837663768.title: DreamBall
1837663768.short_description: DreamBall is a fun sports game with Ragdoll physics set in dreams with one clear objective, try score more than your opponent before time’s up.

1837745362.title: When the Past was Around
1837745362.short_description: Something is missing from her world….

1837805016.title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline Demo
1837805016.short_description: To the world, the Divine Comedy is a poem. To your family, it's a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you must reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

1837938769.title: Run Will Byers Run
1837938769.short_description: Over a small town called Hawkins, there is a terrible threat. Terrible monsters from the parallel universe invaded the town. The boy whose name is Bill Byers should resist monsters. Help him to unite friends and protect his city. Collect the "3 Musketeers" candies and "Eggo" waffles to involve friends in the fight against evil.

1837961078.title: Sunset Bike Racer 2 Pro - Airborne Motocross
1837961078.short_description: Fly with your bike. Race others. Explore. ― “Once you’ve got the hang glider mounted on your dirt bike, you’ll spend a lot of time in the air. Especially if you combine it with a nitro booster.”.

1838054999.title: Cute Astro (Xbox One)
1838054999.short_description: A Puzzle Show on the Star Stage.

1838304803.title: Beam City Racer
1838304803.short_description:
Beaming City Race Game in Windows Store! 

Choose from 3 different vehicles

Choose from 2 different road themes

Don't stop until you reach the highest score.

Don't forget that you will get extra points if you go in the opposite direction!

1838314424.title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic
1838314424.short_description:
Master arena-style pinball stages to save the day and break the witch’s evil curse!

When a power hungry, egotistical witch spreads her dark magic across the land, it is up to one raccoon to stop her! Play as Roxy, an adventurous young cub as she rolls through nine unique worlds in story mode, hoping to put an end to the witch’s dastardly plans! Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic is a retelling of the original 3D platformer, this time told through an energetic and unique pinball format.

Break the witch’s wicked curse and conquer her many challenges across a wide variety of pinball tables, from arenas themed around parks and urban streets to casinos and more! Unlock cosmetics for character customization to express your winning style and prove once and for all that you are the true pinball champion!

1838321370.title: Ages of Mages: the last keeper
1838321370.short_description:
Take the princess back! 
Ages of Mages: The Last Keeper is the perfect TPS beat 'em up game for a great weekend on your couch with family and friends.

1838347207.title: Gaps by POWGI
1838347207.short_description:
These words have one letter missing. Deduce the correct letters to fill the gaps and spell a new word, but watch out for red herrings!

There are 150 puzzles to solve - and 150 terrible jokes.

1838411318.title: Decay
1838411318.short_description: The XBLIG classic is now on Xbox One! All 4 parts in one complete package. Solve the dark mystery and face the challenges in this psychological thriller adventure. The story has multiple endings based on how you play the game.

1838440652.title: Narrative Adventure
1838440652.short_description: Narrative Adventure is a game in which the player has to discover the mysteries of the house, solve riddles.

1838447397.title: the plumber
1838447397.short_description:
In this first-person game you will help Luke, a plumber who is trapped underground because of a weird accident, 
to find a manhole and escape from the labyrinth of the sewers. 

That won't be easy, granted: the level of disgusting liquid and unmentionable matter will keep increasing and you will need to find a way to adjust the valves in each pipe, to avoid flooding; 

in doing that, you will also need to fight against giant bats and angry mice which will lurk in every corner.

Did I mention the air is often toxic there and you will need to find a gas mask to survive?

1838474785.title: Charlatan Demo
1838474785.short_description:
A slot machine roguelike built on dirty tricks. 
Rig the reels to escape a cursed amusement park before it takes your soul.

1838497699.title: Mortal Fighter 23
1838497699.short_description:
Mortal Fighter, the next generation fighting game!

Choose your character and complete the missions assigned to him!

Don't forget that each character has a different mission!

Can you complete all the chapters?

1838518432.title: Space Hulk®: Deathwing™ - Enhanced Edition (Windows 10)
1838518432.short_description:
Space Hulk: Deathwing - Enhanced Edition is the First-Person Shooter set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. 

Play as a Space Marine of the Deathwing and engage in a desperate battle against Genestealers within the confines of a Space Hulk. Grow stronger as you earn experience across perilous missions, in solo or online cooperative multiplayer up to 4 players (Cross-Play).

1838535275.title: Death Come True
1838535275.short_description: Everything rides on your choices in this new wave interactive movie game. Experience a thrilling science fiction mystery in full-length live-action format—from genius creator of the "Danganronpa" series, Kazutaka Kodaka!

1838540786.title: Danger Gazers
1838540786.short_description: Danger Gazers is a post-apocalyptic roguelite top-down shooter where you pave your own path. The choices you make will decide your fate, it will either turn you into the new ruler or... the ashes to be windswept away.

1838564294.title: Boxing Gym Story
1838564294.short_description: Create your own gym, train boxers, and aim for the championship!

1838606356.title: Zumba Marble Blast
1838606356.short_description: Dive into Zumba Marble Blast, a thrilling puzzle adventure with 200 levels of marble-matching madness! Aim and shoot to match colors, trigger combos, and use power-ups to clear the board. Perfect for quick fun and strategic challenges, this game offers sleek graphics and addictive gameplay for all ages. Get ready to blast your way to the top!

1838616414.title: Airplane Flight Simulator : EVO
1838616414.short_description:
Ever wondered what is feels like to pilot legendary jet airliners ? In Airplane Flight Simulator : EVO you have a global open world map to explore, with an amazing selection of 31 realistic airplanes. Enjoy the fully immersive experience
provided by awesome flight controls, realistic interiors and sound effects, full day-night cycle, and challenging weather scenarios. In this Flight Simulator you can fly across the globe between a wide variety of cities and airports, inspired by real-world locations.

1838648944.title: Slipstream
1838648944.short_description: A racing game inspired by the visuals, music, games and cars from the 80s and 90s. It's built with an authentic retro feel and unique graphics. Drifting and slipstreaming mechanics add depth to the gameplay, and the result is a challenging and exciting experience.

1838702290.title: Re:Touring (Windows)
1838702290.short_description:
Solve interesting puzzles and uncover the history of Luoni Energy

Re:Touring is a first-person puzzle game in which you'll explore the abandoned Luoni Energy Competence Center and uncover the facility's history, navigating through a total of 26 varied levels. Using a retro-style computer, you'll create color patterns to control elements such as doors, platforms and lasers. Each mechanism is carefully introduced to make the game accessible to everyone.

1838778501.title: Bouncy Bob 2
1838778501.short_description:
Bouncy Bob 2 is a great party game! Bounce, shoot, and fight your opponents in various games modes. High replayability and lots of fun guaranteed!

Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 is a perfect co-op experience for up to 4 players. Choose your character and prepare to have fun with one of the game modes. In Tower Challenge you need to overcome single-player challenges with rising difficulty. Arena Mode makes you play with your friends on one of the 14 arenas. In Swarm you need to survive zombie attacks and Blender makes you cut as many fruits as possible. Last but not least – why not to play Volleyball with one of your friends? Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 is a fun party games for everyone.

1838798461.title: Hexologic
1838798461.short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautiful world of Hexologic. Solve challenging, yet rewarding puzzles, listen to relaxing music and dive deep in the game’s atmosphere!

1838902884.title: Onigo Hunter
1838902884.short_description: What lies beyond the doors to the ruins? Become the best hunter in the world!

1839147945.title: Pyramid Quest
1839147945.short_description:
Pyramid Quest is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games.
The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.

1839147962.title: Strike Team Gladius
1839147962.short_description: Strike Team Gladius is a turn-based, tactical combat game.

1839283754.title: FAR: Changing Tides Windows Edition
1839283754.short_description: An atmospheric vehicle adventure that follows the emotional journey of a boy and his ship as he embarks on a voyage to find a new home. Sail stormy waters, dive unknown depths, and explore forgotten ruins in a beautifully realised, flooded world.

1839288621.title: Dragon Loop
1839288621.short_description:
Escape The Time Loop In This Open-World Metroidvania

Help Xi navigate a five-day time loop and figure out what happened to her memories in a vast hand-drawn world.
 
Together with her companion, Ouro, travel through a true metroidvania world where time changes the terrain in subtle ways. Escape the loop through exploration and battle. Change Xi’s fate and learn the truth of the Dragon Loop!
 
• Turn Bosses into Summonable Spirits
 
Defeat a wide range of interesting bosses to get exclusive summonable spirits. Destroy your foes with powerful Explosive Spirits, or summon Persistent Spirit companions to follow you around. Upgrade and evolve both types to enhance their combat power!
 
• Multipurpose Metroidvania Powers
 
Find rare Pearls to summon powerful tools that help you traverse the world. Spiky pufferfish, magnetic boxes, a vacuuming whale spirit… and more. Each has multiple uses in both combat and traversing the world, unlocking many ways to play!
 
• Fast-Paced Exciting Battles
 
Combine Xi’s strength with Ouro’s agility in fast-paced combat. Play well, manage your X-Rating, and boost your speed and combat power even further in this fast-paced combat system with no contact damage.
 
• Branches in Time
 
In Dragon Loop, time is a limited resource. Use your five days wisely and plan your routes through an easily-navigable Time Map. Explore and open up new worldlines to see how things play out differently.But don’t worry: this isn’t a roguelike; you never start from scratch.

1839348416.title: Block Breaker Rafted
1839348416.short_description:
Block Breaker Rafted Game ! 

Classic arkanoid fan game!

Skip all the levels and build your raft!

Each chapter is more challenging than the next!

Let's share with your friends and challenge them!

1839403227.title: BombPaws (Windows)
1839403227.short_description:
BombPaws is a fast-paced, bomberman-inspired action game where explosive strategy meets chaotic fun. Step into the paws of a fearless feline hero who uncovers a hidden alien invasion disguised as everyday household furniture. Sofas, wardrobes, TVs — nothing is what it seems.

Armed with powerful bombs and sharp instincts, players must strategically plant explosives, uncover disguised enemies, and clear each room before time runs out. Every level challenges your reflexes, positioning, and tactical thinking as you blast through obstacles and expose alien infiltrators lurking in plain sight.

With tight controls, quick-paced gameplay, and a playful premise, BombPaws delivers an energetic arcade experience where every explosion brings you closer to saving humanity — because someone has to notice the invasion.

1839607296.title: The Surge 2 - Windows 10
1839607296.short_description:
On the way to Jericho City, your plane is shot down by a mysterious storm and crash-lands in the outskirts. Armor-clad soldiers enforce Martial Law, robots are on a rampage, and a dark, expanding nanostorm looms over the cityscape...

- Hardcore, brutal melee combat
- Face deadly foes and colossal bosses
- Cut off parts of the enemy you want to loot
- Rich character progression and customization.

1839622239.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 2
1839622239.short_description:
METAL SLUG 2 is an action game released by SNK in 1998.
Players can choose from Marko, Tarma, Eri and Fio, with the aim of defeating Morden’s Rebel Army which is plotting a coup once again. In addition to the Heavy Machine Guns and Shotguns from the previous games, new weapons such as laser guns have been added for even more battle variations.

1839636294.title: Cloudpunk - XBS/X
1839636294.short_description: A neon-noir story in a rain-drenched cyberpunk metropolis. It’s your first night on the job working for the Cloudpunk delivery service. Two rules: Don’t miss a delivery and don’t ask what’s in the package.

1839710374.title: Radiant: Guardians Of Light Demo
1839710374.short_description: Battle through a magical world in this explosive co-op action game. Master elemental powers, craft your gear, and face legendary enemies to save the kingdom of Helia.

1839740207.title: Supraland
1839740207.short_description: Supraland is the ultimate "sandbox" adventure and offers players a fresh take on puzzles, exploration, and adventure!

1839773225.title: Block Puzzle Classic 2
1839773225.short_description:
Fun and classic block game!

Once you start, you will never stop! 

👉How to play?
- Drag blocks to place them in the board.
- The line will be cleared if it's full vertically or horizontally.
- Game will be over if there is no room for more blocks.

1839786246.title: Murdered: Soul Suspect
1839786246.short_description: A dark, supernatural detective thriller with a unique gameplay twist: solving your own murder from the afterlife.

1839911748.title: Hidden Cats in Santa's Realm
1839911748.short_description: Mew-rry Christmas, everyone – come look for cats in a festive little town!

1840049850.title: Lemnis Gate
1840049850.short_description: Lemnis Gate is the revolutionary turn-based combat strategy FPS taking place in a time loop. Master the unique abilities of powerful deep-space operatives and compete in mind-bending four-dimensional battles.

1840066568.title: Pigeon Simulator
1840066568.short_description: Born to protect, forced to pigeon.

1840144233.title: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
1840144233.short_description: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

1840246441.title: Random Heroes: Gold Edition
1840246441.short_description: Stop an alien invasion by teaming up with a bunch of random heroes!

1840411466.title: Untitled Goose Game
1840411466.short_description: It's a lovely day in the village, and you are a horrible goose.

1840424586.title: Valfaris: Mecha Therion
1840424586.short_description: Therion returns as the hunt for Lord Vroll continues. Pilot an advanced machine of death and destruction in this explosive 2.5D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up, and sequel to the critically acclaimed Valfaris. Strap in and unleash mecha hell!

1840432267.title: Pool_Game
1840432267.short_description:
You can play solo against AI or challenge other players in two-player mode. The game is easy for anyone to start playing, so pick up a cue and line up your first shot.

How to Play?
Pick a ball!
8-Ball Billiards is an intuitive billiards game where you have to pot all of the striped or spotted balls. The balls you’re assigned depend on what ball is potted first.

Line up your cue!
The controls are easy, simply click and drag to find the right level of force, then line up the angle with the ball that seems easiest to pot next.

1840485962.title: Vampire: Hidden Objects
1840485962.short_description: - What can be more exciting than playing with the Evil? If I win you’ll be my dinner. If lady fortune turns her face from me, a mystery will be unveiled.

1840490628.title: Coloring Book World (Pro)
1840490628.short_description: Explore Your Creativity with Coloring Book World!

1840555675.title: Before Exit : Supermarket
1840555675.short_description:
In Before Exit: Supermarket, as a supermarket employee, your job is to close the store at night. With everyone gone, your supervisor has given you the responsibility to lock up. Can you handle it? 

The game combines roguelike features with logical riddles and a walking simulator genre to create a unique experience. Play day by day to find all the assignments, and remember every task before coming back home.

Make sure you turn off all the lights, close all the refrigerators, and clean the questionably clean floor. But wait - is that expired yogurt? Is one letter in a neon sign not lit? Did someone leave a piece of paper behind the store counter?

Your boss is extremely strict, so if even one condition is not met, you will face the harsh reality of being fired. The pressure is on. Can you handle it? The fate of your virtual job is in your hands.

1840565677.title: Island Saver
1840565677.short_description: A group of amazing islands need your help! Horrid plastic waste has washed up and you need to sort it out with your trusty Trash Blaster! But look out for the Litterbugs. They love mess and they’re out to muck things up.

1840574171.title: Murder on the Marine Express
1840574171.short_description: A mystery visual novel taking place aboard the underwater train the Marine Express. Follow student Ranko Togawa on her quest to track down the culprit as she searches for clues, questions the other students and undercovers evidence.

1840648262.title: Georifters Demo
1840648262.short_description: The ground is your weapon in the fast paced battle arena of Georifters. Team up with or against your friends to punch portals, twist tunnels, flip lasers, and steal the ground from under each other using a unique arsenal of weapons and abilities in this ground busting adventure.

1840649344.title: Farming Life
1840649344.short_description:
Are you tired of corporate life? Create your own farm! Plant vegetables and fruits, harvest crops, employ workers, take care of animals. Buy farm equipment, manage employees and just relax!


Become the greatest agricultural entrepreneur!

Are you tired of corporate life? Create your own farm from scratch! Plant vegetables and fruits, harvest crops, employ workers, take care of animals. Buy farm equipment, manage employees and just relax! After a hard day’s work - chill out at a farm!


Build your own farm full of village houses, sheds and granaries. Build roads and design optimal fields with various crops. Choose what you want to plant or sow: apples, beetroots, cabbages, carrots, corns, leeks, onions, pepper, pumpkins, sunflowers, tomatoes, wheat.
Make sure they are watered and kept away from pests!


Remember to take care of your animals! Prepare a place to live for cats, chickens, cows, dogs, goats, geese, horses, pigs, ostriches, rabbits and sheep. Don’t forget to feed them! Keeping them clean is also very important.

Running a big farm will teach you managing financial operations, recruiting human resources and most importantly being responsible for your crops and animals. Make your farm profitable and gain resources to develop it even more!

And remember: Always look on the bright side of a farm!

1840654547.title: Hex Cats (Xbox One)
1840654547.short_description: Twist and move hex pieces to connect yarn threads for playful felines. A charming twist on classic hex pipes puzzle!

1840686590.title: Neon Shape Rush
1840686590.short_description: A fast-paced neon arcade shooter focused on reflexes, precision, and pure action. Dodge glowing hazards, defeat relentless enemies, and survive the rush in this controller-optimized retro-inspired experience.

1840741412.title: Helheim Hassle Demo
1840741412.short_description: Helheim Hassle is a narrative adventure game with puzzle platforming elements. Play as Bjørn, a pacifist Viking that can detach and combine limbs at will to solve challenging puzzles and get out of uncomfortable situations involving desperate Norse Gods, Goblins, Dragons, and angry skeletons.

1840798387.title: DARKLAND III
1840798387.short_description: DARKLAND is an exciting retro-style platformer adventure!Guide our brave shadow hero across mysterious valleys in search of the hidden key that unlocks the portal. Watch out for deadly traps overhead, spikes beneath your feet, and treacherous cliffs at every turn! Leap onto enemies to destroy them, but be careful not to lose your footing.Challenge yourself through 50 thrilling levels and enjoy the adventure!Have fun exploring DARKLAND!

1840838234.title: Nightshade Mysteries: Eternal Moon Collector's Edition
1840838234.short_description:
Archaeologist Helena Nightshade gets entangled in the mysteries surrounding an ominous eternal lunar eclipse, 
prophesied by estranged Moon Worshippers also known as the Anaxagori.

Set in 1930s Southern Europe, where technology has eclipsed magic, 
an estranged group of Moon Worshippers known as the Anaxagori resurfaces with an ominous prophecy: an eternal lunar eclipse. 
Dismissed by the public as antiquated mystics, the Anaxagori's warnings contrast sharply with the populace's enthusiasm for what is hailed as a historic celestial event. 
Fresh from an archaeological expedition, Helena Nightshade only learns of the eclipse's significance upon arriving in Istanbul.

- Follow the story of Helena Nightshade
- Solve the mystery of the Eternal Lunar Eclipse
- Travel through 1930s Southern Europe
- 35 chapters with 1-3 sub scenes
- 29 subgames relating to the story
- 6 special chapters.

1840894018.title: Drilling Chicks
1840894018.short_description: Drilling Chicks is a 2-4 local multiplayer game about chicks trying to mine fuel for their spaceship, before their fuel tank runs dry!

1840987106.title: Zombie Sokoban
1840987106.short_description:
All this poor Zombie wants is some food and they've gone and stuck him in a puzzle game. He has to push around bloody crates (literally!) just so he can get out and find some brains to munch on. Classic sokoban but with a zombie twist. 60 mind bending puzzles to get through. Help a zombie out.

The aim of the game is to push the crates over the targets. Cover all targets to pass the level. It may sound easy but it is not!

Controls: 

- Use the left thumb stick or d-pad to move the zombie around.
- Press B while in game to undo moves (unlimited undos available)
- Press Menu then Y to return to the main menu
- On the top option in the main menu press left or right to select a level
- Only levels you have unlocked will be available.

1840991052.title: Promenade - Demo
1840991052.short_description:
Go on an adventure in a world packed with secrets with a helpful poulp.
Explore dungeons, solve puzzles and blast through races in this 2D platformer!

1840996916.title: Kinect Sports Rivals
1840996916.short_description:
Become a Champion! Cutting-edge Kinect technology scans your likeness to put YOU in the game. 
 
Wake Racing, Climbing, Target Shooting, Soccer, Bowling and Tennis are all in play with power-ups, equipment and outfits specific to each event. 
 
With the power of Xbox Live, your friends are always there to challenge whether they’re online or not. Find your play style, customize your experience and choose a team worthy of your skill. 
 Kinect Sports Rivals: it’s YOU vs. the world!

1841005271.title: Gloomy Eyes
1841005271.short_description: A cozy horror, “self-coop”, adventure about two unlikely souls who forge a forbidden bond and journey together to find the sun. Explore eerie yet charming Tim Burton-esque levels, switch between two unique characters, and solve brain-teasing puzzles.

1841011808.title: Blizzard® Arcade Collection
1841011808.short_description: Relax and rewind with the Blizzard® Arcade Collection, featuring faithful reproductions of Blackthorne®, The Lost Vikings®, Rock N Roll Racing®, Lost Vikings® 2 and RPM Racing™ for modern platforms!

1841018312.title: Crazy Athletics - Summer Sports and Games
1841018312.short_description: On your marks, get set, go! This is definitely the craziest summer sports game ever! Ten games and many more crazy tasks, with cartoon 4K 2D graphics: 4K@120FPS (Xbox Series X & PC) and 4K@60FPS (Xbox One & PC).

1841045106.title: Die for the Economy!
1841045106.short_description: Experience a new take on a classic as you explore the mazes, blast robots and try to escape from this homage to 80s maze-based arcade gaming!

1841055635.title: New York Mysteries 5: Power of Art
1841055635.short_description:
What hides behind the broad strokes of the artist? Talent and skill, or something else?

Three adventures in one story are waiting for you!

“New York Mysteries: Power of Art” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests. 

Creators usually create art for their benefit and the benefit of others. However, anything can become evil... This is just such a case.
When paintings go missing, the police investigate the crime, but who takes on the case when the painting's image goes missing? Bishop, leader of the White Stone Order!
The Order has long gained notoriety in certain circles. Its members are engaged in mystical crimes, which no one dares to investigate. Journalist Laura boldly takes on such cases. Nothing surprises her anymore. However, this incident will lead her to discoveries that will be unexpected even for such an experienced detective. After all, our world is full of secrets. Can there be other worlds besides our world? In this case, there will be twice as many secrets!

Immerse yourself into the criminal world of 20th-century New York City
Conduct a detective investigation of the case on the verge of fantasy
Gather amazing collections and find dozens of morphing-objects
Enjoy stunning locations and atmospheric soundtracks
Solve dozens of puzzles and test your skills by playing exciting mini-games.

1841062643.title: Hunt: Showdown 1896
1841062643.short_description: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is a new era of the addictively unforgiving extraction shooter. In corrupted backwaters lost to history, fight back alone – or with friends – against timeless evil. Twisted monsters and other ruthless Hunters stand between you and your Bounty. Risk everything as Hunt consumes you.

1841078711.title: Zombie Derby 2 (Windows)
1841078711.short_description: Discover the dangerous post-apocalyptic world with cool upgradable cars!

1841198850.title: Keeper's Toll
1841198850.short_description:
Arise, fallen hero, and see your journey through!

Enter Keeper's Toll, an action-packed survival roguelite set within a retro-infused dark fantasy world. Every moment could be your last, but with each setback, you grow stronger. Seize the challenge, overcome daunting foes and purge a callous world in top-down pixel art style. Keeper’s Toll places a heavy focus on skill-based gameplay with action RPG elements. Each run allows you to study your enemies and hone your skills while progressing through the main quest.

Once you have mastered the basics, Keeper’s Toll introduces unique enemy archetypes, intricate bosses and fresh mechanics that will challenge any worthy hero. Choose from the Shadow Monk, Pyromancer, Blood Maiden, Necromancer, Ranger and Bogatyr. Each hero has unique mechanics, abilities and progression trees to explore. Ferocious bosses and cutthroat invaders lie at the heart of Keeper’s Toll and its perilous lands. Strengthen your character with quick-thinking strategy or suffer a swift end to your journey!

1841214941.title: Pangeon
1841214941.short_description: Pangeon is a single player roguelike inspired by dungeon crawler classics. Dive right into a dungeon on a suicide mission to kill all the monsters.

1841233360.title: The Alto Collection
1841233360.short_description: Two journeys lie in wait across the endless desert and atop an alpine expanse. Choose your path and set off on a thrilling adventure with Alto & friends.

1841290462.title: Dark Alliance
1841290462.short_description: The world of Dungeons & Dragons comes to life in an explosive action RPG filled with real-time combat and dynamic co-op. Choose your hero and join up to three friends to battle legendary monsters, earn powerful gear, and unlock new abilities to take on even bigger challenges.

1841294814.title: Project Warlock
1841294814.short_description: Project Warlock is a first person shooter that fans of Doom, Hexen and Wolfenstein cannot miss. It serves you an exploding cocktail of bullets, spells and monsters. Battle through 60 levels of non stop action packed with bloodthirsty enemies and challenging bosses.

1841391186.title: Legendary Tales 3: Stories
1841391186.short_description:
Defeat the unknown illnesses, break the unseen spells, and meet new, unexpected friends!

“Legendary Tales: Stories” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

This chapter will reveal behind-the-scenes stories from the Legendary Tales world. 
•Discover how an ordinary herbalist handled a deadly disease spreading across his village. 
•Learn how a young girl navigated a dangerous forest to deliver gifts to her ailing grandmother. 
•Follow a brave warrior in search of his friend's children. Discover how these events unfold while searching for Hidden Objects, unique Collectibles, and solving challenging puzzles!

- Discover thrilling stories about familiar characters
- Explore the magic world and its forgotten secrets
- Gather fascinating collections and find dozens of morphing objects
- Enjoy stunning locations and beautiful soundtracks
- Solve dozens of puzzles and test your skills in exciting mini-games.

1841498671.title: CONSCRIPT
1841498671.short_description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles - all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new take on classic survival horror.

1841510170.title: Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing
1841510170.short_description: Jump into a 900 horsepower Sprint Car for some Saturday night dirt racing action! Feel the rush as you slide through the turns to take the checkered flag!

1841524842.title: Rookie Knight (Windows)
1841524842.short_description: Rookie Knight is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer. Run, jump, wall slide, and fight your way through forests, mountains, and castles filled with traps and enemies.

1841689454.title: Plumber Hero
1841689454.short_description: Save the city from the flood and the alligator plague. Are you ready?

1841771506.title: Raging Bytes
1841771506.short_description: A story-driven zombie RPG full of drama and pixels! Survive the raging bytes!

1842049989.title: DCL-The Game
1842049989.short_description:

In this game, immerse yourself in an intricate story, where dreams and reality are intertwined into a single whole. Where, at some point, reality itself may lose its stability.

1842095345.title: Otherwar
1842095345.short_description:
Producer: kantal collective

OTHERWAR is a surprising mash-up of Tower Defense and Bullet Hell with the charm and classy aesthetic of the timeless pixel art.

Embody the role of the defender angel who has been called forth to stem the tide of an encroaching hell horde. It falls upon your halo to plan out the defenses, however your adversaries shall not stand idly as they will blot out the sun with fire just to clip your wings. Yet, you are not defenseless as the angel can smite enemies on his own if need be.

Unlike other Tower Defense games, Otherwar's cast of enemies will keep you on your toes as almost every enemy fires a different kind of projectile. From the ever-following eyeballs to slowly approaching wide spider webs and patterns of swirling leaves cast by undead treants. Amidst the chaos of battle, you will also have to be on the look-out for certain enemies such as necromancers, who, if allowed to linger for too long, will raise skeletons from the dead that may overwhelm your defenses.

Before each mission you will have a chance to select towers and skills that will aid you in battle. From straight-forward offensive towers to more situational constructs such as slowing fields that will bog down approaching enemies or emplacements that shoot down incoming projectiles. Besides structures, the angel can also upgrade his own skills during the battle and acquire new abilities between missions. Making each of the 9 levels a puzzle for you to solve.

Go, Defender! Carry your light into the dark!

1842105208.title: Tetsumo Party

1842194426.title: Dr. Oil
1842194426.short_description:
Dr. Oil is a bit hardcore 2D platforming experience that tells a story of a conflict between the butter boy and the seagull.

This story is heavy influenced by the popular fairy tales that you loved to hear so much as youngsters before the sleep. Once upon a time there was a boy who lived in a fabled and distant kingdom. One day he was bitten by a seagull and therefore he turned into the Captain Seagull. Hatred and darkness filled the heart of that boy, and he became evil because all seagulls are evil!

Though he's not our hero. Our hero today is a slice of butter named Doctor Oil. Dr. Oil is a bit evil as well, but not as evil as any seagull! This brave and tiny dairy product just hates the sounds of seagulls, and so he decides to kill Captain Seagull by his own hand. This desire becomes the possible future that will last for the 75 stages from 5 different worlds! By the way, we have a wonderful trailer here as well, so be sure to watch it just after you'll buy this game!

Thanks everyone!

1843471505.title: Brightstone Mysteries: The Others (Xbox)
1843471505.short_description:
Upon your arrival to the town, things get more and more mysterious and clouded.

1843963319.title: Dominoes Colors
1843963319.short_description:
Dominoes Colors

It is a puzzle relaxing game with 30 stages.You need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.
Colors

The game contains 16 different colors, explore your knowledge about colors to discover what will be the next mix result. The "white piece" and "black piece" are special colors, try any kind of combinations with these pieces to identify theirs secrets.
Pieces

Each piece has its own "color side" and "blank side", the blank side will be another color after the colored piece side in your "hand" combine with a colored piece in "board".
Win Condition

The last piece is signaled by a chequered flag, to win you must combine the colors gradually until arrives the last piece.
Coins and Stars

When you finish a stage you will be rewarded with coins and stars according with the quantities of pieces utilized, so if you discovered new ways to complete the same stage, return and unlock all your rewards.
Obstacles and Powerups

According your advance in game, you will notice some obstacles, each one has its own behaviour and complexity. But to help and ease your path, you will can buy powerups with the coins earned in each stage.

1843996291.title: Mel The Space Cat

Welcome to the universe of Mel The Space Cat!

In Mel The Space Cat, you’ll guide Mel, a courageous cosmic cat traveling across alien planets in search of safety even if that means escaping from energy traps, laser cannons, hazardous landscapes, and the mysterious alien Theo!
Across 40 handcrafted space levels, your reflexes and timing will be pushed to the limit in a journey filled with charm, danger, and zero gravity surprises.

Run from danger as you explore alien worlds!

Your mission is simple: help Mel survive each extraterrestrial environment and reach her spaceship.
But beware these planets are full of cosmic threats! Dodge deadly traps, avoid energy balls and cannons, and master tricky platforming challenges across unique interstellar biomes.

Simple controls, increasing challenge.

With easy-to-learn controls, Mel The Space Cat is accessible for players of all ages — but completing all 40 space levels is no small feat.
Precision, quick reactions, and perfect timing will be essential as the adventure grows more intense.

Travel across colorful and dangerous planets.

Journey through vibrant cosmic environments, from glowing purple planets to massive static worlds suspended in space each location brings new challenges, new traps, and unique surprises along your interstellar path.

1844932788.short_description:
Etaria is fictional and mysterious world with a variety of animals and creatures.

◄World of Etaria ► 
Whole world is randomly generated and endless.
