Explore new territories or go down inside of deep caves?

◄Creatures of Etaria ► 
While traveling in the world of Etaria you will notice that creatures and animals may vary upon each location. You will meet not only cute squirrels and fluffy lambs, but huge and scary scorpions and many others. 

◄Sand-box elements ► 
This game has sandbox features, such as changing landscapes and building shelters and other useful structures.

◄Survival elements ► 
Etaria also has survival features. You will need to gather food, fight with wild animals, go hunting, fishing, building shelters and a lots of other stuff to do.

◄Hunting and fishing ► 
Etaria gives you opportunity for hunting animals, gather food, and useful resources such as skin, animal teeth, and etc. Fishing in ponds is one of the most fascinating things to do in this game. By the way, you have to choose the right time of the day in order to make fishing more successful and gather as much fish as possible. 

◄Citizens ► 
You can establish your own village, where your citizens can be settled. Each citizen can have it`s unique profession: lumberjack, hunter, fisherman, miner and etc. 

◄Features ► 
• Randomly generated and endless world
• Different biomes (forests, fields, deserts, swamps, and others)
• Variety of animals and creatures
• Tons of stuff to do: hunting, fishing, mining, crafting and etc
• Tower defense elements. Establish your village and attacks others.
• Survival elements. Survive and fight for your life.

1845067734.title: Pirate Monkey Climb!
1845067734.short_description:
The Pirate Monkey ship is sinking! Climb the mast while avoiding Obstacles, Cannon Balls, and Parrots. Collect Bananas to score big. Compete for best Score, Height, and Bananas on the Xbox LIVE Leaderboards against your Friends and the World. Play as Pirate Monkey Jake or Pirate Monkey Jade.

Please note:
Creators Collection games, such as this one, cannot contain Xbox LIVE achievements and as such cannot increase your GamerScore.
Please be sure to give this game all the required permissions to access Xbox LIVE otherwise Leaderboards and Cloud saving will NOT be available.

1845089422.title: Beacon of Neyda Demo
1845089422.short_description: In a world where a robot revolution failed, the last humans search for a way to survive and escape. Beacon of Neyda is a side-scroller strategy game where you have to survive waves of enemies while creating and upgrading your base.

1845224726.title: Codename: Black Crow
1845224726.short_description: The battlefield is the only place that holds the answers.

1845248290.title: A Juggler's Tale
1845248290.short_description: Lead Abby the string puppet through a bruised, but beautiful fairy tale world in this cinematic 3rd person adventure. Solve riddles, evade traps, and shake off pursuers on your way to find freedom. Can Abby take control of her own fate with all the strings attached?

1845299435.title: Recall: Empty Wishes
1845299435.short_description: Recall: Empty Wishes is a psychological thriller set in Taiwan during the 2010s. Follow Yonny, a sister determined to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper, she confronts unsettling secrets, blurring the lines between reality and illusion.

1845322433.title: Suzerain
1845322433.short_description:
Embark on a thrilling story as President Anton Rayne, steering Sordland through a pivotal time. Confront potential border conflicts, deep-seated corruption, and economic turmoil while navigating complex political dynamics in Anton's first term. As the leader, your choices will shape Sordland's destiny. How will you lead?

Features:

Gripping Story: Traverse a 1 Million+-word branching political saga packed with deep and layered conversations.

Choices with Impact: Make critical decisions on security, economy, welfare, and diplomacy. Your values will be tested beyond the confines of your office.

Your Legacy: Drive Sordland towards one of 9 unique major endings and more than 25 sub-endings. What will your legacy be?

Grand Cast: Engage with a diverse cast of more than 50 characters, each with unique personalities and ideologies.

Duty vs. Personal Values: Witness how your presidential decisions influence the country but also your family and relationships.

Stay Informed: Keep tabs on the state of affairs through country or interactable city tokens, policies, situations, news and reports. See the impact and result of your actions.

Discover the Suzerain Universe: Read about newly introduced nations, codex articles about history, and feel the pulse of the world events.

1845341024.title: Lumo 2
1845341024.short_description:
The isometric icon is back in the sequel to 2016’s arcade-adventure hit, Lumo. Experience a brand-new adventure of shifting dimensions and new perspectives, with gameplay that never stops evolving.

Rewind the cassette and fall head over heels into a love letter to the trailblazing days of early ‘80s & ‘90s British videogames.

Adventure calls—grab your hat, light your staff, and leap into a world of shifting landscapes and interconnected rooms, each a meticulously designed puzzle box with dangers to doge, precision platforming and secrets to uncover.

Echoing the games from the 8bit era, you’ll have to explore and experiment to crack the challenges within.

Hunt for collectibles, and vault through portals—some even flip the script, morphing into wild genre twists that’ll keep you on your toes.

Features:
-	100 rooms to explore with platforming challenges and puzzles
-	Three mini games to master
-	25 cassettes to hunt down 
-	20 ducks to collect that require you to master the controls.

1845393429.title: Suika Nyaa (Xbox Series X/S)
1845393429.short_description: Suika Nyaa is a Suika game where you fuse cat spheres to attract cats! Fuse two similar cat spheres to create a bigger one and every time you discover a new sphere, a new cat will appear in game! Can you find and attract all the cats?

1845419881.title: Guazu: The Rescue
1845419881.short_description: Boarding on this adventure with Guazu in a wide forest of dangers, where you will rescue your friends who have been captured.

1845482837.title: Justice Sucks
1845482837.short_description: In JUSTICE SUCKS, you play as Dusty, a killer robot vacuum on a quest for vengeance.

1845521581.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4 (Windows)
1845521581.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level!

1845646569.title: Yakuza Kiwami 2
1845646569.short_description: The Tojo Clan and Omi Alliance are on the brink of war. Kazuma Kiryu, the Dragon of Dojima, enters as a broker of peace, but Ryuji Goda, the Dragon of Kansai, will stop at nothing to start an all-out war. In this world, there can only be one dragon.

1845677911.title: Marshmallow Takeover Open Beta
1845677911.short_description: Welcome to the Marshmallow Takeover Open Beta. It's a 2-player couch versus, platformer fight between 2 marshmallow friends, Gooey and Stewie to see who the superior fighter is. Who has what it takes?

1845701688.title: Knightoban (Xbox One)
1845701688.short_description: Knightoban is a fantasy-themed puzzle game where a brave knight ventures into a dungeon filled with deadly traps and ancient secrets. Your goal is to clear the path and collect all the treasures to complete each level. By pushing blocks, sealing acid holes, and unlocking gates, you’ll create a safe route for the knight to reach every treasure.

1845803335.title: Boxes Wizard (Windows)
1845803335.short_description: Boxes Wizard is a platform and puzzle game with 36 challenging levels. You control a wizard with the unique ability to swap with boxes scattered throughout the stage.

1845814371.title: Card Party Showdown
1845814371.short_description: Gather family and friends for three lively card games filled with lucky draws, quick reactions, and playful rivalries. Play solo against computer opponents or compete locally with up to four players.

1845885580.title: RV There Yet?
1845885580.short_description:
A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home. 

DRIVE HOME

You and your buddies are on your way home from a relaxing vacation but are forced to take an alternate route. Get your RV through the back country and find the exit to Route 65.

SURVIVE MABUTTS VALLEY

Not everyone who enters Mabutts Valley makes it out alive. So be sure to keep a steady flow of burgers, antidotes, and the classic: EpiPens.

WINCH IT GOOD

Master the physics based winch and earn the right to be the main remote commander. With a winch front and rear, your RV is especially equipped to get over, under or through most road bumps.

HELP YOURSELF, AND EACH OTHER

Help yourself to cold brewskis and filtered low tar cigarettes, but don’t forget that the driver will have a hard time completing this journey alone.

A SCRAPPY BUNCH

Use everything you find to maintain the integrity of your RV and friendships.

1845916931.title: Bool Capture
1845916931.short_description:
Trapped in a glitching program, your mission in Bool Capture is simple: clear the field of menacing red system balls. 
Use physics-based arcade action to hit the red balls and capture the yellow ones. 
The COREDROM system is recovering – can you finish before it’s too late?

1845944662.title: Escape the Abyss (XBox Series)
1845944662.short_description: Ane, a fearless space explorer, is trapped in a deadly vertical world after her ship crashes into a mysterious planet. To escape, she must climb dangerous stages, defeat relentless alien enemies, and collect rare Quartz B crystals to repair her ship and reclaim her freedom.

1845962995.title: Next of Kin: Fidelity
1845962995.short_description: Bjorn is a man haunted by a past that refuses to let go. But what is it that's haunting him – and how, or who, can set him free?

1845982020.title: Gigapocalypse
1845982020.short_description:
As a little kid, picking up your dragon toys, spewing fire, feels powerful and destroying everything is one of the best childhood memories for many of us.
Now you become that giant monster in Gigapocalypse, a 2D pixel art destruction game, inspired by classical Kaijū movies such as “Godzilla” and “King Kong” and the game classic “Rampage”.

Gigapocalypse features a selection of different “Gigas” from the Prehistoric era, the uncharted outer space and the forgotten history. Each with unique skills, mutations and manifold skins that can be unlocked with level ups.
Start your destruction spree and destroy everything on your way through different beautifully detailed pixel style locations. Ever wondered how it looks like when a giant monster destroys a wild west town? Or clashing against the brave Knights Templar? Gigapocalypse has the answer. But beware: Nasty soldiers, wizards, drones and mechs will do everything to stop you! With each try your Giga will become more powerful until you will finally make it to the diversified, epic boss fights that await you at the end of each level.

Complete quests, take care of your Giga in Tamagotchi-style mini games, find secrets to upgrade your Giga and its “home” and unlock cute, but yet lethal pets that accompany you on journey.

Gigapocalypse is loud, punk, metal, anarchy and a lovely homage to the game and movie classics. It´s a game for the kid in all of us.

1845992078.title: GENIE Reprise
1845992078.short_description:
Unlock mysteries scattered through time in a surreal first-person fantasy adventure!

Take the role of Lula and explore a vibrant fantasy world as she journeys to discover the meaning of the Genie and fulfill her destiny! GENIE Reprise is an atmospheric fantasy adventure told through fully voiced poetry and 3D first-person exploration.

Immerse yourself in mystical towns and the surrounding countryside as you collect crystal shards to reveal the next part of the poem that adds to the Genie’s lore, scattered across 15 chapters that span multiple eras and transform the environment around you. Meet intriguing and enigmatic characters and discover how their stories are intertwined as you seek a final truth.

1846016063.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
1846016063.short_description: THE FIRST CLASSIC CRPG IN THE WARHAMMER 40,000 UNIVERSE.

1846024820.title: Farmer Survivors (Windows)
1846024820.short_description: Defeat powerful enemies and become the hero of the farm!

1846081644.title: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process
1846081644.short_description: Greetings, valued employee. You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%.

1846145161.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
1846145161.short_description: From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, & 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears & awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. Strengthen your bonds and build your party to take down powerful foes and discover the kingdom’s true nature.

1846150319.short_description: This is an FTP server for UWP.

1846193647.short_description: Choose your path and solve the mystery of the Sol Dorado Heist!

1846221159.title: NBA THE RUN - OPEN BETA

1846285148.title: CrossfireX
1846285148.short_description:
Attention Mercenaries,

It is with the deepest regret that we are informing you of our decision to end support for CrossfireX on May 18, 2023 @ 21:00 ET. Since the launch of the game, we have worked tirelessly to bring it to a point where we can all be proud, and throughout it all we have had the honor and pleasure of supporting our players.

For full details, please visit our website at the following: www.crossfirex.com.

1846300936.title: Magical Backpack
1846300936.short_description: Lara found a magical backpack that allows her to fly and collect Light stars in an enchanted kingdom. Help her overcome challenges, capture stars, and advance through the levels in this adventure!

1846324298.title: Skater's Solstice
1846324298.short_description:
Become a master of the ice by skating your way through increasingly challenging sliding puzzles!

Slide across frozen lakes and gather stars in a chill puzzle adventure where you take the role of a young ice skater! Skater’s Solstice is a top-down brainteasing game with a wintry theme and crisp HD visuals where you’ll need to overcome 50 stages of gradually increasing complexity to achieve ice skating mastery. Each stage contains 3 stars and a glimmering exit.

Can you put it all together and gather all the stars?

1846471797.title: Bard's Gold - X Edition
1846471797.short_description:
Bard's Gold is a challenging platformer that let's you explore eerie worlds in a quest for a Goblin that stole your gold. Help the Bard to overcome the dungeon’s many dangerous perils and use your new-found treasures to improve your character and to buy new weapons and gear! 

Rogue-lite - Different layouts for each level is randomly chosen every playthrough. While getting the chance to memorize levels and get better at them, the 'random level' system will keep your interest. With the gems you collect you will be able to upgrade your character on the Game Over screen.

1846475286.title: 8 ball master
1846475286.short_description: If you like to play billiards. This is the right game for you. Play timed or against a friend. Have a lot of fun with it.

1846510254.title: Under the Warehouse
1846510254.short_description:
Explore the darkest corners of a mysterious building and its underground in search of a special egg!

In an unnamed city, deep in the urban sprawl, lies a darkened building of brick and concrete filled with boxes, documents, appliances and enigmatic workers of all sorts. No one seems to question the mysterious, haunting atmosphere of the complex. In first-person adventure Under the Warehouse, you take the role of a worker who receives a phone call and a request for help.

The caller needs an egg that lies somewhere in the confines of the warehouse, but in order to find it, you’ll need to converse with the other workers, uncover clues, collect items, solve puzzles in classic point-and-click fashion and explore the darkest corners of this place. With multiple endings to discover, the surreal journey ahead will test you wits and reward your curiosity… if you’ve got the courage to face it.

1846550336.title: Factory Escape
1846550336.short_description: Has work ever tried to kill you? Max is trapped in a deadly factory. Use your rolling skill, dodge traps, and find the key to escape!

1846638355.title: Snake.io - Slither Wormate
1846638355.short_description: 🐍 Slither, grow, and survive in the ultimate offline snake battle! 🧲 Collect power-ups, unlock cool skins 🎨, explore wild worlds 🌍, and dominate in multiple game modes like Battle Royale ⚔️ and King Mode 👑. Eat or be eaten—can you become the biggest snake?

1846662502.title: Puppet House
1846662502.short_description:
Puppet House is a horror survival game. Take on the role of Rick Evans, a photographer with a passion for abandoned and haunted places. Visit the mansion of the deceased Peter Hill and check if you can unravel the place's dark history.

Mystery Story
The press continued to receive reports of disturbing screams coming from the property owned by the late ventriloquist Peter Hill. However, attempts to investigate these incidents have been unsuccessful. What is really going on in this long abandoned house?

Dangerous Investigation
Solve puzzles hidden in the house of Peter Hill to get to the truth. Take on challenges that require you not only to be clever, but also to think logically. Your mind will be put to the test, and any wrong decision can have tragic consequences.

Forgotten Mansion
Walk through dark corridors where shadows of the past and the present intertwine. Remember to look around carefully, forgotten mementos hide the keys to the unknown history of Peter Hill's house. Search the abandoned grounds of a property and find answers.

1846694005.title: Akuto: Showdown
1846694005.short_description: Akuto: Showdown is an award-nominated, isometric, fast-paced action game where players compete with swords and guns in intense versus matches.

1846698557.title: Snakes and Ladders Championship Demo
1846698557.short_description:
3D Snakes and Ladders is a visually enhanced digital version of the classic board game, set in a dynamic 3D environment. Players move across a 3D board filled with animated snakes and ladders. The game supports a single-player mode where the player competes against multiple AI opponents.

Key Features:
-Single Player: Play against 1–3 AI-controlled players.
-AI Opponents: Multiple AI difficulty levels for varied challenge.
-6 Different characters available for the player in the game. (1 character is available in Demo version)
-Animated Snakes: Snakes slither and animate when a player lands on them.
-Climbable Ladders: Characters visually climb ladders in real-time.
-3D Environment: Fully rendered board with zoom, rotate, and pan camera controls. 12 different levels available for the player. Difficulty increases after each level. (2 levels are available in Demo version)
-Many More.

1846720301.title: Music Expert
1846720301.short_description:
A simple but addictive game!

Choose your favorite genres of music and prove that you are a music expert :)

Features:
  - 22 genres
  - more than 700 artists
  - more than 24000 tracks
  - excellent design.

1846760960.title: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway
1846760960.short_description: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway features a cast of over 40 iconic characters; drift, slide and boost your way to the finish line on tracks inspired by legendary Nickelodeon shows!

1846788797.title: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
1846788797.short_description: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening. A story of survival and adventure in the brazilian backlands. Face the drought to explore the more arid regions, gather resources and discover clues about the fate of the young Cícera.

1846808891.title: Escape from the Dungeon (Xbox Series)
1846808891.short_description: Help Anthony overcome the traps and find the way out of the dungeon before it's too late!

1846898884.title: Cute Astro (Xbox Series)
1846898884.short_description: A Puzzle Show on the Star Stage.

1846929507.title: ConnecTank_SGDemo

1847003138.title: Without Escape: Console Edition
1847003138.short_description: Without Escape is a tribute to first-person graphic adventures of the early '90s with an interactive story told through pre-rendered background and full-motion video. Explore the confines of your own home as you flip between a mundane existence and a terrifying otherworld. Are you prepared to endure the horrors that await you?

1847013839.title: Full Mojo Rampage
1847013839.short_description: Full Mojo Rampage is a rogue-like game that takes place within the confines of the Voodoo reality. In this realm only the most powerful rites and powers can provide a safeguard against evil. Dying is not the end, only the beginning to becoming a stronger voodoo soul!

1847106181.title: Oppidum
1847106181.short_description: Enjoy Oppidum, a story-driven survival experience for 1-4 players full of adventure, action, crafting, exploration… Everything a squad of scouts would love for a good story to tell. Do you accept the challenge?

1847180415.title: Death and Taxes
1847180415.short_description: In this 2D, short narrative-based game, you assume the role of the Grim Reaper... on an office job. Your job is to decide which people are going to live or die. The consequences of your choices are yours to bear, while the mystery of your incarnation awaits revelation!

1847230857.title: Cuboid
1847230857.short_description: cuboid is a platform game that requires player patience to pass the level.

1847254069.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX

1847271903.title: Strong Moon
1847271903.short_description: Explore Lunaria's planet and become stronger with new allies help, Moon Shards and Strong Moon's mighty muscles.

1847331312.title: Just Dance® 2020 Demo

1847402697.title: ScreamRide

1847504269.title: Zippy the Circle (Xbox Version)
1847504269.short_description: A shadow appears over Zippy the Circle's home! Zippy must save his family and friends from Jagged, who has taken over his home island!

1847538028.title: The Secret Order: Shadow Breach (Xbox One Version)
1847538028.short_description: There are dark secrets that have an annoying tendency to crawl back into the light, escaping oblivion. But there is also Sarah Pennington, the most skilled agent of the ever-watching Secret Order, who is there to face them.

1847551904.title: Morbid: The Seven Acolytes
1847551904.short_description: Morbid: The Seven Acolytes is a Horrorpunk Action RPG filled with Lovecraftian horrors and Cronenbergian gore, making it the most gruesome take on the isometric Souls-like genre yet!

1847763173.title: Flying Soldiers
1847763173.short_description: Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.

1847786076.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 5 for Windows
1847786076.short_description:
METAL SLUG 5 is an action shooting game released by SNK in 2003.

Look forward to the new Slug Gunner and slide mechanic!

1847833268.short_description: Digiball is a top-down abstract multiplayer team sport where players project triangles in an attempt to deflect balls into the opposing team’s goal.

1847868611.title: Poetic Trio
1847868611.short_description: Poetic Trio is a themed set of three games. A game about rain (Pluviophile), a game about snow (Chionophile), and a game about wind (Loverowind). All in one. 1847979820.title: FIFA 22 Xbox Series X|S

1848024903.title: Dig Deep
1848024903.short_description: Grab a shovel and let's get digging! Join the adventure, hire miners and dig for a treasure.

1848061474.title: Ludo Multiplayer Dice Game
1848061474.short_description: Experience the timeless fun of Ludo with Ludo Multiplayer Dice Game! 🎉 Challenge your friends and family in exciting 2-player, 3-player, or 4-player modes. Enjoy local multiplayer fun with smooth graphics, intuitive controls, and engaging animations. Perfect for kids, families, and board game enthusiasts, this classic game guarantees endless entertainment. Download now and start your Ludo adventure today! 🎮📲🥇.

1848086883.title: Retro Machina
1848086883.short_description: Retro Machina is a single-player action and exploration game set in a retro-futuristic universe. Experience the journey of a little robot as they solve intricate puzzles and begin unraveling the mysteries of a world long forgotten.

Return to Planet 4546B to uncover the truth behind a deadly cover-up. Survive the harsh conditions by building habitats, crafting tools, and diving deeper into the world of Subnautica.

1848104117.title: Kiting Cat (Windows)

1848238632.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry
1848238632.short_description: Hey ladies, I’m back in business! I’m all set to date my way across the modern world!

1848367053.title: Star Trucker

1848403653.title: Space Adventure : Mercury (Windows)

1848421257.title: eFootball™

1848425097.title: Mighty Goose

1848677374.title: ZDQ Island Engagement
1848677374.short_description: Encroaching Fog, Sprinting Zombies, Splitscreen Battle Royale!

1848704212.title: Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect

1849447147.title: Technotopia
1849447147.short_description:
"In beginning the life story of my hero, Alexei Fyodorovich Karamazov, I find myself somewhat perplexed. That is to say: although I call Alexei Fyodorovich my hero, I myself know that he is by no means a great man; therefore I foresee inevitable questions of this kind: What is remarkable about your Alexei Fyodorovich that you have chosen him for your hero? What has he done that is notable? To whom and in what way is he known? Why should I, the reader, spend time learning the facts of his life?

The last question is the most fatal one, for I can only answer: “Perhaps you will see for yourself from the novel.” But suppose they read the novel and fail to see, and do not agree with me about the significance of my Alexei Fyodorovich? I say this because, to my regret, I foresee it. To me he is remarkable, but I greatly doubt whether I shall succeed in proving it to the reader. The fact is, he is perhaps a man of action, but an indeterminate and undefined one. Yet, it would be strange to demand clarity from people in times such as ours. One thing, however, is fairly certain: he is a strange man, even something of an eccentric. But strangeness and eccentricity do more harm than good in attracting attention—especially when everyone strives to bring particulars together and to find at least some general meaning amid universal confusion. An eccentric, after all, is in most cases a particular and an isolation. Is that not so?

But if you do not agree with this last proposition and reply, “Not so,” or “Not always so,” then perhaps I shall take heart concerning the significance of my hero, Alexei Fyodorovich. For not only is an eccentric “not always” an isolated particular, but, on the contrary, it sometimes happens that he, indeed, bears within himself the very core of the whole, while the rest of the people of his time—carried away for the moment by some transient wind—have somehow torn themselves away from him.".

• Simple controls, deep gameplay: Easy to pick up, hard to master - anyone can jump in, but only the cleverest chompers will prevail.
• Colorful, cartoonish visuals: Fun, bright, and visually appealing characters and stages bring the chomping action to life.
• Unique power-ups: Use an array of quirky power-ups to turn the tide, from speed boosts to sudden chomping frenzies.

Get your chomp on in Chompy Chomp Chomp Party: Ultimate Tournament Edition! The ultimate multiplayer madness that’ll keep you coming back for more!

1852829202.title: The Adventures of Panzer: Legacy Collection
1852829202.short_description: Enter the world of General Panzer.

1852853299.title: Call of Duty®: WWII (Windows)
1852853299.short_description: Call of Duty®: WWII - a breathtaking experience that redefines World War II.

1852881282.title: Quantum: Recharged
1852881282.short_description: Dodge and encircle your enemies in this neon-drenched revival of the one-of-a-kind arcade classic!

1852883608.title: Space Is Crazy (Windows)
1852883608.short_description: Pilot your ship through chaotic battles, destroy enemies, and strengthen your ship with random upgrades. Unlock new pilots and ships to create unique combinations and face increasingly greater challenges.

1852909326.title: DeviLevel: Try Again
1852909326.short_description:
A trial of patience even hell would give up on!

Are you ready to survive a dark world filled with demonic traps and deadly platforms? In this 2D hellish platformer, every step tests your reflexes, memory, and will. One wrong move... and it’s all over. But every death makes you stronger!

Key Features:

Brutally clever trap placement

15+ nightmare levels with hundreds of stages

Instant retry, zero loading – die, learn, and go again!

Minimalist, demonic art style with a dark atmosphere

A true challenge only the most patient players can beat

Every death makes you better. Every attempt brings you closer.
There is no mercy here.
Only the will to try again.

DeviLevel: Try Again – If you dare, press start.

1852916479.title: Resident Evil 4
1852916479.short_description:
Survival is just the beginning.

Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City.
Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter
to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

1852939002.title: Nova Strike
1852939002.short_description: Fire up your blaster cannons and take on wave after wave of enemies in this roguelite shoot'em up with procedural levels. Come back stronger with each run by equipping new weapons and upgrades so you can smash your high score!

1853020483.title: Draw a Stickman: EPIC 2 Xbox
1853020483.short_description: Get ready for your most creative adventure yet!

1853081669.title: Witchcrafty (Xbox Series X|S)
1853081669.short_description: Witchcrafty is a platformer with small metroidvania elements that immerses you in a world of magic. Something strange is happening in the Kingdom - the forests are filled with predatory plants, their peace-loving peoples have taken up arms against each other, and goblins were noticed in the deep mines. The little witch has to start her journey in search of truth and answers. Who is behind all these events? Should you trust strangers along the way? Who stole the Witch's mail?

1853124234.title: Blockon (Windows)
1853124234.short_description: A minimalist puzzle game where every move matters. Eliminate the right blocks and solve carefully crafted challenges.

1853152783.title: Jitsu Squad
1853152783.short_description: Jump into crazy, action powered battles with intense lightning-fast, yet accessible gameplay in this unique 2D Brawler action game.

1853160773.title: STAR WARS™: Battlefront Classic Collection
1853160773.short_description: Play the classic STAR WARS™ Battlefront games on modern consoles, online and offline in this complete classic collection.

1853277604.title: RetroRealms Arcade
1853277604.short_description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Retrorealms Arcade is the free launcher for the RetroRealms games (sold separately). A purchase of either RetroRealms: Halloween or RetroRealms: Ash vs Evil Dead is required to play.

Enter the RetroRealms and take control of iconic horror characters in two separate games filled with over-the-top arcade action!

Step into a 16-bit pixelart world filled with gory good fun as horror legends Michael Myers and Ash Williams! Slice and shoot your way across multiple levels of terrifying platformer action filled with familiar sights and sounds from the original “Halloween” film and the STARZ television series “Ash vs Evil Dead!” Test your skill, use your weapons, and confront twisted and fiendish versions of iconic characters in two separate games that can be connected for even more fun. (Each game sold separately.) Engage in epic, heart-pounding encounters to overcome the ultimate evil in this sprawling adventure filled with over-the-top terror!

RetroRealms Arcade:
RetroRealms includes access to the RetroRealms Arcade that connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new areas and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

Retro Aesthetic:
Immerse yourself in Pixel Art-styled 16-bit visuals and a hauntingly nostalgic horror soundtrack. RetroRealms pays homage to classic side-scrollers while delivering a fresh take on retro gameplay.
 
Secrets, Upgrades, and Unlockables:
Discover hidden relics and collectibles. Unlock new power-ups and abilities to enhance your character’s skills, and discover all-new ways play.
 
See where you Stand:
With leaderboards for both “Halloween” and “Ash vs Evil Dead” you can see how you stack up against other RetroRealms players. Do you have skills to get your name on the high score list?

It’s the ultimate arcade experience with iconic legends of horror! Cross into the RetroRealms and see if you have what it takes to make it out alive!

1853524575.title: Mafia: The Old Country
1853524575.short_description: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.

1853578640.title: 『ドラゴンクエストXI 過ぎ去りし時を求めて S』“たっぷり遊べる体験版”
1853578640.short_description:
2020年12月４日（金）発売『ドラゴンクエストXI　過ぎ去し時を求めて S』の世界をいち早く体験できる“たっぷり遊べる体験版”を配信いたしました！

ゲーム序盤をちょっとだけ有利に進めることができるクリア特典もついています。.

1853617848.title: Tactics V: "Obsidian Brigade"
1853617848.short_description:
Tactics V: "Obsidian Brigade" is a retro-style tactical turn-based video game in homage to console tactical RPGs from the 1990s. Its set in an in-house fantasy setting with it's own lore and magic, It also uses techniques to convert to a 2D isometric look from 3D assets.
 
Content Included: 
• Robust combat system (with many mechanics: facing, targeting styles, actions, delayed actions, reactions)
• World map navigation.
• >50 hand crafted levels
• >80 scripted scenes/battles
• 25+ hours and new game plus
• 3 ½ tiers of gear/weaponry
• 13 unique unlockable classes
• >50 skills (proficiencies, abilities, power casting unlockable)
• >140 powers (Elemental magic, close range, Archery, Imbue poisons, etc.)
• Optional cooperative main-game via assigning troops to another controller during deployment
• Training option allowing a non-fatal combat to be controlled by player(s) or AI to gain XP and Skill points
• Optional Alternate top-down perspective available.

1853642628.title: Scarlet Wolf
1853642628.short_description:
If you're ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek, then come on in and make yourself at home. Behind the door, endless oppressive corridors, filthy walls, deadly traps, and a ravenous creature eagerly waiting to get up close and personal with you await.

There are doors that should remain locked. There are places that no one should ever visit. Secrets hidden in the shadows should not come to light.

But if you do wander into one of these places, know this: your enemy is strong and dangerous. He plays with your emotions and feelings as he pleases. Run away from there as fast as you can and don't look back. After all, there is no enemy more cruel and insidious than your own past.

1853674373.title: Break the Loop
1853674373.short_description: Turn-based Rogue-like RPG: build a team, choose events, and stop the apocalypse!

1853695140.title: Bloodshore
1853695140.short_description: Bloodshore is an interactive action movie about a televised battle royale between high-profile streamers, entertainers and death row inmates. You control the fate of Nick, a washed-up actor who fights for a life-changing cash prize.

1853922321.title: Shop & Spot Avenue (Windows)
1853922321.short_description: Relax and test your observation skills in Shop Spot Avenue, a stylish spot the difference game filled with cozy cafés, fashion boutiques, and vibrant shopping streets. Find hidden changes, enjoy calming gameplay, and experience satisfying “I found it!” moments.

1853994299.title: Arctic Awakening
1853994299.short_description: A first-person narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your court-mandated therapy bot for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the mysteries buried beneath the ice.

1854072494.title: Morkull Ragast's Rage
1854072494.short_description: You control Morkull, the villain of the story, who not only knows he's a character in a video game, but is also aware of the player who controls him (i.e., you) and the developers who created him (i.e., us). Your objective? Help Morkull escape from the Ragast so he can rule the world and carry out his evil plans. You know, typical cliché villain stuff...

1854122175.title: Tiny Little Farm (Windows)
1854122175.short_description:
Anna receives a heartfelt letter from her grandpa, revealing that her grandmother is in poor health and they can't afford treatment in town. He asks Anna to take care of their cherished family farm while they focus on her grandma's recovery, trusting her to keep the farm alive during this difficult time.

Manage your own farm, growing a variety of crops in this exciting game.

Tackle unexpected challenges, from fussy customers to pesky crows eager to steal your harvest. Master a wide selection of culinary recipes using the fresh produce from your grandparents' farm.

Take care of the animals and enjoy a bit of fishing to unwind while your dishes simmer on the stove.

And don’t forget to end your day relaxing under the shade of trees you’ve planted with your own hands.

1854170779.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf
1854170779.short_description:
Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf is a turn-based tactical strategy in which you have to take command of the Space Wolves and join the battle against the wicked servants of Chaos and the sinister Necrons.
 
 Game features:
 
 - An epic story campaign, a unique survival mode
 - A system for levelling and tuning the squad
 - Different classes of armour and a huge number of weapons.

1854172310.title: AWAKEN - Astral Blade Demo
1854172310.short_description: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place?

1854205400.title: Speed Crew
1854205400.short_description: A hilarious party game that focuses on chaotic cooperation between players. The task of the pit crew is to inspect arriving cars and perform quick repair services while navigating intricate levels. To succeed and beat their bitter rival, players must help each other and build tactics for each race.

1854216614.title: Pixapple Adventure
1854216614.short_description: Pixapple is a colorful pixel-art platformer starring a brave little apple with arms and legs!

1854236231.title: Letterbox by POWGI
1854236231.short_description: Letterbox is a game of anagrams and logical reasoning! Take the letters from a nine-letter word and place them into the grid to form six new five-letter words. There’s only one correct answer that spells valid words in all directions!

1854284145.title: Reus 2
1854284145.short_description: Shape worlds with your godly titans. Make symbiotic ecosystems and inspire humanity with your creations. Their achievements unlock new possibilities. Make different planets for different human spirits, and fill the universe with life!

1854327039.title: The Banner Saga
1854327039.short_description: Live through an epic role-playing Viking saga where your strategic choices directly affect your personal journey. Make allies as you travel with your caravan across this stunning yet harsh landscape. Carefully choose those who will help fight a new threat that jeopardizes an entire civilization. Every decision you make in travel, conversation and combat has a meaningful effect on the outcome as your story unfolds. Not everyone will survive, but they will be remembered.

1854385564.title: Creature in the Well
1854385564.short_description: Unlock the power of an ancient facility and face the ominous, all-seeing Creature in this unique pinball-inspired hack & slash!

1854415183.title: Barn Finders
1854415183.short_description:
Search for valuables stashed in abandoned barns ranging from old clocks, musical instruments, antiques, gold, weaponry to even vintage cars and motorcycles and sell them for a profit.

Run your family business. Look for valuable items and sell them in your pawnshop. Every item has a value, so collect everything and search everywhere!

1854464830.title: Avian Knights
1854464830.short_description: Battle it out with your friends or compete for the title of Grand World Champion in Avian Knights!

1854473594.title: Don’t Follow the Screams
1854473594.short_description: 😱 Trapped in an abandoned asylum 🏚️ full of terrifying screams 🔊 and flesh-hungry zombies 🧟‍♂️, your only mission is to escape—alive! 💥 Explore dark halls 🔦, solve twisted puzzles 🧩, and survive deadly encounters 🔫 in this heart-pounding survival horror game 💀. Just one warning… when you hear the screams 👂—it’s already too late. 🩸👻.

1854499019.title: Clash of the Monsters : The Horror Fighting Game
1854499019.short_description:
Clash of the Monsters brings the most classic and iconic horror film and literature figures together in the traditional 3D fighting game style! The name quite literally says it all. 

Have you ever wondered what would happen if the Living Dead faced off with Nosferatu? Or what about the Headless Horseman vs the Bride of Dracula? It's time to find out! Take control of your favorite classic horror genre monster or hero and get ready to fight.

Clash of the Monsters makes use of legally licensed characters from both film and novel works of art. Clash of the Monsters includes the following characters: 

-Living Dead, from the film classic 'Night of the Living Dead' 
-Nosferatu, from the film classic 'Nosferatu' 
-The Headless Horseman, from the classic short story "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow"
-Ichabod Crane, from the classic short story 'The Legend of Sleepy Hollow' 
-The Bride of Dracula, from Bram Stoker's novel 'Dracula' 
-The Invisible Man, from H.G. Wells' novel 'The Invisible Man' 
-Bones, a 'Clash of the Monsters' original character 

Clash of the Monsters will be continually updated. You can expect these additions in coming updates:

-Ladder Mode
-An iconic boss character from one of the greatest horror films of all time!
-New playable characters
-New combat stages.

1854525267.title: Sunny Summer Splash
1854525267.short_description: Spot the differences in bright summer scenes packed with BBQs, pool parties, picnics, and backyard fun. Relax, focus, and enjoy the satisfying thrill of finding every hidden change.

1854680102.title: Delta Force
1854680102.short_description: Delta Force is back! The iconic series returns as the definitive free-to-play modern team-based tactical shooter and featuring three distinct gameplay modes: large-scale PvP warfare, intense extraction shooter action, and a remake of the legendary Black Hawk Down campaign.

1854696468.title: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Definitive Edition
1854696468.short_description: Build a deck of iconic Heroes and challenge the forces of Sauron in this thrilling tactical card game.

1854871799.title: Beneath Oresa
1854871799.short_description: Beneath Oresa is a fighting roguelike deckbuilder. Deep within the city, confront your foes in real tactical arenas. As a strategist, choose your cards, upgrades, and artifacts wisely, but as a fighter, keep your distances with your foes, engage them at the right moment and turn their positioning to your advantage. With several factions, many heroes with unique abilities, daily missions, unique game mechanics and more, this furious combination of roguelike and tactics elements will lead you deep beneath Oresa.

1854983612.title: Mr. Brocco and Co.
1854983612.short_description: Vegetables versus normal food. It won't be an easy adventure!

1855024215.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
1855024215.short_description: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine and defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

1855137956.title: 2URVIVE
1855137956.short_description:
2URVIVE is a top-down zombie shooter with tactical and strategic elements. 
Prepare yourself before every wave. 
Buy weapons and ammo, set up turrets and stay alive as long as you can.

1855158493.title: Cartel Tycoon
1855158493.short_description: Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim inspired by the ‘80s narco trade.

1855217179.title: Golf With Your Friends (Windows Version)
1855217179.short_description: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!

1855315596.title: Castle Attacker
1855315596.short_description: Play this amazing game and have a lot of fun trying to solve the quests in every level. Point your cannon to the castle and try to destroy objects ahead.

1855360714.title: Ghostrunner 2 Demo
1855360714.short_description: Blood will run in Ghostrunner 2, a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk future. Become the ultimate cyber ninja and prepare for epic boss fights, improved skills, an interactive story, new game modes, and captivating synthwave soundtrack.

1855370155.title: Star Overdrive
1855370155.short_description: Race across an alien planet in a high-speed action-adventure. Glide on your Hoverboard, mastering gravity-defying tricks, battling powerful enemies, and solving puzzles. Use your unique powers to overcome challenges, unravel mysteries, and shape your destiny!

1855426799.title: FINAL FANTASY XIV Online
1855426799.short_description: FINAL FANTASY XIV Online - Game Application.

1855478649.title: WrestleQuest demo
1855478649.short_description: TAG TEAM WITH DESTINY! Pro wrestling and RPG fantasy collide in the ultimate pixel powered adventure. “Macho Man” Randy Savage and tons of other icons offer guidance as you powerbomb your way to glory beyond the ring. This hero’s journey ain’t just an epic quest, it’s WRESTLEQUEST!

1855599450.title: Doors: Paradox
1855599450.short_description: A relaxing puzzle escape game! Make your way through a variety of hand-crafted 3D dioramas, look for useful objects, find hidden clues and solve fun puzzles! Unravel this mysterious adventure about chaos, order and the surreal.

1855607466.title: Drill Deal - Oil Tycoon
1855607466.short_description:
Build Oil Rigs in Drill Deal Simulator!
Embark on this fun adventure and build your own oil rig! Start with a small platform and expand it to a large interconnected complex! Optimize your designs for more efficient production, increase cash flow, and keep your employees happy and safe!
Remember about your company's reputation!
Sign long-term contracts to sell your products. Conquer new markets. Manage your reputation and customer relationships, and INCREASE YOUR PROFITS while you’re at it!
Many unique events and scenarios
Manage your platform during an environmental crisis. Face countless challenges and threats such as: snow blows, storms, fires, and many more! Remember that it’s your responsibility to protect your rig crew from the attacks of greedy pirates, terrorists or even deadly diseases!
Manage your Oil Rig crew
Remember to choose your employees wisely. Pay attention to their various skills and statistics. Take care of their satisfaction and quality of life on the platform. Build your gameplay and provide your crew with better accommodation as your platform grows. Qualified and satisfied workforce is the key to increasing productivity!
Discover various scenarios in different corners of the world. Ranging from the freezing Arctic with snow and blizzards, through tropical pirate-infested waters, to haunted islands.
Step into the world of Drill Deal!

1855613713.title: Chop is Dish
1855613713.short_description:
The game includes exclusive prologue chapter "Stolen Pork Story" never released on any other platforms!

«Chop is Dish» tells the story of one cook who was robbed by some mystical creatures. Some strange monsters had suddenly appeared in his forest and stole his master chef's chunk of beef. Our cook needed this meat for his ultimate dish, and now it's gone — he has to act quickly and dangerously by pursuing the thieves and recovering his grand ingredient. The main feature is the protagonist — grumpy cook who would love to beat the sauce outta his enemies. Fans of oldschool pixelart games would be pleasantly surprised by this one, instantly feeling like home.

1855729960.title: Just Dance® 2021
1855729960.short_description: Try out Just Dance® 2021 for free with the demo, available now! Dance to the hottest track of the summer, "Rain On Me" by Lady Gaga & Ariana Grande, or spice it up with "Paca Dance" by The Just Dance Band!

1855780914.title: DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party
1855780914.short_description: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.

1855853997.title: Dark Knights Legacy Dimension
1855853997.short_description: Dark Knights Legacy Dimension is a thrilling platformer where you run, jump, and dodge obstacles to reach the end of each level without falling into the void. Classic side-scrolling action meets a unique twist: step into special tunnels to shift between dimensions, switching perspectives while keeping the same fast-paced gameplay. Master both worlds, overcome tricky challenges, and prove your skill as the true Dark Knight of the dimensions!

1855894998.title: Denshattack!
1855894998.short_description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

1855912718.title: RainCity
1855912718.short_description: Rain City: a city where rain always pours. This puzzle game features warm, picture book-like graphics and a story with lifelike animals.

1855969981.title: One Step After Fall (DE)
1855969981.short_description: Immerse yourself inside Steve Robinson's depressive thoughts, learn his story and face his destinies in this incredible narrative experience.

1855976859.title: Forest Camp Story
1855976859.short_description: Create and customize your own campground in this charming pixel art sim game.

1856015490.title: Mangavania 2 (Xbox Series X|S)
1856015490.short_description:
Old school action platformer game with pixel art graphics.

Join the adventure as Yuhiko, a young ninja who has gone to the underworld to find a cure for his brother. Find Spirits in secret places – they will tell you a story or give you advice. Explore dungeons, fight monsters and meet new friends!

The second part of the game will delight you with new types of enemies, fresh gameplay mechanics, and battles with dangerous bosses. If desired, each level can also be attempted in a speedrun. The second part of the game is perfect not only for those already familiar with the black-and-white world of Mangavania but also for newcomers to the series.

Can the young ninja save his brother, and if so, at what cost?

1856172970.title: Game of Thrones - Episode 1: Iron from Ice
1856172970.short_description: Download Episode One of Game of Thrones: Season One, a six part episodic game series set in the world of HBO's groundbreaking TV show. This new story tells of House Forrester, a noble family from the north of Westeros, loyal to the Starks of Winterfell. Caught up in the events surrounding the War of the Five Kings, they are thrown into a maelstrom of bloody warfare, revenge, intrigue, and horror as they fight to survive while the seven kingdoms tear themselves apart.

1856200373.title: Carnage: Battle Arena
1856200373.short_description: Unleash chaos in Carnage Battle Arena! Smash, race, and survive in blocky, retro-styled mayhem. 82 cars, dozens of maps, epic destruction, and game-changing power-ups await. Master multiple modes like Death Match, Survival, and Racing. Get ready for nonstop adrenaline! 🚗🔥.

1856388864.title: The Monty Mole Collection
1856388864.short_description: Experience the story of Monty Mole, British subterranean mammal turned international criminal, in this fantastic collection of six games.

1856401271.title: Frozen Gauntlet
1856401271.short_description: Frozen Gauntlet is a unique platformer game where you play as Zen, an adventurer with a magical gauntlet that can freeze creatures, helping him find his way back home.

1856407399.title: MIO: Memories in Orbit (Demo)
1856407399.short_description: This is the demo version of MIO: Memories in Orbit. Explore the Vessel, as you play MIO, a nimble robot with extraordinary abilities. Face rogue machines, and unlock new abilities to uncover the dormant secrets of this fallen spaceship.

1856474952.title: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story™
1856474952.short_description:
Developed by Digital Sun, creators of Moonlighter, The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story™ is an action RPG that takes place in the League of Legends universe. In the kingdom of Demacia, the Mageseekers hold the power to oppress magic-using citizens in the name of public order–by inducting and indoctrinating them, locking them away, or driving them into hiding.

Play as Sylas, a spell-stealing mage who has just broken free of his unjust captivity at the Mageseekers’ hands. Wielding the chains that once bound you, you must liberate your homeland from tyranny, one Mageseeker at a time.

It’s time to unshackle the magic.

1856508918.title: Faeria
1856508918.short_description: With its unique living board, Faeria is also the only card game where you can gain all 300 cards in less than 50 hours.

1856524616.title: Egg Head to the rescue
1856524616.short_description:
Egghead to the rescue is an arcade platform game.
Remake from the original game by Jonathan Cauldwell in 1990 

Collect all keys and rescue your friends.

1856583352.title: BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW
1856583352.short_description:
BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the dark side of social media and its effect on mental health. You play as Anne, a young woman haunted by the trauma of bullying, trapped in a surreal nightmare where she must confront her past and uncover a buried truth.

To escape, Anne must face the most painful moments of her life. But she’s not alone—grotesque, symbolic creatures stalk her every move. Can she find a way out, or will her fears consume her?

BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW shines a light on real-world struggles, exploring the toxic pressure of online culture, body image issues, and the lasting scars of bullying.

FEATURES
➤ Multiple endings shaped by your choices throughout the game
➤ Unique, unsettling creatures—each representing a different trauma from Anne’s past
➤ A deep, emotional narrative about fear, memory, and healing.

1856594526.title: SGN Sports Downhill Skiing
1856594526.short_description: Grab your skis and hit the slopes! Complete a downhill ski slope in the shortest time possible. As you race down the slope be sure to pass between every gate and cross the finish line.

1856630241.title: Space Boat TGA21Demo
1856630241.short_description: 'Space Boat' is an investigative narrative adventure set on an intergalactic cruise-ship inhabited by various carpet-based lifeforms. Play as a cleverly disguised space cat, traverse the perils of time and space, and track down an elusive shape-shifting jewel thief before it's too late!

1856726040.title: Mr. Massagy: Mayo Edition
1856726040.short_description: This is a two-pack game which includes Mr. Massagy, a dating simulator where you get massages; and My Name is Mayo, a clicker with an emotional mayonnaise-related story.

1856761311.title: Oakbound Quest
1856761311.short_description: You take on the role of a brave warrior on a sacred mission: to recover the mystical oaks whose essence holds the power to restore life to your devastated village.

1856807409.title: IceLine
1856807409.short_description:
IceLine is a top-down puzzle game about Ice Magician, who collects magic crystals and takes his skills to the next level.
This is a puzzle game with unique mechanics in which the player character leaves an ice trail behind him and thus changes the playing field for himself!

1856839804.title: Z-Warp
1856839804.short_description:
Blast off into the darkest corners of space to retrieve the black box of a lost experimental spacecraft!

In the Year 21XX, a starship capable of space-time warping was constructed and launched, only to be lost to the unknown depths of space on its maiden voyage. When a distress signal is received, it falls to you, the most accomplished pilot in Z-Division, to find the experimental ship and retrieve its black box for investigation. This mission will take you into a hellish realm where you’ll have to survive waves of fiendish foes if you hope to return alive and victorious!

Z-Warp is an intense vertical shoot’em up presented in retro pixel art style, featuring frenetic arcade-inspired action where blasters, bombs and KILLER specials are your only allies. Shoot down demonic enemies as they try to overwhelm your ship with bullet hell salvos and turn the tide of battle by charging your KILLER weapon capable of instantly wiping out anything in a tight radius around your ship! Face massive boss abominations and aim for high scores in Story or Endless modes.

1856870909.title: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
1856870909.short_description: Shantae's adventure comes full circle in this long-lost sequel!

1856919997.title: Poly Party - Full Game
1856919997.short_description:
Welcome to the full game of Poly Party! There's a lot more added in here than the demo! New boardgames, minigames, game modes, customization, cars, houses, and much more! 1857530883.short_description: iRacing is proud to present NASCAR 25, the official game of NASCAR featuring ALL FOUR National Series, the ARCA Menards Series, NASCAR Xfinity Series, NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and NASCAR Cup Series.

1857840975.short_description: The original brick breaker returns with its toughest challenge yet. Survive as long as you can in arcade or take on one of 50 challenges picking up game-changing power-ups along the way.

1857859131.title: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris
1857859131.short_description: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris is the sequel to the critically-acclaimed Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light, and the first-ever four-player co-op experience with Lara Croft. Featuring stunning visuals and a brand-new story, players must work together to explore the temple, defeat hordes of enemies from the Egyptian underworld, solve devious puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. 1857944266.short_description:

As you will roam along the neon-soaked streets, you’ll discover what the world has become, how life goes on in a world of intriguing fusion of chaos and technological advancement. 
In Neon-Lore, you will solve puzzles and encounter with various characters and learn about their past life, dreams and fears…And get a chance to discover deeper about the social transformations that has impacted human life in the 21st century…

Features: 
*Discover the world at your own pace.
*No failing or quests, you decide about how you explore the world.
*Beautiful, cyber-punk themed environments.

1858058046.title: Sea Horizon
1858058046.short_description:
Embark on a perilous adventure in classic role-playing style with dice rolls and card-based actions to govern your fate!

In the world of Sea Horizon, every step counts in a journey of survival and high adventure! Sea Horizon is a roguelike turn-based RPG presented in a 3D bird’s eye view of a hex grid map that’s different every time you set out to explore the shattered archipelago of Myrihyn. Choose between a wide variety of characters with their own storied backgrounds and personal motivations. Chart a path across diverse landscapes and treacherous seas as you equip weapons, carefully manage your hunger and health, weigh risk against the potential reward of each side quest, activate blessings to help you along the way and make life-or-death choices in combat!

Traditional role-playing elements like dice rolls and randomized battle cards govern your available actions in Sea Horizon, while wise decisions can stack the deck in your favor. Whether you succeed or fail, new paths will always be open to you in the next attempt, and victory will unlock new playable characters and tales to discover. Will you give rise to new legends in this perilous realm, or will you be among the nameless fallen adventurers who came before?

Meet a charming cast of fully voice acted characters, with intriguing back stories to reveal. Find friendship or maybe even romance?

Transform the Wylde family farm into a productive haven bursting with fresh vegetables, fruit trees and cute baby animals!

Wield your wand and broomstick as you nurture your magical abilities to tend the farm, control the weather, turn the seasons or transform into a cat!

Create hundreds of recipes for yummy food or artisanal goods to sell. Between fishing, mining, crafting and farming (plus a little magic) you'll have lots to do.

Connect with the coven, fall in love and enjoy your cottagecore life as you uncover the mysterious goings-on in the heart of Fairhaven.

Reveal the hidden darkness which is affecting the town and discover how to bring everyone together.

1858286641.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 7 (Xbox One)
1858286641.short_description:
UP SHOT

You constantly run to the right, and your goal is to avoid squares falling on you from above. Hold the button to shoot upward and destroy the squares, but you'll remain stationary while shooting. Large squares require multiple shots.
The game ends when a square hits you.

SMILY ANGRY

You're constantly running and can turn with the press of a button. Two faces shoot at you above you. They can be happy or angry. Your goal is to collect shots from the happy face to score points and avoid shots from the angry face. The faces randomly change their emotions.
The game ends when you're shot by the angry face.

V BOMB

You control a plane that constantly flies from side to side. Press the button to turn. Enemies fly beneath you and slowly approach your position. Enemies drop time bombs that explode upward. Your goal is to avoid the explosions and try to lure enemies into the blast. When the bombs are very close to each other, they explode in a chain reaction.
The game ends when you are caught in the blast or an enemy touches you.

PIN CLIMB

You score points by climbing pins. Hold the button to increase your reach. Try to avoid the pins that are below you.
The game ends when you reach the bottom of the screen.

NUMBER LINE

There are two lines of moving numbers on the screen. Press the button to sum the numbers in both lines. You score points when the sum in the top line is greater than the sum in the bottom line. When the top sum is less than the bottom sum, your score decreases and the lines become closer together.
The game ends when the lines intersect.

1858950011.title: Doodle Taxi
1858950011.short_description:
Navigate an open world city in a car, while your vision is taken away. Deliver customers fast & carefully to restore your vision.

WELCOME TO THE MAGICAL WORLD OF DOODLE TAXI!

Do you miss good old days? No loot boxes, no micro transactions, no season passes? Maybe early 2000s open world games? I got your back!

Get ready for a Zen-like experience
Doodle Taxi's main thing is being a chill taxi driving simulator game. Enjoy this beautiful world as you cruise around and color it in while unraveling the story! Whether you want to drive around like a maniac or just chill out and listen to the bumping soundtrack, this is a great pick up and play driving game!

A GOOFY STORY

What's the worst thing that could happen to a modern day Taxi Driver? Not getting paid? Get mugged? No. A cabbie can get cursed by a witch and lose his sight. What if that witch is unable to control her powers in this world? What happens then?

WHAT THE CAR!?

This is a car game obviously. And we should have cars, more than one. Unlockable, locked behind some in-game currency. But don't worry, you can earn all these without spending real money. This is a game by a gamer who misses old days for the gamers who are sick of those modern tricks to squeeze more and more money from player.

Whether you’re a seasoned city-builder or new to the genre, Antiquitas offers a rewarding and relaxing empire management experience with no time limits or paywalls.

Begin your rise to glory today!

1859288114.title: AirportSim
1859288114.short_description: AirportSim - an Advanced Airport Ground Handling Simulator.

1859296951.title: Epitasis
1859296951.short_description:

Cryptic puzzles, forgotten technologies and treasured relics are riddled among the beautiful wilderness that has engulfed the remains of this fallen race.

If you are to learn their secrets, you must unearth the fate of the civilization that called these lost worlds home.

Epitasis is a sci-fi exploration puzzle game, set on far off distant worlds.

Explore beautifully recreated environments to uncover the story through objects and diary entries.

Ultimately, it’s a game about empathy and hope.

1859435059.title: BAD END THEATER

1859436735.title: Please, Don't Touch Anything

1859816691.title: Neon Strike Bowling 3D
1859816691.short_description:
Neon Strike Bowling 3D

Step into the neon-lit lanes of the future!

Experience bowling like never before in Neon Bowling, a visually stunning arcade simulation set against the backdrop of deep space. Master the art of timing and precision as you face off against a challenging AI opponent in a vibrant, glowing cosmic arena.

Whether you are a casual player looking for a quick match or a competitive bowler aiming for the perfect game, Neon Bowling offers an immersive experience with smooth physics and responsive controls.

🌌 Key Features

Cosmic Atmosphere: Play in a mesmerizing environment featuring neon lights, glowing pins, and a dynamic starfield background.

Realistic Physics: Enjoy satisfying pin action and ball movement powered by a robust 3D physics engine.

Xbox Controller Support: Fully optimized for gamepads! Use the analog stick for precision aiming and the triggers/buttons for power control. Also supports keyboard and mouse.

Challenging AI: Compete against a smart CPU opponent that keeps you on your toes. Can you beat the machine?

Timing-Based Gameplay: It's not just about aiming; it's about power! innovative timing mechanic adds a layer of skill to every throw.

Instant Action: No waiting, no loading screens. Jump straight into the action with our optimized quick-start system.

🎮 How to Play

Using Xbox Controller:

Aim: Use the Left Stick or D-Pad to position your ball.

Power Up: Press and hold the 'A' Button to start the power meter.

Throw: Release the 'A' Button at the right moment to launch the ball.

Spin: Use the Left Stick while charging to add spin to your shot.

Using Mouse:

Aim: Move your mouse left or right.

Throw: Click and hold to charge power, release to throw.

Are you ready to become the champion of the galaxy? Download now and strike your way to victory!

1859847320.title: Richman 10

1860032551.title: Caves and Castles: Underworld

 Above ground, you'll become wrapped up in a quest to rebuild a castle and its grounds – only something strange is preventing you from achieving your goal! Unlock one mystery after another as you restore the stunning structure to its former glory!

Play as a drummer and escape the clutches of an eldritch metal band... or die trying! 
A dark, lovecraftian narrative that’s packed full of music industry tropes and jokes.

1860238573.title: Cardaclysm: Shards of the Four
