-Multi-language support in the Game.
-20 Racing Cars available in the game. (One car available in Demo Version. Buy Full Version to Unlock all Features)

Get Ready for Extreme Racing Adventure........

1888767109.title: Falling Plus
1888767109.short_description: Help Peppy the Penguin clean up the mess by quickly matching colors, but look out for Wally the Walrus! Falling Plus is a love letter to 1980s arcade-style puzzle games!

1888889490.title: Countless Army
1888889490.short_description: Be the villain in this Reverse Tower Defense. Send waves after waves of troops to break the enemy defenses. Summon, upgrade your troops and conquer the whole world.

1888921223.title: Journey to Kreisia
1888921223.short_description: Become the Savior from the outer realm and bring everlasting peace to Kreisia in an epic fantasy RPG!

1888936506.title: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition
1888936506.short_description: Re-live 1999 with this faithful rendition of Worms™ Armageddon. With all the hilarious fun and madness you know and love.

1888959270.title: Cyber Citizen Shockman
1888959270.short_description: Become a hero and restore peace to the town.

1889005839.title: Solus (Xbox Series)
1889005839.short_description: A dark and atmospheric platforming adventure where you play as a lost soul searching for freedom. Collect symbols of light, awaken ancient totems, and overcome challenging traps while uncovering the secrets of a dreamlike world.

1889059808.title: Backpack Hero
1889059808.short_description: The inventory management roguelike! Collect rare items, organize your backpack, and vanquish your foes!

1889120887.title: Envasion
1889120887.short_description: You love shooting stuff non-stop while your whole screen keeps exploding for days? Then this game’s for you, son! Buy and upgrade an assortment of tanks and weapons to roll them into battle! Those machineguns, plasma cannons, railguns, cannons, bombs and missiles will be worth everything you spend on ’em!

1889135706.title: Panda Bamboo Adventure (Windows)
1889135706.short_description:
Help the panda collect the bamboos in this precision adventure!
In Panda Bamboo Adventure, you control a cute little panda who must dodge spears and traps while collecting its missing bamboos.

1889137420.title: Doggy Up!
1889137420.short_description: Play as Ollie, a German Shepherd trapped in his dreams, in this engaging platformer! Explore diverse locations, improve character skills, and experience dynamic events while mastering challenges to help Ollie escape.

1889167057.title: The Walking Dead: Destinies
1889167057.short_description: Change the course of AMC’s The Walking Dead history. Fight walkers, relive iconic moments, and change the destiny of The Walking Dead Universe as your choices separate heroes from villains, and the living from the dead. Will you make the same choices as Rick, or will you forge your own path?

1889204779.title: Deep Space Anomaly
1889204779.short_description:
Deep Space Anomaly is a survival arena shooter game where you battle against hordes of space aliens. Upgrade your ship, buy new weapons and survive as much as possible.
Defeat the cosmic evil!

1889232588.title: MILKY WAY TD SURVIVORS AUTOBATTLER (Xbox One)
1889232588.short_description: Milky Way is a unique blend of real-time strategy, tower defense, autobattler, and survivors. Build a base, choose random upgrades, and use powerful abilities to stand against hordes of enemies.

1889266289.title: Calyssa
1889266289.short_description: Help Calyssa explore cursed ruins in a challenging pixel art platformer full of traps, enemies, and intense action.

1889275388.title: Metal Eden
1889275388.short_description:
METAL EDEN is an adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. 
The advanced HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue the citizens’ CORES from the vast monolithic city MOEBIUS once a hopeful new home for humanity now turned into a deadly trap. 
Blast your way through the INTERNAL DEFENCE CORPS in cybernetic warfare, confront the ENGINEERS and uncover the mysteries of the EDEN project.

1889321756.title: Microsoft Minesweeper
1889321756.short_description: Keep your mind sharp in Microsoft Minesweeper! The original and iconic puzzle game comes to life with MULTIPLE Play Modes, MORE Daily Challenges, Achievements, NEW Themes, and ALL-NEW Auto-Chording. Fun for all ages!

1889374066.title: Mini Legend Chapter 1: King Snow
1889374066.short_description:
Be the Ultimate Warrior by Defeating Endless Monsters!

It is your chance to become the ultimate warrior and protect your land from many monsters. Mini Legend provides you with a one-of-its-kind opportunity where you can exhibit your fighting skills to defeat the enemies and compete with other players.

1889456287.title: Roller Champions™
1889456287.short_description: Skate and roll your way up to glory in Roller Champions™. Discover a free-to-play, team PvP sports game like no other!

1889526561.title: Trigger Witch Demo
1889526561.short_description:
Magic and firearms make a deadly combo!

Recalling the visual style and intuitive gameplay of 16-bit action-adventure classics, Trigger Witch puts an ultra-violent spin on cute and colorful pixel art. With a compelling and original narrative, puzzling environments to explore, a dynamic soundtrack, twin-stick shooter mechanics and a vast array of enemies to blast into smithereens, this is a tale that will grip you from start to bloody finish.

From the creators of Reverie, Trigger Witch is a stylized 2D twin-stick action game set in an odd open world where magic is outdated and firearms are the new way of life. Players assume the role of Colette, a prospective graduate from the Stock, an academy for Witchcraft and Triggery. After a mysterious man invades her realm, events are set in motion that turn Colette’s life upside-down, casting her as the sole heroine with enough firepower to restore peace.

1889539152.title: Wildshade: Unicorn Champions
1889539152.short_description: Cross the finishing line riding a unicorn! In this fast-paced magical racing game, win all the tournaments to unlock the rarest mounts, breed them to create the champion of your dreams and become the best horserider in the fantasy world of Wildshade.

1889657958.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
1889657958.short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat follows the story of special service agent Major Degtyarev as he investigates the fate of a lost expedition. Rich with colorful characters, memorable side stories, and the spirit of true freedom, this chapter delivers a powerful and unforgettable conclusion to the Legends of the Zone Trilogy.

1889714780.title: Lords of the Fallen
1889714780.short_description: A vast world awaits in the medieval, dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. As a fabled Dark Crusader, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God.

1889723336.title: Townsmen - A Kingdom Rebuilt
1889723336.short_description: Townsmen - A Kingdom Rebuilt is a medieval city-building strategy game. It features a complex economy system, requiring you to build production lines, trade efficiently and keep the balance between tax income and your Townies’ happiness. All the while, your town will have to face season specific hardships like water shortage in the summer or the inability to grow crops during the wintertime. A huge variety of buildings and many different jobs for your citizens will help you overcome these and other obstacles. Build military barracks to stand your ground against vicious bandit attacks or employ a doctor in your infirmary to battle the plague. Firefighters, hunters, farmers, blacksmiths and many more will help you build up a stable community. Gain experience for all your deeds as the town’s governor and use it in research that will improve efficiency through technological advances.

1889860883.title: Rock of Ages 3 Beta
1889860883.short_description: Make your own levels. Break everyone else’s.

1889880451.title: FINAL FANTASY XIII
1889880451.short_description:
FINAL FANTASY XIII comes to Windows!

Final Fantasy XIII is a fantasy RPG in which a band of brave humans struggle against fate in the utopian sky city of Cocoon and the primeval world of Pulse. Follow stylish heroine Lightning's fast paced battles and high adventure in a mysterious new world.

1889886349.title: Chess Royal
1889886349.short_description: A simple yet satisfying game of chess that anyone can play and learn from!

1889888979.title: Paddles
1889888979.short_description: Dash, deflect, and survive in Paddles!

1889897703.title: Submarine Patrol
1889897703.short_description:
Submarine Patrol for Windows. We will continue updating the game. Thank you for your support of independent game developers! 

Use your periscope to target and destroy enemy ships. Join our big submarine patrol team. Be on our submarine! 

Legend says: The year was 1982. Argentina invaded the Falklands and other British territories in the South Atlantic. The British sent an expeditionary force to retake the islands. 

In Submarine Patrol, you will relive this era as a leader of a submarine that patrols the islands and destroys enemy battleships. 

Target well before you shoot! Remember, you have a limited number of torpedoes on board. You cannot immediately fire one torpedo after another. 

It takes 2-3 seconds to prepare the next torpedo. Injured ships, depending on the amount of damage, may reduce their speed and move slower. 

Depending on the ship type, you can hit it 1 to 7 times before it is completely destroyed. You have 36 levels to complete. If you do well you will be promoted to commander, captain, or even an admiral. The quality of shooting is determined by your score.

1889913930.title: Hyper-5
1889913930.short_description:
Respond to the distress beacon and confront an unknown enemy in cinematic shoot’em up action!

Deep space scount ship Hyper-5 has received a distress signal and heads into battle against an unknown threat. As a pilot on your own and facing nearly impossible odds, you’ll need to survive more than forty enemy types and massive boss encounters across the varied land, air and underwater stages of planet 4GDT.

Hyper-5 draws inspiration from shoot’em up genre classics of the ‘90s while offering modern advancements in cinematic style! Traditional side-scrolling action is presented in 3D with screen-filling visual effects and thrilling cutscenes. Complete in-game challenges to unlock over twenty weapon systems, ship upgrades and gallery extras!

1889969467.title: Beat 'Em Up Archives (QUByte Classics)
1889969467.short_description: Unleash Your Inner Fighter in Beat 'Em Up Archives: Iron Commando and Legend. Experience Classic Brawling Action in Two Timeless Games from the 90s!

1889971279.title: The Mooseman (Xbox Series X|S)
1889971279.short_description:
You are the Mooseman and you have the ability to see all that is hidden to the mortal eye. You are about to visit three layers of this universe - the first one is the Lower World where the spirits of the dead reside.

Welcome to the mysterious world of ancient myth, based on finno-ugric culture of bygone pagan times.

1890032211.title: Infestor
1890032211.short_description: Jump on platforms and snatch human bodies in alien-themed puzzle Infestor!

1890091569.title: The Psychoduck
1890091569.short_description: Collects crowns from herons in this stealth-based game.

1890091692.title: Poppies Escape House
1890091692.short_description:
New generation horror game.

Can you escape from the house by completing the tasks in the mysterious house?

You need to proceed carefully and follow the instructions in this puzzle house where you will have fun.

Now available on Microsoft Store.

1890159145.title: GORSD
1890159145.short_description: Intense arena combat, set deep inside the heart of darkness. Discover the story of the GORSD alone, or enter battle with up to 4 friends in local multiplayer.

1890189073.title: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary
1890189073.short_description: Entirely rebuilt from the ground up, Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary is the ultimate celebration of the decade-old original, bringing refined visuals, completely redesigned and revised gameplay sections, and a whole new chapter to the award-winning, brain-twisting first-person puzzler.

1890415328.title: Lab Crisis (for Windows 10)
1890415328.short_description: Lab Crisis is a turn-based puzzle about a robot who's rescuing scientists from a mutant-infested lab! The more scientists you grab at once, the longer is the chain, so be careful!

1890458248.title: UnMetal
1890458248.short_description: You play as Jesse Fox who finds himself imprisoned in a covert military base where he was arrested for a crime he didn't commit. Jesse must now escape using his dry wits, quick words, improvised skills, arsenal of warfare, violent explosives, MacGuyvered gadgets, and an elaborate explanation of how it all went down. If that all fails, he'll use his fists.

1890497870.title: Blaster Master Zero 2
1890497870.short_description: Join Jason, Eve, and Fred on an intergalactic journey! The side-scrolling/top-down hybrid action adventure title "Blaster Master Zero" returns with its long-awaited sequel!

1890546098.title: Abyss DX
1890546098.short_description: Your mission will be to find the "Gaia" energy stones by exploring the depths. To do so, you must control Nep2no by counteracting gravity and the surrounding darkness with the aid of a Light that will go out little by little.

1890557199.title: くにおくん ザ・ワールド ～熱血高校ドッジボール部 サッカー編～
1890557199.short_description:
2018年12月にリリースされた「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」に収録されている18作品から、
「熱血高校ドッジボール部 サッカー編」を単品作品としてリリース！！

動作や仕様の改善がされている「クオリティアップ版」、
当時のタイトルをオリジナルのまま収録した「オリジナル版」の2つのモードを搭載！
あの裏技やゲームバランスもそのままお楽しみいただけます！

≪ゲーム紹介≫
「くにおくん」率いる熱血高校ドッジボール部が
サッカーで全国大会を目指す、スポーツアクションゲームです。

スライディング、タックルで相手の選手を攻撃でき、
積極的にボールを奪いに行くことが攻略ポイントの1つになります。
なぜなら、このサッカーはファールをとられません。
「必殺シュート」で相手チームの選手やキーパーを吹き飛ばすこともできます。

トーナメントモードで対戦する高校はどれもユニークで、
さまざまなシュートを仕掛けてきます。特にハーフタイム中の演出は必見です。
最後まで勝ち抜くと「みさこ」からのプレゼントが…？

■クオリティアップ版での変更点
ちらつき・処理落ちの軽減

※本製品は別売タイトル「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」とのネットワークプレイには対応しておりません。
本製品のネットワークプレイは、本製品同士のプレイヤーのみご利用いただけます。.

1890575892.title: BROKEN MIND
1890575892.short_description:
BROKEN MIND is an action Survival Horror. 
You play Agent Frank Morgan, a detective with a dark past. 
Fight, investigate, solve the puzzles and find out what happened to Laura Campbell. 
If she is still alive you must act quickly!

1890581353.title: Blasphemous
1890581353.short_description: Blasphemous is a punishing action-platformer that combines the fast-paced, skilled combat of a hack-n-slash game with a deep and evocative narrative core, delivered through exploration of a huge universe comprised of non-linear levels.

1890588473.title: Slime Ranger
1890588473.short_description: You are on a quest to find and defeat the Slime King.

1890622702.title: Pixel Gladiator
1890622702.short_description:
Distant future…
Brutal gladiatorial battles is a top-rated show, extremely popular all over the Universe. You’ve been sent to the abandoned planet as one of the participants of the show. Your goal is to survive as long as possible, fighting back deadly creatures in the focus of billions of viewers.

Kill your enemies to earn the money for weapons and upgrades. You are funded by your audience, so you have to keep yourself admired by slaughtering the monsters.

Take the challenge and come out victorious from a blood bath with ferocious beasts! Become a champion of the show, full of blood, pain and insensate cruelty. Morituri te salutant!

 -Unique weapons and player upgrades
 -Turrets and traps to maintain security offscreen
 -Treacherous and deadly bosses
 -Fight on cameras to gain more money.

1890624967.title: Elon and the Divine Proof (Windows)
1890624967.short_description: Elon found himself on a beautiful beach with dozens of tasty burgers. He didn't know how he got there. He decided to embark on a mission to collect all the burgers scattered around the island.

1890642947.title: Welcome to Elk Demo
1890642947.short_description: Welcome to Elk: Demo is the free intro of this upcoming biographical adventure set on an island like no other. Every character you encounter has a story to tell. From the weird and wonderful to the dark and desperate, all the tales told on Elk are based on true stories.

1890709531.title: Bay Breaker (Xbox One)
1890709531.short_description:
Use your boat's new technology to launch ultra-springy balls, 
capable of shattering even the toughest rocks.

1890713361.title: The Ramsey
1890713361.short_description: The Ramsey is a 2D platformer that allows you to play as cute squirrel characters solving puzzles using various weapons. Explore maze-like islands and overcome difficult obstacles with the strongest squirrels in the universe.

1890778408.title: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
1890778408.short_description: Tokyo’s cats need a hero - and that hero is you!

1890789689.title: The Casting of Frank Stone™
1890789689.short_description: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

1890793799.title: Mystic Thief - Elemental Conquest (Xbox One)
1890793799.short_description: Master every element. Conquer every chamber. Become the ultimate arcane master.

1890818188.title: Find Love Or Die Trying
1890818188.short_description: Romance is a dangerous game on this shocking TV dating show.

1890858421.title: Harvest Cafe
1890858421.short_description: Explore, grow, repair and cook delicious food! Harvest Cafe combines an open-world adventure with a restaurant business simulation, giving you the opportunity to enjoy farm life.

1890880304.title: Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel
1890880304.short_description: Chasing a potential lead, amateur journalist Roberto Leite Lopes travels to the St. Dinfna Hotel hoping to find his big break. His investigative skills will be needed not only to uncover the truth but to survive when reality is turned upside down with his discovery of a camera that reveals different timelines, a fanatical cult, human experiments, and apparitions roaming the halls. Solve puzzles and scavenge for anything to stop their hunt as the past, present and future collide.

1891013041.title: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi
1891013041.short_description: Solve puzzles, escape danger and uncover mysteries deep in the jungle!

1891096259.title: Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey (Windows)
1891096259.short_description: Build, Discover, and Bring Nature to Life.

1891110608.title: Steel Seed Demo
1891110608.short_description: Steel Seed is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion.

1891198889.title: Realpolitiks II
1891198889.short_description: Lead your nation to glory and reshape history in Realpolitiks II, a real-time grand strategy game of global domination.

1891225930.title: Ash of Gods Redemption
1891225930.short_description: Ash of Gods: Redemption is a turn-based RPG that combines tactical combat, CCG elements, and a constantly evolving story in which no one is safe from death, including the main characters.

1891258006.title: The Bard's Tale ARPG : Remastered and Resnarkled
1891258006.short_description: You are the Bard, a selfish rogue weary of pointless sub-quests and rat-infested cellars. Through magical song you summon characters to join your quest!

1891276362.title: Dungeon Clawler
1891276362.short_description: Dungeon Clawler is a roguelike claw machine deckbuilder. Build your deck, grab weapons and items from the claw machine to battle enemies, discover powerful perks that create game-changing synergies and unleash crazy combos as you fight your way through the dungeon!

1891294325.title: Demon Skin
1891294325.short_description: Brutal Hack&Slash game with a challenging combat system plunges you into the harsh dark fantasy world to test your will and your skills. Only those who dare to get into the Demon Skin can survive!

1891307332.title: Dustborn
1891307332.short_description: Ragtag crew? Check. Musical gear? Check. Tour bus and robot driver? Check. Stolen package? Check! Embark on a perilous road-trip across a Divided States of America. Use the power of words to shape relationships with your crew, get out of trouble and reach your final destination.

1891368289.title: TEMPUS - Level Escape
1891368289.short_description: TEMPUS is a puzzle adventure game with time travel. Each time you advance, you will see the island where you live change over thousands of years. You can only travel forward so it is a one way trip, how far will you go?

1891372981.title: Duck Simulator Lite
1891372981.short_description:
Duck Simulator Lite is a clicker game where you quack a rubber duck to get coins! With those coins, you can purchase upgrades from the shop and advance your quacking career!

This version of Duck Simulator does not include the Challenge Mode or boss fight that was found in the original Duck Simulator for computers and mobile.

1891391982.title: Football Manager 2021
1891391982.short_description:
Unrivalled simulation gaming. No game gets you closer to the dream of managing the world’s best football teams. 
FM21 is a game that rewards planning and knowledge but, unlike other games, there’s no pre-defined ending or script to follow, simply endless opportunities. Every club has a story to tell and it’s up to you to write it.
Choose the club and the challenge that best suits your ambitions. There are more than 2,000 playable clubs from 50+ top footballing nations to pick from to start your journey. The choice is in your hands. 
With a database featuring more than 500,000 real life players and staff, your scouting team will find players to help make your squad better. There's also likely to be a prospect or two in the youth team knocking on the door of the first team. Can you develop their skills and turn them into a world-beater?
Craft tactical strategies, formations and play styles for every occasion to maximise your club’s chances of winning football matches and trophies. Fast-track your success with popular tactics from the real world of football or develop your own unique style.
Immerse yourself in the spectacle of matchday and revel in the glory of management as your planning pays off on the pitch before your very eyes. You can almost taste the victory.
NEW FOR THIS SEASON
Stamp Your Style
Communicating with your players and the media has never been more purposeful or realistic. Gestures enable you to express yourself more clearly, while Quick Chats improve the short conversations part of day-to-day life as a manager. In FM21, others will feel the impact of your words and know the sort of manager you are.
Matchday Magic
Every fixture is now a true spectacle. You’ll now receive better analysis and advice in the pre-match build-up as well as more reaction and data post-match. You’ll benefit from our brand new xG system, which illustrates how well or badly your team performed relative to the chances they created. Those data improvements combine with a remodelled match UI to bring you closer to the action.
Boss The Market
New staff roles, meetings and interactions freshen up one of the game’s most popular areas. Recruitment meetings ensure that you and your scouting team are on the same page, both for the short- and long-term. You’ll also now be able to approach agents directly about a player's interest in joining your club, mimicking how deals are done in the real footballing world. 
Revel In Your Glory
Re-live your campaigns and revel in your success like never before. A new season review experience picks out your best moments on and off the pitch, while showpiece victories feel much sweeter with improved title presentations and masses of media attention.

1891424304.title: Colorim - So simple, yet addictive
1891424304.short_description:
So simple, yet addictive...

Colorim is all about a rim sliced into colors. There is an arrow in the middle with a dot on it's tail. Simply tap the screen to throw that dot to where the arrow points. Do your best to shoot the matching color in the rim but beware of the black dots in between because you should avoid hitting them.

It may sound and look easy at the beginning, but beware all the bits and tricks you'll encounter on each upcoming level...

1891476683.title: Zolrys
1891476683.short_description: An oldschool sci fi platform game. Survive the inhospitable planet of Torlak and discover the truth about this mission. Face the Training Room mode and try to get the best score.

1891490306.title: Woodo Demo
1891490306.short_description: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas. No pressure, just a cozy world that remembers what it felt like to be a child.

1891589728.title: Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar
1891589728.short_description:
Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar is a Visual Novel with a kinetic , linear gameplay and a horror/cyberpunk setting, based on a Story from Michael Kumpmann. Produced by the new indie developer Digital Phoenix.

In the near future, humanity is in conflict with a mysterious, incomprehensible alien species which is defined as terrorists by the government. These aliens can appear everywhere, disappear everywhere, and even go through walls and buildings. No communication is possible and nobody knows what the creatures even want.

A group of mathematicians developed an algorithm which can predict the behavior of the attackers. A young lonely girl is appointed become a new member of the institute but when she arrives at Kyoto Novalis, the aliens attack and she gets lost in the city. Hilal, her new guardian, a female cyborg, searches her in the city, but they don't have much time, because the government ordered a nuclear attack on the city if the aliens can't be stopped in time.

Experience a story which explores the philosophical question of what it means to be human and what to sacrifice in the state of existential danger.

1891653289.title: Retro Racers
1891653289.short_description: A Retro Style Classic Arcade Racing Game! Put the pedal to the metal while speeding by your opponents cars to unlock 12 exciting tracks. Collect the 4 classic power-ups—Acceleration, Top Speed, Nitro Boosts and Traction. Return to your childhood in Retro Racers!

1891684356.title: Lost in Random™
1891684356.short_description: Play the odds in Lost in Random™, a gothic fairytale-inspired action adventure where every citizen’s fate is determined by the roll of a dice.

1891728216.title: Lord of the Сlick
1891728216.short_description:
Lord Of The Click — it's the game for those who outgrew meaningless shooters and tiresome endless RPGs.

Lord Of The Click will give you the unsurpassed feeling of allmightyness by controling the huge army with only one muscle of your body (Well, maybe two muscles...)

Lord Of The Click — it's the game for those who knows the true purpose of their thumbs.

Lord Of The Click — it's more than just a game, it's a whole training system for your fingers created by the best scientists from Kazakhstan!

When King Arthur removed the sword out of the stone, he did a huge mistake! It would be enough to remove the finger out of his...

1891739088.title: Stranded Penguin
1891739088.short_description: A simple but fun platformer with a hopping penguin collecting gold and jewels without falling down into the abyss!

1891744318.title: Buckshot Roulette – Russian Roulette Simulator
1891744318.short_description:
Face the dealer in a terrifying game of chance with a loaded shotgun. 🎯 Choose to shoot yourself or the dealer — survive 4 deadly rounds using only your wits, a 🔍 magnifying glass, and a 🚬 cigarette. Includes a bone-chilling bonus game: Horror Blackjack! 👻
Do you feel lucky? 💀.

1891766494.title: Nacht der Untoten Remastered
1891766494.short_description: nZombies (Nacht der Untoten) after which a more difficult round begins.

1891811268.title: Zumba - Marble Zombie Invasion
1891811268.short_description: Join the adorable undead in Zumba – Zombie Marble Invasion! As a marble-munching zombie, shoot, match, and explode colorful marbles before they overrun the graveyard. Unlock undead power-ups—Brain Freeze, Explosive Guts, Time Revert—and survive themed spooky realms!

1891931390.title: MXGP 2021 - The Official Motocross Videogame - Xbox Series X|S
1891931390.short_description:
All the power of Motocross in your hands: the new MXGP 2021 is finally here!
The official MXGP videogame is ready to show you what it's made of: warm up your engines and get ready for the most realistic, exciting two-wheeled experience ever!

1891953464.title: CloverPit
1891953464.short_description: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

1891981031.title: Runasaurus Rex: Origins (Windows)
1891981031.short_description: Runasaurus Rex: Origins is a thrilling endless runner where you take control of Rex, a fearless T-Rex on a desperate race for survival.

1892026097.title: Bloodwash
1892026097.short_description: A serial killer is terrorizing the city, and Sara's deadbeat boyfriend hasn't done the laundry. Can Sara survive a late-night trip to the laundromat, or will the Womb Ripper perform an early delivery?

1892031217.title: FeedEm
1892031217.short_description:
FeedEm is a short & silly game about being a father to a few greedy kids. You’ll need to keep your kids fed and provide the food they want CONSTANTLY or they’ll starve to death! 

The game was originally created for the Ludum dare game jam however I decided to release it for free so that you may enjoy (or hate) it. 

PS. You can only carry one food item at a time. If you pickup another item the first one will be lost, so don't waste food you'll need it later.

If you like the game please rate and review it and tell me what you like and dislike. I’m not promising anything but if there are good suggestions in the reviews then I might implement them in the game for you 

This game requires either a keyboard, joypad or joystick.

1892031884.title: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
1892031884.short_description: Do you like piloting legendary fighter jets? In Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone, you have open-world maps to explore, with an amazing selection of realistic airplanes. Enjoy the fully immersive experience provided by awesome flight controls, realistic interiors, sound effects and challenging weather scenarios.

1892058991.title: Minigolf Master
1892058991.short_description:
Play this fun mini golf game for free. It's fun to do and i can 
train while off the club.

1892166011.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Yajilin (Windows)
1892166011.short_description: Draw lines through the centers of cells to make a loop, and paint cells black in this original Nikoli puzzle. It's immensely satisfying to see how the lines and black cells all come together to form a solution, and figuring out how to draw the loop isn't as easy as it might seem.

1892179113.title: The Last Faith
1892179113.short_description: Dive into the latest evolution of The Last Faith: a dark and gothic fusion of metroidvania and soulslike. Engage in merciless and precise combat with a huge range of weapons, firearms, and custom executions. Let nothing stand in the way of your journey to salvation.

1892181795.title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1&2 (Holiday Special)
1892181795.short_description: Return to the heartfelt world of To the Moon.

1892184742.title: The Crew Motorfest Closed Beta
1892184742.short_description: The Crew Motorfest Closed Beta is live from 7/21–7/24!

1892192256.title: Dracamar
1892192256.short_description: Welcome to the world of Dracamar!

1892245301.title: ELDEN RING
1892245301.short_description:
THE NEW FANTASY ACTION RPG.
Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

1892264234.title: We should talk.
1892264234.short_description: It's not what you say, it's how you say it. We should talk is a short-form narrative game that will make you think carefully about the words you choose. Can your relationship survive the night?

1892329348.title: Final Zone
1892329348.short_description: Memory with the God of War….

1892393976.title: Sundered®: Eldritch Edition
1892393976.short_description: Sundered is a chaotic hand­-drawn metroidvania where you resist or embrace ancient eldritch powers. Confront hordes of terrifying enemies in an ever-changing world inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft. Sundered is a challenging and unique take on a classic genre from the creators of Jotun, now with local co-op!

1892395244.title: Mundaun
1892395244.short_description: Mundaun is a lovingly hand-penciled horror tale set in a dark, secluded valley of the alps. Explore various areas full of secrets to discover, survive hostile encounters, drive vehicles, fill your inventory and solve a variety of hand-crafted puzzles.

1892426142.title: Deponia Doomsday
1892426142.short_description: Can you change Deponia's fate? Do you have what it takes to change Rufus' past, present and future without accidently destroying the whole planet? Fight time itself in this action-packed, platypus-tastic and insanely hilarious story.

1892430140.title: FlipCat (Xbox Series)
1892430140.short_description: FlipCat is a 2D platformer with a unique perspective rotation mechanic. Explore 30 challenging levels as a curious cat, overcoming obstacles, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden paths in a vibrant pixel art world. Fun for all ages!

1892485156.title: We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip
1892485156.short_description: Partner up with your friend online and test your friendship by solving puzzles together in an abandoned amusement park. Work together to overcome brain-teasing challenges in this standalone We Were Here experience.

1892486586.title: Manitas Kitchen
1892486586.short_description:
Bring together a group of dinosaurs with extraordinary skills to make up the best kitchen brigade the world has ever seen. All under the supervision of a very rude and very tiny boss.

Discover new recipes
As you progress through the story and complete objectives, Trexito will remember recipes from his culinary school. Get the ingredients and obtain the recipes.

Cook like only a dinosaur can
How does an Ankylosaurus knead dough? Why does a Triceratops need a flamethrower? A Pterodactyl that cannot fly? Use their incredible skills to cook faster and better!

Watch out for the competition
You arrive in the kitchen and... broken countertops? Cheese on the floor? Beware of your rivals, because they won't make it easy for you...

Discover Alpadino's secret
Alpadino knows more than you think and hides a not-so-fun secret. Discover what his true mission is behind Trexito's new pizzeria, and maybe... you'll just end up covered in cheese.

1892488925.title: Stepgame
1892488925.short_description:
Our game lets you run or cycle in the beautiful forest chasing the rabbits, ducks and other animals.
Get motivated with Stepgame. More information on stepgame.io.

1892502964.title: Hades II
1892502964.short_description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

1892537035.title: Angels with Scaly Wings
1892537035.short_description: Angels with Scaly Wings is a unique visual novel set in a world populated by dragons.

1892557152.title: Gourmet Warriors (QUByte Classics)
1892557152.short_description: Save the city from demonic mutant robots attempting to take over!

1892576814.title: #Blud
1892576814.short_description: Save your friends, fight off the vampire apocalypse, and survive the horrors of freshman field hockey practice in #BLUD, a delightfully zany animated dungeon crawler that blurs the line between action RPGs and hyperkinetic 90s cartoons.

1892631295.title: Papetura
1892631295.short_description: Join the unique world of hand-crafted paper creations in Papetura, an atmospheric adventure game filled with wonder and beautiful, fragile music.

1892770003.title: Headspun
1892770003.short_description:
Headspun is a FMV/Adventure hybrid set in Cortex; the world of Theo Kavinsky's broken brain.

After waking from a five week coma, Theo finds his life in disrepair. With no memory of the accident, it’s up to Ted and Teddy – the conscious and subconscious voices in his head – to work out what happened, and put his life back on track.

1892832276.title: Kitaria Fables
1892832276.short_description: Kitaria Fables is a delightfully cute action adventure RPG with farming and crafting! Armed with a sword, bow and spellbook, fight back against a rising darkness threatening the world. Discover diverse regions in search of relics and resources, tend to your farm to grow your own provisions, and take on quests solo or with a friend in local co-op mode!

1892886301.title: Block Breaker by Boat
1892886301.short_description:
Block Breaker by Raft Game By ASW STUDIO!
 

Complete the level by destroying all the blocks!

Hit the bonus boxes in the next chapter and earn extra points!

Try to use your rights well to survive!

1892943931.title: Delivery of Us (Xbox Series)
1892943931.short_description: Take flight into a charming puzzle adventure!

1892964985.title: ACA NEOGEO LAST RESORT
1892964985.short_description:
“LAST RESORT” is a shoot ‘em up game released by SNK in 1992.
Players can use weapons such as laser, homing, or grenades which can be powered up as many as three times, along with a "unit" that can nullify enemy bullets and attack foes. Using these abilities and many other attacks players will fight in order to win the war between robots and humanity.

1892967816.title: Rabbit Raid
1892967816.short_description: Save your family by going on an adventure as a cute bunny. Collect berries, find secrets with bonuses, throw objects at enemies or jump on them to win. Find secret stars and change costumes. Defeat the bosses and get to the last one to save the little rabbits from captivity. Explore green fields, caves, rivers, snowy mountains, icy lakes, deserts and ruins.

1892989053.title: Polimines Deluxe
1892989053.short_description: A captivating logic puzzle combining Minesweeper and Nonograms mechanics.

1893031293.title: Formula One Simulator 2 - F1 Race Multiplayer
1893031293.short_description: Experience pulse‑pounding Formula One racing across forests, deserts, and city environments! 🏁 Unlock high‑performance cars, earn rewards, and face off in real‑time multiplayer battles. ⚡ Are you ready to become the next F1 legend?

1893196084.title: Battle Stations Blockade
1893196084.short_description:
Arm the turrets and take aim as you take command of a gunboat in dangerous waters!

Take command of a gunboat on an urgent mission to intercept stolen military intelligence and destroy the enemy’s advanced weapon systems! Battle Stations Blockade is an intense 3D rail shooter presented in voxel style. Receive orders and then set out on treacherous waters as you control a pair of gun turrets, shooting down aircraft, destroying boats and battleships, clearing mines, taking out paratroopers and more.

But watch your health! Each turret has a damage meter that will need to be replenished by eliminating targets, or you’ll fail the mission. Complete your assignments to climb in rank and unlock better weapons for your gunboat turrets, enabling you to shoot for even higher scores. Man both turrets in solo play or team up with a friend in local co-op!

1893250709.title: Matchpoint - Tennis Championships | DEMO
1893250709.short_description:
Matchpoint – Tennis Championships is a modern take on tennis, featuring a true-to-life on-court experience supported by a deep career mode and unique rivalry system.

The game places a strong focus on tactical realism, positioning and aiming, allowing the player to move their superstar in exactly the right way to get the most out of their shots.
Matchpoint – Tennis Championships combines slick character animations, authentic ball physics and enhanced player control to replicate the realistic rhythm of the game - every swing and hit feeling unique and satisfying.

1893326448.title: Classic Chess Board
1893326448.short_description: Classic Chess Board offers a refined and authentic chess experience, focused on pure strategy, clarity, and the timeless rules of the game. Designed for players who value tradition, focus, and competitive depth.

1893352474.title: Elemental War 2
1893352474.short_description: Elemental War 2 offers you the popular tower defense feeling combined with innovative game mechanics - the ultimate mix for many hours of fun!

1893365953.title: The Backrooms: HIDE & SEEK
1893365953.short_description: It's hide and seek in the backrooms.

1893390803.title: Knight Quest: Goblins Raid (Xbox One)
1893390803.short_description: An epic adventure that will test your courage.

1893542225.title: PIPE by BMX Streets
1893542225.short_description:
Mash Games has been in the works of developing the all around EPIC console game BMX Streets. 
Mash Games chose to stay away from options such as crowd sourcing, and has been actively engaging 
followers through physics demo releases and the BMX Streets mobile game. Myself along with the small
 Mash Games team, have been working incredibly hard to define and develop the future of BMX (and other extreme sports) 
video game physics, from an independent level. The community has shown tremendous support through these projects, and 
it's now that I would like to introduce you to....BMX Streets: PIPE.

So please, enjoy some delicious vert ramp boosting and lets SEND IT!

1893545993.title: 3D Golf Monster Arena
1893545993.short_description: Step into the arena and master every shot in Golf Monster Arena! Aim, charge, and unleash powerful strokes across 50 dynamic levels filled with obstacles, walls, and precision challenges. Can you conquer the course and become the ultimate Golf Monster?

1893571510.title: Tattoo Tycoon
1893571510.short_description: Become a tattoo artist and manage your own tattoo parlor. Find the perfect motifs for your curious customers and turn their vague wishes into amazing skin art. Grow from a small personal studio to a multi-parlor business over the different districts of Tattuga Bay.

1893673376.title: Gennady Demo
1893673376.short_description:
Gennady — dynamic roguelike platformer

Remember that dream where you find yourself on a crowded bus wearing nothing but your underwear?
Well, this isn’t a bus — and it’s not a dream either!
The blinding light fades, revealing a grim alien meat factory where you must break through compressed biomass with your own body — not to pay the fare, but to survive!

It’s time to hang the twitching remains of vile creatures on the ropes — those that crawled straight out of the moldy, green-stained pages of this grim comic book.
Better finish this quickly… though sometimes it’s tempting to stay here forever — or at least for the weekend.

Unique Visual Style
Hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation and a high-contrast black-and-white palette tremble under the pressure of pulsating splashes of color that frame this dark pseudo-noir world.

Fast-Paced Action
In addition to classic brawling, use furious dashes to not only overcome obstacles but also rip local inhabitants to pieces — turning your body into a living projectile.

Rage Mode
Enter a special state of insane speed and deadly attacks, fueled by absolute invulnerability. The better you do at exterminating the local fauna, the longer your rage lasts.

Tons of Artifacts and Upgrades
Trade your living currency for artifacts of varying usefulness. Upgrade your character and weapons to create unique builds for more efficient and spectacular gameplay.

Epic Boss Fights
Colossal beasts await you at the end of each biome — ready to test what you’re truly made of. Literally.

Alley of the Dead
Break the rule of permanent death: shoot off your collected artifacts and carry them into your next run — starting stronger and fully charged.
If, of course, you have enough ammo left.

1893675888.title: Monster Trampoline
1893675888.short_description:
The monsters are having a party, and they love playing on the trampoline!

Monster Trampoline is a local multiplayer game for 1-4 players, suitable for the entire family.

Drop monsters onto other monsters to try and knock them out of the ring without having your monster fall off. Transform your monsters into stronger monsters using Star Points and use their special powers to dominate the arena. Target the explosive barrels to really send the other monsters flying! Time the power bar to adjust the force with which you hit the other monsters.

Choose from 3 different levels: jumping from point to point in space, down on a tropical island with sparkling blue water, or on a pirate ship surrounded by sharks.

Battle it out with up to 4 human players, or against up to 3 computer players. Choose between 2 game modes: Turn-based (normal mode) or simultaneous action (Oni mode). Choose between 2 game difficulties: easy or normal.

Game play is fully customizable. Adjust the arena bounciness, number of rounds, or barrel spawn rate.

1893698606.title: JogoMemory3D
1893698606.short_description: Um simples jogo da memória gratuito e em formato 3D, para se divertir e não ter problema de memória na sua velhice. Aproveite que é de graça, faça o downloads para o seu computador Windows 10/11 ou Xbox.

1893702206.title: Booom-Slang! (Preview Demo)
1893702206.short_description: Top-down, Twin-Stick Shooting, FMV-infused, low-poly, creep infested, plasma blasting, crazily competitive CHAOS!!! Booom-Slang! is stocked up with a cavalcade of insane Single-Player and Multiplayer modes, maps and moments. Are you ready for what Conductor Chaos has in store for you?!

1893792348.title: Paper Flight - Future Battles
1893792348.short_description: Paper Flight – Future Battles is an interactive game experience that is designed to ease your mind and have fun popping innocent balloons. Jump into the role of a little paper plane and rescue the world from evil balloon demons by dashing through them.

1893820784.title: Threes!
1893820784.short_description:
THE ONLY 100% FULLY SNAPPABLE GAME ON XBOX ONE!

Threes is tiny puzzle that grows on you. 

Explore our little game’s deep challenge and grow your mind beyond imagination. 

³ Endless challenge from one simple game mode
³ An endearing cast of characters
³ A heart-warming soundtrack
³ Snap mode support - multitask away!

Threes grows with you and you'll grow with Threes.

1893821996.title: Yooperlite (Windows)
1893821996.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a corrupted land in a unique platforming journey with Yooperlite. Facing exploration and adventure challenges, while you walk, jump, slide and collect the fireflies to purify this world. Save what’s been lost and break free from the darkness. Do you have what it takes to restore the light?

1893849638.title: Poke RPG 2
1893849638.short_description:
Poke RPG 2 is an emulator of Pokémon you can catch, train and battle with Pokémon. 

Main Features:
 - 820 pokémons
 - 3 pokemons to start with
 - 6 maps
 - 4 Trainers to help you to make faster your pokémons to level up
 - Ranking Online
 - 7 Generations.

1893882380.title: DIMENSIONS
1893882380.short_description: Embark on an interdimensional adventure where each level is a unique universe. Enjoy enhanced graphics, optimized performance for Xbox Series S/X, and incredible performance on Xbox One. Experience diverse worlds with changing mechanics and styles, overcoming challenges and discovering secrets in every dimension.

1893882441.title: OUTRIDERS Demo
1893882441.short_description: Square Enix and People Can Fly present OUTRIDERS; a 1-3 player, drop-in-drop-out co-op shooter set in an original, dark and desperate sci-fi universe. Take your first steps into a savage future in the OUTRIDERS Demo and get a taste for the most aggressive RPG-Shooter in the genre.

1893886966.title: West Escape
1893886966.short_description: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the Wild West!

1893912101.title: Party Panic
1893912101.short_description: Party Panic is a crazy online and local-multiplayer party game. Compete against your friends in 30+ rapid fire minigames, play the new Board Game mode, race through the brutal Gauntlet, or complete the trophy challenges on Trophy Island. You'll laugh, you'll cry, it's stupid. Grab your friends, pick your characters and get partying in this exciting and panic filled game!

1893921184.title: Football Guy
1893921184.short_description: Welcome to Football Guy! Bad guys are all over the place! You don't know why, but you know that you have to do something about it. And what better way to do it than trucking your way through? Elude and run over bad guys through rain, snow or day and get that touchdown! Getting past them won't be easy though, so you might have to get serious! See if you can Barrel yourself to victory!!

1894058782.title: Cards of the Dead
1894058782.short_description: Cards of the Dead is a survival card game. Play your cards right and you might escape the zombie apocalypse!

1894122921.title: My Singing Monsters Playground
1894122921.short_description: Journey to the Monster World to take part in a tournament of Monster-Game madness! Watch your favorite Monsters come to life as you swing, fling, and spring your way to victory in a variety of 4-player competitions. Grab your friends and hit the Playground to see who has what it takes to win the ultimate Monster bash!

1894147058.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley
1894147058.short_description: Piano bridges, dancing plants and musical showdowns, ready to dive into The Mind?

1894255361.title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator
1894255361.short_description: The ultimate high-tech rubber duck simulation, Placid Plastic Duck brings you dangerous levels of relaxation. With chill music, dreamy 3D graphics, and many different happy ducks, your only priority is to float around. Zero Ducks given.

1894317724.title: The Serpent Rogue
1894317724.short_description: The Serpent Rogue is an action-adventure game set in a medieval fantasy world. Master the art of alchemy, explore forgotten lands, and protect the realm from impending disaster. You will craft, brew, boil, & concoct potions all in your stead to defeat an ominous danger!

1894324345.title: True Colours - A Date With Deception
1894324345.short_description:
Play the villain or seek ultimate redemption in a romantic visual novel adventure!

When three new hires join the office, love is in the air! Take the role of a gender-neutral protagonist that represents every player and make key decisions about work, life and love to guide the story’s development. Get to know your coworkers, go on dates and discover what innermost secrets they could be hiding. Engage in deep, sometimes disarming dialogue and enjoy a wide variety of backdrops and CG scenes.

True Colours – A Date With Deception starts as a cute visual novel about day-to-day life and the pursuit of happiness beyond a boring work routine, but as interpersonal trust is called into question, a darker side begins to emerge. Be forewarned that you could be seen as the villain of this tangled web, but it’s up to you whether you embrace the role or seek ultimate redemption. Dare to explore multiple story routes and romantic interests leading to 12 possible endings, some good… and some very bad!

1894333860.title: WRC 8 FIA World Rally Championship Xbox One
1894333860.short_description: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode….

1894379072.title: Back in 1995
1894379072.short_description: Back in 1995 is a throwback to the survival horror and mystery games of the mid-90's 32-bit generation, it faithfully re-creates everything from this all-but-forgotten era of games.

1894384067.title: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch
1894384067.short_description: Deck-building, dungeon defense, and tactical gameplay combine in Dungeon Monarch! Recruit warriors and wizards, buff your heroes, and thrash your foes — summon your dungeon monarch to punish interlopers and defeat enemies to increase your dark powers!

1894398913.title: Yuletide Legends: Who Framed Santa Claus (Xbox Version)
1894398913.short_description:
"For the Yuletide Detective there is no busier time then the winter season and this year proves it like none other. As Brigitte Woolf you're seconds away from sinking in your cozy armchair and chilling with a cup of cocoa, but a visit from Mrs. Santa changes your plans.

Not only was her husband accused of an extremely callous theft, but Santa himself became a victim of a thief. The unknown perpetrator took away his voice and left him in despair.

In the face of such wickedness and such an aggressive attack on the winter spirit, you have no other option than to put down your book and cozy blanket and get on with some splendid detective work with a magnifying glass in your hand. Especially since you will meet lots of people from magic and myths - the Snow Queen, Jack Frost and Krampus.".

1894440688.title: Battle Puzzle 2048 - Queens of the Abyss
1894440688.short_description: Combine tiles and battle witches, vampires, and cute girly demons in Battle Puzzle 2048 - Queens of the Abyss! Outsmart foes with unique abilities, play infinite mode, or tackle 5 difficulty levels. Can you defeat them all?

1894513996.title: CarX Street
1894513996.short_description: Conquer mountain slopes, vast highways, and bustling city streets in CarX Street. Build the car of your dreams with fine-tuning that reveals the full potential of CarX Technology© physics. Take part in thrilling races, offline or online, and enjoy realistic gameplay and dynamic controls.

1894632879.title: Shoot 1UP DX
1894632879.short_description: Play all your ships at once! Classic arcade gameplay, with a twist!

1894737128.title: Super Sami Roll
1894737128.short_description: Sami’s on a mission to rescue his friend Vera and he needs your help! Join him in this exhilarating, colorful 3D platformer and fast roll, air-grapple, and jump to save her!

1894745655.title: Murder Mystery Machine
1894745655.short_description: Join the District Crime Agency in this isometric, modern noir deduction thriller. Explore crime scenes in complex dioramas, organize your evidence effectively, and blur the lines between right and wrong to present your case. Do you have what it takes to be a real detective?

1894755030.title: Cyber Mines
1894755030.short_description: A fast-paced cyber-themed puzzle game where you scan grids, avoid mines, and secure the system.

1894757738.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95 for Windows
1894757738.short_description:
"THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
In addition to the character of popular work such as "FATAL FURY" and "ART OF FIGHTING" in the sequel title of the previous work "KOF '94", Yagamian will participate as the rival of the main character Kyo Kusanagi.
With the team edit function installed, it became possible to form a team with the player 's favorite character.

1894787867.title: Tofu Dream (Xbox Series X|S)
1894787867.short_description: Tofu Dream is a challenging 2D platformer where you control a sentient block of tofu trying to escape a surreal nightmare. Run, slide, dash, and jump through minimalist environments filled with living hazards. Can a simple tofu wake up in time?

1894839841.title: Mustache In Hell
1894839841.short_description: A trip to hell. Hordes of demons. Big guns. Insane combat encounters. Pixel art mustaches. It's going to be a long day for Officer John Mustache.

1894864113.title: Octo Killer
1894864113.short_description: An octopus found knives and goes on a rampage.

1894870073.title: The Little Ball That Could
1894870073.short_description: The Little Ball That Could is a unique marble platformer that will test your skill and your curiosity! One moment, you'll be dodging lasers as you're looking for the lost gems; the next, you'll be doing crazy aerial acrobatics to reach the switch that sets your friend free!

1894932889.title: 'Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit' Demo
1894932889.short_description: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

1894948980.title: Dreamcore
1894948980.short_description: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

1894950791.title: Motorcycle Stunt Racer
1894950791.short_description: Gear up and get ready for the ride of your life! Ride your bike through 27 exciting and challenging levels.

1894972803.title: Frobbutt 3D (Windows)
1894972803.short_description:
Frobbut 3D is a 3D platformer about a goofy frog finally departing from his home to explore the land! Run, jump, flip and bounce across 5 big open levels searching every nook and cranny for valuable gems! Be creative with your movement abilities to reach the highest mountains and traverse the most dangerous paths to collect every treasure you can find.

There's no time pressure to complete each level, so explore to your heart's content in search of every diamond and secret star! Can you collect everything?

- Lite collectathon platformer designed to be fun for all ages and skill levels
- Unique controls using only two action buttons: run and jump
- Amazing visuals mixing low poly 3D graphics and modern shading
- Cozy soundtrack for the right mood
- Try to collect everything in each level for the most fulfilling experience with the game.

1894986550.title: Froggie - A Retro Platformer
1894986550.short_description:
Hop your way to victory in minimalistic pixel art style!

Return to a simpler style of platforming action in Froggie - A Retro Platformer, a side-scroller presented in minimalistic black-and-white style where you take the role of an anthropomorphic frog as he leaps his way through 100 challenging levels! Run, wall jump and wall slide with fluid pixel art animation as you hop on enemies’ heads, avoid spike traps and more!

Touch flags or travel through doorways to set new checkpoints just in case you meet an untimely demise, but don’t worry too much, as you’ll instantly respawn and have a chance to try again.

1894999989.title: Wave Break Demo
1894999989.short_description: Wave Break is the world's first skateBOATING game, inspired by arcade skateboarding classics. Grind, grab, kickflip and shoot your way through an explosive 80s crime-filled Miami Vice themed world.

1895080876.title: Antarctica 88: 4k Remaster
1895080876.short_description: Survive this horror and creepy action adventure!

1895150701.title: The Last Cube (Demo)
1895150701.short_description: Venture through six unique areas of the cube-world and overcome 3D brain-teasers in this upcoming puzzle adventure game. You, the Last Cube, were awakened for a purpose—save this peculiar world from collapsing by solving puzzle tracks left by your ancestors.

1895188642.title: Zombie Runner͏
1895188642.short_description: Try to shoot zombies and make your way through them. Count your bullets carefully cause each time you have to pass through bigger crowds of zombies.

1895238803.title: Motesolo: No Girlfriend Since Birth

1896441741.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition Demo
1896441741.short_description:
This is the demo version of "Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition," an action RPG set in a dark fantasy version of the Three Kingdoms world. In this demo, players can enjoy the game from the beginning to the Mt. Dongshan stage.

- Game Overview
A new dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA.

It is 184 AD, during the Later Han Dynasty in China, and the land has been overcome by chaos and destruction. The imperial dynasty that prospered for many years is now on the verge of collapse.
As a nameless militia soldier, the player must overcome adversity and survive the turbulence of the Three Kingdoms by utilizing fluid swordplay based on Chinese Martial Arts in order to fight off powerful warriors and deadly demons.
This dark Three Kingdoms RPG is brimming with history, fantasy, and action.

Notes:
- Although this demo is a portion of the full game, it may differ from the retail version in some respects.
- It is possible to carry over saved data from the demo to the full version of "Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty Complete Edition." However, it is not possible to do so for "Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty" (the original version).
- A connection to the Xbox network is required to play.
- A subscription to Game Pass Core is not required to play multiplayer.
- For multiplayer, players can only be matched with other demo version players.
- Distribution of the demo may end without prior notice.
- For more information, please visit the official homepage: https://teamninja-studio.com/wolong.

1896443736.title: Undernauts: Labyrinth of Yomi
1896443736.short_description: Escape from “Yomi” – a dungeon filled with riches – and danger.

1896598798.title: Street Outlaws 2: Winner Takes All
1896598798.short_description: The stakes have just been raised! 1896621270.title: Gloomy Eyes Demo

His mission is to regulate the population of each biome to prevent ecological imbalance, while also capturing creatures for research.

1896690467.title: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
1896690467.short_description: Read instructions, fix ships, get paid, avoid corporate slaughter: job done.

1896704456.title: Arcade Archives 2 TEKKEN

"TEKKEN" is a 3D fighting game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
In "The Tekken Tournament," pugilists with their own hidden agendas clash to determine who possesses the ultimate fist.
The game features a revolutionary control scheme where four buttons correspond to each limb, delivering an intuitive combat experience. Command a vast array of techniques as if you were controlling your own body!

1896773226.title: Shadowgate (remake)
1896773226.short_description: Shadowgate is one of the most well-known and beloved adventure titles in gaming history. It quickly endeared players with its fantastic atmospheric soundtrack, perilous locations to progress through, countless puzzles to solve, and more ways to gruesomely die than gamers previously thought possible. 1896844128.title: GalactiMAX
1896844128.short_description:
Made originally for a 12-hour game jam, GalactiMAX has the player shooting aliens for points to pierce the heavens! As more aliens are defeated, the player's ship will increase in size and power. How big can this ship get?!

INSTRUCTIONS

Keyboard Enter or Space, touching the GalactiMAX logo or Press Start, and A/Start on Gamepad will begin the game.
Arrow keys, Touch, Gamepad D-Pad, or Gamepad Left Joystick move the ship.
Reset High Score will erase high score data and Filter will toggle the CRT display setting.
Firing your bullets is automatic, no button input necessary!
Dodge alien fire. The blue box on your ship is your hitbox!
Collect the wrench to restore your shield.

Game created by:

AJ Ryan - Game designer and Programmer
Steve Felix - Player and Alien artist
Clayton Butcher - Title and Logo Design
Ben Thornburg - Music.

1897248641.title: Bullets and Brains
1897248641.short_description:
In Bullets & Brains, you'll find yourself immersed in a sprawling post-apocalyptic environment, teeming with engaging atmosphere and danger at every turn. As one of the last survivors, it's up to you to navigate through the desolate streets, abandoned buildings, grimy alleyways, but also forests, sewers and even snowy mountains, fighting off waves of relentless zombies.
But fear not, for you possess a powerful advantage. Collect brains and energy and keep on leveling up! These items will boost your character's abilities, enabling you to unleash devastating attacks and turn the tide of battle in your favor.
Bullets & Brains offers you the choice of different characters to play as. Each of them has a unique appearance, stats and starting weapon.
Are you afraid of fighting alone? Group up with another survivor and do everything you can to keep each other alive! The more the merrier, right? Co-op Mode is all you need to have even more fun while battling against hordes of zombies.
The choice is yours, and the outcome depends on your skill and strategy.
As you fight your way through the zombie-infested city, rack up scores and strive to earn high ratings.
Are you ready to face the hordes of brain-hungry zombies in the chaotic post-apocalyptic landscape? Grab your weapons, brace yourself, and embark on the ultimate battle for survival in Bullets & Brains. The fate of humanity rests in your hands.
● Choose between many distinctive characters, each with their own starting weapon.
● Explore a sprawling post-apocalyptic environment, filled with atmospheric locations and hidden secrets.
● Engage in intense top-down 3D shooter combat against never-ending hordes of brain-hungry zombies.
● Group with last survivors to protect each other in mayhem battles - Bullets
and Brains offers a co-op mode!
● Collect brains in order to level up and energy that grants powerful abilities, allowing you to unleash devastating attacks.
● Experience the game with your preferred control scheme, supporting both mouse and keyboard as well as gamepad.
● Test your survival skills against endless waves of undead
● Enjoy the fast-paced action and dynamic gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
● Unleash your strategic thinking and skillful aim to overcome the relentless zombie onslaught.
● Adapt your tactics and loadouts to suit different enemy types and encounter two new challenging foes.
● Uncover hidden collectibles and unlock bonus content as you progress through the game.
● Engage in thrilling and satisfying gunplay, with a wide range of weapons and explosives at your disposal.

Features:

- Easy to play, exactly what you need to rest from the dynamics of big games;
- Level-design with no dead ends, so you don't have to restart any level except if you really want to start anew;
- Short animated cutscenes with story elements.

Engine rooms include such elements as:

1. Power grid: it receives the power from the reactors. Each reactor has a distinct shape of routing the energy it contains. Objective of each level is to have every power grid cell filled with energy.
2. Coloring rays: they change the color of the reactor which it touches. Game starts with only red-colored reactors, then proceeds to include yellow-colored, blue-colored and non-colored, which must be first exposed to the coloring rays. Upon going into the coloring ray, player can lose the level.
3. Various obstacles that block the way.
