Build cannons, save money, destroy the enemy with the help of secret weaponry and keep your wits about you, because your enemy never sleeps.

This unique historical setting will allow you to immerse yourself in an atmosphere of real and uncompromising battle. Varied enemies, powerful cannons and secret weaponry which will drive your enemy to despair – all of this in a new Tower Defense game!

Man the guns!
All the power of artillery in your hands!
Powerful cannons and serious opponents
A unique setting and secret weaponry
Build an ideal defense!

1916305445.title: Palindrome Syndrome: Escape Room
1916305445.short_description: You wake up in a spaceship with no memories. In this escape room with a sci-fi setting you will have to investigate your past solving different puzzles. Will you be able to discover what happened to you and how did you get there?

1916393313.title: SIGNALIS
1916393313.short_description: A classic survival horror experience set in a dystopian future where humanity has uncovered a dark secret. Unravel a cosmic mystery, escape terrifying creatures, and scavenge an off-world government facility as Elster, a technician Replika searching for her lost dreams.

1916459679.title: Mina the Hollower Demo
1916459679.short_description: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

1916478046.title: Plague Road
1916478046.short_description: Rescue survivors, fight monsters and explore a once great city fallen to plague in a dark fantasy game combining turn-based tactical strategy and roguelike elements.

1916483299.title: Alex the Rabbit (Windows)
1916483299.short_description: Alex the Rabbit is a classic 2D platform game where you control an adventurous rabbit. Collect carrots scattered across the map, face challenges, and win the Golden Carrot at the end of each level. There are 20 levels and 4 bosses in a fun retro-style adventure.

1916512352.title: Astrologaster
1916512352.short_description: Astrologaster is a comedy game set in Shakespeare’s London. Play as 'Doctor' Simon Forman and treat his patients using astrology. A story-driven adventure based on a truly ridiculous story.

1916543336.title: Croc's World (Xbox-Edition)
1916543336.short_description:
Croc´s World is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

It features:

Jump and run through the levels and dodge all enemies.
Collect a helmet to crush stoneblocks.
Collect the stonebag to throw stones.
If you collect 100 diamonds you´ll get an extra life!

Controls:
Move: Cursor-keys or 'a', 'w', 'd'
Shoot: Space.

1916584297.title: Bunny Mahjo
1916584297.short_description: Classic Mahjong Solitaire is not 2d puzzle anymore. You can play solo or with a friend on your couch in 3d-environment . Play together, win together, unlock more figures together.

1916618155.title: Quest Hunter
1916618155.short_description: Quest Hunter is an isometric action-RPG where your choice drives the story. Find tons of treasures and secrets, solve puzzles, equip your character, level up your skills and finish off enemy bosses. Play on the couch, alone or with friends, or make it an online party for up to four players!

1916758859.short_description:
Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

The PC version of this game does not support Xbox Live.

1916775416.title: Dragon Takers
1916775416.short_description: Rise and resist the dragons in a fantasy RPG acquiring enemy skills!

1917006388.title: Football, Tactics & Glory – Treble Deluxe Edition
1917006388.short_description: Tactics meet passion – lead your team to glory!

1917064734.title: Pukan, Bye-Bye!
1917064734.short_description: It is not recommended for people with a shattered psyche.

1917094843.title: FARAWAY TRAIN
1917094843.short_description:
In a train that runs forever,
Follow the fall of an empire that had boasted of its glory for a long time,
And the clues of a noble girl who was forgotten and tossed about by history.

At the end of it all, the train arrives at...

FARAWAY TRAIN is an Atmospheric Narrative Adventure Game.

You wake up in an unfamiliar, old-fashioned train and are asked to trace the ephemeral life of Empress Roxelana, who led the world into collapse by using an ancient magical 
device called the "Nebula Astronomical Disc."
Search the train for clues to uncover the date and location where she used the device.

Along the way, there will be locked cabin doors that impede your progress. 
The date of each turning point in Roxelana's life serves as the key to opening these doors.
Find and enter the number representing these dates to unlock each door while unraveling more of the story behind the abandoned Empress and the magical device.

As you explore the train, the beautiful, vast scenery outside the train windows will continuously change with procedural generation. 
Enjoy the unique scenery spreading out endlessly outside; you will never see the same landscape twice. 

The game also offers a Free Mode where the player can freely walk around the train, sit in any seat, look out the train window, and read the ePUB file.

1917135799.title: HYPERCHARGE Unboxed
1917135799.short_description: Hypercharge is a first and third-person shooter action figure game you've always dreamed of! Grab your friends, complete objectives, defend the Hypercore against waves of weaponized toys, and defeat Major Evil together in the story campaign!

1917136506.title: Knowledge, or know Lady Demo
1917136506.short_description:
Knowledge, or Know Lady is a live-action romance simulation where you, by some ridiculous twist of fate, become the only guy at an all-girls university! Step into this first-person love comedy adventure, where sweetness and chaos await on campus.

Under relentless charm offensives from a group of gorgeous girls, will you stay loyal to the one you love? Or enjoy the attention from everyone? Or maybe… resist temptation and proudly shout, “Ladies! Stop distracting me from studying!” — The legend of your time at the girls' university is yours to write.

First-Person Perspective — Total Immersion
Filmed entirely from a first-person view to boost immersion, putting you right in the middle of the action and romance.

Multiple Routes, Endless Endings
Say goodbye to predictable love stories! Besides classic single-heroine endings, explore double routes, multiple love stories, or defy human limits with the ultimate "Lone Wolf at a Girls' School" ending.

Innovative Gameplay, Unpredictable Plot
Beyond standard dialogue choices, collect quirky items hidden around campus. These will play a crucial role in unlocking secret scenes and shaping your destiny.

Stunning Cast, Ultimate Romance
Get swept away in the youthful atmosphere of campus life, as six charming heroines — each with their own distinct personality — bring you a truly unforgettable romantic adventure.

1917162302.title: Rise of the Slime
1917162302.short_description: Rise of the Slime is a roguelite like no other, mixing deep and tactical deckbuilder gameplay with the chill vibes of a side-scrolling adventure.

1917190010.title: Gabriels Worlds The Sokoban Adventure
1917190010.short_description:
Gabriel finally took a vacation, but his adventure is just beginning!
During his travels, he discovered that mysterious villains have trapped helpless kittens inside boxes! Now, it's up to him to solve challenging puzzles to set them free.

1917358881.title: Brave Soldier - Invasion of Cyborgs
1917358881.short_description:
Become a one-man army against impossible odds in a run ’n gun extravaganza inspired by arcade action classics!

Get ready to arm yourself to the teeth and save the world from a cyborg invasion! Brave Soldier – Invasion of Cyborgs is a side-scrolling run ’n gun action game that recalls the 2D pixel art style and tough-but-fair challenge of 16-bit and arcade classics. Take the role of a courageous commando as he stomps through 30 unique stages spanning jungles, snowfields, clifftops and more as he hunts down the mechanical menace that threatens mankind. 

Can you take the fight to big bad bosses to cut the invasion off at its source?

1917405921.title: Choo-chou Spider Train Attack
1917405921.short_description:
"Choo Choo Horror Spider Train" is a thrilling and terrifying horror game that takes you on a journey through a haunted train. Inspired by the classic game "Choo Choo Charles," this updated version takes the terror to a whole new level.

As you step aboard the train, you take on the role of Charlie, a passenger who must navigate through dark and creepy environments filled with jump scares and unexpected twists. The train is inhabited by malevolent spirits who will stop at nothing to prevent you from reaching your destination. With each passing car, the tension builds as you face a new challenge, each more frightening than the last.

The immersive graphics of "Charles Choo Choo Scary" bring the haunted train to life with incredible detail. From the creaking floors to the flickering lights, every aspect of the game has been crafted to create an intense and atmospheric gaming experience. The sound effects are equally chilling, with each footstep, creak, and whisper adding to the tension and making your heart race.

In addition to the main storyline, "Charle Choo Choo Scary" also features several side quests and hidden areas to explore. As you uncover the dark secrets of the train, you'll discover the true motives of the spirits that haunt it, and you'll find yourself drawn deeper into their twisted world.

"Choo Choo Train Scary" is available on Xbox and PC devices, providing a versatile and exciting gaming experience. Whether you're a seasoned horror fan or new to the genre, this game is sure to deliver an unforgettable and spine-tingling journey. So grab your controller, take a deep breath, and get ready to experience the ultimate in terror with "Spider Choo Choo Scary.".

1917441524.title: Escape from Ever After
1917441524.short_description: A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! When a greedy megacorp from the real world starts taking over fairytales for their cheap labor, a storybook hero must climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back!

1917641293.title: Treasure Hunter Simulator
1917641293.short_description: Dive into the exciting world of finding long forgotten treasures. Grab your metal detector and set off to explore the countryside. What today looks like a peaceful meadow might have been the scene of a fierce battle in the past, hiding now the valuable artefacts. Ready to dig in the past?

1917699345.title: Mine Mopper
1917699345.short_description: A creative spin on the classic game Minesweeper, Mine Mopper will challenges your puzzle solving skills. Play today on PC and Xbox!

1917774063.title: Demons of Asteborg
1917774063.short_description: Demons of Asteborg is an action-platform game, with elements of metroidvania. Play as Gareth and prevent Zadimus from destroying Asteborg!

1917836745.title: Masked Memory
1917836745.short_description: Classic style text-based adventure with a twist.

1917867997.title: Colorful Recolor
1917867997.short_description: Colorful Recolor is a fast-paced puzzler with a kaleidoscopic collection of brain teasers. Play through 100 levels with engaging mechanics, striking biomes, 10+ distinct elements and an abundance of colors. Paint your way through this colorful world!

1917892678.title: File Destined
1917892678.short_description:
Could Oliver’s latest case be just a small piece of a much bigger picture? Gather clues, unravel the mystery behind the investigation, and uncover the truth.

In the end, that truth may be far more disturbing—and very different from what you expected.

As you work to identify who is behind one of the country’s most closely watched murder cases, you’ll face unexpected dangers when you least expect them. Take your time at the crime scene: everything you find could bring you one step closer to the answers you’re looking for.

During your mission, be extremely careful not to spend too long in the dark—because in the darkness, evil spirits from beyond this world may be waiting.

Examine the environment closely and inspect every object you come across to see if it holds crucial information about the case. Meanwhile, you’ll need to survive a hostile, shadowy world with only a lighter as your source of light. The lighter uses realistic mechanics, so use it wisely—or you may be left in the dark.

1917938753.title: Yakuza 0 for Windows 10
1917938753.short_description: The glitz, glamor, and unbridled decadence of the 80s are back in Yakuza 0. Fight your way through Tokyo and Osaka with protagonist Kazuma Kiryu and series regular Goro Majima.

1918006946.title: The Inheritance of Crimson Manor
1918006946.short_description:
In The Inheritance of Crimson Manor you will experience a “Penny Dreadful” like gothic horror story set in a beautiful and enigmatic Victorian era manor with a dark secret.

Unravel The Mystery
After working for more than ten years as the private assistant of the enigmatic railroad magnate Hadley Strange, the news of his sudden and unexpected death along his entire family takes you by surprise. Now you have been appointed as the executor in charge of fulfilling his last will,and take care of his majestic manor, a luxurious property on the outskirts of London. Upon your arrival to the mansion you find an envelope with your name containing a letter bearing a cryptic set of instructions that might change your mind about who your former employer really was.

Delve Into The Manor
Explore a beautiful Victorian Mansion filled with fine art, secret passages and mysterious mechanical contraptions that will reveal to you even the most intimate aspects of the life, past and legacy of its former residents. Decipher curious locks and find key items and objects that will help you make your way through the 24 manor rooms in a non linear way, each room has a unique beauty and new pieces that will help you unveil the dark secret kept by the residence.

Solve The Puzzles
Solve clever riddles and fascinating mechanical puzzles crafted to ensure that only the right person could unveil the mansion's secret. Look for clues and take a closer look to your surroundings to discover the shocking truth about the mansion and it's mysterious residents. Find items and manage your inventory to make your way through the different passages of the mansion, examine many detailed items and discover how to use them to unlock all the rooms and get all the pieces to solve the manor puzzling secret, one so shocking that will leave you breathless.

1918072947.title: A Maze Against Time (XOne)
1918072947.short_description: Maze after maze on a tight timer!

1918089106.title: The Dark Eye: Chains of Satinav - Demo
1918089106.short_description: Face your Destiny! In Andergast, whose inhabitants are considered to be notoriously superstitious, King Efferdan awaits a state visit from high-ranking dignitaries. For centuries the kingdom has been at odds with neighboring Nostria, but now first steps are being undertaken toward a lasting peace.

1918176431.title: Braveland Trilogy
1918176431.short_description: Braveland Trilogy is a turn-based game inspired by old-school strategies with hexagonal battlefield.

1918194516.title: World2D RE
1918194516.short_description:
In this short game in a 2.5d world pass the levels and each level will face new challenges
increasingly difficult.

1918222348.title: SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection
1918222348.short_description: Three 8-bit classics officially playable in English for the very first time!

1918259419.title: Clockwork Blackout (Xbox Series X/S)
1918259419.short_description: A megacorporation dominates the city with steam-powered factories and intricate machinery. Rumors suggest the company is secretly developing mutant creatures. The player takes on the role of a lone hacker who must infiltrate the corporation’s headquarters, steal digital evidence, and escape unharmed to expose the truth to the world.

1918361672.title: Werewolf Pinball
1918361672.short_description: Beware of the full moon, the werewolf it's coming for you.

1918389229.title: Countryside Farm Clues (Windows)
1918389229.short_description: Countryside Farm Clues is a cozy spot-the-difference game set in peaceful farm scenes. Subtle changes hide in plain sight, testing your focus and attention. With relaxing visuals, quick “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress-free modes, it’s calm and challenge in one.

1918441274.title: MONOPOLY PLUS
1918441274.short_description: It’s MONOPOLY for a new era! Play the classic game and watch the board come to life! A full 3D city at the center of the board lives and evolves as you play. You own a miniature world that will interact with your progression throughout the game and celebrate your achievements. Play the way you want - you can change the rules and adapt them to your playing style. Take and display photos at key moments for an amplified social gaming experience. Monopoly PLUS raises the classic game to a new level!

1918566348.title: Ah, Love! Season 2 (Windows)
1918566348.short_description: New season of a game about Love! Swap blocks to help hearts have a date, but avoid the black heart, spikes and other obstacles! Optional challenge: make the hearts meet specifically in a romantic zone - a special part of some of the levels.

1918576002.title: Grand Theft Auto VIㅤㅤ
1918576002.short_description:
Grand Theft Auto VI takes place in the year 2025 in the southern state of Florida, more precisely in the city of Miami and rural areas of Dade County, and tells the stories of three protagonists: Lucia Jenkins, Jason Roberts, and Kai Curkman — three uniquely-different criminals as they commit daring and profitable heists across the sprawling city of Los Miami.

It takes place about seven years after the events of Grand Theft Auto V, and Ten years before the events of The Contract update of Grand Theft Auto Online.

1918582545.title: Demon Hunter: Chronicles from Beyond (Xbox Version)

1918699921.title: Club Penquin
1918699921.short_description: Club Penguin was a massively multiplayer online game, involving a virtual world that contained a range of online games and activities. It was created by New Horizon Interactive. Players used cartoon penguin-avatars and played in an Antarctic-themed open-world.

1918737361.title: Mech Mechanic Simulator
1918737361.short_description:
Mechs are our future!
What happens when cars are no longer around? Gigantic robots take over! Powerful, destructive and strong... They are used in sports, at war... and for you, they are moneymakers.
Become Mech Mechanic and open your own workshop to dismantle, fix and rebuild gigantic robots. 
Every mech has its own special purpose and as a Mech Mechanic not only will you be able to diagnose, repair or change the parts but also paint, update and accommodate mechs for their new function. 
Even if you’re the best Mech Mechanic in the world, you’ll find the parts that are unfixable. Do what you can with what you’ve got, but if you find some junk among your parts… dismount it and order new ones. If you don’t like wasting things, don’t worry! Mech Mechanic Simulator lets you remanufacture and renew the parts. It’s your choice: sell, recast or restore your parts!
Gain some respect among other corporations and get access to more advanced machinery. But be careful, it’s not that easy. You’ll have a lot of expenses. Raw materials and equipment are not cheap, the quality of your parts can drop rapidly, and some of the customers have really high demands. If you don’t want to be put out of business, you’ll have to make your workshop look good as well. Can you maintain a good reputation?
Become an expert in your field and compete with the most powerful corporations of the future. Who’s going to produce the most modern, technologically advanced mech? Make sure it’s you!

1918742857.title: Mars Horizon
1918742857.short_description: Lead a major space agency as you guide humanity to Mars in this strategy simulation game. Construct a base, design and build rockets, conduct missions throughout the Solar System, and write your own history of Space exploration.

1918758482.title: Do you know de way
1918758482.short_description: Do you know de way - a game in the style of "maze", about a mutant with pink hair. He comes from Uganda, but events also take place in Uganda's dungeons. The goal of the game is that you need to carefully bring the Queen to the door through the thorny maze. Our main character makes very interesting sounds during movement, downtime, and even when he is near the Queen. The game is not difficult, but requires vigilance and careful management.

1918762956.title: Aero The Acro-Bat: Rascal Rival Revenge
1918762956.short_description: The remake of the classic platformer Aero the Acro-Bat is back!

1918846023.title: Cat Rescue Story
1918846023.short_description: It's up to you to create the most welcoming cat rescue centre around! Follow in your great-aunt's footsteps by renovating the house she left you, rescuing stray cats and taking care of them until you can find a new family to take them in.

1918854602.title: Mini Golf Quest
1918854602.short_description: Can you conquer every hole and become the ultimate mini golf champion?

1918859748.title: Finis
1918859748.short_description: FINIS is a puzzle game with a difference, we create a psychological evaluation based on your choices. Each universe offers a different experience, terror, calm, destruction, war, progress... You can choose between 8 completely different paths and each path will take you to a unique ending.

1918876063.title: ACA NEOGEO LEAGUE BOWLING for Windows
1918876063.short_description:
LEAGUE BOWLING is a bowling game released by SNK in 1990. You are able to select your dominant arm and ball weight, using precise controls to play just like real bowling! Choose from one of three modes, REGULATION, FLASH, and STRIKE 90.
*Game sections requiring use of the connection jack are not included.

1918884435.title: Sword of the Vagrant
1918884435.short_description: Guide Vivian the Vagrant, through vibrant and dynamic landscapes while hacking and slashing a path from a quiet coastal village through mysterious forests, haunted castles, and wrecked battlegrounds. When the endless barrage of enemies have been vanquished, what solace will be left for our hero?

1918931441.title: Fishing Adventure
1918931441.short_description:
Fishing Adventure is a typical fishing game, where the player can (drums) catch different fish species! Fish in USA, Hawaii and other unique fisheries.

Game is quite simple, designed to run even at older computers!

Main Features:

- Over 30 species of fish,
- 7 large locations inspired by real places in the world,
- Interesting quests,
- Tournaments,
- Daily records and rewards,
- Real fishing equipment,
- The realistic and relaxing sound,
- Advanced graphics settings for older computers.

1918964429.title: Horror Tale 2: 4k Remaster
1918964429.short_description: Immerse yourself in the scary and mysterious story of Lakewich with Tom and his friends. Try to solve the mystery of missing children. Explore locations, find items and solve puzzles to protect yourself and your friend from the terrifying kidnapper.

1918965529.title: Mayhem Brawler - Demo
1918965529.short_description: Mayhem Brawler is an urban fantasy themed beat 'em up that brings back the 90s arcade vibe to present day. With comic book style art and kick-ass soundtracks, it offers a unique experience that you can tackle solo or as co-op with friends while defining the next step in the story with your choices.

1919029164.title: Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story
1919029164.short_description: A simulation game where you can create a wonderful sweets shop with Doraemon.

1919133963.title: Praetorians - HD Remaster
1919133963.short_description: Relive the celebrated real-time strategy classic Praetorians, re-imagined in high definition. Praetorians is set amidst the political machinations of an emerging Roman Empire. Prove your worth on the battlefields of Egypt, the combat theaters of Gaul and finally the heart of the Empire itself in Italy, in the crusade to become Emperor.

1919221925.title: Turret Rampage
1919221925.short_description:
Defeat waves of subterranean invaders using quick-thinking strategy in a mix of tower defense and shoot’em up action!

Defend humanity from subterranean monsters as the last standing turret! Turret Rampage is a shoot'em up game with tower defense elements. You are a defensive turret, the only unit that stands between the remnants of humanity and the fierce underground invaders.

Repel enemy waves by quickly moving between their tunnels and using the right weapons for every foe. The more you anger the outlandish creatures, the stronger will be the forces they send to break through your defenses. Use quick-thinking strategy, a varied arsenal of shot types and even an artificial earthquake to survive waves of baddies and move deeper underground!

1919266957.title: Love is all around (Demo)
1919266957.short_description:
"Love Is All Around" is a simulating love story real-life full-motion interactive video . You will not only meet but also fall in love with six beauties with completely different personalities and styles, eventually embark on an immersive and sweet journey one after another.
Under their charisma, how would you deal with the six beauties while you are busy at paying off debts? Would you ignore your feelings and focus on making money? Or would you choose love over money? Among these beauties, who would you choose to be your partner for the rest of your life?

Is it the extremely charming ingenue girl?
Is it the mature girl with intellectual tenderness and gentleness?
Is it the innocent, lovely gamine girl?
If the above isn’t what’s in your mind, then there’s…
Unruly and willful, but slightly masochistic girl who born with a silver spoon!
Sexy, hot, and delicate goddess!
Noble and glamorous, a domineering female CEO who loves you solely!
There is always one that will make you fall in love with it! The right to choose a love one is now in your hands!

Product Features
·Full first-person perspective during the whole story, immersive experience of love -"Love Is All Around" is first-person perspective throughout, completely immersed in scene interaction and real-life simulation. It provides the immersive simulation experience, allows you to try more, and have an immersive love experience with the girl you like.

·Multiple branches, multiple endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes - the interactive video has designed more than a hundred story branches, twelve endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes for you, additionally, you can find achievement system, mining and multiple experiences in product. In the product, make the choice that goes with your heart, rather than the correct choice.

·Acting by real actors , shooting in real-life scenes - numerous wonderful behind-the-scenes stories are waiting to be discovered, revealing the actor's understandings of the character's inner world, and unravel the secrets of flirting through girl’s perspective.

·Various ways to play, finding the faint clues - the game life is not limited to choices, the key clues of the follow-up plot can be hidden in the scene, faint clues can closely related to the ending. Maybe everything is predestined, but sometimes being brave will change your fate. Come and play out your story.

·Six girls with very different personalities can be introduced—either charming, or tender, or innocent, or capricious, or sexy, or glamorous, there is always a kind of girl that make you exclaim: " Damn it! I am surrounded by beauties! "

About Us
We are "intiny", we are all "split personality" nerds who want to have date every day, but will never step out of the house to the real world. Thereford, we would like use interactive video as tool to create one fantasy dream after another, to create dreams for players, and to make our dreams to come true for ourselves.

1919399595.title: WORD SEARCH BY JGABRIB
1919399595.short_description: Playing word search puzzles helps improve focus, attention, and pattern recognition in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a light mental exercise that keeps your mind active while offering a relaxing break from fast-paced games.

1919408396.title: Royal Romances: The Power of Chosen One CE Xbox
1919408396.short_description:
With the power to command the dragons, the Chosen One could be a great hero… or foe!

After werewolves, witches, and evil magic, you finally have a chance to catch your breath. Or do you…? Don’t get too comfortable, because Ida and all her witchery is on your trail, ready to seize the untethered power of the Chosen One and become invincible. She is ever closer to her goals, and the final battle is coming…

The situation may seem grim, but there is hope on the horizon… the very prophecy of a Chosen One that Ida is after! Once the Chosen One returns, they will be able to command the dragons. In Ida’s search for the mystery hero, she took Glissando, but failed while trying to kidnap Princess Amelia… who might just be the real Chosen One. But beware: the witch won’t give up so easily! 

Not to mention, Ida isn’t the only one stirring up trouble. There is also the matter of King Illeon preparing a final assault on the forest, and he has a story of his own, too… 

The wise Great Ent knows you don't give up quite that easily. The fate of the forest and the love of your life are upon your shoulders!

Old friends, a settlement of fairies, and many ancient creatures will come to your aid as you explore the magic forest and search for hidden objects in your quest to restore splendor and tranquility to the kingdom. See all there is to uncover in this magical world and be the force to tip the scale of fate!

1919448388.title: Hexapoda
1919448388.short_description:
Get ready to fight giant Insects for the future of humanity!
After the last human war, gases were spread through the atmosphere, making it unbreathable.
The richest fled to orbital colonies and the others took refuge underground.

You are a young hothead, hired by a team of scientists left on earth who are looking for a solution to bring humans back to the surface.

Playable from 1 to 4 players (local co-op),
Hexapoda is inspired by Arcade classics.

- 3 Game Modes : Normal , Hard and Manic.
- Unlock 3 Different endings, new features and new items.
- 12 stages.
- 4 futuristic combat aircrafts with their own style of shooting.
- A bestiary composed of giant insects.
- Unlock all the 30 achievements !
- Leaderboards for each game mode.

Powered by an original epic soundtrack composed by the French band of electronic music: Double Dragon.

1919539149.title: Danger!Energy
1919539149.short_description: Connect the points with neon rays to liberate virtual city of Santermonia from the Main Virtual Controller's tyranny.

1919541930.title: Dark Grim Mariupolis
1919541930.short_description:
Introducing “Dark Grim Mariupolis”, a point'n'click adventure game set in a world, combining noir, Greek mythology, magic, mysticism, hopeless entourage of Greco-Roman Age of Decadence and stifling everyday routine. Encourage yourself and step into darkness…
Enter Mariupolis, a dark place accompanied with confusing, strange music of no visible source. You are some sort of a detective, and therefore you need to investigate, but why? That’s the thing you’re going to find out… or, maybe not. Everything depends on you and sudden whims of Pentaculus, a grim god stretching its hands out over the whole city.
Investigate and solve puzzles, while resisting dark and obscure grasp of Mariupolis, where the only things guarding you from its baneful influence are sarcasm and arrogance. And be aware – your hero might actually die.

1919546831.title: Circa Infinity
1919546831.short_description: Test your skills in this brain-melting platformer with an incredible pulse-pounding soundtrack.

1919580285.title: Poker Texas Holdem - Ultimate Poker Card Game
1919580285.short_description: 🎉 Play the ultimate Texas Hold’em experience! Outsmart opponents, win big, and enjoy endless rounds of fast-paced, addictive poker action. Stunning visuals, smart AI, and unlimited fun — are you ready to own the table? ♠️♣️.

1919656591.title: Story Tale Mania
1919656591.short_description: Story Tale Mania is a hilarious story app that will leave you laughing. Choose words to fill into blanks in a variety of stories. You can choose your own words for the story or quickly begin a new story using the "Shuffle" mode to automatically select words. A massive list of words are included to help you create the perfect story if you hit writer's block. You can also save your favorite stories to be viewed later. With over 35 stories and a vast number of words the stories never get old.

1919758296.title: Ra Ra BOOM
1919758296.short_description: Grab your pom-poms and gear up for 4-player co-op action with a modern twist! Ra Ra BOOM rockets you to a future Earth overrun by rogue AI. Battle waves of enemies and upgrade your ninja cheerleader’s skills as you beat ‘em up, shoot ‘em up, and smash through the chaos!

1919794986.title: DEADCRAFT Demo
1919794986.short_description: Farm the dead to stay alive.

1919800726.title: Maze Race Challenge
1919800726.short_description: Enjoy the thrill of racing other players through a 3d maze on your Windows 10 PC or Xbox.

1919821567.title: Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure
1919821567.short_description: Explore and gather resources. Farm the land, craft tools and gear, build your base or a cozy home - Ikonei Island is yours to discover! Befriend magical creatures and fight monsters with your friends or adventure solo!

1919839597.title: Overdriven Evolution
1919839597.short_description:
Destroy Huge Bosses, dodge thousand of bullets, and resolve quick puzzles with your powerful space battle ship!

Overdriven Evolution takes you on a challenging journey through the Kruuthian empire with an ever-changing, expertly crafted universe full of action.

The game proposes 7 Game Modes:

- STORY: 4 Difficulties: EASY · NORMAL · HARD · NIGHTMARE
- ARCADE: Can you beat the game with only a few continues?
- MANIC: Test your true arcade skills with no health bar.
- THE LINE: Use all your knowledge and mastery to keep enemies away from the red line.
- 10 CHALLENGES: Replay each stage with a specific goal.
- COLOR-REFLEX: Involving 56 new and improved Puzzle-Maps mixing match3 and shmup!
- BOSS-RUSH: Use everything you have as an expert pilot to beat all the bosses at once.

1919864396.title: Handball 21
1919864396.short_description: Experience the intensity of one of the most complete sports! With accurately reproduced handball motions, the most lifelike players and tactics management deeply integrated into the gameplay, this is the most realistic handball simulation ever made.

1919877006.title: Knight Arcade
1919877006.short_description: Knight Adventure is a 1-Bit style retro arcade game. In the game, you play as a knight and defeat the monster to escape the dungeon.

1920095215.title: HYPERWIRED - Demo
1920095215.short_description: Plug in, recharge, and survive a brutal roguelike space onslaught.

1920100939.title: car game simulator résurection
1920100939.short_description:
Jeu de voiture de course. Dans ce jeu votre objectif sera d'effectuer un maximum de tours, vous disposerez pour cela d'un délai. Passé celui-ci vous serez éliminé de la course.
Le jeu est inspiré des décors de gran turismo 1. L'histoire de revivre les sensations d'un bon jeu d'arcade à l'ancienne!

1920102037.title: Headbangers in Holiday Hell
1920102037.short_description: Twin Stick roguelite about rebelling against cheesy Christmas.

1920103625.title: Street Fighter™ 6 - Open Beta
1920103625.short_description:
A new era for fighting games begins!

The Open Beta of Street Fighter™ 6 allows players to experience certain game features in the Battle Hub.

Open Beta Schedule
Planned for May 19, 2023 (Fri) 12:00am PDT - May 22, 2023 (Mon) 12:00am PDT.

1920135375.title: Rhythm Doctor
1920135375.short_description: Save patients' lives in this rhythm game where you heal by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

1920167136.title: Layers of Fear (2023)
1920167136.short_description: The era-defining first-person psychological horror in all its terrifying glory. All of the game’s chapters collected into one convenient package that allows you to plumb the depths of madness in pursuit of artistic revelation.

1920198712.title: Xray Customs (Windows)
1920198712.short_description: Xray Customs is a puzzle game where you play as a customs inspector, scanning bags with an X-ray machine to find and remove prohibited items. It rewards sharp attention to detail with both relaxed and time-pressure modes, making the simple task of checking luggage engaging and addictive.

1920203007.title: Redout: Space Assault
1920203007.short_description: Redout: Space Assault is arcade space battle, coupling the trademark Redout adrenaline with the thrill of combat. Outsmart, outmanoeuvre, overpower, outclass your opponents in lightning-fast, adrenaline-inducing single-player space combat.

1920237746.title: FINAL FANTASY II
1920237746.short_description: The original FINAL FANTASY II comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

1920299402.title: Alien High
1920299402.short_description: Aliens have taken over your high school! In this interactive story role playing game hybrid, you must survive the onslaught as your school is attacked by alien forces.

1920423590.title: Ludo Masters Plus
1920423590.short_description: Ludo Masters Plus, A complete Ludo game simulation with many bot in different difficulty levels to challenge you. Play against another player in the 2 player mode and take turn to roll the dice . Tap on any of for player piece and tap again to move forward.

1920462610.title: Nine Witches: Family Disruption
1920462610.short_description: When an occult German WW2 division releases an ancient curse upon the world, a supernatural problem is going to require a supernatural solution. Take control of two playable heroes as they embark on a comedic, alternate-history adventure with a truly original story (99.9999% guaranteed).

1920490758.title: The Lost Legends of Redwall : The Scout
1920490758.short_description: A whimsical adventure game based on the bestselling Redwall™ books. Set in the winter shrouded wilderness between Lilygrove and Redwall™ Abbey, help Liam or Sophia race for help from the raiding rats under Scumsnout's command.

1920521666.title: Please Be Happy
1920521666.short_description: A yuri visual novel that will make you both laugh and cry. A story about love, trust, mortality, and about understanding not just how to be happy, but how to be human.

1920569754.title: FIVE NIGHTS WITH CREG XBOX EDITION
1920569754.short_description:
FIVE NIGHTS WITH CREG XBOX EDITION is a horror game where you have to escape from animatronics in single player and local multiplayer mode

Can you survive?

1920618447.title: Arietta of Spirits - Demo
1920618447.short_description:
Arietta of Spirits is a story-driven action-adventure game, following Arietta on her journey to unveil the mysteries of the Spirit Realm. Immerse yourself in a story filled with emotion and surprising turns.

Follow Arietta on her journey to unveil the mysteries of the Spirit Realm!

1920684170.title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles Demo
1920684170.short_description: Craft your own empire of fortresses and battlements atop lonely island peaks through a unique 3D building system. Build mighty and high as danger comes from the air in this open world of warbirds, dragons and airships.

1920745954.title: Aurion: Legacy of the Kori-Odan
1920745954.short_description: Play a powerful story-driven game with fun, action and dilemmas.

1920770735.title: Nicole
1920770735.short_description: Can you solve the mystery of the abductions on campus?

1920845520.title: Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore
1920845520.short_description: A NEW interactive animated adventure! In this action-adventure game, Arzette must explore the Kingdom of Faramore, slay fearsome foes, acquire powerful items, discover secrets, assist colorful characters, and defeat the evil Daimur!

1920884746.title: Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes (Xbox One)

1920996408.title: Age of Wonders 4
1920996408.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm of your own design! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn!

1921002071.title: Ticket to Ride: Classic Edition
1921002071.short_description:
CONNECT MORE THAN JUST CITIES

Set off with your friends and family to re(discover) Ticket to Ride, the classic boardgame. In this railway adventure, you’ll need to be the quickest to link up your cities and reach your destinations.

1921002833.title: Crossy Road Castle
1921002833.short_description:
Climb castles with the Crossy Road crew in this adventurous multiplayer arcade platformer.
 
Shoot out of cannons, ride rainbows, and make your way through a maze of never-ending levels. Bring your friends into the fray with co-op mode for even more chaotic fun!

1921109185.title: Say Cheese!
1921109185.short_description: Are you ready to overcome all the challenges and go in search of the cheese?

1921110273.title: Resident Evil Resistance Open Beta
1921110273.short_description: In this open beta, you can get an early taste of a new 1 vs 4 online multiplayer game set in the Resident Evil universe, where four Survivors face-off against a sinister Mastermind.

1921123976.title: Dream Park Story
1921123976.short_description: Create your own amusement park with a variety of rides, mascots, and activities!

1921146291.title: Beebo & Luna
1921146291.short_description:
Start a healing journey with Luna and Beebo on your desktop!
When you are with Luna and Beebo, the melody of time turns into the light of stars.
Change outfits for Luna and Beebo, decorate the warm Dream Oracle House, meet mysterious travelers and start an incredible adventure.
Every time you focus, you are writing a fantastic magic journey on the desktop.

1921177861.title: Marathon
1921177861.short_description: Explore the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV, scavenging valuable loot in a high-stakes survival first person shooter from the creators of Halo and Destiny.

1921196301.title: Drug Dealer Simulator 2
1921196301.short_description: Grow from a STREET DEALER to a CARTEL LORD in single-player or 3-player co-op.

1921312281.title: Glorious Savior
1921312281.short_description: An everlasting story about the hero's sword with animated 3D battles!

1921323700.title: KinnikuNeko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT - Demo
1921323700.short_description: Join KinnikuNeko, a cat with a bodybuilder's body, in this fun 2D platformer and fight against the mysterious alien invasion. A story full of goofy humor, friendship, drama and action. Its aesthetics are a love letter to 90s anime along with an unforgettable soundtrack.

1921366681.title: Gnomes Garden: Lost King
1921366681.short_description: Gnomes Garden - a fun fantasy strategy game about a world of gnomes. Save the king and return prosperity to the kingdom!

1921616586.title: Midnight Swamp
1921616586.short_description: Midnight Swamp is a dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of a mysterious swamp, where every corner hides a riddle.

1921797214.title: Draconic Resurgence
1921797214.short_description:
In the distant past, world was completely dominated by dragons. relentless creatures of unimaginable power that seemed to live for eternity. As the years passed, humanity challenged the dragons in a merciless war to overthrow their rule. Eventually humanity emerged victorious from this conflict. At least, that's what everyone believed. A few days ago, under the veil of night, a mysterious being attacked their village. Now it's up to you, a noble warrior, to rescue the captured villagers and eradicate the unknown creature.
Dragonic Resurgence is a metroidvania where you have to explore different locations, collect upgrades and fight different bosses.

1921854037.title: Air Combat Flight Sim
1921854037.short_description:
Do you like flight simulators?

This game is one of the most realistic war plane simulators and it is waiting for you!

Air dominance needs to be very advanced to complete challenging missions. But don't worry. In the first chapters, we will develop this ability and prepare you for challenging missions!

Come on buy it and have fun!

1921896806.title: Them Bombs
1921896806.short_description: A bomb has been planted in the most ridiculous place possible, and you're the only one who can disarm it. But you can't do it alone. You need your friend's help. Time is running out, and people's lives are at stake. Can you two handle the pressure and save the day?

1921935939.title: Synchro Hedgehogs
1921935939.short_description:
The puzzle platform game with two funny twins moving as one! 
Enjoy the 40 levels of original design! Your logical and platformer skills are required. Manage this active team of twins tied by your fingers! Where to go first?..
Platform skills are useful, but try to find a simple logical solution.

1922036527.title: Aaero2 Demo
1922036527.short_description:
Aaero2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed 2017 music-driven rail-shooter 'Aaero'. 

This demo version features 2 tracks, playable in both single player and local co-op modes. (Full release will include local and online co-op and PvP modes).

1922051626.title: The Dark Eye: Memoria
1922051626.short_description: In Memoria, players travel through different time periods, following two distinct protagonists: Sadja, a southern princess who wants to be a war hero, and Geron, a bird catcher who wants to lift a curse from his girlfriend.

1922125818.title: Dead Reset
1922125818.short_description:
Trapped in a terrifying deathloop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.

1922162357.title: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
1922162357.short_description: Mystery of Silence is a point-and-click adventure where William, a young writer in search of inspiration, enters an abbey shrouded in silence. What William finds within those walls is not just a story to tell, but a secret that should never be discovered.

1922166719.title: Penguin Flight: Beyond The Clouds
1922166719.short_description: He's back—bolder and ready to soar even higher!

1922223268.title: KINGDOM HEARTS Melody of Memory DEMO Version (Japan)
1922223268.short_description:
「キングダム ハーツ」シリーズ初のリズムアクションゲームの体験版。
※体験版では、FIELD BATTLE/4曲、ダブルプレイモード/2曲の全6曲をお楽しみいただくことができます。
（体験版では、セーブデータの保存は行いません。）.

1922283524.title: Goat Simulator 3: Xbox One Edition
1922283524.short_description:
Pilgor’s baaack! 

Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; an all-new, totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage as a team, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends anymore.

1922347891.title: Queen’s Garden: French Splendor
1922347891.short_description:
Aid Marigold and Florian in their efforts to bring these plants to life!

Welcome to Queen's Garden: French Splendor, where your green thumb meets your Match 3 puzzle-solving brain! 
Step into a world where gardens don't just need water – they need YOUR help! 
Surrounded by gorgeous French scenery, grow and expand your garden, complete Match 3 levels, and make this puzzling paradise truly your own!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 110 bonus levels to explore!
- A whole new garden to decorate!
- Power-ups that make your average garden gnome look boring!

1922370751.title: Dandy Ace Demo
1922370751.short_description: Dandy Ace is an over the top action game that follows this fabulous magician seeking to combine and use his magical cards, fighting and looting his way to defeat the Green-Eyed Illusionist and free himself from a cursed mirror. Play with Dandy Ace, the amazing hero, and survive the challenges of the extravagant, lavish and ever changing palace created to defeat him, filled with bizarre creatures and outrageous bosses. Find all precious cards, gather shards and gold, and get help from other imprisoned magicians that now work as shopkeepers or other jobs.

1922451592.title: King's Guard TD
1922451592.short_description: Your Highness, our kingdom is at risk. We’re facing great danger! Not only villagers, but also maidens, warriors, mages, ravens, bats, eagles and dragons are trying to destroy our empire. Guard your throne and stop them now!

1922470106.title: Stasis
1922470106.short_description:
The 2015 critically acclaimed sci-fi horror masterpiece is coming to Xbox!
In the distant future, aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft, John Maracheck awakes from stasis. 
He must push himself to new limits to unravel the mysteries around him.

1922567975.title: Jungle Shoot (Windows)
1922567975.short_description: Enter an unforgiving forest where every second counts. Fight waves of enemies in a frantic platformer based on precision, movement, and constant progression.

1922639286.title: Bag Hero
1922639286.short_description:
Blast through monster hordes with crazy weapons in a wild bullet hell! It’s chaotic, casual, and seriously fun!
Each run takes just 20–30 minutes — perfect for relaxing anytime! Whether you're unwinding after a long day or just killing time, it's a great way to de-stress.
Choose from 10 unique classes and 7 different weapons, then mix and match to create your own personalized combat style. Hidden classes and secret talents await discovery too!
Every playstyle offers a complete build path, with multiple branches and directions to explore.
Each stage comes with fully adjustable difficulty settings, so you'll always find the perfect level of challenge.

1922642750.title: Bay Breaker (Windows)
1922642750.short_description:
Get ready for an addictive and visually stunning experience with Bay Breaker!
Inspired by classic gameplay, it takes you on a journey across serene seascapes.

1922695178.title: PlateUp!
1922695178.short_description: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

1922741539.title: AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES
1922741539.short_description: In a near-future Tokyo, Special Agent Kaname Date is on the case of a mysterious serial killer. Date must investigate crime scenes as well as dreams on the hunt for clues.

1922758426.title: WRC 9 FIA World Rally Championship
1922758426.short_description: WRC is the leading off-road simulation franchise. It returns with even more realistic gameplay and more content than ever: 3 new rallies, 35 new special stages, creation of your own custom championships and completely redesigned engine sounds.

1922784782.title: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
1922784782.short_description: A new chapter in Whiskey Mafia story.

1922833847.title: Color Pals
1922833847.short_description:
Switch up your hue to navigate tricky maze-like platforming stages!

Welcome to the cute and satisfying world of Color Pals, where brainteasing puzzles meet simple single-screen platforming fun! 

Enjoy 50 stages of hue-based trickery as you take the role of a colored cube and navigate 2D maze-like levels to reach a portal on the far side. But be careful! You can only touch walls, floors, ceilings and platforms that match your current color.

Replay stages as many times as it takes, and freely replay cleared levels any time to improve your skills!

1922924876.title: Galaxy Shooter DX
1922924876.short_description:
Take your starship to fight! 
Cruise the Galaxy and shoot down formations of the evil Kraathu Empire.
Dodge the bullet hell and shoot ’em up!

1922993793.title: Jalopy
1922993793.short_description: Build, repair, refuel and drive a dilapidated old car on a grand journey through the territories of the former Eastern bloc.

1922994269.title: Linn: Path of Orchards
1922994269.short_description:
Step out of your conventional platforming habits and delve into the dynamic and rotating world of Linn, a modern puzzle platformer set in a fantastic and mysterious ancient world.

You are in control of Aban, an exotic guardian of nature, on her journey through a lost sky temple. Help Aban on her divine mission to rejuvenate the ancient Tree of Light.
Levels consist of treacherous dynamic platforms that make you rethink every move before you press any button. Completing each level needs both timely reactions and logical thinking.

1923017469.title: Adrian's Tale
1923017469.short_description:
Adrian's Tale is an action-adventure game where you control a little Hero.
You have to improve your skills in order to move further through the plot, solve puzzles, fight enemies using your sword, as well as additional weapons that you can select in your inventory.

1923029019.title: Freddy Spaghetti 2.0
1923029019.short_description: Scrumptious sequel 3D action gameplay like you’ve never eaten before!

1923085383.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Sudoku
1923085383.short_description: Sudoku is a puzzle in which you place numbers from 1 to 9 into a 9x9 grid, divided into horizontal and vertical lines and 3x3 blocks, filling up all of the spaces with the numbers. With everything from simple puzzles to super-difficult ones, this game is popular with a wide range of players, from beginners to veterans. Please enjoy this high-quality sudoku game.

1923105414.title: Morsels
1923105414.short_description: Morsels is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

1923160643.title: Dead Rising 3
1923160643.short_description: Anything and everything is a weapon in Dead Rising 3. Explore the zombie-infested city of Los Perdidos, and find a way to escape before a military strike wipes the entire city, and everyone in it, off the map. With intense action and an unmatched level of weapon and character customization, Dead Rising 3 delivers a heart-pounding experience unlike any other as you explore, scavenge and fight to survive in a massive open world on the brink of a zombie apocalypse.

1923234340.title: GRIME II
1923234340.short_description: Become the stealer of forms in GRIME II, a surreal action-adventure metroidvania. launch tendrils made of hands to absorb foes and summon molds in their shape, as you explore a bizarre lived-in-world obsessed with art.

1923246994.title: Deserted_SGD23
1923246994.short_description: Deserted is a stylized 3D action adventure with light RPG and narrative elements. Inspired by the alien atmosphere of Out Of This World, Deserted combines narrative storytelling with survival and fast paced strategic combat to deliver a thrilling adventure.

1923260943.title: Power of Ten
1923260943.short_description: Your starfighter against a bloodthirsty armada. Gather weapons, resources and upgrades to help you hold back the relentless tide and protect the galaxies civilians. If you don't succeed try again with a whole new galaxy!

1923279922.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
1923279922.short_description:
Digital download bonus:
- Social-Lord Outfit for Star-Lord (Early Unlock)

Fire up Star-Lord’s jet boots for a wild ride across the cosmos in this third-person action-adventure game, a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. With the unpredictable Guardians at your side, blast your way from one explosive situation to another, with original and iconic Marvel characters caught in a struggle for the fate of the universe. You got this. Probably.

1923294740.title: The Big Con
1923294740.short_description: Hustle your way across ‘90s America as a runaway teen con artist. Choose how to make your scratch as you don disguises, pick pockets, and rip people off in this comedic crime-filled adventure. Experience the totally rad '90s in all its plaid and payphone glory!

1923321130.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword DEMO
1923321130.short_description: Wield Oni Armament attacks and experience the varied swordplay action on offer in this demo that will see you face off against the formidable boss, Sasaki Ganryu.

1923419969.title: The Nameless City (Xbox Series X|S)
1923419969.short_description: Narrative-driven first person horror adventure inspired by Lovecraft's short novel "The Nameless City" (1921). Explore the ruins of a city that some say they are older than humanity itself. While you delve deeper into the ancient buildings, reality and visions blend into an indistinct haze.

1923444705.title: Zero Squares (Windows)
1923444705.short_description: Zero Squares is a minimalist puzzle game that challenges your logic and strategy. Move the colored squares into their matching slots and clear the board.

1923450235.title: Kung Fu Duel
1923450235.short_description: Unleash your inner fighter in Kung Fu Duel, the ultimate martial arts battle experience! Prepare yourself for intense arcade-style combat, packed with jaw-dropping animations, explosive special effects, and authentic fighting moves from around the world.Choose your champion and step onto the battleground for thrilling 1v1 duels, either against challenging AI opponents or in exciting local matches against your friends. Each fight will push your skills, speed, and strategic thinking to the absolute limit.Master powerful techniques inspired by Taekwondo, Muay Thai, Kung Fu, Boxing, and more, as you battle formidable opponents for martial arts supremacy.Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become a martial arts legend? With visually stunning graphics and adrenaline-charged action, Kung Fu Duel promises endless excitement and glory.Join the fight today and prove your strength!

1923495076.title: Concept Destruction
1923495076.short_description: Pick a car model and crash other concept cars to begin mass production!

1923839138.title: 270 Two Seventy US Election

There are many strategic elements to consider in this US Election. You'll have to target Geographic Groups, as well as Special Interest Groups, if your campaign is to be successful in accumulating Two Seventy (270) Electoral Votes.

270 - Two Seventy - Win the US Election.

1923839306.title: Wasteland 3 (PC)

Can you navigate the endless maze and escape before the darkness consumes you?

1924008745.title: Adrenaline Rampage

Shoot, match, and explode marbles before they breach your defenses!

1924867422.title: Air Hockey Strike 3D
1924867422.short_description:
Are you ready for the fastest, most realistic Air Hockey experience on Xbox and PC? Air Hockey Strike 3D brings the classic arcade excitement straight to your screen with fluid physics, vibrant visuals, and challenging gameplay!

Whether you are a casual player or a competitive striker, this game offers:

Realistic 3D Physics: Feel every hit and bounce with our finely tuned puck mechanics.

Challenging AI: Test your skills against 3 levels of difficulty. Can you beat the "Expert" mode?

Sleek Visuals: Play in beautifully designed environments with smooth 60 FPS performance.

Local Multiplayer: Challenge your friends and family on the same screen for ultimate bragging rights!

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls designed perfectly for both controllers and keyboards.

Step onto the table, grip your mallet, and show the world who the true champion is. Download Air Hockey Strike 3D now and start the strike!

1924963402.title: 90'' Soccer
1924963402.short_description:
Tackle! Dribble! Shot!... and Goal!. But do it fast, because you have only 90 seconds to win!

1924980861.title: Ball Race DEMO
1924980861.short_description:
A ball race against time or points, singly or with two people. Split screen mode.
Collect diamonds or stars for jumping ability and faster ball speed.

1925045069.title: Dungeons of Shalnor
1925045069.short_description:
"An Eye for Immortality… What a terrible price to pay for such a terrible curse!"

Dungeons of Shalnor is a tactical Roguelike game. It features a Turn-Based combat along with a "Turn the camera" mechanic that also turns all monsters and projectiles, causing interesting outcomes such as: Monsters walking into traps; or attacking one another.

There are many different types of monsters, and each move and behave differently in puzzle-like patterns.

Every time you die, your gold is transformed into Ghost Coins, which can be used to purchase permanent Upgrades in the Spirit Shop.

1925046583.title: Afterglitch Demo
1925046583.short_description: Afterglitch is an experimental third-person exploration sci-fi video game. The player is an astronaut whose multidimensional journey to find an extraterrestrial civilization is more important than the destination!

1925076302.title: Marathon Server Slam
1925076302.short_description: Take your first steps on Tau Ceti in Marathon's Server Slam from February 26 – March 2. Earn rewards for playing, including a unique emblem and background, plus loot rewards for launch.

1925131943.title: Q.U.B.E. 2 Ultimate Edition
1925131943.short_description: Includes ALL downloadable content for Q.U.B.E. 2: Classic Gloves, Lost Orbit, Aftermath. In Q.U.B.E. 2 you play as Amelia Cross, an archaeologist who has awoken among the ruins of an alien landscape. With the distant help of another survivor you must manipulate the structure of this mysterious world and find a way back home. As you explore and solve puzzles to progress, thought-provoking questions about your true purpose and the origins of the structure you are navigating will need to be considered, forcing you to come to terms with a devastating truth that will shake your world.

1925179516.title: Friday Night Funkin Memory Time
1925179516.short_description: An amazing memory game with beautiful graphics. Concentrate yourself and start to play. Enjoy!Xbox Controller Supported.

1925242158.title: Library Of Ruina
1925242158.short_description:
“May you find your book in this place.”

Become the owner of the Library and receive your guests.

Your librarians will fight for the Library.
Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage.
Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward.

A good book will allow you to invite new guests with greater secrets.
Amass a collection of books and explore the secrets of the City.

And eventually, get your hands on…
The one singular, perfect book.


[A Library Battle Simulation]

Library of Ruina is a game that uses the concept of a “Library Battle Simulation”.
You will invite guests to the Library and engage in combat with them to gain 'Books' with their stories.

Battles are played with the 'Librarians' and the 'Guests' using cards and dice.
You can plan against the guests’ moves by looking at the cards they will use and select the most optimal card to oppose them.

When combat begins, how the dice from your chosen card fall will determine victory or defeat in the struggle.
However, the outcome of the dice is not simply determined by pure luck.
Certain effects and variables will shift the outcome of the dice for and against your favor.

Be sure to carefully choose which cards you utilize to win the battle with your guests.
Behold the outcome of your choices and how luck unfolds as your librarians and guests skirmish.
You can go through an exhilarating experience, putting it all on the line with thrills just like betting.


[Conflicts that Build Emotion]

Confrontation in the Library is not just about killing your enemies, it is about heightening emotions.
The emotions of the librarians and guests rise as the battle progresses, and as it grows fiercer and comes to a head, they will surge.

Depending on your librarian's feelings, positive outcomes or powerful effects with penalties can occur.
In addition, as the emotional tension of the guests grows, the difficulty of combat increases, yet at the same time, rarer books can be acquired.
Furthermore, dialogue can appear depending on the situation of the battle and will make one’s viewing experience of the match unfolding even more enjoyable.


[Books Can Be Anything]

A guest who dies in the Library will turn into a book.
These books can be a librarian's body, materials to grow the Library, or new cards for battle.
You can also use books as the parts of an invitation to bring forth another guest.

Invite different guests to acquire various books, then utilize them accordingly.
How you make use of your collection to grow the Library is up to you.


[The Story of the City and the Library]

In Library of Ruina, you will be witness to the stories of Angela, the Sephirot, and Roland following the ending of Lobotomy Corporation.
You will also watch various events occurring around the huge city in which the Library is located.

Accumulate books to grow your Library and librarians, and invite more powerful guests to gain better books.
From lowly canards to urban legends and beyond...
Throughout the game, you will gradually become familiar with the story of the City.

May you find your book in this place….

1925317786.title: Dark Dungeon Mind Mess
1925317786.short_description:
As soon as the Knight takes his first step, darkness swallows his surroundings. Be brave, o Knight, and traverse the Dark Dungeon! Make your way into the light!

Dark Dungeon Mind Mess is a unique 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your memory and intuition. Grasp the layout of the level at the start, because as soon as you make your first move, almost the whole path ahead will turn pitch black!

Play through 50 mind-boggling dungeon rooms where you'll have to reach the end while navigating in the dark. The shadows hold even more danger: spike traps, falling blocks and pits that the Knight can jump over! Make sure to grab keys along the way to open locked doors and progress forward.

- Puzzle game designed to be fun for all ages
- Simple controls so you can focus on the puzzle: only directional inputs and a jump button
- Cozy low poly 3D graphics with gloomy aesthetics
- Atmospheric soundtrack for the right mood
- A particular puzzle is too difficult? You can skip it to keep the game going.

1925331421.title: Mechaconda
1925331421.short_description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while attaching weapons to your Mechaconda's body. A modern and intense reimagining of the classic Snake game with bullet hell and roguelike elements.

1925359573.title: APG Sudoku
1925359573.short_description: Solve classic Sudoku puzzles with a modern neon style. Train your brain and master logic challenges.

1925360122.title: Gex Trilogy
1925360122.short_description:
Exploding into the modern era like a pro wrestler from the top rope—it’s Gex! The fast-talking gecko who doesn’t want to sell you insurance! That’s right, the greatest gaming hero of the 1990s has returned for the 2020s through the raw, unbridled power of the Carbon Engine. 

Gex Trilogy reproduces all three original games in exacting detail, precisely the way you remember them. Assuming you’ve gone senile and remember them having high-definition native 16:9 widescreen visuals and fully analog controls. Which they didn’t. No, this is the Gex series the way it was meant to be played. The Man didn’t think you were ready back then. He kept this version locked away. But the moment has finally arrived. Down with The Man! Up with Gex! Gex Trilogy is Gex, the next-gen version. The Gex’t-gen version. The Gexiest version of all.

And just like the tightest red carpet attire on Oscar night, the Gex Trilogy is totally stuffed… with tons of bonus features, including a music player featuring every track from each game (even the tunes that are kind of annoying), a massive museum filled with key art, a collection of classic TV commercials for the media-addled idiots in the audience, and an all-new interview with the voice of Gex. 

That’s Gould, Jerry, Gould! (Dana Gould, to be precise.).

1925381775.title: OctaFight
1925381775.short_description: OctaFight is an explosive combat game. A tribute to good old couch multiplayer titles, offering intense and devastating versus matches. Move, jump, shield, throw and trigger your bomb on time to be the last in one piece!

1925393728.title: MyWhoosh
1925393728.short_description: MyWhoosh is a free-to-use online virtual cycling app that provides a fun, and social fitness experience for all. You can explore the extraordinary virtual world, improve your fitness and be a part of an engaging community from the comfort of your own home.

1925474144.title: RPGolf Legends
1925474144.short_description: Become the legend in this golf-action-adventure and save golf in the world!

1925552200.title: Warlock's Tower
1925552200.short_description: When a Warlock threatens the safety of the entire world, salvation must come by mail!

1925571425.title: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
1925571425.short_description: Play solo or with your hetero lifemate in this hand drawn, arcade style, side-scrolling beat-em-up blessed by Jay and Silent Bob themselves.

1925586579.title: Jump King
1925586579.short_description: Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming in Jump King! Struggle upwards in search of the Smoking Hot Babe of legend, but explore with care; a single missed jump could lead to a long fall back down...

1925609034.title: Mr. T-Shirt
1925609034.short_description: Help Mr. T-Shirt in a world of paper and doodles. Collect the key and move on to the next level, facing unique challenges in every stage!

1925706382.title: ATTACK OF THE KILLER FURRIES
1925706382.short_description: The sweet furries have gone mad and it's your time to defend the world against their fluffy fists. Shoot and slaughter your way thought hordes of cute little furries in this action packed FPS adventure. LET THE FURRY HUNT BEGIN!

1925947069.title: FARCRY 6

1926033091.title: A Time Traveller's Guide To Past Delicacies
1926033091.short_description:
A short game about a fictional time traveler raiding the past to steal recipes. 

Follow a sock puppet into the dark bowels of time and learn new recipes. Meet your long-dead ancestors. Exploit them to further your cooking skills. Take some pictures of dinosaurs. Appropriate what you can. 

This is an experimental story-driven adventure. Don't expect state-of-the-art cooking gameplay. Mostly, you will watch videos, cook some simple meals, trying to cope with things falling out of hand, and explore some strange places.

1926053898.title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 (Windows)
1926053898.short_description: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is a new era of the addictively unforgiving extraction shooter. In corrupted backwaters lost to history, fight back alone – or with friends – against timeless evil. Twisted monsters and other ruthless Hunters stand between you and your Bounty. Risk everything as Hunt consumes you.

1926154049.title: Wasteland Remastered
1926154049.short_description: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

1926157525.title: God of Light: Remastered
1926157525.short_description: God of Light: Remastered is a definitive version of the original award-winning game played by over 15 million people. The Remastered edition features all-new HD graphics, tailored light-physics controls and a remastered soundtrack by UNKLE.

1926182660.title: Redeemer - Enhanced Edition
1926182660.short_description: Redeemer: Enhanced Edition is a brutal close-quarters brawler. Punch, crush, shoot, and use the environment to destroy enemies. 1926246519.title: Cubey: Hexfall (Xbox One)
1926246519.short_description: Jump. Smash. Escape. In Cubey: Hexfall, every move matters shatter hexagonal blocks beneath you, grab every last coin, and unlock the gate to freedom. Just don’t leave anything behind.

1926276520.title: Demonic Supremacy
1926276520.short_description: Floor by floor to the top of the infernal tower!

1926303930.title: Darkestville Castle
1926303930.short_description:
Dear Potential servant of chaos,

Everything in Darkestville was just fine: I was tormenting the town people, the town people were being tormented… Who could complain? Not me, that’s for sure!

…until that moron, Dan Teapot, hired a group of demon hunters to banish me. I don’t even know why. Maybe I burnt his house a couple of times, but I only did it because it was hilarious!

Sincerely Evil,
Cid.

1926334123.title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
1926334123.short_description:
A legend is reborn and a new legacy begins.

YAKUZA KIWAMI 3
Continue the story of Kazuma Kiryu as he fights to protect those he cares about most in an extreme remake of Yakuza 3 that evolves every aspect of the beloved game. 

The bustling streets of Okinawa and Tokyo come to life in stunning detail with reimagined combat taking brutal brawling action to the next level. Added scenes deliver more depth and emotion to the beloved story with new and enhanced side experiences that immerse you in the world like never before, and more.

DARK TIES
Experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 in an included separate game. Having once led a successful startup company, he plunged himself into the dark world of the yakuza by choice after losing everything. Left with an empty heart, the pursuit to find true bonds drives him forward once again in a dramatic journey colored by exhilarating boxing-based combat, and a variety of engaging side experiences. 

Two men will walk different paths that converge to shake the very foundations of fate.

1926352092.title: PBA Pro Bowling
1926352092.short_description: Lace up your bowling shoes and experience the most realistic bowling simulation ever created with PBA Pro Bowling!

1926405394.title: Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle
1926405394.short_description: Become horror icon Jason Voorhees and stalk campers across 150+ levels in the most gruesome puzzle game ever! Solve murderlicious puzzles to rank-up and unlock new weapons and special attacks.

1926450768.title: Flora's World (XBOX SERIES)
1926450768.short_description: Help Flora save Flower Land! Jump, smash enemies with your hammer, and explore gardens filled with giant flowers, secrets, and challenges in a classic 2D platformer.

1926467835.short_description: Unique mix between classic space shooters and puzzle games where you drive a forklift that shoots boxes.

You must fight vigorously, strategize smartly, and lead an unexpected combination of Marvel Super Heroes to save the world from the rising darkness.

1926555180.title: Goat Out Of Hell (Xbox One)
1926555180.short_description: The Best Guardian Goat of the Underworld.
