1947656141.short_description: Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.

1947658323.title: Easter Bunny EggVenture
1947658323.short_description: Hop into Easter Bunny EggVenture, a charming spot-the-difference puzzle packed with bunnies, baskets, and colorful eggs! Test your eye in fast-paced Challenge Mode or relax in Casual Mode as you uncover clever hidden changes in cheerful spring scenes.

1947684112.title: Infinite Adventures
1947684112.short_description: Infinite Adventures is a dungeon crawling RPG inspired by classic dungeon RPGs; with fresh new mechanics for exploration, combat, and progression. You are the Traveler, a hero with a forgotten memory. Assemble your party and explore the Infinite Labyrinth to discover the truths of your past.

1947691593.title: Gold-Miner
1947691593.short_description:
Gold-Miner is a Windows Store and a Windows Phone store game where the goal is to collect all nuggets and diamonds in the level and avoid dynamites.
Enjoy playing.

1947725080.title: Skul: The Hero Slayer
1947725080.short_description:
Skul is a fast-paced action rogue-lite where losing your head is encouraged. Featuring 90 playable characters each with their own unique abilities and a ton of items that can create wild synergies, the battles are as electrifying as they are challenging.

The Demon King's Castle in Ruins
The human race attacking the Demon King's castle is nothing new and has happened countless times before. What makes this time different though, is that the Adventurers decided to join forces with the Imperial Army and the 'Hero of Caerleon' to lead a full onslaught in hopes of wiping out the Demons once and for all. They attacked the Demon stronghold with overwhelming numbers and succeeded in its total destruction. All of the demons in the castle were taken prisoner except for one lone skeleton named 'Skul'.

Side-Scrolling Platformer Action
'Skul: The Hero Slayer' is an action-platformer that boasts rogue-like features such as everchanging and challenging maps. It will keep you on your toes, as you will never know what to expect.

Tons of skulls, tons of playable characters
Skul is no ordinary skeleton. In addition to his formidable fighting skills, he can gain new and exciting abilities depending on which skull he's wearing. Use up to 2 skulls at a time, each of which has its own unique attack range, speed and power. Choose combos that match your playing style and switch them in the heat of battle to bring your enemies to their knees. The power is in your hands!

The Adventurers
Skul has crossed paths with a party of Adventurers! They are powerful foes that hunt Demons for sport. While Skul may be small, he still packs quite a punch. So just wait and see who really is the hunter and who is the hunted....

Bosses Corrupted by Dark Quartz
At the end of every chapter, go head-to-head with massive bosses corrupted with Dark Quartz and powerful beyond belief. Derived from the pain and hate of life itself, Dark Quartz taints and takes control of everything it touches.

1947752727.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection Trial Version
1947752727.short_description:
The third entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series is here!
Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate.

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series set in the Monster Hunter world, where you can become a Rider, raising and bonding with your favorite monsters.

1947806444.title: Goodwill Scrolls (Windows)
1947806444.short_description: Goodwill Scrolls is a challenging 2D platformer blending action, precision, and faith. Overcome traps, defeat enemies, and unlock scrolls of encouragement across 15 handcrafted levels. Test your skills in a journey of hope and perseverance!

1947900602.title: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth
1947900602.short_description:
EPIC EMOTIONAL DRAMA
Two larger-than-life heroes brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister…

Ichiban Kasuga, an unstoppable underdog who’s no stranger to crawling up from rock bottom, and Kazuma Kiryu, a broken man facing down his last days.

BEST-IN-CLASS RPG ACTION
Experience one-of-a-kind combat with dynamic, fast-paced RPG battles where the battlefield becomes your weapon, and anything goes. 

Adapt your party’s skills to the situation with outlandish jobs and customizations to strategically subdue enemies with over-the-top moves. 

INFINITE ADVENTURE
Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

Unforgettable moments await at every step of the journey with a unique mix of quests and activities to enjoy at your leisure.

1947911457.title: VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action

1947938436.title: Shotgun Farmers

1948002255.title: Cubey: Blockbyte
1948002255.short_description: Smash. Collect. Escape. In Cubey: Blockbyte, every jump counts, crush every block beneath you, grab every last coin, and unlock the gate to freedom. Just don’t leave anything behind.

* A - shoot
* Right Trigger - Barrel Roll

Fun facts:

* The voice acting (even the guys) was all done by the same person. Her name is Molly.

Thank you so much for taking the time to play! It means a lot.

1948763092.title: Stable Stories - Forest and Meadow Ride
1948763092.short_description:
Welcome to Stable Stories - Forest and Meadow Ride, the ultimate child-friendly riding and adventure game that sparks imagination and joy! Dive into a vibrant, cartoony open world where endless fun and exploration await.

Rebuild your dream farm, race against friends, and uncover hidden secrets as you journey through lush forests and peaceful meadows. Collect and care for a variety of horses, and if you're lucky, you might even unlock a magical unicorn to ride!

With seamless gameplay, charming graphics, and a world filled with surprises, Stable Stories is the perfect game for young adventurers and horse lovers alike. Whether you're competing in thrilling races or simply enjoying a relaxing ride through picturesque landscapes, every moment is an adventure.

Saddle up and let your story begin!

1949165391.title: Eyes: The Horror Game
1949165391.short_description: You’re alone, and no one will save you... this was your choice.

1949177747.title: Death Park
1949177747.short_description: Try to escape the furieous deadly clown in this scary horror game! 💀.

1949212446.title: Cat&Rabbit Pizza Farming
1949212446.short_description: Welcome to your new life as the only pizza farmer-baker around!

1949242128.title: SILENT HILL 2
1949242128.short_description: "My name...is Maria," the woman smiles, just like my late wife.

1949370509.title: Acre Crisis
1949370509.short_description: In 1992, following a series of mysterious deaths caused by wild animals, as well as strange sightings of cryptids in the sparsely populated and underdeveloped Amazon region of Acre, a special operations brigade from the Brazilian Military Police was sent to the area to gather intelligence. However, the situation took an unexpected turn for the soldiers, who soon found themselves cornered in the midst of a jungle infested with hungry dinosaurs.

1949420655.title: Scrap Divers
1949420655.short_description: Dive into an incredibly fast-paced and beautifully crafted retro runner!

1949426934.title: AVICII Invector
1949426934.short_description:
Soar through vocal melodies, sweep each fade and attack every beat in 25 of AVICII’s biggest hits, in this enthralling futuristic rhythm-action experience – AVICII Invector.

Fly solo or bring the pulse-pounding frenetic energy of an AVICII concert to your living room with your friends in competitive gameplay.

1949461717.title: Back 4 Blood: Open Beta
1949461717.short_description: Back 4 Blood is a thrilling cooperative first-person shooter from the creators of the critically acclaimed Left 4 Dead franchise. Play the Open Beta and experience intense four-player co-op, competitive multiplayer as human or Ridden, and frenetic gameplay that keeps you in the action.

1949492588.title: Paradise Lost
1949492588.short_description: It's winter, 1980. Szymon, a boy raised in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, finds an abandoned Nazi bunker. Will he find what he’s looking for? Play Paradise Lost and explore an underground world, where Slavic mythology mixes with retrofuturistic technology. Discover the last story on Earth.

1949522443.title: Etherborn
1949522443.short_description: Delve into an environmental puzzle platformer built on exploring and understanding gravity-shifting structures. You are a voiceless being that has just been born into a world where a bodiless voice awaits your arrival. Go forth and seek your purpose.

1949523812.title: Override 2: Super Mech League
1949523812.short_description: The gigantic robot brawler is Mech-ing a super-charged comeback in Override 2: Super Mech League! Fight in Mech Leagues and soar to new heights, aiming to be the best mech pilot. Pick your playstyle across match types including 1v1, 2v2, free-for-all and several games such as Xenoswarm, King of the Hill and more. Unlock a slew of cosmetics and attachments for your mech of choice in the Garage.

1949530651.title: Tinytopia
1949530651.short_description: Construct charming toy towns and cities atop tiny terrain. Combine building blocks to create new megastructures. Test your skills in the physics-based Challenge stages or simply unwind and obliterate everything with an array of cute catastrophes!

1949535961.title: Peepaw's Farm
1949535961.short_description:
Peepaw's Farm is the ULTIMATE way to experience life as a farmer that hates farming. Get your hands dirty, feed your ungrateful pig, and grab your eggplant - all in a day's work.

BITE-SIZED
Enjoy the 10-minute story when it fits your day.

HARD MODE
Finishing the story is easy - Prove you're a mastermind by completing all of the challenges in ONE playthrough.

1949641254.title: TerraTech Legion
1949641254.short_description: TerraTech Legion, a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Build the ultimate battle vehicle block by block and survive waves of robotic foes, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

1949662682.title: The Beast Inside (Console Version)
1949662682.short_description: The Beast Inside is a unique, gripping twist on thriller and survival horror. Immerse in the story of long-buried secrets, personal tragedies, and madness. Play as two protagonists bounded by dark heritage. Combat the enemies, solve riddles and experience real terror in the 3D-scanned environment.

1949676485.title: Feudal Bros - Tonosama 1
1949676485.short_description: 16-bit classic comes to the West for the first time.

1949676989.title: Tanknarok
1949676989.short_description: TANKNAROK is a high speed, frenzied blastathon where 2-4 tanks go head to head in a wide range of arenas; filled to the brim with huge guns, powerful explosions and dangerous hazards! Wholesome roughhousing with either your friends at home, or friendly strangers on the internet!

1949704395.title: Green Hell Xbox Series X|S
1949704395.short_description: GREEN HELL is an Open World Survival Simulator set in the unique and uncharted setting of the Amazonian rainforest. Survive on your own, or try your chances in an up-to-4-player online co-op mode.

1949737492.title: Mans & Mighties
1949737492.short_description: Mans & Mighties is a free top-down-shooter where you play as a gun who uses humans to fight knives.

1949756621.title: Surgeon Simulator 2
1949756621.short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

1949782736.title: Plunder Panic Demo
1949782736.short_description: Plunder Panic is a team-based pirate fighting game for up to 12 local or online players! Work with your crew to steal treasure, defeat the enemy captain, or sink their ship. The first team to capture an objective wins the battle!

1949817329.title: Offroad master
1949817329.short_description: Be the off road master. Play this game for free.

1949954232.title: Stereo Aereo
1949954232.short_description: Stereo Aereo is an action rhythm game that is inspired by the pop-culture influences of the 80's. You, the player, have to make sure that the mediocre space rockband Stereo Aereo, gets to their life changing concert, on time, in this comic styled sci-fi game. You will face extraordinary situations in which you'll need to make use of your innate sense of musical rhythm. Overcome Stereo Aereo's challenges by avoiding police, escaping prison, battle hordes of space mobsters, and face of the Queen of the space dump, in order to reach your 5 minutes of fame.

1950004384.title: Magin: The Rat Project Stories
1950004384.short_description: Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler. The branching plot, comic book aesthetic, full voice-over, and game mechanics are tightly intertwined in a unique, dark fantasy world.

1950032989.title: Athenian Rhapsody
1950032989.short_description: ARE YOU READY FOR THE CRAZIEST GAME EVER? Forge your own zany story and explore the world of Athens in this one-of-a-kind, fast-paced, wacky comedy RPG!

1950164627.title: Antstream Arcade - Annual
1950164627.short_description: Play over 1300 classic retro games, participate in global tournaments, get gold in mini-game challenges, have fun playing couch co-op, and challenge the community to beat your high scores.

1950200874.title: Desvelado
1950200874.short_description: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platformer!

1950263247.title: Mixtape
1950263247.short_description:
Mixtape - Nothing but the hits. 
On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

1950272122.title: Hellpoint
1950272122.short_description: Hellpoint is an intense action RPG taking place on Irid Novo, a derelict space station soaked in an intoxicating dark sci fi atmosphere. Fight dreadful creatures, face the Cosmic Gods and unravel their twisted story. Should the challenge be too great, play with a friend in local or online coop.

1950365703.title: NeverAwake
1950365703.short_description:
A girl who never wakes up. She has been fighting monsters in her dreams...
"NeverAwake" is a nightmarish twin-stick shooter with a unique worldview and original game rules.

1950367076.title: In rays of the Light (Xbox Series X|S)
1950367076.short_description:
New game from the developer of "7th Sector" Sergey Noskov.

There is only you, the abandoned remains of a former life and the flourishing nature that feels great in the absence of man. This world is both gloomy and empty, but so incredibly beautiful.

1950416460.title: Colorful Boi
1950416460.short_description:
Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled journey like no other with Colorful Boi! This captivating platformer boasts 63 levels of intense gameplay, filled with treacherous traps.

Colorful Boi will push your skills to the limit and deliver an unforgettable gaming experience.

Are you ready to conquer all the challenges and become the ultimate platforming champion? Jump into the vibrant world of Colorful Boi now!

With a LEADERBOARD.

1950484406.title: Ugly
1950484406.short_description: Unravel the dark secrets hidden throughout this stirring puzzle platformer about a tormented nobleman confronting the traumas of his past. Use an innovative mirror mechanic to solve challenging puzzle rooms and defeat towering bosses as you strive to piece together the ugly truth.

1950602651.title: Surgeon Simulator 2
1950602651.short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ solo or play as 4 friends online in this physics-based surgery sim with ludicrous competitive and coop play, plus an awesome builder mode. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

1950684748.title: SAND LAND Demo
1950684748.short_description:
Experience exciting vehicle action and exploration through a partial area of the Sand Land map in this explosive demo!

In this Action RPG, you will become the main character, Beelzebub. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of SAND LAND developed by the creator of Dragon Ball & Dr. Slump, Akira Toriyama.

1950703681.title: Slitterhead Demo
1950703681.short_description:
"I must eliminate them...ALL..."
The bodiless "Hyoki" hunts down the brain-devouring "Slitterheads", lurking in the alleys of a neon-lit city

Set in the densely cluttered streets of "Kowlong," filled with obscurity and chaos, this battle action-adventure game casts players as the "Hyoki," an entity devoid of memory and physical form. His only motive is to eradicate the monstrous beings known as "Slitterheads" crawling around the city, disguising themselves as humans.
Roaming the vibrant neon-lit cityscape, players must seek out allies among humans known as "Rarities," infiltrate and track dangerous organizations, and engage in battles harnessing the power of blood. As the suspenseful drama unfolds, delve into the mystery behind Hyoki's existence and the appearance of the Slitterheads.

1950717553.title: Hood: Outlaws & Legends
1950717553.short_description: In a violent, medieval world, outplay rival gangs in intense PvPvE multiplayer heists. Moving in stealth to steal treasures unseen or dominating through loud and brutal combat, only the best will escape with hard-earned riches.

1950723029.title: NAIAD
1950723029.short_description: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist, and colorful exploration adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. Enjoy a wholesome experience with an original and dreamy visual style.

1950827622.title: Treasure Stack
1950827622.short_description: Catering to solo and multiplayer puzzle fans, Treasure Stack features a wide variety of modes, whether you're testing your skills in Solo Play, partying up with friends in 4-Player Local Party, or taking on the rest of the world in Online Play.

1950881463.title: Bum Simulator
1950881463.short_description: Bum Simulator is a sandbox game bursting with inappropriate humor and memorable characters. You live on the streets of Bumsville. Do you have what it takes to adapt, survive and become an urban legend?

1950909933.title: Castle of Monsters: The Last Knight (Windows)
1950909933.short_description: The Last Knight is a 2.5D voxel-based sidescroller blending fast combat, strategic platforming, and dark fantasy. Play as the Last Knight, the final warrior able to reclaim a fallen kingdom. Wield a magical sword, face relentless enemies, dodge deadly traps, and uncover the castle’s secrets. With striking voxel visuals and a classic side-scrolling feel, this epic journey delivers retro-inspired action with modern polish. Will you restore the kingdom or be consumed by its horrors?

1950999790.title: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree Demo
1950999790.short_description: In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

1951040150.title: Submerged
1951040150.short_description: Submerged is a third-person combat-free game in which you explore a mysterious flooded city and discover the beauty of desolation in vast outdoor environments. You take on the role of Miku, a young girl who has brought her wounded brother to the city in their small fishing boat.

1951058598.title: Weapon of Choice DX
1951058598.short_description: Weapon of Choice is a high-energy, side-scroller with unique playable characters each with their own super weapon!

1951062281.title: Red Cape Knight (Windows)
1951062281.short_description: Help the Knight save the castle from dangerous creatures.

1951151775.title: Vicious Attack Llama Apocalypse
1951151775.short_description: The world's best mass llama-slaughter roguelike-lite-ish couch co-op top-down twin-stick shooter!

1951158296.title: Rune Factory 4 Special - Windows Edition
1951158296.short_description: Journey to the vibrant world of Rune Factory and experience the legendary fantasy farming adventure like never before!

1951168085.title: Teller's Duty
1951168085.short_description: In 1980, you land a teller job at Kertasia Bank thanks to your distant uncle. But the bank follows bizarre rules set by a foolish government. Face strict policies, tough customers, and moral choices while saving for your mom’s medical bills. Your fate is in your hands.

1951198596.title: NBA THE RUN
1951198596.short_description: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN.

1951263739.title: Bottle: Pilgrim Redux
1951263739.short_description: Bottle: Pilgrim is a story of loss, regret and redemption, which reminds us that while we cannot change the things we have done, we can always learn from our mistakes.

1951298086.title: Dead End Job
1951298086.short_description: Dead End Job sends you into a madcap, whacky world to bust up ghosts. It’s a procedurally generated, couch co-op, twin-stick shooter that straps a vacuum pack to your back, and puts a plasma blaster in your hand. For you, it’s just another day in the office.

1951334210.title: SokoPenguin
1951334210.short_description:
Wear hats and slide blocks as you take the role of a puzzle-solving penguin!

A chill puzzle adventure awaits in SokoPenguin, a top-down pixel art block-sliding game where you take the role of a cute penguin and overcome a wide variety of single-screen challenges to help him reach his igloo! Master 100 levels of gradually increasing complexity as you slide power blocks onto their corresponding switches to power a drawbridge, then proceed to the goal!

Enjoy relaxing tunes as you figure out how to move the blocks and slide crates or other obstacles away and retry levels as many times as it takes the get the penguin back home!

1951335572.title: Whiskey Mafia: Frank's Story
1951335572.short_description: Whiskey Mafia: Frank's Story is the new chapter of an ambitious crime story set in New York City in the mid 1920s.

1951375424.title: Together We Live
1951375424.short_description: To atone for the sins of humanity, the girl continues to die.

1951384495.title: Little Bear (Windows)
1951384495.short_description: Venture into a fantasy world in search of honey for your family.

1951420731.title: Street Race Kings - Xbox Series S | X
1951420731.short_description: You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Multiple vehicles, customization, open world maps, and more!

1951599694.title: Rabbit Raid (Xbox Series X|S)
1951599694.short_description: Save your family by going on an adventure as a cute bunny. Collect berries, find secrets with bonuses, throw objects at enemies or jump on them to win. Find secret stars and change costumes. Defeat the bosses and get to the last one to save the little rabbits from captivity. Explore green fields, caves, rivers, snowy mountains, icy lakes, deserts and ruins.

1951643252.title: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia - Demo
1951643252.short_description:
Will you be able to follow the rhythm… or fall victim to the cursed dance?

A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo.

Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions! 

A Fast-Paced 2D Platformer
Journey through four vibrant worlds in this high-energy platformer!
From the colourful jungle to the bustling city, find the clues to the Mummy Queen's hideout. Take on increasingly more intense challenges leading to the ultimate showdown against the Mummy Queen. 

3 Marsupilamis, 3 Abilities
Master the unique abilities of each Marsupilami. Switch characters to soar through the air, punch enemies, or leap across obstacles, and explore the different levels' secrets. Choose your Marsupilami wisely, and you might uncover a hidden level!

Experience the Adventure Together in Local Co-Op
Play the adventure with a friend or on your own and take on the Battle Dojos' challenges and the competitive minigames designed for friendly rivalries.

Dive Into a Vibrant, Colourful Universe Faithful to the Marsupilami Licence
Explore unforgettable environments, face memorable bosses, and uncover hidden levels, all set within a fast-paced, fun atmosphere for the whole family.

1951675244.title: DJMAX RESPECT V
1951675244.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V is the latest installment from the creators of the critically acclaimed rhythm game franchise ‘DJMAX.’ Experience tracks from popular artists such as Marshmello, Porter Robinson, and Yukika, exclusive Full HD Music Videos, online multiplayer, new game modes, and more!

1951695836.title: Darts Grand Slam
1951695836.short_description:
Darts Grand Slam is a Windows Store and a Windows Phone game where you play the very popular Darts game.
Hit the center of the target with all of the seven arrows and beat the record. Try to be accurate as legends like Eric Bristow, Phil Taylor, John Part, Eric Bristow, Raymond van Barneveld.
Can be played by many players.
Enjoy playing and keep hitting.

1951821095.title: Cities: Skylines II
1951821095.short_description: Raise a city from the ground up and transform it into a thriving metropolis with the most realistic city builder ever. Push your creativity and problem-solving to build on a scale you've never experienced. With deep simulation and a living economy, this is world-building without limits.

1951858060.title: Vosaria: Lair of the Forgotten
1951858060.short_description:
A pump-action 2D side-scrolling game with different enemy types. Along with a jump-to-the-roof mechanic that spices up the combat.
Avoid traps, survive enemy encounters, and upgrade your weapons and gear to overcome the challenges.

Deep beneath the surface, in a dark and ominous lair, dwell the horrifying creatures known as the Vosari. Out of fear of their emergence, the Armada has sent a squadron of marines to clear out the lair. However, none have returned from the dangerous mission.
In this thrilling adventure, you play as a brave scout who is tasked with the dangerous mission of delving deep into the Vosari lair to discover the whereabouts of the missing marines. As you explore the treacherous depths of the lair, you will face many encounters with the vicious Vosari.
To overcome the challenges, you must be resourceful and find weapons and upgrades that will improve your chances of survival. Keep in mind that the Vosari are relentless and formidable opponents, and the success of your mission depends on your skills and bravery. Good luck!

- Find Weapons left behind by the missing Marines.
- Enhance your guns with Alt-Fire upgrades.
- Discover hidden secrets stashed with equipment.
- Gravity-belt that allows you to walk on the roof.

1951916716.title: Deponia
1951916716.short_description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence. He is part of the lowest social class, doomed to live his life in literal mountains of trash. He hopes for an opportunity to get into the world of the rich, who live in a floating city high above the clouds.

1952008648.title: Yaga
1952008648.short_description: Smash, clobber and bash the murderous legends of Slavic mythology in this darkly funny action role-playing game that changes every time you play. Play as Ivan, a one-handed blacksmith with incredibly bad luck, who must take on the impossible tasks given to him by the tzar. All the while the mysterious witch, Baba Yaga, watches over Ivan’s fate.

1952170881.title: Two Strikes
1952170881.short_description:
Experience the electrifying rush of life-or-death duels in a heartbeat!

Dive into Two Strikes, a casual 2D fighting saga adorned with mesmerizing hand-drawn animations, whisking you away to a fierce epoch in Japan, where every stroke of the blade could spell doom or glory.

Position yourself wisely; every move could be your last.

Dart around to close in or evade assaults, seizing the opportunity when foes are within your weapon's grasp!

Striking decisively is your path to triumph, yet tread carefully as predictable moves are easily thwarted.

Outwit adversaries by masking your intentions, feigning attacks with nimble dashes.

And when victory is within sight, unleash devastating strikes to claim your honor!

1952187404.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos - Demo
1952187404.short_description: Hunted by mercenaries of an enemy with untold power, the fighter Pseudo and the creature under his protection begin a perilous quest to the edges of strange lands.

1952233261.title: Mongo Dash
1952233261.short_description:
From the maker of Mongo Madness comes an all new 32 level Mongo auto running adventure - Mongo Dash!

Mongo Dash is different from the original Mongo Madness platform game in that Mongo automatically runs forward. All you have to do is make him jump, allowing you to play the game with only one hand!

Collect coins, defeat bad guys, unlock new worlds, and save the princess. Everything you need for an epic run and jump adventure is here. The first three worlds are completely free!

Mongo Dash can be played using touch, a gamepad (including xbox 360 and xbox one controllers), or a keyboard.

1952256197.title: F1 2020
1952256197.short_description: F1® 2020 allows you to create your F1® team for the very first time and race alongside the official teams and drivers. Alternatively, challenge your friends in new split-screen with casual race options for more relaxed racing. Compete on 22 circuits, with current and classic content.

1952293824.title: Flutter Bombs
1952293824.short_description: Experience nature’s wrath in this top down twin stick shooter. Command up to 10 different wing sets each with a unique bombing tactic. Unleash fury with powerful weapon upgrades. Defend your grove with Flutter Bombs!

1952300170.title: Battlefield™ 2042 Xbox One
1952300170.short_description: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

1952333239.title: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
1952333239.short_description: Lead Finnish forces against an overwhelming threat through the Winter War.

1952343997.title: ShapeWorld: Origins
1952343997.short_description: You are a Square who lived in a village with other Squares, One day the village was attacked by the Circles, you with other friend survived and your main goal is to find the boss of the Circles and kill him.

1952405093.title: Ellphaser
1952405093.short_description: An elephant, precise jumps, and a world that changes with every leap!

1952427486.title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night
1952427486.short_description:
Igavania Returns!

Play as Miriam, an orphan scarred by an alchemist's curse which slowly crystallizes her body. To save humanity, and herself in the process, she must fight through the castle and defeat the summoner, Gebel.

1952431977.title: Project Snaqe
1952431977.short_description:
Project SNAQE is an action and precision game inspired by the classic Snake.

The game has 3 different modes with progressive difficulty levels, in addition to the classic mode that harks back to the traditional Snake gameplay. Project SNAQE promises a great experience for all types of gamers, from casual to hardcore.

A simple game at first glance, Project SNAQE is charming and challenging and will put your reflexes, reasoning and solution-finding skills to the test.

1952596537.title: STONKS-9800: Stock Market Simulator (Demo)
1952596537.short_description: A simulator of a businessman on the Japanese stock market in the 80s and 90s. Chill, catch a retro vibe, and watch your profits grow in the text-based game STONKS-9800.

1952634707.title: Pirates on Target
1952634707.short_description: Pulverize pirates with powerful cannons in this puzzle game.

1952793430.title: Unsolved Case: Above the Law CE Xbox
1952793430.short_description: Nothing brings people together as well as a common grief... or crime!

1952805019.title: Save Your Nuts DEMO
1952805019.short_description: Go nuts in this insane 1 to 8 players chaotic arena party game. Put your cooperation skills to the test over intense physics-based battles mixing casual offline modes and competitive matches.

1952847171.title: Basket and Ball
1952847171.short_description:
Tap the jump button to bounce the living ball as if you are dribbling it! 
Use gamepad or virtual joystick controls to lead the stray ball to the basket! 
Perform crazy acrobatic stunts, test your throwing aim, and solve physics puzzles to complete levels! 
Use the time stopping bonus to get out of difficult situations. 
Convert yourself to stone to withstand nails, pump yourself up to jump higher, and even change gravity to reach impossible spots. 
Avoid robotic police and fire traps, jump over spikes, dive into water and propel yourself with explosions on 50 levels of crazy fun! Watch out for the aliens in UFOs trying to abduct you for their evil experiments! 
Compete with your friends on leaderboards in the star collecting challenge.

Basket & Ball offers two types of gameplay:
The first one is a classical arcade mode with virtual joystick controls. You will have to show some agility and timing precision in order to successfully complete the levels. But to really stand out in the high score charts you will have to collect the stars scattered across the basketball court, often in places seemingly impossible to reach. Bonuses like air pump, gravity shift, or time stop will come in handy. Every 3 or so levels a different gameplay is offered. You will have to launch the ball with carefully chosen speed and direction like in many other basketball throwing games! These levels are called "shootout challenges", and the basketball court will contain 3 stars to collect. The stars will be counted only if you deliver them into the basket. Collect all 3 stars and you win immediately. Otherwise, you must get at least one score out of 3 shots to pass the challenge.

Enjoy playing.

1952945858.title: Hello Engineer Demo
1952945858.short_description: Challenge your creepy Neighbor and his mechanical creations!

1952949687.title: Happi Basudei (for Windows 10)
1952949687.short_description: Oldschool platformer which you found on an untitled random cartridge, where you win by doing nothing. Well... except evading.

1952969635.title: Party Hard 2
1952969635.short_description: It's 3am and you just want to get some sleep. Welcome back to Party Hard! Stop parties using hundreds of new ways, incidentally destroy a drug syndicate, and save the Earth from an alien invasion. May the chickens be with you!

1953030770.title: Gang Wars Online
1953030770.short_description:
🔥 Key Features
Precision Headshots
Experience realistic combat with rewarding headshot mechanics that demand skill and accuracy.
Competitive Tournaments
Join intense online tournaments and compete against players worldwide for top rankings and rewards.
Kill Streak System
Build unstoppable momentum with powerful kill streak bonuses that give you a tactical advantage in battle.
Army Backup System (Army on Call)
Call in AI-controlled allies during combat to support your strategy and dominate the battlefield.
Unlimited Weapons & Customization
Access a massive arsenal of guns, skins, and upgrades with no limits—play your way.
Advanced Combat Actions
Perform smooth, realistic movements including dodge, roll, sprint, cover, and tactical shooting.
Dual Perspective Gameplay
Seamlessly switch between First-Person (FPS) and Third-Person (TPS) modes for a dynamic combat experience.

1953035485.title: Green Soldiers Heroes (Windows)
1953035485.short_description: You are one of the Green Soldiers. Defeat the enemies of the Desert region.

1953182469.title: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
1953182469.short_description: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience. You are the Luminary, a hunted Hero who must uncover the mystery of his fate with the aid of a charismatic band of adventurers.

1953214135.title: Crash Team Rumble™ Closed Beta
1953214135.short_description:
Be one of the first to experience an all-new Spin on Crash when the Closed Beta launches April 20th - April 24th*.

Crash Team Rumble™ takes Crash Bandicoot™ in a brand new direction, placing the series’ iconic heroes and villains into a 4v4 team-based competition.

1953289286.title: CROSSBOW: Bloodnight
1953289286.short_description: Hunt. Die. Hunt again. Master the frantic arena FPS set in a world of horror!

1953308421.title: Egglien
1953308421.short_description: Shoot eggs down to fly up in this speedy action platformer!

1953378897.title: Racing Champions
1953378897.short_description: Aim for the podium in the ultimate racing challenge!

1953382311.title: Metro Redux
1953382311.short_description:
Experience two of the finest story-driven shooters of all time: Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light, now remastered for the Xbox One.

Newcomers will experience an epic post-apocalyptic adventure combining thrilling survival horror, combat and stealth, while fans will discover the unique world of Metro transformed with incredible next generation quality.

1953391836.title: Shadowrun Returns
1953391836.short_description: The unique cyberpunk-meets-fantasy world of Shadowrun has gained a huge cult following since its creation over 30 years ago. Return to the world of Shadowrun, with this cult-classic turn-based tactical RPG finally ported to consoles.

1953444097.title: Black Book
1953444097.short_description: “Black Book” is a dark RPG Adventure, based on Slavic myths, in which you play as a young sorceress. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures.

1953589006.title: Yakuza 0
1953589006.short_description: The glitz, glamor, and unbridled decadence of the 80s are back in Yakuza 0. Fight your way through Tokyo and Osaka with protagonist Kazuma Kiryu and series regular Goro Majima.

1953593267.title: Parking World
1953593267.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own lucrative parking enterprise in this management sim. Parking World puts the power to build your perfect parking garage at your fingertips while solving everybody else's parking problems in unique narrative scenarios or without any objectives in freeplay mode.

1953680472.title: Lithium Inmate 39 Relapsed Edition
1953680472.short_description:
A survival horror game where you solve many puzzles, lure enemies into deadly and bloody traps and try to escape running away from twisted monsters chasing you in the dark. 

Inmate 39 is a harmless little creature trapped in a horrific world his mid has created. You must help him escape this traumatic reality by collecting clues and putting the pieces of his life together. 

From time to time Inmate 39’s alter ego, a deadly creature, will come to his aid, destroying everything in his path. Playing as the helpless and small Inmate and switching to the big deadly ally will present a fun and interesting gameplay experience.

1953690296.title: 35MM
1953690296.short_description: Post-apocalyptic story about two travelers who set out on a long journey in the wasteland, left by people after the pandemic. The disaster destroyed much of the world's population, the infrastructure went wrong and the common life remained only in memories. The times when a human has adapted the environment for himself have end and now, in order to survive, he will have to adapt to changes. You will have to play the character whose path runs through the deserted towns and cities in Russia, fields and forests of a vast country and even a secret underground facility. Who are we, where are we from and where do we go – we will be lucky to know it only at the end!

1953716215.title: Dungeonloop
1953716215.short_description: Dungeonloop is a turn-based roguelite where every run plays out differently. Move and act on a grid, battle unpredictable enemies, collect powerful artifacts, and adapt your strategy as random encounters shape your path. Explore three distinct locations - each with its own atmosphere and boss - and build unique loadouts as you fight deeper into the loop.

1953728881.title: John Fart : Text-iverse of Crazyness
1953728881.short_description: Play as John Fart and travel through time to stop mutant bees from causing the bee-pocalypses. But for this mega triga giga epic quest you will need some help... Thankfully you can somehow go inside books using a something called a “Bookalitoo” and recruit help. Using your big farting brain you of course decide to recruit a stupid cartoon bear.

1953745880.title: Roboquest
1953745880.short_description: Roboquest is a fast-paced FPS Roguelite, playable in solo or 2-player co-op. Jump into the steel shoes of a high-powered, hyper-mobile robot and fight like you’ve never fought before.

1953800252.title: Colorful Boi Series X|S
1953800252.short_description:
Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled journey like no other with Colorful Boi! This captivating platformer boasts 63 levels of intense gameplay, filled with treacherous traps.

Colorful Boi will push your skills to the limit and deliver an unforgettable gaming experience.

Are you ready to conquer all the challenges and become the ultimate platforming champion? Jump into the vibrant world of Colorful Boi now!

With a LEADERBOARD.

1953976878.title: Metal Black™ S-Tribute
1953976878.short_description: Collect NEWALONE to level up your beam, then release energy! The home console version of the incredible side-scrolling shooter Metal Black is back with online rankings. Two players can play together!

1954000337.title: Leo: The Firefighter Cat
1954000337.short_description: Leo The Firefighter Cat is a 3D action/adventure game featuring the cutest animal in the world : a cat! Help Leo by saving Feliopolis and the kitties from danger in 20 exciting firefighter missions.

1954010860.title: Knock on the Coffin Lid
1954010860.short_description: Investigate your own death, find ways to break free from a time loop, choose a hero who will ascend to the throne and rule the Northern gate! The fates of whole nations of the land of Midian depend on your choices.

1954227024.title: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS
1954227024.short_description: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS is a 1-on-7 online asymmetrical action game where a team of 7 ordinary citizens tries to survive the Raider (a classic DRAGON BALL rival such as Cell, Frieza, and Buu), who will hunt and evolve into an unstoppable force. Escaping won’t be so easy!

1954250236.title: Cooking Companions
1954250236.short_description: Deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains, supplies dwindle and flood waters are rising. It’s up to you to keep spirits high. Will you butter up the right person? Or will you wind up on the chopping block?

1954375706.title: Bitmaster
1954375706.short_description:
Bitmaster is a dynamic and colorful twin-stick shooter.

You need to destroy the enemies and collect power-ups to improve weapons. Game balance changes periodically, which makes the game unpredictable and difficult to get a high score.

1954381453.title: Forklift Certified : Stacked and Loaded
1954381453.short_description: A chaotic 4-player couch co-op party game where you and your crew take on the ultimate warehouse challenge. Load crates, dodge disasters, and try not to trip over the inventory—or each other.

1954420666.title: Arcade Archives 2 MIDNIGHT LANDING
1954420666.short_description:
"MIDNIGHT LANDING" is a flight simulation game released by TAITO in 1987.
You take control of an aircraft soaring through the midnight sky, with the goal of landing safely at the airport.
The lights of the runway come into view, signalling the end of your journey through the night.
Bring it to a perfect close with a beautiful landing.

1954706929.title: BouncyBoi in Puzzle Land
1954706929.short_description: Bounce into Puzzle Land with BouncyBoi, where cute graphics and funky beats are plenty!

1954729031.title: Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes
1954729031.short_description: Zombie Rollerz is the ultimate mashup of classic pinball, zombie defense and rogue-like!

1954741846.title: Rune Lord
1954741846.short_description: A portal has opened and dark magic is pouring through! Only you can close the gateway and defeat the evil Ice Golem. But you'll need to hurry: time is short!

1954760880.title: Minigolf Adventure
1954760880.short_description: Tough day, week, year? Just relax and play Minigolf Adventure, a beautiful game with engaging and relaxing gameplay - up to 4 players in multiplayer.

1954835393.title: Dark Grim Mariupolis (for Windows 10)
1954835393.short_description:
Introducing “Dark Grim Mariupolis”, a point'n'click adventure game set in a world, combining noir, Greek mythology, magic, mysticism, hopeless entourage of Greco-Roman Age of Decadence and stifling everyday routine. Encourage yourself and step into darkness…
Enter Mariupolis, a dark place accompanied with confusing, strange music of no visible source. You are some sort of a detective, and therefore you need to investigate, but why? That’s the thing you’re going to find out… or, maybe not. Everything depends on you and sudden whims of Pentaculus, a grim god stretching its hands out over the whole city.
Investigate and solve puzzles, while resisting dark and obscure grasp of Mariupolis, where the only things guarding you from its baneful influence are sarcasm and arrogance. And be aware – your hero might actually die.

1954997644.title: Construction Simulator 3 - Console Edition
1954997644.short_description: Construction Simulator 3 returns to Europe! Discover an idyllic European town with officially licensed vehicles by famous brands: Caterpillar, Liebherr, CASE, Bobcat, Palfinger, STILL, MAN, ATLAS, Bell, BOMAG, WIRTGEN GmbH, JOSEPH VÖGELE AG, HAMM AG and MEILLER Kipper. Take on diverse and challenging contracts. Shape the skyline of your city and expand your vehicle fleet. Discover a completely new map and unlock new contracts and vehicles with your growing company.

1954999628.title: Zero Squares
1954999628.short_description: Zero Squares is a minimalist puzzle game that challenges your logic and strategy. Move the colored squares into their matching slots and clear the board.

1955003060.title: Cute Bite
1955003060.short_description: Create a new ruler of the night.

1955122958.title: Taboo Trial
1955122958.short_description:
3D Rogue-like action game. You are a Valkyrie, choosing blessings from the Nordic gods to build your unique combat style. Go to complete the Taboo Trial guided by Loki.

Unlock different Valkyries in Valhalla, each playable with distinct styles.

Take up the weapons of the gods to challenge the “giants”, each weapon having a distinct combat style.
 
Select ""Blessings of the Gods"". Blessing of the Gods not only has different combat strategies, but also activates different combat skills. Your choices will create your own unique combat style.
 
Multi-difficulty levels, each difficulty has a different mechanism, challenging different ""giants"".

1955180046.title: Zoo Tycoon Demo
1955180046.short_description: Create the zoo of your dreams filled with the animals you love on Xbox One! Choose from a huge variety of animals and get up close like never before possible with Kinect HD! Share your zoo over Xbox LIVE with friends all over the world.

1955196528.title: Hidden Depths (Xbox Series)
1955196528.short_description: Explore a deadly cave in Hidden Depths, a challenging 2D platformer in pixel art style with fixed-screen levels, deadly traps, and 30 stages of precision and mastery. Grab the key, escape, and uncover the secrets hidden in the depths!

1955199870.title: We Were Here Together
1955199870.short_description: As we explore these frozen wastes, misfortune strikes once again. Through the fierce blizzard, a flare lights the sky, followed by a cry for help over the radio - broken, dying... No one else can come to their rescue. Can we make it back - together?

1955269140.title: Suika And Dragons (Xbox One)
1955269140.short_description: The moment of destiny has arrived—the dragon eggs are ready to hatch! As the revered Elder Dragon, it is your sacred duty to guide these young hatchlings, ensuring they grow, evolve, and rise to become majestic, unstoppable forces of nature. Will you lead them to greatness, forging a new era of dragonkind?

1955359934.title: Icy Gifts 2 (Xbox One)
1955359934.short_description: Trigger crazy chain reactions using balls with different abilities, mix effects, and turn the icy chaos into a holiday miracle.

1955393584.title: MyMaitê (Xbox Series)
1955393584.short_description:
Maitê is a very intelligent girl, but she lives over the moon. This is why her dad has to go there and bring her back to Earth in this 50 stages long incredible adventure.
Jump over clouds, balloons, trampolines and into special portals in order to get to the ending of this pixel art made beautiful game.

1955583828.title: Battle Combat: Survival Shooter
1955583828.short_description: Battle Combat: Survival Shooter is an intense multiplayer battle shooting game.

1955663537.title: Acorn Assault: Rodent Revolution
1955663537.short_description: Acorn Assault is a quirky, tail-bobbing turn-based strategy game. Raise an army, overthrow a tyrant King and save the oppressed squirrels in the Rodent Revolution! Hone your skills in single-player, then duke it out with your friends in local multiplayer!

1955719850.title: Flat Kingdom Paper's Cut Edition
1955719850.short_description: A puzzle platform adventure about geometry, and heroism.

1955736581.title: Butterfly
1955736581.short_description:
Platformer puzzle game with an interesting gimmick. You can't jump, so you need to bounce off your enemies or use tubes to your advantage. Both platformer skills AND logic are required to complete 40 challenging levels! Deft fingers and quick reactions are required. Sweaty neck guaranteed.

"I am a little caterpillar. I live in a world where obstacles and enemies are waiting for me on the way to a blossoming meadow, where I will fly like a butterfly. I do not jump like a grasshopper, I can not swim like a fish and fly like a bird. But I am smart and can use the weaknesses of my enemies. Every water lily or pebble, every loophole will be my faithful helpers. The adventure begins. You can help the caterpillar to quickly turn into a butterfly.".

1955764099.title: Lady in a Leotard With a Gun
1955764099.short_description:
Short third person shooter where you shoot all the enemies and go to the exit

controls 

Move with WASD or left analogue stick

Jump with space or on a xbox controller button a or right bumper

Dodge roll with left shift or on a controller button b or left bumper

Crouch with C or on a controller button x.

1955779192.title: MechWarrior 5: Clans
1955779192.short_description: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs with cutting-edge technology and explore strategic options.

1955794744.title: CARD SHOP GAME STORE SIMULATOR
1955794744.short_description:
Start your own card shop in CARD SHOP GAME STORE SIMULATOR! Stock the newest booster packs, open them to grow your personal collection, set prices, manage inventory, hire staff, and organize tournaments to attract TCG fans. Build your small shop into a bustling hub for trading card enthusiasts while adapting to market trends to boost profits. Manage Your Store: Customize your shop layout, keep shelves tidy, and spotlight rare cards to create a smooth shopping experience. Make smart business decisions, track market shifts, and build a loyal customer base as you expand your TCG empire. 

Features: 
⁃ Shop Customization: Design and personalize your shop layout to attract more customers. 
⁃ Inventory Management: Stock booster packs, singles, and rare cards while balancing supply and demand. 
⁃ Pricing and Strategy: Set prices, offer deals, and adjust to customer trends to maximize profits. 
⁃ Market Trends: Follow price fluctuations and invest wisely to capitalize on rising card values. 

Transform your small card shop into a thriving TCG empire by making smart decisions, managing your stock, and keeping customers coming back.

1955825716.title: Hami
1955825716.short_description: Hami is a small bunny who is trying to find his little teddy, stolen by mini goblins. His hop adventures are leading him through a mystical forest filled with tricky maps and challenging enemies.

1955832684.title: Beyond Good & Evil 20th Anniversary Edition
1955832684.short_description:
Rediscover the cult action-adventure game in a special edition celebrating its 20th anniversary!
Embark on this epic adventure in up to 4K 60 fps with improved graphics and audio, a new speedrun mode, updated achievements, and an exclusive anniversary gallery.
Enjoy unique new rewards as you explore Hillys and discover more about Jade’s past in a new treasure hunt throughout the planet!

1955842277.title: Paper Dash - Ghost Hunt
1955842277.short_description: Start an adventure as a courageous paper plane hunts evil ghosts across vibrant worlds. Soar through mystical forests and scary mansions, utilizing your flying skills and reflexes to shoot the ghosts.

1955874561.title: Slime Jumper
1955874561.short_description: A casual yet challenging 2D precision platformer.

1955905560.title: Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines
1955905560.short_description: Swing, jump, and blast through dimensions in the follow-up to the critically-acclaimed 2D action-platformer Grapple Dog! Zip between action-packed worlds as Pablo and Luna team up to save the cosmos in their own unique ways.

1955966351.title: Black Myth: Wukong
1955966351.short_description: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

1955982965.title: Gunfire Reborn
1955982965.short_description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite, and RPG Elements. Every level is random, each restart is a brand-new experience. You can play the game alone, or in 2-4 player co-op.

1956025200.title: Vengeance Hunters
1956025200.short_description:
Welcome to VENGEANCE HUNTERS!!! 

 

Pick your fighter: The robot, GOLEM. The brawler, CANDY. The mad scientist, LOONY. 

And adventure from the Last Woods to the desolate Wastelands and to the mean streets of the Megalopolis and beyond! 

 

Play solo or with a friend as you battle a strange array of enemies, aliens, monsters, and thugs. 

Collect secrets, increase your score, and challenge yourself across increased difficulty. 

 

VENGEANCE HUNTERS is an original NeoGeo title created for modern gamers. 

Its combat systems and gameplay are designed to celebrate the fun of classic arcade Beat-Em-Ups with an added flare, attention to detail, and complexity that dares players prove their skill and best FIVE unique Boss encounters. 

 

Happy HUNTING!!!

1956029545.title: Aeterna Noctis
1956029545.short_description: Aeterna Noctis is a challenging 2D Metroidvania drawn by hand, with intense combats and skill-based platform sections. Taking the role of the 'King of Darkness' you must help him regain his power across 16 different and connected areas in an epic journey with environmental storytelling.

1956152442.title: House of 1000 Doors: Evil Inside Collector's Edition
1956152442.short_description:
Use the power of light to defeat a devastating darkness before it destroys mankind! 
Locate cleverly hidden objects, solve cunning puzzles, and complete challenging mini-games as you cleanse everything the infection has touched!

Guide Emily as she explores three amazing worlds ruled by the members of the House, whom the darkness has possessed. 
As you locate cleverly hidden objects, solve cunning puzzles, and complete challenging mini-games, you'll use the light within Emily to cleanse everything the infection has touched. 
With stunning artwork and animation, cinematic quality cutscenes, and an original soundtrack that will immerse you in the thrills of a breathtaking adventure House of 1000 Doors: Evil Inside is an experience you'll never forget!

1956165320.title: High Velocity
1956165320.short_description:
High Velocity is a hybrid-throwback to early arcade-style racing games. Move through the levels without hitting anything. Play over and over to beat your previous best time on each level. 

Ten levels, five farm levels and five city levels in honor of my favorite superhero. My four kids helped design the levels and playtest for maximum fun.

1956257533.title: Sokocat: Castaway
1956257533.short_description: A cozy 3D Sokoban-style puzzle adventure with an isometric view. Guide a shipwrecked kitty across a mysterious island full of clever puzzles, hidden secrets, and peaceful exploration.

1956271706.title: Demoniaca: Everlasting Night
1956271706.short_description:
Enter a dark and malicious world inspired by classic side-scrolling platformers and matured for those who grew up with them!

Gothic “metroidvania” adventure awaits in Demoniaca: Everlasting Night, a side-scrolling action platformer that mixes beautifully grotesque imagery with seductive style. Explore, fight, meet new friends and seek revenge against those who brought you unbearable pain and loss!

As you journey through the dreadful and corrupted Tower of Babel, you’ll uncover its many dangerous secrets, challenge powerful lords and slay hordes of their minions. Immerse yourself in fluid real-time combat that’s easy to learn but challenging to master. Gain access to new areas in and around the tower as you progress and upgrade abilities. But what end could await one filled with such anger and despair?

1956343500.title: Heaven Dust
1956343500.short_description: When you awake, you find yourself in a mansion, where was the secret research center, is now a maze full of horrible zombies and deadly traps. You'll have to escape by overcoming your fears, collecting items, solving innovative puzzles and revealing the cruel truth.

1956402951.title: Final Vendetta
1956402951.short_description: Final Vendetta is a hard-hitting action packed beat ‘em up in the vein of classic arcade titles. Featuring stunning pixel art and a thumping soundtrack with exclusive tracks from Utah Saints! Brawl with bad dudes and tough girls as you fight through dangerous environments.

1956475457.title: GraviFire
1956475457.short_description:
GraviFire is a logic game that mixes the mechanics of movement and gravity. You need to put all the objects in the right places by controlling the character and the force of gravity.

The Green Fire has been abducted by evil aliens, who force him to solve puzzles for tests. You need to pass all the tests to return the Green Fire back to his home. Looks like you are in for some serious brainstorming! Gravity, movement, deadly lasers... What else the aliens have prepared?

1956589316.title: Montgomery Fox And The Case Of The Diamond Necklace (Xbox)
1956589316.short_description:
Very valuable diamond necklace was stolen. Police were unable to find the thief. It's your turn to show your detective skills!

Montgomery Fox and the Case of the Diamond Necklace sets the stage for an exciting Hidden Object investigation. 
When crime strikes the countryside, only a famous city detective can solve the case. 
He'll soon discover there's more to this case than meets the eye! 
Set for a journey, meet different characters, find clues and finally unravel a riveting mystery in this fun and colorful hidden object adventure game! 
Enjoy bright and lighthearted levels and locations, with no time limit or pressure of any kind.

1956623472.title: Order Automatica Demo
1956623472.short_description: A dark roguelike auto battler played on a 3×3 ritual grid. Position your units, combine cursed relics, and unleash powerful synergies before the last candle burns out.

1956748538.title: Cross the Moon
1956748538.short_description: A mystery visual novel seen through the eyes of sibling vampires and a cop.

1956800753.title: Ato (Xbox)
1956800753.short_description:
Ato is an Atmospheric, Metroidvania, Sword Dueling Game set in the Era of Feudal Japan. It tells a visually driven story about a father who has given up his past ways in order to live a life of peace with his wife and child. However this peace is soon disturbed as his child is taken from him...

In Ato, every combat encounter is an intense duel to the death. Perform risky parry maneuvers, bounce off of your opponent, evade their attacks and unlock new abilities to further expand your arsenal of options against your adversaries. Every combat encounter has its own personality and fighting style. Challenge, observe and overcome each opponent you face as you strive to retrieve your child back from the clan you once served.

Explore colorful and atmospheric environments. Obtain new abilities to solve environmental puzzles. Uncover the mystery of this world and experience a story that is told without a single word.

• Difficulty options:
-Assist - For casual playthroughs
-Accessible - Mid-range skill with slight challenge
-Experienced - For veteran players who are familiar with difficult games

Explore, experience and overcome the world of Ato.

1956914131.title: Cannibal Cuisine
1956914131.short_description: A chaotic couch co-op cooking game with a cannibal twist!

1957130244.title: Sacrifice Your Friends
1957130244.short_description: Succumb to madness and come Sacrifice Your Friends! Dangerous arenas, eldritch weapons, lovecraftian creatures, and a lot of fun await you.

1957131124.title: Blue Spiderhuman in Adventure
1957131124.short_description:
We have a hero who can throw a web like a spider and this hero encounters various enemies.

CONTROLS :

Arrow keys for run and walk 
Space key for hit and make web
If you push arrow up and space key , you can fly with spider web.
If you push arrow down and space key , you can shoot with spider web.

1957137539.title: Rabbids®: Party of Legends
1957137539.short_description: Embark on a legendary journey with the Rabbids in this hilarious party game! Join them on an incredible quest, filled with hilarious moments and colorful characters. Gather with friends and family and enjoy a multitude of ridiculously fun mini-games in the most epic Rabbids party yet.

1957172115.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong Xbox One
1957172115.short_description: Play as 3 vampires, wield their powers wisely, and strike the right balance between your human and animal side in a heart-pounding story in which your choices will decide the fate of Boston.

1957190812.title: Horror Tale 1: 4k Remaster
1957190812.short_description: Start a scary adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of this horror game!

1957255658.title: MORDHAU
1957255658.short_description: MORDHAU is a multiplayer medieval slasher. Create your mercenary and fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast paced combat, castle sieges, cavalry charges, and more.

1957310205.title: Streets of Rage 4
1957310205.short_description: Amongst the best beat’em up series ever created, jammin’ ‘90s beats and over the top street beating, the iconic series Streets of Rage comes back with a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.

1957324677.title: Bus Simulator 25
1957324677.short_description: 🚌 Bus Simulator 25 puts you in the driver’s seat of a realistic, city-wide bus driving experience! 🚦 Pick up passengers, follow your route, and earn cash 💰 to unlock and upgrade your fleet. With immersive controls,, and dynamic routes 🗺️, it’s time to build your transport empire one ride at a time! 🏙️.

1957331976.title: Mr.Slime in Dungeon (Xbox Series X|S)
1957331976.short_description: Join Mr. Slime in a 2D pixel-art adventure! Run, jump, and slide through vibrant dungeons, collecting coins and unlocking portal chests to advance. With smooth controls, precision platforming, and an immersive soundtrack, can you help him become the richest slime?

1957418632.title: Forza Infernis
1957418632.short_description:
Brimstone and the Borderhounds train to win and now you can help them! Based on the characters from the popular comics, Forza Infernis features arena style one-on-one battles between the Borderhounds and their enemies in an extraordinary 3D experience.

Just looking for a fight? Versus mode is perfect for just that. Individual fights where you choose the fighters and arenas. Relive epic battles or create fights that would not exist in the Borderhounds world.

1957424962.title: No Straight Roads
1957424962.short_description: Start a rock band & end the EDM empire in NO STRAIGHT ROADS, a rockin' action-adventure from the minds of Wan Hazmer (Final Fantasy XV) and Daim Dziauddin (Street Fighter V).

1957464297.title: King K Roller 2
1957464297.short_description: King K Rool is nothing but a meme character; at least that's what his peers think of him. This inferiority complex drives his attempt to alter the course of history to be seen than more than just a "meme character". Luckily, after finding a time stone, the crocodile is able to embark on this 3D platforming adventure of altering the past.

1957476784.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
1957476784.short_description:
In the dark days of the end of World War 2 amidst the ruins of Berlin, one bullet can change history…

Remastered from the 2012 favourite, Sniper Elite V2 will see you parachuted into World War 2 Berlin amidst the Germans’ final stand. Stealth is key as you find yourself trapped between two desperate armies in a race against time. 

Includes all DLC, modernised graphics, photo mode and more!

1957535525.title: Moon Raider
1957535525.short_description: Go to the moon and its dangerous underworld to save the day. Moon Raider is an action-packed 2D adventure platformer.

1957572287.title: ZombMe (Demo)
1957572287.short_description: As a zombie, run, jump, and throw...or you just might LIVE!

1957625191.title: Gold rush miner
1957625191.short_description: Dig your gold. Be a real miner. Play this fun mind game for free.

1957649282.title: Super Astro Cat (Windows)
1957649282.short_description: After getting their home planet destroyed by a meteor, the cats only option was to flee on a spaceship and embark on a journey to find a new suitable planet to colonize and live. Super Astro Cat is the hero with a mission of locating planets, exploring them and deciding the best one to live. Complete your mission and save the cat race from extinction!

1957825213.title: Lewis: The Nonce
1957825213.short_description: Run away from the fat man and avoid being touched!!

1957857070.title: Unbound: Worlds Apart
1957857070.short_description: Summon portals to overcome vicious beasts, devious puzzles and fiendish platforming challenges. Master the unique powers of each portal to stop the collapse of reality, while exploring lush, hand-drawn worlds and unraveling a deep narrative full of mysteries.

1957871614.title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
1957871614.short_description: A first-person horror adventure that plunges you into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Delve into eerie landscapes, solve unnerving puzzles and uncover secrets in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

1957887363.title: Super Runner Marioner Land
1957887363.short_description: Start running with marioner. Jump over obstacles. Try to get the highest score in the jungle. He's starting to run faster and faster. The game gets harder the faster you run. Despite this difficulty, try to get the highest score in the game.

1957922286.title: Frame Cat (Windows)
1957922286.short_description:
In this retro-style platformer, play as Catherine, a witch and tomb raider caught in a cursed dimension after stealing a forbidden artifact.

Blast enemies with magic fireballs, solve puzzles, and escape the clutches of the Cat Demon across 15 pixel-perfect levels inspired by ‘90s classics.

1957925786.title: Vikings Pinball
1957925786.short_description: The most unusual pinball you can find!

1957960009.title: HALF DEAD
1957960009.short_description: Half dead is a multiplayer sci-fi game about a violent TV show. The players' goal is to survive in a network of rooms full of traps.

1957968654.title: Destroy All Humans! - Clone Carnage
1957968654.short_description: Wreak havoc in Clone Carnage! This standalone DLC comes with 4 modes, 6 maps, and up to 4-player multiplayer. Split-screen lets you double the damage in local 2-player multiplayer. Unleash your wild side in Rampage, Armageddon, Race, and Abduction modes!

1958059335.title: Oaken - Demo
1958059335.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, gather allies, learn to use positioning, choose how to upgrade your cards, wake the spirits and save the Oak!

1958071699.title: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition
1958071699.short_description:
Guacamelee! STCE is a Metroid-vania style action-platformer where YOU take the role of a luchador to combat the evil Carlos Calaca and his hordes of undead minions, to rescue the kidnapped El Presidente's Daughter.

Use the power of your fists to battle an army of evil. Uncover hidden wrestling techniques like the Rooster Uppercut, Intenso turbo-combat mode and Dimension Swap to open new areas and secrets... 
But beware: Saving the world is not a task for the faint of heart.

1958112313.title: YAKUZA: Shadows of New York
1958112313.short_description:
Step into the shadows of New York City in YAKUZA: Shadows of New York, a gripping action-adventure where the old codes of honor clash against the forces of modern corruption. Become Kaito Nakamura, a skilled enforcer on a mission to find his missing mentor while navigating the city's dark and treacherous underbelly.

BECOME THE DRAGON

Master the art of combat, stealth, and strategy as you traverse nine meticulously crafted locations, from sacred temples to neon-soaked city streets. Engage in fluid martial arts, utilize environmental takedowns, and choose your approach—fight, sneak, or talk your way to uncovering the truth.

EXPLORE A LIVING, BREATHING CITY

Interact with a diverse cast across two contrasting worlds: one shaped by ancient honor, the other by gritty urban corruption. Make allies or enemies as you uncover a conspiracy that threatens to reshape New York itself.

MASTER YOUR SKILLS

Dynamic Combat: Engage in fluid, dynamic fights that combine martial arts with environmental takedowns.

Stealth and Strategy: Adapt to different situations—sneak past guards, negotiate, or unleash your full power.

Evolving Abilities: Hone your skills to become the most formidable force in New York’s underworld.

IMMERSIVE NOIR NARRATIVE

Dive into a rich, noir-inspired story of loyalty, betrayal, and justice. Your choices will impact the fate of your allies, enemies, and the city itself. Experience cinematic cutscenes and make crucial decisions that weave a complex web of corruption, from street level to New York’s highest offices.

KEY FEATURES

Intense Action and Stealth: A seamless blend of fast-paced action and strategic stealth gameplay.

Noir-Inspired Storytelling: Rich narrative with memorable characters and impactful choices.

Stunning Visuals: Experience beautifully rendered environments that blend traditional Japanese elements with New York’s urban atmosphere.

Dynamic Combat Evolution: Unlock and master new combat abilities as the story progresses.

Unique Soundtrack: Original score blending traditional Japanese instruments with modern noir jazz.

From the bustling city avenues to the shadows of ancient traditions, every decision, every fight, and every alliance shapes your destiny. Unveil the truth, restore honor, and become the shadow that New York’s underworld fears.

1958117717.title: Bomboban (Xbox Series X|S)
1958117717.short_description: Bomboban is a sokoban-style puzzle game where you push enemy robots into bombs to defeat them and clear each stage. Plan your moves, undo mistakes, and solve handcrafted pixel art puzzles with a fun, explosive twist.

1958132014.title: Elderand
1958132014.short_description: Through the darkness and madness, promised glory awaits. Dismember deadly creatures and terrifying bosses by masterfully wielding an arsenal of brutal weapons in intense skill-based combat. Hunt for untold treasure as you explore a grim world in this gory, gruesome Action-RPG.

1958179604.title: Rat Protocol
1958179604.short_description:
Escape dangerous labs as a mutated rodent in a pushing puzzle adventure about twisted experiments!

Weird science and block-pushing puzzle mechanics combine for a brainteasing adventure in Rat Protocol!

When an experiment unexpectedly grants humanoid strength and intelligence to a lab rat, the scientists in charge decide to test the limits of their creation’s newfound abilities. Guide the lab rat through increasingly tricky chambers by pushing crates, blocking dangerous laser beams, activating switches and detonating explosives. Find the right order to clear obstacles so the lab rat can reach key cards to open doorways and proceed to the next test. 

Will you make the experiment a success or lead your rodent to an untimely demise?

1958191831.title: Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2
1958191831.short_description: Explore your kingdom and rule wisely in the card game - Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2.

1958215676.title: Ninja Master Toru
1958215676.short_description: An evil curse that transforms the dead into living corpses was cast upon the land. The only way to stop the entire nation from crumbling to the undead is defeating the Kind of Undead, but entire armies of soldiers were annihilated and transformed into zombies. Only the master of steath, Ninja Master Toru, can infiltrate into the enemy territory and claim the leader's head!

1958257709.title: Overpass 2
1958257709.short_description: Identify the best routes and balance of power, speed and precision to overcome obstacles at the controls of a UTV, ATV or Rock Bouncer. In both solo and multiplayer mode, your talent and choices of technique will make the difference.

1958260574.title: ClusterPuck 99
1958260574.short_description: Local multiplayer madness! ClusterPuck 99 is an 8 player sports game built for parties, competition and smack talk!

1958263726.title: Music Racer: Ultimate (Xbox Series X|S)
1958263726.short_description:
Now you can race your own music!

Music Racer is the dynamic rhythm game loved by millions of players around the world.

The new "Ultimate" version allows you to use your own music in the game via a WebDAV server (from a computer or smartphone), as well as play to music published on the Audius service.

1958265642.title: TP Bullet
1958265642.short_description: Save the city, one bullet at a time!

1958374921.title: Animal Jam Escape Puzzle
1958374921.short_description: Help cute farm animals escape by solving fun block puzzles offline!

1958464992.title: Mob Control
1958464992.short_description: Are you ready to become the ultimate champion in the world of tower defense battles? Create, grow and Lead!

1958527888.title: Rain World Demo
1958527888.short_description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

1958529503.title: Super Dark Deception
1958529503.short_description:
Super Dark Deception is a fun retro take on the hit horror game, Dark Deception! This is the first and second chapter of the game and contains 8 levels + 4 mini games. All future Super Dark Deception DLC chapters are included in the price.

Features:

- Beautiful hand-drawn 2D pixel art that gives a classic 16-bit RPG look and feel.
- Power System: Earn XP and unlock powers as you progress that will allow you to even the odds and survive longer against horrendous creatures.
- Fast-paced Arcade Horror: Run for your life and run fast. Enemies can be stunned and avoided, but not killed.
- Hazardous Environments: Enemies are not the only danger. The mazes themselves are full of traps, hazards, and other dangers to watch out for.
- Unique Enemies: Every nightmare presents a unique creature that has its own distinct AI. Players will have to change up their tactics in order to survive.

1958635103.title: O-VOID: Console Edition
1958635103.short_description: Survive geometric madness with just one button.

1958687312.title: Table Hockey Challenge
1958687312.short_description: An electronic version of the classic table and arcade ice hockey game.

1958827848.title: Eternal Card Game
1958827848.short_description: Join the battle in the new strategy card game of unlimited choices and fun.

1958841023.title: Horror Adventure Demo
1958841023.short_description:
Horror Adventure is a interactive experience set in a procedurally generated haunted house. You're a paranormal investigator and you find yourself exploring what appears to be a old abandoned manor.
You will be able to interact with basic items and limited tools at your disposal. The procedurally generated random house will create random locations and scares for you (Procedural level generation is available in Full version Only). So make sure to keep your eyes open at all the times, put your headphones on and enjoy the game!

Features:
1. Immersive First person interactive gameplay which allow the player to control various handheld elements.
2. Procedurally generated random house to increase the scare factor and replayability. (Procedural level generation is available only in Full Version)
3. Demo version gives access to only 1 Level. (Buy Full Version to unlock all the features)
4. Featuring different demonic entities, each designed specifically according to the procedural nature of the levels.
5. Save/Load feature so that you can take a breather in between.
6. Both Keyboard and Controller support provided. ( Use arrow keys to move front or back and use mouse to change direction. Use Space Bar to grab any key, torch or open any gate where you see Hand mark).

Note: Procedural Level generation is available only in Full Version. Demo version has access to 1 Level.

1958968882.title: Creepy Tale 2
