1999786795.short_description: Poppy Jump Force is a game with 30 levels, great graphics and a fun gameplay. Use the gamepad or keyboard to control the character to complete the levels. Enjoy!

1999803984.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2™
1999803984.short_description: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 takes place outside the events of the second film in a unique story where Spider-Man discovers a larger threat to NYC that has turned the underworld upside down. Villains from the film as well as fan-favorite, classic Marvel characters are woven together in a twisted web of adrenaline-fueled, free-roaming, web-slinging action that puts players on a collision course with an evil far beyond Spider-Man’s reckoning.

1999827971.title: Rubberduck Wave Racer
1999827971.short_description: Be a duckling - a squeaky duckling!

1999883824.title: Ultra Crystal Rush (Windows)
1999883824.short_description: Ultra Crystal Rush is a high-mobility, precision-focused 2D platformer centered on fast movement, route planning, and flawless execution.

1999941762.title: Little Nightmares 3 - Demo
1999941762.short_description: Discover the eerie Necropolis in this free demo of Little Nightmares III - a standalone story where you follow Low and Alone, two friends trapped in a disturbing world. Play online co-op with a friend on the same platform as yours.

2000004108.title: Hidden Cats in Berlin
2000004108.short_description: HALLO! The city of Berlin is experiencing a cat invasion - let’s find them all!

2000011414.title: Starlit Adventures
2000011414.short_description: Run, dig, jump, fight! Become the best guardian of the stars in the Upper World!

2000128121.title: Lunch A Palooza
2000128121.short_description: Lunch A Palooza is a game for everyone! With its easy to learn controls, and fast-paced random matches, it's perfect for both the beginner and seasoned gamer alike. The goal is to be the last food standing! You must use special attacks and food items to dominate the opposition.

2000145726.title: Party Arcade
2000145726.short_description: Party Arcade is a family friendly party game set in a modern virtual arcade. With 13 addictive games, players collect tickets, unlock different equipment skins, and battle against family and friends at home, or online around the world!

2000224393.title: Afterdream
2000224393.short_description: Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction. Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence.

2000238543.title: Tiny Lands - Deluxe Edition
2000238543.short_description: Tiny Lands - Deluxe Edition is a relaxing 3D game about finding the differences between two handcrafted dioramas. If you are looking for a game that allows you to just sit back and play Tiny Lands is for you!

2000253019.title: SPIRITUS TWO
2000253019.short_description:
Albert and Rose return in SPIRITUS 2. The Book of Rites has been used to build an army and has wiped out the city of London. Together, they must stay together to stay alive and venture to the very depths of evil to prevent the end of the world from happening. With a huge roster of new enemies to fight, challenging bosses, and labryinth areas to solve, SPIRITUS 2 is this year's survival horror classic.

Presented in wonderful 3D HD graphics with awesome PSX style retro effects, SPIRITUS 2 is the definite survival horror experience.

GAME FEATURES
-Take arms and shoot monsters, explore and manage a limited inventory in this 3D survival horror with static camera angles and classic tank controls.
-Explore the City and it's dark depths with Lovecraftian influences.
-Investigate the story with cinematic sequences and found note storytelling
-Quality of life engine upgrades - Shoulder camera toggle added for easier navigation through static camera angles

PRESENTATION
-A game presented in classic 3D survival horror with fixed camera angles adding to the suspense
-PSX Style rendering which takes players back to the best days of survival horror.

SOUNDTRACK
-Immersive sound effects and chilling soundtrack that immerses the player in the horror.

2000272840.title: Extrorb - Halloween Edition
2000272840.short_description: With Extrorb you conquered forests, ice bergs and mountains and you just haven't had enough! Extrorb - Halloween Edition places you in a deserted land with only a creepy haunted house in sight! Are there hidden treasures waiting to be found? Watch out! If you get caught you may find yourself in the dungeon!

2000297004.title: Only Jump
2000297004.short_description: Feeling stuck on the ground? Elevate your adventure with Only Jump! Reach for the clouds and uncover their secrets, but be ready for some challenges along the way. Get ready to defy gravity, jump higher than ever, and dive into the thrilling world of parkour like you’ve never seen before! This isn’t just another parkour simulator; it’s an exciting ONLINE MULTIPLAYER experience that turns every leap into a breathtaking spectacle!

2000350026.title: Minesweeper Genius
2000350026.short_description: Train your brain! Help Aristotle – the genius with a broom – sweep the minefield to regain his memory and escape from the aliens' scientific experiments, discovering where all the bombs are hidden.

2000371555.title: Super Dodgeball Beats
2000371555.short_description:
You’re invited to the craziest dodgeball contest ever! Get your groove on with Super Dodgeball Beats, the world’s most intense rhythm-sports game!

Take part in insanely cool dodgeball games played to the rhythm of 18 original music tracks. Tap to the beat with perfect timing and conquer your rivals in style. There’s nothing else like it!

2000399801.title: Xmas Panda Run
2000399801.short_description:
Xmas Panda Run is fun addictive hyper casual arcade game.There is a brave panda, in order to return home to celebrate Christmas with his family, decided to adventure with tireless running.
How to play:
Use up arrow key to jump and space to shoot.

2000408346.title: Horror Gallery
2000408346.short_description: You have been hired to solve the mystery of a missing caretaker and a scary female ghost that has been seen in the Waterfront gallery. On arrival you start searching for the ghost but slowly but surely are being pulled into her own world. Before you know it you find yourself in a crazy world that represent the thoughts of the dead woman. However, you are determined to find her, figure out why she can’t leave the world of the living and finally bring her peace.

2000430078.title: Tank World
2000430078.short_description:
If you like fast action war games, then Tank World will keep you alert and on the move. 

The fast moving action takes place in arenas – the more battles you win, the more levels you unlock and the fighting continues on.

With 16 levels to combat through, you get to master the art of tactical warfare on a variety of battle grounds - fighting enemy tanks that stand in your way.

2000437097.title: Of Bird and Cage
2000437097.short_description: Of Bird and Cage is a unique metal album presented through a short story-driven game. Play music in a brand-new way. Featuring famous artists like Ron "Bumblefoot" Thal (ex-Guns N' Roses), Rob van der Loo (Epica), Ruud Jolie (Within Temptation), and many others!

2000442171.title: Shadow Warrior 3: Definitive Edition
2000442171.short_description: Take an adrenaline-fueled journey through a mythical Japanese realm in the Definitive Edition of Shadow Warrior 3, packed with new features, and enjoy an ultraviolent blend of fast-paced gunplay, razor-sharp melee combat, and spectacular free-running movement.

2000453514.title: Catch The Eggs Game
2000453514.short_description: You will need to catch the eggs. You have to play with the keyboard arrow keys. Have fun :).

2000460393.title: Alien Hominid Invasion
2000460393.short_description: Old friends and bitter enemies await as you invade Earth alongside a Mothership full of alien friends! Blast, beam, and bite your way through an endless swarm of enemies as you and up to three of your fellow hominids cause mayhem with a huge arsenal of weapons, mutations, and acrobatic maneuvers.

2000501097.title: GRAPPIN
2000501097.short_description:
After a difficult awakening, you stumble upon the Grip, a mysterious artifact and grappling hook. 
Climb up the Mountain to bring back the Grip to the top and unravel the mystery surrounding the Grip in GRAPPIN, an exciting First-Person Adventure game.

2000514300.title: Nightmare Reaper
2000514300.short_description: Progress through the cursed depths of a nightmare, gather mighty weapons and unlock new abilities.

2000556137.title: Street Race Kings Demo - Xbox Series S | X
2000556137.short_description:
Street Race Kings is an open world racing game that is currently in the works! You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Moving up in rank will give you more vehicles, customizations, parts and access to multiple maps! Race and become the champion of the SRK!


NOTE: It is not recommended to play this game on Xbox One. Application tests have only been targeted on Xbox Series S | X.

2000790611.title: THE CARD Perfect Collection Plus: Texas Hold 'em, Solitaire and others
2000790611.short_description: An all-in-one collection for all your card game needs! Whether it's solitaire or competitive online games like Daifugo or Blackjack you're after, this is the game for you!

2000878418.title: Truck Racing Simulator Multiplayer Game
2000878418.short_description: 🚛💨 Race massive trucks across forests, deserts, and tracks in this high-speed truck racing game! 🏁 Play solo through 30 intense levels or challenge a friend in local multiplayer! 🎮🔥.

2000897177.title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
2000897177.short_description: Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Experience the legendary origins of Mortal Kombat with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions and rare, fan-favorite releases—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

2000948170.title: DAEMORGEN: Dawn of Demons (Windows)
2000948170.short_description: Fast-paced pixel art FPS inspired by Doom, Heretic, and Quake. Battle demons, uncover secrets, and survive brutal combat in a corrupted world.

2000960337.title: Mayhem Mail
2000960337.short_description: Find the mail and deliver it like a hero!

2001080469.title: Mars: Chaos Menace
2001080469.short_description:
Humanity is terraforming Mars, but chaos and destruction threaten the planet.
Battle your way through innumerable hordes of enemies that wish to destroy you and face the most terrible and powerful monsters in the galaxy. Our destiny is in your hands.

2001126017.title: Beef Cat Ultra
2001126017.short_description: In the vibrant world of Beeflandia, our hero Beef Cat and his friends always know how to celebrate the good times. But when a mysterious Big Guy shows up and stirs up trouble, everything changes. The peaceful vibes are over and it’s time for a new kind of adventure!

2001173735.title: Sticky Twig DASH!
2001173735.short_description:
Sticky Twig DASH! is a 2D platformer where you play as a kind forest creature who uses a twig spear to stick to walls and then launch himself with a high jump! Use your movement abillities to delve into an unknown place to save your lost little sister.

Experience 40 levels in an atmospheric cave with a moody soundtrack. Coziness meets danger as each level presents a unique challenge for our hero to tackle with precision or brainpower!

- Precision/puzzle platformer designed to be a delight to every platformer lover
- Simple controls using only two action buttons (Jump and Dash) that lead to many movement options
- Enjoy nostalgic pixel art graphics combined with modern lighting effects
- Cozy soundtrack to put you in the right vibe
- Collect the crystal heart in each level for an extra challenge, if you'd like.

2001191032.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Sleepy Cats
2001191032.short_description: Jigsaw Puzzle Sleepy Cats brings cute little kittens and traditional jigsaw puzzles to your Xbox. Chose between 6 different puzzle sizes and more than 30 different adorable sleepy cat pictures and start completing your own jigsaw kittens.

2001285323.title: Horror Adventure
2001285323.short_description:
Horror Adventure is a interactive experience set in a procedurally generated haunted house. You're a paranormal investigator and you find yourself exploring what appears to be a old abandoned manor.

You will be able to interact with basic items and limited tools at your disposal. The procedurally generated random house will create random locations and scares for you. So make sure to keep your eyes open at all the times, put your headphones on and enjoy the game!

Features:
1. Immersive First person interactive gameplay which allow the player to control various handheld elements.
2. Procedurally generated random house to increase the scare factor and replayability.
3. Featuring different demonic entities, each designed specifically according to the procedural nature of the levels.
4. Save/Load feature so that you can take a breather in between.
5. Both Keyboard and Controller support provided. ( Use arrow keys to move front or back and use mouse to change direction. Use Space Bar to grab any key, torch or open any gate where you see Hand mark).

WARNING: This experience uses Jump Scares! You have been warned!

2001295830.title: Gears 5 Tech Test
2001295830.short_description: Be the first to play Gears 5 and help create the future of Versus multiplayer. Included in your Xbox Game Pass membership or Gears 5 pre-order.

2001337102.title: Crystal Veins (Windows)
2001337102.short_description: Crystal Veins is a 2D platformer blending cartoon visuals with intense underground challenge. You play Toby, a miner trapped after a mysterious cave-in. With only his pickaxe, helmet, and flickering lantern, he must dig, dodge, and dash through a forgotten mine. Gates require rare crystals to open, so mine glowing veins, avoid lava, bats and cave beasts, and reach the exit before darkness swallows you.

2001357006.title: Masked Shooters 2
2001357006.short_description: Suit up, boys! The battleground is open and danger has never been more real. Enemies lurk at every turn, their trigger fingers just itching for the opportunity to take you out. Once the mask drops, be ready to pull the trigger.

2001451314.title: Tale of Dark Lands (Xbox Series X|S)
2001451314.short_description:
Tale of Dark Lands - a magical fantasy action RPG with an elegant low-poly style and the charm of a timeless fairy tale. Immerse yourself in a world of mysteries, perils, and glorious adventures!

A story full of secrets and challenges.
The main hero is a brave mercenary hired by the residents of a small village to defend them against fierce goblin raids. But what begins as a simple job turns into something far greater. Soon, the hero becomes entwined in an ancient dark tale that threatens the entire land, and only he can stop the encroaching darkness.

Create the hero of your dreams.
A flexible character editor lets you craft a hero with a unique appearance.
Develop your character: earn experience, acquire new skills, and grow stronger with every battle!

2001507301.title: Trails and Traces: The Tomb of Thomas Tew
2001507301.short_description: Discover clues, solve puzzles, and uncover pirate secrets.

2001553720.title: Time Trap 2 - Hidden Object Adventure Games for Xbox
2001553720.short_description:
"Time Trap" got a long-awaited sequel! Explore this post-apocalypse world in all-around locations!

 The experiments of the Ring of Time corporation didn't end after the incident in the Abandoned City. 
 Following a mysterious electromagnetic surge, the anomalous zone was transformed into Timeless. It is a unique world where space and time are distorted, but also new opportunities open up to heroes! Everyone who entered this zone became a shadow of his old self. The only way to escape from Timeless is to put together the Sphere of Singularity! So far no-one managed to gather all the Fragments of the Sphere. Now it's your mission to prove it is possible!

Game features:
- A variety of tasks: searching for items, spotting the differences, puzzles, restoration of disassembled objects
- Look for items in 360-degree panoramic scenes. Unusual 3D effects and colorful animations.
- Enjoy the exciting gameplay as the "Time Trap" storyline continues!
- Build your collection. Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!

2001626208.title: Roots of Pacha
2001626208.short_description: A farm sim set in the stone age where you develop the ideas that shaped humanity.

2001662315.title: Crystal Ball of Firmament (Xbox One)
2001662315.short_description: The spell book is missing! Help the magician to find it in this action platformer adventure. Use the crystal ball to change between the day and night to make your path, collect tokens and buy useful upgrades. Venture out 4 different biomes (mountain, woods, winter forest and city) with a total of 32 levels. Warping the day / night cycle changes ambiental obstacles and enemies behavior.

2001690907.title: Cowboy Kart
2001690907.short_description: Good, old-fashioned kart racing in the old west! Up to 4 players.

2001814192.title: Zombie Derby 2
2001814192.short_description: Discover the dangerous post-apocalyptic world with cool upgradable cars!

2001815391.title: Junkyard Fury - Breakout
2001815391.short_description: Junkyard Fury is back, with a vehicular combat style game! Each vehicle has its own progression and story, and each environment has its own destructive mechanics. Breakout and destroy everything and everyone in your way!

2001826852.title: My Neighbor Is A Zombie
2001826852.short_description: You will have fun in 1 to 4 player split-screen Action-Arcade Life based GamePlay, where you must fight against infected and angry neighbors which will keep you on target at all times.

2002175613.title: Torchlight II Demo
2002175613.short_description: The award-winning action RPG is back, better than ever, and now comes with a free Demo! Best part? Your progress saves and you pick up right where you left off when you buy the game.

2002259331.title: Darksiders III
2002259331.short_description: Return to an apocalyptic Earth in Darksiders III, a hack-n-slash Action Adventure where players assume the role of FURY in her quest to hunt down and dispose of the Seven Deadly Sins. The most unpredictable and enigmatic of the Four Horsemen, FURY must succeed where many have failed – to bring balance to the forces that now ravage Earth.

2002349228.title: OVERPASS™
2002349228.short_description: Take control of big-name buggies and quads to negotiate scree slopes, steep inclines and various obstacles on extreme off-road and technically challenging tracks. Find the best route, and manage your acceleration, differentials and drivetrain to dominate in local or online competitions.

2002349821.title: Collie Call (Windows)
2002349821.short_description: Herding sheep has never been this fun.

2002362285.title: Royal Frontier
2002362285.short_description: Create your party of heroes and cross the dangerous frontier!

2002365997.title: Football Manager 2022
2002365997.short_description:
No game gets you closer to the dream of managing the world’s best soccer teams.
Football Manager 2022 brings new, progressive ways to find your winning edge, instill your soccer style and earn it for your club. 
Prevail in the moments that matter to turn your club’s dreams into reality and earn your place alongside the managerial greats.
Whether that's fighting your way to the top of the game and shocking the world or clawing your way back from the brink – these are the moments that taste sweetest.
Game Description
•	Lead your favorite soccer club to the top of the game, meeting the objectives set by the owner and chairman, as well as the expectations of the fans.
•	Search the transfer market for best young talents in world soccer, or look closer to home, creating pathways for your youth academy stars to realize their full potential. 
•	Earn respect on the tactics board, developing a soccer style that’s guaranteed to deliver victories on the field and trophies at the end of the season. 
New for this season
FIND YOUR WINNING EDGE
Improve your performance and boost your results with the same stats that real clubs use in the brand-new Data Hub. By crafting your own custom dashboard packed with powerful analytics, you’ll be able to make smarter tactical and player development decisions to fuel your club’s success. 
ON-FIELD REALISM
An improved animation system and sweeping changes to the way players press deliver our most realistic match action yet. You’ll see your players show off their skills with remodeled dribbling, while a wealth of AI improvements means that there’s an authentic flow to the big moments of every game. 
TURN DEFENSE INTO ATTACK 
Implement one of the top tactical trends of recent years with the new Wide Centre-Back role. You now possess even more tools to overwhelm the opposition as you chase those all-important victories. 
DEADLINE DAY DRAMA
Feel the highs and lows of one of the most dramatic fixtures in the soccer calendar. A redesigned experience replicates the unpredictability of the transfer window’s climax.
COLLABORATE LIKE CHAMPIONS
New, true-to-life staff meetings will make things easier for you to reach the top of the game. Lean more heavily than ever before on your backroom team, who are there to handle tasks for you. The improved organization provided by combining weekly reports on Coaching, Recruitment, Player Development and Staffing will propel your players to new heights. 
FURTHER ADDITIONS
Craft your ideal managerial look with a redesigned manager creator, now with more life-like faces and increased facial hair options, build your dream squad with a host of new scouting improvements and earn the bragging rights against your friends online in the improved Fantasy Draft mode.

2002404032.title: Stranded: Alien Dawn
2002404032.short_description: Brave a new world in Stranded: Alien Dawn, a planet survival sim placing the fate of a small marooned group in your hands.

2002405450.title: Kung Fu Fighting
2002405450.short_description:
Welcome to the world of martial arts! Kung Fu Fighting is an arcade-style Kung Fu fighting game that delivers thrilling gameplay, dynamic animations, special effects, and realistic combat techniques. Choose your fighter and step into the battle to prove your dominance.

Stay focused against skilled opponents, anticipate their moves, and unleash powerful techniques from Taekwondo, Muay Thai, Kung Fu, boxing, and more. With stunning visuals and dynamic fighting moves, this game promises an action-packed experience you won’t want to miss!

2002430446.title: Calturin
2002430446.short_description: Bullet Hell Boss Rush game where you are resurrected by a necromancer who now holds you in his power.

2002568765.title: GEORGIE-YOLKIE 64 - The Furry Tale
2002568765.short_description:
Let's tell an old tale anew, and go back to the good ol' days of gaming with a new classic, hack and slash adventure. Upgrade Georgie & Yolkie's abilities and travel across 17 lovely lands and save Princess Tabitha from the clutches of the evil King Rattie! Lots of addictive swordplay and fun here!

Embark on a thrilling adventure across 17 immersive 3D levels! Battle scary Lions, Minions, Witches, Dragons, and the wicked King Rattie who has kidnapped Princess Tabitha and using her power for his own! Collect gold and fish, upgrade weapons, and use powerful items to become an unstoppable feline and bird duo!

Key Features

 Dynamic Combat: Face clever, strategic enemies with fluid battle mechanics.

 10+ Unique Foes: Challenge a variety of fierce opponents.

 Character Customization: Personalize Georgie's gear and obtain upgrades

 Bonus Challenges: Unlock all new stuff!

 Replayability: Replay any level from the World Map and find alternative paths and hidden things!

 Retro Style Polygons, effects, charming atmosphere and a return to great music!

 Well scripted and dynamic boss fights!

 Catch all the sheep that annoy you and force you to find new ways to continue on your way, push objects to make new platforms and avoid their pitfalls!

2002584553.title: Puzzle Quest 3
2002584553.short_description:
The original Match-3 RPG returns with an all-new adventure, bringing the classic combination of strategic puzzle battles with epic monsters, unique hero classes, and rich fantasy stories. 

Explore mythical dungeons, uncover valuable loot, and unlock epic gear as you embark on a brand-new journey to become the next Puzzle Quest legend! 

Complete Endless Match-3 Puzzles! - Win the day by matching multiple colorful gems and deadly skulls in any direction to create devastating combos!

Discover your Legend - Choose from seven hero classes; start a new character anytime - no lootbox required! 

Unlock Epic Gear - Earn loot from your travels and deck your hero with legendary weapons and armor!

Embark on an Adventure - Start a new journey anytime with regularly rotating Adventures and rewarding live events. There is always a quest to complete!

Seasonal Content - Complete story missions or take on seasonal storylines to earn unique rewards added with each major update! 

Incredible 3D Graphics - Discover unique monsters, charming characters, and epic heroes fully animated with incredible effects!

Recruit Allies - Meet a cast of characters who join your cause and help you earn more resources or build new equipment

Collect and Equip Gear - Earn different weapons, armor, and spells to take on increasingly powerful foes.

Multiplayer Action - Battle heroes in PVP and climb the leaderboards, or form a group with up to three friends to take on dungeons together in real time!

2002613703.title: Lethal League Blaze
2002613703.short_description: Lethal League Blaze is an intense, high speed ball game, with unique characters, outta sight sounds and none of that weak stuff. In Shine City, the anti-gravity ball game has long been illegal. The group who kept playing was dubbed the Lethal League. Even now, with their sport pushed underground, players and crews compete in the League for challenge and respect.

2002689707.title: Tandem: A Tale of Shadows Demo
2002689707.short_description: Tandem : A Tale of Shadows redefines the puzzle platformer genre with a unique top down and side-scroller gameplay and exceptional aesthetics. Help Emma and the teddy bear Fenton solve the mystery of the disappearance of the famous magician Thomas Kane.

2002692571.title: Timberman VS
2002692571.short_description: Enter the digital forest and discover this classic, casual game - slice and dice trees in an arcade-style, challenge your friends and be the fastest timberman alive!

2002744916.title: Journey of Johann: Grasslands (Windows)
2002744916.short_description:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.
Collect goblets, secrets and beat time trials.
Use your weapons as tools such as climbing, blocking hits, and defeating enemies.
The game was designed with speedrunning in mind.

2002760978.title: Taxi Chaos 2
2002760978.short_description:
Taxi Chaos 2 is an arcade taxi driving game in a city ruled by AI taxi bots. They dominate the streets, pushing human drivers to the edge. Race the clock, outsmart the Taxi Bot competition, and take on fares that push your driving to the limit through traffic, hazards, shifting road conditions. San Valeda never stands still, and every shift brings new challenges.

Deliver under pressure
Your shift hours are limited, so every run counts. Rush point to point runs for fast payouts, or take fares with fragile cargo, hazardous routes, or oversized loads. Some jobs change how your vehicle handles, from extra weight to rockets bolted to the back.

Adapt to the ever changing city
The streets never stay the same. Roadworks, hazardous fog, and restricted Taxi Bot zones can block your way, while hidden shortcuts open new options. Every shift brings new obstacles and opportunities.

Outdrive the Taxi Bots
AI taxis ram, block, and disrupt your runs, growing more aggressive as you progress. Avoid them to keep your route clean or confront them to clear the way.

Drive with style
Your cab reflects your driving style. Pick from Heavy, Sport, or Drift vehicles, each tuned for responsive arcade driving. Heavy plows through chaos, Sport focuses on speed, and Drift carries momentum through turns. Personalize your ride with cosmetic customizations.

Power up your cab
Research new abilities and equip them to match your approach. Utility skills help you access shortcuts or navigate hazards, while combat skills hit back at Taxi Bot rivals.

Play your way
Choose a campaign in Story Mode with rising challenges, or jump into Arcade Mode for quick runs built for chasing high scores and climbing the leaderboards.

2002827047.title: Ghostlore
2002827047.short_description: Ghostlore is an 'Eastpunk' Action-RPG where you fight monsters from Southeast-Asian folklore. Inspired by timeless classic ARPG's such as Diablo 2 and Titan Quest, Ghostlore features a detailed item and character customization system, procedurally generated maps, and authentic 90's retro graphics.

2002870555.title: A Little to the Left
2002870555.short_description: A Little to the Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 100+ satisfying messes to tidy.

2002882362.title: Squirrel with a Gun
2002882362.short_description: Squirrel, meet gun. As the neighborhood’s most obnoxious rodent, develop a knack (and a love?) for crime and mayhem in pursuit of golden acorns in this nutty sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer. Fight tooth, claw, and gun to escape a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

2002970112.title: CounterAttack Flight
2002970112.short_description: CounterAttack is a side scrolling space shooter (shmup). Team up or fight solo, 1 - 4 player local or up to 8 players online coop, unlock upgrades, use powerful ultimate abilities, enhance your ship the way you want, and save the Earth from annihilation.

2002977221.title: Tails of Iron
2002977221.short_description: Tails of Iron is an epic RPG Adventure with punishingly brutal combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must embark on a perilous quest to reclaim your Kingdom. Explore a deceivingly charming world. Assemble a band of brave companions. Banish the merciless Frog clan... once and for all!

2003002635.title: Survival: Foutain of Youth - Captain's Edition
2003002635.short_description: The game is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, sail to 18 islands and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

2003057356.title: Area 86
2003057356.short_description:
Area 86 is a physics-based escape room puzzle game.
Control your robot in an interactive environment.
Push, pick, throw, activate, or destroy objects to escape.

2003107771.title: Gunma's Ambition -You and me are Gunma- Reiwa 2nd national census edition
2003107771.short_description:
Hello.
Gunma Prefecture makes Japan Gunma Prefecture.
Everyone Gunma.

2003142157.title: Runny Bunny - Console Edition
2003142157.short_description:
Get ready for a fast and furry twist on puzzle action in side-scrolling pixel art platforming style!

Play as a frantic little bunny as you dash between floors, walls and ceilings collecting power dots and yummy carrots. Mazelike stages will take you from grassy wilds to twisted caverns and deadly laboratories. The bunny moves in lightning quick straight lines and clings to walls and ceilings, but you’ll still need to strategically maneuver him around traps and enemies to keep him safe from harm.

Find keys to unlock doors, dodge laser beams, avoid roving robots and more! Can you survive all 100 levels?

2003294836.title: A Time Traveller's Guide To Past Delicacies (Xbox Series X|S)
2003294836.short_description:
A short game about a fictional time traveler raiding the past to steal recipes. 

Follow a sock puppet into the dark bowels of time and learn new recipes. Meet your long-dead ancestors. Exploit them to further your cooking skills. Take some pictures of dinosaurs. Appropriate what you can. 

This is an experimental story-driven adventure. Don't expect state-of-the-art cooking gameplay. Mostly, you will watch videos, cook some simple meals, trying to cope with things falling out of hand, and explore some strange places.

2003316298.title: Hexa River
2003316298.short_description: Explore HEXA RIVER, a relaxing puzzle game where you guide water to bring life to islands. Enjoy 40 levels, soothing music, low-poly visuals, and rewarding achievements as you help crops thrive.

2003436578.title: Cinderscratch (Xbox Series X/S)
2003436578.short_description: Ashpaw, the last of the Flamekeepers, stands alone against a creeping corruption—an ancient plague that transforms all it touches into undead abominations. Once-bright cities and vibrant forests now echo with the moans of the cursed. Carrying the final ember of the Sacred Flame, Ashpaw must journey through this forsaken land, rekindling the ancient bonfires scattered across the realm. Each flame brings a spark of hope, and only when all are lit will the corruption retreat… and the world be saved.

2003460558.title: Speed Truck Racing
2003460558.short_description: In Speed Truck Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 200 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.

2003473581.title: Citizen Sleeper
2003473581.short_description: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

2003514545.title: KickBeat Special Edition
2003514545.short_description: From indie pioneers Zen Studios (makers of Pinball FX2 and CastleStorm) comes KickBeat Special Edition, an innovative rhythm game with a Kung Fu theme, featuring fully 3D characters and high-energy music! Beat-matching mechanics come to life in this kung-fu style music fighter, featuring licensed tracks from a diverse lineup of artists from well known bands such as Pendulum and Marilyn Manson, to indie pioneers Celldweller and Blue Stahli.

2003536034.title: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show
2003536034.short_description: A wild mix of faith, fangs, and first-person chaos.

2003553101.title: Rise Eterna War
2003553101.short_description: Rise Eterna War tells the bloody tale of Arthbane, a great general who led the last stand to reclaim his homeland Ars Rare from foreign invaders. Play as Arthbane, 10 years before the events of Rise Eterna, rallying loyalists in a desperate bid to seize the capital Gaiacus.

2003594594.title: くにおくん ザ・ワールド ～びっくり熱血新記録！ はるかなる金メダル～
2003594594.short_description:
2018年12月にリリースされた「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」に収録されている18作品から、
「びっくり熱血新記録！はるかなる金メダル」を単品作品としてリリース！！！

当時のタイトルをオリジナルのまま収録！
あの裏技やゲームバランスをそのままお楽しみいただけます！

【作品紹介】
本作は「ダウンタウン熱血行進曲 それゆけ大運動会」の続編にあたる作品で、
新たな5つの競技で競い、優勝を目指します。
くにおくんシリーズおなじみのなんでもありなルールに加え、
前作と比べるとオリジナリティの強い競技内容になっています。
また、今作ではショップでアイテムを購入し、対戦を優位に進めることもできます。

「くにお」が率いる熱血高校、「りき」が率いる花園高校、
「りゅういち・りゅうじ」がいる冷峰学園、「ごうだ」や「ごだい」がいる連合チームと、
アメリカから来た強豪オクラホマハイスクールの5チームが参戦します。

※プレイヤーは「オクラホマハイスクール」を操作することができません。
※本製品はオリジナル版のみでプレイいただけます。
クオリティアップ版は搭載されておりません。

※本製品は別売タイトル「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」とのネットワークプレイには対応しておりません。
本製品のネットワークプレイは、本製品同士のプレイヤーのみご利用いただけます。.

2003634783.title: Mimi the Cat: Meow Together
2003634783.short_description: Mimi the Cat – Meow Together: Enjoy a cute, strategic puzzle with 50 levels and local co-op!

2003685113.title: Club Tennis
2003685113.short_description: Tennis split screens multi-players Mario Nintendo wii switch grand slam Women's Tennis Association WTA ATP Challenger Tour tournaments.

2003714857.title: Dungeon Slime Collection
2003714857.short_description: Slide your way out of the dungeon!

2003727579.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III
2003727579.short_description: In the direct sequel to the record-breaking Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II, Captain Price and Task Force 141 face off against the ultimate threat.

2003750628.title: Thetaball
2003750628.short_description: An authentic digital sport with rich, physics-based gameplay and lifelike AI.

2003762766.title: Neon City Riders
2003762766.short_description: Explore a post-cyberpunk decaying city searching for new abilities and bizarre companions to free all its turfs from a group of vicious super-powered gangs.

2003803739.title: Maze-The Amazing Labyrinth
2003803739.short_description:
Maze (The Amazing Labyrinth) is interesting puzzle game for everyone. Get ready to face different types of challenges in the game.

Features
-Amazing Maze Puzzle game for everyone.
-Players ability will be judged in various complex situations. Game will start with easy puzzle levels with complex levels at a later stage.
-50 Different Levels in the game. Players excitement increases after every level.
-Many More.

Get Ready for Ultimate Brain Challenge.

2003805007.title: Arcade Archives 2 AQUA JET
2003805007.short_description:
"AQUA JET" is a marine sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
This game stood out at arcades at the time thanks to its large jet ski-style cabinet. 
Savor the thrill of racing across shimmering waves under the blazing sun in a stunning, resort-like setting brought to life by the "System Super 22" hardware!

2003863742.title: Microsoft Jigsaw
2003863742.short_description:
Piece together the FUN in Microsoft Jigsaw! Discover hundreds of puzzles across three (3) winning game modes: Classic, Jigsaw Jam, & Daily Challenges. 

Pick a favorite puzzle, create your own, or unlock NEW puzzle collections as you play. Find relaxation and joy as you exercise your mind.

Classic Jigsaw: Complete traditional jigsaw puzzles with endless themes and images to choose from. Select the number of pieces to make it easy, moderate or difficult. Zoom-in, auto-arrange, or use special in-game trays to get organized. If you enjoy real jigsaw puzzling, Classic Mode is the experience for you!

Jigsaw Jam: Looking for an energy boost, complete puzzles as you race against the clock. Place each piece quickly to earn bonus multipliers and build a high score! Jigsaw Jam is easy to play but challenging to master.

Daily Challenges: Discover new challenges every day! Complete fresh jigsaw puzzles and game modes to earn badges throughout the month. 

Custom Puzzles: Turn a favorite memory or photo into a jigsaw puzzle! Upload a picture to easily transform into playable pieces. Share your custom puzzles with friends and family.

Sign In: Create a Microsoft Account to save your progress, track your game stats or play on multiple devices. 

Play Microsoft Jigsaw today!

2003918395.title: Cubic 2 3 4 Player Games
2003918395.short_description: 35 Mini Party Games, Up to 4 player controller support, funny challenge with friends or family.

2003935652.title: ACA NEOGEO MAGICIAN LORD for Windows
2003935652.short_description:
MAGICIAN LORD is a side-scrolling action game released by SNK in 1990. 
This fantasy action game was one of the launch titles onNEOGEO. 
Control the magician Elta on a journey to save the world from Gal-Agiese, who came back to life once again.

2004031452.title: Smash Boats Waterlogged Edition
2004031452.short_description: LET’S GO SMASH! Bash, crash and smash through schools of enemies and horrendous hazards to collect star to become the ULTIMATE SMASHER!

2004071321.title: Black Desert - XBOX Series X|S Upgrade Install Pack
2004071321.short_description:
This product is available for free download exclusively to users who own the Xbox One X, Xbox One S version of Black Desert. Please note that you'll be able to access the game with this product only after the June 26, 2025 maintenance.

If you do not own the Xbox One X, Xbox One S version of Black Desert, you won't be able to purchase or download this product.
To use it, please first acquire a package that includes a game pass.

Black Desert is a revolutionary MMORPG that delivers intense, fast-paced combat, profitable life skills and an expansive open world. Slay monsters, abominations and gods, or engage in relaxing life skills like crafting, fishing and cooking. Become your true self in this truly open, open world MMORPG.

2004076451.title: Fruit Adventure
2004076451.short_description: Help Super Strawberry become the bravest Fruit in the Healthy Forest!

2004154041.title: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love
2004154041.short_description: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love is a satirical point and click inspired by the classic adventure games. It smuggles you out of your comfort zone and throws you into the middle of a Cold War spy intrigue - where there’s an even bigger game being played ….

2004155521.title: SOL DIVIDE -SWORD OF DARKNESS-
2004155521.short_description:
Enter a world of swords and sorcery in this fantasy shooter,
and crush the enemy's plan to revive ancient demons!
Now with online rankings!

2004155993.title: Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It’s About Time - Demo
2004155993.short_description:
Pre-Order Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It’s About Time digitally and get access to the Crash Bandicoot™ 4 Demo, available September 16, 2020*.

Get a taste of the time-bending madness before the game launches on October 2, 2020.

2004202673.title: Spica Adventure
2004202673.short_description: Pack your umbrella, it's time for an adventure!

2004230184.title: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 - Warehouse Demo
2004230184.short_description:
Pre-Order any digital edition of Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 and get access to the Warehouse Demo, available now*.

Skate as Tony Hawk in the iconic Warehouse Level and practice your tricks before the game launches on September 4, 2020.

2004278962.title: ZJ the Ball (Xbox Version)
2004278962.short_description: What do you get when you mix a ball who is looking for a gift to give his mom, a robot who loves to play arcade styled video games, and a Christian message? You get ZJ The Ball!

2004292351.title: Offroad Rally Racing
2004292351.short_description: Rally through sun, rain, and night.

2004313785.title: KILL KNIGHT
2004313785.short_description: KILL KNIGHT is an ultra-responsive arcade-inspired isometric action shooter. Condemned to eternal sufferance, deep within the voids of an eldritch arena, you must wield an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate swarms of otherworldly horrors - and MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.

2004428777.title: WILD HEARTS™ Standard Edition
2004428777.short_description: Master ancient tech to hunt down giant beasts. WILD HEARTS™ is a twist on the hunting genre where ancient tech gives you a fighting chance against giant nature-infused beasts. Set in a fantasy feudal Japan, hunt alone or with friends in seamless co-op.

2004585287.title: Revenge On Gold Diggers Demo
2004585287.short_description:
Brought to life by director Hu Yaohui and a team of film industry veterans. In this entirely fictional story, step into the role of a hunter of hearts and infiltrate a shadowy organization deep in emotional deceit.

The game features 472 minutes of cinematic footage. Comes with both Standard and Master modes. One purchase gives you the full experience.

You play as Wu Yulun, a man once shattered by betrayal, who deliberately turns himself into bait to strike back at a ruthless gold-digger ring. Step into the murky depths of love and deceit, navigating a perilous game against dazzling women, each one a force to be reckoned with.

A kind yet vulnerable rookie streamer. A model wrapped in candy-coated charm. A popular influencer who bends public opinion to her will. A cold-blooded fixer lurking in the shadows. And above them all, the unseen mastermind orchestrating it all.

This is no lighthearted romance sim. It’s a test of wit, will, and emotional endurance. Will you emerge as the hunter, or become the prey?

With over 200 decisions to make, your choices don’t just shape the story. They quietly tilt the scales of obsession, drawing you toward one of 38 endings.

Will you stand as avenger or redeemer? Yield to temptation, or seal an unholy pact with your sworn enemy? The die of destiny rattles, and your path lies open before you.

2004666712.title: Journey To The Savage Planet: Employee Of The Month
2004666712.short_description: The definitive, optimized version of Savage Planet with all DLC and running at 60FPS! Play alone or in 2P co-op as you explore a beautiful and surprising alien world! Explore, upgrade your gear, solve puzzles, and more in this hilarious first-person adventure!

2004727734.title: RIDE 5
2004727734.short_description: Rev up your engine and get ready to hit the track with RIDE 5. An adrenaline-filled gaming experience that is so authentic it will make you feel like you're truly racing at break-neck speed.

2004791398.title: Shroomageddon (Windows)
2004791398.short_description: In Shroomageddon, size is power. Collect coins and power-shrooms to grow, tower over your enemies, and smash through a chaotic world where only the biggest survive. Shrink, and you’re prey. Grow, and you bring despair to your enemies and hope to your allies!

2004795446.title: Miraculous - Paris Under Siege
2004795446.short_description: Step into the suits of Ladybug and Cat Noir in their most daring adventure yet! Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat and parkour agility collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city. It’s up to you and your friends to save Paris!

2004896584.title: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
2004896584.short_description:
The puzzle-solving mystery adventure masterpiece returns!
"Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective," created by Shu Takumi of the Ace Attorney series, is remastered in HD from its original 2010 release! Enjoy the remastered soundtrack by Yasumasa Kitagawa, and newly added "Illustrations" and "Music" features.

2004939306.title: Crysis 3 Remastered
2004939306.short_description: Experience the single-player experience from the iconic first-person shooter, Crysis 3, optimized for Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S in Crysis 3 Remastered.

2004944930.title: Crime Simulator
2004944930.short_description: Break in. Steal everything. Get out alive.

2004998164.title: White Shadows
2004998164.short_description: The wolves are watching! Venture through a captivating but brutal dystopia where our young adventurer Ravengirl will travel through this huge city’s brightest highs and delve to its darkest depths on her perilous journey of discovery and finding her destiny where hope seems in short supply.

2005013689.title: LEGO® Bricktales
2005013689.short_description: In this puzzle-adventure, use an intuitive brick-by-brick building mechanic to solve puzzles and bring your creations to life! Experience a charming story as you explore beautiful LEGO® dioramas and help the people inhabiting them.

2005028938.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
2005028938.short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is the unforgiving FPS survival adventure in a dark science-fiction open world.

2005074079.title: Whateverland: Prologue
2005074079.short_description: Find your way out of a magical prison in this non-linear point'n'click adventure full of mini games and challenges.

2005098069.title: Granny Theft Auto Reloaded
2005098069.short_description:
Granny Theft Auto - Reloaded

Help Granny get bran muffins and explore the big city.

2005154607.title: Mister Monser's Shooter
2005154607.short_description: Monser Shooter is a fast-paced, meme-styled action game where you blast round monsters, use crazy power-ups like speed boost, flying, and invincibility, and battle the tough boss Mr. Monser, all while chasing the highest score! 🎮🔥.

2005154977.title: Children of Morta
2005154977.short_description: Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

2005313515.title: Garten of Banban 7
2005313515.short_description:
Explore the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. 
Survive the dreads that reside below as you are now completely on your own. 
Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child….

2005327229.title: Winter Games 2023
2005327229.short_description: Winter Games 2023 is a classic sports game in a modern guise. The player can prove his/her athletic abilities in ten dynamic winter sports disciplines, for example, ski jumping, biathlon, ski cross, skeleton, or super-G.

2005330027.title: Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club (Xbox One)
2005330027.short_description:
Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club is a gripping continuation of Kaito’s story, set in a world of fierce battles and emotional growth.

After months of relentless training, Kaito enters his first professional fighting tournament, determined to prove himself. As he climbs the ranks, he faces not only skilled opponents but also people from his past — childhood friends, former crushes, and rivals turned companions. Each fight is charged with memories, tension, and hidden emotions.

With every victory and loss, Kaito grows — not just as a fighter, but as a person. Bonds are tested, old flames flicker, and the spotlight of the stage reveals more than just skill. It uncovers the heart beneath the gloves.

2005346857.title: Idle Wizard
2005346857.short_description: Idle Wizard is a RPG/Idle hybrid game about becoming the most powerful wizard. Choose your class, adopt a loyal pet, and customize your character through countless upgrades and enhancements. Uncover new sources of mana, advance your technologies, and master an array of spells to dominate the world of wizardry.

2005478922.title: A Frog's Job
2005478922.short_description: A soul-saving frog reaper with the power to stop time.

2005516677.title: Townseek Demo
2005516677.short_description: Take to the skies on a whimsical voyage across Explora and uncover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Trade, fish, mine, and farm, meeting whimsical characters and exploring vibrant towns along the way. The whole world is your sea now, so set sail and see all it has to offer!

2005529169.title: Mayhem Heroes
2005529169.short_description: Mayhem Heroes is a frenetic beat'em up where you need to take down as many enemies as possible and, preferably, be the last one standing. Use punches, kicks, super attacks and power ups to send your opponents flying out of the arena. Play with up to 4 friends and show them who's the boss!

2005535156.title: FORM
2005535156.short_description: Enter a surreal adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. Solve the mystery behind an ancient artifact. Advance through a world that transforms around you. Transcend this existence.

2005620545.title: Awesome Pea 3 (Xbox Series X|S)
2005620545.short_description: Fast precision platformer about the adventures of Pea, who loves gold.

2005642647.title: sCATch: The Painter Cat
2005642647.short_description: sCATch is a puzzle game where the goal is paint all colorful places of the maze and come to the exit. Combining colors and items with different mechanics on the way.

2005647110.title: Hot.Pursuit
2005647110.short_description:
Hot.Pursuit is a Windows store and a Windows Phone store game where you have to avoid the cops and collect all the coins. You can get the power roller and smash the police cars but soon they will be back, ready to chase you again.
The game has very addictive game play similar to the old and popular PacMan game.
Keep playing.

2005746482.title: LOOPOOL Chapter 1
2005746482.short_description:
A robot awakens, finding itself in a digital wasteland ravaged by a virus. LOOPOOL is a sci-fi adventure puzzle game that combines exploration, puzzles, and storytelling to gradually unveil the secrets behind these ruins.

A Solitary and Enigmatic Journey
One robot, one desolate and shattered world. No clamor of human voices, only the low hum of the wind blowing through the ruins and the faint buzz from a distant past. You are the only “life” in this wasteland, bearing a mission: to piece together the truth of this world’s collapse.

A Forgotten World
You will navigate through crumbling buildings and rusted machinery, using a neural data cable to decrypt the “Data Fragments” scattered throughout. 


A Battle of Survival and Strategy
Faced with threats lurking in the shadows, you must remain ever vigilant. Yet even so, every step is an adventure, every choice a matter of life or death. Will you press forward, or choose to retreat? This wasteland watches you—it never forgives mistakes.

Collecting Parts and Chips to Strengthen Yourself
Using the Neural Data Cable to Infiltrate Devices
Collectible “Data Echoes”

A Labor of One
This is a dream crafted single-handedly by an independent developer with sweat and passion. From every line of code to every design detail, it’s infused with heart and perseverance. This is more than a game—it’s a growing story—and you can be a part of it. Join our community, shape this world with me, and explore profound questions about humanity and the future: when machines rule all, are we still “us”?

2005753939.title: Astro Duel
2005753939.short_description: Astro Duel is a competitive local multiplayer party game for up to 6 players. Rounds are quick and death is sudden. Blast your friends into space. Run over their helpless bodies for good measure.

2005818033.title: Split Crystal (Windows)
2005818033.short_description: Master Crystals and Uncover the Secrets of Magic.

2005824828.title: Varenje
2005824828.short_description:
"All grown-ups were once children... but only few of them remember it."
― Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

Get yourself a little summer's day with a raspberry jam adventure!

Varenje is a cute colorful adventure with a number of puzzles and mini-games made by artists for anyone that considers games to be an art. 

Eight unique & gorgeously hand crafted chapters await you. Hours and hours of game play will take you to a far away enchanting place.


Our hero was spending summer happily at the cosy cottage until curiosity forced him to sample an unknown berry at the stream. Before he knew it, everything had become incredibly large, and he was reduced to the size of a bug!
Trying to understand what happened and how to return things back to normal, we set off into the invisible to the human eye tiny world, where worms, beetles and spiders live their life, and build bizarre vehicles, in disguise so that humans do not realize.
Our new friends will surely help us by discovering the secret healing potion, which will return us to our previous dimensions. All we need is to collect enough raspberries to cook grandmother's jam. And as we all know - this is a remedy for all ills!

2005921688.title: Mystic Fate
2005921688.short_description:
Help young Aris to solve the mystery of the fall of Asfand and It’s guild of alchemists, avenge the death of her brother, discover the limits of her powers all of that and more inside a 3D voxel action adventure game where you control weapons made of metal.

Aris has been training for all her life due to her special powers and skills along with her brother to go inside the Alchemists Dungeon and recover the long lost orbs to restore the peace in Asfand long thrilled by Koltors which after the fall of the alchemists guild has been winning the war. Recovering the orbs means Aris will have to discover what happened to her world many generations ago.

Features

- Play as Aris and control her powers over Coins and Swords master them and Fly over the Alchemists dungeon.
- Get to know all the History THrough many NPCs and Collect all the Scrolls to know exactly what happened to Asfand.
- Enjoy the Detailed Environment and rich enemy variety.

2005971285.title: Blast'N Bounty
2005971285.short_description:
Engage in retro vertical scrolling shoot’em up mayhem as Quad the frog bounty hunter!

Betrayed by his first mate, former gangster Quad returns years later as a space bounty hunter, setting his sights on the mafia’s 7 generals so he can finally exact his revenge against their now infamous leader! Blast’N Bounty is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up presented in a mix of retro pixel art and low poly 3D.

Inspired by genre classics, Blast’N Bounty offers modernized widescreen visuals, slick animations and intuitive controls that are easy to pick up but require a deft hand to really push Quad’s limits. Secure upgrade flasks to increase ship defenses and acquire a variety of drones, each with unique behavior that works in tandem with your main shot. Master 8 challenging levels! Blast through the 7 generals’ stages in any order before the final showdown!

2006171548.title: Battle Brothers
2006171548.short_description: Battle Brothers is a turn based tactical RPG which has you leading a mercenary company in a gritty, low-power, medieval fantasy world. You decide where to go, whom to hire or to fight, what contracts to take and how to train and equip your men in a procedurally generated open world campaign.

2006371800.title: Save the Puppies and Kittens
2006371800.short_description:
Remember the classic arcade game Defender? This is a homage to that great game.

Aliens have descended upon Earth with an evil mission to abduct all the puppies and kittens. It's up to you!! Save The Puppies and Kittens!!

With highly accurate radar you can use the all-powerful Smartbomb to destroy masses of enemies. Your ship is also equipped with Hyperspace for those emergency exits.

2006512061.title: There's a Gun in the Office
2006512061.short_description:
"You've been kidnapped and have to get out but luckily, there's a gun in the office. Unluckily, your captor comes back home every day, so you have to cover your tracks when you go out of your cell. Use each passing day to get closer to the gun until you can finally leave.
Imagine being trapped, kidnapped, and racing against the clock to escape. Locked in a room with nothing to protect you or even eat. You’re faced with a terrifying challenge: your captors return every day, so every action you take must be perfectly discreet. Each time you leave your room, you must leave everything exactly as you found it - or risk everything.

You have five days - Monday through Friday - to uncover your escape route. If you fail, you won’t survive. Every decision counts. Can you outsmart your captors and escape in time, or will you be trapped forever? Time is ticking.".

2006583983.title: What Lies in the Multiverse
2006583983.short_description: Welcome to What Lies in the Multiverse – a dimension-shifting, comedic adventure about worlds turned inside out through the powers of one gifted young boy and the misguided lessons of an eccentric scientist.

2006589220.title: DRAGON BALL FIGHTERZ (Windows)
2006589220.short_description:
DRAGON BALL FighterZ is born from what makes the DRAGON BALL series so loved and famous: endless spectacular fights with its all-powerful fighters.

Partnering with Arc System Works, DRAGON BALL FighterZ maximizes high end Anime graphics and brings easy to learn but difficult to master fighting gameplay.

And on top of many different online features, experience a never-seen-before scenario in the Story Mode!

2006666244.title: NBA 2K21 Next Generation
2006666244.short_description: The latest release in the world-renowned, best-selling NBA 2K series, NBA 2K21 leads the charge with next-gen innovations. Featuring extensive improvements upon its best-in-class graphics and gameplay, competitive and community online features, and deep game modes, NBA 2K21 offers one-of-a-kind immersion into basketball and culture - where Everything is Game.

2006671670.title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
2006671670.short_description: Carnival Survivors is a 2D roguelike survival game where you control a parade truck, recruit musicians with unique abilities, and create powerful builds to defeat hordes of aliens who hate Carnival.

2006710939.title: Skater XL
2006710939.short_description:
Skater XL is the evolution of skateboarding gameplay. With it’s Independent Foot Control System and unique physics-based gameplay, skate gamers finally have the expressive controls they have always dreamed of.

Dive into skateboarding paradise with levels that feature famous skate landmarks and environmental elements, including Downtown LA, the ginormous The Big Ramp, Easy Day High School, and community created maps like Grant Park, Hüdland and Streets. Play as some of today’s top skateboarding pros Tiago Lemos, Evan Smith, Tom Asta and Brandon Westgate, or customize and create your own skateboarding legend with gear from more than 30 real skate brands. Skater XL is truly the skateboarding world’s digital counterpart.

Skater XL features include:


Freedom Of Expression - Skater XL’s physics-based controls don’t have any pre-programmed tricks - only the movement through the thumbsticks. Each thumbstick is connected to the corresponding foot of the skater and as the player moves the stick, the board instantly responds. Much like a musical instrument, the player has complete freedom, whether it be pushing to nail a line or skating free from.

Real Life Iconic Locations - Skater XL levels are all inspired real-world skate areas and designed to ensure a constant flow of skate lines. From the DTLA Map with skateboarding landmarks around the Staples Center and LA Convention Center, to Easy Day High School’s sprawling campus of iconic skate spots like the Wallenberg Big 4 and the ‘Leap of Faith’, to the humongous ‘Big Ramp,’ where skaters can soar higher than a hawk.

Play As Real-Life Skate Pros - Select from renowned pros Tiago Lemos, Brandon Westgate, Evan Smith, and Tom Asta, all with their own distinct gear that fits their style.

Customizable Characters - The possibilities are endless to personalize the Skater XL experience. Players can customize their entire look, including their skater’s gear with different tees, hoodies, hats and shoes from over 30 of the most recognized skate brands like Vans, Santa Cruz, DC Shoes, Independent, Lakai and many more.

 Trick Challenges - Hundreds of challenges with progressive difficulties, to help build your bag of tricks as you move further toward the completing them all. Can check off the entire list??

Thriving Community - Join the thriving ecosystem of players creating, sharing and collaborating around the passion of Skater XL!

Legit Soundtrack - Modest Mouse, Getter, Interpol, Animal Collective, Future Islands and Band Of Horses headline the distinctive music that blends well with the Skater XL’s West Coast vibe and fluid physics-based control mechanics.

2006737498.title: The World Of One
2006737498.short_description: You are about to get on a journey around small planet-like worlds as if you were in the Little Prince's world. However, these ones are filled with monsters that are striving to kill you, deadly traps and riddles, which require you to be quick-witted and attentive.

2006741467.title: VISCO Collection
2006741467.short_description: Experience a blast from the past with the VISCO Collection.

2006790324.title: This Means Warp
2006790324.short_description: It’s co-op space survival fun but not as we know it. This Means Warp is an intense spaceship management roguelite experience for 1-4 players. Explore a procedurally generated universe, upgrade your ship, battle dangerous enemies and adapt your strategies to survive.

2006900752.title: Grand Vegas Casino
2006900752.short_description:
Become a gambling master without the financial risk as you test your skills in the world's most popular casino games!

Feeling lucky? Step into the Grand Vegas Casino and try your hand at 4 of the most popular gambling games in the world, with no need to get dressed up or risk your wallet! Grand Vegas Casino is a casual gambling simulation game for players of all skill levels, offering intuitive controls and a fluidly animated HD-2D graphic style to keep you immersed in luxurious high-rolling action.

Build your strategy, improve your skills, place daring bets and experiment to win. Featured casino games include Poker, Roulette, Blackjack and Slots, each with unique mechanics and standard rules that have made them timeless staples of the gambling scene. Play against computer-controlled opponents and unlock cool rewards as you progress! Are you ready to go all in?

2006910211.title: Orion Haste
2006910211.short_description: Defeat hordes of aliens in this run and gun game.

2006916030.title: X1D Menu Reloaded : appx Installer
2006916030.short_description: this is a appx bundle installer for xbox one.

2006937710.title: PACER
2006937710.short_description: PACER®is high-octane anti-gravity racing at its most destructive. Customise your craft and weapons then engage in the campaign, a single-player race or compete against your rivals in explosive online multiplayer for the ultimate combat racing experience.

2006975230.title: Air Twister
2006975230.short_description: Yu Suzuki's return to the Rail Shooter genre.

2006984089.title: Ralph The Buddy 3
2006984089.short_description: Ralph, a very brave Buddyano, sets out on a journey to end Doctor Big Boar's plans, recovering the stolen crystallinis, but he must face the entire population of mini monsters that has been scattered to prevent his victory.

2007018418.title: The Hong Kong Massacre
2007018418.short_description: Blast your way through the streets of Hong Kong in a fast-paced, top-down shooter.

2007033271.title: 80's OVERDRIVE
2007033271.short_description: Ultimate racing game in a style of 80's with the best synth music.

2007070358.title: Young Souls
2007070358.short_description: Young Souls is a gorgeous 2D brawler meets story-rich action RPG. Fight hordes of belligerent goblins, level up with hundreds of weapons and accessories, explore, and journey between worlds, as rebellious twins battle their way to save their foster father.

2007236764.title: The Excrawlers (Windows 10)
2007236764.short_description: Excrawlers is an action-RPG rougelike game in which you and other heroes will embark into dark atmospheric dungeons and realms full of monsters and madness. Embark into parallel realms, defeat ancient monsters and find your way out!

2007242268.title: Pupperazzi
2007242268.short_description: Who will photograph, pet, and befriend these dogs if you don't? The world NEEDS you in Pupperazzi, the dog photography game!

2007283473.title: Recompile
2007283473.short_description: Recompile is a 3D Metroidvania-inspired hacking adventure set in the Mainframe.

2007294646.title: Jelly Math (Xbox Series)
2007294646.short_description: Mix, Combine and Hit the Perfect Result.

2007314399.title: Run, Elric! (XBOX SERIES)
2007314399.short_description: Run, Elric! is a 2D pixel-art platformer set in a mysterious forest filled with danger. You play as Elric, a quick-witted courier whose wagon was ambushed, scattering his coins. Unarmed, he must dash, jump, and outsmart monsters while avoiding traps and reclaiming his treasure. From eerie clearings to caverns with slimes, skeletons, and zombies, each step is a challenge. With tight controls and retro spirit, can Elric survive and recover his fortune?

2007366287.title: Welcome to Elk
2007366287.short_description:
Welcome to Elk is a biographical adventure set on an island like no other, where every character you encounter has a story to tell. From the weird and wonderful to the dark and desperate, all the tales told on Elk are based on true stories of life on the road less traveled.

Welcome to Elk, an adventure game set on a fictional island stitched together with true stories and tall tales, and inhabited by the people who lived them.
You play as Frigg, a young carpenter trading their busy life in the city for an apprenticeship in a small town. When she arrives in Elk, Frigg worries that the slower pace of life will be boring (they don’t even have the internet), but quickly discovers nothing could be further from the truth!
Tragic stories told with love and sometimes humour.

The stories reflect the drama of our lives, on Elk it’s known that humour, love and death go hand in hand. Life may seem hard sometimes, but it is always followed by laughter.

On Elk, you will meet weird and wonderful characters - people whom the world has either ignored or forgotten. Follow their ups and downs, their odd drinking rituals and their unique ways of tackling whatever life throws at them.

Help your new friends on Elk through playful mini games. All games are uniquely tailored to underline the story and the mood of the game.

We value the importance of storytellers, those who carry the tales of others and share them. That's why, in Elk, you will also meet the living storytellers who inspired us to make this game.

2007405472.title: KaelynsDiary
2007405472.short_description: You are trapped in a strange world. You have no idea who you are, where you are, or what your purpose is. Monsters roam the streets along with some at times unhelpful people. Perhaps the key to escaping this nightmare can be found in Kaelyn's Diary.

2007503868.title: Asylum Nightmares
2007503868.short_description: In Asylum Nightmares, explore a terrifying asylum in two game modes: in story mode, use a service elevator to light up the floors and eliminate zombies; in horde mode, survive waves, earn points, and unlock weapons and rooms. Dare to face your nightmares!

2007523425.title: RetroRev28 DevilutionX
2007523425.short_description: This is a port of DIablo. Assets are not included.

2007643379.title: Bouncy Chicken
2007643379.short_description:
Fire your feathery fowl and collect those corn cobs!

It’s time for some fun on the farm in whimsical action puzzler Bouncy Chicken! Master single-screen challenges in top-down 3D style as you take aim at fire your feathered projectile around the chicken pen to gather cobs of corn. In each of the 90 unique levels of Bouncy Chicken, you’ll have only a few shots available to shoot a chicken in any direction, ricocheting off the fence, brick walls and springy obstacles or even through warp points. The objective is to collect every cob of corn on screen before your shot chances run out.

Can you clear every stage, or will this game run… a fowl?

2007728129.title: Gangsta Paradise
2007728129.short_description:
Time to take matters into your own hands... Matters or guns... it doesn't matter.

For years, your city was peaceful. Then Al Calzone and his goons showed up, demanding “protection” money. Pay up, or else.
And now, they’re targeting your mom’s flower shop?
Big mistake.
Because if there’s one thing more dangerous than the mafia… it’s a kid defending his mom’s roses.
Lock, load, and show these thugs what happens when you mess with family.

2007729022.title: Recycle Bin Battle
2007729022.short_description: a video game different from the others. an arcade concentrate in a Japanese atmosphere. All accompanied by Jpop and FMV video.

2007771861.title: Woven the Game
2007771861.short_description: Explore a woollen world where stuffed animals once lived in peace. Search for hidden secrets and customize your character with different animal shapes to solve puzzles. An epic adventure with two very unlikely heroes and a story narrated in rhyme.

2007776940.title: Captain Nemo - Seek and Find Games
2007776940.short_description:
A game based on "20,000 Leagues under the Sea", a famous novel by Jules Vernes. 

It tells the story of the incredible journey of mysterious Captain Nemo and three friends, who have inadvertently found themselves on board his underwater vessel, the Nautilus.
Frigate Abraham Lincoln sets out to search for an undiscovered sea monster. The expedition, in which Pierre Aronnax, his loyal servant Conseil, and Canadian harpooner Ned Land take part, finds the monster and starts a chase. Unexpectedly, the monster turns out to be a unique underwater vessel. Professor Aronnax and his two companions are taken prisoner by the captain of the Nautilus named Nemo. Despite the fascinating beauty of the undersea realm, the three friends yearn to break free and return to normal life on dry land...

Special features:
- Vibrant interiors of a character vessel, magical underwater views, and tropical islands.
- Complex and diverse locations: experience regular landscapes alongside 360-degree panoramas and 3D views!

 Game mechanics:
The game includes scenes where the task is to find the hidden object, transitional scenes between search locations, scenes for finding differences, and search for pairs of identical items.

Jules Verne was an author who always surprised the world. His stories are so realistic that, even today, readers are convinced that the journeys he described were real.

2007812138.title: Sugar Tanks
2007812138.short_description:
Sugar Tanks is an intense, fast-paced, and super sweet tank shooter game. 
 It is fun, looks cute, is addicting, and is a hell of a lot more difficult at the end than you would imagine. 
 Be ready for a colorful, caries-inducing bullet-hell twin-stick shooter!

2008066354.title: Car Mechanic Simulator
2008066354.short_description: Build and expand your repair service empire in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game, where attention to car detail is astonishing. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module.

2008076188.title: Galaxy Kingdoms (Windows)
2008076188.short_description: Explore planets, face monsters, and conquer riches in Galaxy Kingdoms!

2008114824.title: Microsoft Number Puzzle

2011834319.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 6
2011834319.short_description:
All 5 games are fast-paced and controlled with a single button.

FROOOOG. You are a frog trying to cross the road. Press a button to jump forward, hold a button to stick out your tongue and jump farther. Score points by going as far as you can while avoiding the moving cars.
The game is over when you get hit.

SNAKE 1. Play Snake with just one button. Collect coins to score points and to make the snake grow in size. Press a button to rotate 90 degrees. You rotate clockwise initially, but you reverse your direction every time you collect a coin.
The game is over when you hit any of the borders of the screen or the snake hits its tail.

SCREEN. Your screen is split into halves with enemies falling down on each side. Only one side of the screen is visible at a time. Your goal is to shoot the enemies to prevent them from going down. Press a button to shoot once the trajectory is right. You have 3 shots on each side and you switch sides once you shoot all 3 of them.
The game is over when any enemy on any side reaches the bottom of the screen.

BALL TOUR. Your goal is to fly forward and avoid the spikes in the air. There are 2 types of spikes: a standing one, and a moving one. Hold any button to speed up. There are bonuses in the air which add score when you collect them. The score is added using a multiplier, which increases when you collect a bonus by 10 and decreases each second until reaches 1.
The game is over when you hit a spike.

SPEARAIN. You are constantly running from side to side. Your goal is to avoid getting hit by the spears falling from the top. Hold a button to run faster and to slow down the spears. You score one point each time you bump into a wall and reverse your direction. Collect the falling coins to score additional points.
The game is over when you get hit by a spear.

Left/Right/Up/Down = Map scroll
0...9 = Select group
