2033129745.title: Fallen Knight
2033129745.short_description:
A Futuristic Knight's Tale

Fallen Knight is a futuristic knight’s tale that lets players take on the role of a Knight of the Round Table. Play as Lancelot or Galahad the 50th, descendants of the legendary knights from King Arthur’s tales, and face off against unique enemy heroes; each with a dark past of their own. Expect a Dark Souls-esque challenging experience coupled with a fast-paced sword action gameplay that will punish players for every little mistake, and reward generously with every victory.

Nostalgia-fuelled platforming

Enjoy nostalgia-fueled gameplay that players have come to know and love, but with unique combat systems such as Lancelot’s “Parry & Disarm” or Galahad’s “Assassinate”. When playing as Lancelot, the Honorable Knight, killing should be a last resort, disarm your enemies and parry their attacks as you clear level after level. As Galahad, the elite Assassin, assassinate your enemies swiftly and ruthlessly.

Intense boss battles

Take on the formidable bosses of The Purge who stand in your way from protecting Neo Utopia and the information you're sworn to protect. Each boss holds their own challenge, their own trials to overcome. Are you up to the challenge and live up to your reputation as a “Knight of the Round Table”?

Lancelot’s Path

As Lancelot, the Honorable Knight, Fallen Knight allows players to also choose the way they play the game. There are multiple endings, which are determined by the actions each player takes. Players may choose to kill their enemies or skilfully Parry & Disarm their enemies, exhibiting the mercy and honor of a Knight of the Round Table. How you play leads you to discover different endings of the game and story.

Galahad’s Path

As Galahad, as an Assassin from the Knights of the Round Table. Players will take an alternative route through the story and help Galahad save Neo Utopia from The Purge. ‘Galahad’s Path’ brings rogue-like gameplay to Fallen Knight, where players only have “one life”. If players fail, they will have to restart from the first stage so be careful!

2037036894.title: Paradox Error
2037036894.short_description:
Adapt and overcome glitches in an ever-changing digital world!

Paradox Error is a surreal take on the scrolling platformer format, combining minimalistic black-and-white presentation with self-aware, fourth wall breaking design. Glitches are intentionally integrated, allowing the player to cheat death, open new areas by triggering bugs or leap off of UI elements as if they’re part of the stage. The title screen’s main menu acts as a respawn hub, cursors may appear as enemies or helpful guides, graphical errors obscure parts of the screen and the player’s character explodes into pixels upon death.

To survive, you’ll have to quickly identify which portions of the screen can be reached, which pixels can be touched and which ones are simply background art. Adapt as gameplay suddenly shifts to a different perspective or requires interaction with a glitched object to proceed. At its core, Paradox Error is an ever-changing environmental puzzle where you’re expected to die repeatedly and use those failures to inform further attempts, until the goal is eventually within reach. Decidedly hardcore in difficulty but fair enough to encourage repeated play, this is an exercise in trial-and-error, where determination becomes its own reward.

2037049699.title: Demolish & Build 3

Step into the boots of a demolition company owner. Accept and complete contracts to earn money, allowing you to buy new equipment and upgrade your business. Use powerful tools, from sledgehammers to giant excavators, and experience the realism of a true construction site, where every brick matters.

Demolish & Build 3 is a first-person simulation game in which you play the role of a demolition company owner. Your main tasks involve demolishing and building various structures, while managing your growing company. To help you with those tasks, you can utilize a wide array of diverse tools, equipment and vehicles.

The construction site is yours
Breaking walls, cutting roofs, leveling land and building new structures are your daily bread. Diverse tasks from your customers are an excellent opportunity to earn a lot of money. Will you be able to complete them quickly and accurately enough to meet their expectations?

Start the engines!
Throughout the game, you can use numerous vehicles, all with detailed models and sounds. Each can be driven both from a cabin and outside perspective. Some vehicles, such as the Excavator, include several different attachments like shears or jackhammers to help you with more specialized tasks.

The most realistic approach
Have fun with a brand new, realistic demolish model, where every tool, vehicle and fragment is physically simulated. All parts of the structures interact with each other, meaning that getting rid of a few strategically placed elements can collapse an entire building. Delve into the perfect balance between realism, performance and joy of destruction.

You are the boss
You’ll start the game with a small plot of land and a simple shack. By the end, you’ll own a vehicle park. Every machine is versatile and can handle various tasks, leaving you to choose the right one for the job. Find your favorite set of equipment, master its operation and put it to good use!

2038764460.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 4
2038764460.short_description:
BALLS BOMBS is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to move forward and avoid the bouncing balls all around you. Hold a button to walk. There are bombs lying on the ground and when you touch one you will turn into a bomb. When a ball hits you while you're in a bomb form, the bomb will explode and destroy all the balls within the radius of its explosion. You score points for each destroyed ball.

The game is over when a ball touches you while you're not a bomb.

BAROLL is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly moving forward. Your goal is to avoid being hit by the barrels falling from the top and rolling towards you. Press a button to jump and hold a button to jump and slow down.

The game is over when you get hit by a barrel.

BAMBOO is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly running and cutting bamboo that grows in random places. You score points by collecting bamboo. You can run through yellow bamboo to collect it. When bamboo becomes green, you have to cut it multiple times to stop it and you don't get any points from it. Your goal is to stop bamboo from growing and reaching the top.

The game is over when bamboo reaches the top of the screen.

TWO FACED is a fast-paced one-button game.

Play snake on two sides of the square. The snake is constantly rotating clockwise and speeding up while rotating. Hold a button to move straight but you will also speed up. Collect the apples to score points and make the snake grow in size.

The game is over when the snake hits its tail.

LIGHT DARK is a fast-paced one-button game.

The screen is split horizontally in two halves: light and dark, and the dark side is upside down. You are constantly moving forward and every time you press a button you switch between the sides. You also jump by pressing a button and can fly some distance by holding a button. Collect the coins to score points and avoid hitting the spikes.

The game is over when you hit the spikes.

2040415843.title: ABRISS - build to destroy
2040415843.short_description:
ABRISS is an atmospheric physics-destruction building game.

Build structures from parts to let them crash into your targets. Unlock new parts, destroy more, witness entropy at its worst in digital-brutalist cityscapes. Build to destroy.

GAMEPLAY

BUILD
Choose from parts with different weights, forms and functions to build a structure.

Thruster + Connector + Bomb? You just built a rocket. 
Thruster + Rotator + Laser? You just built a rotating laser rocket. 
Pillar + Connector + Ultra Heavy Cube? That's a giant hammer. 

Be creative and resourceful with the parts you get, try to destroy the target with less parts or in a more elegant way – it's going to be a spectacle any way you do it.

DESTROY
Try to hit the main targets to win a level in campaign mode. Destroy an armored wall first so you can then shoot through the hole into the vulnerable center. Try to hit a bomb in the environment. Use environment mechanics like the giant Pistons to catapult Ultra Heavy Cubes into a target. Or just throw everything you have at your targets – that might just work too.

FEATURES

COMPLEX DESTRUCTION SYSTEM
Simulated statics, thousands of little particles of debris, whole chunks of targets flying into the abyss – with little to no framerate spikes.

CAMPAIGN
Seven worlds with several stages including bonus levels each, every stage a hand-crafted destructible cityscape. You will start each stage with a limited set of parts and you will need to find a strategy on how to use them to destroy all main target blocks. You will unlock new parts the further you progress, and every world comes with it's own special environmental mechanic. You can always return to a stage to try to destroy a higher percentage of it, or do it in less moves.

SANDBOX
Try out new patterns of building stuff. Play around with parts you haven't unlocked yet. Try to fry your GPU with 1000 Lasers at once.

NEW: ENDLESS MODE
Play the new Endless game mode and try to reach the ultimate highscore. 

PHOTO MODE
take a free camera flying to get the best composition. Freeze or slow down time to get the perfect shot of the destruction you just caused. Apply filters to change the vibe of your photography. Export in wonderfully sharp 4k jpegs. Share them with us!

My Time at Sandrock-Just like My Time at Portia, My Time at Sandrock takes place in a wholesome post-apocalyptic world 300 years after the Day of Calamity destroyed most modern technologies.
After accepting a job offer to become Sandrock’s newest Builder, you’ll arrive in the wild and rugged city-state, where it’s up to you and your trusty tools to restore the community to its former glory. Gather resources to build machines, befriend locals, and defend Sandrock from monsters — all while saving the town from economic ruin!
---------------------------------
Key Features
Build Your Workshop
Transform a run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility! Use an intricate set of machines to process materials and produce parts of huge structures before assembling them piece by piece to help Sandrock flourish.
Create hundreds of unique items at the worktable to decorate your homestead, give gifts to Sandrock’s residents, or assist with community requests.

Explore the Open World
Explore vast deserts surrounding the city-state of Sandrock. Dive into ruins to dig for Old World relics, seek our materials in hard-to-reach locations, or spend time relaxing in Sandrock with your neighbors.

Extensive Stories for NPCs
Experience a detailed story complete with hundreds of sidequests and over 30 all-new characters. Spend time getting to know Sandrock’s residents, uncovering backstories, and making meaningful connections along the way.

New Combat
Quickly shift between melee combat and third-person shooting mechanics in dynamic action battles.Use the new weapons and defense break mechanic to your tactical advantage, or boost your stats to simply smash through battles!

Mini Games

And More

+Advanced Divine Skills: Experience 8 major skill element factions (Thunder, Wind, Ice, Fire, Earth, Poison, Holy, Dark). Freely mix and match different attack skills that can be upgraded to divine level for double combat power.
+Summon Guardian Spirits: The game features a wide array of unique Guardian Spirits with diverse skills and abilities, fighting and growing with you.

2041063925.title: Lake
2041063925.short_description: It's 1986 - Meredith Weiss takes a break from her career in the big city to deliver mail in her hometown. How will she experience two weeks in beautiful Providence Oaks, with its iconic lake and quirky community? And what will she do next? It's up to you.

2041076002.title: Curse of the Dead Gods (PC)
2041076002.short_description:
You seek untold riches, eternal life, divine powers - it leads to this accursed temple…

- A skill-based roguelike exploring a cruel, dark temple made of endless rooms and corridors
- Swords, spears, bows, guns - wield these and many more
- Unique curses influence each attempt, putting a twist on every action
- Dozens of enemies, with powerful champions and deadly bosses to face off against.

2041098926.title: Paper Glider
2041098926.short_description: Paper Glider is a construction-paper-styled game in which you control a gliding paper triangle through a series of 70 unique and colorful levels. The controls are simple to understand but difficult to master, leading to a challenging and rewarding gameplay experience. Learn to master your momentum to complete all 7 worlds!

2041142160.title: Maximum Football
2041142160.short_description: Build your dream team and compete your way in Maximum Football, the free-to-play football game where customization, strategy, and community shape the ultimate gridiron experience.

2041185325.title: Flatland Vol.2
2041185325.short_description: The second game of the series FLATLAND.

2041223764.title: Ball X Tomb
2041223764.short_description:
Ball X Tomb is a fast-paced roguelike survival game set in a cursed land filled with tombstones and rising undead. Waves of skeletons and dark creatures crawl out of their graves, and your only chance to survive is mastering powerful magical orbs, elemental spells, and deadly synergies.

Every run is unique. Random upgrades, evolving spell types, and unexpected combinations force you to adapt on the fly. Fuse fire, ice, poison, and other elements to wipe out enemy hordes while the difficulty relentlessly escalates.

With simple controls, satisfying visual effects, and constant pressure from ever-growing enemy waves, Ball X Tomb is easy to pick up but hard to master. The graves are opening, the dead are awakening — how long can you survive?

2041230520.title: Coffee Shop Simulator – The Retail Tycoon
2041230520.short_description: Run your dream café! Brew espresso, cappuccinos, and tasty treats 🍩🍵, serve happy customers, and grow your coffee empire with upgrades and expansions. Easy to play, fun to master — become the ultimate coffee tycoon today! 💰🚀.

2041309731.title: The House™
2041309731.short_description: In a strange house apparently floating in thin air, you must explore other worlds to find out what lurks in the dark.

2041331081.title: Shopping Mall Girl
2041331081.short_description: Dress up in fabulous outfits and walk the runway like a pro!

2041393610.title: EvilUP
2041393610.short_description: Build your character’s skills and brave dungeons full of monsters.

2041544227.title: Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus (Xbox One)
2041544227.short_description: The Secret of the Sacred Numbers.

2041565858.title: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia
2041565858.short_description:
Slay demons to avenge your fallen father in side-scrolling action platforming style!

When a boy’s father is suddenly slain by a terrifying lightning demon, he courageously sets out on a quest of vengeance. Take the role of this young hero as he learns to gather and wield powerful demon magic known as Clarity. Run, jump, air dash and swing your sword as you traverse 7 worlds in side-scrolling style, slaying lesser demon spawn and avoiding treacherous traps to reach the boss of each unique stage!

Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia is an action platforming adventure with a focus on thoughtful reward, all presented in hand-drawn HD style. Customize the experience with multiple difficulty settings. Choose whichever stage you want to tackle first but be mindful to collect demon swords from defeated bosses in an order that grants a strategic advantage against the next. Each demon has an elemental weakness to exploit! Use melee slashes from your swords or execute spells with your staff by consuming the Clarity you’ve claimed from fallen foes. Will you be prepared for the final showdown?

2041573360.title: Island of Winds Demo
2041573360.short_description: Island of Winds is an adventure game set in a fantastical world inspired by 17th century Iceland and folklore. Experience the story of Brynhildur, a Balance Keeper who embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Core gameplay involves intriguing puzzles, spellcasting, and a focus on empathy encounters.

2041634175.title: 2048 Maniac
2041634175.short_description: The game’s objective is to slide numbered tiles on a 4×4 grid and combine them to create a tile with higher numbers. The game is won when a tile with a value of 2048 appears on the board.

2041657073.title: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2026
2041657073.short_description:
Step into the shoes of a Border Patrol officer in Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2026, an immersive and highly detailed simulation game.
Take on the challenging role of a border officer where every decision matters, from inspecting documents to uncovering smuggling operations. Navigate a world full of moral dilemmas, corruption, and high-stakes encounters as you work to secure the border.
Key Features:
 • Immersive Realism – Patrol diverse terrains and bustling border checkpoints with lifelike detail.
 • Authentic Equipment – Utilize advanced border control tools, vehicles, and surveillance gadgets to detect contraband.
 • Varied Missions – Handle document inspections, vehicle searches, interrogations, and complex smuggling cases.
 • Dynamic Narrative – Shape your journey through morally ambiguous choices and face the consequences of your actions.
 • Consequence-driven Gameplay – Every decision influences your career, reputation, and the fate of those you encounter.
 • Tense Action – Experience suspenseful confrontations, high-pressure inspections, and thrilling arrests.
Will you enforce the law at all costs, or bend the rules for personal gain? Your choices define your career and the fate of the border.

2041731932.title: Cult of the Lamb
2041731932.short_description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

2041750603.title: Cursed Village
2041750603.short_description: Cursed Village is a game about the history of an ancient abandoned town.

2041760605.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious!
2041760605.short_description: The million selling classic serves up some delish dishes and challenging gameplay for both single player and local co-op!

2041763016.title: CrossCode
2041763016.short_description: CrossCode is all about how it plays! Take the best out of two popular genres, find a good balance between them and make a great game. That’s what CrossCode does. You get the puzzles of Zelda-esque dungeons and are rewarded with the great variety of equipment you know and love from RPGs.

2041877435.title: Blaster Master Zero
2041877435.short_description: Mutant scum never learn! Blaster Master Zero is a 8-bit style top-down & sideview 2D action-adventure game that hearkens back to the golden age of the NES.

2041907684.title: Perfect Ninja Painter
2041907684.short_description: Ninjas have never been... painting! Prepare for a colorful, fast-paced adventure!

2041908109.title: LOVE ETERNAL
2041908109.short_description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative.

2041914388.title: Fight'N Rage
2041914388.short_description:
Set in a far future where humans are enslaved by mutants, Fight’N Rage is a side-scroller beat’em up inspired by the classics from the 90's arcade gems. 
 
In a world where “the law of the jungle” prevails… two humans and a mutant rebel are willing to fight in order to stop this madness. 
Get ready to face ruthless mutants... Get ready to Fight'N Rage. 
 
Features: 
* Several endings: Your in-game actions will decide the story! 
* Explosive combo system: Blow up your enemies with special combos! 
* Lots of unlockables: Costumes, Game Modes, Options and even Playable Enemies! 
* Different weapons and Parry System. 
* Easy to play, hard to master. 
* Local co-op mode: Up to 3 players with optional friendly fire. 
* VS Mode: 1vs1 battles against another player or the CPU. Or simply watch CPU vs CPU battles. 
* Additional near impossible extra challenges for pro-gamers!

2041914938.title: Nuclear Throne
2041914938.short_description: Can you reach the Nuclear Throne?

2042086551.title: Porkshire Hero
2042086551.short_description: Join Porkshire Hero on a delightful yet daring quest to collect all the apples needed to save the princess! In this charming and colorful adventure, you'll meet Pink Pig, a charismatic and brave hero, as he embarks on a journey through vibrant forests and treacherous mountains. Along the way, he'll face formidable enemies and navigate deadly traps, but with courage and skill, he might just succeed in his mission.

2042119715.title: Star Renegades
2042119715.short_description: Star Renegades is a dimension spanning rogue-lite strategy RPG. Outsmart uniquely generated adversaries, forge bonds between heroes and end the cycle!

2042161530.title: XboxOneTestUWP.NoUGCorOnlineComm.13
2042161530.short_description: Xbox One test UWP game enrolled in the Xbox Live Creators Program that does not allow user generated content or online communications.

2042245331.title: Deep Beyond
2042245331.short_description:
In the short story "Deep Beyond," dive into a world of mystery and adventure alongside Lilly as she embarks on her quest. Explore ancient wrecks, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets of her past as you journey through the depths of the ocean. 


FEATURES:

- Dive deep into an underwater adventure.

- Immerse yourself in fully-voiced characters.

- Solve challenging puzzles to uncover the secrets.

- Take Chester on every step of your journey.

- Enjoy stunning visuals with vibrant colors.

2042287543.title: Aliens: Dark Descent
2042287543.short_description: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Moon Lethe.

2042359572.title: Super Soldier Quest S|X Demo
2042359572.short_description: The Platformer that takes place in the sky. And has a free mode too.

2042399211.title: Spellcaster University

2042417208.title: Obsurity (for Windows 10)
2042417208.short_description:
Obsurity swept the whole of Ahn'koval. Eternal darkness and pain is all that we have.
Obsurity - Atmospheric action with puzzles and two playable characters.
The story tells about the fate of a knight exile and a young treasure seeker.
One interconnecting tale of suffering and sacrifice.

2042419031.title: Space Boat Demo
2042419031.short_description: Solve puzzles, run unsanctioned underground races, explore strange new worlds, and travel the galaxy!

2042429958.title: Derelict Fleet
2042429958.short_description:
Derelict Fleet is a fast-paced, space combat game. You are tasked with defending a refugee fleet as you travel the stars searching for a new colony to call home. In each of the game's missions you will need to fight off enemies ranging from small stunt fighters to giant capital ships. You will encounter a variety of enemies, including The Alliance forces who's attack drove you from your home planet, the reclusive Thaalian Empire, and the combat thirsty Space Pirates. Earning medals for completing each mission with certain goals (such as shot accuracy, lives lost, targeting computer usage, and finding hidden power cubes) grant you unlocked perks. Unlocking additional ships, upgrades, and more will help you protect the fleet on it's journey.

Uses Xbox One controller. No other peripherals supported.

2042798246.title: Togges

2042813249.short_description:

2042818026.title: Eternity Warriors™ VR
2042818026.short_description: Eternity Warriors™, an action game franchise is globally recognized by millions of fans, debuting 6 years ago on mobile. Packed with classical action game essences, high-definition visual, and real-time multiplayer features.

2042858232.title: Lines and Boxes
2042858232.short_description: In the game of Lines and Boxes, players take turns joining two horizontally or vertically adjacent lines until a player completes the forth side of the square (a box). When all boxes have been coloured, the game ends and the player who has coloured more boxes wins.

2042908226.title: Rugby League 26
2042908226.short_description:
FORGE YOUR LEGACY!
Step on the pitch in the most authentic Rugby League experience yet! Whether you dream of guiding your club to glory, building your very own ‘Pro Team’ or crafting a superstar from the ground up, Rugby League 26 put YOU in control.

2042909038.title: Endless Swimming Rafting
2042909038.short_description:
Endless Swimming Rafting Game

Increase your speed and difficulty by collecting rafts that come your way.

2042945112.title: Atomicrops
2042945112.short_description: Atomicrops is an action-packed roguelite farming simulator where you must cultivate and defend the last farm in the post-apocalypse wasteland. Farm mutated crops, marry townsfolk, and kill every mutant creature that tries to invade!

2042949468.title: Labyrinthine - Console Edition Demo
2042949468.short_description: A thrilling co-op horror game. Team up online, explore procedurally generated mazes, solve puzzles, collect items, and face terrifying monsters as you fight to survive the mysterious horrors that lurk within.

2042987745.short_description: A boy lost in a coma.

2042995696.short_description: The heartwarming saga of Marnie and Lisbeth continues.

2043013025.title: Jett Rider - Reduce, reuse and BLAST IT OFF!
2043013025.short_description:
Jett Rider, the most unlikely hero stars in the biggest 2D adventure of the year. Save the planet Gravos, free its people, face the toughest bosses... And don't forget to recycle!_x000d_
_x000d_
A collision in the orbit of the planet Gravos is the starting point of an unforgettable adventure with tons of fun and love for the classics. Jett, the space sweeper, was only supposed to pick up the wreckage of the AC-137 cargo ship, but he soon discovered that something messy was brewing on the surface of Gravos.

2043073184.title: Halo Infinite
2043073184.short_description: From one of gaming's most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever with a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.

2043103768.title: YIIK: A Postmodern RPG
2043103768.short_description: Prepare to take into your veins the I.V. patch of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG, a Japanese-style RPG that pushes the boundaries of what you know to be real.

2043130271.title: Saborus
2043130271.short_description: Saborus is a thrilling horror adventure in which you guide a brave chicken through a deadly slaughterhouse where everything wants to kill you!

2043177849.title: Total Arcade Racing
2043177849.short_description:
Experience fast-paced arcade racing action in Total Arcade Racing.
Race solo or with up to 8 players on the same screen across multiple game modes. Inspired by classic top-down racers like Super Sprint, Slicks ’n Slide and Super cars. Total Arcade Racing features tight controls, thrilling tracks, and non-stop fun.

Challenge players from around the world in the global leaderboard. Can you claim the #1 spot in the Hall of Fame?

2043223846.title: TUNIC SGDemo
2043223846.short_description: TUNIC is an action adventure about a tiny fox in a big world. Explore the wilderness, discover spooky ruins, and fight terrible creatures from long ago.

2043228555.title: The Smile Alchemist
2043228555.short_description: Follow the growth of a young alchemist aiming to become the best in the world!

2043254043.title: CometStriker DX
2043254043.short_description: CometStriker DX is an arcade action shooter featuring dodging, strategic power-ups and intense boss fights!

2043277826.title: Pocket Bravery
2043277826.short_description: Inspired by classic fighting games from the 90's such as Street Fighter, Fatal Fury and The King of Fighters, 'Pocket Bravery' channels the 'Neo Geo Pocket' aesthetic for a modern fighting game with a retro twist!

2043285260.title: Astrold Two
2043285260.short_description:
Astrino is a small inhabitant of the Astro galaxy. His mission is to save his planet that was invaded by Asdrubald by enslaving the population.
Through a collaborative experience, Astrino can request Astrold's support to help him in this mission.

2043302400.title: Active Neurons 2
2043302400.short_description: Active Neurons 2 is a game that trains the player in spatial logical thinking. Your main task in the game is to collect enough energy to discover the 12 greatest inventions of mankind.

2043315509.title: The Bit's Escape
2043315509.short_description:
Join Bit's, a small machine built in an underground lab with a big dream: escaping and discovering the world above! The Bit's Escape is a dynamic platformer with simple controls and engaging gameplay.

•Dynamic Platforming: Run, jump, and dash through levels full of challenges.
•Double Jump: Overcome bigger obstacles and reach new heights.
•Dash: Avoid traps and make precise movements with Bit's dash.
•Immersive Adventure: Navigate an underground labyrinth and help Bit's achieve its dream of freedom.
•Simple Controls: Intuitive gameplay that’s easy to learn but challenging to master.

Embark on this epic quest with Bit's for freedom!

2043437627.title: Bananitro (Xbox One)

Reach top speed by eating Bananas?!

2043449905.title: Gori: Cuddly Carnage

2043643783.short_description: A cozy mystery game about a detective with Bollywood dreams.

2043738831.short_description: “Johnny Rocket” is a 2D comic adventure. In this game, your main goal is to help Johnny Rocket fight “Evil Forces.” To do that, you can run, jump, double jump, shoot enemies. Don’t forget about Johnny's secret movement - destroy obstacles or enemies with his head All levels are unique and have a big variety of enemies.

2043794712.title: Kingdoms and Castles
2043794712.short_description: Forge your kingdom's destiny in Kingdoms and Castles, a captivating city-building adventure where your choices define your realm's prosperity and survival.

2043833523.title: Nippon Marathon
2043833523.short_description: San! Ni! Ichi! Hajime!!! Stretch your muscles and embark upon the ultimate marathon of Japan in a crazy party racer! On easy, the game will guide and teach you by showing you full instruction, but on hard you will get no help - instead rely on your builder skills and make everything yourself.

2043906033.title: MX vs ATV Legends
2043906033.short_description:
Race your way to victory on bikes, ATVs and UTVs in MX vs ATV Legends! Featuring massive new open environments, plus a career mode that lets you experience all the risks and rewards of becoming a world-famous professional rider.
Become an off-road racing legend in your own right!
Your time is now!

2044006022.title: Super Platformer Boy
2044006022.short_description:
Super Platformer Boy Game !

 An excellent platform game!

Reach the happy ending by passing the fun parts!

40 challenging levels!
3 different buyable characters!
Similar game Super Mario World !
Can you manage to be the best?

2044034598.title: Mothered - A Role-Playing Horror Game
2044034598.short_description:
MOTHERED is a first-person horror adventure game with point-and-click mechanics, set in a familiar yet eerily unnatural depiction of home. Set over the course of seven days, you play the role of LIANA - a young girl who's arrived home to stay with her mother after having undergone major surgery.

Upon arriving at your new home, all you find is a strange mannequin who claims to be your mother. Through speaking with this mannequin, you will discover more about the role you play in this world. Can Liana help mother go back to the things they were, or will you find yourself repeating past mistakes?

2044046713.title: Kitten Island 2 (Windows)

2044149254.short_description: When a nightmare creeps into reality, the only ones that can help are those whose magical powers we’ve believed in since childhood. A brave teddy bear heads to the far side of “happily ever after” to rescue his owner, Alicia.

2044192216.title: Buildings Have Feelings Too
2044192216.short_description:
Buildings Have Feelings Too! is an exciting new city management game about buildings and the city they inhabit.

Imagine a city where buildings can walk and talk to one another. Each one has its own aspirations, hopes and fears. Most of the time they are just trying to get along with each other and make it through the day. Grow your city into a bustling metropolitan centre with an array of shops, offices, entertainment facilities and amenities, to help your buildings thrive; or risk them being demolished forever.

2044200694.title: Discolored 2
2044200694.short_description: All the colors have gone missing from the world. While on a mission to bring them back you discover you are being hunted by those who would see the colors banished. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

2044234749.title: Dragon's Dogma 2 Character Creator & Storage
2044234749.short_description: In this app, you can create your characters for Dragon's Dogma 2. Customize the looks of your main character, the Arisen, and the looks and inclination of your companion, your Main Pawn. You can store up to 5 characters of each, the Arisen and your Main Pawn respectively.

2044261167.title: Castle Breakout: An Escape Room of Medieval Art
2044261167.short_description: Castle Breakout with stunning photo-realistic 3D graphics and an engaging set of puzzles sets the highest new standard for the room-escape genre in 2017. Some forge steel. Others do battle with swords.

2044312508.title: REPLAY BOYS Demo
2044312508.short_description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

2044343586.title: WildTrax Racing
2044343586.short_description: In WildTrax Racing you will enjoy the wildest and most spectacular races in natural environments.

2044347829.title: Quilts and Cats of Calico
2044347829.short_description: Quilts & Cats of Calico is a wholesome, award-winning complex puzzle game for 1 to 4 players. Meet adorable cats and sew the coziest quilts. Compete with other players in multiplayer mode, play solo, or delve into the story of a quilter sewing their way through the city of cats.

2044409240.title: Edgar Poe: Hidden Objects Game
2044409240.short_description: Unravel Poe’s captivating mystery in The Fall of the House of Usher! Explore haunting rooms, find hidden objects, and solve puzzles in this gothic detective adventure, now fully optimised for Xbox with enhanced visuals and full controller support!

2044524780.title: Firework (Windows)
2044524780.short_description: An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of massacre. Lin Lixun participates the re-investigation by chances. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.

2044614951.title: SlideGame for Five Nights at Freddys Security Breach
2044614951.short_description: Slide Game for Five Nights at Freddy's Security Breach.

2044653846.title: ScubaBoys
2044653846.short_description: A side scrolling action adventure game.

2044736974.title: Pandemic: The Board Game
2044736974.short_description: Humanity is on the brink of extinction. As members of an elite disease control team, you’re the only thing standing in the way of the four deadly diseases spreading across the world. You must travel the globe protecting cities, containing infections from spreading, and discovering the cure for each disease. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

2044796053.title: Jet Set Knights
2044796053.short_description: Band the four knights together to vanquish evil and save Princess Kitty!

2044800492.title: The Legend of Icaro
2044800492.short_description: The gods has died, but some live inside! Immerse yourself in this great adventure and face the titans of the future. To free men from the empire of machines, unravel the mysteries of this amazing world, and write the Legend of Icarus!

2044865131.title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
2044865131.short_description: Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa family, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.

2044883773.title: Horned Knight
2044883773.short_description: Horned Knight is a challenging 2D action-platformer where you must overcome all fears, enemies, and traps as the Hero Knight. Rewrite destiny, with your trusty sword, young Knight - the realm depends on it!

2044941056.title: Sokobalien (Windows)
2044941056.short_description: Build the biggest space farm in the galaxy!

2044979517.title: Shoulders of Giants Ultimate Demo
2044979517.short_description: Simultaneously control a sword-wielding robot and a gunslinging space frog in Shoulders of Giants, an explosively colourful sci-fi roguelike. Play alone, with a friend, or as part of a four-person team, cutting through waves of enemies on a quest to rescue the galaxy!

2045008370.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain
2045008370.short_description: Broken Porcelain brings an abundance of welcome changes to the series, introducing new gameplay and storytelling elements that breathe new life into the characters and an unprecedented level of immersion in this haunting adventure – perfect for both new and returning fans to the series.

2045404355.title: Dome Keeper
2045404355.short_description: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

2045453614.title: Last Days of Lazarus
2045453614.short_description: A disturbing supernatural adventure set in post-communist Romania.

2045526445.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition
2045526445.short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky is the prequel chapter of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy. With the ability to directly influence the balance of power through Faction Wars, step into the boots of Scar — a seasoned mercenary, able to somehow survive deadly Emissions. Make your way to the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant through radiation, anomalies, enemies, mutants, and conflict-raging Zone.

2045542065.title: Sparkle 4 Tales
2045542065.short_description:
"There you are, my little thing... Wondering who am I?
Let's start here, with your first experience of life...
Maybe it will lead us somewhere. Shall we?".

2045560230.title: LIMBO
2045560230.short_description: Uncertain of his sister's fate, a boy enters LIMBO.

2045674504.title: It's Kooky
2045674504.short_description: Look for quirks in the new hidden object game - It's Kooky!

2045688705.title: Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams - Director's Cut
2045688705.short_description: Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams - Director's Cut is a challenging fast-paced platformer with a twist.

2045695664.title: SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off Extra Krusty Edition
2045695664.short_description: The Xbox "Extra Krusty Edition" of SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off is here! We are bringing you all of the fun of the original with none of the grind! Access tons of FREE decorative items, costumes, kitchen gear and more, experience unlimited play and unleash four, Xbox power-ups to help you show off your skill behind the grill!

2045704503.title: Metaball
2045704503.short_description:
Dodge and dribble past opponents on your hoverboard to score epic goals in this easy-to-learn, hard-to-master game where skill is everything!

Prepare to sharpen your abilities and unlock a variety of exciting rewards!

2045720355.title: Farlands Journey
2045720355.short_description: Farlands Journey is a colorful classic adventure platformer game where you play as a little witch fighting the evil forces. Embark on an adventure to recover the stolen heart of your Magical Academy. Discover various magic spells and hats with unique effects. Defeat monsters and their bosses. Solve puzzles by combining platforming skills and magical spells. Collect gems and spend them on upgrades in Magical Academy.

2045736222.title: My Recycling Center
2045736222.short_description: Operate, configure and expand your recycling center in this first-person simulator! Work fast and sort the trash. Use the compactors to destroy bulky waste. Earn satisfaction and cash to buy containers and unlock new trash types. Use the shop to sell re-usable items.

2045907572.title: Puzzle For American Truck Simulator
2045907572.short_description:
American Truck Simulator Puzzle Game now Windows Store!
 It is an unofficial game. There are many puzzle sections of the American Truck Simulator game. Complete the puzzle,find the photo. As the level progresses, more difficult puzzles will appear. Finish the game and complete all the photos.

2045910196.title: Guilty Gear -Strive- Team of 3 Network Open Beta Test
2045910196.short_description:
*Guilty Gear -Strive- Team of 3 Network Open Beta may differ from the official release of Guilty Gear -Strive-.


[Available Characters]
A total of 29 characters are available (including DLC characters).

[Available Modes]
・Team of 3 ONLINE MATCH
・Team of 3 PLAYER MATCH
・Team of 3 SKILL CUSTOMIZE
・Team of 3 SPARRING
・Team of 3 TUTORIAL

*A network connection is required for online play.
*Downloading the app and online match play are free. However, data costs or communication costs may be incurred depending on your internet service provider.
*Save data cannot be transferred from the beta to the full game.

2045917171.title: Metro Simulator
2045917171.short_description: You are the train operator and thousands of people rely on you every day on their way to work or home. Take this unique chance to experience Moscow's subway systems in a whole new way!

2045927459.title: ACA NEOGEO SUPER SIDEKICKS 2
2045927459.short_description: SUPER SIDEKICKS 2 is a soccer game released in 1994 by SNK. Battle for the championship in the peak sports event held once every four years. This version introduces the actual rules as well as fouls in order to provide exciting and thrilling soccer matches. Another highlight is the variety of enhanced rendering.

2045940405.title: Shadow Watch : Observation Duty
2045940405.short_description: Monitor surveillance footage and report supernatural anomalies across eerie locations. Can you survive the night shift and keep the darkness at bay?

2045941654.title: Song Of The Prairie
2045941654.short_description: Song of The Prairie is a 3D relaxing farm game. A hero who defeat the demon begins a new rural life. Experiencing the fun of exploration to the town. Harvesting giant fruits and crops. Taking care fantastic animals. Dating with someone you like. Just enjoy the farming life only belongs to you!

2046117680.title: Wer weiß denn sowas? - Das Spiel
2046117680.short_description: Mit dem offiziellen Spiel zu "Wer weiß denn sowas?" kannst Du Dein Wissen unter Beweis stellen. Spiele an der Seite von Elton, Bernhard Hoëcker oder mit bis zu drei Freunden. 20 komplette Shows, über 250 Fragen aus mehr als 100 Kategorien erwarten Dich. Oft wirst Du denken „Wer weiß denn sowas?“.

2046118756.title: Let's Sing 2022
2046118756.short_description: Become the ultimate superstar in Let's Sing! Are you ready to take on the perfect mix of 20 new chart breakers and all-time classics and rock the stage? Sing alone or grab your friends for a battle of the voices in both online and offline game modes to determine - once and for all - who is the best singer around. Experience the Let's Party mode with up to eight singers or climb to the top of the worldwide online leaderboards.

2046150115.title: Use Your Words 2
2046150115.short_description: WARNING: This game might make you pee your pants! The cult hit Use Your Words is back with all-new prompts and 2x as many mini-games where you compete to write the funniest punchline. You can customize your own playlist of mini-games, there's a new-and-improved spectator mode, and more!

2046176982.title: Empire of Sin
2046176982.short_description: Empire of Sin is a new strategy game brought to you by Romero Games and Paradox Interactive that puts you at the heart of the ruthless criminal underworld of 1920s Prohibition-era Chicago.

2046252470.title: While We Wait Here
2046252470.short_description: Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.

2046294816.title: Aftercharge
2046294816.short_description: Aftercharge is a 3 vs 3 competitive game pitting invisible robots against an invincible security squad in high-voltage tactical skirmishes. The robots must sneak around to punch down all the energy extractors on the site while the guards are tasked to spot the attackers, stop them and put an end to the uprising.

2046367994.title: Those Who Remain
2046367994.short_description: As the lights go out, the embers of darkness are stoked in the sleepy town of Dormont. Confront uncomfortable horrors, keep your sanity in check and survive the night in this story-driven first-person psychological-thriller.

2046395333.title: Titan Chaser
2046395333.short_description: Titan Chaser is a surreal driving and walking experience, where your job is to scout giant creatures and use the light to drive them off without fighting or killing.

2046411883.title: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
2046411883.short_description: A companion-driven adventure through the pages of a living fable. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and togetherness.

2046455345.title: JPpresents Neonbreak
2046455345.short_description: Neonbreak - break all the neon blocks, get all the multi balls, have all the fun!

2046480698.title: SCHiM
2046480698.short_description: SCHiM is a game about jumping from shadow to shadow in a relaxing and lively environment. This 3D platformer takes elements of light, shadow & animation and adds them directly to the gameplay, delivering an experience that you will only find in SCHiM.

2046531735.title: Predator: Hunting Grounds
2046531735.short_description:
Hunt or be hunted in this asymmetrical multiplayer shooter that pits man against Predator. As part of a Fireteam, complete missions before the Predator finds you. Or be the Predator and hunt your prey.

Be the Predator – hunt down the opposing Fireteam, using deadly alien weaponry to stalk your prey.
Get to the chopper – complete challenging missions as part of a four-person Fireteam to escape.
Wield human and alien weaponry – fight with a state-of-the-art arsenal as the Fireteam, and deadly tech like the shoulder-mounted Plasma Caster, Combistick and more as the Predator.

2046562785.title: Avowed
2046562785.short_description: Avowed is a first-person fantasy RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.

2046628793.title: PixARK
2046628793.short_description: Enter a world of mystery, danger, ancient dinosaurs, mythical beasts, and cubes! Work by yourself or with a tribe of others to gather materials, craft useful items, tame wild creatures, and build huge bases to survive in PixARK!

2046656758.title: BALAN WONDERWORLD Demo
2046656758.short_description:
Download the BALAN WONDERWORLD demo NOW to play the entirety of Chapter One and the first acts of Chapters Four and Chapter Six!
Bonus Gift: X Launcher costume

X Launcher costume unlocked by playing the demo and purchasing the full game on the same account.
Demo save data cannot be transferred to full game.

2046808542.title: Luppy
2046808542.short_description: Luppy is a 2D platformer packed with personality, where you'll take on 32 handcrafted, obstacle-filled levels. In each stage, your goal is to collect coins and unlock the hidden trophy to move forward.

2046813901.title: The last one II : Zombie Rising (2023 Edition)
2046813901.short_description: Wake up in a hospital bed with no memory of how you got there. The city is in ruins, and the only thing you know for sure is that your daughter is missing. In this heart-pounding survival horror game, you must fight your way through hordes of zombies, solve puzzles, and find your daughter before it's too late.

2046851303.title: Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn
2046851303.short_description: Show off ninja skills in the remake of a legendary dark and futuristic classic!

2046892842.title: Clock Tower: Rewind
2046892842.short_description: The 16-bit nightmare returns. Survive, hide, and avoid the deadly Scissorman in this legendary horror classic.

2046954487.title: RetroRev37
2046954487.short_description: This is the latest version of RetroArch.

2047037846.title: Abathor
2047037846.short_description: Abathor is a 2D arcade action platformer for up to 4 players. You are the last hope in defense of Atlantis, you’ll face hordes of enemies and countless challenges. Enjoy its pixel art and epic music. A cooperative and competitive game to achieve glory or death.

2047189315.title: Ocean Oddities (Windows)
2047189315.short_description: Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot-the-difference game set in underwater worlds, where players find subtle changes among coral, sea life, and treasures. With soothing visuals and timed or stress-free modes, it delivers satisfying “I found it!” moments.

2047199918.title: Isonzo
2047199918.short_description: Ferocious Alpine warfare will test your tactical skills in this authentic WW1 FPS. Fight high-altitude battles among the scenic peaks, rugged valleys and idyllic towns of Northern Italy. The Great War on the Italian Front is brought to life and elevated to unexpected heights!

2047244350.title: Pawarumi
2047244350.short_description:
Rock-Paper-Scissors... with LASERS!
Avenge the people of Earth in this exciting Neo-Aztec Shoot'em Up!

2047353282.title: Paper Trail Demo
2047353282.short_description: A puzzle adventure set in a foldable, paper world.

2047392824.title: Panic Porcupine
2047392824.short_description: Help Panic blast through over 50 stages of topsy-turvy, spike-laced, slime-drenched, buzzsaw-filled deathtraps in this mashup of precision platforming and high speed gameplay.

2047554233.title: CASE RECORDS: Fear of Abduction
2047554233.short_description:
CASE RECORDS is a psychological horror game that is part of the universe of the games CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival..

The player has to play as a 17 year old female student and solve missing person mysteries by volunteering at the police station of Crowvale, a suburb of Aurora.
Patrol and explore the dark corners of the city to solve its terrifying mysteries.

But the most important thing during your time volunteering is not to go missing yourself....
Features:
- Mysterious atmosphere
- System of interactive dialogs and choices which will affect the ending
- Unique mini-games
- Interaction with surroundings which could become your escape..

Get ready for a thrilling psychological horror where one wrong step can cost you your life.

2047590834.title: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 1
2047590834.short_description:
Put your detective skills to the test in a thrilling solitaire mystery!

Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting solitaire-investigation game where you take on the roles of journalist Lana Whitt and sheriff's assistant Bill Maite to investigate crimes in the sunny little town of Springdale. 
Meet with the town’s people and hear some harrowing stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! 
Complete fun Solitaire challenges, investigate crimes, and make the criminals come clean!

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer.

2047601430.title: Truck and Logistics Simulator
2047601430.short_description: Load, drive, and deliver through a huge open world with up to 24 players in cross-platform multiplayer. Join your friends in exciting heavy transport convoys. Jump into the driver's seat of more than 30 unique vehicles and carry out complex loading tasks to deliver a variety of cargo.

2047629553.title: Summer Seaside Search (Windows)
2047629553.short_description: Relax on sunny shores while testing your eye for detail in Summer Seaside Search, a charming spot the difference adventure filled with vibrant beach scenes, hidden surprises, timed challenges, and cozy stress free gameplay perfect for quick breaks or laid back sessions.

2047630271.title: Lunar Lander 2
2047630271.short_description: Take control of the landing module and make your way safely to the ground. Earn extra points for landing faster and on smaller landing pads.

2047633692.title: The Wizard and The Slug
2047633692.short_description: Join an unlikely duo on a whimsical fantasy platform adventure game.

2047648027.title: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure (for Windows 10)
2047648027.short_description: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure is an exciting precision platformer with 50 levels full of challenges and enemies. Take control of a brave rabbit as he embarks on an epic adventure through vibrant and dangerous worlds. Traversing chasms, avoiding deadly traps, and defeating cunning enemies are just a few of the skills you'll need to master to progress.

2047811112.title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
2047811112.short_description:
The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale.
Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

2047813877.title: Tetraminos - Xbox Series X|S
2047813877.short_description: The classic arcade game is back in a supercharged version! Discover timeless gameplay revamped, practise in Puzzle mode and challenge your friends in local Versus mode with up to 4 players!

2047867006.title: Dofamine
2047867006.short_description: Scientific research is not unlike the work of a detective. Revealing hidden connections and subtle patterns has a lot in common with untangling the web of meanings, studying causes, and predicting consequences. If one correctly combines blocks of data and determines their connectivity, one may eventually uncover the truth. But that truth and the explanation of everything that has happened may come as a shock to the one who finds it.

2047879335.title: BlastMorph: Outbreak (Demo)
2047879335.short_description: BlastMorph challenges, rates, and berates your abilities to survive and thrive across seven different gameplay types.

2047898532.title: Snowboard Legends Demo
2047898532.short_description:
Get ready for a thrilling snowboarding adventure! This game lets you ride through 12 exciting tracks filled with jumps, sharp turns, and breathtaking snowy landscapes. Race down steep slopes, carve through icy forests, and discover hidden shortcuts. Perfect for beginners and pros alike, this game brings the fun and challenge of real snowboarding to your screen!

Features:

12 Unique Tracks: Each track offers a different environment and set of challenges, from rugged mountains to smooth forest trails. (1 Track available in Demo. To Unlock all Tracks Buy Full Version.)

Easy Controls: Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to learn but challenging to master.

Beautiful Winter Environments: Stunning, detailed graphics immerse you in a realistic snowy world.

Experience the rush of snowboarding.

2047911802.title: For The King II
2047911802.short_description: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of four players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelite tabletop RPG. Will you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret?

2047957671.title: Slimeboo
2047957671.short_description: Slimeboo is a simple and fun platformer game that is perfect for children of all ages. The game is controlled with a single button, making it accessible to even the youngest players. Boo, a small and adorable slime, has gotten lost on a tropical island. To find his way home, he must leap over all the obstacles in his path. Help him overcome them! Good luck!

2048111388.title: Hidden Memory - Nature
2048111388.short_description: Relax and disconnect in Hidden Memory - Nature. Memorize simple rules, solve puzzles with geometric shapes, and reveal beautiful hand-painted landscapes. A cozy, stress-free journey, perfect for finding peace in nature.

2048122343.title: ACA NEOGEO KIZUNA ENCOUNTER for Windows
2048122343.short_description:
KIZUNA ENCOUNTER is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996.
Create a team of two fighters and use weapons and your fists to win in single-round sudden death tag-team matches!
Experience the feel of an advanced battle system that pairs mid-battle character change-ups and easy commands leading to rush combos!

2048158164.title: Welcome Spider
2048158164.short_description: It is a score game where you have to rise as high as you can without falling to the ground with the spider web.

2048329805.title: Shred It!
2048329805.short_description:
It’s time to get back to paper nature! 

Shred It! is an innovative endless runner by Extra Mile Studios. Snowboard your way down a never-ending hill in a beautiful paper-craft world.

2048381683.title: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC
2048381683.short_description: PAC-MAN arrives home on his birthday to find the Ghosts have kidnapped PAC-MAN’s family and ruined his party! Off to the rescue, PAC-MAN sets out to Ghost Island!

2048478667.title: Firefighters - Airport Heroes
2048478667.short_description: Firefighters - Airport Heroes: The firefighter series continues! Terrible engine fires, a hell of flames in the passenger terminal, crashed helicopters or collapsed parts of buildings require the skilful use of fire engines, fire extinguishers and special tools. Players expect dramatic situations - every mission counts! Lives must be saved!

2048481228.title: The Last Camp
2048481228.short_description:
"The Last Camp" is a doomsday themed game. This game uses high-quality graphics, rich weapons and props systems, and a grand world map to create a cross-generational dual-stick shooting game, bringing a feast for shooting game enthusiasts.
The world has become a ruin, and humans have built the last camp on the ruins. Everyone must coexist with the doomsday world; in the game, players need to use the technology and weapons left over from the human world to fight against various mutant zombies, evil predators, and giant mechanical monsters. The camp will encounter various troubles, such as lack of oil, inability to generate electricity, and the need for clean water sources. Players need to solve various crises according to the development of the plot.
The game includes 8 chapters and branch challenge levels in endless mode, with a total game time of more than 15 hours. Players can play alone or with multiple controllers locally; the battle mechanism based on the 'Turing AI game model' makes the game battles fierce and changeable; the game has a large sandbox system, including a weapon upgrade system, a blueprint system, a character skill growth system, a prop system, a clothing system, etc. In the sandbox system, players can freely formulate the growth plan of the game character.
Although the world has long been shattered, we still have to hold on to hope and work hard to survive. The continuation of the camp cannot be achieved by simply closing the door. There are many outposts around the camp that need to be maintained, and there will be survivors who need to be rescued.

2048501447.title: Mangavania 2 (Windows)
2048501447.short_description:
Old school action platformer game with pixel art graphics.

Join the adventure as Yuhiko, a young ninja who has gone to the underworld to find a cure for his brother. Find Spirits in secret places – they will tell you a story or give you advice. Explore dungeons, fight monsters and meet new friends!

The second part of the game will delight you with new types of enemies, fresh gameplay mechanics, and battles with dangerous bosses. If desired, each level can also be attempted in a speedrun. The second part of the game is perfect not only for those already familiar with the black-and-white world of Mangavania but also for newcomers to the series.

Can the young ninja save his brother, and if so, at what cost?

2048508903.title: Lost Lands: The Four Horsemen (free to play)
2048508903.short_description:
An exciting adventure of a brave girl who found herself in a fantasy world. She is forced to fight against the Black Horsemen sent by evil forces to annihilate every living thing.

Lost Lands: the Four Horsemen is an adventurous hidden object game-quest with puzzles and mini-games that tells a fairy-tale story about the world with never-before-seen races and folk types.

One fine day an ordinary good-looking housewife was walking down the car-park of a shopping center when she got into a cloud of mysterious fog turning out to be an interdimensional portal. As a result, Susan returns to the fantasy world of the Lost Lands she has been before. There has been a talk of her for years - the brave woman from another world is known as Susan the Warrior.
This time it is a Druid hermit, whose name is Maaron, who called her on. He had a vision of liberation of the Lost Lands from the oppression of the Four Horsemen: Heat, Coldness, Death and Darkness.
Maaron decides on to seek support of the woman from the other side; the one who has already saved the world from the forces of evil once. Susan will set forth towards the encounter with Four Horsemen with an aim to confront them.
But first, she has to eliminate the Horsemen forever in an uphill battle by finding the weakness of each…

Game features:
• Explore over 50 stunning locations
• Complete over 40 different mini-games
• Challenge yourself with interactive hidden object scenes
• Assemble collections, gather morphing objects, and gain achievements
• The game is optimized for tablets and phones!

Immerse yourself in an amazing adventure in a fantasy world
Meet the peoples of the Lost Lands
Solve dozens of puzzles
Stop the Black Horsemen
Save the world from a danger threatening to annihilate every living thing.

2048511735.title: Munchkin: Quacked Quest
2048511735.short_description: Dive into Munchkin: Quacked Quest and re-discover the parody, puns, and humor from the hit card game Munchkin by Steve Jackson.

2048545274.title: Rubber Bandits
2048545274.short_description: Not every heist goes as planned.

2048574450.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
2048574450.short_description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world ruled by real but unrelenting gods. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice has a price and entails consequences. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

2048600577.title: Ball Race Reactivate
2048600577.short_description: In the game, one gamer or from two to four gamer compete against each other controlling their own balls and try to defeat their opponent, navigating a maze full of challenges and surprises in order to reach the finish line first. Racing tracks are full of dangers, such as jumping spiders that make it difficult for players to succeed, as well as auxiliary elements such as blocks to knock the player up and moving platforms to overcome chasms. By collecting diamonds and stars, players gain an advantage that allows them to jump and move faster.

2048641965.title: Castle of Monsters: The Last Knight (XBOX SERIES)
2048641965.short_description: The Last Knight is a 2.5D voxel-based sidescroller blending fast combat, strategic platforming, and dark fantasy. Play as the Last Knight, the final warrior able to reclaim a fallen kingdom. Wield a magical sword, face relentless enemies, dodge deadly traps, and uncover the castle’s secrets. With striking voxel visuals and a classic side-scrolling feel, this epic journey delivers retro-inspired action with modern polish. Will you restore the kingdom or be consumed by its horrors?

2048676266.title: CocoRally Drive
2048676266.short_description:
Experience Fast Cars On Beautiful Maps With CocoRally Drive!
CocoRally Is Back With Drive. Race On 6 Beautiful And Amazingly Detailed Maps For Free.

2048688428.title: Hexfire Witch (Xbox Series X/S)
2048688428.short_description: Help the Hexfire Witch clear her debt and clear her name by completing the mission and collecting every single coin and loot.

2048825105.title: Goosebumps Dead of Night
2048825105.short_description: In Goosebumps Dead of Night, the best-selling Goosebumps franchise has been reimagined as a first person spooky survival adventure game for Xbox One. Experience three chapters of gameplay with 3D graphics and chilling AI monsters. Conquer the all new Extreme Mode! With more frights, and challenges!

2049111049.title: Bendy and the Ink Machine (Xbox Series X|S)
2049111049.short_description: Bendy and the Ink Machine® is the first-person puzzle action horror game that will forever ruin your childhood love of cartoons. Fear the machine and survive.
