2103350728.title: Dragon Is Dead
2103350728.short_description:
The black dragon [Guernian], who once faced down the gods, has fallen. 
From the rift he fled before his death, an unholy energy has spread across the world, and life is undergoing a bizarre mutation. People call it Corruption and live their days in fear, but few know its trustworthy source and full extent.

You are an immortal warrior, a so-called Successor, chosen by the God of Light [Lu], the God of Fire [Ashuran], and the God of Water [Harnia]. Arriving in Cliffshire, a town of light, Successors must head to a burial ground where demons are said to be manifesting and follow clues to cleanse the distorted world.

Dragon is Dead delivers 2D platformer action requiring precise dodging and pattern-breaking. Each area is a vertically and horizontally intertwined, multi-layered structure that regenerates in a rogue-lite fashion with different terrain, monster placement, and loot composition on each run. When you die, you lose your gold and temporary buffs, but your gear and runes are permanently preserved and become the basis for the next cycle. Defeating bosses yields rune stones that can be used to craft or awaken legendary gear, and artifacts found during exploration can bring both powerful blessings and dangerous curses depending on the combination, providing new tactical tension each time.

Make your way to the Citadel – the closer you get, the more you’ll come face-to-face with a secret that has brought the world to its knees.

Features:

•	Tight, immersive platforming and combat
•	Stunning visuals to draw you into the world
•	Each run brings new challenges as you gain strength
•	Extensive customization and character options for exciting builds
•	Conquer the Corruption to unravel the story.

2103383862.title: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia
2103383862.short_description:
Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia is Quiz Game for kids for age 5 and above. This game helps everyone to increase their knowledge by completing various different trivia challenges. 

Features
-Suitable for age 5 and above.
-Various different Trivia categories such as Maths, Science, Geography, GK, English and Picture.
-Difficulty level increases after completion of each level.
-There are 10 questions in each level and each trivia category has 10 levels.
-Many More.

Get Ready for Ultimate Trivia Adventure ahead.....

2103516179.title: The Outlast Trials
2103516179.short_description: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

2103553614.title: Elemental War TD
2103553614.short_description: Elemental War takes Tower Defenses to a new level with dozens of hours of single-player gameplay, and lots of indie love!

2103593534.title: Aztech Forgotten Gods TGA21 Demo
2103593534.short_description: When an unfamiliar enemy awakens to threaten Tenochtitlan, Achtli must master the hidden powers in Lightkeeper, a lost artifact from a time long forgotten, in order to save her city.

2103653839.title: PAC Classic
2103653839.short_description:
It's a classic maze chase game.
The purest rebuild for Microsoft platforms with no modification or hurting the original concept.

2103668444.title: Tiny Troopers: Global Ops
2103668444.short_description: Attention! Tiny Troopers: Global Ops is a fast-paced arcade twin-stick shooter in which you lead an elite squad of Tiny Troopers on action-packed missions to take down hordes of unscrupulous enemies from all corners of the world!

2103772615.title: Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown Demo
2103772615.short_description:
Play the free demo of Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown!
Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate. Play as Sargon and evolve from sword-wielding prodigy to extraordinary legend as you master acrobatic combat and unlock new Time Powers and unique super abilities.

2103789015.title: Monster Hunter Rise
2103789015.short_description: Rise to the challenge and join the hunt! In Monster Hunter Rise, the latest installment in the award-winning and top-selling Monster Hunter series, you’ll become a hunter, explore brand new maps and use a variety of weapons to take down fearsome monsters as part of an all-new storyline.

2103945737.title: The young mathematician: Easy difficulty
2103945737.short_description: This is a math game with easy difficulty. In the game you will have to answer simple equations with addition or subtraction. The game can have minimum numbers of -100 and maximum numbers of 100.

2104043870.title: Jetboard Joust
2104043870.short_description: Fast & fluid arcade-style SHMUP meets hardcore roguelike! Take flight on a pimped-up jetboard and face off against massive, multi-stage bosses. A classic for the next generation!

2104061721.title: Lovecraft's Untold Stories
2104061721.short_description:
Lovecraft’s Untold Stories is an action rogue-lite with RPG elements. You explore randomly generated levels based in H.P. Lovecraft stories, fighting cultists and all kinds of monsters from the Mythos, improving your weapons and gear, solving puzzles and challenges, and looking for clues and knowledge to defeat the Great Old Ones and the Outer Gods.

* Fight hundreds monsters from the Cthulhu Mythos in this intense action roguelite 
* Explore Lovecraft’s stories: every character has a storyline that crosses randomly generated levels set in different locations such as the hospital, the jungle, or Innsmouth to name a few
* Face the Great Old Ones: Cthulhu, Nyarlathotep, Dagon, Shub-Niggurath, and Azathoth await you
* Learn about the Mythos to fight them: to have a chance fighting the Great Old Ones you need information about them, or their mere presence will drive you insane
* Madness awaits: in your adventures you will have to make decisions and taking the wrong ones will shake your sanity. If you go mad you will take your own life
* Pick your hero: 5 different characters, detective, thief, professor, witch, and ghoul. Each one has a different combat style and skills
* Collect weapons, items, and artifacts. Each character has a set of weapons and items, and there are hundreds of other items you can find and use!

2104125318.title: DreamWorks Trolls Remix Rescue
2104125318.short_description: Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony!

2104142109.title: Night Slashers: Remake
2104142109.short_description: Night Slashers is a pulse-pounding, horror-themed beat 'em up game, in a nightmarish world filled with bloodthirsty creatures and unspeakable horrors. Prepare to step into the shoes of the unlikely heroes, as they battle hordes of supernatural foes and terrifying monsters.

2104154326.title: Super Star Shooter 16
2104154326.short_description: Super Star Shooter 16 is a psychedelic retro inspired on-rails shooter.

2104181770.title: The First Berserker: Khazan
2104181770.short_description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

2104269442.title: Cazzarion Adventureland
2104269442.short_description:
Story:
An alien crashed on earth and now he has to find a rescue UFO to escape from planet earth.


Use the free trial version and enjoy a classic platformer game. 
No overloaded controls, just jump and run like in the good old days. 
Avoid the traps and jump on the enemies to remove them from the platform.

For Windows 10: Play with keyboard or Game Controler on Windows 10.

2104363067.title: Fatum Betula
2104363067.short_description:
Welcome to a world without a past. Fatum Betula is an atmospheric exploration game with light puzzle elements. A magical birch is the only thing dictating the future, and it is your job to find something appropriate to feed it with. There is a total of 10 unique endings and a plethora of secrets to uncover. 

"The PS1 era visuals are excellent and although the art style is very different, there's a real Ghibli-esque sense of mystical wonder to the world. Highly recommended."
-Alpha Beta Gamer

WARNING! This title contains infrequent cursing and themes of nihilism, death, and abuse. This game also contains flashing images and lights that may trigger seizures for those with photosensitive epilepsy.

2104417187.title: From Shadows Redux
2104417187.short_description: Action- platformer filled to the brim with blood, mayhem, and demons straight from hell! Play solo or with your friends in split-screen, upgrade your beast, and mow down hordes of enemies and their towering lieutenants.

2104432342.title: Green Light Red Light Escape
2104432342.short_description: Are you ready for the green light red light game? Run while the song continues. Don't move when the song stops. If you move, you die. Cross the line in 60 seconds. Try to finish the chapter without dying.

2104483569.title: Shark Pinball
2104483569.short_description: Try to survive this infested shark waters in this Pinball game.

2104489513.title: Moutain Bike HD
2104489513.short_description:
《Mountain bike HD》is a game that tests players' balance ability. The whole game adopts cartoon style and easy to handle.

The player controls a bicycle on a breathtaking hillside, moving forward, backward, and left-right gravity control to keep the bike steady, rushing as fast as possible to the end of the track.

Especially when through the terminal for the shortest time, the more eager to seek achievement more will make them a blooper, quick to challenge your own balance ability, rich game level design, add fun and challenge for your game, game is simple, operation is easy to fit in a smooth operation experience!

Miracle Games is an important partner of Microsoft Global Independent Software Vendor(ISV).

《Mountain bike HD》is supported by Microsoft Azure,Maintain a seamless experience for gamers without having to worry about downtime or interruptions

The game features
1. Rich game card design, increase game interest and challenge
2. Easy to play, easy to handle, operation experience of process
3. The game screen is rich and colourful

★ Dear Microsoft fans, Miracle Games is a group with happiness, has been focused on publishing Windows platform games for five years.Do remember there are many people with your peers.Innovation always faces challenges.The relentless pursuit of perfection,let's make things better!

2104502032.title: Stories Untold
2104502032.short_description: Stories Untold is a compilation tape of four experimental adventures, including a remaster of the original hit episode “The House Abandon”.

2104575927.title: Fights in Tight Spaces
2104575927.short_description: Build your deck, control the space and use the environment to defeat your enemies. With an evolving roster of abilities, you must train new cards, upgrade existing ones, and find the perfect combinations to defeat your opponents and bring down criminal organisations across the world.

2104660667.title: KungFu Kickball
2104660667.short_description: KungFu Kickball is the fighting-sports game where the best ball kicker wins! Punch, kick, and headbutt your way across the field to smash the ball into your opponents' bell and rack up points!

2104673159.title: Epic Astro Story
2104673159.short_description: Battle baddies and foster interplanetary diplomacy in an epic space colony sim!

2104716520.title: Howl - Demo
2104716520.short_description:
Check out the free demo that lets you play the first levels of the first chapter and try out Howl's gameplay yourself.

Howl is a turn-based tactical folktale set in medieval times. A sinister "howling plague" has ravaged the land, turning all who hear it into feral beasts. You play a deaf heroine plunging into danger in search of a cure. 

Plan up to six steps in advance to outmaneuver your opponents: wolfish creatures filled with hunger and rage. Various types of fiends are lurking in the shadows, each of them possessing different abilities and their own levels of vitality. So, you need to consider carefully the strategy that will bring them to their knees. 

Not only do you have your wits to rely on while plotting your attack, you also have an array of abilities at your disposal. As you slay more wolves, you acquire skills like Vault, Smoke Bomb, and Piercing Shot. Venture forth on your journey to upgrade your skills and unlock more Action Slots and Undo Round Points. As you plan your moves, you will also shape your own prophecy, composing a dynamic work of scripture as you fight. 

Howl's visuals are created through "living ink", a flowing art style that paints the story as you play. Carve your way through a dark, fairy-tale world made up of obscure yet magical places where you fight and write to rid the lands of the plague. 
 
Features 
•	Foretell the actions of your enemies in tactical, turn-based combat. 
•	Outsmart the different wolf species, from fast predators to enormous pack leaders. 
•	Beautifully illustrated in a unique, living ink art style. 
•	Unlock and upgrade new skills like Shadow Step, Exploding Shot, and more. 
•	Save villagers from the claws – and howls – of the wolves. 
•	Play through 60 levels over 4 chapters. 
•	Plot your route on the world map to uncover new skills and secret paths.

2104881444.title: Thunderflash
2104881444.short_description: Gear up for war zone of retro arcade shooting action!

2104908182.title: Sugarbound 2 (Xbox Series X/S)
2104908182.short_description: The human kingdom’s food shortage crisis was resolved thanks to the efforts of the master pâtissière Chloé Fondant, but the food was so delicious that we now face another crisis! With all food reserves empty (again), Chloé has no choice but to return to Sugarbound in search of delicious—and this time, healthier—ingredients and foods!

2104911747.title: Raccoo Venture
2104911747.short_description: Raccoo Venture é um jogo de plataformas 3D que traz a nostalgia dos anos 90 em um mundo lúdico e cheio de quebra-cabeças inspirado pelos grandes clássicos.

2105000098.title: Gridz Keeper
2105000098.short_description:
Restore power to the grid and keep humanity protected from the zombie apocalypse!

In the aftermath of a zombie apocalypse, the world has gone dark. Cities lie silent, their power grids fractured and failing. You are the only remaining repairman that can restore power to the last safe zones of humanity.

Gridz Keeper is an action puzzler featuring 50 levels that challenge you to repair all the generators in them to move on. Each generator you repair sparks hope, but the power lines are unstable. Every switch you flip triggers any adjacent ones too, plunging some back into darkness while others flare to life. Master the grid, anticipate the chain reactions and reclaim the light one generator at a time!

2105009589.title: Outbreak: Lost Hope Definitive Edition
2105009589.short_description: Experience a mother's desperate search for her daughter in the midst of a nation-wide epidemic. This story follows Gwen just after her harrowing escape from an urban center during the outbreak. A terrible accident causes her to get separated from her daughter Hope and she has to fight the undead to survive... and save her daughter.

2105103483.title: Dino Escape
2105103483.short_description: Dino Escape is a fun 2D platformer where danger lurks behind every leaf—and survival is just one jump (or dash) away. Players take control of a brave little dinosaur who’s been separated from his pack and stranded in a haunted forest crawling with monstrous creatures, deadly traps, and mysterious ruins. Armed with instinct, agility, and sheer dino grit, you’ll leap over spikes, dash past undead horrors, and trigger ancient switches to unlock the path forward. But beware—swamps swallow the careless whole, flying beasts patrol the skies, and the shadows seem to whisper secrets best left forgotten. With its eerie pixel-art style, tight platforming controls, and a constant sense of tension, Dino Escape delivers an atmospheric adventure that challenges your reflexes—and your courage. Will you survive the maze and find your way back home? Or will the forest claim another lost soul?

2105122816.title: Block Burst 3D : Colored Block Puzzle
2105122816.short_description: Block Burst 3D takes the iconic Tetris formula and elevates it to new heights with stunning 3D graphics and a sleek user interface. Immerse yourself in the vibrant, ever-evolving world of Block Burst 3D as you strategically maneuver and stack blocks in real-time, all while enjoying the seamless cross-platform compatibility between Xbox Series and Windows 10 & 11.

2105129470.title: Master Maker 3D Ultimate
2105129470.short_description:
Clear retro 3D levels or build your own in this 3D action platformer for all ages!

Play as Master Maker, a young builder who possesses a special boomerang hammer capable of collecting items, destroying boxes and defeating enemies from a distance! In this 3D adventure inspired by classics of the ’90s, you can explore and build freely. Adventure mode features 50 colorful levels to inspire your constructions. Just move Master Maker from the starting point to the flag at the end of the stage by jumping across platforms, knocking out enemies and avoiding traps! Then Level Creator lets you build original stages however you like by adding blocks, coins, spikes, cannons, trees, decorations, ramps and much more!

Presented in high-definition 3D style, Master Maker 3D Ultimate is a low-poly action experience that’s fun for the whole family, and replay value is practically limitless since you can use your imagination to keep creating long after the main stages have been cleared. Plus, if you complete Adventure mode, you’ll unlock 350 new levels to enjoy at any time!

2105140633.title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...
2105140633.short_description: The prequel of the critically-acclaimed masterpiece NieR:Automata, receives a modern upgrade. The protagonist is a kind young man living in a remote village. In order to save his sister Yonah, who fell terminally ill to the Black Scrawl, he sets out with Grimoire Weiss, a strange talking tome, to search for the "Sealed verses".

2105152828.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Prologue Demo
2105152828.short_description:
Embark on an adventure of your own creation.
The latest in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series.

2105228747.title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game
2105228747.short_description:
Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror based on the iconic ‘80s film. In the battle between Killer Klowns and citizens of Crescent Cove, team up and use your wits to harvest humans or save them from the alien invasion!

Crescent Cove is a sprawling arena for these unique multiplier fights between Klowns and humans – boasting various locations, and various tactical opportunities for both teams. Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game provides a unique approach to hide-and-seek gameplay, customization, PvPvE, and dynamic objectives leading to multiple match results. This game evolves the online horror formula in new ways.

Take on the role of the iconic Killer Klowns – cooperate in a team of three players, utilize unworldly abilities, hunt humans with zany weapons, and plan your alien invasion to harvest the population of Crescent Cove successfully.

Fight back as a team of seven brave citizens of Crescent Cove – explore the city for valuable loot and weapons, avoid getting captured by Klowns, and try to survive the alien invasion.

2105300198.title: Formula Retro Racing
2105300198.short_description: Formula Retro Racing is a retro style arcade racing game that’s influenced by the classic arcade racing games of the early 90’s.

2105342780.title: Grounded
2105342780.short_description: The world is a vast, beautiful, and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunken to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?

2105395937.title: Apocryphoid (Xbox One)
2105395937.short_description:
In the afterlife you realize you are trapped in a cyber space as a digital spirit. Now you have to fight the digital Angel Virus to free your new dimension.

The game is a Boss Rush Bullet Hell shooter with upgrades. Fight 10 different bosses and try to defeat a secret boss for better ending!

2105436170.title: Super Juicy Stack (Xbox One)
2105436170.short_description: Will your tower stand tall… or flop like a melted candy?

2105437858.title: Ziggurat 2
2105437858.short_description: Ziggurat is back, and now it's even better! Use powerful weapons and spells to break through hordes of enemies and explore labyrinthine dungeons in this hectic roguelite FPS, while you improve your skills and discover new equipment.

2105457739.title: Adorable Adventures
2105457739.short_description: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

2105541844.title: Damways (Windows)
2105541844.short_description: Slide, Build, and Master the Lake.

2105596480.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 11 Demo
2105596480.short_description: The Jackbox Party Pack 11 transports your game night with 5 new games, 2 of which you can play demo versions of now for free ahead of their fall release! Destroy wholesome things in the head-to-head joke game, Doominate. Record hilarious sound effects and dialogue for short movies in Hear Say.

2105623196.title: The Tenants
2105623196.short_description:
Become a landlord and deal with problematic tenants as you build your rental property empire. Decide how to react to annoyed neighbors or police interventions. Will you design your apartment for a group of gamer friends or an aspiring musician looking for a new home?

Take care of your tenants!
Decide which tenants you want to make business with. React to various situations... you never know what's gonna happen: annoyed neighbours, problematic tenants, police involved? Gotta stay alert!

Give it some style!
Design your apartments and give them a polished look. Get rid of that old paint and buy some new furniture or just change the floors. Do not overdo it though! The better it looks, the more money you make!

Wake up your business mind!
Invest wisely to achieve maximum profit. Keep an eye out for the best bargain, and strike when you see an opportunity. Are you into risky deals, or you just want to play it safe? The choice is yours!

Build your own property empire!
Become a landlord and get involved in real-estate. You are the one in the driver's seat. Stay calm, focused and ready to make your bussiness rise all the way to the top!

2105635738.title: Aery - A New Frontier
2105635738.short_description: Aery – A new Frontier is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a bird-like creature while flying through a immersive but peaceful Sci-Fi world.

2105640347.title: Climb Up Hill
2105640347.short_description: 🚗💨 Climb Up Hill – Race, jump, and flip your way through endless hills! 🏔️ Collect coins 💰, grab fuel ⛽, and unlock faster cars 🏎️ to conquer every climb. Simple, fun, and totally addictive! 🎮🔥.

2105832026.title: Arcade Archives 2 SPACE INVADERS PART II
2105832026.short_description:
"SPACE INVADERS PART II" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1979.
The enemy Invaders have returned more powerful than ever, having acquired new tactics like splitting and receiving reinforcements from UFOs!
With added features like the Rainbow Bonus to aim for high scores, this title is long beloved by skilled experts looking to hone their abilities!

2105890016.title: Primal Fray
2105890016.short_description: Primal Fray is a turn-based strategy roguelite. Enter the Rift and fight your way through enemies while building a team of primals and collecting buffs along the way. Outmaneuver your foes and surprise them with powerful combos of a well-built and synergistic team to learn the truth about the Rift.

2105970959.title: The Prince of Landis
2105970959.short_description: Character-driven horror adventure with catastrophic consequences.

2106029435.title: Aquarun (Windows)
2106029435.short_description: Master the Dash, Defy the Impossible!

2106037555.title: Orbital Racer
2106037555.short_description:
In space no one can hear you drift...

Orbital Racer is a racing simulator set in space. It combines the freedom of movement of 6DOF space simulators with the thrills of racing.

The game offers two game modes:

ACTION
This mode is all about fast, satisfying gameplay. Just jump into the cockpit and use your speed and available powerups, including explosive missiles and mines to beat your opponents.

SPLIT-SCREEN
Travel through the depths of space and race against a friend by sharing the screen in local gameplay. Two pads, two spaceships and only one person to win. Which of you will be better at intergalactic rivalry?

Other main features of the game:
- 8 distinct locations, all based on real places in our Solar System
- a total of 24 tracks
- 3 different ship models, each with additional 3 variants
- a challenging yet flexible AI
- custimizable races
- a compelling career mode.

2106093772.title: Lost Eidolons 2nd Beta
2106093772.short_description: Lost Eidolons is a turn-based tactical RPG with a gripping cinematic narrative, set in a waning empire riven by civil war. Take on the role of a charming mercenary captain, Eden, and lead his band of allies through epic encounters on a classic turn-based battlefield.

2106098605.title: One Button Games 5-in-1 vol. 5 (Xbox One)
2106098605.short_description:
All 5 games are fast-paced and controlled with a single button.

R WHEEL Try to survive inside a spinning wheel with spikes. Press a button to jump and hold a button to stay in the air longer. But your jumps release a wave that spawns the spikes. Collect bonus items to release a wave that clears the spikes and score points by clearing them. The game is over when you hit the spikes.

DIVARR Your goal is to knock the enemy bombs down and avoid hitting your allies. Press a button to fire and press it again to split your shot in two that will fly in two perpendicular directions each. You can split the shots up to 16 per screen. The game is over when you hit an ally or any of the bombs reaches the ground.

THROW M You are flying on a balloon which is constantly going up and down. There are enemies to the left of you firing darts at you and trying to pop your balloon. Hold a button to aim and release it to throw a projectile at them to knock them off and destroy their darts. The game is over when an enemy dart hits your balloon.

WIPER You are in charge of a wiper and your goal is to clean the windscreen from all the raindrops. The wiper is swinging from side to side and you can swing it from a highlighted side by pressing a button. The game is over when any raindrop reaches the bottom of the screen.

D MISSILE Your goal is to launch missiles and shoot down enemy projectiles falling from the top. Press a button to launch a missile, you can launch up to 3 missiles at a time. Hold a button to make the launched missiles rotate clockwise. The game is over when any of the enemy projectiles hits the ground.

2106108993.title: Duck Souls+
2106108993.short_description: Run, jump, and dash your way through traps to collect all the eggs!

2106110227.title: Gravitators
2106110227.short_description:
Repel a relentless alien force, travel the galaxy and deliver payloads to secure the future of mankind!

Old-school challenge and style collide with modern advancements and mission design in Gravitators, a twin-stick shooter that puts you in control of 4 different ships as you defend mankind against invasion! Complete a vast array of mission types as you travel to Earth, the Moon, asteroids, planets and exoplanets, the depths of outer space and even black holes! Explore to unlock hidden objectives and rewards, but always be mindful of which power ups will serve the mission at hand.

Inspired by genre classics, Gravitators holds to the basic principles of maneuvering through tight spaces while carrying heavy objects, fighting enemy spacecraft and preserving fuel. Each ship you pilot changes the experience with variations in thrust, rotation and combat strategy, while gravitational forces and environmental factors threaten to slow you down or bring your mission to a crushing end. Do you have the skill see it through?

2106143929.title: Marfusha
2106143929.short_description: Play as the gate guard Marfusha and protect a dystopian city from invaders.

2106204901.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4(Xbox One)
2106204901.short_description:
ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action!

Based on the concept of "experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield," buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world!

2106226816.title: Potion Permit
2106226816.short_description: Moonbury's residents need healing, and you're the best chemist around! With your trusty tools, a brewing cauldron, and a canine companion at your side, you'll need to diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG.

2106233933.title: United Assault - Normandy '44
2106233933.short_description:
United Assault - Normandy '44 is an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Normandy.
You are a US army paratrooper dropped into enemy territory to prepare the D-Day. Your mission objectives vary form destroying Panzer IV tanks, Flak 88 cannons to obtaining secret documents or even liberate an entire town. After completing your objectives, exfiltrate and claim your rewards.

Higher ranks will unlock new weapons and allow you to customize your start loadout.

2106250831.title: Goth Adventure: Volume 1 Demo
2106250831.short_description:
Demo version. 2D Platform game created by Yherok Scars and Lay Black, where you will embody the adventures of Elighas, a powerful dead wizard that crosses the Autem cemetery to stop the spell that has awakened everyone.

Playable for two players in a local cooperative.

2106306263.title: The Gardener and the Wild Vines
2106306263.short_description: Leap, slash, and climb your way to the top of magical towers in this story-based platformer where platforms grow as you climb.

2106443199.title: Samsara
2106443199.short_description: Zee is lost in Samsara, a puzzling journey of beauty and confusion. Using mystical blocks and powerful portals you must help Zee awaken from Samsara.

2106499159.title: Wonder Blade
2106499159.short_description: What are you waiting for? Grab that trusty weapon of yours, free the princess and save the world, all before breakfast! What do you get when you cross a whimsical adventure, humorous characters and combat to die for? Wonder Blade - an awesome experience you won't soon forget.

2106525034.title: Blockman 1989
2106525034.short_description: The blockbuster faux retro hero returns in a new high blocktane adventure!

2106575517.title: Pecaminosa - A Deadly Hand
2106575517.short_description: Pecaminosa - A Deadly Hand blends the charm of pixel art and the mechanics of an Action RPG with the atmosphere of film noir.

2106583887.title: TEKKEN 8
2106583887.short_description: TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games. Join the fight with over 32 characters and bear witness to the next installment in this epic saga. Get ready for the biggest and best TEKKEN game ever made!

2106598447.title: Family Man
2106598447.short_description: You owe us money, Joe, and we plan to collect. We don't care where it comes from, but you'd better not skip town on us. Otherwise your family will be searching the river for your body.

2106675045.title: Samurai Jack: Battle Through Time
2106675045.short_description: Become Samurai Jack, the greatest warrior across time. Journey through time to finally stop Aku’s evil reign in this new adventure told by the creators of Samurai Jack.

2106683993.title: skate.™ (Game Preview)
2106683993.short_description:
The next evolution of the award-winning skate.™ franchise is here in Game Preview.

Experience improved Flick-It controls, the rich physics based skateboarding gameplay that provides those “only in skate.™“ moments and off-board exploration for full freedom in the online multiplayer world of San Vansterdam.

Your new favorite hangout awaits.

2106780142.title: Beneath
2106780142.short_description: Beneath is a Lovecraft-inspired survival FPS. Scarce ammo, merciless enemies and a sense of the unknown combine in a 10+ hour, story-driven single player campaign, built for both veteran gamers and those seeking a challenging old school experience.

2106793519.title: Mole Cart Mining (Xbox One)
2106793519.short_description: Clever Tracks in the Little Mole Mines.

2106821597.title: Shogun Showdown
2106821597.short_description: Shogun Showdown is a turn-based roguelike with deck-building. Position wisely, upgrade tiles, and time combos to defeat the Shogun. Every move counts!

2106826312.title: Close to the Sun
2106826312.short_description: Journalist Rose Archer steps aboard the Helios in search of her sister Ada. She quickly discovers not all is as it seems. Grand halls stand empty. The stench of rotting flesh lingers in the air. Silence. A single word is painted across the entrance… QUARANTINE!

2106896024.title: The Land Beneath Us Demo
2106896024.short_description: The Land Beneath Us: A turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler rooted in Welsh mythology. Unleash skill combos and wield stylish weaponry in Annwn's Underworld. Conquer the Seven Lords, save The Creator, and retrieve vital Soul-Tech.

2106912648.title: HELLMUT: THE BADASS FROM HELL
2106912648.short_description:
Hellmut: The Badass from Hell is a fast-paced bullet-storm dungeon crawler that cranks the nonsense up to 11 and puts you right in the thick of it.

Challenge randomly generated bosses across the randomly generated world, defeat demonic hordes, loot valuable treasures and soulstones, equip powerful weapons and use all your skills to save humanity! Or at the very least, save yourself, which feels at least as good as saving humanity.

2106982681.title: World Of Solitaire
2106982681.short_description:
A classic collection of Solitaire games featuring stunning 3D graphics, is now on the Xbox platform!

Find the secret behind the cards and uncover a mysterious quest in World of Solitaire, featuring 5 classic versions: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Tri-Peaks and Pyramid.
Progress through the game to unlock unique card sets and backgrounds. Customise the game’s appearance with beautiful card designs, while stunning animations offer a unique and immersive playing experience. 

Enjoy the most popular card game ever with hours of endless entertainment in the palm of your hand!

FEATURES:
* 20 beautifully designed 3D themes
* Play in 3D mode or in classic 2D top-down view
* Detailed statistics 
* Quest Mode with a mysterious story
* 25+ awesome music tracks
* 15+ handcrafted card designs – front and back
* Undo & hints provide help if you get stuck
* Game tutorial for new players
* Classic Solitaire games – Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Tri-Peaks and Pyramid.

2106995952.title: Island Cities - Jigsaw Puzzle
2106995952.short_description: Arrange the town islands and see them come to life. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

2107082519.title: DARKLAND Ⅱ
2107082519.short_description: DARKLAND is a fun retro-style platform game! Our protagonist, the shadow hero, must cross the valley to find the key to open the portal. There are dangers along the way, pay attention to the traps on the head and the spikes under the feet. Step on the enemy and destroy them, being careful not to fall off the cliff. The game has 50 levels. Wish you have a good time!

2107128627.title: Harmony Chronicles: Demon Of The Void Collector's Edition
2107128627.short_description:
Saga continues, Mona is about to travel through dimensions!

After her incredible adventures, Mona, the warrior of Goddess Harmony, 
prepares to meet her divine protector before a magic portal transports her to a world on the brink of collapse. 
Mona discovers she has arrived at the once-thriving Interdimensional University of Magic, which has become a shadow of its former self.

As the fate of the universe hangs in the balance, Mona embarks on a perilous journey through shattered dimensions, 
chasing clues that lead to a terrifying entity devouring everything in its path. 

To stop it, she must venture across awe-inspiring worlds, each filled with unique challenges, fantastical creatures, and powerful allies!

2107195644.title: Scheming Through The Zombie Apocalypse: The Beginning
2107195644.short_description: Can you survive the zombie apocalypse by manipulating other animals to loot for you!?

2107302387.title: Nummels
2107302387.short_description: Help the Nummels get to the exit without dying horribly along the way! This is a 2d platformer where you have to prepare a path for the Nummels to get back home. Pick up and place ladders and bridges, dig and blast through the ground, and use mind control. Everyone dies without your help!

2107339353.title: Control Standard Edition
2107339353.short_description:
After a secretive agency in New York is invaded by an otherworldly threat, you become the new Director struggling to regain Control.

From developer Remedy Entertainment, this supernatural 3rd person action-adventure will challenge you to master the combination of supernatural abilities, modifiable loadouts, and reactive environments while fighting through a deep and unpredictable world.

2107382674.title: Basketball.Olympics
2107382674.short_description:
Basketball.Olympics is a Windows Store and a Windows Phone game where you try to shoot the ball through the hoop just like in NBA. You have 2 minutes to score as many points as you can. Try to be as accurate as the NBA legends Michael Jordan, Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal or Magic Johnson or beat any record you can like one of the current NBA stars LeBron James, Stephen Curry or Kevin Durant.
At the end of the game you will be able to see the statistics from the shots you made.
Can be played from many players. 
Keep scoring.

2107397090.title: Spot The Pup (Windows)
2107397090.short_description: Spot The Pup is a charming hidden object adventure where you search for mischievous pups in vibrant, cozy scenes, a delightful mix of discovery, relaxation, and pure puppy joy. Perfect for dog lovers and puzzle fans alike!

2107405034.title: Gunship Assault
2107405034.short_description:
You're piloting a gunship helicopter on a mission to destroy enemies targets and craft. Watch your radar and long range scanner. Identify targets to destroy to complete your mission. Scout out enemy convoys traversing the terrain. Be on the look out for enemy aircraft such as fighter jets, drones, and even enemy gunships. We are counting on you!

The action is fast and furious. Take charge as you're at the controls to complete these important missions.

** Note:
This game supports leaderboards for fastest completion time. You must complete all missions at a difficulty to post to the leaderboard. For example, complete all 10 Easy missions to post the total time to complete them to the Easy leaderboard.
Creators Collection games, such as this one, cannot contain Xbox LIVE achievements and as such cannot increase your GamerScore.
Please be sure to give this game all the required permissions to access Xbox LIVE otherwise Leaderboards and Cloud saving will NOT be available.

2107472532.title: Scorchy Sky Trials (Windows)
2107472532.short_description: Scorchy, a fearless young hatchling with a heart hotter than his flames, must face the legendary Sky Trials to earn his place among the great dragons. Soar through the clouds, unleash blazing fireballs, and show the world that even the smallest dragon can burn the brightest!

2107522520.title: Reel Fishing: Days of Summer
2107522520.short_description:
Your Ultimate Fishing Trip Awaits!

Catch the largest of lunkers from a variety of picturesque locales! Join three good friends as they spend the last days of summer together with one last memorable fishing trip! Catch over 40 species of fish from 14 different fishing locations and craft over 50 different kinds of tackle to lure the rarest of fish! You can even keep fish in a beautiful aquarium while leveling up and gaining new and exciting skills!

2107556397.title: Layers of Fear 2
2107556397.short_description: Layers of Fear 2 is a first-person psychological horror game with an emphasis on exploration and story. Players control a Hollywood actor who heeds the call of an enigmatic director to take on the lead role in a film shot aboard an ocean liner. Beware, for all may not truly be what it seems.

2107633768.title: Hidden Objects: Rome - The Mystery of the Chronovisor
2107633768.short_description:
Dive into a Hidden Objects quest and unravel the enigma of the mysterious Time Machine!
....Rome is the heart of Italy, the Eternal City on seven hills, where time has stood still. You will plunge into its charming atmosphere together with the characters in this game... 
 There are many myths and legends about a secret trove of artefacts in the library of the Vatican - the city-state in the very centre of Rome. One of these legends is the story of the Chronovisor - a mysterious device that "carries you back in time"…
 In this game you will go for a walk around Rome to search for the secret of the Chronovisor and save the heroes who have fallen into a trap. You will make unbelievable discoveries on your way: alien artefacts, mysterious Masonic symbols and secret Roman dodecahedrons. And in the end the Vatican Museums will show you one of their secrets...

2107633863.title: Virtual Families Cook Off: Chapter 1 Let's Go Flippin'
2107633863.short_description: Virtual Families Cook Off: Let's Go Flippin' is a new way to play! Now a premium experience with no micro transactions to buy!

2107704310.title: Extreme Bike Racing (Demo)
2107704310.short_description:
Extreme Bike Racing is ultimate 3D Bike Racing game for all age group. There are 3 stages with 3 challenges in every stage in which player has to face different hurdles and difficulties to complete that challenge.

Features
1. 10 Different challenges with one demo level. (Demo version give access to demo level only, all other challenges are available in Full version only)
2. Difficulty increases after completing of every challenge.
3. Finale gets unlocked once all challenges of every stage is completed.
4. Smooth gameplay exprience for all age group.
5. Various different bikes available for the player to choose from. (One bike is available in demo version)
6. Multiplayer support in the game. (Multiplayer is available in full version only)
7. Multilanguage support in the game.

Get ready for Extreme Bike Racing...

2107781873.title: Unspottable (Demo)
2107781873.short_description:
Unspottable Demo is a competitive couch party game for 2 to 4 players. 
Blend in the crowd of AI characters, hunt down the other players and use the many different environment specific rules to win the game. 

Walk like a robot and punch like a human!

2107898177.title: NBA 2K21
2107898177.short_description:
NBA 2K21 is the latest title in the world-renowned, best-selling NBA 2K series, delivering an industry-leading sports video game experience on Xbox One.
 
 With extensive improvements upon its best-in-class graphics and gameplay, competitive and community online features, and deep, varied game modes, NBA 2K21 offers one-of-a-kind immersion into all facets of NBA basketball and culture - where Everything is Game.

2107926266.title: The Backrooms: Forsaken
2107926266.short_description: What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity? Based on the backrooms lore, this first person, walking simulator will take you on a 2 hour eerie adventure through a place that only exists in our nightmares. "The Backrooms: Forsaken" takes this concept one step further by introducing a companion character and full story to raise the stakes. If you're looking for a casual game this spooky season, and are good at mazes then "The Backrooms: Forsaken" is for you.

2108030420.title: Exo-Calibre
2108030420.short_description:
Take to the skies as a team of cute pilots and fight for peace in vertical scrolling bullet hell style!

Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

Take flight as one of 3 pilots, each with unique shot types and melee weapons, and engage in vertical scrolling shoot’em up combat against swarms of automaton enemies. Take down screen-filling bosses and chase high scores, earning bonuses for maintaining high health and not losing lives along the way. Challenge player rankings in leaderboards for each of 4 unique play modes!

2108136352.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege - Closed Beta
2108136352.short_description:
Welcome to Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege Closed Beta

Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is an elite, tactical team-based shooter where superior planning and execution triumph.

2108228648.title: Furball Over The Front (2021)
2108228648.short_description: Take to the skies over the western front in this WW1 casual Sim-Shooter. Play as an Allied or German pilot in 6 different planes from 1915-1918.

2108244443.title: Suika Game: Cats
2108244443.short_description:
A fun adorable game about merging cats into bigger ones to get high scores.

This game is in the collection of Suika game (a.k.a Watermelon Game, played by many popular Bigo, YouTube, Tiktok,...streamers)

The rules are simple:
- You move the stick to choose where to drop the fruits
- Fruits of same type when touch will merge into bigger ones
- Don't let the fruits overflow the bowl.

2108294066.title: Golden Royal Bingo!
2108294066.short_description:
B4 G46 O72, BINGO! The classic number calling, card marking game is here with A Golden Royal twist. Each player receives a card with 24 numbers and a free space in the center. Choose to play with standard Bingos, lines and corners or with a random shape. The first player that calls Bingo wins. 

Bingo is great with a group of friends or family. Up to four local players can compete. You must have a controller for each player. Also great when alone as you compete against three computer players.

Please note:
Creators Collection games, such as this one, cannot contain Xbox LIVE achievements and as such cannot increase your GamerScore.

2108304147.title: Ladders by POWGI
2108304147.short_description: Make new words by changing one letter at a time. The goal is to turn one word into another using only a limited number of steps.

2108319895.title: Higgs Boson: Puzzle Collection (Xbox One)
2108319895.short_description: Think in angles. Solve in seconds.

2108360303.title: Anime Poly Puzzle - Mystic Maidens
2108360303.short_description: Anime Poly Puzzle - Mystic Maidens combines cool mind-twisting low-poly puzzles and sweet and amazing looking anime girls in an mysterious RPG setting.

2108394419.title: Dino Land
2108394419.short_description: Dino takes an epic adventure to bring peace back.

2108394919.title: Mystic Thief - Elemental Conquest (Xbox Series X/S)
2108394919.short_description: Master every element. Conquer every chamber. Become the ultimate arcane master.

2108611710.title: TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION
2108611710.short_description: TIEBREAK - GRAND SLAM EDITION Compete in more than 100 official tournaments against over 150 officially licensed professionals. Take on the complete ATP and WTA Tours, including the Australian Open, Roland-Garros, Wimbledon and the US Open.

2108619055.title: Egg Hop
2108619055.short_description: Play as a goose who is navigating the dungeon in search of a treasure. Use a mixture of eggs and platforming to solve puzzles, circumnavigate obstacles, and most importantly, avoid death. Which can prove to be quite difficult since you never know what death trap might be lurking behind each corner. But it will all be worth it for the treasure.

2108660449.title: Super Kart Mini Car Race
2108660449.short_description:
Super Kart Mini Car Race is an exciting and colorful racing game in the style of Mario Kart, offering players a thrilling experience on 13 different race tracks with themes ranging from the kitchen to the bedroom, bathroom, and the beach.

Realistic Vehicle Physics:
Super Kart Mini Car Race delivers an authentic racing experience with its realistic RC car physics. Each of the 21 vehicles in the game is meticulously designed to emulate the handling and responsiveness of remote-controlled cars. Feel the precision of every turn, the impact of various terrains, and the distinct characteristics of each vehicle as you navigate through the diverse race tracks. The game's attention to realistic physics adds an extra layer of immersion, making every race a true test of skill and strategy.

Rich Game Modes:
With various game modes such as Time Trial, Arcade, and Championship Tournaments, Super Kart Mini Car Race aims to capture the interest of all types of players.

2108691958.title: Ratyrinth
2108691958.short_description:
Navigate tricky mazelike levels and help reunite a lost rodent with his family!

Take the role of a nimble rodent separated from his family and lost in a frightening forest filled with fearsome foes! Ratyrinth is a side-scrolling precision platformer with brainteasing level design and retro presentation. Run, jump, cling to walls, swim and climb through mazelike stages presented in minimalistic 2-tone style with fluid pixel art animation.

If you fail, don’t worry too much, as you’ll instantly respawn at the start and can retry as many times as it takes. Challenge increases with each level you clear, gradually introducing new mechanics and enemies as you progress.

2108730441.title: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 2
2108730441.short_description: Eight legendary shmups, one explosive bundle. The Toaplan Shooting Collection Vol. 2 truly puts the blast in "blast from the past"!

2108848036.title: Strike Force 3
2108848036.short_description:
Welcome to the frontline of action-packed warfare in Strike Force 3!
As a highly-trained elite operative, you'll be thrust into the heart of modern-day combat against the ruthless Tariqian Liberation Front (TLF). Prepare for intense firefights, adrenaline-pumping stealth missions, and high-stakes challenges that will put your skills to the test.
Explore stunning desert canyons and war-torn cities as you fight to liberate Al-Tariq from the grips of terror. Use an arsenal of powerful weapons and cutting-edge gear to outmaneuver your enemies and complete daring objectives.

The fate of an entire region lies in your hands as you embark on a gripping singleplayer campaign, filled with twists and turns that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Get ready for the most intense and action-packed military shooter experience with Strike Force 3! Join an elite special operations unit tasked with taking down a ruthless terrorist organization and restoring peace to a war-torn country. With cutting-edge graphics, immersive gameplay, and adrenaline-pumping missions, Strike Force 3 delivers an unparalleled combat experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Key Features:
- Immersive single-player campaign: Engage in a gripping storyline as a member of the elite Strike Force, battling against a ruthless terrorist organization.
- Authentic combat experience: Utilize a wide arsenal of weapons and equipment, employ strategic thinking, and engage in intense firefights in realistic environments.
- Stunning graphics and sound effects: Immerse yourself in realistic visuals and sound effects that enhance the overall gameplay experience.
- Challenging enemy AI: Battle against intelligent enemy AI that react to your tactics and challenge you at every turn, keeping the gameplay fresh and challenging.

Get ready to join the Strike Force and embark on an epic mission to restore peace to Tariq. Are you up for the challenge? Get Strike Force 3 now and experience the ultimate combat experience!

2108887080.title: A Blocc World
2108887080.short_description: A voxel-style open-world RPG. Use a variety of melee, ranged and magical combat abilities to smash your way to saving the world. Grow your strength, with powerful abilities and equipment. Learn about the world of Blocc from friendly characters, and try to keep them in one piece.

2108921213.title: FREE FIRE ULTIMATE
2108921213.short_description:
Key Features
Precision Headshots
Experience realistic combat with rewarding headshot mechanics that demand skill and accuracy.
Competitive Tournaments
Join intense online tournaments and compete against players worldwide for top rankings and rewards.
Kill Streak System
Build unstoppable momentum with powerful kill streak bonuses that give you a tactical advantage in battle.
Army Backup System (Army on Call)
Call in AI-controlled allies during combat to support your strategy and dominate the battlefield.
Unlimited Weapons & Customization
Access a massive arsenal of guns, skins, and upgrades with no limits—play your way.
Advanced Combat Actions
Perform smooth, realistic movements including dodge, roll, sprint, cover, and tactical shooting.
Dual Perspective Gameplay
Seamlessly switch between First-Person (FPS) and Third-Person (TPS) modes for a dynamic combat experience.

2109003457.title: TRANSIRUBY
2109003457.short_description:
Explore the mysteries of an unknown land!
”Transiruby '' is a metroidvania game where you explore the world as a cyborg protagonist named Siruby. Slash and shoot your way to reveal its hidden secrets!

2109036777.title: Floor Kids
2109036777.short_description: Floor Kids is a one-of-a-kind breakdancing game featuring a unique trick-style rhythm gameplay. Innovative controls allow you the freedom to play the way you like with a dynamic scoring system that rewards your moves based on musicality, originality, and style.

2109036916.title: Colorful Recolor (Xbox One)
2109036916.short_description: Colorful Recolor is a fast-paced puzzler with a kaleidoscopic collection of brain teasers. Play through 100 levels with engaging mechanics, striking biomes, 10+ distinct elements and an abundance of colors. Paint your way through this colorful world!

2109105906.title: Pets Hotel
2109105906.short_description:
Start your adventure and open your own Pets Hotel!

Take care of different types of animals.
All your little guests have different needs. The owners will tell you all about them, and it is your job to feed the pets according to their demands. Don’t forget about grooming and play-time! A satisfied customer is the best business strategy of all!

Manage your pet hotel.
One of the biggest challenges that await you in Pets Hotel is designing and running a place where your customers can stay assured that they are leaving their beloved pets in good hands. The competition never sleeps!

Have fun with your guests!
Your guests have their requirements! Make sure you offer them enough daily entertainment and exercise to keep them strong, healthy, and relaxed. Take them for walks, pet them, give them treats, and play with balls. Make all kinds of animals feel at home in your hotel.

Start from scratch and build your pet hotel empire!
As the game progresses, you will expand your business and make it the most premier pets hotel of all time! Imagine a place with a multitude of rooms, each designed and decorated for a different type of animal, with huge playgrounds surrounding your premium hotel! A truly fabulous venue that you can create yourself.

2109269529.title: Mina The Hollower
2109269529.short_description: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

2109276500.title: HAMVENTURE
2109276500.short_description: Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges.

2109326134.title: Chess AI : PC & XBOX
2109326134.short_description: ♞Embark on a timeless journey of strategy and intellect with "Chess AI," the definitive chess experience that has captivated minds for centuries. Hone your cognitive prowess and immerse yourself in deep concentration with the world's most classic board game, now enhanced for the modern era.

2109344129.title: FINAL FANTASY XV
2109344129.short_description:
FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION
Includes all of the exciting content released as part of continuous game updates (Chapter 13 alternate route, off-road Regalia customisation, character swap feature and more!). And comes with all of content released in the Season Pass - Episode Gladiolus, Episode Prompto, Multiplayer Expansion: Comrades, and Episode Ignis
Get ready to be at the centre of the ultimate fantasy adventure. 

Main game:
・FINAL FANTASY XV

New Features:
・ “Insomnia City Ruins: Expanded Map” – a new map that takes you right up to the end
・First Person Mode
・Armiger Unleashed
・Use of the Royal Cruiser has been unlocked, with new fishing spots and recipes
・Additional quest to acquire and upgrade the Regalia TYPE-D
・Additional Achievements

DLC:
・FFXV Episode Gladiolus
・FFXV Episode Prompto
・FFXV Episode Ignis
・FFXV MULTIPLAYER EXPANSION: COMRADES
・FFXV Booster Pack+
・FFXV Holiday Pack+
*Moogle Chocobo Carnival tickets are not included in the FFXV Holiday Pack+.

Bonus Items:
・[Weapon] Masamune (FFXV Original Model)
・[Weapon] Mage Mashers (FFIX Model)
・[Weapon] Blazefire Saber XV (FFXV Original Color)
・[Weapon] Gae Bolg (FFXIV Model)
・[Regalia Coloring] Platinum Leviathan
・[Regalia Coloring] 16-Bit Buddies
・[Regalia Coloring] Cindymobile
・[Regalia Coloring] Gold Chocobo
・[Outfit] Royal Raiment
・[Item] Travel Pack
・[Item] Camera Kit
・[Item] Angler Set
・[Item] Gourmand Set

Check the system requirements before downloading and applying the FFXV WINDOWS EDITION 4K Resolution Pack.


Save data can be cross-saved between the Xbox One software “FINAL FANTASY XV” (released 29th November, 2016) and "FINAL FANTASY XV ROYAL EDITION" (released 6th March, 2018), and “FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION.”


Please go here to see details on FFXV Benchmark:
http://www.jp.square-enix.com/ff15/PC/benchmark/na/.

2109350810.title: Dungeons Of Hinterberg
2109350810.short_description: Armed with a sword and a tourist guide, explore the beautiful alpine village of Hinterberg and uncover the magic hidden within its dungeons! Master magic, solve puzzles, slay monsters; all this and more await you in Hinterberg!

2109355951.title: Endless Calc
2109355951.short_description:
Endless Calc is a small mathematical game in which small tasks are solved by choosing the right one from four proposed solutions.
Each correctly solved task is rewarded with a score.

1) HOW IT WORKS: Choose the right one from four proposed solutions
2) TIMER MODE: Solve a certain number of tasks in a given time
3) SHARE: Share your high score with your family & friends
4) THEMES: Choose your favorite from included themes or create your own.

2109383928.title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2 (Windows)
2109383928.short_description:
After graduating high school, Kaito returns to his hometown for one final summer before stepping into adult life.
The ocean that once shaped his childhood memories now calls him back—and so do the two girls he once shared it with.

In Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2, Kaito reunites with his former surfing partners and close friends, Michiko and Yuuki. Once inseparable, the three drifted apart after the events of the first game. Now older, more confident, and carrying new dreams, they decide to revive the Surfing Club for one last unforgettable season.

2109412601.title: Emergency Call - The Attack Squad
2109412601.short_description:
Take on the role of the attack squad, explore the scene and work through the challenges in a reasonable way. 
The unclear damage situation at the beginning of every scene, whether it is fires, rescue of people or technical assistance requires your attention. Keep in mind that the choice of the right tools is just as important as a reasonable tactical order you have to decide on, when exploring and working through the operations.

2109434372.title: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game (Demo)
2109434372.short_description: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a hand animated JRPG adventure that draws from genre classics. Join Jae as he goes on a journey with his best friends to try and fix the past in a story full of laughs, tears, and Elemelons. Engage in silly battles that involve timed hits, meter, and teamwork.

2109456271.title: Dead Man´s Diary
2109456271.short_description: It's a fictitious post-apocalyptic world, 15 years after the catastrophe, you have to leave your shelter and explore a world devoid of human life. On your own, you must find a way to survive.

2109567965.title: OBLITACRATER
2109567965.short_description: Dive into an action-packed shoot 'em up where every drop onto the planet could be your last. Fight through endless waves of increasingly deadly alien monsters while collecting powerful upgrades to aid you in battle. You can escape at any time, but beware — death resets your score to zero!

2109569827.title: Little Disaster
2109569827.short_description: You’ll have a blast in this explosive puzzle platformer!

2109577659.title: Dyna Bomb
2109577659.short_description:
Dyna Bomb
Explosive Arcade Sensation!

Strap on your jetpack and prepare for chaos! Dyna Bomb is the latest, greatest platform game from 7 Raven Studios. Play it, and believe it.

With 64 explosive levels - and 8 gloriously animated worlds. This arcade smash is a real feast for the senses, with superb artwork and thunderous explosions - oh so many explosions!

Experience the manic arcade action as you dodge enemies, fling bombs and grab the treasure - before making a mad dash for the exit. Do you have the skills to find the secret levels? Can you master all the different power ups and dominate the worlds?

If it moves, detonate it. Dyna Bomb has intuitive arcade action game play, with a blast of humor . Enjoy features like, the wheel of fortune to discover hidden extras, player powerups, different characters designs and much, much more!

2109658878.title: Pizza Tycoon
2109658878.short_description: The economic simulation Pizza Tycoon offers a number of hot new toppings! Work your way through a challenging campaign to rise from a simple pizza baker in the streets of Rome to the owner of the world's most successful pizza chain!

2109710078.title: Hook: Complete Edition
2109710078.short_description:
Experience the ultimate relaxing puzzle game collection with Hook: Complete Edition, featuring both Hook 1 and Hook 2 in one package.

Hook – A minimalist puzzle game where your goal is to remove all hooks from the board using intuitive mechanics. No timers, no scores—just pure, stress-free gameplay complemented by a calming ambient soundtrack.

2110345579.title: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul
2110345579.short_description:
It is the 17th century and the Ottoman Empire is at the height of its power, forming a transcontinental realm stretching across Europe, Asia, and Africa. However, it is locked in a deadly struggle with Venice, for resources and power, centered around the richest of its provinces, crete. You are an impoverished patrician from Venice, exiled in Istanbul. The accidental discovery of a mysterious compass sets you on a course for vengeance against the Ottoman commander responsible for the death of your family and your disgrace.

Vendetta Across Worlds

The Compass is your only chance at finding justice. By day, explore the meticulously recreated Istanbul at its richest and most beautiful, running into characters ripped straight from the pages of history. Meet Ahmed Dede, astronomer, poet, and historian, who played an unlikely role in your hero's past, and a vital ally of Sultan Mehmed IV, whose rule saw the Empire reach its greatest territorial extent.

By night, descend into Fitrat, the realm of dreams where everything is possible. Draw and redraw the course of your destiny, peer into the lives of others, from petty merchants to mighty kings. But beware, the compass can only take you so far. Beyond that, you'll need strength of arms, wits, and a keen eye for secrets.

Overcome, Grow, Conquer

Every time you descend into Fitrat, you have the opportunity to grow stronger and push closer to the truth. Fight enemies trying to keep you from changing fate, using a light RPG system featuring skills, weapons, and armor to build your disgraced patrician the way you like.

But this realm is more than just violence: You'll need to explore in depth, tackle challenging puzzles and show off your agility in platforming sections, if you want to learn the complete truth. The Compass will be your irreplaceable aid.

A Blend of Reality and Fantasy

Compass of Destiny was created using meticulous research, to give you an authentic glimpse into the Ottoman Empire at its peak, challenged for supremacy by the Serene Republic of Venice. The brutal Cretan War defined the balance of power in the Mediterraneans for centuries to come, making it the perfect moment in history to combine with exploring fantasy concepts and the personal struggles of people caught in the middle of a titanic struggle between superpowers.

Master the Art of Distraction: Create clever diversions using everyday household items to redirect attention away from your escape route
Navigate Dynamic Security: Family members have unique patrol patterns, areas of focus, and levels of awareness that change based on your actions
Transform Ordinary Objects: Turn remote controls, toys, household tech and more into sophisticated tools for your master escape plan
Multiple Escape Routes: Each exit presents different challenges and opportunities - from bedroom windows to basement doors
Real-time Strategy: Timing is everything! One misplaced item or poorly timed move could send you back to square one
Escalating Challenges: Progress through increasingly complex scenarios requiring multi-stage plans and perfect execution
Neighborhood Freedom: Successfully escape to meet your waiting friends and enjoy bonus arcade mini-games as your reward

From simple sneaking to elaborate multi-stage plans worthy of a Hollywood heist, Schoolboy Escape turns everyday suburban life into the ultimate puzzle-solving adventure!

He has lost everything he had and loved, and with nothing more to lose he leaves for Samarnath, an evil subterranean kingdom (which no knight has ever returned alive) in search of treasures, adventures and the most important: five magical orbs that together provide: the Eternal youth.

Thanks to its progressive difficulty curve, and with a path divided into “worlds” of 5 levels each one, Eternum Ex is challenging, addictive and an ode to the nostalgia of the golden age of arcade games.

With a very simple core gameplay mechanics, an increasing difficulty, an exciting and addictive gameplay, and with a very precise control, Eternum Ex is perfect for retro hardcore gamers but also for those who want to start in retro games, and even for those who want to show children how games were when game industry was taking its first steps and gameplay was the most important factor in a video game.

2114143751.title: Akatsuki: Lord of the Dawn
2114143751.short_description:
Build your battle party, construct facilities and strategize to reclaim the kingdom from chaos!

Akatsuki: Lord of the Dawn is a real-time strategy RPG where you build your own parties from a large cast of characters and use various military techniques to take down your enemies, all presented in fluidly animated retro pixel art style! Will you claim victory or let it slip from your grasp?

2114307100.short_description:
Welcome to Bad Dream: Coma. A point&click game where unique minimalistic art style creates an unforgettable and atmospheric experience. Travel through the surreal and disturbing dreamland where everything depends on your actions. You can't die but you can suffer greatly...

TIP OF THE ICEBERG
The game is designed in the "action-reaction" way and there are no obvious choices. Beat the game once and then be curious "What if I would do it differently". Sometimes it's something small but from time to time you'll see huge differences. The smallest things can be the most rewarding.

DARK, SAD AND DISTURBING WORLD
Visit the place known from the previous chapters of the Bad Dream Series. Encounter well-known creatures in their new form, or find a way to erase them from your memory and turn this dream to the peaceful nap.

* non-linear gameplay with high replayability

2114567052.title: Find The Cats (Windows)
2114567052.short_description:
Discover adorable cats hidden across charming handcrafted scenes in Find The Cats! Explore colorful environments, sharpen your attention, and find every sneaky little kitty before moving to the next level.

Perfect for casual and cozy game fans, Find The Cats offers a relaxing experience with cute visuals, satisfying discoveries, and plenty of fluffy cats to uncover. Can you find them all?

2114614966.title: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Europe
2114614966.short_description: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia is a spot-the-difference game with a twist! Explore hand-drawn scenes, catch all 25 mafia rats, and bring peace to Europe. Hidden objects, surprises, and justice await. The continent is counting on you!

2114661204.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
2114661204.short_description:
HIDDEN IN PLAIN SIGHT is a set of local multiplayer (2-4 players) game modes that share a common theme: trying to accomplish goals without drawing attention to yourself. 

In each game mode, players control a character in a sea of identical NPCs. Players are given a task, but also the means to eliminate each other from the game. The goal is to blend in with the NPCs, accomplish the task at hand, and take out other players before they get you.

One of the simplest game modes is called "Death Race." Players and NPCs are racing to be the first to cross a finish line. Each player has a gun with one bullet, and can eliminate one person from the race. Do you sprint ahead, calling attention to yourself but maximizing you chances of winning? Or do you hang back with the pack?

Other game modes create similar tension by putting players in a conflicted position of wanting to accomplish a goal, but risking elimination by doing so.

Rounds are quick and lively, and always end in laughter and friendly shouting. So grab your controllers and friends and give it a shot!

2115998347.title: The Drone Racing League Simulator

Battle it out with your friends to the finish line. Crash nonstop without wrecking your drone and breaking the bank. 2116045375.title: ACA NEOGEO TOP HUNTER RODDY & CATHY

2116095486.title: Care Bears: To The Rescue
2116095486.short_description: Care Bears: To The Rescue is a brand-new action-platformer set in the world-renowned Care Bears universe, drawing direct inspiration from the original animated show “Care Bears: Unlock the Magic”!

2116180460.title: Excessive Trim
2116180460.short_description:
Wreak havoc through backwater farmlands as a pothead alien with a buzzsaw flying saucer!

Take flight as a blunt-smokin’ alien in a buzzsaw saucer as he terrorizes farms and recklessly grinds through herds of livestock! Excessive Trim is a pseudo-3D vertical scrolling slice ’em up presented in stark black, white and red 3-tone pixel art. Take control of your circular bladed UFO and try to survive while you collect precious leaves.

Perform dashes to buzz through lines of stampeding cattle, avoid farm machinery, zip between trees and rock formations, cut down angry agriculturalists and more! Tag specific dash points for bonus leaves. Find backwater shops where you can choose between upgrades to give you more health or grant multipliers. But watch out! There’s always bound to be a tradeoff. Survive as long as you can through a procedurally generated stage loop, shoot for the high score and change your color palette to customize the experience.

2116209805.title: Soul Hackers 2
2116209805.short_description: Explore a supernatural RPG with stylish summoners and dark dangers lurking under the neon lights of a cyberpunk Japan. It is up to the agents of Aion to decrypt destiny and save the world from apocalypse!

Build a dice pool strong enough to purify Astrea's out-of-control corruption and save the Star System.

2116409537.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist : Link Evolution
2116409537.short_description: Experience 20 years of Yu-Gi-Oh! history with Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution! Build your Deck from over 10,000 cards and take on the most iconic Duelists from the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe. Relive the stories from the original Yu-Gi-Oh! animated series through Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS!

2116409833.title: Stick Infinite Kingdom - Demo
2116409833.short_description: 3D Action-Strategy: Build, Command, and Defend Your Kingdom.

2116420839.title: Wild Seas (Windows)

2116424411.title: JokerJack
2116424411.short_description:
JokerJack is a hypnotically additive deckbuilder that takes the classic game of 21 and cranks it to the breaking point. Forget everything you know about playing it safe; here, "busting" is just a missed opportunity for a massive multiplier.

Combine the fundamentals of Blackjack with a growing collection of over 60 unique Joker cards to create game-breaking synergies. Whether you're adding flat chips for every Face card played or triggering an exponential Multiplier for hitting exactly 21, your goal is simple: reach the target score, survive the Blind, and keep the run alive.

With seeded runs, deep strategic discards, and a retro-neon aesthetic, every hand is a fresh chance to find the ultimate combo. Do you have the strategy to outsmart the deck, or will you go bust trying?
Key Features:

 The Power of the Joker: Discover and equip over 60 distinct Jokers, each with unique rarities and game-altering effects.

 Massive Scoring: Master the Chips×Multiplier formula to turn a simple hand of 21 into a billion-point payout.

 Deep Roguelike Strategy: Navigate through escalating Blinds, utilize limited discards to sculpt your hand, and buy powerful upgrades in the Shop between rounds.

 Endless Variety: No two runs are ever the same. Unlock new decks, hidden card types, and "Exotic" Jokers as you climb the ranks.

 Play Your Way: Optimized for Xbox with full controller support, cloud saves, and achievements for the most daring card sharks.

 Master the Seed: Compete on the same RNG with friends or the community in Seeded Runs to see who can build the most broken deck.

2116434099.title: TMSurvival
2116434099.short_description: Protect your base from attacks by cooperating with your friends.

2116462750.short_description: Get in trouble with Morkull again!

2116661902.title: Bubble Shooter FX

2116661936.title: Projection: First Light

2116686564.title: Taqoban

2116699371.title: My Land
2116699371.short_description:
My Land is a farm simulation game from the makers of the award winning god simulation My Planet. You begin the game with a blank plot of land and $5000. From there, it is up to you to make it your own. You can create a farm with crops and animals, or you can create a commerce area with side walks and pizza stands, or you can create a nature park with lakes and trails. The choice is yours!

In My Land, you may take up several avenues of revenue generation. You can do farming, business, or run a nature trail system. The farm is where the easiest money is to be made. There are no real rules to the simulation, so you can basically do anything you want to. Feel free to explore all that the game has to offer!

My Land is designed for desktops and tablets alike. I consider My Land to be a game in progress, and as such, I am open to any and all suggestions on how to make it better. If you guys want it to be more farm oriented, I can add more farm related things. If you like the business and nature side, I can work on that too. If you would rather start seeing it move in a different direction, tell me in the comments! This game is for you guys!

If you are looking for a nice laid back farm sim game and do not want to be bothered with constant in app purchase requirements and financial nags, then try My Land today!

2116707271.title: Energy Cycle (Windows)

Sounds pretty easy, but try to do it!

2116714436.title: Marvel's Avengers BETA
