In the depths of a dark and unforgiving forest, an exiled princess whiles her time in solitude. For a girl raised in the lap of comfort, the woods are impossibly harsh, and day-to-day survival is the most she can manage. One day, however, a mysterious, beautiful maiden appears, throwing her world out of its already delicate alignment. The princess is instantly captivated by this stranger and begins to fancy herself the heroine of a fairytale, even as the maiden proves herself to be less and less of a fantasy.

Without a Voice is a thought-provoking visual novel adventure told through detailed character portraits, scripted dialogue of more than 15,000 words, lush backdrops and a dozen unlockable event illustrations. Make key decisions to decide how the story plays out and discover 8 possible endings to this tale of love and intrigue between its leading ladies.

2136356568.title: Mighty Switch Force! Collection
2136356568.short_description: Switch up the fun with four games in one! As cybernetic peacekeeper Officer Patricia Wagon, you'll use your platforming skills, puzzle-solving abilities, and level-altering Siren Helmet to catch criminals, extinguish infernos, and smash enemies. Four-player co-op and versus modes included!

2136359198.title: Infernitos
2136359198.short_description: Serve devilish dishes by solving puzzles in a fiery kitchen!

2136375300.title: Spectrum!
2136375300.short_description:
Spectrum is a revolutionary 2-8 player local party game. In Spectrum, there is no respawning and no more waiting to get back in the action. Instead each time you kill someone, they instantly become part of your team! Each round ends when all the players are on one team.

Spectrum offers a wealth of competitive screaming-at-each-other-across-the-room fun for small to large groups alike!

2136381305.title: Thrill Penguin
2136381305.short_description: Chill out with this thrilling penguin challenge.

2136427846.title: ZooKeeper
2136427846.short_description:
Become a Zoo Keeper, manage and build the zoo of your childhood dreams! Take care of the animals and create ideal conditions for them. Grow your zoo, add extraordinary species and prepare amazing attractions for visitors.

ZooKeeper is a low poly game in which the player takes on the role of a zoo owner. Your main task is to manage the zoo to make it as popular as possible!

Become the best Zoo Owner and build the greatest Zoo of all time! While creating your dream zoo, you can build structures and objects such as enclosures adapted to a given species of animal, additional attractions for visitors, alleys and decorations.

Create biomes for animals. Raise the necessary funds, purchase animal pens and get it organized to open the best zoo in the region. Choose new objects for individual biomes. Create biomes that will match the climate for the rare animals.

Look after the animals. Keeping your animals in good health is very important and the success of your zoo depends on it. Don’t forget that each animal requires regular feeding and cleaning up of the enclosure, and if it becomes ill, you should treat it. Do not forget to clean the pen for animals and take care of their good mood through fun!

Build a great team of employees. As a leader, you must be aware that your employees are not only a great help for you, but also a great responsibility. You will have to learn to manage your team in all situations and remember to pay their salary on time…

Bring back to life long-extinct reptile species and place them in your Zoo. When you become a successful zoo owner, nothing will stop you from achieving even more. Nobody will ever forget a zoo where they can see prehistoric animal species, and you can become the first to provide visitors with such an amazing opportunity.

2136460296.title: Seek Hearts
2136460296.short_description: Set out on an adventure to discover Izen's mysterious origins in a sci-fi RPG!

2136524032.title: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
2136524032.short_description: A top-down adventure game in a coloring book world full of vibrant characters. Use painting powers to explore, solve puzzles, make friends, and draw on anything!

2136590033.title: Cinderscratch (Windows)
2136590033.short_description: Ashpaw, the last of the Flamekeepers, stands alone against a creeping corruption—an ancient plague that transforms all it touches into undead abominations. Once-bright cities and vibrant forests now echo with the moans of the cursed. Carrying the final ember of the Sacred Flame, Ashpaw must journey through this forsaken land, rekindling the ancient bonfires scattered across the realm. Each flame brings a spark of hope, and only when all are lit will the corruption retreat… and the world be saved.

2136723382.title: The Fast Journey
2136723382.short_description:
In "The Fast Journey", embark on an exciting 2D adventure as a brave frog named Rafa.
Your beloved frog, Polly, is captured by malevolent creatures.

2136865616.title: Sword of the Necromancer
2136865616.short_description: Turn your foes into allies in this Action RPG with Rogue-lite elements.

2136871363.title: Indoor Baseball
2136871363.short_description: Play a fast paced game of 1v1 baseball where your parents wouldn't let you. Break windows for home runs, smash toys and other house hold items, and avoid all the destruction while playing an arcade style baseball game.

2136950563.title: Bugsnax
2136950563.short_description: Catch mysterious living snacks and feed them to your friends in this unusual island adventure!

2136960458.title: Geometry Destroyer
2136960458.short_description: Fight enemies with your ship destroying geometries in horde mode.

2137040856.title: Urban Ninja
2137040856.short_description: Test your abilities as an agile ninja by running over rooftops of a city. There are many obstacles in your way so you need to show your skills to overcome them. Run as far as you can...and when you are tired... run some more.

2137121835.title: Pyramid Platformer - The Gem Heist Windows
2137121835.short_description: Explore the pyramid world in Pyramid Platformer, a challenging 2D pixel art game. Face 40 levels filled with traps like spikes and spinning saws. Unlock skills like Double Jump and Dash, and collect gems to advance on this thrilling journey full of challenges!

2137169995.title: Tenebris Somnia Demo
2137169995.short_description: Enter a world of nightmares in Tenebris Somnia, the retro-inspired survival horror game with live-action cutscenes.

2137208120.title: Crate Fang
2137208120.short_description:
One crate at a time. One clever move at a time.
In Crate Fang, you play as a golden-armored wolf solving smart sokoban puzzles across ancient ruins. Push, undo, restart, and outthink each level at your own pace in this charming pixel-art adventure.

2137228830.title: Oirbo
2137228830.short_description: As Oirbo you will explore a labyrinthian spacecraft and discover its mysteries and purpose. Navigate a huge Metroidvania-inspired, hand-drawn, 2D action platformer full of secrets to uncover, areas to explore, and enemies to dismantle.

2137239411.title: Minute of Islands
2137239411.short_description: Explore strange and wonderful islands and dark labyrinths below in this narrative puzzle platformer. Guide young mechanic Mo on her quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse. The powerful Omni Switch at your disposal may not be enough to fix the damage that hides beneath the surface...

2137248033.title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 - Demo
2137248033.short_description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

2137426654.title: My Child Lebensborn
2137426654.short_description:
"My Child Lebensborn tells a disturbing tale about innocents in the aftermath of WW2” -Polygon-
“The strongest game experience that I have ever had.”-LevelUp-

You adopt a young Lebensborn child in Norway afterWW2, but parenting will be hard as your child grows up in a hostile and hateful environment. See a different side of the war, inspired by the true stories of the Lebensborn children. Discover how hatred towards an enemy creates war victims even in peacetime. Find out their past and support them in the present. You must balance your time and resources to provide for your child. You will find answers to the hard questions; about their history, the hatred, bullying and the passing of blame. Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the burden of their heritage, to find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom? 
Key Features:
- Influence the child’s feelings, personality and worldview through your choices.
- Look for the effects of your choices in your child expressions and body language.
- Explore a gripping storyline based upon true events.
- Earn money as you work, then cook, craft, forage and play.
- Use your time and meagre resources wisely.- Adopt a boy or girl, and support them through a defining year of their life. 

User Reviews: 
“Groundbreaking, compassionate and engaging.”
“It's so simplistic in gameplay with such a powerful story”
“I loved it. It brought me many emotions I didna even know I could express. To say I cherished this game would be an understatement.”.

2137443576.title: RetriXGold
2137443576.short_description:
Games library organizer and games engines frontend
you can organize your games as you like and test any engine on PC, Mobile and XBOX
it will help both users and developers to maintain many things in one place with Easy to use UI.

2137538060.title: Little Triangle
2137538060.short_description: Little Triangle has two well-polished gameplay modes, the awesome platformer mode and the hilarious party fighting mode like a mini battle royale.

2137543335.title: Dino Kid: Island Platformer Adventure
2137543335.short_description:
🦖 Explore, Jump, and Run!

Join Dino Kid on an exciting island adventure! This fun-filled platformer lets you explore 20 challenging levels, dodge enemy dinosaurs, and collect fruits to stay energized. Perfect for kids and families, it’s a thrilling journey through a mysterious island packed with fun and adventure. Download now and start your dino adventure!

2137647180.title: LumbearJack
2137647180.short_description: Grab your axe and save the environment by chopping and recycling every man-made thing in your path and solving puzzles with your charming animal friends!

2137651733.title: New Super Lucky's Tale Demo
2137651733.short_description: Jump, burrow, and tail swipe your way to victory in this love letter to classic 3D platformers!

2137667623.title: Magnetail (Windows)
2137667623.short_description: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor.

2137716551.title: Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
2137716551.short_description: Dive deep through the neon-hued '80s inspired classic 2D action-platformer!

2137734969.title: Brews & Bastards Demo
2137734969.short_description: Brews & Bastards is an intoxicating local co-op dungeon crawler for 1 to 4 players, overflowing with action-packed combat, magical brews and outlandish bosses. Select from a group of distinct heroes and blast your way through hordes of drunken demons in search of the stolen Brew Stone.

2137795532.title: WorldCup Soccer
2137795532.short_description: Be a part of the World Cup playing this game in three different modes. Quick match, Championship and Penalty mode. Choose your team and win the World Cup if you have what it takes.

2137978746.title: Daniel in Danger
2137978746.short_description: Help little Daniel find his way out using quick reflexes and precise movements.

2137985485.title: WONDER BOY ASHA in Monster World
2137985485.short_description: The adventures of Asha the little warrior. Save the world with Pepelogoo.

2138066534.title: Sapu
2138066534.short_description: Help Sapu on this adventure in the middle of the forest to find a cure for his grandfather who was bitten by a poisonous carnivorous plant.

2138200431.title: Joe Wander and the Enigmatic adventures
2138200431.short_description: Start the best Enigmatic Adventure of your life! Solve brain-teasing puzzles, explore different worlds with smooth platforming, and enjoy the beautiful scenery in the mysterious world of Joe Wander.

2138218417.title: Becastled
2138218417.short_description: Build your castle by day and defend it by night. Becastled blends a cozy city-building sim with a challenging tower defense strategy. Lead the Sun Kingdom�s last stand against the Moon beasts!

2138276496.title: Pneuma: Breath of Life
2138276496.short_description: Pneuma: Breath of Life is an enthralling first person puzzler putting gamers’ minds to the test in a visually stunning world. Pneuma provides players with a sense of awe and a relentless determination to solve every puzzle and progress through a narrated story of self-discovery, exploring the fundamental nature of being. This first person puzzler designed to force players think outside the box and explore beyond what they know as reality.

2138304024.title: Rec Room
2138304024.short_description:
Rec Room is the best place to build and play games together. Party up with friends from all around the world to chat, hang out, explore MILLIONS of player-created rooms, or build something new and amazing to share with us all.
Rec Room is free, and cross plays on everything from phones to VR headsets. It’s the social app you play like a video game!

2138444881.title: THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION
2138444881.short_description:
Find a way to lift a curse on the lone survivor of horrifying incident in this cinematic first-person horror game!

Hui-Ting’s investigation into a forgotten resort ended in tragedy. She was the sole survivor of a horrifying accident, plagued now by relentless nightmares. A desperate visit to a medium reveals a terrifying truth: she is haunted by a vengeful spirit, and the curse that took her colleagues is still tightening its grip on her life.

To survive, Hui-Ting must return to the epicenter of her terror, the abandoned resort. There, she must perform a desperate ritual to sever the connection. But the grounds are alive with malice, guarding secrets of past atrocities and a truth far more sinister than she imagined. She must uncover the intertwining mysteries of this place, or become its final victim.

Guide Hui-Ting through a nightmare where every shadow holds a memory and every spirit seeks vengeance. Solve intricate puzzles, piece together clues from the past, and use your wits to hide from the relentless supernatural forces that stalk the halls. Your courage will be tested, and only by facing the past can you hope to break the curse.

2138534542.title: Raccoon is Hungry (Windows)
2138534542.short_description: Racoon is Hungry is the second installment of the "Is Hungry" series. Follow the adventures of a gluttonous racoon searching for food, but in the city the food is not as easy to pass by on the ground. To find food the racoon must search inside dumpsters for edibles food, such as apples, slices of piza, hamburguers, grapes and so on. But watch out, as food is not the only thing that is possible to find on a dumpster! What kind of surprise awaits the curious racoon?

2138535394.title: Rugby League Live 3
2138535394.short_description: It’s Footy season and this is Rugby League Live 3!!! Featuring: Be a Pro mode, Fanhub Player Sharing, a Dynamic Tacking System and Action replay! Plus all 2014/2015 rule changes, updates to current 2015 rosters and team uniforms.

2138597343.title: Kingdoms and Castles Demo
2138597343.short_description: Forge your kingdom's destiny in Kingdoms and Castles, a captivating city-building adventure where your choices define your realm's prosperity and survival.

2138600918.title: Little Kingdom RTS (Windows)
2138600918.short_description: In Little Kingdom RTS, you take on the role of the ruler of a small kingdom. With limited resources, you must build a base, organize the extraction of wood, stone, and wheat, erect defenses, raise an army, and fend off enemies.

2138628084.title: Expansion for Explorer
2138628084.short_description:
Expansion for Explorer is a hub with unreleased games developed by Marcelo de Souza.

It also contains inbuilt tools to mod the inbuilt games or other games which supports and allows public Mods such as Minecraft.

Games included.

+ Hit the Diamond. V 1.0
It has the fashion of a very old classical style game, shoot all the enemies before they pass through you, each level increases the dificulty.

2138676726.title: Super Chess
2138676726.short_description: You can play it with AI (your device brain) . It is classic chess game. It has undo and redo features.

2138688417.title: Shadows of Arcania (Windows)
2138688417.short_description: Step out of retirement and save the magical realm of Arcania! Play as Meryl in this thrilling action platformer, master powerful elemental spells by collecting lost book pages, and defeat a shadow-possessed wizard to restore peace.

2138726693.title: Steampunch (Xbox One)
2138726693.short_description: A STEAM-POWERED ADVENTURE FULL OF ADRENALINE!

2138769152.title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions

2138769337.title: Gryphon Knight Epic: Definitive Edition
2138769337.short_description: Gryphon Knight Epic is a 2D Medieval Shoot’em up that mixes elements from classical shoot’em ups, exploration and duel-like boss battles, it tells the story of Sir Oliver and Aquila, an accomplished knight and his loyal gryphon that are forced back to adventure once again.

2139029288.title: Space Station Sprint
2139029288.short_description: Infiltrate each space station and complete your objective before your escape ship is spotted by the enemy. Sprint your way to find the quickest path to the objective and Space Jump back to your escape ship. Use your slide, grenade, shockwave, and slow motion abilities to increase your chance to survive. Find permanent upgrades, time bonuses, collectibles, and secrets throughout each space station.

2139071220.title: Vera Blanc: Full Moon
2139071220.short_description: A detective mystery thriller visual novel!

2139098715.title: Section 13
2139098715.short_description: Unravel a thrilling sci-fi mystery in this action-packed twin-stick roguelite shooter. Select your load-out, stack up temporary and persistent upgrades, and delve into the depths of a subterranean base, either alone or in a group of up to 3 players.

2139111044.title: Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club
2139111044.short_description:
Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club is a gripping continuation of Kaito’s story, set in a world of fierce battles and emotional growth.

After months of relentless training, Kaito enters his first professional fighting tournament, determined to prove himself. As he climbs the ranks, he faces not only skilled opponents but also people from his past — childhood friends, former crushes, and rivals turned companions. Each fight is charged with memories, tension, and hidden emotions.

With every victory and loss, Kaito grows — not just as a fighter, but as a person. Bonds are tested, old flames flicker, and the spotlight of the stage reveals more than just skill. It uncovers the heart beneath the gloves.

2139269757.title: Save My Wife (XBOX SERIES)
2139269757.short_description: Save My Wife is a 2D platformer focused on agility and precision. The hero's peace is shattered when the fearsome Black Wizard kidnaps his wife in the blink of an eye. Wielding his trusty sword, he must traverse perilous environments and overcome dynamic challenges to face the villain and bring his love back home.

2139353144.title: Tested on Humans: Escape Room
2139353144.short_description: You are the test subject. In this dark environment escape room, you have to solve puzzles to escape from the research center where you are trapped. Can you find out how you got there and escape?

2139482268.title: Ravva and the Cyclops Curse
2139482268.short_description:
Unleash your summoning powers to defeat the Cyclops Lord in retro 8-bit style!

Take the role young summoner apprentice Ravva as she calls upon her 4 unique companions in a desperate struggle against the Cyclops Lord! After Ravva’s mother is suddenly stripped of her summoning powers and inflicted with a terrible curse, Ravva is faced with the perilous task of saving her and restoring peace to their homeland. Traverse dark forests, desolate wastelands and spooky castle halls, using the talents of your unusual minions to cast elemental spells and clear away obstacles. Merciless enemies under the Cyclops Lord’s command will try to stop little Ravva at every turn, but with enough wit and determination, she will prevail!

Inspired by 8-bit platformers, Ravva and the Cyclops Curse combines clever level design with vibrant pixel art and precise controls to pay homage to those genre classics while offering a new and fresh experience. Endearing characters, fluid animation and brain-teasing puzzles fill 10 challenging stages as you journey to the Cyclops Lord’s castle. Discover power-ups, scores and secrets hidden along the way!

2139519684.title: Hydroneer
2139519684.short_description: Hydroneer is a mining and base building sandbox. Dig for gold and other resources to turn a profit and enhance your mining operation. Build a base of operations, forge weapons, go fishing, and dig deep!

2139570900.title: くにおくん ザ・ワールド ～熱血高校ドッジボール部～
2139570900.short_description:
2018年12月にリリースされた「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」に収録されている18作品から、
「熱血高校ドッジボール部」を単品作品としてリリース！！！

動作や仕様の改善がされている「クオリティアップ版」、
当時のタイトルをオリジナルのまま収録した「オリジナル版」の2つのモードを搭載！
あの裏技やゲームバランスもそのままお楽しみいただけます！

【作品紹介】
本作品はくにおくんシリーズ初のスポーツゲームとしてリリースされた、
アーケード版からのアレンジ移植作品になります。

一般的なドッジボールのルールとは異なり、
相手チームの内野手にボールを当てると体力を減らすことができ、
体力が無くなった選手は失格となってしまいます。
相手チーム全員を失格にすれば勝利となります。

選手ごとに特徴があるパラメータや「必殺シュート」があり、
「ダッシュ」「ジャンプ」「パス」などを駆使した駆け引きが攻略の要素になっています。
ストーリーの攻略はもちろん、対戦ゲームとしても奥の深い本作品を、
ぜひお楽しみください！

■クオリティアップ版での変更点
キャラクターのシュートテクで使用可能なシュートを変更
・シュートテク7以上 ダッシュナイスシュートが可能
・シュートテク10以上 ダッシュジャンプナイスシュートが可能
・シュートテク12以上 その場ジャンプからスーパーナイスシュートが可能
・シュートテク15以上 ダッシュスーパーナイスシュート、ダッシュジャンプスーパーナイスシュートが可能

「くらぶかつどう」で全チームが使用可能
ダッシュナイスシュートのタイミングを変更（5歩）
はなそのこうこう「なりたか」のその場ジャンプからの必殺シュートを変更
はなそのこうこう「あきら」「まさひこ」にその場ジャンプからの必殺シュートを追加
ちらつき・処理落ちの軽減
バグ修正

※本製品は別売タイトル「くにおくん ザ・ワールド クラシックスコレクション」とのネットワークプレイには対応しておりません。
本製品のネットワークプレイは、本製品同士のプレイヤーのみご利用いただけます。.

2139612962.title: Potata: fairy flower (Xbox Series X|S)
2139612962.short_description: Adventure platformer about Potata's travel in fairy forest. Reveal all secrets and hidden treasures and don't forget to save the world.

2139646219.title: VALORANT
2139646219.short_description:
VALORANT is a character-based 5v5 tactical shooter set on the global stage. Outwit, outplay, and outshine your competition with tactical abilities, precise gunplay, and adaptive teamwork.

DEFY THE LIMITS
Blend your style and experience on a global, competitive stage. You have 13 rounds to attack and defend your side using sharp gunplay and tactical abilities. And, with one life per-round, you'll need to think faster than your opponent if you want to survive. Take on foes across Competitive and Unranked modes as well as Deathmatch and Spike Rush.

CREATIVITY IS YOUR GREATEST WEAPON
More than guns and bullets, you’ll choose an Agent armed with adaptive, swift, and lethal abilities that create opportunities to let your gunplay shine. No two Agents play alike, just as no two highlight reels will look the same.

FIGHT AROUND THE WORLD
Each map is a playground to showcase your creative thinking. Purpose-built for team strategies, spectacular plays, and clutch moments. Make the play others will imitate for years to come.

2139913324.title: Hindsight 20/20 - Wrath of the Raakshasa
2139913324.short_description: Hindsight 20/20: Wrath of the Raakshasa is a 3D third-person action RPG with morality decisions created by BioWare and Sucker Punch veterans. Carve out your destiny with choices and actions that truly matter.

2139967680.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Open Network Test
2139967680.short_description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Open Network Test is available now!

Race with players from around the world during this limited free-to-play period!

Open Network Test:
United States (PST) Thurs, Aug. 28, 9:00 p.m. to Mon, Sept. 1, 9:00 p.m.
United Kingdom (UTC) Fri, Aug. 29, 4:00 a.m. to Tues, Sept. 2, 4:00 a.m.
Japan (JST) Fri, Aug. 29, 1:00 p.m. to Tues, Sept. 2, 1:00 p.m.

Content included in the Open Network Test

• World Match – Online Mode (Days 1-2, 4): Compete against 11 other players and rank up! Squads will also be available during this period.
• Festival – Online Mode (Day 3): Try racing as Joker during the Joker Festival Event, where players are split into teams of 3 to compete for points. The team with the most points at the end of the Festival earns rewards!
• Grand Prix – Offline Mode: Go for gold in the Donpa Grand Prix!
• Time Trial – Offline Mode: Race for the best time in 1 of 3 tracks from the Donpa Grand Prix!

All players who participate in the Open Network Test will receive an exclusive Decal and Title for their vehicles when the full game launches.

Please note:
• Local split-screen multiplayer is not supported on the Open Network Test.
• Save data will not carry over to the full game.

For more information, please see: https://RaceCrossWorlds.com/.

2139970300.title: Moonglow Bay
2139970300.short_description: Embark on a journey as a rookie angler in Moonglow Bay, fulfilling your partner's final wish. Team up with friends, family, and neighbours to hone your fishing skills, nourish relationships, and restore a remote town's fractured community in this slice-of-life fishing RPG!

2140018399.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures Deluxe
2140018399.short_description: Adventure and family fun await! Build over 200 wacky rides, coasters, shops and more.

2140111917.title: The Shapeshifting Detective
2140111917.short_description: The Shapeshifting Detective is a supernatural-noir murder mystery FMV game where you play as a detective who can shapeshift into other characters, allowing you to unlock secret conversations and private encounters.

2140131389.title: [REDACTED]
2140131389.short_description: In [REDACTED], a fast-action isometric roguelike, a shadowy agent watches Black Iron Prison spiral into chaos. As one of the last guards, fight through monsters, rivals, and reanimated corpses of your fellow guards to escape the penitentiary alive.

2140145081.title: Pirate Monkey Match
2140145081.short_description:
Jake and Jade, the Pirate Monkeys, star in their own Match Game. Help Jake and Jade master the 100 levels along the path. 

Match 3 or more candies in a row to clear them. More than three results in a power candy that when matched with two others candies of the same color has a powerful effect. Different levels have different requirements to clear. Match a certain number of candies of a certain color, clear all the sugar, find hidden pineapples, drop ingredients such as bananas and coconut milk, and more.

Clear the boards with less than the allowed or moves, or within the time limit. Fail and you'll have to try again.

Please note:
Creators Collection games, such as this one, cannot contain Xbox LIVE achievements and as such cannot increase your GamerScore.

2140148075.title: Taco Tom 2
2140148075.short_description: It's time to make some tacos!

2140165399.title: Regions of Ruin
2140165399.short_description: Regions of Ruin is a 2D side-scrolling RPG with town-building where you are introduced to an open world that progressively challenges your hero and settlement the further you delve into the vast continent.

2140273725.title: Petey Pedro unBEETable Adventure Demo
2140273725.short_description: Help Petey Pedro get back home after falling into a magical world where the SWEETS he chose over a healthy BEET are now his worst nightmare. A colorful 2D platformer inspired by the golden age of classic side-scrolling adventures. Jump, explore, collect coins and hidden treasures, unlock power-ups, battle quirky bosses, and discover secret-filled levels in a fun family-friendly adventure.

2140283055.title: Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Editions
2140283055.short_description:
Gather your party: the RPG saga returns. Immerse yourself in an epic RPG series where every choice matters. Play over 100 hours of adventure in enhanced editions of Baldur’s Gate and Baldur’s Gate II— plus the full Siege of Dragonspear expansion!

- CONTENT -

BALDUR’S GATE: ENHANCED EDITION
Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition brings you the classic RPG with fresh updates for modern adventurers. Customize your hero, recruit a party of brave allies, and explore the Sword Coast in your search for adventure, profit…and the truth. The enhanced edition includes:
• The Original Baldur’s Gate Campaign
• The Sword Coast Expansion
• New challenges in the Black Pits arena

BALDUR’S GATE II: ENHANCED EDITION
The legendary adventure continues as you explore the Forgotten Realms and discover your destiny! Includes the original campaign and expansions: 
• The original Shadows of Amn campaign
• The Throne of Bhaal expansion
• New challenges in the Black Pits II arena

BALDUR’S GATE: SIEGE OF DRAGONSPEAR (EXPANSION)
Explore a brand new chapter in the Baldur’s Gate Saga! Siege of Dragonspear is a full expansion to Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition, with 25+ hours of adventure in the classic style of the original RPG.

2140309950.title: Gravity Duck
2140309950.short_description: Help a Duck become super rich by flipping towards golden eggs for a Maui Statue!

2140351236.title: Morgan: Metal Detective
2140351236.short_description: A cosy, first person metal detector adventure game, where you reunite residents of the beautiful Cornish island of Glasden with things they have lost. And with your late Grandpa's help, maybe restore magic along the way.

2140366834.title: Loot River Demo
2140366834.short_description: Explore procedurally generated labyrinths in a dungeon crawling action roguelike that combines tense, real-time combat with spatial block-shifting - slide blocks of ancient ruins, fight bestial abominations, loot, explore, level-up, strategize, cast powerful spells, die and wake up anew.

2140460499.title: Before We Leave
2140460499.short_description: Before We Leave is a city building game set in a cozy corner of the universe. Nurture your Peeps and their surroundings while rebuilding and rediscovering civilisation. Settle new lands and planets while avoiding hungry Space Whales.

2140470058.title: Bouncy Bullets 2
2140470058.short_description: In this colorful world, shoot bouncing bullets to achieve victory!

2140572340.title: Escape Fnafena
2140572340.short_description: It is a brand new horror game. The adventure of Fnafena begins. Search for clues. I wish secret places. Collect the items. Unlock locked doors. Run away from scary beings. Try to solve the mystery in the house. It is a very scary game.

2140583401.title: Sensible Blood Rugby
2140583401.short_description: An hommage to classic arcade game from the 90s, adapted to the olympic sports of rugby sevens !

2140620075.title: Loot Box Simulator
2140620075.short_description: Do you love to spend money in order to buy loot boxes that are filled with crappy items? NO, OF COURSE NOT! With LOOT BOX SIMULATOR you can open as many item packed loot boxes as you want while finishing easy, funny and very questionable click quests. Can you collect them all?

2140624229.title: BINGO Hall
2140624229.short_description: Play Bingo with friends and family in person. When you buy BINGO Hall you get everything you'll need to play Bingo. Play Bingo today; get it on Windows 10 and Xbox.

2140732504.title: zombie destruction le retour unité
2140732504.short_description: zombie destruction est un jeu dans lequel vous devrez détruire une centaine de zombies sans vous faire toucher. Si vous vous faites toucher, vous perdez des points de vie. A chaque fois que vous tuez des zombies, vous récupérer un certain nombre de points. Vous évoluerez dans des décors de folie, toujours plus attirants pour le joueur...

2140749722.title: Vanaris Tactics
2140749722.short_description:
Vanaris Tactics is a short narrative tactical RPG experience that tells a story about refugees fleeing their occupied motherland.
You lead a group of refugees looking for freedom outside the walls of Vanaris, unite your people and use tactical prowess to escape your oppressors.

2140805845.title: Wizards of Brandel
2140805845.short_description: You wake up and notice... that your house is gone! Retrieve your life back through a new adventure in a fantasy RPG!

2140840644.title: Soundfall
2140840644.short_description: Feel the Beat. Use the Beat. Defend the Beat.

2140849257.title: Maisons de repos
2140849257.short_description: Maison's de repos Based on true events is a survival horror where players take on the role of the new night shift worker Karen who is starting her first shift at Briarwood house. After being left alone to look after four vulnerable elderly residents with little to no experience things soon turn ugly when your left in a power cut and left in the dark halls and corridors of briarwood house that is also rumoured to be haunted by the ghost of the white lady. Can you handle the night shift!

2140882795.title: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
2140882795.short_description: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game that will push your skills to the limit.

2140888699.title: 3 Minutes to Midnight
2140888699.short_description: In a race against time, Betty embarks on a thrilling, comedy-packed adventure to crack a conspiracy that starts with a bang and ends at 3 Minutes to Midnight.

2140925602.title: Particle Hearts
2140925602.short_description: In Particle Hearts, you explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and uncover the role you play in this sinister and beautiful land.

2140969580.title: Space Escape
2140969580.short_description: Space Escape is a retro style platform pixel game. Your character automatically runs forward until bumping into something and then it runs in the opposite direction. Your only move you can control is having your character jump. In many cases this game requires extensive use of the double jump, often requiring you to jump into a wall and then jump again to move in the opposite direction. As you get into higher levels some of the traps can move just like enemies do. There are 4 power up types. Some of the power ups actually work against you. For instance, the power up which makes you run faster means you have less time to react before potentially running over spikes or running into an enemy. Other power ups can help you a lot. A power up which makes you smaller is helpful if you have to jump over spikes in a narrow passageway.

2140987130.title: Awakening the Charge
2140987130.short_description: Awakening the Charge is a colorful puzzle platformer with action elements. In this game you play as a small robot that, with the help of a charge, uses different mechanisms and destroys enemies. Improve your abilities with microcircuits, defeat big bosses, solve interesting puzzles. Immerse yourself in the world of robots and try to figure out what caused the massive failure in it.

2141077076.title: Dragon Snack: From Ice to Ember (Xbox Series)

2141103826.title: Undungeon

2141212892.title: 33 Immortals
2141212892.short_description: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

2141271000.title: Project Nightmares Case 36: Henrietta Kedward
2141271000.short_description:
Explore a living nightmare in this ever-changing bone-chilling survival horror.
Can you survive the horrors lurking in Henrietta Kedward's dark past? 
Experience a twisted tale of paranormal terror and mystery.

2141363036.title: Worldless
2141363036.short_description: Worldless is a stylised 2D platformer with a unique, active, turn-based combat system, and a mind-bending interpretative narrative. Players embark on a journey of self-growth and understanding, pushing the limits of their nature in a newly born and abstract universe.

2141425860.title: Deleveled Demo
2141425860.short_description: Master momentum in this unique jumping game that features no jump button! Preserve your potential energy and fall to new heights as you solve these clever puzzles and maneuver your way to victory.

2141647881.title: Tales from the Borderlands - Episode 1: Zer0 Sum
2141647881.short_description: Download Episode One of Tales from the Borderlands, a five part episodic game series from the creators of The Walking Dead: A Telltale Games Series. Set on the unforgiving world of Pandora after the events seen in Borderlands 2, this is a story full of Borderlands’ trademark humor, following two adventurers on their quest for greatness. You’ll play as Rhys, a Hyperion ‘suit’ with dreams of being the next Handsome Jack, and Fiona, a Pandoran con artist looking to score her biggest ever swindle.

2141648684.title: Edna & Harvey: The Breakout - Anniversary Edition
2141648684.short_description: Edna & Harvey are back! The award-winning adventure has a new paintjob! For "Edna & Harvey: The Breakout – Anniversary Edition", Daedalic's classic has been redrawn and received a nice overhaul: high resolution visuals, new technology, intuitive controls – it's a truly insane adventure. Experience this quirky cult classic with Edna & Harvey anew or for the first time, but better than ever before!

2141672058.title: OVIVO
2141672058.short_description: OVIVO is a mesmerizing platformer with unusual mechanics where everything is as simple as black and white. It is a metaphorical game filled with illusions and hidden messages.

2141688284.title: Wildmender
2141688284.short_description: A desert gardening survival game. Start from a tiny spring and cultivate a blooming garden. Explore a vast world amid the sands and uncover its mysteries. Can you defend against the relentless forces of nature and mysterious wraith corruption, to bring life to a dying world?

2141690330.title: Merek's Market
2141690330.short_description: Merek’s Market is a chaotic crafting game about running a medieval shop. Take ownership of Merek’s Market as you haggle, barter and craft your way through a comical single player campaign or team up with friends to supply the whole town.

2141742892.title: Deep Space Shooter
2141742892.short_description: Again you are alone against the hordes of hostile spacecrafts where you can only rely on yourself. It is the victory or the death!

2141778943.title: Xeno Crisis
2141778943.short_description: Xeno Crisis is an arena shooter in which up to two players enter a ravaged research outpost to confront an alien menace and get out alive! Run and gun your way through thousands of adversaries as you search for the source of the deadly alien outbreak.

2142005586.title: Nefiriya and the Sands of Eternity
2142005586.short_description: Nefiriya has just awakened from her 3,000-year slumber. Help her find a way out of the pyramid and begin a new life in the contemporary world! But beware—her destiny is in your hands. Collect gemstones along the way so she can live a wealthy and luxurious life.

2142027917.title: Fallout Shelter
2142027917.short_description:
***
Fallout Shelter is no longer playable from Xbox.com or the Xbox app on PC.
***

Fallout Shelter puts you in control of a state-of-the-art underground Vault from Vault-Tec. Build the perfect Vault, keep your Dwellers happy, and protect them from the dangers of the Wasteland.

2142029144.title: Beyond Doors (Windows)
2142029144.short_description: Door-to-door, embark on a mystical journey.

2142047281.title: Lots Of Things Collector's Edition
2142047281.short_description:
Puzzles, mini games and plenty of hidden objects!

Explore a wide variety of topics, from a farm and a confectionery shop to a laboratory and a medieval castle. 
Finish the levels in new "Layers" modes, where you have to search for the right objects among a various things. 
Overgo the themes in any order - either starting with mini-games or searching for objects, as you like! 
This hidden object game is full of new interesting locations and hidden things. 
Use your search skills and logic to complete puzzles and find all hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes:
- 5 supplementary themes, accommodating 10 more locations for hidden objects!
- 10 mini games, across all themes
- 14 collector's puzzles that you can collect while playing!

2142053337.title: Trüberbrook
2142053337.short_description:
SCI-FI IN 1960s GERMANY

»Trüberbrook« is a thrilling mystery-sci-fi adventure game. Enjoy an adventurous vacation to a 1960's parallel universe! A Sci-Fi-Mystery Adventure Game with handmade scenery.

2142075035.title: Bunny Pit Stop (Windows)
2142075035.short_description: Smart moves keep the pit stop running.

2142080360.title: Love is all around (Japanese Dub) Demo
2142080360.short_description:
"Love Is All Around" is a simulating love story real-life full-motion interactive video . You will not only meet but also fall in love with six beauties with completely different personalities and styles, eventually embark on an immersive and sweet journey one after another.
Under their charisma, how would you deal with the six beauties while you are busy at paying off debts? Would you ignore your feelings and focus on making money? Or would you choose love over money? Among these beauties, who would you choose to be your partner for the rest of your life?

Is it the extremely charming ingenue girl?
Is it the mature girl with intellectual tenderness and gentleness?
Is it the innocent, lovely gamine girl?
If the above isn’t what’s in your mind, then there’s…
Unruly and willful, but slightly masochistic girl who born with a silver spoon!
Sexy, hot, and delicate goddess!
Noble and glamorous, a domineering female CEO who loves you solely!
There is always one that will make you fall in love with it! The right to choose a love one is now in your hands!

Product Features
·Full first-person perspective during the whole story, immersive experience of love -"Love Is All Around" is first-person perspective throughout, completely immersed in scene interaction and real-life simulation. It provides the immersive simulation experience, allows you to try more, and have an immersive love experience with the girl you like.

·Multiple branches, multiple endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes - the interactive video has designed more than a hundred story branches, twelve endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes for you, additionally, you can find achievement system, mining and multiple experiences in product. In the product, make the choice that goes with your heart, rather than the correct choice.

·Acting by real actors , shooting in real-life scenes - numerous wonderful behind-the-scenes stories are waiting to be discovered, revealing the actor's understandings of the character's inner world, and unravel the secrets of flirting through girl’s perspective.

·Various ways to play, finding the faint clues - the game life is not limited to choices, the key clues of the follow-up plot can be hidden in the scene, faint clues can closely related to the ending. Maybe everything is predestined, but sometimes being brave will change your fate. Come and play out your story.

·Six girls with very different personalities can be introduced—either charming, or tender, or innocent, or capricious, or sexy, or glamorous, there is always a kind of girl that make you exclaim: " Damn it! I am surrounded by beauties! "

About Us
We are "intiny", we are all "split personality" nerds who want to have date every day, but will never step out of the house to the real world. Thereford, we would like use interactive video as tool to create one fantasy dream after another, to create dreams for players, and to make our dreams to come true for ourselves.

2142151190.title: Jurassic Differences (Windows)
2142151190.short_description: Travel back to the age of dinosaurs in Jurassic Differences! Spot hidden changes in vibrant prehistoric scenes packed with playful details and visual surprises. Race the clock or relax in Casual Mode as you uncover every clever difference. Perfect for sharp-eyed puzzle fans!

2142183333.title: Drink 'Em Demo
2142183333.short_description: The first ever drinking video game! Grab 8 people and gather around the TV to get the party started. Play against each other or team up in a bunch of mini games. Losers end up drinking! Play exclusive drinking games never seen in a video game before. Start your next party right with Drink Inc!

2142309066.title: WWE 2K Battlegrounds
2142309066.short_description: The world of WWE is your battleground with all-new, over the top, in-your-face arcade action as your favorite WWE Superstars and Legends battle it out in outlandish environments with an arsenal of moves, special abilities, and power-ups. Compete in your favorite match types including Steel Cage, Royal Rumble, Fatal Four Way and more, as Mauro Ranallo and Jerry “The King” Lawler call the mayhem!

2142315481.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind
2142315481.short_description: In Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind, the team faces off against a robotic reincarnation of the Power Rangers' long-time nemesis. Robo Rita has conjured a portal to send herself back in time so she can finally vanquish the Power Rangers by forming an alliance with her younger self.

2142413322.title: Word-Up.free
2142413322.short_description:
Word-Up.free is a Windows store and a Windows Phone store word puzzle game where you should construct words by tapping on different letters. 
Longer words and words that contain gold letters give bonus points.
Fail to construct a correct word will cause a penalty of 30 seconds.
It is very addictive and challenging game.
Find as many words as you can and beat the record.
Keep playing.

2142468457.title: Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club (Windows)
2142468457.short_description:
Beautiful Sakura: Fighting Club is a gripping continuation of Kaito’s story, set in a world of fierce battles and emotional growth.

After months of relentless training, Kaito enters his first professional fighting tournament, determined to prove himself. As he climbs the ranks, he faces not only skilled opponents but also people from his past — childhood friends, former crushes, and rivals turned companions. Each fight is charged with memories, tension, and hidden emotions.

With every victory and loss, Kaito grows — not just as a fighter, but as a person. Bonds are tested, old flames flicker, and the spotlight of the stage reveals more than just skill. It uncovers the heart beneath the gloves.

2142487375.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
2142487375.short_description:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection assembles thirteen classic TMNT games by Konami in one incredible package. This collection provides a unique opportunity for gamers to experience these immensely popular and very influential games on XBOX and includes a fantastic set of new quality of life features:

Added Online Play* for certain games and Local Couch Play

Unique Development Art & Sketches
Historic TMNT Media Content

The games are based on the characters and themes from on the 80's children's cartoon and comic book series, The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. The game often takes place in a fictionalized New York city, in the sewers, inside futuristic enemy bases and even across time itself! Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection will be available on XBOX in 2022!

•Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (SG)
